translations.translation: karuNAmaYa o parama daYAlu AllAhara nAme
sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, (yini) nikhila jagatera prabhu;
karuNAmaYa, daYAlu
vicAra-dinera mAlika|
AmarA tomArai ivAdata kari evaM tomArai sAhAyya cAi|
AmAderake saThika patha dekhAo;
tAderai patha, yAderake tumi anugraha karecho; tAdera patha naYa, yArA (tomAra) krodhera pAtra kiMvA vipathagAmI|
Alipha lAma mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
ei to kitAva, yAte kona sandeha nei, Ache mottAkIdera (anyAYa parihArakArI, AllAhabhIru, satkarmazIla o dharmaparAYaNa vyaktidera) janya pathanirdeza;
yArA adRzya satyake vizvAsa kare, nAmAya AdAYa kare, Ara Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tA theke (satkAje) vyaYa kare;
yArA tomAra kAche yA nAyila karA haYeche evaM tomAra pUrve (anya navIdera kAche) yA nAyila karA haYechila tA vizvAsa kare; Ara parakAlera prati tArA dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe|
e dharanera lokerAi tAdera prabhura saThika pathe Ache evaM erAi saphalakAma|
vastuta yArA (satyake) avizvAsa kare tAderake tumi satarka karo kiMvA nA karo, tAdera janya ekai kathA, tArA vizvAsa karave nA|
AllAha tAdera antara o kAna sIla kare diYechena evaM tAdera cokhera opara ekaprakAra AvaraNa par3eche| odera janya var3arakama zAsti nirdhArita Ache|
AvAra kichu mAnuSa Ache yArA vale, “AmarA AllAha o parakAlake vizvAsa karechi”; kintu Asale tArA vizvAsI naYa|
tArA AllAha o vizvAsIdera dho~kA dite cAYa; tave kAryata tArA nijederakei dho~kA deYa, yA tArA vujhate pAre nA|
tAdera antare ekaTi vyAdhi Ache; AllAha tAdera se vyAdhi vAr3iYe diYechena| Ara mithyA valAra kAraNe tAdera janya kaSTadAYaka zAsti nirdiSTa Ache|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “tomarA pRthivIte vivAda sRSTi karo nA,” takhana tArA vale, “AmarAto kevala zAnti pratiSThA karate cAi|”
jene rekho, tArAi vivAda sRSTikArI; tave tArA tA upalavdhi kare nA|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “anya lokerA yemana ImAna eneche tomarAo temani ImAna Ana,” takhana tArA vale, “AmarA ki vokAdera mata ImAna Anate pAri?” jene rekho, Asale tArAi vokA; tave tArA tA jAne nA|

tArA yakhana ImAnadAradera sAthe milita haYa takhana vale, “AmarA ImAna enechi”; AvAra yakhana nijedera zaYatAnadera (duSTa vyaktidera) sAnnidhye yAYa takhana vale, “AmarA tomAdera saGgei Achi; AmarA kevala tAmAzA karachi|”
AllAhao tAdera sAthe tAmAzA karachena (tAdera tAmAzAra pAlTA vyavasthA nicchena) evaM tAderake Aro anyAYa karAra avakAza dicchena, yAte tArA pathahArA haYe ghurate thAke|
orA to hedAYetera parivarte bhraSTatA kraYa kareche| phale tAdera vyavasAo lAbhajanaka haYani evaM tArA hedAYetao pAYani|

tAdera upamA: yena eka vyakti (Alora janya) Aguna jvAliYeche; tArapara Aguna yakhana tAra AzapAza Alokita karala takhana AllAha tAdera Alo niYe gelena evaM tAderake andhakAre phele dilena, tArA Ara dekhate pAYa nA|
tArA (yena) vadhira, vovA o andha; tAi (satpathe) phire Asate pArache nA|

athavA (tAdera upamA:) yena AkAzera vRSTivAhI megha, yAra madhye raYeche andhakAra o vajra-vidyut; tArA mRtyura bhaYe vajrapAtera zavda pratirodhera janya kAne AGgula diYe rAkhache| vastuta AllAha kApheradera gherAo kare rekhechena|

vidyut (tAra jhalakAni diYe) tAdera dRSTi ker3e nevAra upakrama kare| yakhanai tA tAdera janya Alora vikiraNa ghaTAYa takhanai tArA tAte patha cale; AvAra yakhana tAdera opara andhakAra neme Ase takhana tArA dA~r3iYe thAke| Ara AllAha icchA karale tAdera zravaNazakti o dRSTizakti (ekevAre) niYe nite pAratena| AllAha to savakichui karAra kSamatA rAkhena|
he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera prabhura dAsatva karo, yini tomAderake evaM tomAdera pUrve yArA chila tAderake sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA (akalyANa theke) ve~ce thAkate pAra|

yini tomAdera janya pRthivIke vichAnA evaM AkAzake zAmiYAnA vAniYe diYechena; Ara AkAza theke pAni varSaNa kare tAra sAhAyye tomAdera jIvikAra janya phalamUla utpanna karechena| tomarA tAi savakichu jene AllAhara janya aMzIdAra sAvyasta karo nA|

Ara Ami AmAra vAndAra opara yA nAyila karechi (arthAt koraAna) se samvandhe yadi tomAdera kona sandeha thAke tAhale (nijerA) tAra Adale ekaTi sUrA racanA kare dekhAo evaM AllAha vyatIta tomAdera sAkSIderake (athavA sAhAyyakArIderake) DAka; yadi tomarA Antarika hao|
Ara yadi tA karate nA pAra—evaM avazyai tA pAravenA—tAhale (jAhAnnAmera) sei Agunake bhaYa karo, yAra jvAlAni have mAnuSa o pAthara; evaM yA avizvAsIdera janya prastuta karA haYeche|

Ara vizvAsI o satkarmazIladera susaMvAda dAo ye, (vehezate) tAdera janya vAga-vAgicA thAkave, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita have; yakhanai tAderake sekhAna theke kona phala khete deoYA have, takhanai tArA valave, “eTAto sei khAvAra yA AmAderake itipUrveo deoYA haYeche|” (erUpa valAra kAraNa,) tAderake ekai AkRtira vastu deoYA haYeche| (yadio pratiTi vastura svAda bhinna|) sekhAne tAdera janya pAka-pavitra saGginIrAo thAkave evaM tArA sekhAne cirakAla vAsa karave|

avazyai AllAha kona kichurai udAharaNa dite lajjAvodha karena nA, tA kona mazA hoka kiMvA tAra ceYe aneka var3a kichu (athavA aneka choTa kichu) hoka; erUpa kSetre yArA vizvAsI tArA jAne ye, eTAi tAdera prabhura pakSa theke saThika; Ara yArA avizvAsI tArA vale, “ei jinisera udAharaNa diYe AllAha ki vujhAte ceYechena?” (vastuta) era dvArA tini anekake vipathagAmI karena, AvAra anekake pathera sandhAna dena; tave era dvArA tini phAseka (pApAcArI) vyatIta kAuke vipathagAmI karena nA|

orA to tArAi yArA AllAhara sAthe pAkApAki aGgIkAra karAra parao tA bhaGga kare evaM AllAha yA saMyukta (aTuTa) rAkhAra nirdeza diYechena tA chinna kare Ara pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare| Asale orAi kSatigrasta|

tomarA kIbhAve AllAhake avizvAsa karo? athaca ekasamaYa tomarA chile prANahIna, tArapara tini tomAdera jIvana dAna karechena; erapara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, tArapara AvAra jIvita karavena evaM savazeSe tomAderake tA~ra kAchei phiriYe neoYA have|

tini sei mahAna sattA yini tomAdera janya pRthivIra savakichu sRSTi karechena; tArapara AsamAna sRSTi karate ceYechena evaM suSamabhAve sAta AsamAna sRSTi karechena| tini savakichui bhAlabhAve jAnena|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAra prabhu pherezatAdera valechilena, “Ami pRthivIte (AmAra) eka pratinidhi (mAnuSa) vAnAva;” tArA valechila, “tumi ki sekhAne emana kAuke sRSTi karate cAo ye sekhAne golayoga o raktapAta karave? AmarAi to tomAra saprazaMsa guNagAna karachi evaM tomAra pavitratA varNanA karachi|” (javAve) tini valechilena, “Ami emana tathya jAni yA tomarA jAna nA|”

tini Adamake (sakalera) sava nAma zikhiYe dena; tArapara (nAmagulo yAdera) tAderake pherezatAdera sAmane hAjira kare valena, “yadi tomAdera kathA satya haYa, tAhale tomarA AmAke edera nAmagulo vala dekhi|”
tArA valala, “tomAra mahimA! tumi AmAdera yA zikhiYecho tAra vAire AmAdera kona jJAna nei; vastuta tumii mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|”

tini valalena, “Adama! oderake edera nAmagulo vale dAo|” erapara Adama yakhana pherezatAderake tAdera nAmagulo vale deYa, takhana AllAha valena, “tomAderake valechilAma nA ye, Ami AsamAna o jaminera adRzya rahasya jAni? Ara tomarA yA kichu prakAza karo o yA kichu gopana karate Ami tA-o jAni|”

Ara Ami yakhana pherezatAdera valechilAma, “tomarA Adamera sammAne mAthAnata karo” takhana ivalIsa (zaYatAna) chAr3A anyarA mAthAnata karechila| ivalIsa (se Adeza) amAnya kare evaM nijeke var3a mane kare| ebhAve se akRtajJadera tAlikAbhukta haYa|

Ami (Adamake) valalAma, “he Adama! tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte vAsa karo evaM sekhAna theke yakhana yekhAne cAo tRpti sahakAre (khAdya-sAmagrI) AhAra kara| tave ei gAchaTira kAche yeYo nA, gele tomarA anyAYakArIdera dalabhukta have|”

erapara zaYatAna sekhAna theke tAdera sariYe deYa evaM tArA ye (zAntimaYa) avasthAYa chila tA theke tAderake vera kare deYa| Ami valalAma, “tomarA (pRthivIte) neme yAo, (sekhAne) tomAdera kataka katakera zatru have| Ara pRthivIte tomAdera janya kichukAla paryanta vasavAsa o bhogera vyavasthA Ache|”
Adama takhana (kSamA cAoYAra janya) tAra prabhura kAcha theke kaYekaTi kathA zikhe neYa| ataHpara tini tAke kSamA kare dena| kAraNa, tini to kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

Ami valalAma, “tomarA savAi jAnnAta theke (pRthivIte) neme yAo| anantara (sekhAne) yakhanai AmAra pakSa theke tomAdera kAche kona nirdezanA yAve takhana yArAi AmAra nirdezanA mene calave tAdera kona bhaYa kiMvA duHkha thAkave nA|”
kintu yArA (tA mene calate) asvIkAra karave evaM AmAra pramANasamUhake mithyA valave tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI have, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

he vanI isarAIla (isarAIlera vaMzadharagaNa)! Ami tomAderake ye neYAmata dAna karechi tA smaraNa karo evaM AmAra aGgIkAra pUraNa karo, tAhale Amio tomAdera aGgIkAra pUraNa karava| Ara AmAkei bhaYa kara|

Ara tomAdera sAthe yA Ache (arthAt tAorAta o inajIla) tAra satyAYana-kArIrUpe Ami yA avatIrNa karechi (arthAt koraAna) tA vizvAsa karo evaM tomarA tAra prathama avizvAsakArI haYo nA| Ara tomarA AmAra AYAtasamUha vikri kare sAmAnya mUlya (suvidhA) grahaNa karo nA| Ara AmAkei bhaYa kara|
tomarA satyake asatyera sAthe mizrita karo nA evaM jenezune satya gopana karo nA|
Ara nAmAya AdAYa karo, yAkAta dAo o rukukArIdera sAthe ruku karo (dalavaddhabhAve nAmAya par3a)|
tomarA ki mAnuSake satkAja karate vala Ara nijedera kathA (nijerA tA karate) bhule yAo? athaca tomarA kitAva pATha kara| tAhale ki tomarA vuddhi khATAo nA?
tomarA dhairya o nAmAyera sAhAyya nAo| avazya ei nAmAya ekaTi kaThina kAja; tave ekaniSTha vyaktivargera janya (tA kaThina) naYa,
yArA vizvAsa kare ye, tAdera prabhura saGge tAdera sAkSAt have evaM tArA tA~rai kAche phire yAve|
he vanI isarAIla! Ami tomAderake ye neYAmata diYechi tA smaraNa karo, Ara eTAo smaraNa karo ye, (atIte) Ami tomAderake sArA vizvavAsIra opara zreSThatva dAna karechilAma|

Ara tomarA emana ekaTi dinake bhaYa karo yedina keu kAro kAje Asave nA, kAro kona supAriza gRhIta have nA, kAro theke kona vinimaYa grahaNa karA have nA evaM tAderake (pApIderake) kona sAhAyya karA have nA|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami pherAunera lokadera theke tomAderake rakSA karechilAma, yArA tomAdera opara bhaYAvaha niryAtana cApiYe diYechila| tArA tomAdera chelederake hatyA karata evaM nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| era madhye chila tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke eka virATa parIkSA|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami tomAdera janya samudrake vibhakta kare tomAderake vA~ciYe-chilAma Ara tomAdera cokhera sAmanei pherAunera lokadera DuviYe merechilAma|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami mUsAra janya calliza rAta nirdhAraNa karechilAma| ataHpara nijerA jAlema valei tAra anupasthitite tomarA (upAsyarUpe) vAchura grahaNa karechile|
ai ghaTanAra parao Ami tomAderake kSamA kare diYechilAma, yAte tomarA kRtajJa hao|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami mUsAke kitAva (tAorAta) o satya-mithyAra mAnadaNDa diYechilAma, yAte tomarA dika-nirdezanA pAo|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana mUsA tAra lokaderake valechila, “he AmAra lokerA! tomarA vAchurake upAsya vAniYe nijedera prati juluma karecho| ataeva, tomAdera sraSTAra nikaTa taovA karo evaM nijederake (nijedera madhya theke aparAdhIderake) hatyA kara| tomAdera sraSTAra vicAre seTAi tomAdera janya maGgala|” erapara tini tomAdera taovA kavula karechilena| vastuta tinii taovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomarA valechile, “he mUsA! AmarA AllAhake prakAzye nA dekhA paryanta tomAra kathAYa vizvAsa karava nA|” takhani tomAdera opara vajrapAta hala Ara tomarA tA dekhachile|
tArapara tomAdera mRtyura para Ami AvAra tomAderake jIvita karechilAma, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

Ara Ami tomAdera opara meghera chAYA diYechilAma evaM tomAdera janya (AsamAni khAdya) mAn‌ o sAlaoYA pAThiYechilAma| (Ara valechilAma) “AmAra deoYA uttama khAvAra khAo|” tArA to AmAra opara juluma kareni, varaM nijerAi nijedera opara juluma karachila|

Ara (smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami valechilAma, “ei janapade (jerujAleme) praveza kare era yekhAne cAo sukhe-svAcchandye khAoYA-dAoYA kara| Ara (pravezakAle) ‘kSamA kara’ valate valate mAthAnata kare phaTake praveza karo; Ami tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA kare deva evaM nekakAraderake Aro vezi (puraskAra) deva|”
kintu (ei) jAlemaderake yA (valate) valA haYechila tArA tAra parivarte anya kathA valala| tAi tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe Ami jAlemadera opara AsamAna theke AjAva nAyila karechilAma|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana mUsA tAra lokadera janya pAni ceYechila, Ami valalAma, “(he mUsA!) tumi tomAra lAThi dvArA pAthare AghAta kara|” (mUsA AghAta karale) takhana sekhAna theke vAraTi jharanA niHsRta hala| lokadera pratiTi dala nijedera pAni pAnera jAYagA jene nila| (tAdera valA hala) “AllAhara rijika theke pAnAhAra karo; Ara pRthivIte golayoga sRSTi karo nA|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomarA valechile, “ he mUsA! AmarA ekairakama khAvAre dhairya rAkhate pArava nA; tAi tumi AmAdera janya tomAra prabhura kAche prArthanA karo, tini yena AmAdera janya zAka-savaji, zasA, gama (vA rasuna), DAla, pe~YAja ityAdi mATira phasala utpanna karena|” se (mUsA) valala, “tomarA ki bhAla jinisera parivarte nimnamAnera jinisa pete cAo? (tAhale) kona eka zaharAJcale cale yAo, tomarA yA yA cAile sekhAne tomAdera janya tA savai Ache|” (erapara) tAdera opara lAJchanA o dAridra e~Te deoYA hala evaM tArA AllAhara krodhabhAjana haYe gela| tAdera ai pariNatira kAraNa, tArA AllAhara pramANasamUha avizvAsa karata o navIderake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| tAdera ai pariNatira kAraNa, tArA avAdhya haYechila o sImAlaGghana karata|

ImAnadAra (musalamAna), ihudi, khriSTAna, sAveYI (pherezatA o nakSatrapUjArI ekaTi samapradAYa)—yArAi AllAha o zeSa dine (parakAle) vizvAsa rAkhe Ara satkAja kare, tAdera janya tAdera prabhura kAche puraskAra raYeche| Ara tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|

(he vanI isarAIla! smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami tomAdera (mAthAra) opara tUra pAhAr3a tule dhare tomAdera kAche pratizruti niYechilAma, (Ara valechilAma) “tomAderake yA diYechi tA zakta kare dhare rAkhave evaM tAra madhye yA Ache tA mane rAkhave, yAte tomarA dharmaparAYaNa hate pAra|”
tAra pareo tomarA (sei pratizruti theke) phire giYechile| Asale tomAdera prati yadi AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkato, tAhale avazyai tomarA dhvaMsa haYe yete|
Ara tomAdera madhye yArA zanivArera viSaYaTi samparke vAr3AvAr3i karechila tomarA to tAdera kathA jenecho| takhana Ami tAderake valechilAma, “tomarA nikRSTa vAnara haYe yAo|”
ai ghaTanAke Ami takhanakAra o paravartI lokadera janya ekaTi dRSTAnta evaM dharma-parAYaNadera janya ekaTi zikSAra vastu vAniYe rekhechi|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana mUsA tAra lokaderake valechila, “AllAha tomAderake ekaTi garu javAi karAra Adeza dicchena|” tArA valala, “tumi ki AmAdera sAthe ThATTA karacha?” se valala, “Ami mUrkhadera antarbhukta haoYA theke AllAhara nikaTa AzraYa cAi|” (arthAt Ami AllAhara nirdeza niYe ThATTA karAra mata mUrkha hate pAri nA|)

tArA valala, “tomAra prabhuke vala, tini yena AmAderake vale dena, seTi kemana (garu)|” se valala, “tini valachena, seTi emana ekaTi garu yA adhika vRddhao naYa AvAra ekevAre kamavaYasIo naYa; era mAjhAmAjhi madhyavaYasI| ataeva, tomAderake yA Adeza karA hacche tA kare phela|”
tArA valala, “tomAra prabhuke vala, tini yena AmAderake vale dena, garuTira raM ki|” se valala, “tini valachena, seTi ekaTi haluda raGera garu yAra raM ujjvala o gAr3ha, seTi dekhate khuvai sundara|”

tArA valala, “tomAra prabhuke vala, tini yena AmAderake vale dena, seTi kemana (garu have); AmarA to garu Thika karate pArachi nA (garu to sava AmAdera kAche ekai rakama mane haYa); AllAha cAile avazyai AmarA saThika dika-nirdezanA pAva|”

se valala, “tini valachena, eTi emana ekaTi garu yAke diYe kona kAja karAno haYa nA; se jami cASa kiMvA kSete pAni seca konaTAi kare nA; sampUrNa nikhu~ta, tAra gAYe kona dAga nei|” tArA valala, “evAra tumi Thika valecho|” tArapara tArA seTi javAi karala; yadio tArA tA karAra kAcheo chila nA (kAjaTi karate icchuka chila nA)|
(smaraNa karo) tomarA yakhana ekaTi lokake hatyA kare tAra (hatyAra) vyApAre eke aparera viruddhe abhiyoga karachile; Ara tomarA yA gopana karachile AllAha tA vera karavena vale sthira karechilena|
tAi Ami valalAma, “(javAikRta) garuTira kona aGga dvArA (nihata) lokaTike AghAta kara|” emanibhAve AllAha mRtadera jIvita karena evaM tomAderake tA~ra nidarzana dekhAna, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

ai ghaTanAra para tomAdera mana AvAra kaThina haYe gela| yena tA pAthara kiMvA tAra ceYeo kaThina| kAraNa, emana pAtharao to Ache yA theke jharNAdhArA pravAhita haYa; emana pAtharao Ache yA pheTe giYe tA theke pAni vera haYa; AvAra emana pAtharao Ache yA AllAhara bhaYe nice dhase par3e| tomarA yA karo se samvandhe AllAha vekhavara nana|

(he musalamAnagaNa) tomarA ki tAhale kAmanA karo ye, tArA (ihudirA) tomAdera kathAmato ImAna Anave? athaca tAdera madhye ekaTi dala AllAhara vANI zunata, tArapara vujhate pereo jJAtasAre tA vikRta karata|

yakhana ImAnadAradera sAthe tAdera sAkSAt haYa takhana vale, “AmarA ImAna enechi”, AvAra yakhana nijerA paraspara ekAnte milita haYa takhana (eke anyake) vale, “AllAha (tAorAte zeSa navI samparke) tomAdera kAche yA prakAza karechena tomarA ki tA musalamAnadera kAche vala nAki? tAhale to tArA eTA diYe tomAdera prabhura kAche tomAdera viruddhe yukti pradarzana karave| tomarA ki vujhate pAra nA?”
tArA (ihudirA) ki jAne nA ye, tArA yA gopana kare Ara yA prakAza kare AllAha tA (sava) jAnena|
tAdera madhye ekadala nirakSara loka Ache yArA katipaYa (mithyA) AzA poSaNa chAr3A kitAvera kona jJAna rAkhe nA; Ara tArA zudhu AndAja-anumAnai kare thAke|

yArA nijedera hAte (managar3A) kitAva lekhe, tArapara era vinimaYe sAmAnya mUlya grahaNera janya vale, “eTA AllAhara kAcha theke eseche” tAdera janya zAsti nirdhArita Ache| arthAt tAdera hAta yA likheche tAra kAraNe tAdera janya zAsti raYeche evaM tArA yA upArjana karache tAra kAraNeo tAdera janya zAsti raYeche|

tArA vale, “doyakhera Aguna AmAderake sparza karave nA, tave zudhumAtra kaYekadinera janya|” vala, “tomarA AllAhara kAcha theke kona aGgIkAra niYecho nAki, ye tini tA~ra aGgIkAra bhaGga karavena nA? nAki tomarA AllAhara nAme emana kathA valacha yA tomarA jAna nA|”
vastuta yArA kona pApa kare evaM tAdera pApa tAderake pariveSTana kare rAkhe tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI have, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|
Ara yArA ImAna rAkhe o satkAja kare tArA jAnnAtera adhivAsI have, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami vanI isarAIla theke (ei marme) oYAdA niYechilAma ye, tomarA AllAha chAr3A anya kAro dAsatva karave nA; pitAmAtA, AtmIYa-svajana, anAtha (iYAtIma) o asahAYadera (misakIna) saGge sadaYa AcaraNa karave; mAnuSake bhAla kathA valave; nAmAya AdAYa karave o yAkAta dAna karave| kintu pare alpa kichu loka chAr3A tomarA savAi (sei oYAdA theke) mukha phiriYe niYechile|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAdera theke oYAdA niYechilAma ye, tomarA nijedera madhye raktapAta karave nA evaM nijedera lokaderake gharavAr3i theke vera kare deve nA| takhana tomarA svIkAra karechile, Ara tomarAi to tAra sAkSI|

tArapara ei tomarAi nijedera lokaderake hatyA karacha, tomAdera ekadala lokake tAdera gharavAr3i theke vera kare diccha| tomarA pApa o vAr3AvAr3i kare tAdera viruddhe (tAdera zatruderake) sahayogitA karacha| Ara yadi tArA tomAdera kAche yuddhavandI haYe Ase tAhale AvAra tAdera (muktira) janya muktipaNa niccha (athavA muktipaNa diccha); athaca tAderake vera kare deoYATAi tomAdera janya niSiddha chila| tomarA ki tAhale (AllAhara) kitAvera kichu vizvAsa karo Ara kichu avizvAsa karo? tomAdera madhye yArA emana kAja kare tAdera pratiphala anya kichu naYa— pArthiva jIvane (var3a rakama) lAJchanA, Ara keYAmatera dina tAderake tAr3iYe neoYA have kaThora zAstira dike| tomarA yA karacha se samvandhe AllAha vekhavara nana|
orAi parakAlera mUlye pArthiva jIvana kraYa kareche| sutarAM odera zAstio lAghava karA have nA evaM oderake sAhAyyao karA have nA|

Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechi evaM tAra pare eke eke Aro rasUla pAThiYechi| mariYama-putra IsAke spaSTa nidarzana diYechi evaM pavitra AtmAra (jivarAIla) mAdhyame tAra pRSThapoSakatA karechi| tave ki yakhanai tomAdera kAche tomAdera amanaHpUta viSaYa niYe kona rasUla eseche takhanai tomarA nijederake var3a mane karecho? kAraNa (sei rasUladera) ekadalake tomarA avizvAsa karecho evaM ekadalake hatyA karecho|
tArA valechila, “AmAdera antarasamUha mor3akavaddha (arthAt AllAhara kathA zunate pAYa nA)|” Asale tAdera kupharira kAraNe AllAha tAderake abhizapta karechena| tAi tArA kamai vizvAsa kare|

yakhana tAdera kAche AllAhara pakSa theke kitAva (ei koraAna zarIpha) ela, yA tAdera nikaTa vidyamAna kitAvera (tAorAta o inajIla) satyatA svIkArakArI,— Ara itipUrve tArAi (zeSa navI o tAra kitAvera prasaGga tule) kApheradera viruddhe vijaYa prArthanA karata— (kintu) yakhana tAdera ei pUrvaparicita vastui tAdera kAche ela takhana tArA tA avizvAsa karala| Ara tAi avizvAsIdera opara AllAhara abhizApa|

yAra vinimaYe tArA nijederake vikri kare diYeche tA kata khArApa! tA ei ye, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra kAche icchA tAra anugraha preraNa karena— eTA mAnate nA perei tArA AllAhara nAyilakRta vastu (koraAna) avizvAsa karache| tAi tArA krodhera opara krodhera pAtra haYeche| ei avizvAsIdera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “AllAha yA nAyila karechena tA vizvAsa karo” takhana tArA vale, “AmarA AmAdera kAche yA nAyila karA haYeche tA vizvAsa kari|” kintu tAra pare yA nAyila karA haYeche tA tArA avizvAsa kare, athaca tA satya evaM tAdera kAche yA Ache (tAorAta o inajIla) tArao samarthaka| vala, “tomarA yadi vizvAsIi hao tAhale atIte AllAhara navIderake hatyA karate kena?”
nizcaYai mUsA tomAdera kAche spaSTa pramANa niYe esechila| kintu se cale yAvAra para tomarA (upAsya hiseve) vAchura grahaNa karechile evaM ebhAve (nijedera prati) juluma karechile|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAdera kAche pratijJA niYechilAma o tomAdera mAthAra opara tUra pAhAr3a tule dharechilAma, (Ara valechilAma) “tomAderake yA diYechi tA dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhara Ara (AmAra kathA) zona|” tArA valechila, “AmarA zunalAma o amAnya karalAma|” kupharira kAraNe tAdera antare (upAsya hiseve) vAchuraprIti vaddhamUla haYechila| vala, “tomarA yadi (tomAdera dAvi anuyAYI) ImAnadAra haYe thAka tAhale tomAdera ImAna tomAdera yA karate vale tA kata khArApa!”

(tAderake) vala, “(tomAdera kathA anuyAYI) AllAhara kAche parakAlera nivAsa yadi anya lokadera chAr3A kevala tomAdera janyai khAsa haYa tAhale tomarA mRtyu kAmanA karate pAra, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|”
kintu tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe tArA tA kakhano kAmanA karave nA| AllAha ei jAlemadera kathA bhAla kare jAnena|

tumi avazyai tAderake ve~ce thAkAra prati sava mAnuSera ceYe adhika AgrahI dekhate pAve, emanaki muzarikadera ceYeo | tAdera eka ekajana hAjAra vachara vaYasa pete cAYa; kintu tA peleo ai dIrgha jIvana tAke zAsti theke dUre rAkhate pArave nA| tArA yA karache AllAha tA bhAlabhAvei dekhachena|

vala, “ye jivarAIlera zatru—kAraNa se AllAhara nirdezei tomAra antare ei koraAna nAyila kareche yA tAra Agera kitAvera (tAorAta o inajIla) satyatA svIkArakArI evaM vizvAsIdera janya dika-nirdezanA o susaMvAdasvarUpa—
ye AllAhara, tA~ra pherezatA o rasUladera evaM jivarAIla o mIkAIlera zatru, (se yena jene rAkhe ye,) AllAha avazyai kApheradera zatru|”
Ami tomAra kAche spaSTa nidarzanasamUha nAyila karechi; phAsekarA chAr3A keu tA asvIkAra karate pAre nA|
tAhale ki yakhanai tArA kona pratijJA kareche takhanai tAdera kona nA kona dala tA bhaGga kareche? Asale tAdera adhikAMzerai prakRta ImAna nei|

yakhana tAdera kAche AllAhara pakSa theke ekajana rasUla esechena yini tAdera kAche vidyamAna kitAvera satyatA svIkAra karena takhana ei kitAvadhArIdera ekaTi dala AllAhara kitAvake emanabhAve pechane phele rekheche, yena tArA (esamparke) jAnei nA|

solAYamAnera rAjatvera nAme zaYatAnerA yA pATha karata tArA tA mAnate lAgala| tave solAYamAna kuphari kareni, varaM zaYatAnerAi kuphari kareche| tArA mAnuSake yAdu zekhAto| Ara vyAvilane dui pherezatA hArUta o mArUtera kAche yA nAyila karA haYechila (tArA tAra pratio jhu~ke par3ala)| athaca ai dui pherezatA kAuke (sei jinisa) zekhAnora samaYa (Agei) vale nita, “Asale AmarA kintu ekaTi parIkSA, tAi (AmAdera zekhAno jinisa dvArA) kuphari karo nA|” tAra parao tArA tAdera kAcha theke emana jinisa zikhata yA dvArA svAmI-strIra madhye viccheda ghaTAte pArata| yadio tArA AllAhara hukuma chAr3A ai jinisa dvArA kona kSati karate pArata nA| tArA yA zikhata tAte tAdera kSatii hata, kona upakAra hata nA| tArA nizcaYai jAnata ye, ye vyakti ei jinisa kinave (AYatta karave) tAra janya parakAle (kalyANera) kona aMza nei| ye jinisera vinimaYe tArA nijederake vikri kare diYeche tA kata khArApa! yadi tArA (tA) jAnata!
Ara yadi tArA (prakRta) ImAna Anata Ara AllAhake bhaYa karata tAhale AllAhara pakSa theke avazyai Aro uttama pratiphala peta, yadi tArA (tA) jAnata!

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA (rasUlake samvodhanakAle) “rA’inA” (AmAdera prati lakSya rAkhuna) valo nA, varaM “un‌yur‌nA” (AmAdera dike tAkAna) vala Ara (manoyoga diYe) zona; kApheradera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

kitAvadhArI kiMvA muzarikadera madhye yArA avizvAsI tArA cAYa nA ye, tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke kona kalyANa Asuka; kintu AllAha tA~ra anugrahera janya yAke icchA manonIta karena| AllAha vipula anugrahera mAlika|
Ami ye AYAta rahita kiMvA vismRta kari (tAra jAYagAYa) tAra ceYe bhAla kiMvA anurUpa AYAta niYe Asi| tomAra ki jAnA nei ye, AllAha savakichu karate sakSama?
tomAra ki jAnA nei ye, AsamAna o jaminera kartRtva (ekamAtra) AllAharai? (Asale) AllAha vyatIta tomAdera Ara kona vandhu vA sAhAyyakArI nei|
atIte mUsAke yemana prazna karA haYechila tomarA ki tomAdera rasUlakeo temani prazna karate cAo? ImAnera parivarte ye kuphari grahaNa kare, se avazyai saThika patha hAriYe phelala|

tAdera kAche satya prakAza pAoYAra parao aneka kitAvadhArI (ihudi o khriSTAna) nijedera IrSAvazata tomAdera ImAna grahaNera para AvAra tomAderake kAphera vAnAte cAYa| tomarA kSamA kare yAo evaM upekSA karate thAka yatakSaNa nA AllAha (e vyApAre) tA~ra hukuma pradAna karena| AllAha savakichui karate sakSama|

tomarA nAmAya AdAYa karo evaM yAkAta dAo| Ara tomarA nijedera janya bhAla yA kichu addhvima pAThAve, AllAhara kAche giYe tA (tAra phala) peYe yAve| tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha avazyai tA dekhe rAkhena|
tArA (ihudi o khriSTAnarA) vale, “ihudi kiMvA khriSTAna haoYA chAr3A keu jAnnAte praveza karate pArave nA|” eTAto tAdera manera vAsanA| tumi vala, “tomarA satyavAdI hale tomAdera pramANa niYe eso|”
hyA~, varaM ye nijeke AllAhara kAche sa~pe dive evaM satkarmazIla have tAra puraskAra tAra prabhura kAche thAkavei| edharanera lokadera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|

ihudirA vale, “khriSTAnadera kAche kichu nei” evaM khriSTAnarA vale, “ihudidera kAche kichu nei” (eke aparera dharmake heYa karAra janya tArA e dharanera kathA vale); athaca tArA AsamAni kitAva pATha kare thAke| yArA (kichu) jAne nA tArAo tAdera mata emana kathAi vale| tArA yA niYe (duniYAYa) matabheda karata keYAmatera dina AllAha se viSaYe mImAMsA karavena|

ye vyakti AllAhara masajidasamUhe tA~ra nAma smaraNa karate vAdhA deYa evaM tA dhvaMsera pA~YatArA kare tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre? e dharanera lokadera to sekhAne nirbhaYe praveza karArai kathA naYa| tAdera janya duniYAte lAJchanA Ara AkherAte var3a rakamera zAsti nirdhArita Ache|
pUrva-pazcima AllAharai (dika)| ataeva, tomarA ye dikei mukha pherAo se dikei AllAha raYechena| AllAha to vizAla, mahAjJAnI|
tArA valeche, “AllAha ekajana santAna grahaNa karechena|” (ei apavAda theke) tini pavitra| varaM AsamAna-jamine yA kichu Ache savai tA~ra| savAi tA~ra anugata|
tini AsamAna o jaminera sRSTikartA| Ara tini yakhana kona kichu karAra siddhAnta nena takhana tAra janya zudhu valena, “hao”, Ara amani tA haYe yAYa|

ajJarA vale, “AllAha AmAdera sAthe (sarAsari) kathA valena nA kena? kiMvA AmAdera kAche kona nidarzana Ase nA kena?” ebhAve edera pUrvavartIrAo edera matai valechila| tAdera (savAra) antara ekairakama| Ami pratyaYI lokadera janya nidarzanasamUha spaSTa kare diYechi|
Ami tomAke (vizvAsIdera janya) susaMvAdadAtA o (avizvAsIdera janya) satarkakArIrUpe satya (dvIna) niYe pAThiYechi| Ara doyakhavAsIdera samparke tomAke prazna karA have nA|

ihudi o khriSTAnarA kakhano tomAra opara santuSTa have nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi tAdera dharmera anusaraNa kara| vale dAo, “AllAhara pathai hacche saThika patha|” Ara tomAra kAche jJAna (koraAna) AsAra parao yadi tumi tAdera abhilASa anusAre cala, tAhale AllAhara vipakSe tomAra kona vandhu kiMvA sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|
Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi, (tAdera madhye) yArA tA yathArthabhAve pATha kare tArA tA vizvAsa kare| Ara yArA tA avizvAsa kare tArAi kSatigrasta|
he vanI isarAIla! Ami tomAderake ye neYAmata diYechi tA smaraNa karo, Ara eTAo smaraNa karo ye, (atIte) Ami tomAderake sArA vizvavAsIra opara zreSThatva dAna karechilAma|

Ara emana ekaTi dinake (keYAmatera dina) bhaYa karo yakhana keu kAro kona kAje Asave nA, kAro theke kona vinimaYa grahaNa karA have nA, kona supAriza kAro upakAre Asave nA evaM tAderake (pApIderake) kona sAhAyya karA have nA|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana ivarAhImake tAra prabhu kaYekaTi kathA dvArA parIkSA karechilena evaM se tA pUraNa karechila| takhana tini (AllAha) valechilena, “Ami tomAke mAnuSera netA vAnAva|” se valechila, “AmAra santAnadera madhya thekeo?” tini valechilena, “AmAra oYAdA jAlemadera kSetre prayojya have nA|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami kAvAgharake mAnuSera milanasthala o nirApattAra jAYagA vAniYechilAma Ara valechilAma, “tomarA mAkAme ivarAhImake nAmAyera jAYagArUpe grahaNa kara|” Ara ivarAhIma o isamAIlake ei Adeza diYechilAma ye, tomarA AmAra gharake taoYAphakArI, etekAphakArI o ruku-sejadAkArIdera janya pavitra rAkhave|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana ivarAhIma valechila, “he prabhu! eke (makkA nagarIke) ekaTi nirApada zahara vAniYo evaM era adhivAsIdera madhye yArA AllAha o zeSa dina (parakAla) vizvAsa karave, phala-phalAdi dvArA tAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA kare dio|” tini valechilena, “Ara ye avizvAsa karave tAkeo kichudinera janya (e sava) upabhoga karate deva, tArapara tAke jAhAnnAmera zAstira dike Thele deva; seTA kata khArApa gantavyasthala!”
(smaraNa karo) yakhana ivarAhIma o isamAIla kAvAgharera bhitti ge~the tulachila Ara valachila, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera e kAja grahaNa karo; tumito savai zona, savai jAna|”

“he AmAdera prabhu! Ara AmAdera dujanake tomAra anugata vAndAYa pariNata karo evaM (AgAmIte) AmAdera vaMza theke tomAra prati anugata ekaTi jAti tairI karo| Ara AmAderake AmAdera (hajera) karaNIYa kAja o tA pAlanera sthAnasamUha dekhiYe dAo evaM AmAdera taovA kavula kara| tumii to taovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|”

“he AmAdera prabhu! Ara tumi tAdera (AmAdera vaMzadharadera) madhye tAdera thekei ekajana rasUla pAThiYo ye tAderake tomAra AYAtasamUha pATha kare zonAve evaM tAderake kitAva o prajJA zikSA deve Ara tAderake parizuddha karave| tumii to mahAparAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|”
AtmavismRta vyakti chAr3A Ara ke ivarAhImera dharma theke vimukha hate pAre? Amii to tAke pRthivIte manonIta karechilAma| Ara parakAleo se avazyai sat lokadera madhye gaNya have|
yakhana tAra prabhu tAke valalena, “anugata hao” takhana se valala, “Ami vizvaprabhura anugata halAma|”

Ara ei panthA anusaraNera janya ivarAhIma tAra putraderake upadeza diYechila, iYAkUvao; ei vale ye, “he AmAra putragaNa! AllAhai tomAdera janya ei dvIna manonIta karechena| ataeva, tomarA (tA~ra) anugata nA haYe kichutei maro nA|”

yakhana iYAkUvera mRtyura samaYa haYechila takhana tomarA ki (sekhAne) upasthita chile? se takhana tAra putradera valechila, “AmAra (mRtyura) pare tomarA kisera ivAdata karave?” tArA valechila, “AmarA ApanAra evaM ApanAra pUrvapuruSa ivarAhIma, isamAIla o isahAkera eka prabhura ivAdata karava| AmarA tA~rai anugata”
erA chila eka jAti yArA atikrAnta haYeche| tArA yA upArjana kareche tA tAdera, Ara tomarA yA upArjana karacha tA tomAdera| tArA yA karata se samparke tomAderake jijJAsA karA have nA|

tArA (ihudi o khriSTAnarA) vale, “tomarA ihudi kiMvA khriSTAna hao, tavei saThika patha pAve|” tumi vala, “(AmarA) varaM ivarAhImera saThika dharma (anusaraNa karava)| tini muzarikadera antarbhukta chilena nA|”

tomarA vala, “AmarA AllAhake vizvAsa karechi evaM yA AmAdera kAche nAyila karA haYeche; yA ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tAra vaMzadharadera kAche nAyila karA haYechila evaM yA mUsA, IsA o anya navIderake tAdera prabhura pakSa theke deoYA haYechila tAo vizvAsa karechi| AmarA ei navIdera madhye kAro sAthe kAro pArthakya kari nA| Ara AmarA tA~rai (AllAhara) anugata|”

tomarA yA yA vizvAsa karecho tArAo yadi tadrUpa vizvAsa kare tAhale tArA saThika patha pAve| Ara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale tArA virodhera madhyei thAkala| sekSetre tAdera vyApAre AllAhai tomAra janya yatheSTa havena| tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

(vala, “AmarA) AllAhara raGa (dhAraNa karechi); Ara raGe AllAhara ceYe sundara ke Ache? [arthAt AmarA AllAhara dvIna grahaNa karechi; Ara AllAhara dvInera ceYe bhAla Ara kAro dvIna hate pAre nA|] AmarA tA~rai dAsatva kari|”

vala, “tomarA ki AllAha samparke AmAdera sAthe jhagar3A karate cAo? athaca tini AmAderao prabhu, tomAderao prabhu| AmAdera karma AmAdera janya Ara tomAdera karma tomAdera janya; AmarA tA~rai janya nivedita|”

athavA tomarA ki valate cAo ye, ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tA~ra vaMzadharagaNa ihudi kiMvA khriSTAna chila? vala, “tomarA ki vezi jAna nA AllAha?” ye vyakti AllAhara pakSa theke tAra kAche vidyamAna kona sAkSya gopana kare tAra ceYe var3a jAlema ke Ache? tomarA yA karo se samparke AllAha vekhavara nana|
erA chila eka jAti yArA atikrAnta haYeche| tArA yA upArjana kareche tA tAdera, Ara tomarA yA upArjana karacha tA tomAdera| tArA yA karata se samparke tomAderake jijJAsA karA have nA|

nirvodha lokerA acirei valave, “tArA (musalamAnarA) ye kevalAra anusArI chila tA theke tAdera phirAlo kise? (tAdera pUrvera kevalA parivartanera kAraNaTA ki?)” tumi valave, “pUrva o pazcima (savai) AllAhara; tini yAke cAna saThika pathera sandhAna dena|”

Ara ebhAvei Ami tomAderake ekaTi madhyapanthI (serA) jAti vAniYechi, yAte tomarA mAnuSera vyApAre sAkSI hao, Ara rasUla sAkSI hana tomAdera vyApAre| (tomAdera madhye) ke rasUlera anusaraNa kare Ara ke ulTo dike phire yAYa tA dekhAra janyai Ami tomAra pUrvavartI kevalA nirdhAraNa karechilAma| AllAha yAderake hedAYeta dAna karechena tArA vyatIta anyadera janya viSaYaTi veza kaThina chila| Ara AllAha tomAdera ImAna (nAmAya) naSTa karate pArena nA| AllAha niHsandehe mAnuSera prati atyanta snehaparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|

Ami tomAke vAravAra AkAzera dike tAkAte dekhi| tAi avazyai Ami tomAke tomAra pachandera eka kevalAra dike pherAva| tumi masajide hArAmera (makkAra pavitra masajidera) dike tomAra mukha phirAo| Ara tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena ei masajidera dikei tomAdera mukha phirAve| yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tArA (ihudi/khriSTAnarA) avazyai jAne ye, eTAi tAdera prabhura pakSa theke saThika vidhAna| tArA yA kare se samvandhe AllAha vekhavara nana|

yadi tumi kitAvIdera (ihudi/khriSTAnadera) kAche samasta pramANa upasthita karo tavuo tArA tomAra kevalAra anusaraNa karave nA| tumio tAdera kevalAra anusaraNa karate pAra nA| tArA nijerAo eke anyera kevalAra anusaraNakArI naYa| Ara tomAra kAche ye jJAna eseche tAra pare tumi yadi tAdera icchAnusAre kAja karo tAhale avazyai tumi anyAYakArIdera ekajana vale gaNya have|
Ami yAderake kitAva (tAorAta/inajIla) diYechi tArA tAke (rasUlake) nijedera cheledera matai (khuva bhAla kare) cene| Asale tAdera ekaTi dala jJAtasArei satyake gopana karache|
e satya tomAra prabhura pakSa theke (eseche); ataeva, (e vyApAre) kichutei sandeha poSaNa karo nA|

(ivAdatakAle) mukha phirAnora janya pratyekerai ekaTi dika Ache| ataeva, tomarA kalyANera dike dhAvita hao| tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, AllAha tomAdera sakalake (keYAmatera dina eka jAYagAYa) niYe Asavena| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao nA kena, masajide hArAmera dike mukha phirAo| eTA tomAra prabhura pakSa theke Agata satya| Ara tomarA yA karo AllAha se samparke anavahita nana|

tumi yekhAna thekei vera hao nA kena, masajide hArAmera dike mukha phirAo; Ara tomarAo yekhAnei thAka nA kena, ei masajidera dikei mukha phirAve; yAte jAlemarA vyatIta mAnuSa tomAdera vipakSe kona yukti dA~r3a karAte nA pAre (jAlemarA to yukti dA~r3a karAvei); ataeva, tomarA tAderake bhaYa karo nA, kevala AmAkei bhaYa karave; Ara yAte Ami tomAdera janya AmAra neYAmata pUrNa karate pAri evaM tomarAo hedAYeta pAo|

yemana Ami tomAdera mAjhe tomAdera thekei ekajana rasUla pAThiYechi, ye tomAderake AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha kare zonAYa, tomAderake parizuddha kare, tomAderake kitAvera jJAna o prajJA zikSA deYa evaM tomarA yA jAnate nA tomAderake tA jAniYe deYa|
ataeva, tomarA AmAke smaraNa karo, Amio tomAderake smaraNa karava; Ara AmAra prati kRtajJatA svIkAra karo, AmAra akRtajJa haYo nA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA dhairya o nAmAyera mAdhyame sAhAyya cAo; nizcaYai AllAha dhairya dhAraNakArIdera saGge Achena|
yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYa tAderake mRta valo nA, varaM tArA jIvita; tave tomarA (tA) anubhava karo nA|
Ami tomAderake bhaYa, kSudhA, jAnamAla o phala-phalAdira kSati ityAdira kichu ekaTA dvArA avazyai parIkSA karava| Ara dhairyadhAraNakArIderake tumi susaMvAda dAo|
yArA vipada Asale vale, “AmarA to AllAharai (vAndA) evaM AmarA tA~rai kAche phire yAva|”
odera opara odera prabhura pakSa theke raYeche karuNArAzi Ara anugraha; evaM orAi hedAYetaprApta|

chAphA o mAraoYA hacche AllAhara anyatama (duTi) nidarzana| ye AllAhara gharakendrika hajja kiMvA omarA karave tAra e duTo paribhramaNa karAYa kona pApa nei| Ara ye svapraNodita haYe bhAla kAja karave (se tAra kAjera puraskAra pAve), nizcaYai AllAha yathArtha puraskAradAtA, sarvajJAta|
mAnuSera janya kitAve spaSTabhAve varNanA karAra parao yArA AmAra prerita pramANasamUha o dika-nirdezanA gopana kare tAderake AllAha abhizApa dena evaM abhizApadAtArAo tAderake abhizApa deYa|
tave yArA taovA kare bhAla kAja karave evaM (yA gopana karechila tA) spaSTabhAve varNanA karave Ami tAdera kSamA kare deva| Ami to kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
yArA kuphari kare evaM kAphera avasthAYa mArA yAYa tAdera opara AllAha, pherezatAgaNa o sakala mAnuSera abhizApa|
tArA ai abhizApa niYei cirakAla thAkave| nA tAdera zAsti laghu karA have evaM nA tAderake (konarakama) chAr3a deoYA have|
tomAdera prabhu eka prabhu| tini chAr3A anya kona prabhu nei| tini karuNAmaYa, daYAlu|

AsamAna-jaminera sRSTite, rAta-dinera Avartane, mAnuSera upakArI sAmagrI niYe jalapathe calamAna nauyAne, AllAha AkAza theke ye pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa kare tAra sAhAyye mRta bhUmike jIvita karena tAte, tini bhUmite ye sava pazu-prANI char3iYe diYechena tAte, vAtAsera dika-parivartane evaM AkAza Ara bhUmira mAjhe bhAsamAna megharAzite avazyai vujhamAna lokadera janya nidarzana raYeche|

kichu mAnuSa Ache yArA AllAhake chAr3A (tA~ra) katipaYa samakakSakeo mAne, yAderake tArA AllAhake bhAlavAsAra matai bhAlavAse| pakSAntare yArA ImAnadAra, AllAhara prati tAdera bhAlavAsA Aro vezi| jAlemarA (kaThina hAzare) zAstira sammukhIna hale yemana vujhave temana yadi (ekhana) vujhata ye, sava zakti AllAhara evaM AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA (tAhale katai nA bhAla hata)!
yakhana anusRta vyaktirA (netArA) anusArIdera dAYa asvIkAra karave o zAstira sammukhIna have Ara tAdera sAthe sakala yogasUtra chinna haYe yAve|

Ara anusArIrA valave, “hAYa! AmarA yadi ekavAra (duniYAYa) phire yete pAratAma tAhale tArA (anusRta netArA) yebhAve AmAdera dAYa asvIkAra kareche temani AmarAo tAdera dAYa asvIkAra karatAma| ebhAvei AllAha tAdera kAjasamUhake tAdera janyai AkSepe pariNata karavena| tArA jAhAnnAma theke kakhano vera have nA|
he mAnuSa! pRthivIra hAlAla o pavitra jinisasamUha khAo; Ara zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA| se kintu tomAdera prakAzya zatru|
se kevala tomAderake anyAYa o khArApa kAja karate vale Ara AllAha samparke tAi valate vale yA tomarA jAna nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “AllAha ye vidhAna nAyila karechena tA mene cala”, takhana tArA vale, “AmarA to tA-i mene calava yA AmAdera vApa-dAdAdera mene calate dekhechi|” tAdera vApa-dAdArA kichu nA vujhe thAkaleo kiMvA saThika dika-nirdezanA nA peYe thAkaleo ki (tArA tAdera anusaraNa karave)?

kApheradera udAharaNa hala, yemana eka vyakti kona kichuke citkAra kare DAke, kintu yAke DAke se DAka Ara samvodhana chAr3A Ara kichu zunate pAYa nA| (arthAt zudhu DAkAra zavdai zone, kintu Deke ki valache tA kichui vojhe nA|) tArA vadhira, mUka o andha; tAi tArA vojhe nA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! riyika hiseve AmAra deoYA pavitra vastusamUha khAo Ara AllAhara zokara karo, yadi tomarA tA~rai ivAdatakArI hao|

AllAha tomAdera janya mRtadeha, rakta, zUkarera mAMsa evaM AllAha chAr3A anyera janya utsargIkRta (athavA javAikAle AllAhara nAma nA niYe deva-devIra nAme javAikRta) prANIra mAMsa khAoYA niSiddha karechena| tave keu yadi avAdhya kiMvA sImAlaGghanakArI nA haYe ekAnta nirupAYa haYe (egulora madhye konaTi) khAYa, tAhale tAra kona pApa have nA| AllAha avazyai kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

AllAha kitAvera ye vidhAna avatIrNa karechena tA yArA gopana kare evaM era vinimaYe sAmAnya (vaiSaYika) mUlya grahaNa kare tArA zudhu Aguna kheYe nijedera peTa bharti kare| keYAmatera dina AllAha tAdera sAthe kathA valavena nA evaM tini tAderake zodhana karavena nA| tAdera janya raYeche kaSTadAYaka zAsti|
orAi supathera parivarte vipatha Ara kSamAra parivarte zAsti kraYa kareche| tArA jAhAnnAmera (zAstibhogera) jhu~kiteo kata duHsAhasI!
eTA ejanya ye, AllAha satyasaha kitAva nAyila karechena| kintu yArA ei kitAvera vyApAre matabheda sRSTi kareche tArA gabhIra virodhera madhye (lipta) raYeche|

(nAmAyera samaYa) tomAdera mukha pUrva o pazcimadike phirAno (Asala) puNya naYa, varaM yArA AllAha, parakAla, pherezatA, kitAva o navIderake vizvAsa kare; sampadera prati bhAlavAsA sattveo tA AtmIYa-svajana, etima-misakIna, pathikajana o sAhAyyaprArthI-derake dAna kare o dAsa mukta karAra janya tA vyaYa kare; Thikamata nAmAya par3e o yAkAta deYa; oYAdA karale tA pUraNa kare evaM duHkha-kaSTe, abhAva-anaTane o bhaYera samaYe dhairyadhAraNa kare tAdera kAjai (prakRta) puNya| orAi khA~Ti evaM orAi mottAkI|

he ImAnadAragaNa! nihatadera vyApAre tomAdera janya kesAsera (pAlTA vyavasthAra) vidhAna nirdhArita haYeche| svAdhIna vyaktira janya svAdhIna vyakti, dAsera janya dAsa Ara nArIra janya nArI| (arthAt hatyAkArI ye-i hoka nA kena, kesAsera vidhAna anuyAYI tAkei hatyA karate have|) tave (anugraha kare) kAuke tAra bhAiYera pakSa theke kichuTA mArjanA karA hale se kSetre nyAYasaGgata vyavasthA grahaNa karA ucita evaM sahRdaYatAra sAthe tAra anukUle raktamUlya parizodha karA ucita| eTA tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke (vizeSa) lAghava o anugraha| era pare yadi keu vAr3AvAr3i kare tAhale tAra janya kaSTadAYaka zAsti nirdhArita Ache|
he vuddhisampanna mAnuSerA! kesAsera madhye tomAdera janya jIvana (vA~cAnora vyavasthA) nihita Ache, yAte (ei vidhAnera kalyANe) tomarA rakSA pete pAra|

tomAdera keu mRtyukAle sampada rekhe gele pitAmAtA o Apanajanadera janya nyAyyabhAve asiYata kare yAoYAra vidhAna rAkhA haYeche| [paravartIte uttarAdhikAra vaNTanera vidhAna nAyila haoYAYa asiYata kare yAoYA Ara vAdhyatAmUlaka naYa|] eTA dharmaparAYaNadera ekaTi kartavya|
erakama asiYatera kathA zonAra para yArA tA parivartana karave, vastuta era pApa tAdera oparai vartAve| AllAha avazyai savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

tave keu yadi kona asiYatakArIra (asiYate) konarakama pakSapAta kiMvA anyAYera AzaGkA kare evaM (svIYa hastakSepera mAdhyame mUla asiYate kona nyAyya parivartana kare) saMzliSTadera madhye virodha mImAMsA kare deYa tAhale tAra kona pApa have nA| AllAha nizcaYai kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera pUrvavartIdera janya yemana royA pharaya karA haYechila, temani tomAdera janyao tA pharaya karA hala, yAte tomarA tAkaoYA arjana karate pAra|

(ei royA) nirdiSTa kaYekadinera janya; tave tomAdera madhye yadi keu asustha haYa kiMvA saphare thAke (evaM e kAraNe tAke nirdhArita dinera royA chAr3ate haYa) tAhale se anya (samaYera) dinagulote royA rekhe (royAra) saMkhyA pUraNa karave| Ara yAdera (vArdhakya, kaThina roga ityAdi kAraNe) royA rAkhate atyanta kaSTa haYa tAderake (royA chAr3Ara janya) ekaTi phidiYA arthAt (prati royAra janya) ekajana garIvera (ekadinera) khAdya dite have| tave svecchAYa ye satkAja karave tAra janya tA adhikatara maGgalajanaka (have)| Ara royA rAkhAi tomAdera janya maGgala, yadi tomarA jJAnI hao|

ramayAna mAsa, e mAsei nAyila karA haYeche Ala-koraAna: mAnuSera janya dika-nirdezanA evaM satpatha o (nyAYa-anyAYera) mAnadaNDera spaSTa pramANa| ataeva, tomAdera madhye yArA ei mAsa pAve tArA yena takhana royA rAkhe; Ara ye asustha kiMvA saphare thAkave se anya (samaYera) dinagulote royA rekhe (royAra) saMkhyA pUraNa karave| AllAha tomAdera janya sahaja cAna, tini tomAdera janya kaThina cAna nA| Ara tomarA yena (dinera) saMkhyA pUrNa karo, Ara AllAha ye tomAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karechena sejanya tA~ra mahimA varNanA karo, yAte tomarA (tA~ra prati) kRtajJa thAka|

(he rasUla!) AmAra vAndArA yakhana tomAra kAche AmAra (avasthAna) samvandhe jAnate cAYa (takhana tAdera jAniYe dAo), Ami to kAchei Achi| keu yakhana AmAke DAke Ami takhana tAra DAke sAr3A dei; ataeva, tArAo AmAra DAke sAr3A dika evaM AmAke (yathArthabhAve) vizvAsa karuka yAte tArA Thika pathe thAkate pAre|

royAra rAte tomAdera janya strIsambhoga vaidha karA haYeche| tArA tomAdera paricchada, tomarAo tAdera paricchada| AllAha jAnena ye, tomarA itipUrve anyAYa kare nijedera kSati karachile| pare tini tomAdera prati sadaYa haYechena evaM tomAderake kSamA kare diYechena| ekhana tomarA tomAdera strIdera saMsparze yete pAra evaM AllAha tomAdera janya yA varAdda kare rekhechena (arthAt santAna-santati) tA kAmanA karate pAra| Ara kAlo rekhA theke prabhAtera sAdA rekhA spaSTa nA haoYA paryanta (arthAt rAtera andhakAra cale giYe bhorera Alo udbhAsita nA haoYA paryanta) tomarA pAnAhAra kara| tArapara (paravartI) rAta AsA paryanta (pAnAhAra vandha rekhe) royA pUrNa kara| Ara tomarA yakhana masajide eJcatekApharata thAkave takhana strIdera saMsparze yeYo nA| egulo AllAhara sImArekhA; ataeva, era kAche yeYo nA (egulo laMghanera ceSTA karo nA)| AllAha ebhAvei tA~ra nidarzanasamUha mAnuSake vujhiYe dena, yAte tArA tAkaoYAsampanna hate pAre|
tomarA anyAYabhAve eke anyera sampada kheYo nA kiMvA jJAtasAre anyAYabhAve mAnuSera sampadera ekaTA aMza khAoYAra uddezye tA zAsakadera nikaTa peza karo nA|

lokerA tomAke (vibhinna AkArera) natuna cA~da samparke prazna kare| tumi vala, “egulo mAnuSera janya evaM hajjera janya samaYa-nirdezaka|” tomarA ye pechana dika theke ghare praveza karo, eTA puNya naYa, varaM ye AllAhake bhaYa kare tAra puNya Ache| tomarA darajA diYei ghare praveza karo o AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAte tomarA saphala hate pAra|
yArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kare tomarA AllAhara pathe tAdera viruddhe yuddha karo, Ara sImAlaMghana karo nA| AllAha sImAlaMghanakArIderake pachanda karena nA|

tomarA tAderake yekhAnei pAve hatyA karave evaM tArA yekhAna theke tomAderake vera kare diYechila sekhAna theke tAderake vera kare deve| phetanA (golayoga, vizRGkhalA, dAGgA-hAGgAmA, niryAtana, ziraka) hatyAra ceYeo gurutara| tomarA masajide hArAmera kAche tAdera sAthe yuddha karave nA yatakSaNa nA tArA sekhAne tomAdera sAthe yuddha kare| yadi tArA tomAdera sAthe yuddha kare tAhale tomarA tAderake hatyA karave| eTAi kApheradera (nyAyya) pratiphala|
Ara tArA yadi (yuddha theke) virata haYa tAhale AllAha avazyai kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
tomarA tAdera sAthe yuddha karave yAte kona phetanA nA thAke evaM dvIna ekamAtra AllAhara haYe yAYa| Ara tArA yadi virata haYa tAhale jAlemadera chAr3A kAro viruddhe kona vairitA nei|

pavitra mAsera parivarte pavitra mAsa| Ara pavitra jinisasamUhera kSetre kesAsa (pAlTA vyavasthA) prayojya| tAi keu yadi tomAderake AkramaNa kare tAhale tomarAo tAke AkramaNa karave yemana se tomAderake AkramaNa kareche| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karave| jene rekho, AllAha mottAkIdera saGge Achena|
tomarA AllAhara pathe (tomAdera sampada) vyaYa karo, (anyathA kare) nijederake dhvaMsera dike Thele dio nA| Ara bhAla kAja karo; yArA bhAla kAja kare AllAha tAderakei bhAlavAsena|

tomarA AllAhara janya hajja o omarA yathAyathabhAve sampanna kara| tave yadi (tA karate) vAdhAprApta hao tAhale yemanaTi pAoYA yAYa ekaTi pazu koravAni deve| koravAnira pazuTi tAra (javAiYera) jAYagAYa nA pau~chA paryanta mAthA muNDana karo nA| Ara tomAdera madhye yadi keu asustha haYa kiMvA kAro mAthAYa (mAthAra tvaka vA cule) kona samasyA thAke (ye kAraNe nirdiSTa samaYera Agei cula muNDana karate haYa) tAhale se royA kiMvA chadakA athavA koravAni dvArA phidiYA (kSatipUraNa) deve| tArapara tomAdera nirApattA phire ele ye omarA kare ekatre hajja karave se yemanaTi pAoYA yAYa ekaTi pazu koravAni deve| yadi tA nA pAYa tAhale hajjera samaYe tinadina evaM hajja theke phire sAtadina ei moTa dazadina royA rAkhave| yAra parivAra masajide hArAmera (makkAra) vAsindA naYa emana vyaktira janya ei vidhAna| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo Ara jene nAo, AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA|

hajjera samaYa hala nirdiSTa kaYekaTi mAsa| e samaYe keu yadi hajja karate manastha kare tAhale hajjera madhye se kona azlIlatA, anyAYa kAja kiMvA jhagar3A-vivAda karate pArave nA| tomarA ye bhAla kAja karo AllAha tA jAnena| saGge pAtheYa nio; tave tAkaoYAi serA pAtheYa| he vuddhisampanna mAnuSerA! tomarA AmAke bhaYa kara|

(hajjera samaYa) tomAdera prabhura dAna anveSaNa karA (hAlAla upArjana karate cAoYA) tomAdera janya pApa naYa| tomarA yakhana ArAphAta tyAga karave takhana Ala-mAz‌‘Arula hArAme (muyadAliphAYa) AllAhake smaraNa karave| tini yebhAve tomAderake dika-nirdezanA diYechena sebhAvei tA~ke smaraNa kara| era Age to tomarA Asalei vibhrAntira madhye chile|
ataHpara sava mAnuSa yekhAna theke char3iYe par3e tomarAo sekhAna theke char3iYe par3a Ara AllAhara kAche kSamA cAo; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

tomarA yakhana tomAdera hajjera pAlanIYa kartavyasamUha sampanna karave takhana AllAhake smaraNa karave yemana tomAdera pUrvapuruSadera smaraNa karate athavA tAra ceYeo vezi kare| kichu mAnuSa Ache yArA vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake (yA devAra) ei duniYAtei dAo|” erA parakAle kichui pAve nA|
AvAra emana mAnuSao Ache yArA vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake duniYAte kalyANa dAo evaM AkherAteo kalyANa dAo; Ara AmAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA kara|”
emana lokadera janya tAdera upArjanera aMza varAdda thAkave| AllAha khuva druta hisAva karena|

(minAYa avasthAnera) nirdhArita dinasamUhe AllAhake smaraNa kara| keu yadi tAr3AtAr3i kare dui dine cale Ase, tAra kona pApa have nA; AvAra keu yadi deri kare (Aro ekadina theke yAYa), tArao kona pApa have nA; eTA tAkaoYA avalamvanakArIra janya| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM jene rAkha, tomAderake tA~ra kAchei ekatra karA have|

mAnuSera madhye emana lokao Ache, yAra pArthiva jIvana samparkita kathA tomAke mugdha kare| tAra antare yA Ache se samparke se (pratAraNAvazata) AllAhake sAkSI rAkhe| Asale se sarvAdhika kalahapriYa pratipakSa|
(tomAra kAcha theke) phire giYe se jamine azAnti sRSTi evaM zasyakSeta o jIvajantu dhvaMsa karAra praYAsa cAlAYa| AllAha azAnti pachanda karena nA|

yakhana tAke valA haYa, “AllAhake bhaYa karo”, takhana (tAra) ahamikA tAke aparAdhera dike Tene dhare| (arthAt ahamikAra kAraNe se aparAdha chAr3ate pAre nA|) ataeva, jAhAnnAmai tAra prApya, nizcaYai tA var3a khArApa ThikAnA!
mAnuSera madhye AvAra emana lokao Ache ye AllAhara santuSTi arjanera janya nijeke viliYe deYa| AllAha (tA~ra) vAndAdera prati parama snehaparAYaNa|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA isalAmera madhye puropuri praveza karo, Ara zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA; nizcaYai se tomAdera spaSTa zatru|
tomAdera kAche spaSTa nidarzana AsAra parao yadi tomarA ho~caTa khAo (satya theke sare yAo) tAhale jene rAkha, AllAha atyanta parAkramazAlI, prajJAvAna|

(tAdera avasthAdRSTe mane hacche) tArA kevala ei apekSAi karache ye, AllAha meghera chAYAra madhya diYe tAdera kAche cale Asavena, pherezatArAo; Ara (ebhAvei) viSaYaTira mImAMsA haYe yAve| Asale (mImAMsAra janya) sakala viSaYai AllAhara kAche phiriYe neoYA have|
vanI isarAIlake jijJAsA karo, Ami tAderake ki parimANa spaSTa nidarzana diYechi| AllAhara neYAmata AsAra para ye tA parivartana kare, (tAra kSetre) AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA|

kApheradera janya ei duniYAra jIvana sajjita (AkarSaNIYa) kare rAkhA haYeche| tArA muminaderake upahAsa kare| tave yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche keYAmatera dina tArA tAdera (kApheradera) ceYe opare thAkave| Ara AllAha yAke cAna vinA hisAve dAna karena|

(sakala) mAnuSa ekaTimAtra jAti chila| anantara AllAha susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe navIderake pAThiYechena evaM matabhedera viSaYe lokadera virodha mImAMsAra janya satyasaha tAdera sAthe kitAva nAyila karechena| Ara yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tArAi spaSTa pramANa AsAra parao nijedera ekagu~Yemira kAraNe ei kitAvera vyApAre matabhede lipta haYeche| ataHpara tArA ye satya niYe matabheda karechila se vyApAre AllAha tA~ra icchAYa muminaderake saThika dika-nirdezanA diYechena| AllAha yAke cAna saThika pathe paricAlita karena|

tomarA ki mane karo ye, jAnnAte praveza karave? athaca tomAdera pUrve yArA cale giYeche tAdera mata avasthA tomAdera ekhano Aseni| tArA abhAva-anaTana o duHkha-kaSTera kavale par3echila evaM (bhaYe) emanabhAve kampita haYechila ye rasUla o tA~ra saGgI ImAnadAragaNa valechila, “kakhana AllAhara sAhAyya Asave?” jene rekho, AllAhara sAhAyya nikaTavartI|

tArA kI vyaYa karave tA tomAra kAche jAnate cAYa| tumi vala, “tomarA ye sampada vyaYa karave tA pitAmAtA, AtmIYa-svajana, iYAtIma-misakIna o pathikadera janya hate have| Ara tomarA yesava bhAla kAja karo AllAha tA samyaka avagata Achena|”

tomAdera janya yuddha (jehAda) vidhivaddha karA haYeche, athaca tomAdera kAche tA apachandanIYa| tave emana hate pAre ye, tomarA ekaTA jinisa apachanda karo, athaca seTA tomAdera janya bhAla; AvAra emanao hate pAre ye, tomarA ekaTA jinisa pachanda karo, athaca seTA tomAdera janya khArApa| AllAha jAnena (prakRtapakSe kon‌TA bhAla Ara kon‌TA khArApa), tomarA jAna nA|

lokerA tomAra kAche pavitra mAse (muhArarama, rajava, yulakAjJadA o yulahijjA) yuddha karA samvandhe prazna kare| tumi vale dAo, esamaYe yuddha karA ekaTi gurutara anyAYa| tave AllAhara pathe calate vAdhA deoYA, tA~ra sAthe kuphari karA evaM masajide hArAme praveza karate vAdhA deoYA o tAra vAsindAdera sekhAna theke vera kare deoYA AllAhara kAche Aro gurutara anyAYa| Ara phetanA hatyAra ceYe gurutara| tArA (kApherarA) tomAdera sAthe yuddha avyAhata rAkhave, yatakSaNa nA tArA tomAderake pArale tomAdera dvIna theke phiriYe neYa| Ara tomAdera madhye yArA tAdera dvIna theke phire yAve evaM kAphera avasthAYa mutyuvaraNa karave tAdera kAjasamUha duniYA o AkherAte niSphala haYe yAve evaM tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI have; sekhAne tArA ciradina thAkave|
yArA ImAna eneche Ara yArA hijarata kareche o AllAhara pathe jehAda kareche tArA savAi AllAhara rahamata kAmanA kare| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

lokerA tomAke mada o juYA samparke jijJAsA kare| tumi vale dAo, “e duTite var3a pApa Ache, AvAra mAnuSera kichu upakArao Ache| tave era pApa upakArera ceYe var3a|” tArA kI vyaYa karave tAo tomAra kAche jAnate cAYa| tumi vala, “yA praYojanera atirikta”| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya vidhAnasamUha spaSTabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA cintA kara|

(yAte tomarA) duniYA o AkherAta samvandhe (cintA karo)| tArA tomAke anAthadera samparkeo jijJAsA kare| vale dAo, “tAdera punarvAsanai uttama| Ara yadi tAderake tomAdera sAthe miliYe nAo tAhale to (tArA) tomAderai bhAi|” AllAha jAnena ke akalyANakArI Ara ke kalyANakArI| AllAha cAile (e vyApAre) tomAderake kaSTe phelate pAratena| AllAha to parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA muzarika nArIdera viYe karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna Ane| ImAnadAra krItadAsIo muzarika nArIra ceYe uttama, tAke tomAdera pachanda haleo| Ara muzarikadera kAche tomarA (meYedera) viYe dio nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA ImAna Ane| ImAnadAra krItadAsao muzarika puruSera ceYe uttama, tAke tomAdera pachanda haleo| orA (muzarikarA) jAhAnnAmera dike DAke; Ara AllAha tA~ra anugrahe jAnnAta o kSamAra dike DAkena evaM tA~ra vidhAnasamUha mAnuSake vujhiYe dena, yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|

tArA tomAra kAche hAYeya (mahilAdera RtusrAva) samvandhe jijJAsA kare| tumi vala, seTA (saGgamera janya) kSatikara| ataeva, hAYeyera samaYa tomarA nArIdera theke AlAdA thAka (saGgama theke virata thAka) evaM tArA pavitra nA haoYA paryanta tAdera kAche yeYo nA (tAdera sAthe saGgama karo nA)| yakhana tArA pavitra haYe yAve takhana AllAha yebhAve tomAdera nirdeza diYechena sebhAve tAdera kAche yete pArave (saGgama karate pArave)| nizcaYai AllAha taovAkArIdera bhAlavAsena, Ara yArA pAka-sApha thAke tini tAderakeo bhAlavAsena|

tomAdera nArIrA tomAdera kSetasvarUpa; ataeva, tomarA tomAdera kSete yebhAve cAo yete pAra| nijedera janya saJcaYa rAkhave| AllAhake bhaYa karo Ara jene rAkha, avazyai tA~ra sAthe tomAdera sAkSAt have| Ara (he navI!) ImAnadAradera susaMvAda dAo|

tomarA satkAja karA, tAkaoYA avalamvana karA o mAnuSera madhye zAnti sthApana karAra kSetre AllAhake zapathera ajuhAta hiseve khAr3A karo nA| (arthAt AllAhara nAme zapatha karecho vale esava bhAla kAja karate pAracha nA emana ajuhAta khAr3A karo nA|) AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
anarthaka zapathera janya AllAha tomAderake dharavena nA, varaM tini tomAderake dharavena tomAdera antarera abhiprAYera janya| AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, dhairyazIla|

yArA tAdera strIdera saMsrava theke virata thAkAra zapatha kare tArA cAra mAsa apekSA karave| tArapara yadi tArA phire Ase (arthAt e samaYera madhye mata parivartana kare) tAhale AllAha nizcaYai kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
Ara yadi tAlAka deoYAra siddhAnta neYa se kSetreo AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

tAlAkaprApta nArIrA nijederake tina RtusrAvakAla apekSAYa rAkhave| Ara AllAha tAdera garbhe yA sRSTi karechena tA (arthAt garbhera santAna) gopana karA tAdera janya vaidha naYa, yadi tArA AllAha o parakAle vizvAsI haYa| e samaYera madhye tAdera svAmIrA tAderake phiriYe nilei savaceYe bhAla haYa, yadi tArA miTamATa cAYa| nArIra opara yemana (puruSera) adhikAra Ache temani (puruSera opara) nArIderao nyAYasaGgata adhikAra Ache| tave tAdera opare puruSera ekaTi (vizeSa) maryAdA raYeche| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

(vidhAnasammata) tAlAka hala duivAra| erapara (strIke) haYa yathocitabhAve dhare rAkhate have, nA haYa bhAloYa bhAloYa cher3e dite have| Ara tomarA tAderake yA yA diYecho tA theke kichui niYe neoYA tomAdera janya vaidha naYa; tave yadi (svAmI-strI) dujane AllAhara sImArekhA (vidhAna) Thika rAkhate nA pArAra AzaGkA kare tAhale bhinna kathA| tAi tomarA yadi AzaGkA karo ye, tArA dujane AllAhara sImArekhA Thika rAkhate pArave nA tAhale strI nijeke mukta karate (svAmIke) kichu vinimaYa dile tAte dujanera kAro pApa have nA| egulo AllAhara sImArekhA; tomarA egulo laMghana karo nA| yArA AllAhara sImArekhA laMghana kare tArAi jAlema|

ataHpara svAmI yadi strIke (tRtIYa vArera mata) tAlAka deYa tAhale erapara strI Ara ei svAmIra janya vaidha have nA, yatakSaNa nA se anya eka svAmIke viYe kare| tArapara sei (anya) svAmI yadi tAke tAlAka deYa tAhale tArA punarAYa (vivAhera mAdhyame) parasparera kAche phire gele tAdera kona pApa have nA, yadi tArA mane kare ye, tArA AllAhara vidhAna Thika rAkhate pArave| egulo AllAhara vidhAna, yA tini jJAnI lokadera janya spaSTa kare dicchena|

tomarA yakhana nArIdera tAlAka deve, ataHpara tArA tAdera nirdiSTa samaYakAle upanIta have (iddata pUraNera kAchAkAchi Asave) takhana haYa tAderake yathocitabhAve dhare rAkhave, nA haYa yathocitabhAve vidAYa kare deve| kaSTa deoYAra janya tAderake ATake rekho nA, tAte tomAdera sImAlaMghana karA have| ye tA karave se nijera pratii juluma karave| AllAhara vidhAnasamUhera sAthe parihAsamUlaka AcaraNa karo nA| tomAderake deoYA AllAhara neYAmata smaraNa karo evaM tini ye grantha o prajJA avatIrNa kare tA dvArA tomAderake zikSA dicchena tAo smaraNa kara| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| jene rAkhave, AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|

tomarA yakhana nArIdera tAlAka deve, ataHpara tArA tAdera nirdiSTa samaYakAle upanIta have (iddata pUrNa karave) takhana tArA tAdera (pUrvavartI) svAmIdera viYe karate cAile tAderake vAdhA deve nA, yadi tArA vidhimata paraspara sammata haYa| tomAdera madhye yArA AllAha o zeSa dina (parakAla) vizvAsa kare tAderake ei upadeza deoYA hacche| eTA tomAdera janya adhikatara paricchanna o pavitratara (vidhAna)| AllAha jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|

mAYerA tAdera santAnaderake puro duJcavachara vukera dudha pAna karAve| eTA tAdera janya, yArA dudha pAna karAnora meYAda pUrNa karate cAYa| ekSetre santAnera pitAke yathocitabhAve mAYedera khAoYA-parAra vyavasthA karate have| kAro opara sAdhyera atirikta kichu cApiYe deoYA yAve nA| kona mA kiMvA vAvAke tAra santAnera kAraNe kSatigrasta karA yAve nA| (vAvAra avartamAne kiMvA apAragatAYa tAra) uttarAdhikArIke ekairakama dAYitva pAlana karate have| yadi pitAmAtA pArasparika sammati o parAmarzakrame (santAnake) dudha chAr3Ate cAYa, tAhale tAdera kona pApa have nA| Ara tomarA yadi tomAdera santAnaderake (anya meYelokera) dudha pAna karAte cAo, tAhale tomAdera kona pApa have nA, yadi (era mUlya hiseve) tomAdera yA deoYAra tA Thikamata diYe dAo| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| jene rAkhave, tomarA yA karo AllAha tA savai dekhate pAna|

tomAdera madhye yArA strI rekhe mArA yAve tAdera strIrA cAra mAsa daza dina nijederake apekSAYa rAkhave| tAdera ei samaYakAla (iddata) pUrNa hale tArA nijedera vyApAre nyAYasaGgatabhAve yA karave tAte (arthAt AvAra viYe karale) tomAdera kona doSa nei| tomarA yA karo AllAha se samparke samyaka avagata|

tomarA (iddata pAlanarata vidhavA) nArIderake viYe karAra kathA AkAre-iGgite valale kiMvA (tA) manera madhye gopana rAkhale tomAdera kona doSa nei| AllAha jAnena ye, tAdera kathA tomAdera mane Asave| kintu yathArtha kathA nA vale gopane tAdera sAthe oYAdAvaddha have nA| Ara nirdiSTa meYAda (iddata) pUrNa nA haoYA paryanta vivAhavandhanera siddhAnta neve nA| jene rAkha, AllAha tomAdera manera kathA jAnena; ataeva, tAke bhaYa kara| jene rAkha, AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, sahanazIla|

strIderake sparza karAra kiMvA tAdera janya moharAnA dhArya karAra Agei yadi tomarA tAderake tAlAka dAo tAhale tomAdera kona doSa have nA; tave tAderake (yAra yAra sAdhyAnusAre) kichu bhogyasAmagrI dAna karave| dhanI deve tAra sAdhyAnusAre, Ara garIva deve tAra sAdhyAnusAre; yathocitabhAve kichu sAmagrI; eTA nekakAradera ekaTA dAYitva|

Ara yadi tAderake sparza karAra Age evaM tAdera janya moharAnA dhArya karAra pare tAlAka dAo, tAhale ye parimANa moharAnA dhArya karecho tAra ardheka (dite have)| tave yadi tArA (arthAt strIrA tAdera ardheka) cher3e deYa (arthAt kona moharAnA nA neYa) kiMvA yAra hAte vivAhavandhana se (arthAt svAmI tAra ardheka) cher3e deYa (arthAt puro moharAnA diYe deYa) tAhale bhinna kathA| Ara tomarA (ebhAve yAra yAra pAonA) cher3e dile seTAi have tAkaoYAra nikaTatara (kAja)| tomarA nijedera madhye udAratA (pradarzana karate) bhule yeYo nA| tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tA dekhate pAna|
tomarA nAmAyera prati ya.vAna hao, vizeSa kare madhyavartI (Acharera) nAmAyera prati; Ara AllAhara sAmane ekaniSTha haYe dA~r3Ao|

Ara yadi tomAdera (zatrura) bhaYa thAke tAhale hA~Tate hA~Tate athavA ArohI avasthAYa (nAmAya AdAYa karave)| ataHpara yakhana tomarA nirApada have takhana AllAhake sebhAvei smaraNa karave yebhAve tini tomAdera zikhiYechena, yA tomarA (Age) jAnate nA|

tomAdera madhye yArA strIdera rekhe mArA yAYa tArA yena tAdera strIderake eka vachara paryanta praYojanIYa jIvanopakaraNa pradAna karA o tAderake (vAr3i theke) vera kare nA deoYAra asiYata kare yAYa (paravartIte anya AYAta dvArA ei vidhAna rahita karA haYeche); tave tArA yadi (nijerA) vera haYe yAYa evaM nijedera vyApAre vidhisammata kona kAja kare tAhale tAte tomAdera kona pApa have nA| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tAlAkaprApta nArIderake Thikamata praYojanIYa jIvanopakaraNa saravarAha karate have; eTA dharmaparAYaNa vyaktidera ekaTi dAYitva|
ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra anuzAsanagulo spaSTa kare dena, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani (tAdera kathA bhAvani) yArA mRtyura bhaYe nijedera gharavAr3i theke vera haYechila? Ara tAdera saMkhyA chila hAjAra hAjAra| takhana AllAha tAderake valechilena, “mare yAo”| tArapara tini tAderake jIvita karechilena| nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa zokara kare nA|
tomarA AllAhara pathe lar3Ai karo Ara jene rAkha, AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

emana ke Ache ye AllAhake ekaTi uttama RNa dite pAre? (tAhale) AllAha tA tAra janya anekaguNa vAr3iYe devena| AllAha (tomAdera sampada) kamAteo pArena, vAr3Ateo pArena| Ara tomAderake tA~rai kAche phiriYe neYA have|

tumi ki mUsAra pare vanI isarAIla netAderake dekhani? yakhana tArA tAdera eka navIke valechila, “AmAdera janya ekajana rAjA niyukta karo, AmarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karava|” navI valechilena, “emana have nAto ye, tomAdera opara yuddha dhArya karA hale takhana tomarA yuddha karave nA?” tArA valala, “AmAderake yakhana nijedera gharavAr3i theke o santAna-santatira kAcha theke vera kare deoYA haYeche takhana AllAhara pathe yuddha karava nA kena?” kintu yakhana (Thikai) tAdera opara yuddha dhArya karA hala takhana alpa kaYekajana vyatIta tArA piThaTAna dila| AllAha jAlemadera samparke bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|

tAdera navI tAderake valechilena, “AllAha tomAdera janya tAlUtake rAjA niyukta karechena|” tArA valala, “se AmAdera rAjA haYa kIbhAve? rAjA haoYAra janya to tAra ceYe AmarAi vezi yogya; tAra to paryApta dhana-sampadao nei|” navI valalena, “AllAha tomAdera janya tAkei manonIta karechena evaM tini tAke vyApaka jJAna o vizAla deha dAna karechena| Ara AllAha yAke icchA tAke rAjatva dAna karena| AllAha sarvavyApI, mahAjJAnI|”

tAdera navI tAderake Aro valechilena, “tAra (tAlUtera) rAjA haoYAra lakSaNa ei ye, tomAdera kAche sinduka Asave, yAte thAkave tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke AsA prazAntira upakaraNa evaM mUsA o hArUnera vaMzadharadera rekhe yAoYA jinisapatrera kichu avaziSTAMza| pherezatArA seTi vahana kare Anave| tomarA yadi (prakRta) ImAnadAra hao tAhale ete tomAdera janya avazyai ekaTi nidarzana Ache|”

pare tAlUta yakhana sainya niYe vera haYechila takhana se (sainyaderake) valechila, “AllAha tomAderake ekaTi nadI dvArA parIkSA karavena| ye ai nadIra pAni pAna karave se AmAra dalabhukta thAkate pArave nA, Ara ye tAra svAda grahaNa karave nA se AmAra dalabhukta thAkave| avazya ye nijera hAte mAtra eka koSa parimANa (pAni) neve tAra kathA AlAdA (arthAt se sAdhAraNa pAnakArIdera paryAYe par3ave nA, tAi seo AmAra dalabhukta thAkate pArave)|” kintu alpa loka chAr3A savAi nadIra pAni pAna karechila| tArapara tAlUta o tAra sAthera vizvAsIrA yakhana nadITi pAra haYe gela takhana tArA valala, “Aja jAlUta o tAra sainyadera mokAvelA karAra kSamatA AmAdera nei|” tave yArA nizcita jAnata ye, AllAra sAthe tAdera sAkSAt have tArA valala, “AllAhara hukume kata choTa dala kata var3a dalake parAjita kareche!” AllAha dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|

yakhana tArA jAlUta o tAra sainyadera mokAvelAra uddezye vera haYechila takhana valechila, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake paryApta dhairya dAna karo, AmAdera pA avicala rAkha evaM avizvAsI lokadera viruddhe AmAderake vijaYI kara|

tArapara AllAhara hukume tArA tAderake (jAlUtavAhinIke) parAjita kare o dAuda jAlUtake hatyA kare evaM AllAha tAke (dAudake) rAjatva o vicakSaNatA dAna karena Ara se yA cAcchila tini tAke tA zikhiYe dena| AllAha yadi kataka mAnuSake kataka mAnuSa dvArA damanera vyavasthA nA rAkhatena tAhale pRthivI vinaSTa haYe yeta| tave AllAha sArA vizvavAsIra prati anugrahazIla|
egulo AllAhara nidarzana; Ami tA tomAra kAche yathArthabhAve varNanA karachi| Ara avazyai tumi rasUladera antarbhukta|

ei rasUladerai katakake katakera opara zreSThatva diYechi| tAdera madhye keu Ache yAra sAthe AllAha (sarAsari) kathA valechena, AvAra katakake aneka ucca maryAdA dAna karechena| Ami mariYamera putra IsAke mojeyA (alaukika viSaYa) dAna karechi o pavitra AtmA (jivarAIla) dvArA tAke sAhAyya karechi| AllAhara icchA thAkale tAdera paravartIrA spaSTa pramANAdi pAoYAra parao hAnAhAni karata nA; kintu tArA bhinna bhinna mata poSaNa karechila| phale tAdera keu ImAna enechila AvAra keu kAphera haYechila| AllAhara icchA thAkale tArA hAnAhAni karata nA; kintu AllAha tAi karena yA tini karate cAna|
he ImAnadAragaNa! emana dina AsAra pUrve AmAra deoYA jIvikA theke vyaYa karo yakhana kona kraYa-vikraYa, vandhutva kiMvA supAriza (karAra suyoga) thAkave nA | Ara avizvAsIrAi anyAYakArI|

AllAha (emana eka sattA ye), tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| (tini) ciraJjIva o avinazvara| tA~ke tandrAYa kiMvA nidrAYa dhare nA| AsamAne o jamine yA kichu Ache tA (sava) tA~rai| emana ke Ache ye tA~ra anumati chAr3A tA~ra kAche supAriza karate pAre? yA kichu tAdera sAmane Ache o yA kichu tAdera pechane Ache tini tA (sava) jAnena| tini yataTuku cAna tA chAr3A tA~ra jJAnera kichui tArA AYatta karate pAre nA| tA~ra kurasI (Asana) AsamAna o jamina parivyApta kare Ache| e duiYera saMrakSaNe tA~ra kona kaSTa haYa nA| tini sarvocca, mahAmahima|

dharme valapraYoga nei| bhrAnta patha theke saThika patha spaSTa haYe giYeche| ataeva, ye tAgUta (bhrAnta upAsya/zaYatAna) ke amAnya karave evaM AllAhara prati ImAna Anave avazyai se dRr3hatama razi A~kar3e dharave, yA (kakhano) chi~r3avAra naYa| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

AllAha ImAnadAradera abhibhAvaka| tini tAderake andhakAra theke vera kare Alote niYe Asena| Ara yArA kAphera tAdera abhibhAvaka hala tAgUta| tArA tAderake Alo theke vera kare andhakAre niYe yAYa| tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA ciradina thAkave|

AllAha tAke rAjatva diYechilena vale ye lokaTi ivarAhImera sAthe tAra prabhura vyApAre vitarka karechila, tumi ki tAke dekhani? yakhana ivarAhIma valechila, “AmAra prabhu to tini, yini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna” takhana se valechila, “Amii jIvana dAna kari o mRtyu ghaTAi|” ivarAhIma valala, “tAhale AllAha to pUrvadika theke sUrya uThAna, tumi tA pazcima dika theke uThAoto|” takhana ai kAphera hatavAka haYe yAYa| AllAha jAlema lokaderake hedAYeta karena nA|

athavA sei lokaTira mata ye ekaTi grAme giYechila yAra gharagulo mAcAra opara patita avasthAYa chila (arthAt grAmaTi dhvaMsastUpe pariNata haYechila)| se valechila, “eTike era mRtyura para AllAha kIbhAve jIvita karavena (arthAt dhvaMsaprApta ei grAmaTike AllAha kIbhAve punargaThita karavena)?” erapara AllAha tAke ekaza vachara mRta avasthAYa rAkhena| tArapara tAke jIvita kare valena, “tumi (mRta avasthAYa) katadina chile?” se vale, “chilAma ekadina kiMvA ekadinera kichu aMza|” AllAha valena, “(tA naYa,) varaM tumi ekaza vachara (mRta) par3echile| tomAra khAdyasAmagrI o pAnIYa dravyera dike tAkAo, ogulo naSTa haYani| Ara tomAra gAdhATira dike tAkAo, Ami tomAke mAnuSera janya ekaTi nidarzana vAnAte cAi| (gAdhAra) hAr3agulora dike tAkiYe dekha Ami kIbhAve ogulo ekatrita kari, tArapara tA mAMsa diYe Dheke dei|” yakhana (goTA) vyApAraTi tAra kAche pariSkAra haYe yAYa takhana se vale, “Ami jAnate pAralAma ye, AllAha savakichui karate sakSama|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana ivarAhIma valechila, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAke dekhAo kIbhAve tumi mRtadera jIvita kara|” tini valalena, “kena, tumi ki vizvAsa karo nA?” se valala, “hyA~, (avazyai vizvAsa kari) tave manera prazAntira janya (dekhate cAcchi)|” tini valena, “AcchA, tAhale cAraTi pAkhi lao evaM tAderake tomAra poSa mAnAo| (ataHpara tAderake javAi kare keTe TukarA TukarA kara|) tArapara tAdera ekaTi kare TukarA pratiTi pAhAr3e rekhe dAo| ataHpara tAderake DAka dAo, tArA tomAra kAche chuTe Asave| Ara jene rAkha, AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|”

yArA tAdera sampada AllAhara pathe vyaYa kare tAdera avasthA ekaTi zasyadAnAra mata yA sAtaTi ziSa utpanna kare, pratiTi ziSe thAke ekazaTi kare dAnA| AllAha yAke cAna tAra sampada vahuguNa vAr3iYe dena| AllAha var3a dAnazIla, mahAjJAnI|

yArA tAdera sampada AllAhara pathe vyaYa kare evaM yA vyaYa kare tAra janya pare (grahItAke) khoTA kiMvA kaSTa deYa nA tAdera janya tAdera prabhura kAche puraskAra raYeche| tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|
ye dAnera pare (grahItAke) kaSTa deoYA haYa tAra ceYe bhAla kathA Ara kSamA uttama| AllAha abhAvamukta, sahanazIla|

he ImAnadAragaNa! khoTA kiMvA kaSTa diYe tomarA tomAdera dAnagulo ai vyaktira mata naSTa kare dio nA ye loka-dekhAnora janya sampada vyaYa kare evaM AllAha o parakAlake vizvAsa kare nA| tAra udAharaNa deYA yAYa ekaTi masRNa pAtharera sAthe, yAra opara kichu mATi chila, tArapara bhArI vRSTi pAtharaTike pariSkAra kare diYe geche| tArA yA upArjana kareche tA diYe kichui karate pArache nA| AllAha avizvAsI lokaderake patha dekhAna nA|

Ara yArA nijedera sampada AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera janya o nijedera manake sudRr3ha karAra janya vyaYa kare tAdera udAharaNa deYA yAYa kona TilAra opare avasthita ekaTi vAgAnera sAthe, yA bhArI vRSTi haoYAra phale dviguNa phasala utpanna kareche| sekhAne bhArI vRSTi nA haleo zizira to Ache| tomarA yA karo AllAha tA bhAlabhAve dekhate pAna|

mane karo, tomAdera kAro khejura o AGgurera ekaTi vAgAna Ache, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita hacche, vAgAnaTite tAra savarakama phala Ache, Ara tAra santAna-santati durvala thAkatei se vRddha haYe geche; ematAvasthAYa se ki cAive ye, vAgAnaTite ekaTi agnimaYa ghUrNijhar3a AghAta hAnuka Ara tA pur3e yAka? AllAha ebhAvei tomAdera janya nidarzanasamUha varNanA karena yAte tomarA cintA karate pAra|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA nijedera upArjita bhAla jinisa theke evaM Ami yA tomAdera janya bhUmi theke utpanna karechi tA theke vyaYa karo; khArApa jinisa vyaYa karate yeYo nA, kenanA tomarA nijerA cokha vandha nA kare (arthAt cokhe dekhe) tA nite cAive nA| jene rAkha, avazyai AllAha praYojanamukta, prazaMsita|
zaYatAna tomAderake dAridrera bhaYa dekhAYa evaM khArApa kAja karate vale, Ara AllAha tomAderake tA~ra pakSa theke kSamA o anugrahera pratizruti dena| AllAha mahAdAnazIla, suvijJa|
tini yAke cAna prajJA dAna karena| Ara yAke prajJA dAna karA haYa tAke prabhUta kalyANa dAna karA haYa| vuddhimAna mAnuSa chAr3A keu zikSA grahaNa kare nA|
tomarA yA kichu vyaYa karo kiMvA yA kichu mAnata karo AllAha tA avazyai jAnena| Ara jAlemadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tomarA yadi (tomAdera) dAnasamUha prakAza karo tAhale tA bhAla; tave yadi tA gopana rekhe garIvadera diYe dAo tAhale seTA tomAdera janya Aro bhAla| (ei dAnera kAraNe) AllAha tomAdera kichu kichu pApa mocana karena| Ara tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

tAderake pathe AnAra dAYa tomAra naYa, varaM AllAha yAke cAna patha dekhAna| Ara tomarA ye sampada vyaYa karo tA tomAdera nijedera janyai kara| tomarA to AllAhara santuSTira uddezya chAr3A vyaYa karacha nA| ye sampada tomarA vyaYa karo tA puropuri tomAdera kAche phiriYe deYA have| tomAderake (moTeo) juluma karA have nA|

(dAna) sei garIvadera janya yArA AllAhara pathe emanabhAve Avaddha haYe Ache ye, (jIvikAra janya) jamine yAtAYAta karate pAre nA| hAta nA pAtAra kAraNe ajJarA tAderake abhAvamukta mane kare thAke| tAdera (cehArAra) hAvabhAva dekhe tumi tAderake cinate pArave| tArA mAnuSera kAche minati kare kichu cAYa nA| tomarA ye sampada vyaYa karo AllAha tA bhAla karei jAnena|
yArA rAte o dine, gopane o prakAzye nijedera sampada vyaYa kare tArA tAdera prabhura kAche (era) puraskAra pAve| tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|

yArA suda khAYa tArA (keYAmatera dina) zaYatAne-dharA mAnuSera matai dA~r3Ave| eTA ejanya ye, tArA vale, “kraYa-vikraYao to sudera matai|” athaca AllAha kraYa-vikraYa hAlAla karechena Ara suda hArAma karechena| ataeva, prabhura kAcha theke upadeza AsAra para keu yadi (suda khAoYA theke) virata haYa tAhale Age yA (neoYA) haYeche tA tArai thAkave evaM tAra viSaYaTi (phaYasAlAra bhAra) AllAhara kAche (nyasta thAkave)| Ara yArA phire yAve (arthAt punarAYa suda khAve) tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI have, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|
AllAha sudake nizcihna karena Ara dAnake vardhita karena| AllAha kona avizvAsI pApIke pachanda karena nA|
yArA ImAna eneche, satkAja kareche, nAmAya par3eche o yAkAta diYeche tArA tAdera prabhura kAche (ejanya) puraskAra pAve| tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita have nA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM (tomAdera kAche) ye suda vakeYA Ache tA cher3e dAo, yadi tomarA (prakRta) ImAnadAra haYe thAka|

yadi tA nA karo tAhale AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pakSa theke ekaTi yuddhera ghoSaNA zune rAkha| Ara yadi tomarA taovA karo tAhale tomAdera mUladhana tomAdera thAkave| (e vyApAre) tomarAo juluma karate pArave nA evaM tomAderakeo juluma karA yAve nA|
(khAtaka) yadi abhAvagrasta haYa tAhale svacchalatA (AsA) paryanta (tAke) avakAza dio| Ara mApha kare deoYA tomAdera janya uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate|

tomarA sei dinake bhaYa karo yakhana tomAderake AllAhara kAche phiriYe AnA have| ataHpara pratyeka vyaktike se yA upArjana kareche tA puropuri diYe deoYA have evaM tAdera prati kona avicAra karA have nA|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yakhana kona nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta paraspara RNera lenadena karo takhana tA likhe rAkhave| ekajana lekhaka yena nyAYasaGgatabhAve tomAdera janya (viSaYaTi) likhe deYa| kona lekhaka yena likhe dite asvIkAra nA kare; Thika yebhAve AllAha tAke zikhiYechena; ataeva, se yena likhe deYa| RNagrahItA yena likhiYe rAkhe Ara svIYa prabhu AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM tA theke (arthAt RNera saThika parimANa theke) etaTuku kama nA lekhAYa| tave RNagrahitA yadi vokA kiMvA durvala haYa athavA nije lekhAte nA pAre tAhale tAra abhibhAvaka yena nyAYasaGgatabhAve likhiYe deYa| tomAdera puruSadera madhya theke dujanake sAkSI rekho; yadi dujana puruSa nA thAke tAhale sAkSI hiseve tomarA pachanda karo emana ekajana puruSa o dujana mahilA (rekho), yAte dujanera madhye ekajana bhula karale anyajana tAke smaraNa kariYe dite pAre| sAkSIderake DAkA hale tArA yena (sAkSya dite) asvIkAra nA kare| choTa hoka kiMvA var3a hoka, RNa lenadenera viSaYaTi meYAda ullekhasaha likhe rAkhate tomarA virakta have nA| eTAi AllAhara kAche nyAyyatara, sAkSyapramANa hiseve dRr3hatara o tomAdera sandehe patita nA haoYAra nikaTatara sahAYaka| avazya yadi tomarA nijedera madhye kona nagada vyavasAYika lenadena sampanna karo tAhale bhinna kathA; seTA nA likhale tomAdera kona pApa have nA| tave tomarA yakhana paraspara kenAvecA karo takhana sAkSI rekho| lekhaka kiMvA sAkSI kAro yena kSati nA karA haYa| yadi tomarA tA karo tAhale seTA tomAdera anyAYa have| AllAhake bhaYa kara| AllAha tomAderake (savakichu) zikhiYe dena| tini savakichui bhAlabhAve jAnena|

Ara tomarA yadi saphare thAka evaM kona lekhaka nA pAo tAhale hastAntarakRta vandhaka (rekho)| yadi tomAdera ekajana Arekajanake vizvAsa kare (tAra kAche kichu AmAnata rAkhe) tAhale yAke vizvAsa karA haYeche se yena tAra (kAche rAkhA) AmAnata pherata deYa evaM svIYa prabhu AllAhake bhaYa kare| tomarA sAkSya gopana karo nA| ye tA gopana kare se nizcaYai antarapApI| tomarA yA karo AllAha tA bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|

AsamAnasamUhe yA kichu Ache evaM jamine yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara| tomarA tomAdera manera kathA prakAza karo kiMvA gopana rAkha, AllAha tomAdera kAche tAra hisAva nevena| tArapara tini yAke icchA kSamA karavena Ara yAke icchA zAsti devena| AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|

rasUlera kAche tAra prabhura pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche tA se vizvAsa kareche, ImAnadAragaNao (tAi kareche)| savAi AllAhara prati, tA~ra pherezatAdera prati, tA~ra kitAvasamUhera prati o tA~ra rasUladera prati ImAna eneche| (tArA valeche,) “AmarA tA~ra rasUladera madhye kAro sAthe kAro tAratamya kari nA|” tArA valeche, “AmarA zunechi o mene niYechi| he AmAdera prabhu! tomAra kSamA (prArthanA kari), tomArai kAche (sakalera) pratyAvartana|”

AllAha kAuke tAra sAdhyera vAire kAja cApiYe dena nA| se yA (bhAla) upArjana kare tAra suphala se pAYa, AvAra yA (manda) upArjana kare tAra kuphalao se bhoga kare| (tomarA ebhAve prArthanA karo:) “he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA yadi bhule yAi kiMvA bhula kari tAhale (anugraha kare) AmAderake zAsti dio nA| he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera opara kona bhArI vojhA cApiYo nA, yemanaTi AmAdera pUrvavartIdera opara cApiYechile| he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake emana kona dAYitva dio nA yA pAlana karAra kSamatA AmAdera nei| Ara AmAdera pApa mocana karo, AmAderake kSamA karo evaM AmAdera prati anugraha kara| tumi AmAdera prabhu, tAi kApheradera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya kara|”
Alipha lAma mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
AllAha (emana eka sattA ye), tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei, (tini) ciraJjIva o avinazvara|

tini tomAra kAche mahAsatya niYe mahAgrantha (koraAna) avatIrNa karechena yA tAra sAmane yA Ache tAra (arthAt itipUrve avatIrNa AsamAni kitAvera) samarthaka; tini tAorAta o inajIla avatIrNa karechilena

itipUrve mAnuSera janya pathanirdeza hiseve, Ara (ekhana) satya-mithyAra pArthakyakArI grantha (koraAna) avatIrNa karechena| yArA AllAhara (kitAvera) AYAtasamUha avizvAsa kare tAdera janya kaThora zAsti raYeche| AllAha parAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNakArI|
AllAhara kAche jaminera kiMvA AsamAnera kona kichui gopana thAke nA|
