tinii mAtRgarbhe yebhAve cAna tomAdera AkRti gar3ena| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei, tini parAkramazAlI, parama prAjJa|

tinii tomAra kAche ei kitAva nAyila karechena| era madhye emanasava AYAta raYeche yA ekevArei spaSTa, eguloi kitAvera mUla; AvAra (ete) anya katipaYa dvyarthavodhaka AYAtao Ache| phale, yAdera antare vakratA Ache tArA phetanA sRSTira uddezye era dvyarthavodhaka aMzera (AYAtasamUhera) tAtparya khu~jate era pechane lege yAYa| athaca era (Asala) tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA| Ara paripakka jJAnera adhikArIrA vale, “AmarA egulo vizvAsa karechi; savai AmAdera prabhura pakSa theke (eseche)|” kevala vuddhisampanna vyaktirAi (ebhAve) upadeza grahaNa kare|
(tArA vale,) “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake patha dekhAnora para AmAdera antarasamUha vakra (satyavimukha) karo nA| Ara AmAderake tomAra pakSa theke anugraha dAna kara| niHsandehe tumii var3a dAtA|”
“he AmAdera prabhu! nizcaYai tumi emana eka dine (hAzarera dina) sava mAnuSa ekatrita karave ye samparke kona sandeha nei| AllAha to oYAdA bhaGga karena nA|”
yArA (satyake) avizvAsa kare tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati AllAhara sAmane tAdera konai kAje Asave nA| Ara tArAi have doyakhera jvAlAni|

(tAdera AcaraNa) pherAunera samapradAYa o tAdera pUrvavartIdera AcaraNera mata; tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA valechila| takhana AllAha tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNei pAkar3Ao karechilena (zAsti diYechilena)| AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA|
avizvAsIderake vala, “tomAderake zigagirai parAjita karA have evaM ekatra kare jAhAnnAmera dike niYe yAoYA have| seTA var3a khArApa ThikAnA!”

(yuddhakSetre) milita haoYA duTo dalera madhye tomAdera janya avazyai eka nidarzana chila| ekaTi dala AllAhara pathe yuddha karachila Ara anyaTi chila kApheradera dala, yArA tAderake (ImAnadAraderake) cokhera dekhAYa tAdera (nijedera) dviguNa dekhachila| Ara AllAha yAke cAna svIYa sAhAyya dvArA zaktizAlI karena| nizcaYai ai ghaTanAra madhye dRSTisampannadera janya zikSA raYeche|

nArI, santAna-santati, svarNa-raupyera aDhela sampada, chApayukta (sundara sundara) ghor3A, gavAdipazu o kSeta-khAmAra ityAdi kAmyavastura AkarSaNa mAnuSera janya manohara karA haYeche| esava hala pArthiva jIvanera bhogera sAmagrI| Ara AllAhara nikaTa raYeche uttama pratyAvartanasthala (jAnnAta)|

vala, “Ami ki tomAderake esava theke bhAla kichura saMvAda deva? yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janya tAdera prabhura nikaTa emana sava jAnnAta raYeche yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita; tArA sekhAne anantakAla thAkave| Aro raYeche pavitra saGginIrA o AllAhara santuSTi| AllAha vAndAdera savakichu dekhena|”
yArA vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA to ImAna enechi, tAi AmAdera pApagulo mApha kare dAo evaM AmAderake doyakhera AjAva theke rakSA kara|”
yArA dhairyadhAraNakArI, satyavAdI, (AllAhara) anugata, (satpathe) vyaYakArI o zeSa-rAte kSamA prArthanAkArI|

AllAha sAkSya dena ye, tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei; pherezatArA o jJAnI vyaktirAo (ekai sAkSya deYa); (AllAhara ei sAkSya) nyAYa pratiSThAkArI hisAve| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAvAna|

AllAhara kAche dharma hacche isalAma| Ara yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tArA (ihudi o khriSTAnarA) tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra parao kevala pArasparika vidveSavazata matavirodha kareche| yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kare tAdera jAnA ucita ye, AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

yadi tArA tomAra sAthe vitarka kare tAhale tumi valave, “Ami AllAhara kAche nijeke samarpaNa karechi, AmAra anusArIrAo (tAi kareche)|” kitAvadhArI o azikSitaderake (makkAra muzarikaderake) vala, “tomarA ki AtmasamarpaNa karecho?” yadi tArAo AtmasamarpaNa kare tAhale tArA hedAYeta pAve; Ara yadi asvIkRti jAnAYa tAhale (mane rAkhave,) tomAra dAYitva kevala vArtA pau~che deoYA| AllAha vAndAdera savakichu dekhena|
yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kare, navIderake anyAYabhAve hatyA kare evaM nyAYera Adeza dAnakArI lokaderake hatyA kare tAderake kaSTadAYaka zAstira kathA jAniYe dAo|
erAi sei loka yAdera karmasamUha ihakAla o parakAle niSphala haYe giYeche| tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ki tAdera dike tAkiYe dekhani, yAderake kitAvera ekaTi aMza deoYA haYeche? tAdera madhyakAra virodha mImAMsA karAra janya tAderake AllAhara kitAvera dike DAkA hacche| kintu tAdera ekaTi dala mukha phiriYe cale yAcche|
era kAraNa, tArA vale, “alpa kaYekadina vyatIta (doyakhera) Aguna AmAderake sparza karave nA|” nijedera dharma samparke tAdera (erUpa) mithyA udbhAvana tAderake dho~kAYa phele diYeche|

kintu yakhana Ami tAderake emana eka dine ekatra karava ye samparke kona sandeha nei Ara (sedina) ye yA upArjana kareche pratyekake tA puropuri deoYA have evaM (pratidAna pradAne) kAro prati avicAra karA have nA takhana kemana have?

vala, “rAjatvera mAlika he AllAha! tumi yAke cAo rAjatva dAo, AvAra yAra kAcha theke cAo rAjatva ker3e nAo; yAke cAo sammAnita karo, AvAra yAke cAo lAJchita kara| tomAra hAtei kalyANa| tumi savakichu karate sakSama|”
“tumi dinera madhye rAta o rAtera madhye dina praveza karAo; mRta theke jIvitake o jIvita theke mRtake vera karo evaM yAke cAo vinA hisAve jIvikA dAna kara|”

muminarA yena muminadera parivarte kApheraderake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA kare| ye tA karave se AllAhara pakSa theke kona sAhAyya pAve nA| tave tAdera dika theke tomAdera kona bhaYa thAkale bhinna kathA| AllAha tomAderake tA~ra nijera samparke (tA~ra zAsti samparke) satarka kare dicchena| Ara tA~ra kAchei (savAra) pratyAvartana|
vala, “tomarA tomAdera manera kathA gopana karo kiMvA prakAza karo AllAha tA jAnena| AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache sava tini jAnena| AllAha sava kichu karAra kSamatA rAkhena|”

yedina pratyekei tAra bhAla kAja upasthita pAve, tAra khArApa kAjao, sedina se kAmanA karave, yadi tAra o khArApa kAjera madhye ekaTi var3a dUratva hata! AllAha tomAderake tA~ra nijera samparke (tA~ra zAsti samparke) satarka kare dicchena| Ara AllAha (tA~ra) vAndAdera prati daYAzIla|
vala, “tomarA yadi AllAhake bhAlavAsa tave AmAke anusaraNa karo, tAhale AllAhao tomAderake bhAlavAsavena evaM tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA kare devena| AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|”
vala, “tomarA AllAha o rasUlera Anugatya kara|” yadi tArA (tA karate) asvIkAra kare tAhale (jAnave) AllAha kApheradera bhAlavAsena nA|
AllAha Adama, nUha, ivarAhImera parivAra o imarAnera parivArake sArA vizvavAsIra opare manonIta karechena|
edera kataka katakera vaMzadhara chila| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana imarAnera strI valala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra peTe ye santAna raYeche tAke Ami ekAntabhAve tomAra janya utsarga karalAma| AmAra pakSa theke tumi tA grahaNa kara| nizcaYai tumi sarvazrotA, mahAjJAnI|”

tArapara se yakhana tAke prasava karala takhana valala, “he AmAra prabhu! Ami to kanyA prasava karechi,” —se yA prasava kareche tA to AllAhai bhAla jAnena,— “puruSa to nArIra mata naYa, Ami tAra nAma rekhechi mariYama, Ara Ami tAke o tAra santAna-santatike abhizapta zaYatAnera prabhAva theke (rakSAra janya) tomAra hephAjate dicchi|”

AllAha tAke bhAlabhAve kavula karena evaM bhAlabhAve var3a kare tolena| tini tAke yAkAriYAra tattvAvadhAne rekhechilena| yAkAriYA yakhanai tAke dekhate (tAra) kakSe praveza karata takhanai tAra kAche khAdyasAmagrI dekhate peta| se tAke valata, “mariYama! egulo tumi kothA theke pele?” se valata, “egulo AllAhara pakSa theke (eseche)|” Asale AllAha yAke cAna vinA hisAve riyika dAna karena|
sekhAne yAkAriYA tAra prabhura kAche doYA kare| se vale, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAke tomAra pakSa theke (tomAra vizeSa kRpAYa) bhAla santAna dAna kara| avazyai tumi doYA zravaNakArI|”

ataHpara se yakhana kAmarAra madhye nAmAye daNDAYamAna chila takhana pherezatArA tAke samvodhana kare valala, “AllAha tomAke (tomAra santAna) iYAhaiYAra susaMvAda dicchena, ye have AllAhara ekaTi kathAra (mariYamaputra IsAra) prati vizvAsa sthApanakArI, netRtvasampanna, nArI-saMsarga theke virata o ekajana satkarmazIla navI|”
se (yAkAriYA) valala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra chele have kIbhAve? AmAra ye vArdhakya ese geche, Ara AmAra strIo vandhyA|” tini (AllAha) valena, “ AllAha ebhAvei yA cAna tA kare thAkena|”

se valala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra janya (santAna haoYAra) ekaTi pUrvalakSaNa dio|” tini valalena, “tomAra pUrvalakSaNa have ei ye, tumi tinadina dhare izArAYa chAr3A mAnuSera sAthe kathA valate pArave nA| (takhana) vezi kare tomAra prabhuke smaraNa karo evaM sakAla-sandhyA tAsavIha par3o|”

Ara (smaraNa karo) yakhana pherezatArA (mariYamake) valechila, “he mariYama! AllAha tomAke manonIta karechena, tomAke pavitra karechena evaM sArA pRthivIra nArIdera madhya theke tomAke vAchAi karechena|
he mariYama! tomAra prabhura anugata hao evaM (tA~ra uddezye) sejadA karo o mAthAnatakArIdera saGge mAthAnata kara|”

e hacche ekaTi anyatama gAYevI saMvAda yA Ami tomAke ohIra mAdhyame avahita karachi| tAdera madhye ke mariYamera dAYitva neve tA Thika karAra janya tArA yakhana tAdera (laTArira) kalama nikSepa karachila takhana tumi tAdera kAche chile nA| temani tArA yakhana (viSaYaTi niYe) jhagar3A karachila takhanao tumi tAdera kAche chile nA|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana pherezatArA valechila, “he mariYama! AllAha tomAke tA~ra ekaTi kathAra (tomAra santAnera) susaMvAda dicchena, yAra nAma mAsIha—mariYamaputra IsA—evaM ye ihakAla o parakAle maryAdAvAna o (AllAhara) ghaniSTha vAndAdera anyatama|
se dolanAYa (zizu avasthAYa) o pariNata vaYase mAnuSera sAthe kathA valave evaM sat lokadera antarbhukta have|”

se valala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra santAna have kIbhAve? AmAke to kona mAnuSa (puruSa) sparza kareni|” tini (AllAha) valena, “ebhAvei (have)| AllAha (yebhAve) yA cAna sRSTi karena| tini yakhana kona kichu karAra siddhAnta nena takhana tAke zudhu valena, "hao" Ara amani tA haYe yAYa|”
AllAha tAke (IsAke) kitAva, prajJA, tAorAta o inajIla zikSA devena|

evaM (tAke) vanI isarAIlera nikaTa ekajana rasUla hiseve (pAThAvena)| (se tAderake valave,) “Ami tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura nikaTa theke nidarzana niYe esechi| (tA ei ye,) Ami tomAdera janya kAdAmATi dvArA ekaTi pAkhira AkRti tairI kari; tArapara tAte phu~ka dei; takhana tA AllAhara hukume (jIvanta) pAkhi haYe yAYa| Ami janmAndha o kuSTharogIke sustha kari evaM AllAhara hukume mRtaderake jIvita kari| tomarA yA khAo Ara yA ghare saMrakSaNa karo Ami tA tomAderake avahita kari| yadi tomarA vizvAsI hao tAhale nizcaYai era madhye tomAdera janya nidarzana Ache|

Ara (Ami esechi) AmAra sAmane ye tAorAta Ache tAra satyAYanakArIrUpe o tomAdera janya avaidha karA haYechila emana katipaYa jinisa vaidha karate| Ami tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke nidarzana niYe esechi| ataeva, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
nizcaYai AllAha AmAra prabhu evaM tomAderao prabhu; tAi tomarA tA~ra ivAdata kara| eTAi saThika patha|”

kintu IsA yakhana tAdera madhye avizvAsa Tera pela takhana valala, “AllAhara pathe AmAra sAhAyyakArI kArA Ache?” (tAra) anusArIrA valala, “AmarA AllAhara (pathe) sAhAyyakArI| AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi| tumi sAkSI thAka ye, AmarA musalima (AllAhara anugata)|”
(tArA AllAhara uddezye vale,) “he AmAdera prabhu! tumi yA nAyila karecho AmarA tA vizvAsa karechi evaM (tomAra) rasUlera anusaraNa karechi| ataeva, AmAderake sAkSIdera tAlikAbhukta kara|”
tArA (avizvAsIrA) Sar3ayantra karechila Ara AllAhao (tAdera Sar3ayantrera viruddhe pAlTA) kauzala karechilena| AllAha hacchena serA kauzalakArI|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana AllAha valechilena, “he IsA! Ami tomAke niYe neva, tomAke AmAra kAche uThiYe Anava, tomAke avizvAsIdera (mithyA Aropa) theke pavitra karava evaM keYAmata paryanta tomAra anusArIderake avizvAsIdera opare rAkhava| tArapara AmAra kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana (have)| takhana Ami tomAdera matAnaikyera viSaYe tomAdera madhye mImAMsA karava|
yArA avizvAsa kare Ami tAderake duniYA o AkherAte kaThina zAsti deva; tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|
Ara yArA vizvAsa kare o satkAja kare tini (AllAha) tAdera pratiphala puropuri devena| AllAha jAlemadera bhAlavAsena nA|
AYAtasamUha o prajJAmaYa vANI theke eTA tomAke AvRtti kare zonAcchi|
Asale IsAra dRSTAnta AllAhara kAche Adamera matai| tini tAke (arthAt tAra AkRtiTi) mATi theke tairI karechilena, tArapara valechilena, “hao”, takhana se haYe yAYa|
satya tomAra prabhura pakSa thekei (Ase); tAi sandeha poSaNakArIdera dalabhukta haYo nA|

tomAra kAche (pUrNa) jJAna AsAra pare keu tAra (IsAra) vyApAre tomAra sAthe vitarka karale valave, “eso AmarA AmAdera o tomAdera putraderake, strIderake o nijederake DAki (arthAt nijedera strIputradera Deke niYe AmarA ubhaYapakSa vasi); tArapara (savAi ekatre) prArthanA kare mithyAvAdIdera opara AllAhara abhisampAta dei|”
nisandehe eTAi satya varNanA| AllAha chAr3A kona upAsya nei evaM nisandehe AllAhai hacchena parAkramazAlI, parama prAjJa|
tArA yadi nA mAne tAhale (jene rAkha,) AllAha golayoga sRSTikArIdera samparke samyaka avagata Achena|

vala, “he kitAvadhArIgaNa! tomarA AmAdera o tomAdera mAjhe ekaTi abhinna kathAYa Asa ye, AmarA (keu) AllAha chAr3A kAro ivAdata karava nA, tA~ra sAthe kAuke zarIka karava nA evaM AllAhara parivarte keu kAuke prabhu vAnAva nA|” yadi tArA asammata haYa tAhale tomarA valave, “tomarA sAkSI thAka ye, AmarA musalima|”
he kitAvIrA! tomarA ivarAhImera vyApAre kena vitarka karacha? athaca tAorAta o inajIla tAra parei nAyila karA haYeche| tomarA ki vojha nA?

zona, tomarAi to (itipUrve) emana viSaYa niYe vitarka karecho ye viSaYe tomAdera kichu jJAna Ache| kintu (ekhana) ye viSaYe tomAdera kona jJAna nei tA niYe kena vitarka karacha? (Asale) AllAha jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|
ivarAhIma ihudi kiMvA khriSTAna chila nA; varaM se chila ekaniSTha musalima| se muzarikao chila nA|
avazyai ivarAhImera ghaniSThatama mAnuSa tArAi yArA tAra anusaraNa karechila evaM ei navI (muhAmmAda) o yArA ImAna eneche tArA (musalamAnarA)| Ara AllAha ImAnadAradera abhibhAvaka|
kitAvIdera ekaTi dala tomAderake vibhrAnta karate cAYa| Asale tArA kevala nijederakei vibhrAnta karache, kintu tArA (tA) vujhate pAre nA|
he kitAvIrA! tomarA kena AllAhara AYAtasamUha amAnya karacha? athaca tomarAi (tAra satyatAra) sAkSya diccha|
he kitAvadhArIrA! tomarA kena satyake mithyAra sAthe mizrita karo evaM jenezune satya gopana karo?

kitAvadhArIdera ekadala (tAdera anusArIderake) valechila, “ImAnadAradera (musalamAnadera) kAche yA nAyila karA haYeche tA dinera prathamabhAge vizvAsa karave evaM zeSabhAge avizvAsa karave| ete tArA (tAdera dharma theke) phire Asate pAre|

Ara tomAdera dharmera anusaraNa kare emana loka chAr3A (anya kAuke) vizvAsa karave nA|” (he navI) tumi vala, “Asala patha hacche AllAhara (nirdezita) patha|” (tArA Aro valechila,) “(tomarA eTAo vizvAsa karave nA) ye, tomAdera yA deoYA haYeche temanaTi anya kAuke deoYA hate pAre; anyathAYa tArA tomAdera prabhura sAmane tomAdera sAthe vitarke lipta have|” vala, “anugraha to AllAhara hAte| tini yAke icchA tA dAna karena| AllAha var3a dAnazIla, mahAjJAnI|”
tini yAke cAna svIYa anugrahera janya veche nena| AllAha mahA anugrahera adhikArI|

kitAvIdera madhye emana loka Ache yAra kAche tumi vipula sampada AmAnata rAkhaleo se tA tomAke pherata deve| AvAra tAdera madhye emana lokao Ache yAra kAche tumi ekaTi dInAra (mudrA) AmAnata rAkhaleo se tA tomAke pherata deve nA, yadi nA tumi tAra kAche dA~r3iYe thAka| eTA ei kAraNe ye, tArA valeche, “mUrkhadera (a-kitAvIdera) vyApAre AmAdera kona dAYitva nei (tAdera sampada AtmasAt karAYa AmAdera kona doSa nei)|” tArA AllAha samparke jenezune mithyA vale|
hyA~, ye tAra oYAdA pUraNa karave evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karave avazyai AllAha erakama mottAkIdera bhAlavAsena|

yArA AllAhara (sAthe karA) oYAdA o nijedera zapathake sAmAnya mUlye vikri kare deYa tAdera janya parakAle kona aMza nei| keYAmatera dina AllAha tAdera sAthe kathA valavena nA evaM tAdera dike tAkAvena nA| tini tAderake zodhanao karavena nA| tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

Ara tAdera madhye ekadala loka Ache yArA (AllAhara) kitAva par3Ara samaYa (uccAraNavikRti ghaTAte) jihavA vA~kA kare, yAte tomarA tAke (vikRta uccAraNake) kitAvera aMza mane karo, athaca tA kitAvera aMza naYa| Ara tArA vale, “eTA AllAhara pakSa theke”, athaca tA AllAhara pakSa theke naYa| ebhAve tArA jenezune AllAha samparke mithyA vale|

AllAha kona mAnuSake kitAva, prajJA o navuoYAta dAna karAra para se mAnuSaderake valate pAre nA ye, tomarA AllAhara parivarte AmAra dAsa hao, varaM (se to valave) tomarA prabhuparAYaNa hao, kAraNa tomarAi to kitAva zikSA dite o (nijerA tA) pATha karate|
pherezatA o navIderake prabhu vAnAteo se tomAdera nirdeza dite pAre nA| tomarA musalamAna haoYAra para se ki tomAderake kupharira nirdeza dite pAre?

(smaraNa karo) yakhana AllAha navIdera kAcha theke aGgIkAra niYechilena (Ara valechilena), “Ami tomAderake ye kitAva o prajJA dAna karechi tA grahaNa kara| ataHpara tomAdera kAche yA Ache tAra samarthaka ekajana rasUla Asave| takhana avazyai tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anave evaM tAke sAhAyya karave|” tini valechilena, “tomarA ki svIkAra karale evaM e vyApAre AmAra cukti grahaNa karale?” tArA valechila, “svIkAra karalAma|” tini valechilena, “tAhale tomarA sAkSI theko, Ara Amio tomAdera sAthe sAkSI thAkalAma|”
erapara yArA phire yAve (aGgIkAra bhaGga karave) tArAi anyAYakArI|
tArA ki AllAhara dvIna chAr3A anya dvIna cAYa? athaca AsamAnasamUhe o jamine yArA Ache tArA svecchAYa o anicchAYa tA~ra anugata haYeche| Ara tAderake tA~ra kAchei phiriYe neYA have|

vala, “AmarA AllAhara prati; AmAdera opara yA nAyila karA haYeche tAra prati; ivarAhIma, IsamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tAra vaMzadharadera opara yA yA nAyila karA haYeche tAra prati evaM mUsA, IsA o (anyAnya) navIderake tAdera prabhura pakSa theke yA yA deoYA haYeche tAra prati ImAna enechi| tAdera kAro madhye AmarA pArthakya kari nA| Ara AmarA tA~rai anugata|”
keu isalAma chAr3A anya kona dharma cAile tAra theke seTA kakhano grahaNa karA have nA| Ara parakAle se kSatigrasta have|

ye lokerA ImAna AnAra para, rasUlake satya vale sAkSya deoYAra para evaM tAdera kAche pramANa ese yAvAra para (punarAYa) kAphera haYeche tAderake AllAha kIbhAve hedAYeta karavena? AllAha jAlemadera hedAYeta karena nA|
odera zAsti ei ye, odera opara AllAhara, pherezatAdera o sava mAnuSera abhisampAta,
yAra madhye tArA cirakAla thAkave| tAdera zAsti laghu karA have nA evaM (zAsti bhogera kSetre) tAderake avakAzao deoYA have nA|
tave era pareo yArA taovA kare satkAja karave tAdera avasthA bhinna have; kenanA AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA vizvAsa karAra para avizvAsa kareche, tArapara se avizvAsa vAr3iYe diYeche tAdera taovA kavula karA have nA| tArAi pathabhraSTa|

yArA kuphari kare evaM kAphera avasthAYa mArA yAYa tAdera keu yadi muktipaNasvarUpa puro pRthivI parimANa svarNao deYa tavu tA grahaNa karA have nA| tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti (nirdhArita) raYeche| Ara tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
yatakSaNa nA tomarA tomAdera pachandera jinisa theke vyaYa karave tatakSaNa tomarA puNyera nAgAla pAve nA| Ara tomarA yA kichu vyaYa karo AllAha tA bhAla kare jAnena|

tAorAta nAyila haoYAra pUrve isarAIla (iYAkUva) nijera janya ye khAvAra hArAma karechila tA chAr3A vanI isarAIlera janya savarakama khAvArai hAlAla chila| vala, “tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale tAorAta niYe eso evaM tA pATha kara|”
tAra pareo yArA AllAha samparke mithyA vAniYe vale tArAi jAlema|
vala, “AllAha satya valechena, ataeva, tomarA ekaniSTha ivarAhImera dharma anusaraNa kara| se muzarika chila nA|”
makkAYa avasthita varakatapUrNa o sArA vizvavAsIra janya pathanirdezarUpI gharakhAnAi Asale mAnavajAtira janya sthApita prathama ghara|

ete katipaYa spaSTa nidarzana Ache yemana mAkAme ivarAhIma (ivarAhImera pAYera chApasamvalita pAthara)| ei ghare ye praveza karave se nirApada| ai ghara paryanta yAoYAra sAmarthya Ache emana mAnuSera janya AllAhara (santuSTira) uddezye sekhAne (hajja karate) yAoYA kartavya| keu asvIkAra karale (tAra jAnA ucita,) AllAha sRSTijagatera praYojana theke mukta|
vala, “he kitAvadhArIrA! tomarA kena AllAhara nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa karacha? athaca tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tAra sAkSI|”

vala, “he kitAvadhArIrA! yArA ImAna eneche tomarA kena tAderake AllAhara pathe vAdhA dAo? tomarA to sekhAne vakratA sandhAna karacha| athaca tomarAi (tAra satyatAra) sAkSI| tomarA yA karo AllAha se samparke vekhavara nana|”
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yadi kitAvadhArIdera kona ekaTi dalera Anugatya karo tAhale ImAna AnAra para tArA tomAderake AvAra kAphera vAniYe deve|

tomarA kIbhAve avizvAsa karo, yakhana tomAderake AllAhara AYAtasamUha pATha kare zonAno haYa evaM tomAdera mAjhe tA~ra rasUlao Ache? ye AllAhake A~kar3e dharave (AllAhara nirdeza pAlane anar3a thAkave) se saThika pathera sandhAna pAve|
he ImAnadAragaNa! AllAhake yathArthabhAve bhaYa karo evaM musalamAna nA haYe (athavA puropuri AllAhara anugata nA haYe) maro nA|

savAi AllAhara razike zakta kare dhara, vicchinna haYo nA| tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa kara| tomarA paraspara zatru chile, tArapara tini tomAdera antare hRdyatA saJcAra karechena| phale tomarA tA~ra anugrahe bhAi bhAi haYecho| tomarA eka agnikuNDera prAnte avasthAna karachile| tini tomAderake sekhAna theke uddhAra karechena| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra nidarzanasamUha prakAza karena, yAte tomarA dika-nirdezanA pAo|
tomAdera madhye yena emana ekaTi dala thAke yArA kalyANera dike DAkave evaM bhAla kAja karate Adeza deve o khArApa kAja karate niSedha karave| erAi saphalakAma|
tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA paraspara vicchinna haYechila evaM tAdera kAche nidarzanasamUha AsAra parao matabheda karechila| odera janya raYeche virATa zAsti|

yedina katipaYa cehArA sAdA (ujjvala) have Ara katipaYa cehArA kAlo (malina) have| yAdera cehArA kAlo have (tAderake valA have,) “tomarA ki ImAna AnAra para kuphari karechile? ekhana tAhale kuphari karAra zAsti bhoga kara|”
Ara yAdera cehArA sAdA have tArA AllAhara rahamatera madhye (jAnnAte) thAkave| sekhAne tArA anantakAla avasthAna karave|
egulo AllAhara AYAta yA tomAke saThikabhAve pATha kare zonAcchi| AllAha vizvavAsIra prati avicAra karate cAna nA|
AsamAnasamUhe yA Ache evaM pRthivIte yA Ache tA (sava) AllAharai| Ara AllAhara kAchei yAvatIYa viSaYa phiriYe neYA have|

tomarA (prakRta musalamAnarA) hale zreSTha jAti yAderake mAnuSera janya AvirbhUta karA haYeche| tomarA bhAla kAja karAra Adeza dAo, khArApa kAja karate vAraNa karo evaM AllAhake vizvAsa kara| kitAvadhArIrA yadi ImAna Anata tAhale tA tAdera janya maGgalajanaka hata| tAdera madhye kichu ImAnadAra Ache, tave tAdera adhikAMzai phAseka (pApAcArI)|
kichuTA kaSTa deoYA chAr3A tArA tomAdera kona kSati karate pArave nA| Ara yadi tArA tomAdera sAthe yuddha kare tAhale tomAdera theke pazcAdapasaraNa karave| tArapara tArA kona sAhAyya pAve nA|

AllAhara pakSa theke kiMvA mAnuSera pakSa theke kona rakSAcuktira AotA chAr3A yekhAnei tAderake pAoYA geche tAdera opara lAJchanAra chApa lAgiYe deoYA haYeche; tArA (nijedera opara) AllAhara krodha Tene eneche evaM tAdera opara duravasthAra chApa lAgiYe deoYA haYeche| eTA ejanya ye, tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha avizvAsa karata evaM navIderake anyAYabhAve hatyA karata| eTA ejanya ye, tArA (AllAhara) avAdhya haYechila evaM sImAlaMghana karachila|
tArA savAi ekarakama naYa| kitAvadhArIdera madhye (nyAYera opara) aTala ekadala mAnuSa Ache, yArA rAtera velAYa AllAhara AYAtasamUha pATha kare evaM sejadArata thAke|
tArA AllAha o parakAle vizvAsa kare, bhAla kAjera Adeza deYa o khArApa kAja theke virata rAkhe evaM satkarmera ceSTA kare| tArA satlokadera antarbhukta|
tArA yesava bhAla kAja kare tAra phala theke tAderake vaJcita karA have nA| AllAha mottAkIdera samparke samyaka avagata|
yArA avizvAsa kare tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati AllAhara sAmane tAdera konai upakAre Asave nA| tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI (have)| sekhAne tArA ciradina thAkave|

ei pArthiva jIvane tArA yA vyaYa kare tAra udAharaNa: yena kanakane ThANDA ekaTi vAtAsa emana ekadala lokera zasyakSete AghAta hene tA dhvaMsa kare diYeche yArA nijedera prati juluma kareche| AllAha tAdera prati juluma karenani, varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma karache|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA tomAdera (ImAnadAradera) chAr3A anyadera sAthe ghaniSThatA karo nA| tArA tomAdera kSati karate truTi kare nA| tomarA yAte kaSTa pAo tArA tAi cAYa| tAdera mukhera kathAYa zatrutA prakAza peYeche| Ara tAdera mane yA lukiYe Ache tA Aro gurutara| tomAdera janya nidarzanasamUha pariSkAra kare dilAma, yadi tomarA vujhate pAra|

dekha, tomarAi tAderake bhAlavAsa, kintu tArA tomAderake bhAlavAse nA| Ara tomarA sava kitAva vizvAsa karo (kintu tArA tA kare nA)| tArA yakhana tomAdera sAthe sAkSAt kare takhana vale, “AmarA vizvAsa karechi|” Ara yakhana nijerA ekAnte milita haYa takhana tomAdera prati rAge (dA~ta diYe) AGgula kAmar3AYa| vala, “tomarA tomAdera rAga niYe mara| nizcaYai AllAha (mAnuSera) manera kathA bhAlabhAve jAnena|”

tomAdera yadi bhAla kichu haYa tAhale tAdera tA khArApa lAge; Ara tomAdera khArApa kichu hale tAte tArA Anandita haYa| (tave) tomarA yadi dhairyadhAraNa karo o tAkaoYA avalamvana karo tAhale tAdera Sar3ayantra tomAdera kona kSati karave nA| nizcaYai AllAha tAdera karmakANDa AYatte rekhechena|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana tumi yuddhera janya musalamAnaderake (tAdera) ghA~Tite niyukta karate sakAle ghara theke vera haYechile| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
yakhana tomAdera duTi dala hatodyama haoYAra upakrama karechila, athaca AllAha tAdera abhibhAvaka chilena| ImAnadArarA yena AllAhara opara nirbhara kare|
tomarA durvala haoYA sattveo vadare AllAha tomAderake vijaYI karechilena| ataeva AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA kRtajJa hate pAra|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana tumi muminadera valachile, “tomAdera prabhu (AsamAna theke) nAyilakRta tina hAjAra pherezatA dvArA tomAderake sAhAyya karale seTA ki tomAdera janya yatheSTa have nA?”

avazyai (yatheSTa have); yadi tomarA dhairyadhAraNa karo o satarkatA avalamvana karo Ara tArA (muzarikarA) tomAdera opara erakama AcamakA AkramaNa kare vase tAhale tomAdera prabhu pracaNDa AkramaNakArI pA~ca hAjAra pherezatA dvArA tomAderake sAhAyya karavena|
AllAha eTA karechena kevala tomAdera janya susaMvAdasvarUpa, evaM yAte tomAdera mana nizcinta haYa| Ara sAhAyya to zudhu parAkramazAlI o prajJAmaYa AllAhara kAcha thekei Ase|
(AllAha eTA karechena) kApheradera ekaTi aMzake vicchinna karAra janya kiMvA tAderake avadamita rAkhAra janya yAte tArA nirAza haYe phire yAYa|
tomAra kichu karAra nei; tini haYa tAderake kSamA karavena natuvA zAsti devena, kenanA tArA jAlema|
AsamAne o jamine yA kichu Ache tA AllAhara| tini yAke cAna kSamA karena evaM yAke cAna zAsti dena| AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA dviguNa-vahuguNa kare suda kheYo nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAte tomarA saphala hao|
Ara sei doyakhake bhaYa karo yA kApheradera janya prastuta karA haYeche|
AllAha o (tA~ra) rasUlera Anugatya karo, yAte tomarA anugraha lAbha karate pAra|
tomarA tomAdera prabhura kSamA o sei jAnnAta lAbhera ceSTA karo yAra vizAlatA AsamAna o jaminera mata| mottAkIdera janya tA prastuta karA haYeche;
yArA sudina o durdine (AllAhara pathe) vyaYa kare evaM yArA krodha saMvaraNakArI o mAnuSera prati kSamAzIla| AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

evaM yArA kona azlIla kAja kare phelale kiMvA nijedera prati juluma kare phelale AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM nijedera pApera janya kSamA cAYa| AllAha chAr3A pApa kSamA karave ke? Ara tArA jenezune nijedera kRtakarmera opara jida dhare thAke nA|
tAdera pratidAna hala tAdera prabhura pakSa theke kSamA Ara emanasava jAnnAta yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| sekhAne tArA cirakAla vAsa karave| satkarmazIladera ei pratidAna kata uttama!
tomAdera pUrve nAnArakama jIvanapaddhati atIta haYeche| ataeva, tomarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekha avizvAsIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila?
eTA (koraAna) mAnuSera janya (spaSTa) varNanA evaM mottAkIdera janya patha-nirdeza o upadeza|
(zatrura sAmane) tomarA durvala kiMvA viSaNna haYo nA| (prakRta) ImAnadAra hale tomarAi vijaYI have|

yadi tomAdera kona AghAta lAge tAhale (mane karave) anurUpa AghAta to anyaderao legeche| Ara ei dinagulo Ami mAnuSera madhye adalavadala kari; yAte AllAha muminadera yAcAi karate pArena evaM tomAdera madhya theke zahIdadera grahaNa karate pArena| AllAha jAlemadera bhAlavAsena nA|
evaM yAte tini muminaderake zodhana Ara kApheraderake nirmUla karate pArena|
AllAha tomAdera madhya theke jehAdakArI o dhairyadhAraNakArIdera yAcAi karAra Agei ki tomarA jAnnAte praveza karave vale mane karecho?
mRtyura sammukhIna haoYAra pUrve tomarA mRtyu kAmanA karate; ekhana tomarA tAkiYe tAkiYe se mRtyu dekhale|

muhAmmAda ekajana rasUla vai nana| tA~ra Ageo aneka rasUla ativAhita haYeche| tAi tini yadi mArA yAna kiMvA nihata hana tAhale ki tomarA pazcAdapasaraNa karave? ye pazcAdapasaraNa karave se AllAhara kona kSati karate pArave nA| Ara AllAha zigagirai kRtajJadera puraskAra devena|

AllAhara hukuma chAr3A keu marate pAre nA; (mRtyu haYa) nirdhArita samaYe| ye duniYAra puraskAra cAYa Ami tAke duniYAra jinisa deva evaM ye AkherAtera puraskAra cAYa Ami tAke AkherAtera zAnti deva| Ara zigagirai Ami kRtajJadera puraskAra deva|

Ara kata navI yuddha kareche! tAdera sAthe aneka dhArmika loka chila| AllAhara pathe (yuddhe) tAdera ye kaSTa-kleza haYeche tAte tArA klAnta haYani; tArA durvalao haYani evaM natisvIkArao kareni| AllAha dhairyadhAraNakArIdera bhAlavAsena|
tArA kevala valeche, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera pApa o AmAdera kAje sImAlaMghana kSamA kare dAo, AmAdera padakSepasamUha dRr3ha karo evaM kAphera lokadera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya kara|”
ataHpara AllAha tAderake duniYAra puraskAra o AkherAtera uttama puraskAra dAna karechena| AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yadi kApheradera kathAmato cala tAhale tArA tomAderake pechanera dike phiriYe deve evaM tAte tomarA kSatigrasta have|
varaM AllAhai tomAdera prabhu evaM tinii zreSTha sAhAyyakArI|

Ami zigagirai kApheradera antare bhItira saJcAra karava; kAraNa tArA AllAhara sAthe aMzIdAra sAvyasta kareche, yAra kona kSamatA tini denani| Ara tAdera ThikAnA hala jAhAnnAma| jAlemadera ThikAnA kata khArApa!

vastuta AllAha tomAdera sAthe tA~ra (sAhAyyera) oYAdA pUraNa karechena, yakhana (uhudera yuddhe) tA~ra nirdeze tomarA tAderake (kApheraderake) hatyA karachile| avazeSe eka paryAYe tomarA hatodyama haYe par3echile, (karaNIYa) kAja samparke paraspara vitarke lipta haYechile evaM tini tomAderake tomAdera pachandera jinisa (ganImata) dekhAnora para tomarA avAdhya haYechile| tomAdera madhye keu ihakAla cAYa, AvAra keu parakAla cAYa| ataHpara parIkSA karAra janya tini tomAderake tAdera theke sariYe rekhechilena| tave tini tomAderake kSamA kare diYechena| AllAha muminadera prati anugrahazIla|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomarA oparera dike chuTe yAcchile evaM kAro dike phirachile nA; athaca tomAdera pechane rasUla tomAderake DAkachilena| phale tini (AllAha) tomAderake kaSTera opara kaSTa diYechilena; yAte tomAdera yA hAtachAr3A haYeche evaM ye vipada tomAdera opara eseche tAra janya duHkha nA kara| Ara tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

ataHpara tini tomAderake kaSTera para zAntimaYa tanadrA dAna karena yA tomAdera ekadalake Acchanna karechila| Arekadala kevala nijedera niYei bhevechila| erA AllAha samparke anyAYabhAve ajJatAra dhAraNA poSaNa karachila| tArA valachila, “viSaYaTite AmAdera ki kichu karAra Ache?” vala, “puro viSaTii AllAhara (hAte)|” tArA tAdera mane kichu ekaTA lukAcchila yA tomAra kAche prakAza karachila nA| tArA valachila, “viSaYaTite yadi AmAdera kichu karAra thAkata tAhale ekhAne AmarA (ebhAve) nihata hatAma nA|” vala, “tomarA yadi tomAdera ghareo thAkate tavuo yAdera nihata haoYA nirdhArita chila tArA tAdera mRtyura jAYagAYa veriYe Asata|” Asale AllAha ceYechena tomAdera mane yA Ache tA parIkSA karate evaM tomAdera antare yA Ache tA zodhana karate| AllAha (sakalera) manera kathA bhAlabhAve jAnena|

yedina duTo dala (uhudera yuddhakSetre) milita haYechila sedina tomAdera madhye yArA pazcAdapasaraNa karechila Asale tAdera upArjita kichu pApera kAraNe zaYatAna tAderake skhalita karechila| tave AllAha tAderake kSamA kare diYechilena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, sahanazIla|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA avizvAsa kare evaM tAdera bhAiYerA yakhana saphare kiMvA yuddhe yAYa takhana vale, “orA yadi AmAdera kAche thAkata tAhale marata nA kiMvA nihata hata nA;” yAte AllAha eTAke tAdera antare ekaTA anutApera viSaYe pariNata karate pArena| athaca AllAhai vA~cAna evaM mArena| Ara tomarA yA karo AllAha tA dekhate pAna|
Ara tomarA AllAhara pathe nihata hao kiMvA mare yAo (yA-i hoka nA kena), tArA yA (pArthiva sampada) jamA kare tAra ceYe AllAhara kSamA o anugraha uttama|
tomarA mare yAo kiMvA nihata hao (yA-i hoka nA kena), AllAhara kAchei tomAderake ekatrita karA have|

AllAhara anugrahe tumi tAdera prati komala AcaraNa karechile| yadi tumi rUr3ha o kaThinahRdaYa hate tAhale avazyai tArA tomAra AzapAza theke sare yeta| tumi tAderake mApha kare dAo, tAdera janya mAgapherAta kAmanA karo evaM kAje-karme tAdera sAthe parAmarza kara| Ara yakhana (kichu karAra janya) saGkalpa karave takhana AllAhara opara bharasA karave| AllAha (tA~ra opara) bharasAkArIdera bhAlavAsena|

AllAha yadi tomAderake sAhAyya karena tAhale tomAdera opara keu vijaYI hate pArave nA| Ara tini yadi tomAderake parityAga karena tAhale tini chAr3A emana ke Ache ye tomAderake sAhAyya karate pAre? ataeva, muminarA yena AllAhara oparai bharasA kare|

kona navIra pakSe gopane kichu neoYA zobhana naYa| keu gopane kichu nile keYAmatera dina se tA saGge niYe Asave| tArapara ye yA upArjana kareche pratyekake tA puropuri deoYA have| kAro prati avicAra karA have nA|
ye vyakti AllAhara santuSTira anveSaNe thAke se ki ai vyaktira mata ye AllAhara asantoSa arjana kare evaM yAra vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma? var3a khArApa gantavya seTA!
tArA AllAhara nikaTa vibhinna starera (maryAdAsampanna)| Ara AllAha tAdera kAjakarma dekhe rAkhena|

AllAha muminadera prati anugraha karechena; yakhana tini tAdera nijedera thekei tAdera madhye emana ekajana rasUla pAThiYechena yini tAderake tA~ra AYAtasamUha pATha kare zonAna, tAderake parizodhana karena o kitAva o jJAna zikSA dena; yadio tArA Age spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye chila|

ki vyApAra! yakhana tomAdera opara ekaTi viparyaYa ela— yAra dviguNa viparyaYa itipUrve tomarA (tomAdera pratipakSera janya) ghaTiYechile— takhana tomarA valale, “eTA kothA theke ela?” (tAderake) vala, “eTA tomAdera nijedera kAcha thekei eseche (tomAdera kRtakarmera phalei eseche)|” nizcaYai AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
yedina duTo dala (uhudera yuddhakSetre) milita haYechila sedina tomAdera opara ye viparyaYa neme esechila tA AllAhara hukumei haYechila, Ara (AllAha eTA karechilena) muminaderake yAcAi karAra janya;

evaM monAphekadera yAcAi karAra janya| ei monAphekaderake valA haYechila, “eso, AllAhara pathe yuddha karo athavA (antata) pratirodha kara|” tArA valechila, “AmarA yuddha have jAnale avazyai tomAdera anusaraNa karatAma|” sedina tArA ImAnera ceYe kupharira vezi kAche chila| tArA mukhe se kathAi valata yA tAdera antare chila nA| Ara tArA yA gopana kare AllAha tA bhAla karei jAnena|

erA seisava loka yArA ghare vase theke tAdera (nihata) bhAidera samparke valechila, “orA AmAdera kathA zunale nihata hata nA|” (tAderake) vala, “yadi tomAdera kathA satyai haYa tAhale (pArale) tomarA nijedera mRtyu ThekiYe rekho|”
yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYeche tAderake kakhano mRta mane karo nA| vastuta tArA tAdera prabhura kAche jIvita o jIvikAprApta|

AllAha tAderake ye anugraha dAna karechena tAte tArA Anandita; tArA tAdera janyao Ananda prakAza kare yArA tAdera pechana theke ekhano tAdera sAthe milita haYani (arthAt yArA AgAmIte zahIda have vale nirdhArita Ache); e janya ye, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tAdera duHkhao karate have nA|
tArA AllAhara dAna o anugrahe Ananda prakAza kare; Ara tA ejanya ye, AllAha ImAnadAradera zramera phala naSTa karena nA|
yArA Ahata haoYAra parao AllAha o rasUlera DAke sAr3A diYeche tAdera madhye yArA satkAja kareche o tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche tAdera janya raYeche mahAna pratidAna|

yAderake lokerA valechila, “(zatrupakSera) mAnuSerA tomAdera (mokAvelAra) janya (sainya) samAveza kareche; ataeva, tAderake bhaYa kara|” e kathAYa tAdera ImAna Aro ver3e giYechila evaM tArA valechila, “AllAhai AmAdera janya yatheSTa evaM tini var3a uttama karmavidhAYaka!”
tArapara tArA AllAhara dAna o anugraha niYe phire esechila| kona aniSTa tAderake sparza kareni| tArA AllAhara santuSTira anugAmI (santuSTi arjane saceSTa) chila| AllAha vizAla anugrahera adhikArI|
vastuta ai zaYatAna tomAderake tAra vandhudera bhaYa dekhAYa; tave tomarA tAderake bhaYa nA kare kevala AmAke bhaYa karave, yadi tomarA (prakRta) ImAnadAra hao|

yArA kupharira dike dhAvita haYa tArA yena tomAke duzcintAYa nA phele| tArA AllAhara kona kSati karate pArave nA| AllAha cAna, tAdera janya parakAle kona aMza rAkhavena nA| tAdera janya Ache mastavar3a zAsti|
yArA ImAnera mUlye kuphari kraYa kare tArA AllAhara kona kSati karate pArave nA| tAdera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka zAsti|
kApherarA yena mane nA kare, Ami ye tAderake avakAza dicchi tA tAdera janya bhAla| Ami to tAderake avakAza dicchi yAte tArA pApera parimANa vRddhi kare| tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|

ziSTa theke duSTake pRthaka nA karA paryanta AllAha muminaderake tomAdera (vartamAna) avasthAYa rAkhavena nA| AllAha tomAderake gAYeva samvandheo avahita karavena nA; tave AllAha tA~ra rasUladera madhya theke yAke cAna veche nena| tAi tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladerake vizvAsa kara| yadi tomarA vizvAsa karo Ara tAkaoYA avalamvana karo tAhale tomAdera janya raYeche virATa pratidAna|

AllAhara deoYA sampada niYe yArA kArpaNya kare tArA yena mane nA kare ye eTA tAdera janya bhAla,varaM eTA tAdera janya khArApa| keYAmatera dina tAdera kArpaNyera dhana dvArA tAdera galAYa ver3I parAno have| Ara AsamAna o jaminera uttarAdhikAra AllAharai| tomarA yA karo AllAha se samvandhe samyaka avahita|

AllAha seisava lokadera kathA zunechena yArA valeche, “AllAha garIva Ara AmarA dhanI|” tArA yA valeche evaM tArA ye navIderake anyAYabhAve hatyA kareche Ami tA likhe rAkhava Ara (tAderake) valava, “tomarA Agune por3Ara kaSTa AsvAdana kara|”
eTA tomAdera kRtakarmerai phala| Ara vastuta AllAha vAndAdera prati julumakArI nana|

orA to seisava loka yArA valeche, “AllAha AmAdera theke pratijJA niYechena yAte AmarA kona rasUlera prati ImAna nA Ani, yatakSaNa nA tini AmAdera kAche emana koravAni upasthita karena yAke Aguna grAsa kare neYa|” (oderake) vala, “tomAdera kAche to AmAra pUrveo aneka rasUla spaSTa nidarzana niYe esechilena; tomarA ye nidarzanaTira kathA valale tAo| ataeva, tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale tAderake hatyA karechile kena?”

Ara tArA yadi tomAke asvIkAra kare tAhale tomAra Ageo to emana aneka rasUlake asvIkAra karA haYechila yArA nidarzanasamUha, AsamAni sahIphA o Alo dAnakArI (dika-nirdezanA pradAnakArI) kitAva niYe esechila|

pratyeka prANIi mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave| Ara keYAmatera dina tomAderake tomAdera karmaphala puropuri deoYA have| takhana yAke jAhAnnAma theke dUre sariYe jAnnAte praveza karAno have se-i saphalakAma| Ara pArthiva jIvana to zudhu pratAraNAra sAmagrI|

tomAdera sampada o jIvanera vyApAre tomAderake parIkSA karA have| tomarA tomAdera pUrvavartI kitAvadhArIdera kAcha theke o muzarikadera kAcha theke aneka kaSTadAYaka kathA zunate pAve| yadi tomarA dhairyadhAraNa o tAkaoYA avalamvana karate pAra tAhale seTA have ekaTA dRr3ha pratyaYera kAja|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana AllAha kitAvadhArIdera kAcha theke pratijJA niYechilena ye, tomarA ei kitAva mAnuSera kAche varNanA karave evaM tA gopana karave nA| kintu tArA se oYAdA tAdera pechane chu~r3e merechila (bhaGga karechila) evaM era dvArA nagaNya vitta kraYa karechila| tArA yA kraYa kare tA kata khArApa!
yA kareche tA niYe Ananda kare Ara yA kareni tAra janya prazaMsA pete cAYa emana lokaderake zAsti theke rehAiprApta mane karo nA| tAdera janya vedanAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
AsamAna o jaminera rAjatva AllAhara| Ara AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
AsamAna-jaminera sRSTite evaM rAta-dinera Avartane avazyai vuddhimAna lokadera janya nidarzana raYeche;

yArA dA~r3Ano avasthAYa, vasA avasthAYa o zoYA avasthAYa AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM AsamAna o jaminera sRSTi samparke cintA kare Ara vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! tumi esava nirarthaka sRSTi karani| AmarA tomAra mahimA varNanA kari| ataeva, tumi AmAderake doyakhera AjAva theke rakSA kara|”
“he AmAdera prabhu! tumi yAke doyakhe DhukAve tAke to ekevArei lAJchita karale| Ara jAlemadera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|”

“he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA eka AhavAnakArIke jJatomarA tomAdera prabhura prati ImAna AnaJca vale ImAnera dike AhavAna karate zunechi; tAi AmarA ImAna enechi| ataeva, he AmAdera prabhu! tumi AmAdera pApagulo kSamA kare dAo, AmAdera khArApa kAjagulo muche dAo evaM puNyavAnadera sAthe AmAdera mRtyu nasiva kara|”
“he AmAdera prabhu! tumi tomAra rasUladera mAdhyame AmAderake yA devAra oYAdA karecho tA diYe dAo Ara keYAmatera dina AmAderake lAJchita karo nA| tumi to oYAdA bhaGga karo nA|”

ataHpara tAdera prabhu tAdera doYA kavula kare valena, “tomAdera kAro kAja Ami naSTa kari nA (viphale yete dei nA), se puruSa hoka kiMvA nArI| tomarA eke aparera aMza| tAi yArA hijarata kareche, nijedera gharavAr3i theke vahiSkRta haYeche, AmAra pathe nipIr3ita haYeche evaM (AmAra pathe) yuddha kareche o nihata haYeche Ami tAdera khArApa kAjagulo (AmalanAmA theke) muche deva evaM tAderake jAnnAte praveza karAva yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| eTA AllAhara pakSa theke ekaTi puraskAra| Ara AllAhara kAchei uttama puraskAra Ache|”
deze deze kApheradera avAdha ghorAghuri yena tomAke vibhrAnta nA kare|
(eTA to) svalpakAlIna upabhogamAtra| paravartIte tAdera (zeSa) nivAsa have jAhAnnAma| var3ai khArApa vizrAmasthala!

kintu yArA tAdera prabhuke bhaYa kare tAdera janya AllAhara pakSa theke AtitheYatAsvarUpa jAnnAta raYeche, yAra nice diYe nadI pravAhita haYa, yekhAne tArA cirakAla vAsa karave| Ara AllAhara kAche yA Ache puNyavAnadera janya tAi uttama|

Ara avazyai kitAvIdera madhye emana lokao Ache yArA AllAhara prati vinIta theke AllAhake vizvAsa kare evaM tomAdera kAche o tAdera kAche yA yA avatIrNa haYeche tAo vizvAsa kare| tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha alpa mUlye vikri kare nA| emana lokadera janya tAdera prabhura kAche puraskAra raYeche| AllAha druta hisAva sampannakArI|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA dhairya dhara, dhairyera sAthe (zatrura) mokAvelA karo evaM (zatrura AkramaNera viruddhe) sarvadA satarkAvasthAYa thAka| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

he mAnuSa! tomAdera prabhuke bhaYa karo, yini tomAderake eka vyakti (Adama) theke sRSTi karechena; tAra theke tAra saGginIkeo sRSTi karechena Ara ai dujana thekei aneka nara-nArI (sRSTi kare pRthivIte) char3iYe diYechena| AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAra nAme tomarA eke aparera kAche (yAra yAra pAonA) ceYe thAka| rakta-samparkera vyApAreo sAvadhAna theko| avazyai AllAha tomAderake paryavekSaNe rekhechena|

etimaderake tAdera sampada diYe dAo; (tomAdera) khArApa jinisake (tAdera) bhAla jinisa dvArA vadala karo nA evaM tomAdera sampadera sAthe miziYe tAdera sampada bhakSaNa karo nA; eTA avazyai ekaTA var3a pApa|

Ara yadi tomarA etima meYedera (viYe karAra) kSetre suvicAra karate nA pArAra AzaMkA karo tAhale (sAdhAraNa) nArIdera madhye tomAdera pachanda haYa emana duijana, tinajana kiMvA cArajanake paryanta viYe karate pAra| kintu yadi (ekAdhika strIdera sAthe) suvicAra karate nA pArAra AzaMkA karo tAhale mAtra ekajanake (viYe karate pArave) athavA nijedera adhikArabhukta dAsI (rAkhate pArave)| eTA tomAdera avicAra nA karAra nikaTatara (eTA karale tomAdera dvArA strIdera prati avicAra nA haoYAra sambhAvanA thAkave)|
nArIderake sAnande tAdera moharAnA diYe dAo| tave tArA yadi khuzimane tomAderake tAra kichu aMza cher3e deYa tAhale tomarA tA svAcchandye khete (bhoga karate) pAra|
ye sampadake AllAha tomAdera jIvanayAtrAra avalamvana karechena tA vokAdera hAte dio nA, tave tAra madhye tAdera khAoYA-parAra vyavasthA karave evaM tAdera sAthe bhAlabhAve kathA valave|

vivAhera vaYase upanIta haoYA paryanta etimaderake tomarA paryavekSaNe rAkhave| yadi tAdera madhye vuddhimattA lakSya karo tAhale tAdera sampada tAderake diYe dio| apacaYa kare evaM tArA var3a haYe yAve ei bhaYe tAr3AtAr3i kare etimadera sampada zeSa kare phelo nA| ye (abhibhAvaka) dhanI se yena (etimera sampada kharaca karA theke) virata thAke| Ara ye garIva se (tAra zramera janya) nyAYabhAve (nyAyya parimANa) khete pAre| Ara yakhana tomarA tAdera sampada diYe deve takhana tAdera upasthitite sAkSI rekho| AllAha hisAva grahaNera janya yatheSTa|
pitAmAtA o nikaTAtmIYarA yA rekhe yAYa tAte puruSadera aMza Ache evaM pitAmAtA o nikaTAtmIYarA yA rekhe yAYa tAte nArIdera aMza Ache; (rekhe yAoYA sampatti) kama hoka kiMvA vezi; eka nirdhArita aMza|
(sampatti) vanTanakAle AtmIYa-svajana o etima-misakInarA upasthita thAkale tA theke tAderake kichu dio evaM tAdera sAthe bhAlabhAve kathAvArtA valo|

tArA nijerA pechane durvala chelemeYe rekhe (mArA) gele tAdera janya yemana bhaYa karata, (sampatti vanTanakAle) tArA (vanTanakArIrA) yena antare temana bhaYa rAkhe| ataeva, tArA yena AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM nyAyya kathA vale|
yArA anyAYabhAve etimadera sampada khAYa tArA nijedera peTe vastuta Aguna khAYa| tArA zigagirai jvalanta Agune (doyakhe) praveza karave|

AllAha tomAderake tomAdera santAnadera (uttarAdhikArera) vyApAre Adeza dicchena: puruSa pAve dui nArIra aMzera samAna; kintu uttarAdhikArIrA yadi zudhu nArI haYa sekSetre duiYera adhika hale (dujana haleo) tArA pAve (mRtera) rekhe yAoYA sampattira tina bhAgera duibhAga, Ara ekajana hale se pAve ardheka| mRtera pitAmAtAra pratyeke pAve tAra rekhe yAoYA sampattira chaYa bhAgera ekabhAga, yadi tAra santAna thAke; kintu yadi kona santAna nA thAke evaM tAra pitAmAtAi tAra uttarAdhikArI haYa tAhale tAra mA pAve tina bhAgera ekabhAga; Ara yadi (pitAmAtA chAr3Ao) tAra bhAivona thAke tAhale mA pAve chaYa bhAgera ekabhAga, tAra kona asiYata thAkale tA pUraNa kiMvA kona RNa thAkale tA parizodha karAra pare| tomAdera pitAmAtA o santAnadera madhye upakArera dika theke ke tomAdera nikaTatara tA tomarA jAna nA| esava aMza AllAhara pakSa theke nirdhArita| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA tomAdera strIdera rekhe yAoYA sampattira ardheka pAve, yadi tAdera kona santAna nA thAke; Ara tAdera santAna thAkale tomarA tAdera rekhe yAoYA sampattira cAra bhAgera ekabhAga pAve, tAdera kona asiYata thAkale tA pUraNa kiMvA kona RNa thAkale tA parizodha karAra pare| Ara tomAdera strIrA tomAdera rekhe yAoYA sampattira cAra bhAgera ekabhAga pAve yadi tomAdera kona santAna nA thAke; Ara tomAdera santAna thAkale tArA tomAdera rekhe yAoYA sampattira ATa bhAgera ekabhAga pAve, tomAdera kona asiYata thAkale tA pUraNa kiMvA kona RNa thAkale tA parizodha karAra pare| Ara ye lokaTira athavA strIlokaTira uttarAdhikAra vanTana karA have (arthAt mRtavyakti) se yadi niHsantAna o pitRmAtRhIna haYa evaM tAra ekajana (vaipitreYa) bhAi kiMvA ekajana (vaipitreYI) vona thAke tAhale tAdera pratyeke chaYa bhAgera ekabhAga pAve| Ara yadi tAdera saMkhyA era ceYe adhika haYa tAhale tArA tina bhAgera ekabhAge (savAi samAna) aMzIdAra have, kona asiYata thAkale tA pUraNa kiMvA kona RNa thAkale tA parizodha karAra pare, yAte kAro kona kSati nA haYa| eTA AllAhara nirdeza| AllAha mahAjJAnI, sahanazIla|

egulo AllAhara sImArekhA| yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya karave AllAha tAderake emanasava jAnnAte praveza karAvena yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| tArA sekhAne cirakAla thAkave| Ara eTAi virATa sAphalya|
Ara ye AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera avAdhya have evaM tA~ra sImArekhA laGghana karave tini tAke jAhAnnAme praveza karAvena| sekhAne se cirakAla thAkave| tAra janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|

tomAdera nArIdera madhye yArA vyabhicAra kare tomarA tAdera viruddhe tomAdera cArajanera sAkSya neve| tArA yadi sAkSya deYa tAhale ai nArIderake ghare Avaddha rAkhave yatakSaNa nA tAdera mRtyu haYa athavA AllAha tAdera janya (anya) kona patha nirdeza karena|

tomAdera madhye ye dujana (nara-nArI) ai kAja (vyabhicAra) kare tAderake tomarA zAsti deve | tArapara tArA yadi taovA kare evaM nijederake saMzodhana kare neYa tAhale tAderake tAdera mata thAkate dio| nizcaYai AllAha taovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|
vastuta AllAhara kAche tAderai taovAra suyoga raYeche yArA ajJatAvazata khArApa kAja kare, tArapara avilamve taovA kare neYa| emana lokaderake AllAha kSamA kare devena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAvAna|

emana lokadera taovAra suyoga nei yArA (jIvanabhara) khArApa kAja karate thAke; avazeSe yakhana tAdera kAro mutyu upasthita haYa takhana vale, “Ami ekhana taovA karalAma;” tAderao (taovAra suyoga) nei yArA kAphera avasthAYa mArA yAYa| esava lokadera janya Ami vedanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

he ImAnadAragaNa! jora kare nArIdera uttarAdhikArI haoYA (uttarAdhikAra hiseve tAderake pete cAoYA) tomAdera janya vaidha naYa| tomarA tAderake (moharAnAsvarUpa) yA diYecho tAra kichu aMza niYe yAoYAra janya tAderake ATake rekho nA, tave tArA prakAzya azlIlatA karale bhinna kathA| tAdera sAthe sammAnajanakabhAve vasavAsa kara| Ara yadi tomarA tAderake apachanda karo tAhaleo to emanao hate pAre ye, tomarA ekaTA jinisa apachanda karacha athaca AllAha tAra madhye aneka kalyANa rekhechena|

Ara tomarA eka strIra sthale anya strI grahaNa karate cAile evaM tAdera kAuke (moharAnAsvarUpa) vipula sampada diYe thAkale tA theke kichui neve nA| tomarA ki apavAda diYe Ara spaSTa pApa kare tA (pherata) nite cAccha?
tomarA tA kIbhAve (pherata) nite pAra, athaca tomarA eke aparera kAche gamana karecho (paraspara milita haYecho) Ara tArAo tomAdera kAcha theke zakta aGgIkAra niYeche|

ye nArIderake tomAdera vAvArA (vAvA, dAdA, nAnA) viYe kareche tomarA tAderake viYe karave nA; tave pUrve yA haYe giYeche (tA bhinna kathA)| avazyai eTA chila ekaTA azobhana o ghRNya kAja evaM nikRSTa niYama|

yAderake viYe karA tomAdera janya niSiddha karA haYeche tArA hala: tomAdera mAYerA (mA, nAnI, dAdI), kanyArA (kanyA, pautrI, dauhitrI), vonerA (sahodarA, vaimAtreYI, vaipitreYI), phuphurA, khAlArA, bhAijhirA, bhAgnirA, dudhamAYerA, dudhavonerA, zAzur3IrA evaM tomAdera ye strIdera sAthe tomarA sahavAsa karecho tAdera (anya svAmIra aurasajAta) kanyArA yArA tomAdera tattvAvadhAne Ache— tomarA ai strIdera sAthe sahavAsa nA kare thAkale (tAdera kanyAdera viYe karAYa) kona pApa nei—| tomAdera aurasajAta putradera (putra, pautra, dauhitra) strIderake evaM ekatre dui vonake viYe karAo (tomAdera janya niSiddha karA haYeche); tave pUrve yA haYe giYeche (tA ei niSedhera AotAmukta thAkave)| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

evaM tomAdera adhikArabhukta krItadAsIrA (vA yuddhavandinIrA) vyatIta sadhavA (anyera vivAhAdhIna) nArIderakeo tomAdera janya niSiddha karA haYeche| eTA tomAdera janya AllAhara vidhAna| ullikhita kaYeka prakAra nArI vyatIta anya sava nArIke artha vyaYa kare viYe karAra janya pete cAoYA tomAdera janya vaidha karA haYeche; tave avaidha yaunakarmera janya naYa| ataeva, edera madhya theke yAdera sAthe tomarA (viYera para) yauna sambhoga karave tAderake tAdera nirdhArita pAonA (moharAnA) diYe deve| (moharAnA) nirdhAraNera para pArasparika sammatite kona hrAsa-vRddhi karale tomAdera kona pApa have nA| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|

tomAdera madhye yAdera ImAnadAra saccaritra (svAdhIna) nArIderake viYe karAra Arthika sAmarthya nei, tArA tomAdera adhikArabhukta ImAnadAra dAsIderake viYe karave| tomAdera ImAna samparke AllAhai bhAla jAnena| tomarA to savAi eka| tAi tAdera (dAsIdera) mAlikadera anumati niYe tAderake viYe karave evaM yathAyathabhAve tAdera pAonA (moharAnA) parizodha karave, yadi tArA saccaritrA haYa evaM vyabhicAriNI kiMvA upapati- grahaNakAriNI nA haYa| Ara vivAhavandhane Avaddha haoYAra para tArA yadi vyabhicAra kare tAhale tAdera zAsti svAdhIna (avivAhita) nArIdera zAstira ardheka| tomAdera madhye yArA pApake bhaYa kare e vyavasthA tAdera janya| Ara dhairyadhAraNa karate pArale tA tomAdera janya Aro uttama| AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
AllAha tomAdera janya (savakichu) pariSkAra kare dite cAna, tomAderake tomAdera pUrvavartIdera patha dekhiYe dite cAna evaM tomAderake kSamA kare dite cAna| AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|
AllAha tomAderake kSamA kare dite cAna; kintu yArA pravRttira Anugatya kare tArA cAYa, tomAdera var3arakama lakSyacyuti ghaTuka|
AllAha tomAdera vojhA hAlakA karate cAna| mAnuSake to durvala kare sRSTi karA haYeche|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA pArasparika sammatite vyavasA chAr3A eke aparera sampada anyAYabhAve grAsa karo nA| Ara nijerA khunokhuni karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera prati daYAvAna raYechena|
sImAlaMghana kare anyAYabhAve keu tA karale Ami tAke zigagirai Agune nikSepa karava| AllAhara janya eTA sahaja|

tomAderake yA yA niSedha karA haYeche tAra madhye var3agulo theke yadi tomarA dUre thAka tAhale Ami tomAdera (choTa) pApagulo mocana kare deva evaM tomAderake ekaTi mahat jAYagAYa (jAnnAte) sthAna deva|

ye sava jinisa dvArA AllAha tomAdera ekajanake Arekajanera opara zreSThatva diYechena tomarA se rakama jinisa pete ceYo nA| puruSa yA kAmAi kare se tAra aMza (phala) pAve evaM nArI yA kAmAi kare seo tAra aMza pAve| tomarA AllAhara kAche tA~ra dAna prArthanA kara| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu avagata Achena|

pitAmAtA o AtmIYadera rekhe yAoYA savakichura janya Ami uttarAdhikArI nirdhAraNa karechi| Ara yAdera sAthe tomAdera aGgIkAra raYeche, tAderake tAdera aMza diYe dAo| avazyai AllAha savakichurai sAkSI thAkena|

puruSerA nArIdera tattvAvadhAYaka; kAraNa AllAha tAdera ekajanake Arekajanera opara zreSThatva diYechena evaM tArA (puruSerA) tAdera sampada theke (nArIdera janya) vyaYa kare thAke| ejanyai nyAYaniSTha nArIrA (svAmIdera) anugata haYa evaM (tAdera) anupasthititeo AllAha yA rakSA karate valechena tA (nijedera satItva, svAmIdera sampatti ityAdi) rakSA kare| Ara ye nArIdera madhye tomarA avAdhyatAra AzaGkA karo tAderake (prathame) upadeza dAo, (tAte kAja nA hale) vichAnAYa tAderake varjana karo evaM (tAteo kona phala nA hale) tAderake (mRdu) prahAra kara| ete yadi tArA tomAdera anugata haYa tAhale tAdera viruddhe anya kona patha anveSaNa karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha aneka u~cu, aneka var3a|

tomarA yadi svAmI-strIra madhye virodhera AzaGkA karo tAhale svAmIra parivAra theke ekajana sAlisa evaM strIra parivAra theke ekajana sAlisa niyukta kara| tArA yadi mImAMsA cAYa tAhale AllAha tAdera madhye milasAdhana kare devena| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, savakichu avagata|

tomarA AllAhara ivAdata karo, tA~ra sAthe kona kichu zarIka karo nA; pitAmAtAra sAthe sadvyavahAra karo evaM AtmIYa, etima, misakIna, kAchera prativezi, dUrera prativezi, ghaniSTha sahacara, pathikajana o tomAdera dAsa-dAsIra sAtheo (sadvyavahAra karo)| AllAha kakhano dAmbhika o var3AikArIke pachanda karena nA|

(orA seisava loka) yArA (nijerA) kArpaNya kare evaM lokaderakeo kArpaNya karate vale, Ara AllAha anugraha kare tAderake yA dAna karechena tA gopana kare| Ami kApheradera janya lAJchanAkara zAsti prastuta rekhechi|

evaM (orA seisava loka) yArA loka-dekhAnora janya nijedera sampada vyaYa kare evaM AllAha o zeSa dinake (parakAla) vizvAsa kare nA| Ara zaYatAna yAra saGgI haYa, (tAke se pathabhraSTa karavei, kAraNa) se khuva khArApa saGgI|

tArA yadi AllAha o zeSa dinake vizvAsa karata evaM AllAha tAderake ye jIvikA dAna karechena tA theke (bhAla kAje) vyaYa karata tAhale tAdera kI kSati hata? AllAha tAdera samparke samyaka avagata Achena|
AllAha (kAuke) aNu parimANao juluma karena nA| Ara yadi (kAro) kona puNya thAke tAhale tini tA dviguna kare dena evaM nijera theke virATa puraskAra dAna karena|
Ami yakhana pratyeka jAti theke ekajana kare sAkSI niYe Asava evaM edera viruddhe tomAkeo sAkSI kare Anava takhana kemana have?

yArA kuphari kareche evaM rasUlera avAdhya haYeche tArA sedina kAmanA karave, yadi tAderasaha mATi samAna kare deoYA hata (tAderake mATira sAthe miziYe deoYA hata)! tArA AllAhara kAche kona kathAi gopana karate pArave nA|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA nezAgrasta avasthAYa nAmAyera dhArekAcheo yeYo nA, yatakSaNa nA yA vala tA vujhate pAra evaM (daihika) apavitra avasthAYao nA, yatakSaNa nA gosala karo, tave saphare thAkale bhinna kathA| Ara yadi tomarA asustha hao kiMvA saphare thAka athavA tomAdera keu pAYakhAnA theke (malamUtra tyAga kare) Ase kiMvA tomarA nArI-sambhoga karo evaM (gosala karAra janya) pAni nA pAo tAhale pavitra mATi dvArA tAYAmmuma karave evaM (yathArIti) mukhamaNDala o hAta muche neve| nizcaYai AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|
yAderake kitAvera ekaTA aMza deoYA haYeche tumi ki tAderake (ihudiderake) dekhani? tArA bhraSTatA kraYa karache Ara cAcche ye, tomarAo saThika patha theke vicyuta hao|
AllAha tomAdera zatruderake khuva bhAla kare jAnena| Ara abhibhAvaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa evaM sAhAyyakArI hiseveo AllAhai yatheSTa|

ihudidera madhye keu keu Asala artha theke sariYe kathA vikRta kare| yemana vale, “AmarA zunalAma o amAnya karalAma”; “zona, tomAke to zonAno yAYa nA” evaM jihavA vA~kA kare o dvInake upahAsa kare (vale) “rA’inA (AmAdera rAkhAla)”| athaca tArA yadi valata, “AmarA zunalAma o mAnalAma” evaM “zona o AmAdera prati lakSya karo” tAhale tAdera janya bhAla hata evaM tA saThika hata| kintu tAdera kupharira kAraNe AllAha tAderake abhizapta karechena; tAi alpa kaYekajana vyatIta tArA vizvAsa kare nA|

he kitAvadhArIgaNa! Ami katagulo cehArA muche diYe tA pechanera dike ghuriYe deoYAra Age kiMvA tAderake AchahAvusa sAv‌tera (zanivAra saMkrAnta vidhiniSedha amAnya kare zAstiprApta ihudidera) nyAYa abhizapta karAra Agei tomarA tomAdera kAche vidyamAna kitAvera satyAYanakArI AmAra avatIrNa ei kitAva (Ala-koraAna) vizvAsa kara| AllAhara Adeza kintu kAryakara haYei thAke|

AllAha tA~ra sAthe zarIka karAra pApa kichutei kSamA karena nA| e chAr3A anyAnya pApa tini yAke icchA mApha kare dena| Ara ye AllAhara sAthe (konakichu) zarIka kare niHsandehe se eka virATa pApa kare|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani yArA nijederake pUta-pavitra vale? varaM AllAha yAke cAna pavitra karena| Ara tAdera prati sutA parimANao avicAra karA have nA|
dekha, tArA kIbhAve AllAhara samparke mithyA vAniYe vale! spaSTa pApa hiseve eTAi yatheSTa|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani yAderake kitAvera ekaTi aMza deoYA haYechila? tArA mUrti o devatAYa vizvAsa kare evaM kApheradera samvandhe vale, “erA musalamAnadera ceYe bhAla hedAYetaprApta|”
erA hala tArA yAderake AllAha abhizapta karechena| Ara AllAha yAke abhizapta karena tAra janya tumi kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
nAki tAdera kAche rAjyera kona aMza Ache? tAhale to tArA mAnuSake sAmAnya parimANao deve nA|
nAki AllAha mAnuSake yA dAna karechena tAra janya tArA tAdera hiMsA kare? Ami to ivarAhImera vaMzadharaderake grantha o prajJA dAna karechilAma evaM tAderake vizAla rAjyao diYechilAma|
ataHpara tAdera madhye keu tA~ra prati ImAna Anala AvAra keu tA~ra theke mukha phiriYe nila| (tAderake por3Anora) Aguna hiseve jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa|

yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa karave Ami tAderake avazyai Agune por3Ava| yatavAra tAdera cAmar3A dagdha have tatavAra Ami anya cAmar3A diYe tA parivartana kare deva, yAte tArA AjAva AsvAdana karate thAke| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche Ami tAderake jAnnAte sthAna deva yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita| tArA sekhAne anantakAla thAkave| sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave pavitra saGgI-saGginI| Ami tAderake nivir3a chAYAYa praveza karAva|

AllAha tomAderake nirdeza dicchena yena tomarA AmAnatasamUha tAra prApakaderake phiriYe dAo evaM tomarA yakhana lokadera madhye vicAra karo takhana yena nyAYera sAthe vicAra kara| AllAha tomAderake ye upadeza dena tA kata uttama! nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhara o rasUlera Anugatya karo evaM tomAdera (nyAYavAna) zAsakavRndera kathA mene cala| Ara yadi (kakhano) kona vyApAre tomAdera madhye virodha lege yAYa tAhale tA mImAMsAra bhAra AllAha o rasUlera kAche cher3e dio (AllAha o rasUlera nirdeza motAveka tA mImAMsA kare nio), yadi tomarA AllAha o zeSa dine (parakAle) vizvAsI hao; seTAi bhAla evaM pariNAmera dika theke zreYatara|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani yArA dAvi kare ye, tomAra kAche avatIrNa kitAva o tomAra pUrve avatIrNa kitAvera prati tArA ImAna eneche? tArA eke aparera viruddhe vicAra cAoYAra janya tAgUtera (zaYatAnera) kAche yete cAYa, athaca tAke amAnya karatei tAderake nirdeza deoYA haYeche| zaYatAna tAderake vipathe anekadUra niYe yete cAYa|
Ara yadi tAderake valA haYa, “AllAha yA nAyila karechena tAra dike evaM rasUlera dike eso” tAhale dekhave, monAphekarA tomAra dika theke ekevAre mukha phiriYe nicche|

kintu tAdera kRtakarmera phale yakhana tAdera kona vipada Asave takhana kemana have? takhana tArA tomAra kAche ese AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave, “AmarA to kalyANa Ara mImAMsA chAr3A Ara kichu cAini|”
orA to tArAi yAdera antarera kathA AllAha jAnena; tAi tumi tAderake upekSA karo, Ara (pArale) kichu upadeza dAo evaM tAdera mane prabhAva phelate pAre emana kichu kathA vala|

Ami to pratyeka rasUlake ejanyai pAThiYechi ye, mAnuSa AllAhara nirdezamata tAra Anugatya karave| tArA yakhana nijedera prati juluma karechila takhana yadi tomAra kAche Asata evaM AllAhara kAche (nijedera aparAdhera janya) kSamA cAita Ara rasUlao tAdera janya kSamA cAita tAhale avazyai tArA AllAhake kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu peta|

kintu nA, tomAra prabhura zapatha, tArA ImAnadAra have nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA nijedera sakala virodhe tomAke vicAraka kare, tArapara tumi ye vicAra karo tAte tAdera mana savarakama saGkIrNatAmukta thAke evaM sarvAntakaraNe tA mene neYa|

Ami yadi (vanI isarAIlera mata) tAdera opara cApiYe ditAma ye, tomarA nijerA nijederake hatyA karo (niraparAdharA aparAdhIdera hatyA karo) athavA tomAdera gharavAr3i theke veriYe yAo, tAhale alpa kichu loka chAr3A anyarA tA karata nA| tave tAderake yA karate upadeza deoYA hacche tA karale tAdera janya bhAla hata evaM tAdera ImAnao majavuta hata|
Ara takhana Ami avazyai tAderake AmAra pakSa theke eka mahAna puraskAra ditAma
evaM avazyai tAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karatAma|
yArA AllAha o rasUlera Anugatya karave tArA AllAhara anugrahabhAjana navI, satyaniSTha vyakti, zahIda o satkarmazIla vyaktidera saGgI have| Ara saGgI hiseve tArAi uttama|
ei anugraha (vA maryAdA) AllAhara pakSa theke| Ara sarvajJa hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AtmarakSAmUlaka vyavasthA nAo evaM dale dale bhAga haYe athavA savAi ekatre (abhiyAne) veriYe par3a|

Ara nizcaYai tomAdera madhye emana loka Ache ye (jehAde yete) gar3imasi karavei| tArapara yadi tomAdera kona vipada haYa tAhale valave, “AllAha AmAra opara rahamata kareche, kAraNa Ami tAdera sAthe (sekhAne) upasthita chilAma nA|”

Ara yadi tomarA AllAhara pakSa theke kona anugraha (vijaYa o ganImata) lAbha karo tAhale nizcaYai se valave, —yena tomAdera o tAra madhye kona hRdyatA chilanA— “hAYare, Ami yadi tAdera saGge thAkatAma tAhale dAruNabhAve saphala hatAma (var3a ekaTA dAna peYe yetAma)!”

tAi yArA AkherAtera janya pArthiva jIvanake vikri (tyAga) karate cAYa tArA yena AllAhara pathe yuddha kare| Ara keu AllAhara pathe yuddha kare nihata kiMvA vijaYI hale acirei Ami tAke eka mahAna puraskAra deva|

tomAdera kI haYeche ye, tomarA AllAhara pathe o seisava durvala nara-nArI o zizudera (rakSAra) janya yuddha karacha nA? yArA valache, “he AmAdera prabhu! atyAcArI adhivAsIviziSTa ei janapada theke AmAderake vera (uddhAra) kara| Ara tomAra pakSa theke AmAdera janya ekajana abhibhAvaka dAo evaM tomAra pakSa theke AmAdera janya ekajana sAhAyyakArI dAo|”

yArA ImAnadAra tArA AllAhara pathe yuddha kare| Ara yArA kAphera tArA yuddha kare zaYatAnera pathe| ataeva, tomarA zaYatAnera dosaradera viruddhe yuddha kara| (dekhave) zaYatAnera kauzala Asale durvala|

tumi ki tAderake dekhani, yAderake valA haYechila, “tomarA tomAdera hAta saMyata karo, nAmAya kAYema karo o yAkAta dAo?” tArapara yakhana tAderake yuddhera nirdeza deoYA hala, amani tAdera madhye ekaTi dala mAnuSake bhaYa karate lAgala, Thika AllAhake bhaYa karAra mata kiMvA tAra ceYeo vezi| tArA valate lAgala, “he AmAdera prabhu! kena tumi AmAdera opara yuddha cApiYe dile? AmAderake kichu samaYera janya avakAza dile nA kena?” vale dAo, “e jagatera bhoga to sAmAnya| mottAkIdera janya parakAlai uttama| Ara tomAderake sutA parimANao juluma karA have nA|”

tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, mRtyu tomAderake dhare phelave; surakSita durge thAkaleo| yadi tAdera bhAla kichu haYa tAhale tArA vale, “eTA AllAhara pakSa theke,” Ara yadi khArApa kichu haYa tAhale vale, “eTA tomAra pakSa theke|” vala, “savakichui AllAhara pakSa theke|” e lokagulora haYeche ki? tArA kona kathAi yena vujhate pAre nA|
tomAra kAche bhAla yA Ase tA AllAhara pakSa theke; Ara tomAra khArApa yA ghaTe tA tomAra nijera kAraNe| Ami tomAke mAnuSera janya ekajana rasUla hiseve pAThiYechi| Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
ye rasUlera Anugatya kare se AllAharai Anugatya karala| Ara ye phire yAYa (se yAka), Ami to tomAke tAdera rakSaka kare pAThAini|

tArA vale, “(AmarA) anugata Achi|” kintu tomAra kAcha theke veriYe yAoYAra para rAte tAdera ekadala tumi yA vala tAra viparIta parikalpanA kare| AllAha tAdera ei rAtera pari-kalpanA likhe rAkhena| tAi tumi tAderake upekSA karo evaM AllAhara opara bharasA kara| kAryasampAdanakArI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
tave ki tArA koraAna samparke cintA kare nA? ei koraAna yadi AllAha chAr3A anya kAro kAcha theke Asata tAhale tArA ete aneka vaiparItya dekhate peta|

yakhana tAdera kAche nirApattA kiMvA bhaYera kona viSaYa upasthita haYa takhana tArA seTA pracAra kare deYa| (tA nA kare) tArA yadi viSaYaTA rasUla o tAdera madhye dAYitvazIladera gocare Anata tAhale seTA tAdera theke (sarAsari) emana lokerA jAnate pArata yArA tAra sUtra ud‌ghATana karate pArata| tomAdera opara yadi AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata tAhale alpa kaYekajana chAr3A tomarA (savAi) zaYatAnera anusaraNa karate|

tumi AllAhara pathe lar3Ai kara| tumi zudhu tomAra nijera janya dAYI| Ara muminaderake udvuddha kara| zigagirai AllAha kApheradera dApaTa thAmiYe devena| AllAhara dApaTai savaceYe pravala evaM tA~ra zAstii savaceYe kaThora|

ye vyakti bhAla kAjera supAriza karave tAra janya tAra (puNyera) ekaTi aMza thAkave, Ara ye khArApa kAjera supAriza karave tAra janya tAra (pApera) ekaTi aMza thAkave| AllAha savakichu karAra zakti rAkhena|

Ara yakhana tomAderake kona abhivAdana jAnAno haYa takhana (tAra javAve) tomarA tAra ceYe Aro bhAla abhivAdana jAnAve kiMvA (antatapakSe) ekai abhivAdana phiriYe deve| AllAha to savakichurai hisAva grahaNakArI|
AllAha, tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| avazyai tini tomAderake keYAmatera dine ekatrita karavena, ete kona sandeha nei| kathAYa AllAhara ceYe adhika satyavAdI ke hate pAre?

tomAdera kI hala ye, monAphekadera vyApAre tomarA dui dala haYe gele? athaca tAdera kRtakarmera phale AllAha tAderake pechanera dike (avizvAsera dike) ghuriYe diYechena| AllAha yAderake pathabhraSTa karechena tomarA ki tAderake pathe Anate cAo? Asale AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janya tumi kona patha pAve nA|

tArA cAYa, nijerA yemana kuphari kareche tomarAo temani kuphari karo evaM ebhAve savAi ekarakama haYe yAo| ataeva, tAdera madhya theke vandhu grahaNa karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA AllAhara pathe hijarata kare| yadi tArA rAji nA haYa tAhale tAderake yekhAnei pAve dharave Ara mArave (hatyA karave); Ara tAdera madhya theke kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI grahaNa karave nA;

tAderake vyatIta yArA emana kona dalera sAthe milita haYa yAdera sAthe tomAdera kona zAnticukti Ache, athavA yArA tomAdera kAche emana avasthAYa Ase ye tAdera mana tomAdera sAthe athavA tAdera nijedera (gotrera) lokadera sAthe yuddha karate anIha| Ara AllAha icchA karale tomAdera ceYe tAderake adhika zaktizAlI karatena, takhana tArA avazyai tomAdera sAthe yuddha karata| ataeva, tArA yadi tomAdera theke sare yAYa evaM tomAdera sAthe yuddha nA kare sandhi karate cAYa tAhale AllAha tomAdera janya tAdera viruddhe kichu karAra patha rAkhenani (arthAt tAhale tomarA tAdera viruddhe kona vyavasthA grahaNa karate pArave nA)|

zigagirai tomarA Aro kichu loka pAve yArA tomAdera kAche nirApattA cAYa AvAra tAdera nijedera (gotrera) lokadera kAcheo nirApattA cAYa| ederake yakhanai phetanAra (zir‌ka, kuph‌ra, vizRMkhalA, dAGgA ityAdira) dike phire Asate valA haYa takhanai tArA AvAra tAte nipatita haYa| tAi tArA yadi tomAdera theke sare nA yAYa athavA tomAdera sAthe sandhi nA kare kiMvA nijedera hAtake saMyata nA rAkhe tAhale yekhAnei pAve tAderake dharave Ara hatyA karave| Ami tomAderake edera viruddhe (vyavasthA grahaNera) spaSTa kartRtva diYe dilAma|

ekajana ImAnadAra Arekajana ImAnadArake hatyA karate pAre nA (kona ImAnadArake hatyA karale hatyAkArI Ara ImAnadAra thAke nA), tave bhulakrame hatyA karale bhinna kathA| keu yadi kona ImAnadAra lokake bhulakrame hatyA kare tAhale tAke ekajana ImAnadAra dAsa mukta karate have evaM nihatera parivArake raktamUlya parizodha karate have, tave tArA mApha kare dile bhinna kathA| yadi nihata vyakti tomAdera kona zatrupakSera loka haYa evaM ImAnadAra haYa tAhale ekajana ImAnadAra dAsa mukta karate have| Ara yadi emana kona goSThIra loka haYa yAdera sAthe tomAdera zAnticukti Ache tAhale tAra parivArake raktamUlya parizodha karate have evaM ekajana ImAnadAra dAsa mukta karate have| ye tA pArave nA tAke AllAhara kAcha theke pApamukti kAmanAYa avirAma dui mAsa royA rAkhate have| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara ye icchAkRtabhAve kona ImAnadAra lokake hatyA kare tAra zAsti jAhAnnAma, sekhAne se cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAra opara rAgAnvita haYechena, tAke abhizapta karechena evaM tAra janya var3a zAstira vyavasthA kare rekhechena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yakhana AllAhara pathe saphare vera have takhana (savakichu) yAcAi kare neve evaM ye tomAderake sAlAma deve tAke valo nA, “tumi momena nao;” tomarA pArthiva jIvanera sampada pete cAo; athaca AllAhara kAche aneka sampada Ache| tomarAo to Age emana chile; tArapara AllAha tomAdera prati anugraha karechena; ataeva, (savakichu) yAcAi kare nAo| tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha se samvandhe nizcaYai avahita raYechena|

yesava ImAnadAra akSama naYa athaca (jehAde nA giYe ghare) vase thAke tArA evaM nijedera jAnamAla diYe AllAhara pathe jehAdakArIrA samAna hate pAre nA| nijedera jAnamAla diYe jehAdakArIderake AllAha (ghare) vase thAkA lokadera ceYe maryAdAYa zreSThatva diYechena| pratyekake AllAha kalyANera oYAdA karechena| Ara AllAha jehAdakArIderake var3a puraSkAra diYe (ghare) vase thAkA lokadera ceYe zreSThatva diYechena,
tA~ra pakSa theke maryAdAYa; kSamA o anugraha diYeo| AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

nijedera prati julumakArI avasthAYa pherezatArA yAdera prANa neYa tAderake tArA prazna kare, “tomarA ki avasthAYa chile?” uttare tArA vale, “AmarA pRthivIte durvala chilAma|” tArA vale, “AllAhara jamina ki tomAdera hijarata karAra mata prazasta chila nA?” tAi esava lokera nivAsa hala jAhAnnAma, seTA var3a khArApa ThikAnA!
durvala nara-nArI o zizurA vyatIta; yArA kona upAYa avalamvana karate pAre nA evaM kona patherao sandhAna pAYa nA|
AzA Ache, AllAha ederake mArjanA karavena| AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|

ye AllAhara pathe hijarata kare se pRthivIte aneka AzraYasthala o prAcurya lAbha karave| Ara ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera uddezye hijarata kare nijera ghara theke vera haYa, tArapara (hijarate thAkA avasthAYa) mArA yAYa, tAke puraskRta karA AllAhara dAYitva haYe yAYa| AllAha to kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa|

tomarA yakhana kothAo saphare vera hao takhana yadi kApheradera utpAtera (AkramaNera) bhaYa thAke tAhale nAmAya saMkSipta karale tomAdera kona pApa have nA| nizcaYai kApherarA tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

Ara (kApheradera AkramaNera bhaYa thAkA avasthAYa) yakhana tumi tAdera mAjhe thAkave evaM tAdera niYe nAmAya AdAYa karave takhana tAdera ekadala tomAra sAthe dA~r3Ave evaM tArA tAdera astra saGge rAkhave; tArapara yakhana tArA sejadA sampanna karave (eka rAkAta samApta karave) takhana tomAdera pechane avasthAna neve evaM nAmAya par3eni emana ArekaTi dala ese tomAra sAthe nAmAya par3ave; tArAo satarka thAkave evaM nijedera astra saGge rAkhave| kApherarA cAYa tomarA tomAdera astrazastra o mAlAmAla samparke asatarka thAka, yAte tArA ekavAre tomAdera opara jhA~piYe par3ate pAre| Ara vRSTira kAraNe yadi tomAdera kaSTa haYa kiMvA tomarA asustha thAka tAhale (nAmAya AdAYarata avasthAYa) astra rekhe dile tomAdera kona pApa have nA; tave tomarA satarka thAkave| nizcaYai AllAha kApheradera janya lAJchanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena|

ebhAve yakhana nAmAya sampanna karave takhana dA~r3iYe, vase evaM zuYe AllAhake smaraNa karave| tArapara yakhana nizcinta (zaGkAmukta) have takhana ThikabhAve nAmAya par3ave| nAmAya to muminadera janya eka samaYa-nirdhArita pharaya|

tomarA (zatrupakSera) lokadera pechane chuTate durvala (hatodyama) haYo nA| (ete) yadi tomAdera kaSTa haYa tAhale (mane karave) tAderao to tomAdera matai kaSTa hacche; Ara tomarA AllAhara kAcha theke ye puraskAra (jAnnAta) AzA karo tArA to tA AzA kare nA| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

Ami tomAra kAche satya sahakAre kitAva avatIrNa karechi, yAte tumi AllAhara dekhAno (zekhAno) jJAna dvArA lokadera mAjhe vicAra-mImAMsA karate pAra| tAi tumi vizvAsaghAtakadera pakSe vitarkakArI haYo nA|
Ara AllAhara kAche kSamA prArthanA karo; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA nijedera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA kare tAdera pakSe vitarka karo nA| vastuta AllAha kona vizvAsaghAtaka pApIke bhAlavAsena nA|

tArA mAnuSera kAcha theke (cakrAnta) gopana karate cAYa, kintu AllAhara kAcha theke gopana karate pAre nA; kAraNa tArA yakhana rAte lukiYe lukiYe emanasava kathA vale yA AllAha pachanda karena nA takhana tini tAdera sAthei thAkena| AllAha tAdera kAjakarma pariveSTana kare Achena|
dekha, tomarAi ihakAlIna jIvane tAdera pakSe vitarka karecho, kintu keYAmatera dina ke tAdera pakSe AllAhara sAthe vitarka karave athavA ke tAdera kAryanirvAhI have?
ye loka kona khArApa kAja kare kiMvA nijera prati anyAYa kare, tArapara AllAhara kAche kSamA cAYa se AllAhake kSamAzIla o daYAlu pAve|
ye loka kona pApa kare, se tA nijera viruddhei kare (tAra pariNAma tAkei bhoga karate have)| AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|
ye loka kona anyAYa kiMvA pApa kare, tArapara tA kona niraparAdha lokera dike nikSepa kare (arthAt kona niraparAdha lokera opara tAra dAYa cApAYa) se ekaTi apavAda o spaSTa pApa vahana karala|

yadi tomAra opara AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata tAhale tAdera ekaTi dala avazyai tomAke vibhrAnta karAra saMkalpa karata| tave prakRtapakSe tArA kevala nijederakei vibhrAnta karache| tArA tomAra konai kSati karate pArache nA| AllAha tomAra kAche kitAva o prajJA avatIrNa karechena evaM tumi yA jAnate nA tomAke tA zikhiYechena| tomAra prati AllAhara anugraha aneka var3a|

tAdera gopana parAmarzera anekagulote bhAla kichu nei| tave ye dAna-chadakA, bhAla kAja kiMvA mAnuSera madhye zAnti pratiSThAra Adeza deYa tAra kathA AlAdA| Ara ye esava kAja AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera janya kare, Ami tAke var3a puraskAra deva|

saThika patha spaSTa haoYAra para keu yadi rasUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare Ara muminadera patha chAr3A anya patha anusaraNa kare tAhale Ami tAke sedikei pherAva yedike se phirate ceYeche evaM tAke jAhAnnAmera Agune dagdha karava| seTA kata khArApa gantavya!

AllAhara sAthe zarIka karA hale tini tA kSamA karena nA| echAr3A Ara sava (pApa) tini yAke icchA kSamA kare dena| Ara ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare se sudUra (apanodana karA kaThina emana) vibhrAntite patita haYa|
tArA (muzarikarA) tA~ke (AllAhake) vAda diYe kevala nArI devatAderakei DAke, tArA kevala avAdhya zaYatAnakei DAke;
yAke AllAha abhizApa diYechena; Ara ye valechila, “Ami avazyai tomAra vAndAdera madhya theke ekaTi nirdiSTa aMzake AmAra anusArI kare neva|

Ami avazyai tAderake vipathagAmI karava, Ami avazyai tAdera mAjhe mithyA AzA jAgAva, Ami avazyai tAderake Adeza deva yAra phale tArA pazura kAna kartana karavei, Ami avazyai tAderake Adeza deva yAra phale tArA AllAhara sRSTi vikRta karavei|” tave ye AllAhara parivarte zaYatAnake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare se spaSTatai kSatigrasta haYa|
se tAdera sAthe oYAdA kare evaM tAderake AzAnvita kare| zaYatAna to Asale pratAraNA karAra janyai tAdera sAthe oYAdA kare thAke|
ederai AvAsa hala jAhAnnAma| sekhAna theke tArA kona pAlAnora jAYagA pAve nA|

Ara yArA ImAna eneche evaM satkAja kareche Ami tAderake jAnnAte praveza karAva yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| sekhAne tArA anantakAla dhare vAsa karave| eTA AllAhara satya oYAdA| kathAYa AllAhara ceYe satyavAdI Ara ke Ache?
tomAdera AzA anuyAYI kiMvA kitAvadhArIdera AzA anuyAYI kichu have nA| ye khArApa kAja karave se tAra pratiphala pAve evaM AllAha chAr3A se nijera janya kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
ImAnadAra avasthAYa ye puruSa kiMvA nArI satkAja karave tArA jAnnAte praveza karave| tAdera prati sAmAnya parimANao avicAra karA have nA|

ye satkarmazIla vyakti nijeke AllAhara janya samarpaNa kare evaM ekaniSTha haYe ivarAhImera dharma anusaraNa kare, dharmera vyApAre tAra ceYe ke zreSTha? AllAha ivarAhImake antaraGga vandhurUpe grahaNa karechena|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tA AllAharai| AllAha savakichu pariveSTana kare Achena|

tArA tomAra kAche nArIdera vyApAre (tAdera karaNIYa) jAnate cAYa| vala, “tAdera vyApAre (tomAdera karaNIYa) AllAha tomAderake jAnAcchena| adhikantu ye etima meYederake tomarA tAdera nirdhArita prApya dAo nA athaca tAderake viYe karate cAo tAdera vyApAre evaM durvala nipIr3ita zizudera vyApAre tini tomAderake kitAvera mAdhyame (tomAdera karaNIYa) jAnAcchena| tini tomAderake etimadera prati nyAYavicAra karateo valachena| tomarA bhAla yA kichu karo AllAha tA avagata Achena|

yadi kona nArI tAra svAmIra kAcha theke durvyavahAra kiMvA upekSAra AzaGkA kare tAhale tArA nijedera madhye Aposa-mImAMsA kare nile kAro kona doSa have nA| Aposa-mImAMsAi bhAla| Ara mAnuSera mane to (sarvadA) svArthacintA vartamAna thAke| tave tomarA yadi bhAla kAja karo evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo tAhale (jene rekho,) tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

tomarA cAileo nArIdera (tomAdera strIdera) prati yathAyatha nyAYavicAra karate pArave nA| tavuo ekajanera prati puropuri jhu~ke par3e Arekajanake jhulanta avasthAYa phele rekho nA| Ara yadi tomarA bhAla kAja karo evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo tAhale (jene rekho,) avazyai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
Ara yadi tArA (svAmI-strI) paraspara vicchinna haYe yAYa tAhale AllAha tA~ra prAcurya (sampada) dvArA pratyekake abhAvamukta karavena| AllAha prAcuryamaYa, prajJAvAna|

AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tA savai AllAhara| vastuta tomAdera pUrve yAderake kitAva deoYA haYeche tAderake evaM tomAderake Ami nirdeza diYechi ye, AllAhake bhaYa kara| Ara yadi tomarA (AllAhara Adeza) amAnya karo tAhaleo AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tA savai AllAhara| AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tA savai AllAhara| karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
he mAnuSa! tini yadi icchA karena tAhale tomAderake niYe giYe (tomAdera sthale) anyaderake niYe Asate pArena| AllAha tA karAra kSamatA rAkhena|
ye ihakAlera puraskAra cAYa (tAra jAnA ucita), AllAhara kAche ihakAla o parakAlera (ubhaYa jagatera) puraskAra raYeche| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera nijedera kiMvA pitAmAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera vipakSe geleo tomarA AllAhara (pakSe) sAkSI hiseve nyAYera opara aTala thAkave| (sAkSya yAra viruddhe yAve) se dhanI hoka vA garIva hoka AllAhai ubhaYera bhAla rakSaka| ataeva, tomarA pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA, pAche (nyAYa theke) vicyuta hao| Ara yadi tomarA (sAkSya) ghuriYe dAo kiMvA er3iYe yAo tAhale (jene rAkhave) tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tA avagata Achena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake (yathArthabhAve) vizvAsa karo evaM tini ye kitAva tA~ra rasUlera opara nAyila karechena o ye kitAva tAra Age nAyila karechilena tAo vizvAsa kara| ye vyakti AllAha, tA~ra pherezatAgaNa, tAra~ kitAvasamUha, tA~ra rasUlagaNa o zeSa dinake (parakAlake) avizvAsa karave se sudUra (gurutara) vibhrAntite patita have|

yArA ekavAra vizvAsa kare punarAYa avizvAsa kareche, tArapara AvAra vizvAsa kare AvAro avizvAsa kareche o avizvAsera mAtrA Aro vAr3iYe diYeche AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA evaM kona pathao dekhAvena nA|
monAphekaderake jAniYe dAo ye, tAdera janya eka vedanAdAYaka zAsti nirdhArita Ache|
yArA ImAnadAradera vAda diYe kApheradera sAthe vandhutva kare tArA ki tAdera kAche kSamatA cAYa? Asale sava kSamatA to AllAharai|

tini to kitAve itimadhyei tomAderake vale diYechena ye, tomarA yakhana AllAhara AYAtasamUhake amAnya karate o vidrUpa karate zunave takhana tomarA tAdera sAthe (amAnyakArI o vidrUpakArIdera sAthe) vasave nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA anya kathAYa lipta haYa| tAhale (tAdera sAthe vasale) tomarAo tAdera matai have| nizcaYai AllAha monApheka o kApheradera sakalake jAhAnnAme ekatra karavena|
