yArA tomAdera vyApAre pratIkSAYa thAke; yadi tomAdera janya AllAhara pakSa theke kona vijaYa Ase tAhale tArA vale, “AmarA ki tomAdera sAthe chilAma nA?” Ara yadi kApheradera kona sAphalya Ase tAhale (tAderake) vale, “AmarA ki tomAdera opara kartRtva karini evaM tomAderake muminadera hAta theke rakSA karini?” AllAha keYAmatera dina tomAdera madhye mImAMsA karavena| Ara AllAha kApheradera janya ImAnadAradera viruddhe (sAphalyera) kona rAstA rAkhavena nA|

vastuta monAphekarA (ImAnera bhAna kare) AllAhara sAthe pratAraNA karache, tinio tAdera sAthe pratAraNA karavena (tAdera pratAraNAra viruddhe pAlTA vyavasthA nevena)| Ara tArA yakhana nAmAyera janya dA~r3AYa takhana alasabhAve loka-dekhAnora janya dA~r3AYa; tArA AllAhake alpai smaraNa kare|
tArA ei avasthAra madhye (ImAna o kupharira madhye) dodulyamAna; nA edera dike nA odera dike| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janya tumi kona patha pAve nA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA ImAnadAradera vAda diYe kApheraderake vandhu hiseve grahaNa karo nA| tomarA ki AllAhara janya nijedera viruddhe ekaTi spaSTa pramANa yogAr3a kare dite cAo?
monAphekadera jAYagA have jAhAnnAmera sarvanimna stare| Ara tumi tAdera janya kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA;

sei sava loka vyatIta yArA taovA kare, nijedera avasthA saMzodhana kare, AllAhake (AllAhara vidhAnake) A~kar3e dhare evaM zudhu AllAhara (santuSTira) janya nijedera dharme ekaniSTha thAke| emana lokerA muminadera sAthe thAkave| Ara AgAmIte AllAha muminaderake eka mahAna pratidAna devena|
tomarA yadi kRtajJatA prakAza karo o ImAnadAra hao tAhale AllAha tomAderake zAsti devena kena? AllAha to puraskAradAtA, mahAjJAnI|
AllAha khArApa kathAra pracAraNA pachanda karena nA; tave kAro prati juluma haYe thAkale tAra kathA AlAdA| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
tomarA yadi kona bhAla kAja prakAza karo kiMvA tA gopana karo athavA (kAro) kona doSa kSamA kare dAo, tAhale (jAnave) AllAhao kSamAzIla, sarvazaktimAna|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladerake (mUlata) avizvAsa kare, (vizvAsera kSetre) AllAha o rasUladera madhye pArthakya karate cAYa Ara vale, “AmarA katakake vizvAsa kari Ara katakake vizvAsa kari nA” evaM era madhyavartI kona patha avalamvana karate cAYa,
tArAi prakRtapakSe kAphera; Ara Ami (ei) kApheradera janya lAJchanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladerake vizvAsa kare evaM (vizvAsera kSetre) tAdera kAro madhye pArthakya kare nA, tini tAderake avazyai tAdera puraskAra devena| AllAha to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

kitAvIrA (ihudirA) tomAke AsamAna theke ekaTi kitAva nAyila karAte vale| vastuta tArA mUsAra kAche era ceYeo var3a jinisa ceYechila| tArA valechila, “(he mUsA!) tumi prakAzye AmAdere AllAhake dekhAo|” takhana tAdera ei anyAYera janyai tAdera opara vajrapAta haYechila| ataHpara tAdera kAche spaSTa pramANAdi AsAra pareo tArA vAchura pUjA karechila| Ami tAo kSamA karechilAma| Ara mUsAke Ami eka spaSTa kartRtva diYechilAma|

Ara tAdera kAcha theke pratijJA neoYAra janya tUra pAhAr3ake tAdera opare tule dharechilAma evaM tAderake valechilAma, “avanatamastake darajAYa praveza karo”; tAderake valechilAma, “zanivArera vyApAre vAr3AvAr3i karo nA”| ebhAve tAdera kAcha theke kaThora pratijJA niYechilAma|

tAdera pratijJA bhaGga karAra kAraNe, AllAhara vidhAnasamUha amAnya karAra kAraNe, anyAYabhAve rasUladerake hatyA karAra kAraNe evaM “AmAdera antarasamUha AcchAdita” e kathA valAra kAraNe (tAdera opara zAsti neme esechila)| varaM tAdera kupharira kAraNei AllAha tA (tAdera antarasamUha) sIla kare diYechena; tAi tArA alpai vizvAsa kare|
(tAdera opara zAsti neme esechila) tAdera kupharira kAraNe, mariYamera prati gurutara apavAda Aropa karAra kAraNe

evaM “AmarA mariYamera putra AllAhara rasUla IsA masIhake hatyA karechi” tAdera e kathA valAra kAraNe; athaca tArA tAke hatyA kareni, kruzaviddhao kareni; varaM tArA dhA~dhAYa par3echila| Ara yArA tAra vyApAre matabheda karechila tArA Asale tAra vyApAre sandihAna chila| dhAraNAra vazavartI haoYA vyatIta tAra samvandhe tAdera kona jJAna chila nA| Ara eTA nizcita ye, tArA tAke hatyA kareni;
varaM AllAha tAke nijera kAche uThiYe niYechena| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
mRtyura pUrve kitAvIdera savAi avazyai tAke (IsAke AllAhara rasUla vale) vizvAsa karave, Ara keYAmatera dina se tAdera viruddhe sAkSI have|
(prathame) vaidha karA haYechila emana katipaYa bhAla jinisa Ami ihudidera janya avaidha kare diYechi tAdera julumera kAraNe, AllAhara pathe anekake vAdhA deoYAra kAraNe,

niSedha karA sattveo sudagrahaNera kAraNe evaM anyAYabhAve mAnuSera sampada bhakSaNa (haraNa) karAra kAraNe| Ara tAdera madhye yArA kAphera tAdera janya Ami eka yantraNA-dAYaka zAsti prastuta rekhechi|

kintu tAdera madhye yArA jJAne paripakka tArA evaM ImAnadArarA tomAra kAche yA nAyila karA haYeche evaM tomAra pUrve yA nAyila karA haYechila tA vizvAsa kare; Ara yArA nAmAya susampAdana kare, yAkAta dAna kare evaM AllAha o parakAla vizvAsa kare Ami tAderake eka mahAna puraskAra deva|

Ami tomAra kAche ohI pAThiYechi; yemana ohI pAThiYechilAma nUhera kAche o tAra paravartI navIdera kAche| Aro ohI pAThiYechilAma ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tAra santAnadera kAche evaM IsA, AiYUva, iunusa, hArUna o solAYamAnera kAche| Ara dAudake diYechilAma yavUra|
Ara kichu rasUla pAThiYechi yAdera kathA tomAke Agei valechi AvAra kichu rasUla pAThiYechi yAdera kathA tomAke valini| Ara mUsAra sAthe AllAha sarAsari kathA valechena|
rasUladera pAThiYechilAma susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hiseve; yAte rasUla AsAra pare AllAhara viruddhe mAnuSera kona ajuhAta nA thAke| AllAha halena parAkramazAlI, parama prAjJa|
tave AllAha tomAra kAche yA nAyila karechena se samparke tini sAkSya dicchena ye, tini tA nija jJAne nAyila karechena; pherezatArAo (temana) sAkSya dicche| Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|
yArA (satyake) avizvAsa kare evaM AllAhara patha theke (mAnuSake) phiriYe rAkhe tArA dAruNabhAve vipathagAmI haYeche|
yArA (satyake) avizvAsa kare evaM (satya gopana kare) anyAYa kare AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA evaM tAderake kona pathao dekhAvena nA,
jAhAnnAmera patha chAr3A; sekhAne tArA anantakAla vAsa karave| eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|

he mAnuSa! rasUla to tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke satya niYe esechena; ekhana tomarA vizvAsa karo; ete tomAderai maGgala have| Ara yadi avizvAsa karo tAhale (jene rekho) AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara| Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|

he kitAvadhArIrA! tomarA tomAdera dharmera vyApAre vAr3AvAr3i karo nA evaM AllAha samparke satya chAr3A kona kathA valo nA| vastuta mariYamaputra IsA masIha AllAhara rasUla o tA~ra vANI, yA tini mariYamera kAche preraNa karena evaM tA~ra kAcha theke Agata eka rUha (Adeza)| ataeva, tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladerake vizvAsa kara| Ara “tina (arthAt prabhu hacche tinera samaSTi emana kathA)” valo nA| (emana kathA valA theke) virata thAka; ete tomAdera maGgala have| vastuta AllAha hacchena ekaka upAsya| tA~ra kona santAna haoYA theke tini pavitra| AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache sava tA~rai| Ara karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

masIha (IsA) AllAhara vAndA hate kakhano asvIkAra karave nA; (AllAhara) khuva kAchera pherezatArAo nA| Ara yArA tA~ra evAdata karate asvIkAra karave o ahaGkArI have AllAha tAdera sakalake acirei tA~ra kAche ekatrita karavena|

ataeva, yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche tini tAderake tAdera nyAyya puraskAra devena evaM nija anugrahe Aro vezi devena| Ara yArA (tA~ra evAdata karate) asvIkAra kareche o ahaGkArI haYeche tini tAderake kaSTadAYaka zAsti devena evaM tArA nijedera janya AllAha vyatIta kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
he mAnuSa! tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura kAcha theke pramANa eseche evaM Ami tomAdera kAche spaSTa Alo (koraAna) nAyila karechi|

ataeva, yArA AllAhake vizvAsa kareche o tA~ke (tA~ra dvInake) zaktabhAve dhare rekheche tini tAderake nijera daYA o anugrahe (jAnnAte) sthAna devena evaM tA~ra dikera sarala pathe paricAlita karavena|

lokerA tomAra kAche (vidhAna) jAnate cAYa| vala, “AllAha tomAderake jJakAlAlAhaJca (pitRhIna o niHsantAna vyakti) samparke jAnAcchena| yadi kona puruSa mArA yAYa yAra kona santAna nei kintu ekajana vona Ache tAhale ei vona pAve bhAiYera rekhe-yAoYA sampadera ardheka|” AvAra vonera kona santAna nA thAkale (se mArA yAoYAra para) bhAi tAra uttarAdhikArI have| (mRtera) yadi dui vona thAke tAhale tArA pAve rekhe-yAoYA sampadera dui tRtIYAMza| Ara yadi bhAi o vona ubhaYai thAke tAhale (tAdera) ekajana puruSa pAve dujana nArIra aMzera samAna| tomarA vibhrAnta hate pAra vale AllAha tomAderake spaSTabhAve vujhiYe dicchena| Ara AllAha savakichui samyaka avagata|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA aGgIkArasamUha pUraNa kara| tomAdera janya catuSpada jantu hAlAla karA hala, segulo vyatIta yegulo tomAdera kAche ullekha karA have (ei sUrAra 3naM AYAte ullikhita)| tave tomarA eharAmarata avasthAYa zikAra karA hAlAla mane karave nA| AllAha yA karate cAna tAra nirdeza dena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera, pavitra mAsasamUhera, koravAnira pazura, galAYa mAlA-parAno cihnita pazura evaM prabhura anugraha o santuSTi lAbhera AzAYa pavitra gRhera (kAvAra) uddezye gamanakArIdera asammAna karo nA| Ara yakhana tomarA eharAma theke mukta have takhana zikAra karate pAra| tomAderake pavitra masajide (kAvAYa) yete vAdhA diYechila vale kona sampradAYera zatrutA yena tomAderake vAr3AvAr3i karate prarocita nA kare| tomarA satkAja o dvInadArite paraspara sahayogitA karo, pApa o vAr3AvAr3ite sahayogitA karo nA; Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo; nizcaYai AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA|

tomAdera janya (khAoYA) niSiddha karA haYeche: mRta prANI, rakta, zUkarera mAMsa, AllAha vyatIta anyera nAme javAikRta prANI, zvAsarodha kare mArA haYeche emana prANI, AghAta kare mArA haYeche emana prANI, par3e giYe mArA giYeche emana prANI, ziMera AghAte mArA giYeche emana prANI, hiMsra jantura khAoYA prANI— (marAra Age) tomarA javAi karate pArale tA vyatIta— evaM pUjAra vedIte javAikRta prANI| tIra dvArA tomAdera bhAgya jAnate cAoYAo niSiddha| egulo pApera kAja| Aja kApherarA tomAdera dvIna samparke hatAza haYe par3eche| ataeva, tAderake bhaYa karo nA, varaM AmAkei bhaYa kara| Aja Ami tomAdera janya tomAdera dvIna pUrNa karalAma, tomAdera janya AmAra anugraha sampUrNa karalAma evaM dvIna hiseve isalAmake tomAdera janya pachanda karalAma| tave pApapravaNa nA haYe kevala tI\ kSudhAYa keu yadi (niSiddha khAvAra khete) vAdhya haYa, tAhale AllAha to kSamAzIla o daYAlu|

lokerA tomAra kAche jAnate cAYa ki ki tAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche| vala, “tomAdera janya yAvatIYa pavitra jinisa hAlAla karA haYeche| Ara tomarA zikAre pAThAnora janya yesava zikArI pazu-pAkhi prazikSaNa diYecho evaM AllAha tomAderake yebhAve zikhiYechena tAderakeo tomarA sebhAvei zikSA diccha, erA tomAdera janya ye zikAra dhare Ane tomarA tA khete pAra, tave (zikAra dhare AnAra uddezye ederake preraNakAle) tAra opara AllAhara nAma neve; Ara AllAhake bhaYa karave| nizcaYai AllAha druta hisAva grahaNa karena|”

Aja tomAdera janya pavitra vastusamUha vaidha karA hala| kitAvadhArIdera khAdya tomAdera janya vaidha evaM tomAdera khAdya tAdera janya vaidha| satI-sAdhvI musalima nArI o tomAdera pUrvera kitAvadhArIdera satI-sAdhvI nArIo (tomAdera janya vaidha), yakhana tomarA tAderake moharAnA diYe viYe karave, avaidha yaunakarma kiMvA vAndhavI grahaNera janya naYa| ImAnera viSaYa ye avizvAsa kare tAra karma niSphala haYe gela| parakAleo se kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|

he ImAnadAragaNa! yakhana tomarA nAmAyera janya uThave (udyogI have) takhana mukhamaNDala o kanui paryanta hAta dhove, mAthA muchave evaM gor3Alira oparera gi~Tha paryanta pA dhove| yadi tomarA apavitra avasthAYa thAka tave pavitra haYe neve| Ara tomarA yadi asustha hao (evaM pAni vyavahAre kSatira AzaMkA thAke) kiMvA saphare thAka, athavA tomAdera keu pAYakhAnA theke (malamUtra tyAga kare) Ase, kiMvA tomarA nArIdera saMsarge yAo Ara (ayu/gosala karAra janya) pAni nA pAo tAhale pavitra mATi dvArA tAYAmmuma karave arthAt ai mATi dvArA tomAdera mukhamaNDala o hAta muche neve| AllAha tomAderake asuvidhAYa phelate cAna nA, kintu pavitra rAkhate cAna evaM tomAdera prati tA~ra neYAmata pUrNa karate cAna, yAte tomarA dhanya hao|

tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o tomAdera kAcha theke neoYA tA~ra aGgIkArera kathA smaraNa karo, yakhana tomarA valechile, “AmarA zunechi o mene niYechi”, Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo; nizcaYai AllAha antarera viSaYa samyaka avagata|

he ImAnadAragaNa! AllAhara janya nyAYera sAkSIrUpe tomarA avicala theko| kona samapradAYera zatrutA yena nyAYavicAra nA karate tomAderake prarocita nA kare| tomarA nyAYavicAra karave| eTA tAkaoYAra adhikatara kAchAkAchi| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha nizcaYai tAra khavara rAkhena|
yArA vizvAsa kare evaM satkAja kare tAdera janya kSamA o mahAna puraskAra Ache vale AllAha tAderake oYAdA diYechena|
Ara yArA avizvAsa kare evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera prati AllAhara anugrahera kathA smaraNa karo, yakhana ekaTi samapradAYa tomAdera dike tAdera hAta vAr3Ate ceYechila, kintu tini tAdera hAta tomAdera theke nivRtta karechilena| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| ImAnadArarA yena AllAhara oparai nirbhara kare|

AllAha vanI isarAIla (ihudidera) theke aGgIkAra niYechilena| Ara Ami tAdera madhya theke vAra jana netA niyukta karechilAma| AllAha valechilena, “Ami tomAdera sAthei Achi| yadi tomarA nAmAya kAYema karo, yAkAta dAna karo, AmAra rasUladerake vizvAsa karo o tAderake sAhAyya karo evaM AllAhake ekaTi uttama RNa dAo tAhale Ami tomAdera pApasamUha mocana kare deva evaM tomAderake sei jAnnAte sthAna deva yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| kintu era parao tomAdera madhye ye kuphari karave se avazyai sarala patha theke vicyuta have|”

ataeva, tAdera aGgIkArabhaGgera kAraNe Ami tAderake abhisampAta diYechi evaM tAdera antarasamUha kaThina karechi| tArA zavdasamUhera saThika artha vikRta kare| tAderake yA smaraNa kariYe deoYA haYechila tAra ekaTi gurutvapUrNa aMza tArA bhule giYeche| tumi tAdera alpasaMkhyaka loka chAr3A savasamaYa tAdera madhye kona nA kona vizvAsaghAtaka dalera sandhAna pAve| tave tAderake tumi kSamA kare dio evaM upekSA kare yeYo| nizcaYai AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

yArA vale, “AmarA khriSTAna” Ami tAdera thekeo aGgIkAra niYechilAma; kintu tAderake ye kathA smaraNa kariYe deoYA haYechila tArAo tAra ekaTA gurutvapUrNa aMza bhule giYeche| ejanyai Ami keYAmata paryanta tAdera madhye pArasparika zatrutA o vidveSa saJcArita karechi| AllAha tAderake acirei tAdera kRtakarma avahita karavena|

he kitAvIrA! tomAdera kAche AmAra rasUla esechena| tomarA (AllAhara) kitAvera yA yA gopana karate tini tAra anekakichu tomAdera kAche prakAza karena evaM anekakichu mArjanA karena| tomAdera kAche AllAhara pakSa theke eka vizeSa Alo o ekaTi spaSTa kitAva eseche|
yArA AllAhara santuSTi lAbha karate cAYa ei kitAva dvArA tini tAderake zAntira patha dekhAna, nija hukume tAderake andhakAra theke Alote vera kare Anena evaM sarala pathe paricAlita karena|

yArA vale, “AllAha to mariYamera putra masIha” tArA avazyai kupharira madhye raYeche| vala, “tAhale AllAha yadi mariYamera putra masIha o tAra mAke evaM pRthivIte yArA Ache tAdera sakalake dhvaMsa karate cAna tAhale ke Ache ye AllAhara icchAra viruddhe kichu karAra kSamatA rAkhe?” AsamAna-jamina o tAra madhyavartI savakichura kartRtva AllAharai| tini yA cAna sRSTi karena| AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|

ihudi o khriSTAnarA vale, “AmarA AllAhara santAna o tA~ra priYajana|” vala, “tAhale tomAdera pApera kAraNe tini tomAdera zAsti dena kena? tomarA varaM tA~ra sRSTa anyadera matai mAnuSa|” tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti dena| AsamAna-jamina o tAra madhyavartI savakichura kartRtva AllAharai| tA~ra kAchei (savakichura) pratyAvartana|

he kitAvadhArIrA! tomAdera kAche AmAra rasUla esechena yini rasUladera AgamanadhArAYa ekaTi viratira para ese tomAderake savakichu vujhiYe dicchena; nA hale tomarA valate, “AmAdera kAche kona susaMvAdadAtA kiMvA satarkakArI Aseni|” sejanyai tomAdera kAche ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI esechena| Ara AllAha savakichui karate sakSama|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana mUsA tAra lokaderake valechila, “he AmAra lokerA! tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa karo, yakhana tini tomAdera madhye navI pAThiYechena, tomAderake rAjA vAniYechena evaM tomAderake emana jinisa diYechena yA pRthivIra kAuke denani|”
“he AmAra samapradAYa! AllAha tomAdera janya ye pavitra bhUmi nirdiSTa kare rekhechena tomarA sekhAne (philistIne) praveza karo evaM pazcAdapasaraNa karo nA, tA karale kSatigrasta have|”

tArA valechila, “he mUsA! sekhAne to ekadala mahAzaktidhara loka Ache| tArA yatakSaNa nA sekhAna theke vera haYa AmarA sekhAne praveza karava nA| tArA yadi sekhAna theke vera haYa tAhale avazyai AmarA praveza karava|”

yArA bhaYa karachila tAdera madhya theke AllAhara anugrahaprApta dujana valala, “tomarA tAdera (mokAvelAra) uddezye darajAYa praveza kara| praveza karalei tomarA vijaYI have| Ara tomarA yadi (yathArtha) ImAnadAra hao tAhale AllAhara oparai AsthA rAkha|”

tArA valechila, “he mUsA! orA yatakSaNa bhitare thAkave tatakSaNa AmarA kichutei sekhAne Dhukava nA| sutarAM tumi o tomAra prabhu yAo evaM tomarA dujanei (zatrura sAthe) yuddha karo; AmarA ekhAnei vase thAkava|”
mUsA valala, “he prabhu! Ami o AmAra bhAi chAr3A anyadera opara AmAra kona kSamatA nei; tAi tumi AmAdera dujanake (ei) avAdhya lokadera theke AlAdA kare dAo|”
AllAha valalena, “tAhale ei pavitra bhUmi tAdera janya calliza vachara paryanta niSiddha thAkave| tArA pRthivIte dig‌bhrAnta haYe ghurave| sutarAM tumi (ei) avAdhya lokadera janya duHkha karo nA|”

oderake Adamera dui putrera (hAvIla o kvAvIla) ghaTanA ThikaThikabhAve zonAo; yakhana tArA (AllAhara uddezye) ekaTi kare koravAni karechila| tAdera ekajanera koravAni kavula hala, anyajanera hala nA| takhana dvitIYajana (prathamajanake) valala, “Ami tomAke khuna kare phelava|” prathamajana valala, “AllAha to kevala mottAkIdera koravAni kavula karena|”
“tumi yadi AmAke hatyA karAra janya AmAra dike tomAra hAta vAr3Ao, Ami tomAke hatyA karAra janya tomAra dike AmAra hAta vAr3Ava nA; (kAraNa) Ami to sArA jAhAnera prabhu AllAhake bhaYa kari|”
“Ami cAi, tumi AmAra o tomAra (dujanerai) pApa mAthAYa niYe jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIdera antarbhukta hao| Ara seTAi jAlemadera zAsti|”
takhana dvitIYajana nijera bhAike hatyA karAra janya manera sAYa pAYa evaM tAke hatyA kare kSatigrastadera (pApIdera) tAlikAbhukta haYa|

takhana AllAha ekaTi kAka pAThAna| hatyAkArI tAra bhAiYera mRtadeha kIbhAve lukAve tAke tA dekhiYe deoYAra janya kAkaTi mATi khu~r3ate lAgala| eTA dekhe se valala, “hAYare! Ami ki AmAra bhAiYera mRtadehaTi lukAte ei kAkaTira matao vuddhi khATAte pAralAma nA?” pare se anutapta haYa|

e kAraNei vanI isarAIlera janya Ami ye vidhAna nirdiSTa kare diYechi tA hala, keu yadi kona mAnuSa hatyAra pratizodha chAr3A kiMvA pRthivIte azAnti sRSTira abhiyoga chAr3A kAuke hatyA kare se yena sava mAnuSakei hatyA karala; AvAra keu yadi kAro jIvana rakSA kare se yena sava mAnuSerai jIvana rakSA karala| AmAra rasUlagaNa to tAdera kAche spaSTa pramANa niYe esechila| tAraparao tAdera anekei pRthivIte sImAlaGghana kare caleche|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAthe yArA yuddha kare Ara pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare ver3AYa tAdera zAsti ei ye, tAderake hatyA karA have athavA zUle car3Ano have kiMvA viparIta dika theke tAdera hAta-pA keTe deoYA have athavA tAderake deza theke vahiSkAra karA have| eTA hala tAdera janya duniYAra lAJchanA| (e chAr3A) AkherAteo tAdera janya raYeche var3a rakamera zAsti|
tave yArA tomAdera kavjAYa AsAra pUrve taovA karave tArA era vyatikrama| se kSetre jene rAkhave, AllAha kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo, tA~ra naikaTyalAbhera upAYa anveSaNa karo evaM tA~ra pathe jehAda karo, yAte tomarA saphala hate pAra|

pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA sava evaM tAra sAthe Aro samaparimANa sampada yadi kApheradera haYa evaM tArA roya keYAmatera zAsti theke niSkRti pAoYAra janya egulo vinimaYa hiseve dite cAYa tavuo tAdera kAcha theke tA grahaNa karA have nA| tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti avadhArita Ache|
tArA Aguna theke vera hate cAive, kintu tArA sekhAna theke Ara vera have nA; tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI zAsti|
puruSa cora o nArI cora ubhaYera hAta keTe dAo| eTA tAdera kRtakarmera pratiphala evaM AllAhara pakSa theke eka dRSTAntamUlaka zAsti| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
kintu keu yadi anyAYa karAra para taovA kare Ara satkAja kare tAhale AllAha tAke nizcaYai kSamA kare devena| AllAha to kSamAzIla o daYAlu|
tumi ki jAna nA ye, AsamAna o jaminera Adhipatya zudhu AllAharai? tini yAke cAna zAsti dena evaM yAke cAna kSamA kare dena| AllAha savakichui karate sakSama|

he rasUla! yArA kupharira dike dhAvita haYa tAdera AcaraNe tumi yena duHkha nA pAo| edera madhye ekadala Ache yArA mukhe vale, “AmarA ImAna enechi” athaca tAdera antare ImAna nei| AvAra ihudidera madhye ekadala Ache yArA mithyA zunate AgrahI, tArA anya ekadala lokera kathAo zunache yArA tomAra kAche Aseni| orA zavdasamUhera saThika artha vikRta kare| orA (odera caradera) vale, “tomAderake yadi eTA deoYA haYa tAhale tA neve Ara yadi tA nA deoYA haYa tAhale dUre thAkave|” Asale AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa rAkhate cAna tAra janya tumi AllAhara icchAra viruddhe kichui karate pArave nA| orA hala seisava loka yAdera antara AllAha vizuddha karate cAna nA| tAdera janya pRthivIte Ache lAJchanA Ara parakAle raYeche bhaYAnaka zAsti|

tArA mithyA zunate AgrahI, hArAma khete abhyasta| tave tArA yadi tomAra kAche (vicArera janya) Ase tAhale tAdera madhye vicAra kare dio athavA tAdera dika theke mukha phiriYe nio| yadi tumi tAdera dika theke mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale tArA tomAra konai kSati karate pArave nA| Ara yadi vicAra karo tAhale tAdera madhye suvicAra karo| nizcaYai AllAha suvicArakArIdera bhAlavAsena|
tave tAdera kAche AllAhara vidhAnasamvalita tAorAta thAkate tArA tomAke vicAraka mAnave kIbhAve? era parao tArA mukha phiriYe neYa; kAraNa, tArA ImAnadAra naYa|

nizcaYai Ami pathanirdeza o Alosamvalita tAorAta nAyila karechilAma| era dvArA (AllAhara) AjJAvaha navIrA, dhArmika vyaktirA evaM yAjakerA ihudidera madhye vicArakAja sampanna karata| kAraNa, tAdera oparai AllAhara (ei) kitAva saMrakSaNera bhAra deoYA haYechila| tArA era sAkSIo chila| ataeva, tomarA mAnuSake bhaYa karo nA, varaM AmAke bhaYa karo evaM nagaNya mUlye AmAra AYAtasamUha vikri karo nA| Ara yArA AllAhara nAyilakRta vidhAna anusAre vicAra kare nA tArAi kAphera|

tAorAte Ami tAdera janya vidhivaddha karechilAma ye, prANera vadale prANa, cokhera vadale cokha, nAkera vadale nAka, kAnera vadale kAna, dA~tera vadale dA~ta evaM jakhamera vadale samAna jakhama| tave keu mApha kare dile tA tAra janya pApera prAYazcitya have| Ara yArA AllAhara nAyilakRta vidhAna anusAre vicAra kare nA tArAi jAlema|

tAdera paraparai Ami mariYama-tanaYa IsAke pAThiYechi| se chila tAra pUrvavartI kitAva tAorAtera satyAYanakArI| Ami tAke inajIla (kitAva) diYechi, yAte Ache pathanirdeza o Alo evaM yA tAra pUrvavartI kitAva tAorAtera satyAYanakArI Ara mottAkIdera janya pathanirdeza o upadeza|
inajIle AllAha ye vidhAna nAyila karechena inajIladhArIrA yena se anusAre vicAra kare| Ara yArA AllAhara nAyilakRta vidhAna anusAre vicAra kare nA tArAi phAseka|

Ami tomAra kAche yathArthai kitAva (Ala-koraAna) nAyila karechi yA tAra pUrvavartI kitAvera satyAYanakArI o tAra praharI| ataeva, AllAhara avatIrNa vidhAna anusAre tAdera madhye vicAra-mImAMsA karo Ara tomAra kAche Agata satya cher3e tAdera icchAke prazraYa dio nA| tomAdera pratyekera janya Ami ekaTi vidhAna o patha nirdhAraNa kare diYechi| AllAha cAile tomAderake ekaTimAtra jAti vAnAte pAratena, kintu (tA karenani) yAte tomAderake yA diYechena se viSaYe tomAderake parIkSA karate pArena| ataeva, tomarA pAllA diYe bhAla kAja kara| AllAhara kAchei tomAdera savAra pratyAvartana| takhana tomarA ye sava viSaYa niYe matabheda karate se samvandhe tini tomAderake avahita karavena|

Ara tumi AllAhara avatIrNa vidhAna anusAre tAdera madhye vicAra-mImAMsA karave, tAdera icchAke prazraYa deve nA evaM tAdera theke sAvadhAna thAkave yAte tArA tomAke AllAhara avatIrNa katipaYa vidhAna theke dUre sarAte nA pAre| anantara tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa (AllAhara vidhAna mAnate rAji nA haYa) tAhale jene rAkhave, AllAha tAdera kona kona pApera kAraNe tAderake zAsti dite cAna| Ara mAnuSera madhye anekei to avAdhya|
tAhale ki tArA jAhiliYAta Amalera vicAra-mImAMsA kAmanA kare? vicArera kSetre dRr3ha vizvAsIdera janya AllAhara ceYe ke bhAla?

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA ihudi o khriSTAnaderake vandhu hiseve grahaNa karo nA| tArA paraspara parasparera vandhu| tomAdera madhye keu tAdera sAthe vandhutva karale se tAderai dalabhukta have| AllAha kakhano jAlemaderake hedAYeta karena nA|

evaM yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tumi tAderake odera mAjhe chuTe yete dekhave| tArA vale, “AmAdera bhaYa haYa, nA jAni AmAdera opara kona vipada ese par3e|” tave zigagirai AllAha vijaYa athavA tA~ra pakSa theke kona nirdeza devena; takhana tArA tAdera mane yA lukiYe rAkhata sejanya anutapta have|
Ara ImAnadArarA valave, “erAi ki tArA yArA AllAhara nAme jorAlo zapatha kare valechila ye, tArA tomAdera sAthei Ache?” tAdera karmasamUha niSphala haYe giYeche; yAra phale tArA kSatigrasta haYeche|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera madhye yArA svIYa dharma tyAga karave tAdera sthale AllAha emana ekadala loka niYe Asavena yAderake tini bhAlavAsavena evaM tArAo tA~ke bhAlavAsave; tArA muminadera prati narama Ara kApheradera prati kaThora have evaM tArA AllAhara pathe jehAda karave o kona nindukera nindAYa bhIta have nA| eTA AllAhara anugraha, tini yAke icchA tA dAna karena| AllAha var3a dAnazIla, mahAjJAnI|
vastuta tomAdera vandhu hala AllAha, tA~ra rasUla Ara vizvAsIgaNa—yArA vinaYAvanata haYe nAmAya susampanna kare o yAkAta deYa|
Ara yArA AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o vizvAsIderake vandhurUpe grahaNa kare (tArAi AllAhara dala), AllAhara ei dalai vijaYI have|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera pUrvavartI kitAvadhArIdera madhye yArA tomAdera dvInake ThATTA o khelAra vastu mane kare tAderake evaM kApheraderake tomarA vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo, yadi tomarA (yathArtha) ImAnadAra hao|
tomarA yakhana nAmAyera DAka dAo takhana tArA eke ThATTA o khelAra vastu mane kare| era kAraNa, tArA nirvodha|

vala, “he kitAvadhArIrA! tomarA ki AmAdera sAthe e chAr3A anya kona kAraNe vairI AcaraNa karacha ye, AmarA AllAhara prati evaM AmAdera kAche o AmAdera pUrve ye kitAva nAyila karA haYeche tAra prati ImAna enechi, Ara tomAdera adhikAMzai (AllAhara) avAdhya?” (arthAt tomarA to zudhu e kAraNei AmAdera sAthe vairI AcaraNa karacha|)

vala, “AllAhara pakSa theke pratiphala hiseve tAra ceYeo khArApa kichu ki Ami tomAderake jAnAva?” AllAha yAderake abhizapta karechena o yAdera opara kruddha haYechena, tAdera (ihudidera) madhye yAderake vAnara o zUkara vAniYechena evaM yArA tAgUtera (bhrAnta upAsya vA zaYatAnera) upAsanA kareche, tAdera sthAna adhikatara nikRSTa evaM tArA satpatha theke adhikatara vibhrAnta|

tArA yakhana tomAdera kAche Ase takhana vale, “AmarA vizvAsa karechi”, athaca tArA avizvAsa niYe praveza karechila evaM tArA avizvAsa niYei veriYe giYeche| tArA yA gopana karata AllAha tA bhAlabhAve avahita Achena|
tumi tAdera anekake pApa, vAr3AvAr3i o hArAma khAoYAYa tatpara dekhave| tArA yA karache Asale tA khuvai khArApa|
(tAdera) dhArmika vyaktirA o yAjakerA kena tAderake pApera kathA valate o hArAma khete niSedha kare nA? tArA yA karache Asale tA khuvai khArApa|

ihudirA vale, “AllAhara hAta vaddha (tini vyaYa karachena nA)|” e kathA valAra kAraNe tAdera hAtai vaddha hoka evaM tArA abhizapta hoka! varaM tA~ra (kudaratI) dui hAta prasArita (mukta)| tini yebhAve icchA vyaYa karena| tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche nizcaYai tA tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o avizvAsa vAr3iYe deve| Ami keYAmata paryanta tAdera madhye zatrutA o vidveSa saJcArita karechi| tArA yakhanai yuddhera Aguna jvAliYeche AllAha takhanai tA nibhiYe diYechena| tArA pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare ver3AYa; Ara AllAha azAnti sRSTikArIdera bhAlavAsena nA|
kitAvIrA yadi ImAna Anata o tAkaoYA avalamvana karata tAhale Ami tAdera pApasamUha mArjanA kare ditAma evaM tAderake sukhera vAgAne (vehezate) praveza karAtAma|

tArA yadi tAorAta o inajIla evaM tAdera kAche tAdera prabhura pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche tA (Ala-koraAna) saThikabhAve mene calata tAhale tArA tAdera opara theke evaM tAdera pAYera nica theke khAdyera yogAna peta| tAdera madhye kichu loka Ache satpathera anusArI| tave tAdera anekei khArApa kAja kare|

he rasUla! tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche tA pracAra kara| yadi tumi tA nA karo tAhale to tumi tA~ra vArtA pau~che dile nA| AllAha tomAke mAnuSa theke rakSA karavena| AllAha to kApheraderake patha dekhAna nA|

vala, “he kitAvIrA! yatakSaNa nA tomarA tAorAta o inajIla evaM tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche tA (Ala-koraAna) saThikabhAve mene calave tatakSaNa tomarA kona pathei nei|” tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche nizcaYai tA tAdera anekera avAdhyatA o avizvAsa vAr3iYe deve| ataeva, avizvAsIdera janya duHkha karo nA|
musalamAna, ihudi, chAviYI, khriSTAna edera madhye yArA AllAha o parakAla vizvAsa kareche evaM satkAja kareche tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|

Ami vanI isarAIlera kAcha theke pratijJA niYechilAma evaM tAdera kAche aneka rasUla pAThiYechilAma| (tave) yakhanai kona rasUla tAdera kAche emana viSaYa niYe Asata yA tAdera manaHpUta hata nA takhanai tArA (tAdera) katakake mithyuka valata AvAra katakake hatyA karata|

tArA mane karechila ye, (tAdera) kona zAsti have nA| tAi tArA andha o vadhira haYechila| tArapara AllAha tAderake kSamA karechilena| (kintu) punarAYa tAdera madhye aneke andha o vadhira hala| tArA yA kare AllAha tA dekhate pAna|

yArA vale, “AllAha halena mariYamera putra masIha” tArA nizcaYai kAphera haYe giYeche| athaca masIha valechena, “he vanI isarAIla! tomarA AllAhara evAdata karo yini AmAra prabhu evaM tomAderao prabhu|” ye AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare AllAha tAra janya jAnnAta hArAma kare diYechena| tAi jAhAnnAmai tAra vAsasthAna| Ara jAlemadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

yArA vale, “AllAha halena tinajanera tRtIYajana” tArA nizcaYai kAphera haYe giYeche| athaca eka upAsya chAr3A (anya) kona upAsya nei| tArA yadi tAdera e dharanera kathA vandha nA kare tAhale tAdera kApheradera opara yantraNAdAYaka zAsti Asavei|
tave ki tArA AllAhara dike phire Asave nA kiMvA tA~ra kAche kSamA cAive nA? AllAha to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

mariYamaputra masIha ekajana rasUlamAtra| tAra Ageo aneka rasUla cale giYeche| Ara tAra mA ekajana satyaniSTha mahilA| tArA dujanei khAvAra kheta| dekha, kIbhAve Ami odera janya nidarzanasamUha varNanA karachi| tArapara dekha, orA kIbhAve (satya theke) vicyuta hacche|
vala, “tomarA ki AllAha vyatIta emana kichura ivAdata karo yA tomAdera kona kSati kiMvA upakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA? varaM AllAhai savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|”

vala, “he kitAvadhArIrA! tomarA tomAdera dharmera vyApAre vAr3AvAr3i karo nA—yA Thika naYa—evaM emana lokadera icchAnusAre kAja karo nA yArA itipUrve nijerA vipathagAmI haYeche, anekake vipathagAmI kareche evaM saThika patha theke vicyuta haYeche|”
vanI isarAIlera kApherarA tAdera avAdhyatA o sImAlaMghanera kAraNe dAUda o mariYamaputra IsA kartRka abhizapta haYechila| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA avAdhyatA karata evaM tArA sImAlaMghana karata|
tArA ye nikRSTa kAja karata tA theke eke aparake vAraNa karata nA| tArA yA karata tA avazyai khArApa|

tumi tAdera anekake kApheradera sAthe vandhutva karate dekhave| tArA nijedera janya yA saJcaYa kareche tA avazyai khArApa! ye kAraNe AllAha tAdera opara kruddha haYechena evaM tArA cirakAla AyAvera madhye thAkave|
yadi tArA AllAhara prati, navIra prati o tAra nikaTa avatIrNa viSaYera prati (yathArtha) ImAna Anata tAhale tAderake (kApheraderake) vandhurUpe grahaNa karata nA| kintu tAdera madhye anekei pApAcArI|

tumi avazyai dekhate pAve ye, muminadera janya kaThoratara zatrutA poSaNakArI mAnuSa hacche ihudi o muzarikarA; evaM tAdera janya ghaniSThatara hRdyatA poSaNakArI mAnuSa hacche tArA yArA vale “AmarA khriSTAna”| era kAraNa, edera madhye purohita o pAdrIrA raYeche evaM tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|

(yArA nijederake khriSTAna vale) tArA yakhana rasUlera kAche nAyilakRta vANI zone takhana tumi dekhate pAo, tArA ye satya cinate pereche tAra kAraNe tAdera cokha azrupUrNa haYe oThe| tArA vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA vizvAsa karechi, ataeva, AmAderake sAkSIdera tAlikAbhukta kare nAo|”
“kena AmarA AllAhake o AmAdera kAche Agata satyake vizvAsa karava nA evaM AzA karava nA ye, AmAdera prabhu AmAderake bhAla lokadera saGge (jAnnAte) praveza karAna?”
tAdera ei kathAra pratidAnasvarUpa AllAha tAderake jAnnAta dAna karavena yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita have, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTA satkarmazIla-dera pratidAna|
Ara yArA avizvAsa kareche Ara AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA valeche tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI have|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera janya AllAha ye sava utkRSTa vastu hAlAla karechena tomarA tA hArAma karo nA evaM sImAlaMghana karo nA| AllAha sImAlaMghanakArIderake bhAlavAsena nA|
tomarA AllAhara deoYA hAlAla o pavitra jinisa khAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAke tomarA vizvAsa kara|

tomAdera bhula zapathera janya AllAha tomAderake zAsti devena nA; tave icchAkRta zapatha (kare tA bhaGga) karale tini tomAderake zAsti devena| zapathabhaGgera kAphaphArAra (pApa skhAlanera) janya tomarA tomAdera parivAra-parijanake ye dharanera khAvAra dAo tAra madhyama mAne dazajana misakInake khAvAra deve, athavA tAderake vastradAna karave kiMvA ekajana krItadAsa mukta kare deve| keu era konaTi nA pArale se tinadina royA rAkhave| tomarA kakhano zapatha karale eTAi tomAdera zapathera kAphaphArA| tomarA tomAdera zapatha rakSA karave| ebhAvei AllAha tA~ra vidhAnasamUha tomAdera janya spaSTa kare dena, yAte tomarA kRtajJa hao|
he ImAnadAragaNa! mada, juYA, mUrti, bhAgya nirNaYera tIra egulo vastuta zaYatAnera eka ekaTi ghRNya kAja; ataeva, esava theke dUre thAka, yAte tomarA saphala hate pAra|

vastuta mada o juYAra mAdhyame zaYatAna cAYa tomAdera parasparera madhye zatrutA o vidveSa sRSTi karate evaM tomAderake AllAhara smaraNa o nAmAya theke virata rAkhate| ataeva, tomarA ki (esava) chAr3ave?
tomarA AllAha o rasUlera anugata hao Ara sAvadhAna thAka| yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale jene rAkhave, pariSkArabhAve (vArtA) pau~che deoYAi AmAra rasUlera kAja|

yArA vizvAsa kare o satkAja kare tArA pUrve yA kheYeche tAte tAdera kona pApa nei, yadi tArA AllAhake bhaYa kare, vizvAsa kare evaM satkAja kare; AvAra AllAhake bhaYa kare o vizvAsa kare; AvAra AllAhake bhaYa kare o satkAja kare| AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera hAta o varzAra nAgAlera madhyera kichu zikArera prANI dvArA AllAha tomAderake parIkSA karavena; yAte tini vujhate pArena, ke tA~ke nA dekheo bhaYa kare| erapara ye sImAlaMghana karave tAra janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA eharAma avasthAYa zikAra vadha karo nA| tomAdera madhye ye icchAkRtabhAve tA vadha karave tAke tAra kSatipUraNasvarUpa vadhakRta jantura anurUpa ekaTi pazu— yA tomAdera dujana nyAYavAna vyakti Thika kare deve— kAvAYa koravAni hiseve pau~chAte have; athavA misakIna khAoYAnora kAphaphArA dite have; kiMvA tAra samaparimANa royA rAkhate have; yAte se tAra kRtakarmera zAsti AsvAdana kare| Age yA giYeche AllAha tA mApha kare diYechena; kintu ye AvAra e kAja karave AllAha tAke zAsti devena| AllAha parAkrAnta, pratizodha grahaNakArI|

tomAdera janya sAmudrika prANI zikAra karA o tA khAoYA hAlAla karA haYeche tomAdera o paryaTakadera suvidhAra janya; tave yatakSaNa tomarA eharAmarata thAkave tatakSaNa tomAdera janya sthalera zikAra hArAma karA haYeche| AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAra kAche tomAderake ekatrita karA have|

AllAha pavitra ghara kAvAke mAnuSera karmacAJcalyera kendra karechena evaM pavitra mAsa, koravAnira pazu o galAYa mAlA-parAno pazuke tAdera kalyANera janya nirdhArita karechena; tA e janya ye, tomarA yena jAnate pAra, AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache AllAha tA jAnena evaM tini savakichui bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|
jene rAkha ye, AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA evaM eTAo jene rAkha ye,AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
rasUlera dAYitva to kevala (vArtA) pau~che deoYA| Ara tomarA yA prakAza karo evaM yA gopana karo AllAha tA jAnena|
vala, “mandera Adhikya tomAke camatkRta karaleo manda Ara bhAla samAna naYa| ataeva, he vuddhimAnerA! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAte tomarA saphala hao|”

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA emanasava jinisa samvandhe prazna karo nA yA tomAdera kAche spaSTa karA hale tomAdera khArApa lAgave| yadi koraAna avataraNakAle tomarA erakama prazna karo tAhale tomAdera kAche tA spaSTa karA have| (pechane yA haYeche) AllAha tA mApha kare diYechena| AllAha kSamAparAYaNa, sahanazIla|
tomAdera pUrve ekaTi samapradAYa erakama prazna karechila| tArapara e kAraNei tArA avizvAsI haYechila|
vAhIrAha, sAJcaivAha, oYAchIlAha kiMvA hAma era konaTAi AllAha Thika kare denani; varaM kApherarA AllAhara opara mithyA Aropa kare; Ara tAdera adhikAMzai vojhe nA|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “AllAha yA nAyila karechena tomarA tAra dike evaM rasUlera dike eso” takhana tArA vale, “AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAderake ye pathe peYechi AmAdera janya tAi yatheSTa|” tAdera vApa-dAdArA kichu nA vujhe thAkaleo evaM saThika pathe nA cale thAkaleo ki (tArA tAdera pathe calave)?

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA nijedera kathA bhAva| tomarA yadi saThika pathe cala tAhale vipathagAmIrA tomAdera kSati karate pArave nA| AllAhara kAchei tomAdera sakalake phire yete have| takhana tini tomAderake tomarA yA karate tA avahita karavena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! yakhana tomAdera madhye kAro mRtyu upasthita haYa takhana asiYatakAle tomAdera madhya theke dujana nyAYaparAYaNa lokake sAkSI rAkhave| athavA tomarA saphare thAkale evaM se avasthAYa tomAdera mRtyura vipada ese par3ale tomAdera chAr3A anyadera madhya theke dujana sAkSI rAkhate pAra| yadi (sAkSIdera satatA samparke) tomAdera sandeha haYa tAhale sAkSIdvaYake nAmAyera para dhare rAkhave evaM tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave, “AtmIYa haleo AmarA era vinimaYe kona mUlya (pArthiva suvidhA) neva nA evaM AmarA AllAhara sAkSya gopana karava nA; tA karale avazyai AmarA pApIdera antarbhukta hava|”

ataHpara yadi jAnA yAYa ye, tArA dujana kona aparAdha kareche tAhale yAdera viruddhe aparAdha haYeche tAdera madhya theke dujana nikaTatara AtmIYa tAdera sthalAbhiSikta have| tArapara tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave, “nizcaYai AmAdera sAkSya tAdera sAkSyera ceYe vezi satya| Ara AmarA (satyera) anyathA karini; tA karale avazyai AmarA jAlemadera antarbhukta hava|”

etei adhikatara sambhAvanA Ache ye, tArA saThikabhAve sAkSya deve athavA tAdera zapathera para AvAra zapatha neoYAra AzaGkA karave| AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM (tA~ra kathA) zona| AllAha phAsekaderake patha pradarzana karena nA|

(smaraNa karo) yedina AllAha rasUladerake ekatra kare valavena, “tomarA (mAnuSera kAcha theke tomAdera AhavAnera) kI javAva peYechile?” tArA valave, “AmAdera kichu jAnA nei; tumii to adRzya viSaYa bhAla jAna|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana (keYAmatera dina) AllAha valavena, “he mariYamaputra IsA! tomAra prati o tomAra mAYera prati AmAra anugrahera kathA mane karo, yakhana Ami pavitra AtmA (jivarAIla) dvArA tomAke dolanAYa thAkA avasthAYa o pariNata vaYase mAnuSera sAthe kathA valate sAhAyya karechilAma; yakhana tomAke kitAva, prajJA, tAorAta o inajIla zikSA diYechilAma; yakhana tumi AmAra Adeze kAdAmATi dvArA pAkhira AkRti vAniYe tAte phu~ dite, phale tA AmAra hukume pAkhi haYe yeta Ara tumi AmAra hukume janmAndha o kuSTharogIke sustha kare dite; yakhana tumi AmAra hukume mRtaderake (jIvita) vera kare Anate evaM yakhana Ami tomAke hatyA karA theke vanI isarAIlake nivRtta rekhechilAma, yakhana tumi tAdera kAche nidarzana niYe ele tAdera madhye avizvAsIrA valechila, jJaeto spaSTa yAdu chAr3A kichu naYaJca|”

Ara (smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami hAoYArIderake (IsAra ziSyaderake) nirdeza diYechilAma ye, tomarA AmAke o AmAra rasUlake vizvAsa karo; tArA valechila, “AmarA vizvAsa karalAma evaM tumi sAkSI thAka ye, AmarA musalima (anugata)|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana hAoYArIrA valechila, “he mariYamaputra IsA! tomAra prabhu ki AmAdera janya AsamAna theke kichu khAdya pAThAte pArena?” se (IsA) valechila, “tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo, yadi tomarA (satyai) vizvAsI hao|”
tArA valechila, “AmarA cAcchi, AmAdera antarera prazAntira janya kichu khAvAra khAva Ara jAnava ye, tumi AmAdera kAche satya valecho evaM AmarA tAra sAkSI hava|”

mariYamaputra IsA valechila, “he AmAdera prabhu! tumi AmAdera janya AsamAna theke kichu khAdya pAThAo, yA AmAdera janya— AmAdera prathama o zeSa savAra janya— have ekaTi utsavera vyApAra evaM tomAra pakSa theke ekaTi nidarzana| Ara AmAderake riyika dAna karo; tumi to zreSTha riyikadAtA”
AllAha valechilena, “hyA~, Ami tomAdera janya tA pAThAva, kintu tArapara tomAdera madhye ye avizvAsa karave tAke Ami emana (bhaYAnaka) zAsti deva yA sArA pRthivIra Ara kAuke deva nA|”

Ara (smaraNa karo) yakhana (hAzarera dina) AllAha valavena, “he mariYamaputra IsA! tumi ki mAnuSake valechile ye, AllAhake cher3e tomarA AmAke o AmAra mAke upAsya vAnAo?” se valave, “mahimA tomAra! AmAra yA valAra adhikAra nei Ami to tA valate pAri nA| Ami yadi amana kathA valatAma tAhale tumi tA avazyai jAnate| AmAra mane ki Ache tumi tA jAna, Ara tomAra mane ki Ache Ami tA jAni nA| adRzya viSaYAdi samparke to ekamAtra tumii samyaka avagata|”

“tumi AmAke yA (valate) Adeza diYechile Ami tAderake zudhu tAi valechi| tA hala, jJatomarA AmAra prabhu o tomAdera prabhu AllAhara evAdata kara|Jca Ara Ami yatadina tAdera mAjhe chilAma tatadinai tAdera karmakANDa avagata chilAma| tArapara tumi yakhana AmAke lokAntarita karecho takhana theke to tumii tAdera paryavekSaka chile| Ara tumi savakichui avagata Acho|”
“tumi yadi tAderake zAsti dAo dite pAra, kAraNa tArA tomArai vAndA; Ara yadi tAderake kSamA kare dAo tAo pAra, kAraNa tumi to parAkramazAlI, parama prAjJa|”

AllAha valavena, “Ajakera dine satyavAdIrA tAdera satyavAditAra upakAra (puraskAra) pAve|” tAdera janya emanasava udyAna (jAnnAta) raYeche yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita| sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa evaM tArAo AllAhara prati santuSTa| eTAi var3a saphalatA|
AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhye yA kichu Ache tAra Adhipatya AllAharai| evaM tini savakichu karate sakSama|
sava prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena evaM andhakAra o Alora udbhava ghaTiYechena| tAraparao avizvAsIrA tAdera prabhura sAthe samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa|
tini sei sattA yini tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena evaM tArapara ekaTi samaYa nirdhAraNa karechena| ArekaTi nirdhArita samaYa tA~ra kAche Ache| tAraparao tomarA sandeha kara|
Ara AsamAna o jamine tinii AllAha| tini tomAdera gopana o prakAzya viSaYa jAnena; tomarA yA kichu upArjana karo tini tAo jAnena|
tAdera (avizvAsIdera) kAche tAdera prabhura pakSa theke kona nidarzana elei tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
ataeva, satya yakhana tAdera kAche eseche tArA tAke avalIlAYa mithyA valeche| tave tArA yA niYe ThATTA karata tAdera kAche acirei tAra saMvAda Asave|

tArA ki dekheni Ami tAdera pUrve kata prajanmake dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yAderake Ami ei pRthivIte emanabhAve pratiSThita karechilAma yemanaTi tomAderakeo karini? Ara Ami tAdera opara AkAza theke pracura vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma o tAdera nica diYe nadI pravAhita karechilAma| ataHpara tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe dhvaMsa kare diYechi evaM tAdera pare anyAnya prajanma sRSTi karechi|
Ara Ami yadi tomAra kAche kAgaje likhita kona kitAvao nAyila karatAma evaM tArA tA nijedera hAta dvArA sparza kare dekhata tavuo avizvAsIrA valata, “eTA prakAzya yAdu vai kichu naYa|”
tArA eo valeche, “tA~ra kAche kona pherezatA pAThAno hala nA kena?” Ami yadi kona pherezatAi pAThAtAma tAhale viSaYaTi takhanai niSpatti haYe yeta evaM tAderake kona avakAza deoYA hata nA|
Ara yadi kona pherezatAke rasUla karatAma tAhale tAke to mAnuSera AkRtitei pAThAtAma evaM tAderake sei sandehei phelatAma ye sandeha tArA ekhana karache|
tomAra pUrveo rasUladerake upahAsa karA haYeche| tave yArA tAderake upahAsa kareche tAdera upahAsera pariNati tAdera oparai Apatita haYeche|
vala, “tomarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekha, yArA satyake pratyAkhyAna karechila tAdera kemana pariNati haYechila|”

vala, “AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tA kAra?” (tumii) vale dAo, “(sava) AllAharai”| anugraha karAke tini nijera kartavya kare niYechena| tini tomAderake keYAmatera dina avazyai ekatrita karavena, ete kona sandeha nei| yArA nijerA nijedera kSati kareche tArA vizvAsa karave nA|
rAte o dine yA kichu thAke tA tA~rai| tinii savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

vala, “Ami ki AsamAna-jaminera sraSTA AllAha chAr3A kAuke abhibhAvaka vAnAva? athaca tinii khAdya dAna karena, tA~ke keu khAdya deYa nA|” vala, “AmAke to (AllAhara kAche) prathama AtmasamarpaNakArI vyakti hate Adeza deoYA haYeche|” Ara tumi kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
vala, “Ami eka bhaYAnaka dinera zAstike bhaYa kari, yadi AmAra prabhura avAdhyatA kari|”
sedina yAke zAsti theke dUre rAkhA have tAke avazyai tini anugraha karalena| Ara seTAi have spaSTa (yathArtha) saphalatA|
AllAha yadi tomAke kona kaSTa dena tAhale tini chAr3A keu tA dUra karate pAre nA| Ara tini yadi tomAra kona kalyANa karate cAna (tAo karate pArena, kAraNa) tini savakichui karate sakSama|
tini tA~ra vAndAdera opara pravala parAkramazAlI| Ara tinii prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|

vala, “kon‌ jinisa savaceYe var3a sAkSI?” vala, “AllAha, tinii AmAra o tomAdera mAjhe sAkSI| Ara AmAra kAche ei koraAna pAThAno haYeche yAte Ami era sAhAyye tomAderake evaM yAdera paryanta tA pau~che tAderake satarka karate pAri| tomarA ki sAkSya dAo ye, AllAhara sAthe anyAnya upAsyao Ache?” vala, “Ami (amana) sAkSya dei nA|” vala, “tinii ekamAtra upAsya| Ara tomarA (AllAhara sAthe) yA kichu zarIka karo tAra sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei|”
Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA (ihudi o khriSTAnarA) tA~ke (muhAmmadake) cene, yemana tArA nijedera chelederake cene| yArA nijerA nijedera kSati kareche tArA vizvAsa karave nA|
ye vyakti AllAhara nAme mithyA vAniYe vale athavA tA~ra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale tAra ceYe var3a jAlema ke hate pAre? jAlemarA kakhanao saphala haYa nA|
(smaraNa karo) yedina Ami tAdera sakalake ekatrita karava, tArapara muzarikadera valava, “kothAYa tomAdera managar3A zarIkarA?”
takhana tAdera kona ajuhAta thAkave nA; zudhu valave, “AmAdera prabhu AllAhara kasama! AmarA muzarika chilAma nA|”
lakSya karo, kIbhAve tArA nijedera janya kSatikara mithyA valeche, Ara tArA vAniYe vAniYe yA valata tA (kIbhAve) tAdera theke udhAo haYe giYeche!

tAdera madhye kichu loka Ache yArA tomAra kathA kAna pete zone, tave Ami tAdera antare AvaraNa diYe rekhechi, ye janya tArA tA vujhate pAre nA, Ara tAdera kAne diYechi vadhiratA| yadi tArA pratiTi nidarzana dekhe tavuo tArA tA vizvAsa karave nA| emanaki tArA yakhana vitarka karAra janya tomAra kAche Ase takhana ei kApherarA vale, “e to dekhachi Agera dinera mAnuSera kesasA-kAhini chAr3A Ara kichu naYa|”
tArA tA~ra (anusaraNa) theke (anyadera) virata rAkhe evaM (nijerA) tA~ra theke dUre thAke| (ebhAve) tArA nijederai dhvaMsa Deke Ane, kintu tA upalavdhi kare nA|

yakhana tAderake (doyakhera) Agunera sAmane dA~r3a karAno have takhana tumi yadi dekhate! tArA takhana valave, “hAYare AmAderake yadi AvAra (duniYAYa) pAThAno hata! tAhale AmarA AmAdera prabhura nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karatAma nA evaM AmarA ImAnadAra haYe yetAma|”

(tAdera ei kathA Thika naYa) varaM tArA Age yA gopana karata tAdera sAmane tA prakAza haYe par3eche| Ara tAderake yadi AvAra (duniYAYa) pAThAno hata tAhale tArA punarAYa tAi karata yA tAderake niSedha karA haYechila| nizcaYai tArA mithyAvAdI|
tArA vale, “AmAdera e duniYAra jIvana chAr3A Ara kona jIvana nei evaM (mRtyura para) AmAderake punarAYa uThAno have nA|”

yakhana tAderake tAdera prabhura sAmane dA~r3a karAno have takhana tumi yadi dekhate! tini takhana valavena, “eTA ki satya naYa?” tArA valave, “hyA~, AmAdera prabhura zapatha!” tini takhana valavena, “tAhale tomarA zAstira svAda grahaNa karo, kAraNa tomarA (eTA) avizvAsa karate|”

yArA AllAhara sAthe sAkSAtke mithyA valechila tArA kSatigrasta haYeche| avazeSe yakhana tAdera kAche akasmAt keYAmata ese yAve takhana tArA valave, “hAYa Aphasosa, ei vyApAraTite AmarA var3a avahelA karechilAma!” takhana tArA tAdera (pApera) vojhA nijedera piThe vahana karave| jene rAkha, tArA yA vahana karave tA khuvai khArApa|
ei duniYAra jIvana khelA o Amoda-pramoda chAr3A kichu naYa| tave yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare tAdera janya AkherAtera AvAsa aneka bhAla| tomarA ki vojha nA?
Ami to jAni, tAdera kathAYa tumi avazyai duHkha pAo| tave tArA to (zudhu) tomAke avizvAsa kare nA, varaM (ei) jAlemarA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIkei asvIkAra kare|

tomAra Ageo rasUladerake avizvAsa karA haYeche| tAderake avizvAsa karA o kaSTa deoYA sattveo tArA dhairyadhAraNa karechila; yatakSaNa nA tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya Ase| AllAhara kathA (siddhAnta) keu parivartana karate pAre nA| Ara rasUladera kichu saMvAda (tathya) tomAra kAche pau~cheche|

tAdera vimukhatA yadi tomAra kAche kaSTakara haYa tAhale pArale tumi bhUgarbhe yAoYAra ekaTi sur3aGga athavA AsamAne oThAra ekaTi si~r3i anusandhAna kare (sekhAna theke) tAdera janya kona nidarzana niYe Asa| (kintu tA yehetu pAracha nA tAi dhairyadhAraNa kara|) AllAha icchA karale tAderake saThika pathe samaveta karate pAratena| (kintu tini tA cAna ni|) ataeva, tumi mUrkhadera antarbhukta haYo nA (mUrkhadera mata cintA karo nA)|
vastuta yArA (mana diYe) zone tArAi sAr3A deYa| Ara yArA mRta tAderake AllAha punarjIvita karavena| tArapara tAderake tA~ra dikei phiriYe neYA have|
tArA valeche, “tAra prabhura pakSa theke tAra kAche kona nidarzana pAThAno haYani kena?” vala, “avazyai AllAha nidarzana pAThAte sakSama, tave tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|”

pRthivIte calamAna pratiTi prANI evaM nijera dui DAnA diYe uDDaYamAna pratiTi pAkhi tomAdera matai eka ekaTi jAti| Ami kitAve kona kichui (ullekha karate) avahelA karini| pare sakalake tAdera prabhura kAche ekatra karA have|
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare tArA andhakArera madhye vadhira o vovA| AllAha yAke cAna vipathagAmI karena evaM yAke cAna saThika pathe rAkhena|
vala, “tomarA vala dekhi, tomAdera opara yadi AllAhara AjAva Ase athavA tomAdera kAche keYAmata ese par3e tAhale ki tomarA AllAha chAr3A anya kAuke DAkave? (vala,) yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|”
varaM (kona vipada ele) tomarA to tA~kei DAka evaM ye kaSTera janya tA~ke DAka tini icchA karale tA dUra kare dena; Ara tomarA yAderake (tA~ra) zarIka karo, tAdera kathA takhana bhule yAo|
Ami tomAra pUrve aneka jAtira kAche rasUla pAThiYechilAma evaM yAte tArA vinaYAvanata haYa sejanya tAderake duHkha-durdazAYa nipatita karechilAma|

tAdera kAche yakhana AmAra zAsti esechila takhana tArA vinaYAvata haYani kena? varaM tAdera antara kaThina haYechila evaM tArA yA karachila zaYatAnera dAgAYa tAdera kAche tA bhAla kAja mane haYechila|

tAderake yA smaraNa kariYe deoYA haYechila tArA yakhana tA bhule gela takhana Ami tAdera sAmane pratiTi (Anandera) jinisera darajA khule dilAma| ebhAve tAderake yA deoYA haYechila tArA yakhana tA niYe Anandita, takhana Ami akasmAt tAderake pAkar3Ao kari| takhanai tArA nirAza haYe yAYa|
ataHpara ye lokerA anyAYa karechila tAdera zikar3a keTe deoYA haYa| Ara sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini nikhila jagatera prabhu|

vala, “tomarA vala dekhi, AllAha yadi tomAdera zravaNazakti o dRSTizakti ker3e nena evaM tomAdera antarasamUha sIla kare dena tAhale AllAha chAr3A ke emana upAsya Ache ye tomAderake egulo ene dite pAre?” dekha, kIbhAve Ami pramANasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA kari; tAraparao tArA anyadike phire yAYa|
vala, “tomarA vala dekhi, yadi tomAdera opara haThAt kiMvA prakAzye AllAhara AjAva Ase tAhale jAlemarA chAr3A Ara keu ki dhvaMsa have?”
Ami susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hisevei rasUladera pAThAi| ataeva, yArA vizvAsa kare Ara satkAja kare tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNei tAdera opara zAsti Asave|

vala, “Ami tomAderake vali nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara dhanabhANDAra Ache| Ami adRzya viSaYao jAni nA| Ami tomAderake emana kathAo vali nA ye, Ami ekajana pherezatA| Ami zudhu AmAra kAche ye pratyAdeza pAThAno haYa tAi mene cali|” vala, “andha Ara dRSTisampanna mAnuSa ki samAna haYa? tomarA ki tAhale cintA karo nA?”

ei koraAna dvArA tumi seisava lokaderake satarka karave yAdera mane ei bhaYa Ache ye, tAderake tAdera prabhura kAche ekatra karA have, yini chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA supArizakArI nei; yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare|

Ara seisava lokaderake tAr3iYe dio nA yArA tAdera prabhuke pAoYAra janya sakAla-sandhyAYa tA~ke DAke| tomAra opara tAdera javAvadihira kona dAYabhAra nei evaM tAdera oparao tomAra javAvadihira kona dAYabhAra nei| ataeva, tAderake tAr3Ave kena? eTA karale tumi jAlemadera antarbhukta have|

ebhAvei Ami ekadalake Arekadala dvArA parIkSA karechi; kenanA tArA valate pArata, “AllAha ki AmAdera madhya theke ederakei anugraha karalena?” kRtajJadera samparke AllAhai ki savaceYe vezi avagata nana?

yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhe vizvAsa kare tArA tomAra kAche ele tumi valave, “tomAdera opara zAnti varSita hoka!” tomAdera prabhu anugraha karAke nijera kartavya vale sthira karechena| (tAi) tomAdera madhye keu yadi ajJatAvazata kona khArApa kAja kare evaM tArapara taovA kare o satkAja kare tAhale nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
emanibhAve Ami nidarzanasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA kari, yAte aparAdhIdera pathao spaSTa haYe yAYa|

vala, “AllAhake chAr3A tomarA yAderake DAka tAdera upAsanA karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche|” vala, “Ami tomAdera icchAmata cali nA| tAhale to Ami vipathagAmI haYe yAva evaM satpathaprAptadera antarbhukta thAkava nA|”

vala, “AmAra kAche AmAra prabhura pakSa theke AsA ekaTi spaSTa pramANa Ache, tave tomarA tAke mithyA valecho| tomarA yA tAr3AtAr3i pete cAo AmAra kAche tA nei| kartRtva ekamAtra AllAhara| tini satya varNanA karena evaM tinii zreSTha vicAraka|”
vala, “tomarA yA tAr3AtAr3i pete cAo tA yadi AmAra kAche thAkato tAhale AmAra o tomAdera mAjhe vyApAraTi to miTei yeto| AllAha jAlemadera samparke bhAlabhAve avahita|”

yAvatIYa adRzya viSaYera cAvi tA~ra kAche| tini chAr3A keu tA jAne nA| sthale o jale yA kichu Ache savai tini jAnena| (gAcha theke) ye pAtATi par3e tAo tA~ra jAnA Ache| AvAra bhUmira andhakAre ye zasyadAnATi kiMvA ye Ardra vA zuSka vastuTi Ache tAo ekaTi spaSTa granthe likhita raYeche|

tinii rAtrikAle tomAderake prANahIna (nidrAYa acetana) karena| Ara (pUrvavartI) dine tomarA yA kichu karecho tAo tini jAnena| ataHpara (paravartI) dine tini AvAra tomAderake jAgrata karena, yAte ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda (jIvanakAla) pUrNa haYa| tArapara tA~rai kAche tomAdera pratyAvartana (nirdhArita)| ataHpara (pRthivIte) tomarA yA kichu karachile tini tomAderake tA avahita karavena|

tini tA~ra vAndAdera opara parAkramazAlI| tini tomAdera janya rakSakadera (tattvAvadhAYaka pherezatAdera) pAThAna| avazeSe yakhana tomAdera kAro mRtyu hAjira haYa takhana AmAra dUterA (mRtyura pherezatArA) tAra mRtyu ghaTAYa, evaM tArA (tAdera kAje) kona truTi kare nA|
ataHpara tAderake tAdera satya prabhu AllAhara kAche phiriYe neoYA have| jene rAkha, vicAra-kSamatA tA~rai, evaM tinii drutatama hisAvagrahaNakArI|

vala, “ke tomAderake sthalera o jalera andhakAra (vipada) theke uddhAra kare? (vipada ele) tomarAi to tA~ke (AllAhake) minati kare o gopane DAka (Ara vala): tini yadi ei vipada theke AmAdera uddhAra karena tAhale AmarA avazyai cirakRtajJa thAkava|”
vala, “AllAhai tomAderake se vipada theke evaM sakala duHkha-kaSTa theke uddhAra karena| tAraparao tomarA zir‌ka kara|”

vala, “tomAdera oparera dika theke athavA tomAdera pAYera nica theke tomAdera opara AjAva pAThAte kiMvA tomAderake vibhinna dala-upadale miliYe phele ekadalake Arekadalera zaktimattAra svAda grahaNa karAte tinii sakSama|” lakSya karo, kIbhAve Ami AYAtasamUha nAnAbhAve vujhiYe dicchi, yAte tArA vujhate pAre|
Ara tomAra lokerA to eke (AjAvake athavA koraAnake) mithyA valeche; athaca tA satya| vala, “Ami tomAdera kAryanirvAhI nai|”
pratyeka saMvAderai ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa raYeche; evaM samaYa halei tomarA jAnave|

Ara yakhana tumi AmAra AYAtasamUha niYe vAje AlocanAYa rata lokaderake dekhave takhana tumi tAdera theke sare thAkave; yatakSaNa nA tArA anya viSaYera AlocanAYa phire yAYa| Ara yadi zaYatAna tomAke bhuliYe deYa tAhale smaraNa haoYAra para tumi kichutei jAlema lokadera sAthe vasave nA|
tAdera (jAlemadera) javAvadihira kona dAYabhAra tAkaoYA avalamvanakArIdera (muminadera) opara nei; tave tArA smaraNa kariYe dite pAre, yAte tArA AllAhake bhaYa kare|

yArA nijedera dharmake khelA o kautukarUpe grahaNa kare evaM ei duniYAra jIvana yAderake dho~kAYa phele rekheche tumi tAdera kathA cher3e dAo| Ara ei koraAna dvArA (tAderake) smaraNa kariYe dAo ye, (vicArera dine) ye keu nijera kRtakarmera kAraNe ATakA par3e yete pAre; takhana AllAha vyatIta tAra kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA supArizakArI thAkave nA evaM savarakama muktipaNa dileo tAra kAcha theke tA grahaNa karA have nA| orAi nijedera kRtakarmera kAraNe ATakA par3e yAve| tAdera kupharira kAraNei tAdera janya thAkave garama pAnira zaravata o yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

vala, “AmarA ki AllAhake vAda diYe emana kichura upAsanA karava yA AmAdera upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAre nA? Ara AllAha AmAderake saThika patha dekhAnora para AmarA ki AvAra pechane ghure yAva? yemana ekaTi loka yAke zaYatAnerA vibhrAnta kare pRthivIte dizehArA kareche Ara tAra katipaYa saGgI tAke saThika pathera dike Deke valache: AmAdera dike esa|” vala, “AllAhara pathai ekamAtra patha; Ara AmAderake sArA jAhAnera prabhu AllAhara kAche AtmasamarpaNa karAra nirdeza deoYA haYeche|”
ei nirdezao deoYA haYeche ye, tomarA nAmAya kAYema karave o tA~ke bhaYa karave| Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake ekatrita karA have|

tinii yathArthabhAve AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena| yedina tini valavena, “(keYAmata) hao” takhanai tA haYe yAve| tA~ra kathAi Thika| yedina ziGgAYa phu~ deoYA have sedina rAjatva have tA~rai| tini adRzya o dRzyamAna viSaYa avagata Achena| tinii prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana ivarAhIma tAra vAvA Ayarake valechila, “(vAvA!) tumi ki mUrtiguloke upAsya mane karo? Ami to dekhachi tumi o tomAra samapradAYa spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye raYecho|”
Ara ebhAvei Ami ivarAhImake AsamAna o jaminera rAjatva dekhAte thAki, yAte tAra mane dRr3ha vizvAsa janme|

ekavAra rAtera andhakAra neme ele se ekaTi (ujjvala) tArakA dekhate pAYa| takhana se vale, “ei to AmAra prabhu|” kintu yakhana seTi Duve yAYa takhana vale, “yArA Duve yAYa Ami tAderake pachanda kari nA|”

tArapara yakhana udIYamAna cA~da dekhate pAYa takhana vale, “ei AmAra prabhu|” kintu yakhana tAo Duve yAYa takhana vale, “AmAra prabhu yadi AmAke patha nA dekhAna tAhale Ami avazyai pathahArA lokadera antarbhukta haYe thAkava|”

erapara yakhana udIYamAna sUrya dekhe takhana vale, “eTAi AmAra prabhu have, (kAraNa) eTA Aro var3a|” kintu yakhana tAo Duve gela takhana valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA ye zir‌ka karacha tAra sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei|”
Ami ekaniSTha haYe sei mahAna sattAra dike AmAra mukha (manoyoga) phirAlAma yini AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena evaM Ami muzarika nai|

tAra samapradAYera lokerA tAra sAthe vitarka karechila| se valechila, “tomarA ki AllAhara vyApAre AmAra sAthe vitarka karacha? tini to AmAke saThika patha dekhiYechena| tomarA tA~ra sAthe yAderake zarIka karo Ami tAdera bhaYa kari nA, tave AmAra prabhu kichu cAile tA bhinna kathA| AmAra prabhura jJAna sarvavyApI| tomarA ki tAhale cintA karave nA?”

tomarA yAderake zarIka karo Ami tAderake kIbhAve bhaYa kari? yekhAne tomarA AllAhara sAthe emanasava vastuke zarIka karate bhaYa karo nA yAdera samparke tini tomAdera kAche kona pramANa pAThAnani| ataeva, ubhaYa dalera madhye kon‌Ti nirApattA lAbhera vezi yogya? yadi tomarA jAna (tAhale vala)|
yArA ImAna eneche evaM nijedera ImAnake julumera (zir‌kera) sAthe mizrita kare nA tAdera janyai nirApattA evaM tArAi supathagAmI|
oTA chila AmAra pramANa yA Ami ivarAhImake tAra samapradAYera viruddhe (praYogera janya) diYechilAma| Ami yAke cAi tAra maryAdA u~cu kari| nizcaYai tomAra prabhu parama prAjJa, mahAjJAnI|

Ami tAra (ivarAhImera) janya isahAka o iYAkUvake dAna karechilAma| pratyekakei Ami supathagAmI karechilAma| era Age nUhake supathagAmI karechilAma; Ara tAra vaMzadharadera madhya theke dAuda, solAYamAna, Aiuva, iusupha, mUsA o hArunakeo| ebhAvei Ami satkarmazIladera puraskAra diYe thAki|
yAkAriYA, iYAhaiYA, IsA o iliYAsakeo (supathagAmI karechilAma)| (erA) pratyekei satlokadera tAlikAbhukta|
(supathagAmI karechilAma) isamAIla, Ala-iYAsAjJa, iunusa o lUtakeo| (edera) pratyekake Ami vizvavAsIra opara zreSThatva dAna karechilAma|
edera pUrvapuruSa, vaMzadhara o bhAidera madhya theke Aro katakake (zreSThatva dAna karechilAma)| tAderake Ami manonIta karechilAma evaM saThika patha pradarzana karechilAma|
eTAi AllAhara patha| tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke cAna e patha pradarzana karena| Ara tArA yadi zir‌ka karata tAhale tAdera karmasamUha avazyai niSphala haYe yeta|

tAderakei Ami kitAva, kartRtva o navuoYAta dAna karechilAma| ataeva, erA yadi tA avizvAsa kare tAhale (kona asuvidhA nei, kAraNa) Ami tA Arekadala lokera dAYietva nyasta karechi yArA tA avizvAsa karave nA|

tAderake AllAha supathagAmI karechena; ataeva, tumi tAdera pathai anusaraNa kara| vala, “Ami tomAdera kAche era (koraAnera) janya kona pratidAna cAi nA| e to sArA vizvavAsIra janya eka (amUlya) smAraka|”

tArA (avizvAsIrA) AllAhake yathAyatha mUlyAYana karate pAreni, yakhana tArA valeche, “AllAha kona mAnuSera nikaTa kona kichu nAyila kareni|” vala, “mAnuSera janya Alo o patha-nirdezasvarUpa ye kitAva mUsA niYe esechila tA ke nAyila karechila? tomarA (ihudirA) tA vibhinna kAgaje bhAga bhAga kare prakAza karacha evaM aneka kichui gopana karacha| Ara tomAderake emana kichu jAnAno haYeche yA tomarAo jAnate nA, tomAdera vApa-dAdArAo jAnata nA|” vala, “(tA) AllAhai (nAyila karechilena)|” ataHpara tAdera prasaGga cher3e dAo; tArA khelA mane kare tAdera nirarthaka kathAvArtAYa lipta thAkuka|

eTi (Ala-koraAna) ekaTi varakatamaYa kitAva yA Ami nAyila karechi; eTi tAra pUrvavartI kitAvera samarthaka; Ara (Ami ei kitAva nAyila karechi) yAte tumi mUla janapada (makkA) o tAra AzapAzera mAnuSake satarka karate pAra| yArA parakAla vizvAsa kare tArA e kitAvao vizvAsa kare evaM tArA tAdera nAmAyera prati ya.vAna thAke|

AllAhara viruddhe ye mithyA Aropa kare athavA vale, “AmAra kAche ohI pAThAno haYeche” athaca tAra kAche kichui pAThAno haYani; evaM ye vale, “AllAha yA nAyila karechena tAra mata Amio zigagirai kichu ekaTA nAyila karava” tAra ceYe var3a jAlema ke hate pAre? tumi yadi dekhate pete, yakhana jAlemadera mRtyu-yantraNA haYa evaM (mRtyura) pherezatArA tAdera hAta prasArita kare vale, “tomAdera prANagulo vera kare dAo; Aja tomAderake lAJchanAkara zAsti deoYA have, kAraNa tomarA AllAhara viruddhe asatya valate evaM tA~ra nidarzanAvalI samvandhe auddhatya prakAza karate|”

tomarA to AmAra kAche niHsaGga avasthAYa esecho, Thika yemanaTi Ami tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma| Ami tomAderake yA yA diYechilAma savai tomAdera pechane rekhe esecho| tomAdera supAriza-kArIderakeo to tomAdera saGge dekhachi nA, yAderake tomarA tomAdera aMzIdAra vale dAvi karechile| Asalei tomAdera madhyakAra samparka chinna haYe giYeche evaM tomarA yA yA dAvi karate tA sava tomAdera theke udhAo haYe giYeche|
nizcaYai AllAha zasya-vIja o phalera A~Ti aMkurita karena| tini mRta theke jIvitake evaM jIvita theke mRtake vera karena| AllAha e rakamai, ataeva, tomarA vibhrAnta hao kIbhAve?
tini prabhAta unmeSakArI| tini rAtake vizrAmera janya evaM sUrya o candrake hisAvera janya nirdhAraNa karechena| eTA mahAparAkramazAlI o mahAjJAnIra nirdhAraNa|
tinii tomAdera janya tArakArAji sRSTi karechena yAte tomarA sthale o samudre (rAtera) andhakAre pathera sandhAna pAo| Ami jJAnI lokadera janya nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karechi|

tinii tomAderake ekajana mAnuSa (Adama) theke sRSTi karechena evaM (tomAdera janya) ekaTi AvAsasthala o ekaTi saMgrahazAlA (svalpameYAdI o dIrghameYAdI vAsasthAna) raYeche| Ami vujhamAna lokadera janya nidarzanasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA karechi|

tinii AkAza theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karena| tArapara era sAhAyye Ami savarakamera gAchapAlA utpanna kari; tA theke savuja vRnta ud‌gata kari, yA theke ghana thokA-thokA zasyadAnA vera kari| khejuragAchera ziSa theke nirgata haYa nice nuYe-par3A kA~di| AGgurera vAgAna, jalapAi o DAlima utpanna kari| egulora madhye kona konaTi anya kona konaTira mata AvAra kona konaTi anya ye-konaTi theke bhinna| gAche yakhana phala dhare takhana era phala o tAra paripakkatAra dike lakSya kara| nizcaYai esavera madhye vizvAsI lokadera janya aneka nidarzana raYeche|

tArA jvinaderake AllAhara sAthe zarIka kareche, athaca tinii tAderake sRSTi karechena| ajJatAra kAraNe tArA AllAhara janya chelemeYeo sAvyasta kareche| mahimA tA~ra! tArA (tA~ra janya) yesava vizeSaNa Aropa karache tini tAra Urdhve|
tini AsamAna o jaminera sraSTA| tA~ra santAna have ki kare? tA~ra to kona saGginI (strI) nei| Ara tinii to savakichu sRSTi karechena evaM savakichu samvandhe tini suvijJa|
ei halena tomAdera prabhu AllAha| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| tini savakichura sraSTA; ataeva, tomarA tA~rai evAdata kara| tini savakichurai kAryanirvAhI|
kona dRSTi tA~ra nAgAla pAYa nA, tave tini sava dRSTira nAgAla pAna| Ara tini atyanta sUkSmadarzI o savakichura khavara rAkhena|

tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke cAkSuSa pramANAdi ese geche| ekhana ye (tA) dekhave tAra upakAra have evaM ye andha haYe thAkave (dekhave nA) tAra kSati have| Ami to Ara tomAdera praharI nai|

emanibhAve Ami AYAtasamUha nAnAbhAve vivRta kari; tA nA hale tArA (avizvAsIrA) valate pAre, “tumi to (eTA pUrvera AsamAni kitAvei) par3echo;” Ara yAte Ami jJAnI lokadera kAche tA pariSkAra kare vyakta karate pAri|
tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura nikaTa theke ohIra mAdhyame yA pAThAno haYa tA anusaraNa kara| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| Ara muzarikadera dika theke mukha phiriYe nAo|
AllAha yadi cAitena tAhale tArA zir‌ka karata nA| Ara Ami tomAke tAdera praharI vAnAini; tumi tAdera karmavidhAYakao nao|

AllAhake vAda diYe tArA yAderake DAke tomarA tAderake gAli dio nA; tAhale tArA ajJatAvazata anyAYabhAve AllAhakeo gAli deve| emanibhAve Ami pratyeka jAtira dRSTite tAdera nijedera kAjakarma suzobhita kare diYechi| (phale yAra kAja tAra kAche bhAla mane haYa|) ataHpara tAdera prabhura kAchei tAdera pratyAvartana (nirdhArita)| takhana tini tAderake tArA yA karata tA avahita karavena|

tArA AllAhara nAme jorAlo zapatha kare vale ye, yadi tAdera kAche kona nidarzana Asata tAhale tArA avazyai tA vizvAsa karata| vala, “nidarzana to AllAhara kAche| (he musalamAnagaNa!) tomAderake ke jAnAve ye,tAdera kAche nidarzana eleo tArA vizvAsa karave nA?”

yehetu prathamavAra tArA tA vizvAsa kareni tAi Ami tAdera antara o cokha (saThika patha theke) ghuriYe deva evaM tAderake cher3e deva, yAte nijedera avAdhyatAra madhye ud‌bhrAntera nyAYa ghurate thAke|

yadi Ami tAdera kAche pherezatA pAThAtAma o mRtavyaktirA tAdera sAthe kathA valata evaM Ami savakichu tAdera sAmane ekatrita karatAma tathApi tArA ImAna Anata nA| avazya AllAha (anyarakama) icchA karale seTA bhinna kathA; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mUrkhera mata kAja kare|

emanibhAve Ami pratyeka navIra janya katipaYa zatru niYoga karechi| tArA hala mAnuSa o jvinadera madhye zaYatAnerA| tArA dho~kA deoYAra janya eke aparake kArumaYa kathAvArtA zikhiYe deYa| tave AllAha cAile tArA eTA karata nA| ataeva, tumi tAdera kathA o tArA yA vAniYe vale tAra kathA cher3e dAo|
(tArA kArumaYa kathAvArtA ejanya zekhAYa) yAte era prati parakAle avizvAsIdera mana AkRSTa haYa, tArA ete santuSTa thAkate pAre evaM tArA yesava apakarma karache tA kare yete pAre|

(vala,) “Ami ki tAhale AllAha vyatIta anya kona vicAraka khu~java? athaca tinii tomAdera kAche vistArita kitAva nAyila karechena|” Ara Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA jAne ye, tA satyai tomAra prabhura pakSa theke avatIrNa| ataeva, tumi kichutei sandeha poSaNa karo nA|
tomAra prabhura vANI satya o nyAYe paripUrNa| keu tA~ra vANI parivartana karate pAre nA| tinii sarvazrotA, mahAjJAnI|
tumi yadi pRthivIra adhikAMza mAnuSera kathAmato cala tAhale tArA tomAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karave| tArA zudhu AndAjera anusaraNa kare, tArA zudhu anumAna kare vale|
tomAra prabhui bhAla jAnena, ke tA~ra patha cher3e vipathe yAYa| saThika pathera anusArIdera samparkeo tini bhAla jAnena|
AllAhara nAma niYe javAi-karA prANIra mAMsa khAo, yadi tomarA tA~ra vidhAnasamUhe vizvAsI hao|

kena tomarA AllAhara nAma niYe javAi-karA prANIra mAMsa khAve nA? athaca AllAha tomAdera janya yA yA hArAma karechena vistAritabhAve segulora vivaraNa diYechena; avazya nirupAYa haYe tomarA kichu khete vAdhya hale tAra kathA AlAdA| Ara aneke to nA jene nijedera kheYAla-khuzimata mAnuSake vibhrAnta kare| avazyai tomAra prabhu sImAlaMghanakArIdera samparke bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|
tomarA prakAzya o gopana (savarakama) pApa cher3e dAo| yArA pApa kAmAi kare tArA zigagirai tAdera kRtakarmera zAsti pAve|

(javAikAle) AllAhara nAma neoYA haYani emana prANIra mAMsa kheYo nA| avazyai tA pApa| Ara zaYatAnerA tAdera vandhuderake tomAdera sAthe vitarka karate prarocanA deYa| yadi tomarA tAdera kathAmato cala tAhale avazyai muzarika haYe yAve|

ye vyakti mRta chila, tArapara Ami tAke jIvita karechi evaM ekaTi Alo dAna karechi yAra sAhAyye se mAnuSera madhye calate pAre, se ki ai vyaktira mata hate pAre, ye andhakArera madhye Ache evaM sekhAna theke vera hacche nA? ebhAvei kApheradera dRSTite tAdera nijedera kAja zobhana karA haYeche|

Ara ebhAvei Ami pratyeka janapade sekhAnakAra var3a aparAdhIderake sekhAne cakrAnta karate diYechi| tave (prakRtapakSe) tAdera cakrAntera pratiphala tAdera nijedera viruddhei yAYa; kintu tArA tA anubhava kare nA|

Ara yakhana tAdera kAche kona nidarzana Ase takhana tArA vale, “AmarA vizvAsa karava nA, yatakSaNa paryanta AllAhara rasUladerake yA deoYA haYechila AmAderakeo anurUpa jinisa deoYA nA haYa|” AllAha tA~ra risAlAta (rasUlera dAYitva) kothAYa devena tA tinii bhAla jAnena| aparAdhakArIrA tAdera cakrAntera kAraNe zigagirai AllAhara kAche lAJchanA o kaThina zAsti lAbha karave|

ataeva, AllAha yAke supatha dekhAte cAna isalAmera janya tAra mana khule dena; Ara yAke vipathe nite cAna tAra mana (emana) saGkIrNa o kaThina kare dena yena se AkAze ArohaNa karache| ebhAvei AllAha avizvAsIdera opara zAsti dhArya karena|
ei hala tomAra prabhura (nirdezita) saThika patha| Ami upadeza grahaNakArIdera janya nidarzanasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA karechi|
tAdera janya tAdera prabhura nikaTa zAntira AvAsa raYeche evaM tAdera karmera pratidAne tinii tAdera abhibhAvaka (havena)|

yedina tini tAdera sakalake ekatrita karavena Ara (jvinaderake) valavena, “he jvinerA! tomarA to mAnuSera madhya theke anekake tomAdera anugAmI kare niYechile;” Ara tAdera mAnuSa vandhurA valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA eke aparera dvArA upakRta haYechilAma (Thikai), tave ekhana AmarA sei samaYe upanIta haYechi yA tumi AmAdera janya nirdhAraNa karechile;” takhana tini valavena, “jAhAnnAmai tomAdera vAsasthAna, sekhAne tomarA cirakAla vAsa karave, tave AllAha (anya) kichu cAile se kathA bhinna| nizcaYai tomAra prabhu prajJAmaYa, mahAjJAnI|”
Ara ebhAvei Ami tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe jAlemadera ekadalake (aparAdha sampAdane) Arekadalera sahayogI kare thAki|

(Ami valava) “he jvina o mAnuSera dala! tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera madhya thekei rasUla Aseni yArA tomAdera kAche AmAra nidarzanasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA karata evaM tomAderake eidinera mukhomukhi haoYAra vyApAre satarka karata?” tArA valave, “AmarA AmAdera nijedera viruddhei sAkSya dicchi|” (Asale) duniYAra jIvana tAderake pratArita kareche; (tAi) tArA tAdera nijedera viruddhei sAkSya deve ye, tArA kAphera chila|
eTA (rasUlapreraNa) ejanya ye, tomAra prabhu kona anyAYera kAraNe adhivAsIderake anavahita rekhe janapadasamUha dhvaMsa karena nA|
yAra yAra kAja anusAre sakalera maryAdA Ache| tArA yA karache se samparke tomAra prabhu vekhavara nana|

tomAra prabhu amukhApekSI o daYAzIla| tini yadi icchA karena tAhale tomAderake sariYe tomAdera para yAderake cAna tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karate pArena; yemana tomAderakeo tini anya lokadera vaMzadhara theke sRSTi karechena|
tomAderake yA oYAdA karA haYeche tA avazyai Asave evaM tomarA (tA) vyartha karate pArave nA|
vala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA tomAdera mata kAja karate thAka, Amio (AmAra mata) kAja kari| tomarA jAnate pArave, parakAle kAra pariNAma bhAla haYa| avazyai jAlemarA saphalakAma have nA”

AllAha yesava zasya o gavAdipazu sRSTi karechena tAra ekaTi aMza tArA AllAhara janya nirdiSTa kare Ara nijedera dhAraNA motAveka vale, “eTA AllAhara janya Ara eTA AmAdera zarIkadera janya|” Ara (tAdera vicAre) ye aMza tAdera zarIkadera janya tA AllAhara kAche pau~che nA, kintu ye aMza AllAhara janya tA tAdera zarIkadera kAche pau~che yAYa| (ebhAve) tArA ye vicAra karache tA var3ai khArApa!

temanibhAve tAdera zarIkarA aneka muzarikera dRSTite nijedera santAnahatyA zobhana kareche, tAderake dhvaMsa karAra janya o tAdera mane dharma samparke vibhrAnti sRSTi karAra janya| AllAha yadi icchA karatena tAhale tArA e kAja karata nA| ataeva, tAderake tAdera vAnAno mithyA niYei thAkate dAo|

tArA tAdera dhAraNA anusAre vale, “ei pazu o zasyagulo niSiddha| AmarA yAderake cAiva tArA vyatIta keu esava khete pArave nA|” (tAdera dhAraNAmate) kichu kichu pazura piThe ArohaNao niSiddha| AvAra AllAhara viruddhe mithyA Aropera uddezye tArA kona kona pazu javAikAle AllAhara nAma neYa nA| tAdera esava managar3A mithyAcArera janya tini zigagirai tAderake zAsti devena|

tArA Aro vale, “ei pazugulora peTe (garbhe) yA Ache tA AmAdera puruSadera janya nirdiSTa evaM AmAdera nArIdera janya niSiddha| Ara yadi tA mRta haYa tAhale tArA (savAi) tAte aMzIdAra|” tini tAdera (esava managar3A) varNanAra janya zigagirai tAderake zAsti devena| nizcaYai tini prajJAvAna, mahAjJAnI|

yArA vokAra mata nA jene nijedera santAnadera hatyA kareche evaM AllAha tAderake ye jIvikA dAna karechena AllAhara prati bhrAnta dhAraNAvazata tA niSiddha kareche tArA avazyai kSatigrasta haYeche| nizcaYai tArA vipathagAmI haYeche evaM tArA satpathe chila nA|

tinii vAga-vAgicAra mAcAviziSTa o mAcAvihIna gAchapAlA, khejuragAcha, vibhinna svAdera zasya, jalapAi Ara DAlima utpanna karena yAra konaTi konaTira mata AvAra konaTi konaTira mata naYa| esava gAchapAlAYa yakhana phala haYa takhana tomarA tAra phala khAve; tave phasala saMgrahera dine tAra nyAyya aMza dAna karave| Ara apacaYa karave nA; (kAraNa) tini to apacaYakArIdera bhAlavAsena nA|

Ara gavAdipazura madhye (kataka) bhAravAhI o (kataka) choTa AkRtira (sRSTi karechena)| AllAha tomAderake ye jIvikA dAna karechena tA theke khAo evaM zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA; (kAraNa) se to tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

ATaTi jor3A-pazu (sRSTi karechena): bher3Ara duTo (ekaTi puruSa o ekaTi strI) o chAgalera duTo (ekaTi puruSa o ekaTi strI); vala, “tini ki puruSaduTo hArAma karechena, nAki strIduTo, nAki strIduTora garbhe ye vAccA raYeche tA? tomarA jene AmAke vala, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|”

evaM uTera duTo (ekaTi puruSa o ekaTi strI) o garura duTo (ekaTi puruSa o ekaTi strI); vala, “tini ki puruSaduTo hArAma karechena, nAki strIduTo, nAki strIduTora garbhe ye vAccA raYeche tA? nAki AllAha yakhana erakama nirdeza diYechilena takhana tomarA upasthita chile? ataeva, mAnuSake vipathagAmI karAra janya nA jene ye AllAhara nAme mithyA vAniYe vale tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke Ache? AllAha jAlemaderake supathagAmI karena nA|”

vala, “AmAra kAche ye vidhAna pAThAno haYeche tAte mRta prANI vA pravAhita rakta athavA zUkarera mAMsa yA apavitra kiMvA AllAha vyatIta anyera nAme utsargIkRta prANIra avaidha mAMsa chAr3A kAro janya khAoYA hArAma vale kichu pAi nA|” tave keu yadi icchAkRta avAdhyatA kiMvA sImAlaMghana vyatIta kevala nirupAYa haYe (kona hArAma khAvAra khete) vAdhya haYa tAhale nizcaYai tomAra prabhu kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

ihudidera janya Ami savakarama nakhaoYAlA prANI (khAoYA) hArAma karechilAma| Ara garu o chAgala theke tAdera janya hArAma karechilAma carvi; tave edera piTha o nAr3Ibhu~r3ira sAthe saMlagna athavA hAr3era sAthe mizrita carvi naYa| tAdera avAdhyatAra janya Ami tAderake e zAsti diYechilAma| Ara nizcaYai Ami satyavAdI|
ataHpara tArA yadi tomAke mithyAvAdI vale tAhale tumi valave, “tomAdera prabhu asIma daYAra mAlika evaM aparAdhIdera theke tA~ra zAsti phiriYe neYA haYa nA|”

muzarikarA valave, “yadi AllAha cAitena tAhale AmarA kiMvA AmAdera vApa-dAdArA zir‌ka karatAma nA evaM (tA~ra vidhAnera vAire) kona kichu hArAma karatAma nA|” ebhAvei tAdera pUrvavartIrAo avizvAsa karechila yatakSaNa nA tArA AmAra zAsti AsvAdana karechila| vala, “tomAdera kAche ki kona jJAna (pramANa) Ache yA AmAdera sAmane peza karate pAra? tomarA to zudhu dhAraNAra vazavartI hao evaM zudhu managar3A kathA vala|”
vala, “pUrNAGga pramANa to AllAhara kAchei| ataeva, tini yadi cAitena tAhale avazyai tomAdera sakalake saThika pathe cAlAtena|”

vala, “tomAdera sei sAkSIderake niYe eso yArA sAkSya dite pAre ye, AllAha eTA hArAma karechena|” ataHpara tArA yadi (emana) sAkSya deYa, tAhale tumi tAdera sAthe sAkSya dio nA| Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale, yArA parakAla vizvAsa kare nA o tAdera prabhura samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa tumi tAdera icchAnusAre kAja karo nA|

vala, “edike eso, tomAdera prabhu tomAdera janya yA niSiddha karechena Ami tA par3e zonAi| tA ei ye, tomarA tAra sAthe konakichu zarIka karave nA| echAr3A pitAmAtAra sAthe sadvyavahAra karave| dAridrera bhaYe nijedera santAnaderake hatyA karave nA|” tomAderake o tAderake Amii jIvikA dAna kari| “prakAzya hoka kiMvA gopana hoka azlIla kAjera kAcheo yAve nA| nyAYasaGgata kAraNa chAr3A mAnuSa hatyA karave nA, yA AllAha niSiddha karechena| tini tomAderake ei Adeza diYechena, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|”

“vaYoprApta nA haoYA paryanta anAthera sampadera kAcheo yAve nA| yete hale zarIYatasammata zreSThatama panthAYa yAve| mApa o ojana nyAYera sAthe puropuri deve|” kAuke Ami tAra sAdhyera atIta kaSTa dei nA| “yakhana kathA valave, nyAyya valave, saMzliSTa vyakti nikaTAtmIYa haleo| Ara AllAhara aGgIkAra pUraNa karave| tini tomAderake ei Adeza diYechena, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|”

“Ara ei hacche AmAra sarala patha| ataeva, tomarA e pathai anusaraNa karo, anyAnya patha anusaraNa karo nA; tAhale sesava patha tomAderake tA~ra patha theke vicchinna karave| tini tomAderake ei Adeza diYechena, yAte tomarA (vibhrAnti theke) ve~ce thAkate pAra|”

ataHpara Ami satkarmazIladera janya (neYAmatera) paripUrNatA, savakichura vistArita vivaraNa, patha-nirdeza evaM anugrahasvarUpa mUsAke kitAva (tAorAta) diYechilAma; yAte tArA tAdera prabhura saGge sAkSAte vizvAsa kare|
eTi (Ala-koraAna) AmAra nAyilakRta ekaTi varakatamaYa kitAva| ataeva, tomarA eTi mene cala evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karo, yAte tomarA anugrahaprApta hao|
pAche tomarA vala, “kitAva to nAyila karA haYechila AmAdera pUrve duTi samapradAYera kAche evaM tArA ki par3ata se samvandhe AmarA to anavahitai chilAma|”

kiMvA tomarA vala, “yadi AmAdera kAche kitAva nAyila karA hata tAhale AmarA tAdera ceYe adhika hedAYetaprApta hatAma|” ekhana to tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke spaSTa pramANa (Ala-koraAna), hedAYeta o rahamata ese geche| ataeva, AllAhara AYAtasamUhake ye mithyA vale evaM tAra dika theke mukha phiriYe neYa tAra ceYe var3a jAlema ke Ache? yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha theke mukha phiriYe neYa, zigagirai Ami tAderake ei mukha phiriYe neoYAra janya nikRSTa zAsti deva|

tArA ki (tAhale) eTA chAr3A anya kichura pratIkSA karache ye, tAdera kAche pherezatArA Asave kiMvA tomAra prabhu Asavena athavA tomAra prabhura kona nidarzana (keYAmatera AlAmata) Asave? (arthAt tArA yena e rakama kichurai pratIkSA karache|) Asale yedina tomAra prabhura kona nidarzana Asave sedina emana kAro ImAna kona kAje Asave nA ye Age ImAna Aneni kiMvA ImAna anusAre kona satkAja kareni| vala, “tomarA pratIkSA karo, AmarAo pratIkSA karachi|”

yArA nijedera dharmake khaNDa-vikhaNDa kareche evaM vibhinna dale vibhakta haYeche tumi tAdera sAthe kona kichutei nao| tAdera viSaYaTi AllAhara kAche nyasta raYeche| tini tAderake tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe avahita karavena|
ye vyakti ekaTi bhAla kAja karave se tAra mata dazaTira phala pAve; AvAra ye ekaTi khArApa kAja karave tAke zudhu seTirai pratiphala deoYA have| tAdera prati juluma karA have nA|
vala, “AmAke to AmAra prabhu sarala pathe paricAlita karechena; (eTAi) ekaniSTha ivarAhImera saThika dharma| tini muzarikadera dalabhukta chilena nA|”
vala, “AmAra nAmAya, AmAra koravAni, AmAra jIvana o AmAra mRtyu sArA jAhAnera prabhu AllAhara janya|”
