“tA~ra kona zarIka nAi| AmAke ei Adezai deoYA haYeche evaM Amii prathama musalima (anugata vAndA)”

vala, “Ami ki AllAha chAr3A anya kona prabhu cAiva? athaca tinii savakichura prabhu| ye yA upArjana kare tAra phala tAra oparai vartAYa| ekajana Arekajanera bhAra vahana kare nA| parizeSe tomAdera prabhura kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana (nirdhArita)| tomarA yA niYe matabheda karate se vyApAre takhana tini tomAderake avahita karavena|”

tinii tomAderake duniYAra pratinidhi karechena evaM tomAderake yA kichu dAna karechena se samvandhe parIkSA karAra janya tomAdera katakake katakera opare maryAdA diYechena| nizcaYai tomAra prabhu druta zAsti pradAnakArI; AvAra nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Alipha lAma mIma chada [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|

eTi tomAra kAche nAyilakRta ekaTi grantha; ataeva, era vyApAre tomAra mane yena konarUpa saMkIrNatA nA thAke| (eTi nAyila karA haYeche) yAte era dvArA tumi (lokaderake) satarka kara| Ara muminadera janya eTi ekaTi smAraka|
tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche tomarA tAra anusaraNa karo evaM tini chAr3A anya abhibhAvakadera anusaraNa karo nA| tomarA khuva kamai upadeza grahaNa kara|
(pApera kAraNe) Ami aneka janapada dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tAdera (adhivAsIdera) opara AmAra (Akasmika) zAsti esechila rAte athavA tArA yakhana dupure vizrAmarata chila|
tAdera opara yakhana AmAra zAsti esechila takhana tAdera Ara kona dAvi chila nA; tArA zudhu ekaTi kathAi valechila, “Asale AmarA jAlema chilAma|”
ataeva, yAdera kAche rasUla pAThAno haYechila avazyai Ami tAderake prazna karava evaM avazyai Ami rasUladerakeo prazna karava|
ataHpara Ami tAdera kAche jJAtasAre (tAdera sava ghaTanA) varNanA karava| Ami to anupasthita chilAma nA|
sedina (hAzarera dina) ojana have saThika| ataeva, yAdera (nyAYera) pAllA bhArI have tArAi saphalakAma|
Ara yAdera (nyAYera) pAllA hAlakA have tArAi nijedera kSati kareche; kAraNa (avizvAsa kare) tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhera prati avicAra karata|
avazyai Ami tomAderake duniYAte pratiSThita karechi evaM sekhAne tomAdera janya jIvikAra vyavasthA karechi| tomarA (sejanya) khuva kamai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

avazyai Ami tomAderake (tomAdera pitA Adamake) sRSTi karechi, tArapara tomAdera AkRti diYechi, tArapara pherezatAdera valechi, “Adamake sejadA karo”; takhana ivalIsa vAde tArA sejadA karala| se (ivalIsa) sejadAkArIdera dalabhukta hala nA|

tini valalena, “Ami yakhana tomAke Adeza diYechi takhana kise tomAke niSedha karala ye tumi sejadA karacha nA?” se valala, “Ami tAra ceYe zreSTha; (kAraNa) AmAke tumi Aguna theke sRSTi karecho, Ara tAke sRSTi karecho mATi theke|”
tini valalena, “tumi ei jAnnAta theke neme yAo| ekhAne tomAra auddhatya dekhAnora suyoga nei| ataeva, veriYe yAo| nizcaYai tumi lAJchitadera dalabhukta|”
se valala, “yedina tAderake uThAno have sedina (keYAmatera dina) paryanta AmAke samaYa dAo|”
tini valalena, “tomAke samaYa deoYA hala|”
se valala, “yehetu (mAnuSera kAraNe) tumi AmAke vipathe Thele dile tAi Amio tomAra sarala pathe tAdera viruddhe apekSamAna thAkava|”
ataHpara Ami tAdera kAche Asava tAdera sAmane theke, tAdera pechana theke, tAdera DAnadika theke o tAdera vAmadika theke; phale tumi tAdera adhikAMzake kRtajJa pAve nA|
tini valalena, “tumi ei jAnnAta theke dhikkRta o vitAr3ita haYe vera haYe yAo| tAdera madhye yArA tomAra kathAmato calave avazyai Ami tomAdera sakalera dvArA jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|”
Ara he Adama! tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa karo evaM yebhAve cAo khAdya grahaNa karo; tave ei gAchaTira kAche yeYo nA, tAhale tomarA anyAYakArIdera antarbhukta have|

takhana zaYatAna tAdera AvRta lajjAsthAna anAvRta karAra matalave tAderake kumantraNA deYa Ara vale, “tomAdera prabhu tomAderake gAchaTira kAche yete niSedha karechena kevala ei kAraNe ye, pAche tomarA pherezatA athavA (jAnnAtera) sthAYI vAsindA haYe yAo|
se tAdera kAche zapatha kare valala, “Ami avazyai tomAdera hitAkAMkSI|”

ebhAve se dho~kA diYe tAderake vibhrAnta karala| ataHpara yakhana tArA gAchaTira (phalera) svAda grahaNa karala takhana tAdera lajjAsthAna anAvRta haYe gela evaM tArA jAnnAtera pAtA diYe nijederake AvRta karate lAgala| (ematAvasthAYa) tAdera prabhu tAderake samvodhana kare valalena, “Ami ki tomAderake ai gAchaTira kAche yete vAraNa karini evaM valini ye, zaYatAna tomAdera prakAzya zatru?”
tArA valala, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA nijedera prati juluma karechi| (ekhana) tumi yadi AmAderake kSamA kare nA dAo Ara AmAdera prati daYA nA karo tAhale AmarA avazyai kSatigrasta hava|”
tini valalena, “tomarA neme yAo| tomarA eke aparera zatru| Ara pRthivIte tomAdera janya kichukAlera nivAsa o sukhabhogera vyavasthA raYeche|”
tini valalena, “tomarA sekhAnei vA~cave, sekhAnei marave evaM sekhAna thekei tomAderake vera kare AnA have|”

he Adama santAnerA! Ami tomAderake lajjA nivAraNa o sAja-sajjAra janya pozAka diYechi; Ara tAkaoYAra pozAka, eTAi savaceYe bhAla| egulo AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera antargata; yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare (mithyA cher3e satyera anusaraNa kare)|

he Adama santAnerA! zaYatAna yena tomAderake phetanAYa nA phele, yebhAve se tomAdera pitAmAtAke (Adama o hAoYAke) nijedera lajjAsthAna dekhAnora matalave vivastra kare jAnnAta theke vera karechila| se o tAra dalavala tomAderake dekhate pAYa, kintu tomarA tAderake dekhate pAo nA| yAdera ImAna nei Ami zaYatAnaderake tAdera vandhu kare diYechi|

yakhana tArA kona azlIla kAja kare takhana vale, “AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera eTA karate dekhechi evaM AllAhao AmAderake eTA karAra Adeza diYechena|” vala, “AllAha azlIla kAjera Adeza dena nA| tomarA ki AllAha samvandhe emana kathA valacha yA tomarA jAna nA?”

vala, “AmAra prabhu nyAYavicArera Adeza diYechena|” Ara tomarA pratyeka sejadAra (nAmAyera) samaYa tomAdera mukhamaNDala sojA rAkhave evaM dvInake kevala tA~rai janya nivedita kare (ekaniSThabhAve) tA~ke DAkave| yebhAve tini tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena sebhAvei tomarA (keYAmatera dina) AvAra Asave|
ekadalake tini supathagAmI karechena evaM Arekadalera vipathagAmitA avadhArita haYeche| tArA AllAhara parivarte zaYatAnaderake vandhu vAniYeche Ara mane karache, tArA saThika pathei Ache|
he AdamasantAnerA! pratyeka sejadAra (nAmAyera o taoYAphera) samaYa sAjagocha kare nio Ara pAnAhAra karo; tave apacaYa karave nA| tini apacaYakArIdera bhAlavAsena nA|

vala, “svIYa vAndAdera janya sRSTa AllAhara deoYA sAjasajjA evaM pavitra jIvikA (khAdrasAmagrI) ke niSiddha kareche?” vala, “ImAnadAradera janya pArthiva jIvane esava vaidha, Ara keYAmatera dina to kevalamAtra tAdera janyai|” emanibhAve Ami jJAnIdera janya vidhAnasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA kari|

vala, “vastuta AmAra prabhu hArAma karechena prakAzya o gopana azlIla kAjakarma, (savarakama) pApa, asaGgata vAr3AvAr3i, AllAhara sAthe tomAdera zarIka karA- yAra kona kartRtva tini denani evaM AllAha samparke tomAdera emana kathA valA yA tomarA jAna nA|”
pratyeka jAtira janya ekaTi samaYa nirdiSTa Ache| yakhana tAdera (sei) samaYa ese yAYa takhana tArA tA eka muhUrtao pichAte kiMvA AgAte pAre nA|
he AdamasantAnerA! yadi tomAdera kAche tomAdera madhya theke rasUla ese AmAra nidarzanasamUha varNanA kare, takhana yArA mottAkI o sat have tAdera kona bhaYa kiMvA duHkha thAkave nA|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA valave evaM segulora vyApAre auddhatya dekhAve tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI have, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

ye AllAhara viruddhe mithyA vAniYe vale athavA tA~ra nidarzanasamUhake avizvAsa kare tAra ceYe var3a jAlema ke Ache? bhAgyalipi theke tAdera nirdiSTa aMza tAdera kAche pau~che yAve| (tAdera bhAgye yA Ache tArA tA peYe yAve|) avazeSe yakhana AmAra dUterA (mRtyura pherezatArA) tAdera prANa nite tAdera kAche Asave takhana tArA (pherezatArA) valave, “AllAhake vAda diYe tomarA yAderake DAkate tArA kothAYa?” (javAve) tArA valave, “tArA AmAdera theke udhAo haYe geche|” Ara tArA nijedera viruddhei sAkSya deve ye, tArA kAphera chila|

AllAha valavena, “tomAdera pUrve ye sava jvina o mAnuSera dala cale geche tAdera sAthe tomarAo jAhAnnAme praveza kara|” yakhanai kona dala sekhAne praveza karave, takhana tAdera mata ArekaTi dalake abhizApa deve| avazeSe savAi yakhana sekhAne ekatrita have takhana paravartI dala pUrvavartI dala samparke valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! erA AmAderake vipathagAmI kareche; ataeva, ederake jAhAnnAmera dviguNa zAsti dAo|” tini valavena, “pratyekera janyai dviguNa raYeche; tave tomarA jAna nA|”
pUrvavartIrA paravartIdera valave, “AmAdera opara tomAdera kona zreSThatva nei; ataeva, tomAdera kRtakarmera janya zAsti AsvAdana kara|”

yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kare evaM segulo samvandhe auddhatya dekhAYa tAdera janya AsamAnera darajA kholA have nA evaM tArA jAnnAte praveza karave nA; yatakSaNa nA suiYera chidre uTa praveza kare| (arthAt suiYera chidre uTa praveza karA yemana asambhava tAdera jAnnAte praveza karAo temana asambhava|) ebhAvei Ami aparAdhIdera zAsti diYe thAki|
tAdera janya thAkave jAhAnnAmera eka zayyA evaM opara theke AcchAdana| ebhAvei Ami jAlemadera zAsti diYe thAki|
Ara yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche— Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyera atIta kAja dei nA— tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

Ami tAdera mana theke (duniYAra) yAvatIYa vidveSa dUra kare deva| tAdera nica theke nadI pravAhita have| tArA valave, “prazaMsA AllAhara yini AmAderake ekhAne AsAra patha dekhiYechena| AllAha AmAderake patha nA dekhAle AmarA pathera sandhAna petAma nA| AmAdera prabhura rasUlagaNa avazyai satya niYe esechilena|” Ara tAderake Deke valA have, “ei hala jAnnAta; tomAdera karmera pratidAne tomAderake era uttarAdhikArI karA haYeche|”

jAnnAtera adhivAsIrA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIdera Deke valave, “AmAdera prabhu AmAderake ye aGgIkAra karechilena AmarA tA Thikamato peYechi| tomAdera prabhu tomAderake ye oYAdA karechilena tomarA ki tA Thikamato peYecho?” tArA valave, “hyA~”| takhana ekajana ghoSaNAkArI tAdera madhye ghoSaNA karave, “jAlemadera opara AllAhara abhizApa;
yArA AllAhara pathe (lokaderake) vAdhA dita evaM tAte vakratA anveSaNa karata|” tArA parakAlera pratio avizvAsI chila|

ubhaYera (jAnnAtera adhivAsI o jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIdera) mAjhakhAne ekaTi pardA thAkave| Ara AjJarAphera (jAnnAta o jAhAnnAmera madhyavartI prAcIra) oparao kichu loka thAkave yArA (ubhaYa dikera) sakalake tAdera cehArAra cihna dekhe cinate pArave| tArA jAnnAtera adhivAsIderake Deke valave, “tomAdera opara zAnti varSita hoka|” (tAdera avasthA takhanao emana ye,) tArA nijerA jAnnAte praveza kareni, tave (pravezera) pratyAzA karache|
erapara yakhana tAdera cokha jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIdera dike phiriYe deoYA have takhana tArA valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake ei jAlemadera saGgI karo nA|”
AjJarAphaoYAlArA (madhyavartI prAcIrera opare avasthAnarata lokerA) kataka lokake, yAderake tArA cehArAra cihna dekhe cinave, Deke valave, “tomAdera dalavala o ahaMkAra tomAdera kona kAje Aseni|”

erA ki tArA, yAdera samparke tomarA kasama kheYe valate ye, AllAha edera prati anugraha karavena nA? (ederakei valA hacche,) “tomarA jAnnAte praveza kara| tomAdera kona bhaYa kiMvA duHkha thAkave nA|”

Ara jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIrA jAnnAtera adhivAsIdera Deke valave, “AmAdera opara kichu pAni Dhele dAo athavA AllAha tomAderake ye jIvikA (khAdya) dAna karechena tAra kichu aMza AmAdera dike dAo|” tArA valave, “AllAha to (Aja) e duToi kApheradera janya niSiddha karechena;

yArA tAdera dharmake vinodana o khelAra vastu vAniYe niYechila evaM duniYAra jIvana yAderake pratArita karechila|” ataeva, Aja Ami tAderake bhule yAva yebhAve tArA tAdera Ajakera dinaTira sAkSAtake bhule giYechila evaM yebhAve tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karata|
nizcaYai Ami tAdera kAche ekaTi grantha (Ala-koraAna) pau~che diYechi yA Ami jene vujhe ImAnadAradera janya pathanirdeza o anugraharUpe vistAritabhAve varNanA karechi|

tArA ki kevala tAra (koraAnera) marma ud‌ghATanera apekSA karache? yedina tAra marma ud‌ghATita have sedina yArA tAke Age bhule giYechila tArA valave, “AmAdera prabhura rasUlagaNa to satya niYe esechilena| AmAdera janya ki supArizakArI pAoYA yAve, yArA AmAdera janya ekaTu supAriza karave? athavA AmAderake ki AvAra pRthivIte phiriYe neYA have, yAte AmarA Age yA karatAma tAra theke bhinnatara kichu karate pAri|” tArA nijederai kSati kareche evaM tArA ye mithyA vAniYe valata tAo tAdera theke udhAo haYe geche|

nizcaYai tomAdera prabhu AllAha, yini chaYadine AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena; ataHpara Araze (siMhAsane) samAsIna haYechena| tini rAta diYe dinake Dheke dena; (edera) ekaTi ArekaTira pechane druta chuTache| Aro sRSTi karechena tA~ra AjJAnuvartI sUrya, canadra o nakSatrarAji| jene rAkha, sRSTi o Adeza tA~rai| AllAha mahimAnvita, yini sArAviztera prabhu|
tomarA minatibhare o saMgopane tomAdera prabhuke DAka| tini to sImAlaMghana-kArIdera bhAlavAsena nA|
zAnti pratiSThAra para tomarA duniYAYa (AvAra) azAnti sRSTi karo nA evaM bhaYa o pratyAzA niYe tA~ke (AllAhake) DAka| nizcaYai AllAhara anugraha satkarmazIladera kAchAkAchi Ache|

tinii svIYa anugrahera (vRSTira) Age susaMvAdarUpe vAtAsa pAThAna| ei vAtAsa yakhana bhArI megha uThiYe Ane takhana Ami tA kona nirjIva bhUkhaNDera dike cAliYe nei, tArapara tA theke pAni varSaNa kari evaM tAra sAhAyye savarakama phala utpanna kari| ebhAvei Ami mRtaderake vera karava, yAte tomarA zikSAgrahaNa karate pAra|

utkRSTa bhUmira phasala tAra prabhura Adeze (sahajei) utpanna haYa| Ara ye bhUmi nikRSTa tAte kaThora parizrama chAr3A kichu janme nA| ebhAve Ami kRtajJa lokadera janya nAnAbhAve nidarzanasamUha varNanA kare thAki|

Ami nUhake tAra samapradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara evAdata karo; tini chAr3A tomAdera kona upAsya nei| Ami tomAdera janya eka bhaYAnaka dinera zAstira AzaMkA karachi|”
tAra samapradAYera netArA valechila, “AmarA to tomAke spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye dekhate pAcchi|”
se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! AmAra madhye kona vibhrAnti nei; tave Ami vizvaprabhura pakSa theke ekajana rasUla|”
“Ami AmAra prabhura vArtAsamUha tomAdera kAche pracAra kari evaM tomAderake sadupadeza dei| Ami AllAhara pakSa theke emanasava viSaYa jAnate pAi yA tomarA jAna nA|”

“tomarA ki ete vismita haYecho ye, tomAderai ekajanera mAdhyame tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke upadeza eseche, yAte se tomAderake satarka kare evaM tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karo o (AllAhara) anugraha lAbha karate pAra?”

ataHpara tArA tAke mithyAvAdI vale| pare Ami tAke o tAra saGge yArA naukAYa chila tAderake uddhAra kari evaM yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa karechila tAderake DuviYe dei| Asale orA chila katagulo andha (satyadarzane akSama) loka|

Ara Ada jAtira nikaTa (pAThiYechilAma) tAdera bhAi hUdake| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara evAdata karo; tini chAr3A tomAdera kona upAsya nei| tave ki tomarA (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?”
tAra samapradAYera kAphera netArA valechila, “AmarA tomAke nirvodha dekhate pAcchi evaM AmarA tomAke mithyAvAdIdera dalabhukta mane kari|”
se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! AmAra madhye kona nirvuddhitA nei; tave Ami vizvaprabhura pakSa theke ekajana rasUla|”
“Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra prabhura vArtAsamUha pau~che dei evaM Ami tomAdera ekajana vizvasta hitAkAMkSI|”

“tomarA ki ete vismita haYecho ye, tomAderai ekajanera mAdhyame tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke upadeza eseche, yAte se tomAderake satarka kare? tomarA smaraNa karo ye, AllAha tomAderake nUhera samapradAYera para (tAdera) sthalAbhiSikta karechena evaM tomAdera dehera AkAra vAr3iYe diYechena| ataeva, tomarA AllAhara neYAmatasamUha smaraNa karo, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao|”

tArA valala, “tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanya esecho ye, AmarA eka AllAhara evAdata kari evaM AmAdera vApa-dAdArA yA kichu pUjA karata tA cher3e dei? tA haYe thAkale tumi AmAderake ye jinisera (zAstira) bhaYa dekhAccha AmAdera kAche tA niYe eso, yadi tomAra kathA satya haYa|”

se valala, “tomAdera opara tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke zAsti o krodha avadhArita haYe geche| tomarA ki tomAdera o tomAdera vApa-dAdAdera rAkhA katagulo nAma niYe AmAra sAthe vitarka karate cAo, ye samparke AllAha kona kartRtva denani? tAhale tomarA pratIkSA karo, Amio tomAdera sAthe pratIkSA karachi|”
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra saGgIderake AmAra vizeSa anugrahe rakSA karechilAma evaM yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha amAnya karechila tAdera zikar3a keTe diYechilAma| tArA vizvAsI chila nA|

Ara chAmUda jAtira kAche tAdera bhAi chAlehake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara evAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona upAsya nei| tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke ekaTi pramANa (pAtharera madhya theke veriYe AsA eka virATakAYa uSTrI) eseche| eTi AllAhara uSTrI, tomAdera janya eka nidarzana| ataeva, tAke cher3e dAo, se AllAhara jamine care khAve| tAke anyAYabhAve sparza karo nA; tAhale tomAdera opara kaThina zAsti Asave|”

“smaraNa karo, tini tomAderake Ada jAtira pare tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechena evaM tomAderake pRthivIra vAsindA karechena| sekhAne samatalabhUmite tomarA prAsAda vAnAccha Ara pAhAr3a keTe gharavAr3i nirmANa karacha| tAi AllAhara neYAmatasamUha smaraNa karo evaM pRthivIte golayoga sRSTi karo nA|”

tAra samapradAYera ahaGkArI netArA durvala vale vivecita lokadera madhye yArA ImAna enechila tAderake valechila, “tomarA ki jAna ye, chAleha tAra prabhura pakSa theke prerita?” (javAve) tArA valechila, “tAke yA niYe pAThAno haYeche AmarA to tA vizvAsa kari|”
(takhana) ahaGkArIrA valechila, “tomarA yA vizvAsa karo AmarA tA avizvAsa kari|”
ataHpara tArA uSTrITike hatyA kare o tAdera prabhura Adeza amAnya kare evaM vale, “he chAleha! tumi AmAderake yAra (ye zAstira) bhaYa dekhAccha tA niYe Asa, yadi tumi rasUla haYe thAka|”
takhana bhUmikampa tAderake AghAta kare| phale tArA yAra yAra vAr3ite (mRta avasthAYa) upur3a haYe par3e thAke|

takhana se (chAleha) tAdera dika theke mukha phiriYe neYa Ara vale, “he AmAra samapradAYa! Ami to AmAra prabhura vArtA tomAdera kAche pau~che diYechilAma evaM tomAdera bhAla ceYechilAma, kintu tomarA hitAkAMkSIdera bhAlavAsa nA|”
Ara lUtake pAThiYechilAma| se tAra samapradAYake valechila, “tomarA ki emana (eka) azlIla kAja karacha yA tomAdera Age sArA viztera keu kareni?”
“tomarA kAma-lAlasA pUraNe nArIdera parivarte puruSaderake vyavahAra karacha| tomarA to eka sImAlaMghanakArI samapradAYa|”
tAra samapradAYera kAche (era) kona javAva chila nA| tAi tArA (auddhatyapUrNabhAve) zudhu valala, “ederake tomAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo| erA Asale (ati) pavitratAkAmI loka|
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra parivArera lokaderake rakSA karechilAma| tave tAra strIke naYa| se pechane theke-yAoYA (zAsti kavalita) lokadera madhye chila|
Ami tAdera opara (pAtharera) pravala vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma| ataeva dekha, aparAdhIdera kemana pariNati haYeche|

Ara mAd‌iYAnera (adhivAsIdera) prati tAdera bhAi zoYAivake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara evAdata karo; tini chAr3A tomAdera kona upAsya nei| tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke spaSTa pramANa eseche| ataeva, tomarA mApa o ojana puropuri dio evaM lokaderake tAdera jinisapatra kama dio nA| Ara pRthivIte zAnti sthApanera para sekhAne (AvAra) azAnti sRSTi karo nA| eTAi tomAdera janya bhAla, yadi tomarA ImAnadAra hao|”

“yArA tA~ra (AllAhara) prati ImAna eneche tAderake humaki dite o AllAhara patha theke virata rAkhate evaM tAte vakratA anveSaNa karate tomarA pratiTi pathe vase theko nA| Ara smaraNa karo, yakhana tomarA saMkhyAYa kama chile, tArapara AllAha tomAdera saMkhyA vAr3iYe diYechena| dekha, azAnti sRSTikArIdera kemana pariNati haYeche|”

“yadi tomAdera ekadala AmAke yA niYe pAThAno haYeche tA vizvAsa kare evaM Arekadala vizvAsa nA kare tAhale tomarA dhairya dhAraNa karo, yatakSaNa nA AllAha AmAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dena| tinii to zreSTha mImAMsAkArI|”

tAra samapradAYera ahaGkArI netArA valala, “he zoYAiva! AmarA avazyai tomAke o tomAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche tAderake AmAdera grAma theke vera kare deva; athavA tomarA AmAdera dharme phire Asave|” se valala, “AmarA tA apachanda karaleo?”

“AllAha AmAderake tomAdera dharma theke uddhAra karAra para AmarA yadi AvAra tAte phire yAi tAhale to AllAhara viruddhe AmAdera mithyA Aropa karA have| AmAdera prabhu AllAha nA cAile tomAdera dharme AmAdera Ara phire yAoYAra prazna oThe nA| AmAdera prabhu savakichui tA~ra jJAnera AotAYa rekhechena| AmarA AllAhara oparai bharasA karechi| he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera o AmAdera samapradAYera mAjhe yathArtha mImAMsA kare dAo| kAraNa tumi zreSTha mImAMsAkArI|”
tAra samapradAYera kAphera netArA valala, “tomarA yadi zoYAivera kathAmato cala tAhale avazyai kSatigrasta have|”
ataHpara bhUmikampa tAderake AghAta karala evaM tArA tAdera vAr3ite mRta avasthAYa upur3a haYe par3e raila|
yArA zoYAivake avizvAsa karechila (tArA emanabhAve nizcihna hala) yena tArA sekhAne (tAdera vAr3ighare) vasavAsai kareni| yArA zoYAivake avizvAsa karechila tArAi kSatigrasta haYechila|

ataHpara se tAdera dika theke mukha phiriYe nila Ara valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! Ami tomAdera kAche AmAra prabhura vArtAsamUha pau~che diYechi evaM tomAderake hitopadeza diYechi| tAi kApheradera janya duHkha kari kIbhAve?”
Ami yakhanai kona janapade kona navI pAThiYechi takhanai tAra adhivAsIderake (tAdera avizvAsera kAraNe) duravasthA Ara duHkha-kaSTa dvArA pAkar3Ao karechi, yAte tArA nati svIkAra kare|

tArapara bhAla avasthA dvArA (tAdera) khArApa avasthAra parivartana ghaTiYechi| phale tArA prAcuryera adhikArI haYeche Ara valeche, “AmAdera pUrvapuuruSadera jIvaneo duHkha-kaSTa o sukha-samRddhi esechila|” takhana Ami tAderake emana AkasmikabhAve pAkar3Ao kari ye tArA Terai pAYani|

Ara yadi grAmavAsIrA ImAna Anata o tAkaoYA avalamvana karata tAhale avazyai Ami tAdera janya AsamAna o jaminera varakatasamUha unmukta kare ditAma| kintu tArA (satyake) avizvAsa kareche| tAi Ami tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera janya pAkar3Ao karechi|
ataeva, grAmagulora adhivAsIrA ki rAte ghumanta avasthAYa tAdera opara AmAra zAsti Agamana samvandhe nirApada vodha karechila?
athavA grAmagulora adhivAsIrA ki sakAlavelAYa khelAdhulAYa rata avasthAYa tAdera opara AmAra zAsti Agamana samvandhe nirApada vodha karechila?
tArA ki AllAhara parikalpanA theke nirApada vodha karechila? vastuta kSatigrasta lokerA chAr3A keu AllAhara parikalpanA theke nirApada vodha kare nA|

jaminera (Agera) vAsindAdera pare yArA era uttarAdhikArI haYeche tAdera kAche ki pariSkAra haYani ye, Ami cAile tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe dharate pAri? Ami tAdera antare chApa mere dicchi, phale tArA zunate pAve nA|

seisava janapadera kichu vRttAnta Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karachi| tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa pramANAdi niYe esechila| kintu tArA Agei yA avizvAsa karechila tA Ara vizvAsa karate prastuta chila nA| ebhAvei AllAha kApheradera antare chApa mere dena|
Ami tAdera adhikAMzake pratijJA pAlanakArI pAini; varaM tAdera adhikAMzake avAdhya peYechi|

ataHpara tAdera pare Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzana niYe pherAuna o tAra pAriSadavargera kAche pAThiYechilAma| kintu tArA anyAYabhAve tA pratyAkhyAna kare| sutarAM ceYe dekha, anAcArIdera kemana pariNati haYechila|
mUsA valechila, “he pherAuna! Ami vizvaprabhura pakSa theke ekajana rasUla|”
“AllAha samparke satya chAr3A kichu nA valAi AmAra janya samIcIna| Ami tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke eka spaSTa pramANa niYe esechi| ataeva, vanI isarAIlake AmAra sAthe yete dAo|”
pherAuna valala, “tumi yadi kona nidarzana ene thAka tAhale tA peza karo, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|”
takhana mUsA tAra lAThikhAnA nikSepa karala, Ara amani tA ekaTi jalajyAnta ajagare pariNata hala|
tArapara se tAra hAta vera karala, Ara amani tA darzakadera janya zUbhrojjvala haYe gela|
takhana pherAunera lokadera madhye netRsthAnIYa vyaktirA valala, “avazyai se (mUsA) ekajana vijJa yAdukara;
ye tomAderake tomAdera deza theke vera kare dite cAYa| e vyApAre tomarA ki parAmarza dAo?”
tArA valala, “tAke o tAra bhAike kichuTA avakAza dina Ara edike Apani zahare zahare saMgrahakArI dala pAThAna;
yena tArA ApanAra kAche pratyeka vijJa yAdukarake upasthita kare|”
yAdukarerA pherAunera kAche upasthita hala| tArA valala, “yadi AmarAi vijaYI hai tAhale AmAdera janya avazyai yogya puraskAra thAkate have|”
se valala, “avazyai| adhikantu tomarA (AmAra) nikaTavartI lokadera madhye gaNya have|”
yAdukarerA valala, “mUsA! haYa tumi nikSepa karave, nA haYa AmarAi (Age) nikSepa karava|”
se valala, “tomarAi nikSepa kara|” tArapara tArA yakhana nikSepa karala takhana tArA lokadera cokhaguloke sammohita karala, tAderake AtaGkagrasta karala evaM ekaTA var3a yAdu pradarzana karala|
takhana Ami mUsAke Adeza dilAma ye, tumi tomAra lAThikhAnA nikSepa karo; Ara amani tA tAdera vAnAno vastuguloke gile phelate lAgala|
phale satya pramANita hala Ara tAdera karmakANDa akAryakara haYe gela|
ebhAve tArA sekhAne parAbhUta hala evaM lAJchita haYe phire gela|
yAdukarerA sejadAYa par3e gela|
tArA valala, “AmarA vizvaprabhura prati ImAna enechi;
yini mUsA o hArUnera prabhu|”

pherAuna valala, “Ami tomAderake anumati devAra Agei tomarA tAra prati ImAna Anale? nizcaYai eTA ekaTA cakrAnta| tomarA nagarIra vAsindAdera sekhAna theke vera kare devAra janya nagarIte vasei ei cakrAnta karecho| tomarA (era pariNAma) jAnate pArave|”
“Ami avazyai viparIta dika theke tomAdera hAta-pA keTe deva| tArapara tomAdera sakalake zUle car3Ava|”
tArA valala, “AmAderake to AmAdera prabhura kAche phire yetei have|”

“tumi to ejanyai AmAdera opara pratizodha niccha ye, AmAdera kAche yakhana AmAdera prabhura nidarzanasamUha eseche takhana AmarA tA vizvAsa karechi|” “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake paryApta dhairya dAna karo evaM musalima hiseve AmAdera mRtyu dio|”

pherAunera lokadera madhye netRsthAnIYa vyaktirA valala, “Apani ki mUsA o tAra lokaderake pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi karAra janya evaM ApanAke o ApanAra devatAderake varjana kare calAra janya cher3e devena?” (javAve) se valala, “AmarA tAdera chelederake hatyA karava evaM tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhava| AmarA to tAdera opara parAkramazAlI|”

mUsA tAra lokaderake valala, “tomarA AllAhara kAche sAhAyya cAo Ara dhairya dhara| jamina to AllAharai| tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke cAna era uttarAdhikArI vAnAna| Ara zubha pariNAma to mottAkIdera janyai|”

tArA valala, “AmarA to tomAra AsAra Ageo evaM tomAra AsAra pareo niryAtita haYechi|” se valala, “hate pAre, tomAdera prabhu tomAdera zatruke dhvaMsa karavena evaM pRthivIte tomAderake pratinidhitva dAna karavena, tArapara dekhavena tomarA kemana kAja kara|”
Ami pherAunera lokaderake vachare vachare durbhikSa o phala-phalAdira ghATati dvArA pAkar3Ao karechilAma, yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|

yakhana tAdera kona maGgala hata takhana valata, “eTA AmAdera janyai”| Ara yadi kona amaGgala ghaTata tAhale sejanya mUsA o tAra saGgIderake azubha lakSaNayukta mane kare tAderake dAYI karata| jene rAkha, nizcaYai tAdera azubha lakSaNa AllAhara jAnA Ache| tave tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAne nA|
tArA valechila, “AmAdera opara yAdu karAra janya tumi ye nidarzanai niYe Asa, AmarA tomAra kathAYa vizvAsa karava nA|”
takhana Ami spaSTa nidarzanasvarUpa tAdera opara plAvana, paGgapAla, ukuna, veGa o raktera vAlAi preraNa kari| tavuo tArA ahamikA pradarzana kare evaM aparAdhI theke yAYa|

yakhana tAdera opara zAsti neme Asata takhana tArA valata, “he mUsA! tomAra prabhu tomAra kAche ye oYAdA karechena se anusAre tumi tA~ra kAche AmAdera janya prArthanA kara| tumi yadi AmAdera theke zAsti sariYe dAo tAhale avazyai AmarA tomAra kathAYa vizvAsa karava evaM tomAra sAthe vanI isarAIlake yete deva|”
kintu yakhana Ami tAdera theke ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYera janya zAsti sariYe nitAma se paryanta pau~chAmAtrai tArA tAdera pratizruti bhaGga karata|
sutarAM Ami tAdera opara pratizodha niYechilAma evaM tAderake samudre DuviYe merechilAma; kenanA tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa karechila evaM se samvandhe amanoyogI chila|

Ara yAderake durvala mane karA hata tAderake Ami pRthivIra seisava pUrvAJcala o pazcimAJcalera uttarAdhikArI karalAma yekhAne Ami varakata dAna karechi; evaM yehetu isarAIlera santAnerA (vanI isarAIla) dhairyadhAraNa karechila, tAi tAdera janya tomAra prabhura zreYatara aGgIkAra pUraNa hala; Ara pherAuna o tAra lokerA yA kichu tairI karechila o yesava bhavanAdi u~cu kare nirmANa karechila Ami tA dhvaMsa kare diYechi|

Ami vanI isarAIlake samudra pAra kariYe dei| takhana tArA emana eka jAtira kAche ese par3e yArA tAdera katipaYa pratimAra prati nivedita chila| mUsAra saGgIrA valala, “he mUsA! odera yemana devatArA raYeche temani AmAdera janyao ekaTi devatA vAniYe dAo|” mUsA valala, “tomarA to dekhachi katagulo mUrkha loka|”
“ei lokagulo ye kAje lipta raYeche tAra janya erA dhvaMsaprApta have evaM erA yA kichu karache tA bhrAnta|”
se Aro vale, “Ami ki tomAdera janya AllAha vyatIta anya kona upAsya cAiva, athaca tini tomAderake sArA viztera sakalera opara zreSThatva dAna karechena?”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami tomAderake pherAunera lokadera kavala theke rakSA karechilAma, yArA tomAderake nikRSTa zAsti dita| tArA tomAdera chelederake mere phelata Ara tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| era madhye tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke eka virATa parIkSA chila|

Ami mUsAra janya trizaTi rAta nirdhAraNa karechilAma evaM pare era sAthe Aro daza (rAta) yoga kare tA paripUrNa karechilAma| ebhAve tAra prabhura nirdhArita samaYa calliza rAte pUrNa haYechila| mUsA tAra bhAi hArUnake valechila, “tumi AmAra lokadera madhye AmAra pratinidhi hiseve thAka; Thikamata kAja karave Ara anartha sRSTikArIdera patha anusaraNa karavenA|”

mUsA yakhana AmAra nirdhArita samaYa anuyAYI upasthita haYechila evaM tAra sAthe tAra prabhu kathA valechilena takhana se valechila, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAke dekhAo, Ami tomAke dekhava|” AllAha valena, “tumi AmAke dekhate pAve nA; tumi varaM pAhAr3aTira dike tAkAo| pAhAr3a yadi nijera jAYagAYa sthira thAke tAhalei tumi AmAke dekhate pAve|” erapara tAra prabhu yakhana pAhAr3aTira dike svIYa jyotira vikiraNa ghaTAlena takhana tini seTike cUrNa-vicUrNa kare dilena Ara mUsA vehu~za haYe par3e gela| ataHpara yakhana se saMjJA phire pAYa takhana valala, “mahimA tomAra! Ami tomAra kAche taovA karalAma evaM Amii prathama vizvAsI (halAma)|

tini valalena, “he mUsA! tomAke AmAra rasUla vAniYe evaM tomAra sAthe kathA vale Ami (anyAnya) mAnuSera opare tomAke zreSThatva diYechi| ataeva, Ami tomAke yA dilAma tA grahaNa karo evaM kRtajJa hao|”

Ami tAra janya sava jinisa theke prAptavya zikSA evaM sava jinisera spaSTa vyAkhyA phalakasamUhe likhe diYechi| (evaM valechi) egulo dRr3habhAve dhAraNa karo Ara tomAra samapradAYera lokaderake era zreSTha jinisa grahaNa karate vala| Ami zigagirai tomAderake avAdhya lokadera vAsasthAna dekhAva|

yArA anyAYabhAve pRthivIte dAmbhika AcaraNa kare Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanasamUha theke phiriYe rAkhava| tArA pratiTi nidarzana dekhaleo tA vizvAsa karave nA| tArA satpatha dekhaleo tAke patha hiseve grahaNa karave nA; kintu bhrAnta patha dekhalei tAke patha hiseve grahaNa karave| eTA ejanya ye, tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA valeche evaM se samvandhe tArA amanoyogI|
yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha o parakAlera sAkSAt avizvAsa kare tAdera yAvatIYa kAjakarma naSTa haYe giYeche| tArA yA karata tA chAr3A ki anya kichura pratiphala tAderake deoYA have?

mUsAra samapradAYa tAra anupasthitite tAdera alaMkAra theke (upAsanAra janya) ekaTi vAchurera kAYA vAniYechila| eTite hAmvAravera mata ekaTi zavda hata| tArA ki dekheni ye, seTi tAdera sAthe kathA valate kiMvA tAderake patha dekhAte pAre nA? (tavu) tArA tAkei (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karechila| vastuta tArA chila jAlema|

yakhana tArA anutapta hala evaM dekhate pela ye, tArA pathabhraSTa haYe giYeche takhana valala, “AmAdera prabhu yadi AmAderake anugraha nA karena evaM kSamA kare nA dena tAhale AmarA avazyai kSatigrasta hava|”

yakhana mUsA rAgAnvita o duHkhabhArAkrAnta avasthAYa tAra samapradAYera kAche phire ela takhana valala, “AmAra anupasthitite tomarA ye kAjaTi karale tA kata khArApa! tomarA ki tomAdera prabhura Adezera vyApAre tAr3Ahur3A karale? erapara se (tAorAtera) phalakagulo chu~r3e phelala evaM nijera bhAi hArUnake tAra mAthAra cula dhare nijera dike TAnate lAgala| hArUna valala, “ore AmAra mAYera putra (bhAi)! lokagulo to AmAke durvala mane karechila evaM AmAke prAYa merei phelachila| ataeva, tumi AmAke zatrudera Anandera khorAka vAniYo nA evaM AmAke jAlemadera sArite gaNya karo nA|”
mUsA valala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAke o AmAra bhAike kSamA kare dAo evaM AmAderake tomAra daYAra AotAYa praveza karAo| tumii to savaceYe var3a daYAlu|”
yArA vAchurake upAsya vAniYechila tAdera opara ei duniYAra jIvanei tAdera prabhura krodha o lAJchanA ese par3ave| mithyA racanAkArIderake ebhAvei Ami pratiphala diYe thAki|
tave yArA khArApa kAja karAra para taovA kare o ImAnadAra haYe yAYa tAdera kSetre paravartIte tomAra prabhu avazyai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
pare yakhana mUsAra rAga prazamita haYa takhana se phalakagulo tule neYa| phalakasamUhera lipite seisava lokera janya patha-nirdeza o anugrahera kathA lekhA chila yArA tAdera prabhuke bhaYa kare|

AmAra nirdhArita samaYa o sthAne sAkSAtera janya mUsA tAra samapradAYera sattarajana lokake vAchAi karala| ataHpara yakhana bhUmikampa tAderake AghAta karala takhana mUsA valala, “he AmAra prabhu! tumi icchA karale tAderake o AmAke Agei dhvaMsa karate pArate| AmAdera madhye nirvodha lokadera karmera janya ki tumi AmAderake dhvaMsa karave? e to tomAra parIkSA chAr3A Ara kichu naYa| ei parIkSAra mAdhyame tumi yAke icchA vipathagAmI karave evaM yAke icchA supathagAmI karave| tumi AmAdera abhibhAvaka; tAi AmAderake kSamA kare dAo evaM AmAdera prati anugraha kara| tumii to zreSTha kSamAkArI|”

“Ara AmAdera janya ei duniYAYa o parakAle kalyANa nirdhAraNa kara| AmarA to tomAra dikei phire esechi|” AllAha valalena, “AmAra zAsti Ami yAke cAi diYe thAki evaM AmAra anugraha savakichute parivyApta| tAi yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare o yAkAta deYa evaM yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha vizvAsa kare tAdera janya zigagirai Ami AmAra ei anugraha nirdhAraNa karava|”

(erA to tArAi) yArA sei rasUla o nirakSara navIra (muhAmmAda sa.) anusaraNa kare yAra kathA tArA tAdera tAorAta o inajIle likhita pAcche| se tAderake bhAlakAja karAra Adeza deYa o mandakAja karate niSedha kare, tAdera janya bhAla jinisake vaidha o khArApa jinisake avaidha ghoSaNA kare evaM tAderake bhAramukta o zRMkhalamukta kare| ataeva, yArA tAke vizvAsa, sammAna o sAhAyya kare evaM tAra sAthe prerita Alora anusaraNa kare tArAi saphalakAma|

vala, “he mAnuSa! nizcaYai Ami tomAdera sakalera prati AllAhara rasUla, yini AsamAna o jaminera rAjatvera adhikArI| tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| tini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| ataeva, tomarA AllAha o tA~ra sei rasUla o nirakSara navIra prati ImAna Ana ye AllAha o tA~ra vANIsamUhera opara vizvAsa rAkhe| evaM tomarA tArai anusaraNa karo, yAte saThika pathera sandhAna pAo|”
mUsAra samapradAYera madhye emana ekaTi dala Ache yArA ThikabhAve (mAnuSake) patha-nirdeza deYa evaM ThikabhAve nyAYavicAra kare|

Ami tAderake vAraTi jAti-gotre vibhakta karechilAma| mUsAra lokerA yakhana tAra kAche pAni cAila takhana tAke nirdeza diYechilAma, “tumi tomAra lAThi dvArA pAthare AghAta kara|” phale pAthara pheTe vAraTi jharanA vera haYe Ase| pratyeka dala tAdera pAnipAnera jAYagA cinate pAre| Ara Ami tAdera opara meghera chAYA pradAna kari evaM tAdera kAche (khAdya hiseve) mAn‌ o sAl‌oYA preraNa kari| (Ara vali) AmAra deoYA bhAla jinisagulo khAo| tArA Asale AmAra kona kSati kareni, varaM tArA nijederai kSati karachila|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tAderake valA haYechila, “ei janapade (jerujAleme) vasavAsa karo evaM ekhAnakAra yekhAne vase cAo AhAra karo Ara vala, (he AllAha) AmAdera pApa kSamA kare dAo| Ara mAthA nata kare darajAYa praveza karave| tAhale Ami tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA kare deva| Ami satkarmazIladera Aro vezi deva|
kintu tAderake ye kathA (valate) valA haYechila tAdera madhye anyAYakArIrA tA parivartana kare valechila| tAdera ei anyAYera kAraNe Ami tAdera opara AsamAna theke zAsti pAThiYechilAma|

tAderake samudrera nikaTavartI (tIravartI) sei janapadaTi samvandhe jijJAsA karo; yakhana (sekhAne) tArA zanivArera vyApAre sImAlaMghana karata; yakhana tAdera zanivAra ud‌yApanera dina mAcherA pAnira opare bhese tAdera kAchAkAchi Asata, Ara ye dina tArA zanivAra ud‌yApana karata nA sedina tArA Asata nA| tAdera avAdhyatAra kAraNe ebhAvei Ami tAderake parIkSA karachilAma|

yakhana tAdera ekaTi dala valechila, “kena tomarA emana lokaderake upadeza diccha yAderake AllAha dhvaMsa kare devena kiMvA kaThina zAsti devena?” takhana tArA (upadezadAtArA) valechila, “tomAdera prabhura kAche kaiphiYata deoYAra janya, Ara yAte tArA sAvadhAna hate pAre|”

tAderake ye sava upadeza deoYA haYechila paravartIte tArA yakhana tA bhule gela takhana yArA anyAYa karate niSedha karata Ami tAderake uddhAra kari Ara yArA anyAYa karechila tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAra janya kaThina zAsti dei|
tAderake yA karate niSedha karA haYechila tArA yakhana tAra sImA chAr3iYe gela takhana Ami tAderake valalAma, “tomarA itara vAnara haYe yAo|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAra prabhu ghoSaNA karechilena ye, tini tAdera (ihudidera) viruddhe keYAmata paryanta emana lokadera pAThAte thAkavena yArA tAderake kaThina zAsti deve| nizcaYai tomAra prabhu (avAdhyadera janya) druta zAstidAtA evaM nizcaYai tini (anugatadera janya) kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

Ami tAderake pRthivIte vibhinna dale vibhakta kare diYechi| tAdera madhye keu keu satkarmazIla, AvAra keu keu tAra vyatikrama| Ara Ami tAderake kalyANa o akalyANa dvArA parIkSA karechi, yAte tArA (AllAhara Anugatyera dike) phire Ase|

tAdera para tAdera sthalAbhiSikta haYeche eka (adhama) prajanma, yArA kitAvera uttarAdhikArI haYeche, kintu tArA ei tuccha jagatera sAmagrI grahaNa kare Ara vale, “AmAderake kSamA kare deoYA have”| athaca yadi tAdera kAche erakama Aro sAmagrI Ase tAo tArA grahaNa karave| tAdera theke ki kitAvera aGgIkAra neoYA haYani ye, tArA AllAha samparke satya chAr3A valave nA? tArA to kitAve yA Ache tA pAThao kareche| vastuta parakAlera AvAsai mottAkIdera janya zreYa| tomarA ki tA vojha nA?
Ara yArA kitAvake dRr3habhAve A~kar3e thAke Ara saThikabhAve nAmAya AdAYa kare, erakama satkarmazIladera puraskAra Ami kichutei naSTa kari nA|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami tAdera opare zAmiYAnAra mata pAhAr3a tule dharechilAma, Ara tArA mane karechila ye, seTA tAdera oparei par3ave| (Ami valalAma,) “Ami tomAderake yA diYechi tA zakta kare dhara evaM tAte yA Ache tA smaraNa karo, yAte tomarA dvInadAra hate pAra|”

Ara yakhana tomAra prabhu Adamera santAnadera piTha theke tAdera vaMzadharadera vera karena evaM tAderake tAdera nijedera vyApAre sAkSya dite valena; (ei vale ye,) “Ami ki tomAdera prabhu nai?” tArA vale, “hyA~, AmarA sAkSya dilAma|” eTA ejanya ye, tomarA yena keYAmatera dina nA vala, “AmarA e samparke vekhavara chilAma|”
athavA yena nA vala, “AmAdera vApa-dAdArAi to Age zir‌ka kareche; Ara AmarA halAma tAderai paravartI vaMzadhara| ataeva, tumi ki vAtilapanthIdera kRtakarmera janya AmAderake dhvaMsa karave?
ebhAvei Ami nidarzanasamUha savistAre varNanA kari, yAte tArA (satyera dike) phire Ase|

tumi tAderake sei lokaTira vRttAnta par3e zonAo (lokaTi chila vAl‌jJaAma ivane vAjJaUrAJca nAmaka janaika ihudi paNDita) yAke Ami AmAra nidarzana diYechilAma, kintu se tA cher3e deYa| tArapara zaYatAna tAra pichu neYa| phale se pathabhraSTa haYe yAYa|

Ami icchA karale ai nidarzanasamUhera kalyANe tAke opare oThAte pAratAma kintu se duniYAra prati jhu~ke par3e o nijera pravRttira anusaraNa kare| sutarAM tAra avasthA kukurera avasthAra mata| yadi tumi tAke tAr3A karo tAhaleo se hA~pAYa, AvAra yadi tAke cher3e dAo tAhaleo hA~pAYa| yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale tAderao avasthA se rakama| ataeva, tumi ghaTanAgulo varNanA karo, haYato tArA cintA karave|
ye lokerA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA valechila Ara nijedera pratio juluma karachila tAdera avasthA var3ai khArApa|
AllAha yAke supatha dekhAna sei supathaprApta, Ara yAderake tini vipathe nena tArAi kSatigrasta|

Ami jAhAnnAmera janya aneka jvina o mAnuSa sRSTi karechi| tAdera hRdaYa Ache yA dvArA tArA upalavdhi kare nA; tAdera cokha Ache yA dvArA tArA dekhe nA evaM tAdera kAna Ache yA dvArA tArA zone nA| tArA catuSpada jantura mata, varaM tAra ceYeo adhika vibhrAnta; tArAi prakRta amanoyogI|

AllAhara sundara sundara nAma Ache| ataeva, tomarA tA~ke sesava nAme DAkave| Ara yArA tA~ra nAmasamUhera vyApAre adhArmikasulabha mantavya kare tAderake varjana karave, tArA zigagirai tAdera kRtakarmera phala pAve|
Ami yAderake sRSTi karechi tAdera madhye ekadala Ache yArA satbhAve (mAnuSake) patha dekhAYa evaM sebhAvei nyAYavicAra kare|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kare tAderake Ami dhIre dhIre emanabhAve pAkar3Ao karava ye, tArA jAnatei pArave nA|
Ami tAderake avakAza diYe thAki| Asale AmAra kauzala veza majavuta|
tArA ki cintA kare dekheni? tAdera saGgIra madhye kona pAgalAmi nei| se to eka spaSTa satarkakArI|

tArA ki AsamAna o jaminera kartRtva samparke, AllAha yesava jinisa sRSTi karechena se samparke evaM sambhavata tAdera nirdiSTa samaYa ye ghaniYe Asache se samparke cintA kareni? ataeva, era pare Ara kon‌ kathAYa tArA vizvAsa karave?
AllAha yAderake vipathe nena tAderake keu pathe Anate pAre nA| tini tAderake cher3e dena; tArA tAdera avAdhyatAra mAjhe dizehArA haYe ghurate thake|

tArA tomAra kAche keYAmata samvandhe prazna kare, “tAra nirdhArita samaYa kakhana?” vala, “viSaYaTi kevala AmAra prabhui jAnena| tini chAr3A keui tAra saThika samaYa valate pAre nA| AsamAna o jamine eTi ekaTi gurutara viSaYa| tomAdera kAche tA AkasmikabhAvei Asave|” tArA tomAra kAche (emanabhAve) prazna kare yena tumi se samparke puropuri avahita| vala, “viSaYaTi kevala AllAhai jAnena|” kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (tA) jAne nA|

vala, “AllAha yA icchA karena tA vyatIta Ami AmAra nijerao kona upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAri nA| Ami yadi adRzya viSaYa jAnatAma tAhale vezi kare kalyANa lAbha karatAma evaM akalyANa AmAke sparza karata nA| vastuta Ami ImAnadAra lokadera janya ekajana satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA chAr3A Ara kichu nai|”

tini sei sattA yini tomAderake eka vyakti (Adama) theke sRSTi karechena| tAra thekei tini tAra jor3A (strI hAoYAke) sRSTi karechena yAte se tAra kAche zAnti pAYa| tArapara yakhana strIra sAthe tAra zArIrika saMzrava ghaTe takhana strI garbhavatI haYa| (prathamadike) garbha hAlakA haoYAYa se tA niYe calApherA kare| kintu yakhana tAra garbha bhArI haYa takhana tArA ubhaYe tAdera prabhu AllAhara kAche prArthanA kare vale, “tumi yadi AmAderake susantAna dAna karo tAhale avazyai AmarA (tomAra prati) kRtajJa thAkava|”

ataHpara AllAha tAderake susantAna dile tini tAderake yA diYechena se vyApAre tArA (arthAt tAdera paravartI vaMzadhararA) tA~ra sAthe aMzIdAra sAvyasta kare (arthAt santAnera kalyANArthe deva-devIra AzraYa neYa)| tArA yAderake (AllAhara) aMzIdAra sAvyasta kare AllAha tAdera theke aneka Urdhve|
tArA ki emanasava vastuke (AllAhara) aMzIdAra karache yArA kichui sRSTi kare nA, varaM tAderakei sRSTi karA haYa?
tArA nA tAderake kona sAhAyya dite pAre, nA nijederake sAhAyya karate pAre|
tomarA tAderake satpathe DAkaleo tArA tomAdera kathA mAnave nA| (ataeva) tAderake DAka athavA cupa kare thAka tomAdera janya ekai kathA|
AllAha vyatIta tomarA yAderake DAka tArA to tomAdera matai vAndA| ataeva, tAderake DAkate cAo DAka, tave tArA yena tomAdera DAke sAr3A deYa, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

tAdera ki pA Ache yA diYe hA~Tate pAre? nAki tAdera hAta Ache yA diYe dharate pAre? nAki tAdera cokha Ache yA diYe dekhate pAre? nAki tAdera kAna Ache yA diYe zunate pAre? vala, “tomAdera zarIkaderake DAka, tArapara AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karo Ara AmAke avakAza dio nA|”
“AmAra abhibhAvaka to AllAha, yini kitAva (Ala-koraAna) nAyila karechena| Ara tinii satkarmazIladera abhibhAvakatva karena|”
Ara tA~ke vyatIta yAderake tomarA DAka tArA nA tomAderake kona sAhAyya dite pAre, nA nijederake sAhAyya karate pAre|
Ara yadi tAderake satpathe DAka, tArA zone nA evaM tAderake tumi dekhave, tomAra dike tAkiYe Ache, tave tArA dekhe nA|
kSamA karo, satkAjera Adeza dAo evaM mUrkhaderake upekSA kara|
Ara yadi tomAra kAche zaYatAnera pakSa theke kona kumantraNA Ase tAhale AllAhara AzraYa cAive| nizcaYai tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
mottAkIdera kAche yakhana zaYatAnera pakSa theke kona kumantraNA Ase takhana tArA AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM takhani tArA (satya) dekhate pAYa|
Ara zaYatAnadera dosaraderake tArA (zaYatAnerA) bhraSTatAra dike Tene niYe yAYa| ekSetre tArA kona truTi kare nA|

yakhana tumi tAdera kAche kona nidarzana nA Ana takhana tArA vale, “tumi ekaTA (nidarzana) vAniYe Anale nA kena?” vala, “AmAra kAche AmAra prabhura pakSa theke ohIra mAdhyame yA pAThAno haYa Ami zudhu tAi mene cali| ei koraAna tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke spaSTa pramANa evaM ImAnadAradera janya patha-nirdeza o anugraha|”
(ataeva) yakhana koraAna pATha karA haYa takhana tA manoyoga diYe zunave evaM cupa kare thAkave, yAte tomarA anugraha lAbha karate pAra|
Ara Apana mane vinItabhAve o bhaYera sAthe anucca vAkye sakAle o vikele svIYa prabhuke smaraNa karo evaM amanoyogI haYo nA|
yArA tomAra prabhura kAche Ache tArA (arthAt pherezatArA) tA~ra dAsatvera vyApAre ahaGkAra kare nA; varaM tA~ra guNagAna kare o tA~kei sejadA kare|sejadA

lokerA tomAra kAche ganImatera mAla (yuddhalavdha sampada) samvandhe jAnate cAYa| vala, “ganImatera mAla AllAha o rasUlera| ataeva, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM nijedera pArasparika viSaYAdi saMzodhana kare nAo| Ara AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya karo, yadi tomarA mumina hao|”
mumina to tArAi, AllAhara kathA Alocita hale yAdera antare bhItira saJcAra haYa evaM tA~ra AYAtasamUha telAoYAta karA hale yAdera ImAna vRddhi pAYa| Ara tArA tAdera prabhura oparai bharasA kare|
(mumina tArAi) yArA nAmAya susampanna kare evaM Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tA theke (satkAje) vyaYa kare|
tArAi hala satyikAra mumina| tAdera janya tAdera prabhura kAche raYeche maryAdA, kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
yemana tomAra prabhu yauktika kAraNe tomAke tomAra ghara theke vera karechilena| Ara muminadera ekaTi dala tA apachanda karechila|
satya spaSTa haoYAra parao tArA satyera vyApAre tomAra sAthe vitarka karachila, yena tAderake mRtyura dike niYe yAoYA hacche Ara tArA (sedike) tAkiYe Ache|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana AllAha (tomAdera zatrupakSera) duTo dalera (ekaTi sazastra vAhinI, ArekaTi nirastra kAphelA) ye kona ekaTira vyApAre tomAdera sAthe oYAdA karechilena ye, seTi tomAdera have| tomarA cAcchile, kaNTakamukta (nirastra) dalaTi tomAdera hoka; athaca AllAha cAcchilena tAra vANI dvArA satyake pratiSThita karate o kApheradera zikar3a keTe dite;
kAraNa AllAhara uddezyai chila satyake pratiSThita karA Ara mithyAke nirmUla karA; yadio aparAdhIrA tA apachanda karechila|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomarA tomAdera prabhura kAche sAhAyyera Avedana jAnAcchile evaM tini tomAdera Avedane sAr3A diYe valechilena, “Ami tomAderake eka hAjAra pherezatA pAThiYe sAhAyya karava, yArA ekajanera pechane Arekajana kramAnvaYe Asate thAkave|”
AllAha eTA karechilena kevala susaMvAda hiseve, Ara yAte tomAdera mana prazAnta haYa| Ara sAhAyya kevala AllAhara pakSa thekei Asate pAre| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tini tA~ra pakSa theke prazAnti deoYAra janya tomAderake tanadrAcchanna karechilena evaM tomAderake pavitra karAra janya, tomAdera theke zaYatAnera apavitratA apasAraNa karAra janya, tomAdera antara zakta karAra janya evaM tomAdera pA sudRr3ha karAra janya AkAza theke tomAdera opara pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karechilena|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAra prabhu pherezatAdera kAche vArtA pAThAna, “Ami tomAdera sAthe Achi; ataeva, tomarA muminaderake avicala rAkha| Ami zigagirai kApheradera mane bhIti saJcAra kare deva| takhana tomarA (zatrudera) ghAr3e AghAta karo evaM tAdera pratyeka AGgulera DagAYa AghAta kara|”
eTA e janya ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhAcaraNa kareche| keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhAcaraNa karale AllAha tAke kaThora zAsti dena|
ataeva, (ApAtata) ei zAsti AsvAdana kara| e chAr3Ao kApheradera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti|
he ImAnadAragaNa! yakhana tomarA kApheradera sAthe yuddhera maYadAne mukhomukhi have takhana tAdera dike piTha phirAve nA (pazcAdapasaraNa karave nA)|

yuddhera kauzala avalamvanakArI athavA kona dalera kAche AzraYa grahaNakArI vyatIta ye vyakti sedina tAdera dike piTha phirAve se AllAhara virAgabhAjana have evaM tAra nivAsa have jAhAnnAma, var3a khArApa gantavya!

(yuddhera maYadAne sedina) tomarA tAderake hatyA karani, varaM AllAhai tAderake hatyA karechena evaM tumi yakhana (kaGkara) nikSepa karechile takhana tumi (tA) nikSepa karani, varaM AllAhai nikSepa karechena, yAte tini muminaderake tAra pakSa theke ekaTi sundara parIkSAra mAdhyame parIkSA karate pArena| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
eTAi vyApAra, Ara avazyai AllAha kApheradera Sar3ayantra durvala kare dena|

yadi tomarA mImAMsA cAo tAhale tomAdera kAche mImAMsA ese geche| yadi tomarA (anyAYa theke) virata hao tAhale tomAdera janya maGgala, Ara yadi (anyAYera) punarAvRtti karo tAhale Amio (zAstira) punarAvRtti karava| saMkhyAYa vezi haleo tomAdera dala tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA| nizcaYai AllAha muminadera sAthe Achena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera kathA mene cala evaM (rasUlera kathA) zunate thAkA avasthAYa tAra kAcha theke cale yeYo nA|
Ara sei lokadera mata haYo nA yArA vale, “AmarA zunechi”, athaca tArA zone nA|
AllAhara kAche nikRSTatama prANI hala vadhira o vovArA (avizvAsIrA), yArA kichu vojhe nA|
AllAha yadi tAdera madhye bhAla kichu (Ache vale) jAnatena tAhale avazyai tini tAderake zonAtena| Ara tini yadi tAderake zonAtenao tavu tArA upekSAbhare mukha phiriYe nita|

he ImAnadAragaNa! yakhana AllAhara rasUla tomAderake emana kAjera AhavAna jAnAYa yA tomAderake prANamaYa kare takhana tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera DAke sAr3A deve| Ara jene rAkhave, mAnuSa o tAra antarera mAjhe AllAha prativandhaka hana (arthAt khArApa mAnuSake kichu siddhAnta nite tini vAdhA dena) evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAderake ekatrita karA have|
tomarA emana vipadake bhaYa karave yA tomAdera madhye zudhumAtra jAlemadera oparai Asave nA| Ara jene rekho, AllAhara zAsti var3a kaThora|

smaraNa karo, yakhana pRthivIte tomarA saMkhyAYa kama Ara durvala chile| tomarA bhaYa karate ye, mAnuSa tomAderake uThiYe niYe yAve| tArapara tini tomAderake (nirApada) AzraYa diYechena, nijera sAhAyya dvArA tomAderake zaktizAlI karechena evaM bhAla bhAla jinisa dvArA tomAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA karechena; yAte tomarA kRtajJa hao|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAha o rasUlera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karo nA evaM jenezune nijedera AmAnatasamUhera kheYAnata karo nA|
jene rekho, tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati ekaTi parIkSA vai naYa evaM AllAhara kAche raYeche eka mahA puraskAra|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yadi AllAhake bhaYa karo tAhale tini tomAdera janya nyAYa-anyAYera pArthakyakArI ekaTi mApakAThi devena, tomAdera pApasamUha mocana karavena evaM tomAderake kSamA kare devena| Ara AllAha to var3a dAnera mAlika|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana kApherarA tomAke vandI karAra janya athavA hatyA karAra janya kiMvA (mAtRbhUmi theke) vera kare deoYAra janya tomAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karachila| tArA Sar3ayantra karachila Ara AllAha (tAdera Sar3ayantrera viruddhe) pAlTA kauzala grahaNa karachilena| Ara AllAhai sarvazreSTha kauzalI|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana tArA vale, “AmarA zunechi| icchA karale AmarAo erakama valate pAri| e to AgekAra mAnuSera galpa-kAhini chAr3A Ara kichu naYa|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tArA valechila, “he AllAha! eTA (ei koraAna athavA ei dvIna) yadi tomAra pakSa theke satya haYa tAhale tumi AmAdera opara AsamAna theke pAthara varSaNa karo athavA AmAderake vedanAdAYaka zAsti dAo|”
tave tumi tAdera madhye thAkate AllAha tAderake zAsti devena nA| AvAra tArA kSamA prArthanA karache emana avasthAYao AllAha tAderake zAsti dite cAna nA|

Ara tini tAderake zAsti devena nA kena, yakhana tArA masajide hArAma theke lokaderake virata rAkhe? athaca tArA tAra abhibhAvaka naYa| tAra abhibhAvaka to mottAkIrAi| tave tAdera adhikAMza tA jAne nA|
(AllAhara) gharera kAche tAdera nAmAya valate zisa&ni o hAtatAli chAr3A Ara kichu chila nA| ataeva, nijedera kupharira janya tomarA zAsti AsvAdana kara|

yArA kuphari kare tArA AllAhara patha theke (lokaderake) virata karate nijedera dhana-sampada vyaYa kare thAke| ataeva, tArA tA vyaYa karave; tave avazeSe ei sampada tAdera janya AkSepera kAraNa have| tArapara tArA parAjita have| Ara kApheraderake jAhAnnAme ekatra karA have;

yAte AllAha bhAla lokadera theke khArApa lokaderake pRthaka karate pArena evaM khArApa lokadera ekajanake Arekajanera opara rekhe sakalake stupAkAra kare (ekavAre) jAhAnnAme nikSepa karate pArena| ai lokaguloi kSatigrasta|
kApheraderake vala, yadi tArA (kuphari theke) virata haYa tAhale atIte yA haYeche tA mApha kare deoYA have| Ara yadi punarAvRtti kare tAhale pUrvavartIdera dRSTAnta to Achei|

Ara tAdera sAthe yuddha karate thAka, yAte phetanA (ziraka, kuphara ityAdi adharma) nA thAke Ara dvIna (evAdata) sAmaddhvikabhAve AllAhara janya pratiSThita haYe yAYa| yadi tArA (anyAYa theke) virata haYa tAhale avazyai AllAha tAdera (e) kAja dekhate pAna|
Ara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa (anyAYa cher3e dite rAji nA haYa) tAhale jene rekho, AllAha tomAdera (muminadera) abhibhAvaka; (tini) kata uttama abhibhAvaka o kata uttama sAhAyyakArI!

Arao jene rAkha ye, tomarA ye ganImata (yuddhalavdha sampada) lAbha karo tAra pA~ca bhAgera ekabhAga hala AllAhara, rasUlera, tA~ra AtmIYa-svajanera, etimadera, misakInadera o pathikadera; yadi tomarA AllAhara prati o AmAra vAndAra nikaTa mImAMsAra dine (vadara-yuddhera dine) yA pAThiYechilAma tAra prati vizvAsa rAkha; yedina dui vAhinI parasparera sammukhIna haYechila| Ara AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomarA chile upatyakAra kAchera prAnte (eprAnte) Ara tArA (kApherarA) chila dUrera prAnte (oprAnte), Ara (vyavasAYI) kAphelATi chila tomAdera theke nicu sthAne| (erakama ekaTi avasthAYa) tomarA yadi paraspara (yuddhera janya) oYAdAvaddha hate tAhale se oYAdA pAlane avazyai vyartha hate pArate| tave AllAha ceYechilena emana ekaTi kAja sampanna karate yA Age thekei nirdhArita haYe giYechila; yAte yArA dhvaMsa havAra, tArA eka spaSTa pramANera para dhvaMsa haYa Ara yArA ve~ce thAkAra, tArA eka spaSTa pramANera para ve~ce thAke| Ara nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana AllAha tomAke svapne tAdera saMkhyA kama dekhiYechilena| tini yadi tomAke tAdera saMkhyA vezi dekhAtena tAhale tomarA sAhasa hAriYe phelate evaM siddhAnta nite nijerA vitarke jar3iYe par3ate| kintu AllAha (tomAderake) rakSA karechena| nizcaYai tini antarera viSaYa bhAla kare jAnena|

(smaraNa karo) tomarA yakhana (yuddhera maYadAne) paraspara mukhomukhi haYechile takhana AllAha pUrvanirdhArita ekaTi kAja sampanna karAra janya tomAderake tAdera saMkhyA kama kare dekhiYechilena evaM tAdera dRSTiteo tomAdera saMkhyA kamiYe diYechilena| Ara sakala viSaYa AllAhara kAchei phiriYe neYA have|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yakhana kona vAhinIra mukhomukhi have takhana avicala thAkave evaM AllAhake vezi kare smaraNa karave, yAte tomarA saphala hate pAra|

Ara AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya karave| nijedera madhye vivAda karave nA| yadi tA karo tAhale sAhasa hAriYe phelave evaM tomAdera zakti cale yAve| Ara dhairyadhAraNa karave| nizcaYai AllAha dhairyadhAraNakArIdera saGge Achena|

tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA dambhabhare o loka-dekhAnora janya nijedera ghara theke vera haYeche Ara AllAhara patha theke (mAnuSake) virata rAkhache| tAdera yAvatIYa karmakANDa AllAha ghire rekhechena|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana zaYatAna kApheradera kAche tAdera kAja yauktika vale upasthApana kareche Ara valeche, “Ajakera dine kona mAnuSa tomAdera opara jaYI have nA| Ara Ami tomAdera pAzei raYechi|” kintu yakhana ubhaYa vAhinI eke aparera dRSTisImAYa ese gela takhana se pechanera dike chuTe pAlAla Ara valala, “Ami tomAdera saGge nei| Ami emana kichu dekhate pAcchi yA tomarA dekhacha nA| Ami AllAhake bhaYa kari| (kAraNa) tini kaThora zAstidAtA|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana monAphekarA o yAdera antare (avizvAsera) vyAdhi Ache tArA (musalamAnadera samparke) valachila, “edera dharma ederake dho~kAYa pheleche|” tave yArA AllAhara opara bharasA kare tArA nizcinta; kAraNa AllAha parAkramazAlI, parama prAjJa|
pherezatArA yakhana kApheradera jAnakavaja (prANa haraNa) kare takhana tumi yadi dekhate! tArA tAdera mukhe o pAchAYa AghAta kare Ara vale, “ jvalanta Agunera zAsti AsvAdana kara|”
eTA tomAdera kRtakarmera phala| AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati juluma karena nA|

(kApheradera AcaraNa) pherAunera lokajana o tAdera pUrvavartIdera AcaraNera mata| tArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karechila| tAi AllAha tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe pAkar3Ao karechilena| nizcaYai AllAha zaktizAlI o kaThora zAstidAtA|
era kAraNa ei ye, AllAha kona jAtike kona neYAmata dAna karale tA parivartana karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA tAdera nijedera avasthA parivartana kare| Ara AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

(kApheradera AcaraNa) pherAunera lokajana o tAdera pUrvavartIdera AcaraNera mata| tArA tAdera prabhura nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa karechila| tAi Ami tAderake tAdera pApera kAraNe dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma evaM pherAunera lokaderake DuviYe diYechilAma| tArA savAi jAlema chila|
yArA kuphari kare AllAhara kAche tArAi nikRSTa jIva| ataeva, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
(orA to tArAi) yAdera sAthe tumi cuktivaddha haYecho, kintu orA pratyekavArai nijedera cukti bhaGga kare| Ara orA AllAhake bhaYa kare nA|
ataeva, tumi yadi yuddhe oderake nAgAle pAo tAhale oderake zAYestA kare odera pazcAte avasthAnakArIderakeo chatrabhaGga kare deve; yAte orA zikSA pAYa|
Ara yadi tumi kona samapradAYera kAcha theke aGgIkArabhaGgera AzaGkA karo tAhale tAdera aGgIkArao ekaibhAve tAdera dike chu~r3e mArave| AllAha kakhano aGgIkAra bhaGgakArIdera pachanda karena nA|
kApherarA yena mane nA kare ye, tArA ve~ce giYeche| tArA kakhano (zAstipradAne AmAke) akSama karate pArave nA|

tomarA tAdera viruddhe yataTA pAra zakti o azva-vAhinI prastuta rAkhave yA dvArA AllAhara o tomAdera zatruke evaM tAdera chAr3A anyAnyaderakeo AtaGkita rAkhave| tAderake tomarA cena nA, AllAha cenena| tomarA AllAhara pathe yA kichu vyaYa karave tA puroTAi tomAderake phiriYe deoYA have| tomAdera prati (moTeo) juluma karA have nA|
Ara tArA yadi sandhira dike jho~ke tAhale tumio tAra dike jhu~kave, Ara AllAhara opara bharasA rAkhave| nizcaYai tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
pakSAntare tArA yadi tomAra sAthe pratAraNA karate cAYa tAhale tomAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| tinii svIYa sAhAyya o muminadera dvArA tomAra zakti yugiYechena|

tini tAdera antareo hRdyatA sRSTi karechena| tumi yadi pRthivIra tAvat sampadao vyaYa karate tavuo tAdera antare hRdyatA sRSTi karate pArate nA| kintu AllAha tAdera madhye vandhutva sthApana kare diYechena| nizcaYai tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
he navI! tomAra janya evaM tomAra anusArI muminadera janya AllAhai yatheSTa|

he navI! muminaderake yuddha karate udvuddha kara| tomAdera vizajana dhairyazIla (avicala) loka hale tArA duJcazajanake parAbhUta karave, Ara tomAdera ekazajana hale kApheradera ekahAjAra janake parAbhUta karave; kAraNa, ai lokagulo (Asale) vojhe nA|

ekhana AllAha tomAdera kAja ekaTu hAlakA kare diYechena; kAraNa tini jAnate perechena ye, tomAdera madhyeo kichuTA durvalatA Ache| ataeva, (ekhana) tomAdera ekazajana dhairyazIla loka hale tArA (kApheradera) duJcazajanake parAbhUta karave, Ara tomAdera ekahAjAra jana hale AllAhara hukume (tAdera) dui hAjAra janake parAbhUta karave| AllAha dhairyazIladera saGge Achena|

jamine vyApaka zatrunidhana nA karA paryanta yuddhavandI rAkhA (evaM muktipaNera vinimaYe tAdera cher3e deoYA) kona navIra kAja naYa| tomarA duniYAra sampada cAo; Ara AllAha (tomAdera janya) cAna AkherAta| AllAha parAkramazAlI o parama prAjJa|
yadi viSaYaTi AllAhara pakSa theke Agei nirdhArita nA hata tAhale tomarA yA grahaNa karecho tAra janya tomAdera avazyai ekaTA var3a zAsti hata|
ataeva, tomarA ye vaidha o uttama ganImata (yuddhalavdha sampada) peYecho tA khete (bhoga karate) pAra; tave antare AllAhara bhaYa rAkhave| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he navI! tomAdera hAte ye vandIrA Ache tAderake vala, “yadi AllAha tomAdera antare kona maGgalacintA Ache vale jAnena tAhale tomAdera kAcha theke yA neoYA haYeche tAra ceYe bhAla kichu tini tomAderake dAna karavena evaM tomAderake kSamA kare devena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|”

Ara yadi tArA tomAra sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karate cAYa tAhale era Ageo to tArA AllAhara sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA kareche| se janyai tini tAdera opara (tomAderake) kSamatA diYechena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche o nijedera jAnamAla diYe AllAhara pathe jehAda kareche evaM yArA (tAderake) AzraYa diYeche o sAhAyya kareche tArA savAi eke aparera mitra| Ara yArA ImAna eneche kintu hijarata kareni tAdera prati tomAdera kona dAYadAYitva nei, yatakSaNa nA tArA hijarata kare| Ara yadi tArA dharmera vyApAre tomAdera kAche sAhAyya cAYa tAhale (tAderake) sAhAyya karA tomAdera kartavya; tave tA emana kona samapradAYera viruddhe naYa, yAdera sAthe tomAdera maitrIcukti raYeche| Ara tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tA dekhate pAna|
Ara yArA kAphera tArA eke aparera mitra| tomarA yadi temanaTi nA karo (sava musalamAna eke aparera mitra nA hao) tAhale pRthivIte var3arakamera phetanA-phAsAda sRSTi have|

yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche o AllAhara pathe jehAda kareche evaM yArA (tAderake) AzraYa diYeche o sAhAyya kareche tArAi hacche satyikAra mumina| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|

Ara yArA pare ImAna eneche evaM hijarata kare tomAdera sAthe jehAdao kareche tArAo tomAdera antarbhukta| Ara raktasamparkita AtmIYarA (uttarAdhikAra prazne) AllAhara vidhAne parasparera adhikatara hakadAra| AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|
tomarA ye muzarikadera sAthe cuktivaddha haYechile tAdera prati AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pakSa theke dAYamukti (ghoSaNA karA hala)|
ataeva, tomarA cAramAsa pRthivIte ghure ver3Ate pAra| tave jene rAkhave, tomarA AllAhake apAraga karate pArave nA (tA~ra zAsti theke pAlAte pArave nA) evaM kApheraderake AllAha lAJchita karavena|

Ara mahAna hajjera dine AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera pakSa theke mAnuSera prati ekaTi ghoSaNA ei ye, AllAha muzarikadera vyApAre savarakamera dAYa theke mukta evaM tA~ra rasUlao| tave tomarA yadi taovA karo tAhale seTA tomAdera janya bhAla| Ara yadi (tA theke) mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale jene rAkhave, tomarA AllAhake apAraga karate pArave nA (tA~ra zAsti theke pAlAte pArave nA)| Ara kApheraderake kaSTadAYaka zAstira kathA jAniYe dAo|

tave muzarikadera madhye yAdera sAthe tomAdera cukti haYeche evaM yArA tomAdera se cukti rakSAYa kona truTi kareni kiMvA tomAdera viruddhe kAuke sAhAyyao kareni tAdera vyApAraTi AlAdA| meYAda pUrNa haoYA paryanta tomarA tAdera sAthe cukti mene calave| nizcaYai AllAha mottAkIdera pachanda karena|

ataHpara niSiddha mAsasamUha ativAhita hale muzarikadera yekhAne pAve hatyA karave, pAkar3Ao karave, avarodha karave evaM tAdera janya pratyeka ghA~Tite (OMt pete) vase thAkave| tave yadi tArA taovA kare evaM ThikabhAve nAmAya par3e o yAkAta deYa tAhale tAdera patha cher3e deve| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
Ara yadi muzarikadera keu tomAra kAche AzraYa cAYa tAhale tAke AzraYa deve, yAte se AllAhara kAlAma (koraAna) zone| tArapara tAke tAra nirApada sthAne pau~che deve| eTA ejanya ye, odera jJAna nei|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAthe muzarikadera kIbhAve cukti hate pAre? tave yAdera sAthe masajidula hArAmera kAche tomarA cukti karechile tAdera kathA AlAdA| ataeva, tArA yatakSaNa tomAdera sAthe Thika thAkave tatakSaNa tomarAo tAdera sAthe Thika thAkave| nizcaYai AllAha mottAkIdera pachanda karena|

kIbhAve (tAdera sAthe cukti hate pAre), yakhana tArA tomAdera opara jaYI hale tomAdera AtmIYatA kiMvA cuktira maryAdA rAkhe nA? tArA mukha diYe tomAderake santuSTa rAkhe, tave tAdera antara (tomAdera prati) virUpa thAke| tAdera adhikAMzai phAseka|
tArA nagaNya mUlye AllAhara AYAtasamUha vikri kareche evaM tA~ra pathe vAdhAra sRSTi kareche| tArA yA karachila tA khuvai khArApa|
tArA kona muminera sAthe AtmIYatA kiMvA cuktira maryAdA rAkhe nA| Ara tArAi sImAlaMghanakArI|
tave tArA yadi taovA kare evaM Thikamato nAmAya par3e Ara yAkAta deYa tAhale tArA tomAdera dharmera bhAi (vale gaNya have)| (ebhAve) Ami jJAnI lokadera janya nidarzanasamUha savistAre varNanA kari|

Ara yadi tArA cuktira para zapatha bhaGga kare evaM tomAdera dharmera prati kaTAkSa kare tAhale kAphera netAdera sAthe yuddha karave; kAraNa tAdera janya kona zapatha nei; yAte tArA (anyAYa theke) virata haYa|

tomarA ki emana lokadera sAthe yuddha karave nA yArA tAdera zapatha bhaGga kareche evaM rasUlake vahiSkArera saGkalpa kareche? erAi to prathama tomAdera sAthe (vivAda) zuru kareche| tomarA ki tAderake bhaYa karo? kintu bhaYa to tomAdera AllAhakei karA ucita, yadi tomarA ImAnadAra hao|
tAdera sAthe yuddha karo; yAte AllAha tomAdera hAte tAderake zAsti dite pArena, tAderake lAJchita karate pArena, tomAderake tAdera opara vijaYI karate pArena, muminadera vuka zAnta karate pArena
evaM tAdera antarera krodha dUra karate pArena| Ara AllAha yAra prati icchA kSamAzIla hana| AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|

tomarA ki mane karecho ye, tomAderake cher3e deoYA have? athaca AllAha ekhano tomAdera madhye tAderake cihnita karenani yArA jehAda kareche evaM AllAha, tA~ra rasUla o muminadera chAr3A kona antaraGga vandhu grahaNa kareni| Ara tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

AllAhara masajidasamUha rakSaNAvekSaNa karA muzarikadera kAja hate pAre nA, yArA nijerAi nijedera viruddhe kuphari karAra sAkSya deYa| e dharanera lokadera yAvatIYa kAja niSphala haYe giYeche evaM erA jAhAnnAmei cirakAla thAkave|
AllAhara masajidasamUhera rakSaNAvekSaNa to tArA karave yArA AllAha o parakAle vizvAsa kare, nAmAya kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa evaM zudhu AllAhakei bhaYa kare| Asale erAi saThika pathe raYeche|

tomarA ki hAjIdera khAvAra pAni saravarAha Ara masajidula hArAmera rakSaNAvekSaNake tAdera maryAdAra samAna mane karo yArA AllAha o parakAle vizvAsa kare evaM AllAhara pathe jehAda kare? tArA (savAi) AllAhara kAche samAna (maryAdAsampanna) naYa| AllAha jAlemaderake saThika patha dekhAna nA|
yArA ImAna eneche, hijarata kareche evaM nijedera dhana-sampada o jIvana diYe AllAhara pathe jehAda kareche, maryAdAYa tArAi AllAhara kAche var3a| Ara tArAi saphalakAma|
tAdera prabhu tAderake svIYa anugraha, santuSTi Ara jAnnAtera susaMvAda dicchena, yekhAne tAdera janya sthAYI sukhera vyavasthA raYeche|
sekhAne tArA cirakAlera janya vAsa karave| nizcaYai AllAhara kAche raYeche eka mahAna puraskAra|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera vApa-bhAiYerA yadi ImAnera viparIte kupharike bhAlavAse tAhale tomarA tAderake abhibhAvaka mAnave nA| tomAdera madhye yArA amana vApa-bhAike abhibhAvaka mAne tArAi jAlema|

vala, “yadi AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera ceYe evaM AllAhara pathe jehAdera ceYe tomAdera kAche adhika priYa haYa tomAdera pitArA, tomAdera santAnerA, tomAdera bhAiYerA, tomAdera strIrA, tomAdera gotrIYa lokerA, dhana-sampada yA tomarA upArjana karecho, vyavasA-vANijya yA tomarA mandA haoYAra AzaMkA karo evaM gharavAr3i yA tomarA pachanda karo, tAhale apekSA karate thAka yatakSaNa nA AllAha tAra vidhAna (zAsti) niYe Asena|” AllAha phAsekaderake saThika patha dekhAna nA|

AllAha tomAderake aneka yuddhakSetre sAhAyya karechena; hunAina yuddhera dineo, yakhana tomarA nijedera saMkhyA vezi dekhe ullasita haYechile, kintu tA tomAdera konai kAje Aseni evaM pRthivI prazasta haoYA sattveo tomAdera kAche saGkIrNa mane haYechila evaM pare tomarA pazcAdapasaraNa karechile|

tArapara AllAha tA~ra rasUla o muminaderake prazAnti dAna karechilena, (tomAdera sAhAyyArthe) tomarA dekhani emana senAdala pAThiYechilena evaM kApheraderake zAsti diYechilena| oTAi kApheradera karmaphala|
tAraparao AllAha yAke icchA kSamA karavena| AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAnadAragaNa! muzarikarA Asale apavitra| ataeva, tArA yena e vacharera para Ara masajidula hArAmera kAche nA Ase| Ara yadi tomarA dAridrera AzaMkA karo tAhale (jene rAkha) bhaviSyate AllAha tomAderake svIYa anugrahe abhAvamukta karavena, yadi tini (tA) cAna| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|

kitAvadhArIdera madhye yArA AllAha kiMvA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA, AllAha o tA~ra rasUla yA avaidha ghoSaNA karechena tAke avaidha gaNya kare nA evaM satya dharma grahaNa kare nA tomarA tAdera viruddhe yuddha karo, yatakSaNa nA tArA nati svIkAra kare svecchAYa jiyiYA (isalAmI rASTre amusalimadera opara dhAryakRta karo) pradAna kare|

ihudirA vale oyAYera AllAhara putra evaM khriSTAnarA vale masIha (IsA) AllAhara putra| e hacche tAderai mukhera kathA| tArA pUrvavartI kApheradera matai kathA valache| tAdera opara AllAhara abhizApa par3uka; tArA kIbhAve satya theke vicyuta haYe yAcche!

tArA AllAhake chAr3Ao tAdera yAjaka o pAdrIderake evaM mariYamera putra (IsA) masIhake prabhu vAniYeche| athaca tAderake mAtra ekajana upAsyera (ekamAtra AllAhara) upAsanA karate nirdeza deoYA haYechila| tini chAr3A anya kona upAsya nei| tArA ye zir‌ka karache tini tA theke pavitra|
tArA cAYa mukha dvArA (phu~ diYe) AllAhara (taohIdera) Alo nibhiYe dite; kintu AllAha tA~ra Alora pUrNatAdAna chAr3A Ara kichu hate devena nA, yadio kApherarA tA apachanda kare|
tini sei sattA yini tA~ra rasUlake patha-nirdeza o satya dvInasaha pAThiYechena sava dvInera opara ei dvInake vijaYI karAra janya, yadio muzarikarA tA apachanda kare|

he ImAnadAragaNa! aneka yAjaka o pAdrI anyAYabhAve mAnuSera sampada bhakSaNa (AtmasAt) kare evaM AllAhara pathe (calAYa) vAdhAra sRSTi kare| Ara (he navI!) yArA sonA-rupA jamA kare rAkhe evaM tA AllAhara pathe vyaYa kare nA tAderake eka kaSTadAYaka AyAvera kathA jAniYe dAo|

yedina tA (jamAkRta sonA-rupA) jAhAnnAmera Agune garama karA have evaM tAra dvArA tAdera lalATa, pA~jara o piTha dAgAno have| (Ara tAderake valA have) “ei hala sei sampada yA tomarA nijedera janya jamA rekhechile| ataeva, yA jamA rAkhate ekhana tAra svAda grahaNa kara|

AllAha yedina AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena sedinera Thika karA niYame AllAhara kAche mAsera saMkhyA vAraTi| era madhye cAraTi pavitra (mAsa)| eTAi saThika dharma| e mAsagulote nijedera prati avicAra karo nA evaM muzarikadera viruddhe savAi ekasaGge yuddha karo, yemana tArA tomAdera viruddhe ekasaGge yuddha karache| jene rekho, AllAha mottAkIdera sAthei Achena|

(pavitra) mAsa pichiYe deoYAra kAja kupharite eka saMyojana vai naYa| era dvArA kApheradera madhye vibhrAnti char3Ano haYa| eke (nirdiSTa kona mAsake) tArA kona vachara vaidha kare AvAra kona vachara avaidha kare, yAte AllAha kartRka niSiddha mAsera saMkhyA Thika rekhe AllAha yA avaidha karechena tArA tA vaidha karate pAre| tAdera esava khArApa kAja tAdera kAche yauktika vale upasthApana karA haYeche| AllAha kApheraderake patha dekhAna nA|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera vyApAraTA ki? yakhana tomAderake valA haYa, “AllAhara pathe (jehAde) vera hao” takhana tomarA mATira sAthe A~kar3e thAka (ekevArei gA tulate cAo nA)| tomarA ki AkherAtera parivarte duniYAra jIvana niYei santuSTa? duniYAra jIvanera bhoga to AkherAtera tulanAYa ati nagaNya|

yadi tomarA (AllAhara pathe) vera nA hao tAhale tini tomAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAsti devena evaM anya lokaderake tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena; tomarA tA~ra kona kSati karate pArave nA| AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|

tomarA yadi tAke (rasUlake) sAhAyya nA karo tave (tAra kona asuvidhA have nA, kAraNa) AllAha to tAke takhanao sAhAyya karechilena yakhana kApherarA tAke vera kare diYechila, yakhana se chila duJcajanera dvitIYajana, yakhana tArA dujana guhAYa chila, yakhana se tAra saGgIke valechila, “cintA karo nA, nizcaYai AmAdera sAthe AllAha Achena|” ataHpara AllAha tAra opara zAnti varSaNa karechena, tomarA dekhani emana senAdala (pherezatAdera) diYe tAke samarthana yugiYechena evaM kApheradera kathA heYa pratipanna karechena| Ara AllAhara kathAi samunnata (raYeche)| AllAha parAkramazAlI, parama prAjJa|
hAlakA o bhArI (savala o durvala) ubhaYa avasthAYa abhiyAne veriYe par3a evaM nijedera sampada o jIvana diYe AllAhara pathe jehAda kara| eTAi tomAdera janya maGgala, yadi tomarA jAnate!

yadi Azu lAbha o sahaja saphara hata tAhale avazyai tArA tomAra sahayAtrI hata, kintu gantavyaTi (tAvUka abhiyAna) tAdera kAche sudIrgha mane hala| tArA zigagirai AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave, “AmarA yadi pAratAma tAhale avazyai tomAdera sAthe vera hatAma|” orA nijedera dhvaMsa Deke Anache| AllAha jAnena, orA mithyAvAdI|
AllAha tomAke kSamA karuna! kArA satyavAdI tA spaSTa nA haoYA paryanta evaM kArA mithyAvAdI tA nA jAnA paryanta kena tumi tAderake (abhiyAne nA yAoYAra) anumati dile?
AllAha o zeSa dine (parakAle) vizvAsIrA nijedera sampada o jIvana diYe jehAda karA theke tomAra kAche avyAhati cAive nA| AllAha mottAkIdera samparke bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|
vastuta tomAra kAche tArAi avyAhati cAYa yArA AllAha o zeSa dine (parakAle) vizvAsa kare nA evaM yAdera antare sandehera sRSTi haYeche| tArA tAdera sandehera madhye dvidhAgrasta|

tAdera yadi vera haoYAra icchAi thAkata tAhale tArA sejanya kichu saraJjAma prastuta karata; kintu AllAha tAdera abhiyAtrA apachanda karechena; tAi tini tAderake hatodyama karechena evaM (tAderake) valA haYeche, “yArA (vAr3ite) vase Ache tomarA tAdera sAthei vase thAka|”

tArA yadi tomAdera sAthe vera hata tAhale tomAdera zudhu aniSTai vAr3Ato evaM phetanA (vibheda) sRSTira uddezye avazyai tomAdera mAjhe chuTochuTi karata| Ara tomAdera madhye tAdera kathA zonAra mata lokao raYeche| AllAha jAlemadera samparke bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|
era Ageo tArA phetanA sRSTi karate ceYeche evaM tomAra kAjakarma ulTe diYeche| avazeSe satya eseche evaM AllAhara Adeza vijaYI haYeche; yadio tArA (tA) apachanda karache|
tAdera madhye eka loka Ache ye vale, “AmAke avyAhati dAo evaM AmAke phetanAYa phelo nA|” Are! tArA to phetanAYa par3ei geche| Ara jAhAnnAma avazyai kApheraderake veSTana kare Ache|
tomAra kona kalyANa hale tAdera tA khArApa lAge, kintu tomAra kona vipada hale tArA vale, “AmarA Agei AmAdera kAja sAmale niYechi” evaM tArA takhana sAnande sare par3e|
vala, “AllAha AmAdera bhAgye yA likhe rekhechena tA chAr3A anya kichui AmAdera have nA| tini AmAdera prabhu|” Ara AllAhara oparai muminadera bharasA karA ucita|

vala,”tomarA ki AmAdera janya duTo kalyANera (zAhAdAta o vijaYa) ye kona ekaTi chAr3A Ara kichura apekSA karo? (nizcaYai nA) kintu AmarA tomAdera janya yA apekSA karachi tA hala, AllAha tomAderake nijera pakSa theke athavA AmAdera hAte zAsti devena| ataeva, tomarA apekSA karate thAka, AmarAo tomAdera sAthe apekSA karachi|”
vala, “tomarA svecchAYa vyaYa karo kiMvA anicchAYa (vyaYa karo), tomAdera se vyaYa kichutei kavula have nA| tomarA hale eka avAdhya samapradAYa|”
tAdera vyaYasamUha kavula hate vAdhA zudhu eTAi ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake avizvAsa kareche evaM nAmAya alasabhAve par3e Ara sava vyaYa anicchAYa kare|

ataeva, tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati yena tomAke mugdha nA kare| Asale AllAha cAcchena, esava jinisa dvArA tAderake pArthiva jIvane zAsti devena evaM kAphera avasthAYa tAdera prANa cale yAve (mRtyu have)|
tArA AllAhara nAme halapha kare vale ye, tArA tomAdera loka, kintu (Asale) tArA tomAdera loka naYa, varaM tArA emana eka goSThI yArA (tomAderake) bhaYa kare|
tArA yadi kona AzraYasthala vA guhA kiMvA kona pravezasthala pAYa tAhale sedikei chuTe pAlAve|
tAdera madhye emana lokao Ache yArA chadakA vaNTanera vyApAre tomAke doSAropa kare| yadi tAderake tAra kichu aMza deoYA haYa tAhale khuzI haYa, Ara yadi nA deoYA haYa amani tArA kruddha haYa|

katai nA bhAla hata, yadi AllAha o tA~ra rasUla tAderake yA diYechena tAte tArA santuSTa hata Ara valata, “AllAha AmAdera janya yatheSTa| AllAha tA~ra anugraha theke AmAderake dAna karavena, tA~ra rasUlao| nizcaYai AmarA AllAhake pete cAi|”

chadakA (yAkAta) to kevala garIvadera janya, misakInadera janya, tAra (vyavasthApanAra) sAthe saMzliSTa karmacArIdera janya, yAdera mana AkRSTa karA praYojana tAdera janya, dAsamuktira janya, RNagrastadera janya, AllAhara pathe jehAdakArIdera janya evaM (sahAYa-samvalahIna) pathikera janya| eTA AllAhara avazyapAlanIYa vidhAna| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

tAdera madhye emana lokao Ache yArA navIke kaSTa deYa Ara vale, “se ekaTi kAna (sava kathAYa kAna deYa)|” vala, “(se to) tomAdera maGgalera kAna (tomAdera maGgalera janya yA zonA darakAra tAi zone)| se to AllAhake vizvAsa kare evaM muminadera prati AsthA rAkhe| Ara tomAdera madhye yArA ImAnadAra tAdera janya se rahamatasvarUpa|” yArA AllAhara rasUlake kaSTa deYa tAdera janya raYeche kaSTadAYaka AjAva|
tArA tomAderake santuSTa karAra janya tomAdera kAche AllAhara zapatha kare| athaca (Age) AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake santuSTa karAi tAdera kartavya, yadi tArA ImAnadAra haYa|
tArA ki jAnate pAreni ye, AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera virodhitAkArIra janya nizcitabhAve jAhAnnAmera Aguna raYeche, yAte se cirakAla thAkave? eTAi to carama lAJchanA|

monAphekarA bhaYa pAYa, pAche muminadera kAche emana kona sUrA nAyila karA haYa yA tAdera (monAphekadera) antarera kathA tAderake (muminaderake) avahita kare deYa| vala, “tomarA ThATTA-vidrUpa karate thAka; tave tomarA yA bhaYa karacha nizcaYai AllAha tA prakAza kare devena|”

yadi tAderake prazna karo tAhale valave, “AmarA to zudhu kathAvArtA valachilAma Ara khela-tAmAzA karachilAma|” vala, “tomarA ki AllAha o tA~ra vidhAnasamUha evaM tA~ra rasUlake niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karachile?”
ajuhAta dekhiYo nA| tomarA ImAna AnAra para kuphari karecho| Ami yadi tomAdera ekadalake kSamAo kare dei tavu anya ekadalake zAsti deva, kAraNa tArA aparAdhI chila|

monApheka puruSerA Ara monApheka nArIrA ekai dalabhukta| orA khArApa kAjera Adeza deYa Ara bhAla kAja theke virata rAkhe, evaM (dAna karAra parivarte) nijedera hAta vandha kare rAkhe| tArA AllAhake bhule giYeche, tAi tinio tAderake bhule giYechena| nizcaYai monAphekarA pApAcArI|

AllAha monApheka puruSa o monApheka nArI evaM kApheraderake jAhAnnAmera Agunera oYAdA karechena| tAra madhye tArA cirakAla thAkave| seTAi tAdera janya yatheSTa| AllAha tAderake abhizapta karechena evaM tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI zAsti|

(tomarA) tomAdera pUrvavartIdera matai| tArA zaktite tomAdera ceYe pravala chila evaM tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santatio tomAdera ceYe vezi chila| tArA tAdera aMza bhoga karechila; tomarAo tomAdera aMza bhoga karecho, yemana tomAdera pUrvavartIrA tAdera aMza bhoga karechila evaM tArA yemana anarthaka kathAvArtA valechila tomarAo temana anarthaka kathAvArtA valecho| tArAi sei loka, duniYA o AkherAte yAdera karmasamUha niSphala haYe giYeche Ara tArAi kSatigrasta|

tAdera kAche ki tAdera pUrvavartI nUhera samapradAYa, Ada o chAmUda jAti, ivarAhImera samapradAYa evaM mAd‌iYAna o ulTe-deoYA janapadasamUhera adhivAsIdera saMvAda pau~cheni? tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa pramANa niYe esechilena| ataeva, AllAha to tAdera prati juluma karenani, varaM tArAi nijedera prati juluma karata|

ImAnadAra puruSerA o ImAnadAra nArIrA eke aparera suhRda| tArA bhAla kAjera Adeza deYa o khArApa kAja theke virata rAkhe, nAmAya kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kare| ederake AllAha anugraha karavena| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArIderake oYAdA karechena jAnnAtera, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita have o yekhAne tArA ciradina thAkave evaM (oYAdA karechena) sthAYI jAnnAte sundara sundara vAsasthAnera| Ara AllAhara santuSTii savaceYe var3a| seTAi mahAna sAphalya|
he navI! kAphera o monAphekadera viruddhe jehAda karo evaM tAdera prati kaThora hao| tAdera nivAsa hala jAhAnnAma, var3a khArApa ThikAnA!

tArA AllAhara zapatha kare vale ye, tArA (khArApa) kichui valeni; athaca tArA kupharira kathA valeche evaM isalAmagrahaNera para (AvAra) kuphari kareche evaM emana kAja (rasUlake hatyA) karate ceYechila yA tArA karate pAreni| ekaTimAtra vAstavatA chAr3A tAdera emana zatrutA karAra kona kAraNa nei| Ara tA hala, AllAha o tA~ra rasUla svIYa anugrahe tAderake samRddhizAlI karechena| sutarAM tArA yadi taovA kare tAhale tAdera janyai bhAla have| Ara yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale AllAha tAderake ihakAla o parakAle kaSTadAYaka zAsti devena| pRthivIte tAdera kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI nei|

tAdera madhye kichu loka Ache yArA AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra kare valechila, “tini yadi svIYa anugraha theke AmAderake dAna karena tAhale avazyai AmarA chad‌kA (yAkAta) deva evaM avazyai satkarmazIladera antarbhukta hava|”
ataHpara yakhana tini tAderake svIYa anugraha theke dAna karalena takhana tArA tA niYe kArpaNya karala evaM (nijedera aGgIkAra theke) mukha phiriYe cale gela|
era zAstisvarUpa tini (AllAha) tA~ra sAthe tAdera sAkSAtera dina paryanta tAdera antare kapaTatA saJcAra karena, kAraNa tArA AllAhara sAthe kRta oYAdA bhaGga karechila evaM mithyA valata|
