tArA ki jAnate pAreni ye, AllAha tAdera gopana kathA o gopana salA-parAmarza avagata Achena, evaM AllAha adRzya viSaYasamUha khuva bhAla kare jAnena?

yArA muminadera madhye svecchAYa dAna-sadakAkArIderake evaM yArA kaSTArjita sAmAnya vastu chAr3A (dAna karAra mata) kichu pAYa nA tAderake kaTAkSa kare o tAdera niYe vidrUpa kare AllAha tAderake pAlTA vidrUpa karavena| Ara tAdera janya raYeche kaSTadAYaka zAsti|

tumi tAdera (monAphekadera) janya kSamA cAo Ara nA cAo—yadi tAdera janya sattara vArao kSamA cAo—AllAha tAderake kichutei kSamA karavena nA| era kAraNa, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake avizvAsa kareche| AllAha phAsekaderake saThika patha dekhAna nA|

(tAvUka abhiyAne aMzagrahaNa nA kare) AllAhara rasUlera pechane theke-yAoYA lokagulo vase vase Ananda kareche evaM nijedera sampada o jIvana diYe AllAhara pathe jehAda karate apachanda kareche Ara valeche, “garamera madhye abhiyAne vera haYo nA|” vala, “jAhAnnAmera Aguna Aro aneka vezi garama;” yadi tArA vujhata!
tArA (ekhana) ekaTukhAni hAsuka; (pare) nijedera kRtakarmera phale aneka kA~dave|

ataHpara AllAha yadi tomAke tAdera kona dalera kAche phiriYe Anena evaM (takhana) tArA (tomAra sAthe) vera haoYAra janya tomAra anumati cAYa tAhale tumi valave, “Asale tomarA AmAra sAthe kakhanao vera have nA evaM AmAra sAthe zatrura viruddhe yuddhao karave nA| prathamavAre tomarA to vase thAkatei pachanda karechile, ataeva, (ekhanao) pechane theke-yAoYA lokadera sAthei vase thAka|”

tAdera (monAphekadera) madhye keu mArA gele tumi tAra janya kakhanao doYA karave nA (jAnAyA nAmAya par3ave nA); tAra kavarera pAze dA~r3Aveo nA| (kAraNa) tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake avizvAsa kareche evaM phAseka (avAdhya) avasthAYa mArA giYeche|
tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati yena tomAke vismita nA kare| vastuta AllAha cAcchena, osava diYe tAderake duniYAYa zAsti devena Ara kAphera avasthAYa tAdera prANa cale yAve (mRtyu have)|

“AllAhara prati ImAna Ana o tA~ra rasUlera saGge theke jehAda karo” ei nirdezasamvalita kona sUrA yakhana avatIrNa haYa takhana tAdera madhye sAmarthyavAnerA tomAra kAche (jehAde nA yAoYAra) anumati cAYa evaM vale, “AmAderake avyAhati dAo, yAte AmarA (vAr3ite) vase-thAkA lokadera saGge thAkate pAri|”
tArA pechane theke-yAoYA mahilAdera saGge thAkatei pachanda kareche| tAdera antare chApa mere deoYA haYeche; yAra phale tArA vujhate pAre nA|
kintu rasUla o tAra sAthera ImAnadAragaNa tAdera sampada o jIvana diYe (AllAhara pathe) jehAda kareche| tAdera janyai kalyANa raYeche evaM tArAi saphalakAma|
AllAha tAdera janya jAnnAta tairI kare rekhechena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita| tArA sekhAne anantakAla vAsa karave| eTAi to mahA saphalatA|

veduInadera madhya theke ajuhAta pezakArIrA ela, yAte tAderake (yuddhe nA yAoYAra) anumati deoYA haYa| Ara yArA (vAr3ite) vase raila tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAthe mithyA valechila| tAdera madhye yArA kuphari kareche zigagirai tAdera opara kaSTadAYaka zAsti neme Asave|

(jehAde aMzagrahaNa nA karAYa) durvaladera viruddhe kiMvA pIr3itadera viruddhe athavA yAdera vyaYa karAra mata kichu nei tAdera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei, yadi tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati Antarika thAke| satkarmazIladera viruddhe abhiyogera kona kAraNa nei| AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

tAdera viruddheo (kona abhiyoga) nei yArA tomAra kAche vAhanera janya ele tumi valechile, “AmAra kAche to tomAderake deoYAra mata kona vAhana nei|” takhana tArA vyaYa karAra mata kichu nA pAoYAra kaSTe azrupUrNa naYane phire giYechila|

Asale abhiyoga tAdera viruddhe, yArA dhanI haoYA sattveo tomAra kAche (jehAde nA yAoYAra janya) anumati cAYa| tArA pechane theke-yAoYA mahilAdera sAthe (vAr3ite) thAkate pachanda kareche| AllAha tAdera antare chApa mere diYechena; tAi tArA jAnate pArache nA|

tomarA tAdera kAche phire ele tArA (monAphekarA) tomAdera kAche (nAnA) ajuhAta peza karave| tumi valave, “tomarA (kona) ajuhAta peza karo nA, AmarA tomAdera kathA vizvAsa karava nA, AllAha itimadhyei AmAderake tomAdera samparke jAniYe diYechena| AllAha o tA~ra rasUlai tomAdera karmakANDa dekhavena| avazeSe tomAderake gopana o prakAzya savakichu samparke avagata sattAra (AllAhara) kAche phiriYe neoYA have, takhana tomarA yA kichu karate tini tomAderake tA avahita karavena|”

tomarA tAdera kAche phire ele tArA tomAdera kAche AllAhara nAme zapatha karave, yAte tomarA tAdera viSaYaTi upekSAra dRSTite dekha| Thika Ache, tomarA tAderake upekSAi kara| (kAraNa) tArA apavitra, Ara tAdera upArjanera phalasvarUpa jAhAnnAmai tAdera AvAsasthala (have)|
tArA tomAdera kAche zapatha karave, yAte tomarA tAdera prati santuSTa hao, kintu tomarA tAdera prati santuSTa haleo AllAha ai avAdhya lokadera prati kichutei santuSTa havena nA|
veduInarA kuphari o monAphekite adhika pAraGgama evaM AllAha tA~ra rasUlera opara yA nAyila karechena tAra sImArekhA samvandhe (tArA) adhikatara ajJa| Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|

kichu kichu veduIna Ache yArA (AllAhara pathe) nijedera vyaYake jarimAnA mane kare evaM tomAdera vipadApada Asuka ei pratIkSAYa thAke| tAdera oparai durvipAka (neme Asave)| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

AvAra kichu kichu veduIna Ache yArA AllAha o parakAlera prati vizvAsa rAkhe evaM (AllAhara pathe) nijedera vyaYake AllAhara naikaTyalAbha o rasUlera doYA pAoYAra achilA mane kare| Asalei tA tAdera janya (AllAhara) naikaTyalAbhera ekaTi achilA| AllAha tAderake svIYa anugrahera mAjhe praveza karAvena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa|

prathamadikera mohAjera o AnasAradera prati evaM tAdera yathArtha anusArIdera prati AllAha santuSTa, evaM tArAo AllAhara prati santuSTa| tAi AllAha tAdera janya jAnnAta prastuta kare rekhechena yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita| tArA sekhAne cirakAla thAkave| eTAi to var3a sAphalya|

tomAdera AzepAzera veduInadera madhye o madInAvAsIdera madhye kichu kapaTa loka Ache| tArA jida kare kapaTatA karache| tumi tAderake cena nA, tave Ami tAderake cini| tAderake Ami duJcavAra zAsti deva, tArapara tAderake bhaYAnaka eka zAstira dike niYe yAoYA have|

Ara ekadala loka Ache yArA nijedera pApa svIkAra kareche| tArA bhAla kAjera sAthe khArApa kAja miziYe phelechila (arthAt bhAlamanda duJcarakama kAjai karechila|) AllAha tAderake kSamA kare devena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

tumi tAderake pavitra o parizodhana karAra janya tAdera sampada theke sadakA (yAkAta) grahaNa karo evaM tAdera janya doYA kara| tomAra doYA avazyai tAdera janya zAntira kAraNa (have)| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera taovA kavula karena o (tAdera) dAna-sadakA grahaNa karena evaM kevala AllAhai kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu?

Ara vala, “tomarA kAja karo, AllAha tomAdera kAja dekhavena, tA~ra rasUla o muminagaNao (dekhave)| tArapara tomAderake sei sattAra (AllAhara) kAche phiriYe neoYA have yini adRzya o dRzyamAna (savarakama) vastu samparke jAnena| takhana tomarA yA karate tini tomAderake tA avagata karavena|”
Ara kichu loka Ache yAdera vyApAre siddhAnta AllAhara nirdezera janya sthagita rAkhA haYeche| tAderake haYa tini zAsti devena, nA haYa kSamA kare devena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|

Ara yArA kSatisAdhanakalpe, kupharira tAr3anAYa, muminadera madhye vibheda sRSTira abhilASe evaM itipUrve AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhe yuddhakArIdera janya ghA~Ti hiseve vyavahArera uddezye ekaTi masajida (masajide dirAra) vAniYeche (tAdera samparke sAvadhAna thAkave); tArA nizcaYai zapatha kare valave, “AmAdera uddezya to bhAla”; tave AllAha sAkSya dicchena, tArA mithyuka|

ai masajide tumi nAmAye dA~r3iYo nA| ye masajidaTi (kuvAra masajida) prathamadina thekei tAkaoYAra opara bhitti kare pratiSThita haYeche tomAra nAmAya par3Ara janya seTAi adhikatara upayogI| sekhAne katipaYa loka Ache yArA pavitra thAkate bhAlavAse| Ara AllAha pavitratA arjanakArIdera pachanda karena|

ataeva, ye loka AllAhara bhaYa o santuSTira opara svIYa bhavanera bhitti sthApana kare se ki bhAla, nA ye par3apar3a eka bhAGganera kinArAYa tAra bhavanera bhitti sthApana kare Ara ei bhavana tAke niYe jAhAnnAmera Agune bheGge par3e se bhAla? AllAha jAlemaderake hedAYeta karena nA|

ye bhavanaTi (masajide dirAra) tArA nirmANa kareche tA tAdera antare sarvadA eka sandehera vastu haYei thAkave, ye paryanta nA tAdera antarasamUha TukarA TukarA haYe yAYa (arthAt tArA ai bhavana nirmANera janya sArAjIvana sandehera antarjvAlAYa jvalate thAkave)| Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha to muminadera kAcha theke tAdera jIvana o sampada kine niYechena| era mUlya hiseve (parakAle) tAdera janya jAnnAta raYeche (arthAt AllAhara kAcha theke parakAle jAnnAta lAbhera pratizruti peYe muminarA tAdera jAnamAla visarjana dicche)| tArA AllAhara pathe yuddha karache evaM (zatruke) hatyA karache o (nijerA) nihata hacche| eTA tAorAta, inajIla o koraAne (varNita) AllAhara satya oYAdA| Ara AllAhara ceYe var3a oYAdA pUraNakArI ke Ache? ataeva, tomarA ye vikraYa sampanna karecho tAte santuSTa thAka| Ara oTAi var3a sAphalya|

(ei muminarA) taovAkArI, evAdatakArI, (AllAhara) prazaMsAkArI, royA pAlanakArI (vA AllAhara pathe paribhramaNakArI), ruku-sejadAkArI (nAmAya AdAYakArI), nyAYera Adeza dAnakArI, anyAYa theke viratakArI evaM AllAhara sImAsamUha (vidhi-vidhAna) rakSAkArI| tumi (ei) muminaderake (jAnnAtera) susaMvAda dAo|
AtmIYa-svajana haleo jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI vale nizcita haoYAra para muzarikadera janya kSamAprArthanA karA navI o ImAnadAradera ucita naYa|

ivarAhImera vAvAra janya tAra kSamAprArthanA to chila kevala tAra (vAvAra) sAthe kRta tAra ekaTi pratijJAra kAraNe| kinta yakhana tAra kAche pariSkAra haYe gela ye, se (vAvA) AllAhara ekajana zatru takhana se tAra theke dAYamukta haYe gela (tAra sAthe samparka chinna karala)| ivarAhIma avazyai vinaYI o suzIla|
kona samapradAYake patha dekhAnora para tArA ki ki parihAra karave tA spaSTa vale nA deoYA paryanta AllAha tAderake vipathagAmI karena nA| AllAha savakichu bhAlabhAve jAnena|
AsamAna o jaminera rAjatva AllAharai| tini vA~cAna, tini mArena| AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI nei|

navIra prati evaM mohAjera o AnasAradera madhye yArA saMkaTera samaYe (tAvUka abhiyAnakAle) tA~ra anusArI haYechila tAdera prati AllAha anugrahazIla haYechena, yakhana itimadhyei tAdera madhye ekaTi dalera mane (e vyApAre) vibhrAnti sRSTira upakrama haYechila, ataHpara tini tAderake kSamAo kare diYechilena| nizcaYai tini tAdera prati sahAnubhUtizIla, parama daYAlu|

sei tinajanera pratio (AllAha anugrahazIla haYechena) yAdera samparke siddhAnta sthagita rAkhA haYechila, yakhana prazasta pRthivI tAdera janya saMkucita haYe giYechila Ara tAdera nijedera jIvana tAdera kAche kaThina haYe giYechila evaM tArA mane karechila ye AllAhara zAsti theke (pAlAnora janya) tA~ra kAche chAr3A kona AzraYasthala nei| ataHpara tini tAdera prati anugrahazIla halena, yAte tArA taovA kare| nizcaYai AllAha anugrahazIla, karuNAmaYa|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM satyavAdIdera saGge thAka|

madInAra adhivAsI o tAdera AzapAzera veduInadera (abhiyAne nA giYe) AllAhara rasUlera pechane theke yAoYA evaM rasUlera jIvanake bhAla nA vese nijedera jIvanake bhAlavAsA Thika haYani| tA ejanya ye, jehAdakArIrA AllAhara pathe ye tRSNA, klAnti vA kSudhA sahya kare athavA kApheraderake rAgAnora mata ye padakSepai neYa kiMvA kona zatrura ye kona kSatii kare tAra vinimaYe tAdera AmalanAmAYa ekaTi kare satkarma likhita haYa| AllAha to satkarmazIladera pratiphala naSTa karena nA|

Ara tArA (AllAhara pathe jehAde) choTa kiMvA var3a yA kichui vyaYa kare athavA ye kona upatyakA atikrama kare, (tAra janya) AllAha tAderake tAdera zreSThatama karmera pratiphala devena vale tAdera AmalanAmAYa tA likhe rAkhA haYa|

muminadera sakalera ekasaGge (abhiyAne) vera haoYA samIcIna naYa| tAdera pratyeka dala theke ekaTi kare aMza kena vera haYa nA? (arthAt pratyeka dala theke ekaTi kare aMza vera haoYA ucita|) yAte tArA (zahare avasthAnakArIrA) dvInera jJAna arjana karate pAre evaM tAdera lokerA (abhiyAna theke) phire ele tAderake (zikSAdAnera mAdhyame) satarka karate pAre, yAte tArAo satarka haYa|

he ImAnadAragaNa! kApheradera madhye yArA tomAdera kAchAkAchi raYeche tAdera sAthe yuddha cAliYe yAo| tArA yena tomAdera madhye kaThoratA dekhate pAYa| Ara jene rAkhave, AllAha mottAkIdera sAthei Achena|

yakhana (koraAnera) kona sUrA avatIrNa haYa takhana tAdera (monAphekadera) madhye keu keu vale, “eTA tomAdera kAra ImAna vRddhi kareche?” Asale yArA ImAnadAra, ei sUrA tAdera ImAna vRddhi kare evaM tArA khuzI haYa|
pakSAntare yAdera antare (avizvAsera) vyAdhi Ache, ei sUrA tAdera (antarera) paGkilatAra sAthe Aro paGkilatA vRddhi kare evaM tArA kAphera avasthAYa mRtyuvaraNa kare|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, tAderake prati vachara duJcaekavAra kare (vipadApada diYe) parIkSAYa phelA haYa? tAraparao tArA taovA kare nA kiMvA zikSAgrahaNa kare nA|

Ara yakhanai kona sUrA avatIrNa haYa, tArA eke anyera dike tAkAYa (Ara vale), “keu ki tomAderake dekhache?” tArapara tArA cale yAYa| AllAha tAdera antarasamUha (satya theke) phiriYe rekhechena; kAraNa, tArA eka nirvodha janagoSThI|
tomAdera kAche tomAdera madhya thekei ekajana rasUla eseche| tomarA yAte kaSTa pAo tA tAra janyao kaSTadAYaka| se tomAdera kalyANakAmI evaM muminadera prati snehazIla o daYAlu|

tathApi yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa (tomAra Anugatya nA kare) tave tAderake valave, “AmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| Ami tA~rai opara nirbhara kari evaM tinii mahAna Arazera (siMhAsanera) mAlika|”

Alipha lAma rAJca [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| egulo prajJApUrNa granthera (koraAnera) AYAta|

mAnuSera janya eTA ki ekaTA vismaYera vyApAra ye, Ami tAdera madhya thekei ekajanera kAche ei vale ohI pAThiYechi ye, lokaderake satarka karo Ara muminaderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya tAdera prabhura kAche ucca maryAdA (athavA satkarmera puraskAra) raYeche? tAi kApherarA valate lAgala, “nizcaYai e to eka prakAzya yAdukara|

tomAdera prabhu to sei AllAha, yini chaYadine AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena| tArapara Araze (siMhAsane) samAsIna haYe savakichu paricAlanA karachena| tA~ra anumati pAoYAra parai kevala keu kichura supAriza karate pAre| ei hacchena tomAdera prabhu AllAha| ataeva, tomarA tA~ra evAdata kara| tave ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

tA~ra kAchei tomAdera sakalera pratyAvartana (nirdhArita)| AllAhara oYAdA satya| tinii prathama sRSTi karena; pare ImAnadAra o satkarmazIladera nyAyya pratiphala deoYAra janya AvAra sRSTi karavena| tave yArA kAphera, kuphari karAra kAraNe tAdera janya raYeche garama pAnira zaravata o kaSTadAYaka zAsti|

tinii prakhara kiraNera janya sUrya Ara snigdha Alora janya canadra sRSTi karechena| ei canadrake tini katagulo parimApa-stare vinyasta karechena, yAte tomarA vacharera saMkhyA o hisAva jAnate pAra| eke AllAha yathArthai sRSTi karechena| tini jJAnI lokadera janya nidarzanasamUha vyAkhyA kare thAkena|
nizcaYai rAta o dinera parivartane evaM AsamAna o jamine AllAhara sakala sRSTite tAkaoYA avalamvanakArIdera janya aneka nidarzana raYeche|
yArA AmAra sAthe sAkSAtera AzA rAkhe nA evaM pArthiva jIvanei santuSTa Ache o tA niYei nizcinta raYeche, Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha samparke gAphela haYe Ache,
nijedera kRtakarmera kAraNei tAdera ThikAnA (have) jAhAnnAma|
(pakSAntare) yArA vizvAsa kare o satkAja kare tAdera vizvAsera kAraNei tAdera prabhu tAderake (saThika) pathera sandhAna devena evaM sukhera jAnnAte tAdera nica diYe nadI pravAhita have|

sekhAne tAdera doYA have, “he AllAha! tumi mahiYAna”; sekhAne tAdera (pArasparika) abhivAdana have, “sAlAma (zAnti)” evaM tAdera doYA zeSa have ei vale ye, sakala prazaMsA AllAra, yini nikhila jagatera prabhu|

AllAha yemana druta mAnuSera kalyANa karate cAna, temana druta tini yadi tAdera akalyANa karatena tAhale avazyai tArA dhvaMsa haYe yeta| tAi yArA AmAra sAkSAtera AzA kare nA tAderake Ami tAdera avAdhyatAra mAjhe emanabhAve cher3e dei ye, tArA dikabhrAnta haYe ghurate thAke|

Ara mAnuSa yakhana kaSTe par3e takhana se zuYe, vase o dA~r3iYe AmAke DAke| tArapara Ami yakhana tAra kaSTa dUra kare dei takhana se emanabhAve cale yAYa ye, se yena tAra kaSTera janya AmAke DAkeini| emanibhAve sImAlaMghanakArIdera dRSTite tAdera kAjakarma zobhana karA haYeche|

tomAdera pUrve aneka prajanmake Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yakhana tArA anyAYa karechila| athaca tAdera rasUlagaNa tAdera kAche spaSTa pramANAdi niYe esechila, kintu tArA ImAna Anate prastuta chila nA| ebhAvei Ami pApIderake zAsti diYe thAki|
ataHpara tomarA kIbhAve kAja karo tA dekhAra janya pRthivIte Ami tAdera pare tomAderake pratinidhi karechi|

yakhana tAderake AmAra spaSTa AYAtasamUha par3e zonAno haYa takhana yArA AmAra sAthe sAkSAtera pratyAzI naYa tArA vale, “tumi eTA chAr3A anya kona koraAna niYe eso kiMvA eTAke parivartana kara|” tumi vala, “Ami to nijera pakSa theke eTA parivartana karate pAri nA| AmAra kAche ye ohI Ase Ami zudhu tAi mene cali| Ami yadi AmAra prabhura kathAra anyathA kari tAhale nizcaYai AmAra eka mahAdivasera zAstira bhaYa raYeche|”

vala, “AllAha yadi (temana) icchA karatena tAhale Amio tomAderake ei koraAna par3e zonAtAma nA Ara tinio tomAderake tA jAnAtena nA| Ami to ei koraAna AsAra Ageo tomAdera mAjhe ekaTA vaYasakAla avasthAna karechi| tomarA ki tavuo vujhate pAra nA?”
ataeva, ye AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare kiMvA tA~ra AYAtasamUhake mithyA vale tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke hate pAre? pApIrA kakhanao saphala haYa nA|

tArA AllAha chAr3A emana kichura upAsanA kare yA tAdera nA kSati karate pAre, nA upakAra; tArA vale, “erA AllAhara kAche AmAdera supArizakArI (have)|” vala, “tomarA ki AllAhake emana kichu jAnAte cAccha yA AsamAne kiMvA jamine Ache vale tini jAnena nA?” tini pavitra evaM tArA (tA~ra sAthe) zarIka kare emana savakichura Urdhve|

(prathame) sava mAnuSa to eka samapradAYabhukta (eka dharmAvalamvI) chila| pare tArA matabheda kare| yadi tomAra prabhura pakSa theke ekaTi kathA Agei nirdhArita nA thAkata tAhale yA niYe tArA matabheda karache tAdera madhye tA mImAMsA kare deoYA hata|

tArA vale, “tAra kAche tAra prabhura pakSa theke kona nidarzana Aseni kena?” tumi vale dAo, “adRzya viSaYa to kevala AllAhara kAchei thAke; sutarAM tomarA apekSA karate thAka, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSA karachi|”

kaSTabhogera para mAnuSake Ami yakhana anugraha AsvAdana karAi, takhani AmAra nidarzanasamUha niYe tArA chalanA kare| vala, “AllAha drutatama kauzalakArI|” tomarA ye sava chalanA karo AmAra dUtagaNa (pherezatArA) tA likhe rAkhe|

tinii tomAderake sthale o samudre calAcala karAna| emanaki (kona kona samaYe emanao haYa ye) tomarA yakhana nauyAne thAka evaM segulo ArohIdera niYe anukUla vAtAse cale Ara tArA tAte Ananda pAYa, takhana (haThAt) tAte jhar3o hAoYA ese lAge evaM sava jAYagA (caturdika) theke tAdera dike Dheu Asate thAke Ara tArA mane kare ye, tArA pariveSTita (mRtyura sammukhIna) haYe giYeche, takhana tArA khA~Ti dharmavizvAse AllAhake DAke Ara vale, “tumi yadi AmAderake ei vipada theke rakSA karo tAhale AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava|”

kintu tini yakhana tAderake (vipada theke) rakSA karena, amani tArA pRthivIte anyAYabhAve vAr3AvAr3i (zuru) kare| he mAnuSa! tomAdera vAr3AvAr3i kevala tomAdera nijederai kSati karave| pArthiva jIvanera (kSaNasthAYI) bhoga (karate pAra)! tArapara AmAra kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana (avadhArita)| takhana Ami tomAderake tomAdera kRtakarmasamUha avahita karava|

Asale (ei) pArthiva jIvanera udAharaNa erakama: yemana Ami AsamAna theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karalAma, yAra phale bhUmite ghana haYe gAchapAlA janmAla yA theke mAnuSa o pazu AhAra kare thAke| avazeSe bhUmi yakhana tAra sAja dhAraNa karala o susajjita hala Ara tAra adhivAsIrA mane karala ye, tArAi era hartAkartA, takhana rAte kiMvA dine sekhAne AmAra nirdeza pau~che gela evaM Ami tAke phasala keTe-neoYA jamira mata kare dilAma, yena gatakAlao tA (phasale) samRddha chila nA| cintAzIla lokadera janya ebhAvei Ami (AmAra) nidarzanasamUha savistAre varNanA kari|
AllAha zAntira nivAsera (jAnnAtera) dike DAkena evaM yAke cAna saThika pathe paricAlita karena|
yArA bhAla kAja kare tAdera janya raYeche kalyANa evaM vAr3ati puraskAra| kona kAlimA kiMvA lAJchanA tAdera cehArA Acchanna kare nA| tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

Ara yArA khArApa kAja kare tArA (tAdera) khArApa kAjera anurUpa pratiphalai pAve| lAJchanA tAderake Acchanna kare rAkhe| AllAhara hAta theke tAdera kona rakSAkArI nei| tAdera cehArA yena andhakAra rAtera TukarA diYe Acchanna karA haYeche| tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

Ara (smaraNa karo) yedina Ami tAdera sakalake ekatra karava, tArapara muzarikadera valava, “tomarA o tomAdera zarIkarA tomAdera jAYagAYa dA~r3iYe thAka|” tArapara Ami tAderake pRthaka kare deva, Ara tAdera zarIkarA valave, “tomarA to AmAdera evAdata karate nA|”
“AmAdera o tomAdera mAjhe sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa| tomAdera (ai) evAdata samvandhe AmarA to kichui jAnatAma nA|”

sekhAnei pratyeke tAra pUrvera kRtakarma yAcAi karave evaM tAderake tAdera saThika prabhura kAche phiriYe neYA have, Ara tArA ye sava mithyA (deva-devI) udbhAvana karata tA tAdera theke udhAo haYe yAve|

vala, “ke tomAderake AsamAna o jamina theke jIvikA pradAna kare? athavA zravaNazakti o dRSTizaktira mAlika ke? Ara ke mRta theke jIvitake o jIvita theke mRtake vera kare evaM ke savakichu sampanna kare?” dekhave, tArA valave, “AllAha”| takhana tumi valo, “tavuo ki tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karave nA?”
ei hacche tomAdera saThika prabhu AllAha| ataeva, satyera pare (vAire) vibhrAnti chAr3A Ara kI thAkate pAre? ataeva, (ei satya theke) tomarA kIbhAve vicyuta haccha?
ebhAve phAsekadera samparke tomAra prabhura kathAi saThika hala ye, tArA ImAna Anave nA|

vala, “tomAdera zarIkadera (tomarA yAderake AllAhara sAthe zarIka karo tAdera) madhye emana keu Ache ki ye sRSTira sUcanA o tAra punarAvRtti kare?” vala, “AllAhai sRSTira sUcanA o tAra punarAvRtti karena| ataeva, tomarA kIbhAve (satya theke) vicyuta haccha?”

vala, “tomAdera zarIkadera madhye emana keu Ache ki ye satyera patha dekhAYa?” vala, “AllAhai satyera patha dekhAna| tAhale yini satyera patha dekhAna tini, nAki yAke patha nA dekhiYe dile nijei pathera sandhAna pAYa nA se Anugatya pAoYAra vezi yogya? tomAdera haYeche ki? tomarA kIbhAve vicAra karo?”
tAdera adhikAMzai kevala anumAnera opara cale| Asale satyera jAYagAYa anumAna kona kAje Ase nA| nizcaYai tArA yA kare AllAha tA bhAla karei jAnena|

ei koraAna AllAha vyatIta anya kAro vAnAno vastu naYa, varaM tA pUrvavartI AsamAni kitAvera satyatA samarthanakArI evaM vidhAnasamUhera vyAkhyA, yAra madhye kona sandeha nei evaM yA sArA jAhAnera prabhura pakSa theke Agata|
nAki tArA vale ye, se (muhAmmada) eTA vAniYeche| tumi vala, “tAi yadi haYa tAhale tomarAo era mata ekaTi sUrA vAniYe Ana, evaM (e kAje) AllAha vyatIta yAke pAra DAka, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

varaM emana jinisake (koraAnake) tArA mithyA vale abhihita kareche ye samparke tArA bhAlabhAve avagata haYani evaM yAra tAtparya tAdera kAche spaSTa haYani| emanibhAve tAdera pUrvavartIrAo (satyake) mithyA vale abhihita karechila| ataeva dekha, (ai) jAlemadera kI pariNati haYechila!
tAdera madhye keu keu tA (koraAna) vizvAsa karave, AvAra tAdera madhye keu keu tA vizvAsa karave nA| Ara tomAra prabhu anartha sRSTikArIderake khuva bhAlabhAve jAnena|
tArA yadi tomAke mithyAvAdI vale tAhale tumi valave, “AmAra kAjera dAYa AmAra evaM tomAdera kAjera dAYa tomAdera| Ami yA kari tA theke tomarA dAYamukta evaM tomarA yA karo tA theke Amio dAYamukta|”
tAdera madhye keu keu tomAra kathA zravaNa kare| kintu tArA yadi nA vojhe tave ki Ara tumi (ei) vadhiraderake (kathA) zonAte pArave?
AvAra tAdera madhye keu keu tomAra dike tAkAYa| kintu tArA yadi nA dekhe tave ki Ara tumi (ei) andhaderake patha dekhAte pArave?
Asale AllAha mAnuSake ekaTuo juluma karena nA; tave mAnuSa nijederake juluma kare thAke|

Ara (hAzare) yedina tini tAderake ekatrita karavena sedina mane have yena (pRthivIte) tAdera avasthAna chila dinera kichuTA samaYamAtra| (sedina) tArA eke aparake cinate pArave| (pRthivIte thAkate) yArA AllAhara sAthe sAkSAt haoYAke avizvAsa karechila evaM hedAYetaprApta chila nA tArAi nizcita kSatigrasta have|
Ara Ami tAderake (zAstira) ye oYAdA karachi tomAke tAra kichuTA dekhAi kiMvA (tA nA dekhiYei) tomAra mRtyu ghaTAi, AmAra kAchei tAdera pratyAvartana| Ara tArA yA karache AllAha tAra sAkSI thAkachena|
pratyeka jAtira janya ekajana rasUla thAke| yakhana tAdera (sei) rasUla Ase takhana tAdera madhye savakichu nyAYera sAthe niSpanna haYa| tAdera prati kona anyAYa karA haYa nA|
Ara tArA vale, “yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, ei oYAdA (zAsti) kave Asave?”

tumi vale dAo, “AllAhara icchA chAr3A Ami to AmAra nijerao kona kSati kiMvA upakAra karate pAri nA| pratyeka janagoSThIra janya ekaTi nirdhArita samaYa Ache| yakhana tAdera sei samaYa Ase takhana tArA tA eka muhUrtao vilamvita kiMvA egiYe Anate pAre nA|”
vala, “tomarA AmAke vala, rAte kiMvA dine yadi tomAdera kAche AllAhara zAsti ese par3e? (takhana kI karave?) pApIrA tA~ra kAcha theke tAr3Ahur3A kare kI pete cAYa?”
tAhale ki zAsti yakhana esei par3ave takhana tomarA tA vizvAsa karave? ekhana ki (vizvAsa) karo? tomarA to era janyai tAr3Ahur3A karate|
tArapara jAlemaderake valA have, “cirantana zAsti AsvAdana kara| tomarA yA upArjana karate tomAderake tArai pratiphala deoYA hacche|”
tArA tomAra kAche jAnate cAYa, tA (zAsti) ki satya? vala, “hyA~, AmAra prabhura zapatha! avazyai tA satya evaM tomarA (tA dite AllAhake) apAraga karate pArave nA|

yadi (kaThina hAzarera dina zAstira sammukhIna) pratyeka jAlema vyakti pRthivIra savakichurao mAlika haYa tAhale tA diYe se (nijeke vA~cAnora janya) muktipaNa dite cAive| Ara yakhana tArA zAsti dekhate pAve takhana anutApa lukAnora ceSTA karave (athavA antare dAruNa anutApa anubhava karave)| tAdera viSaYaTi nyAyyabhAve niSpanna karA have| tAdera prati kona rakama avicAra karA have nA|
jene rAkha! AsamAne o jamine yA kichu Ache tAra mAlika kevala AllAha| jene rAkha! nizcaYai AllAhara pratizruti satya; tave tAdera adhikAMzai (tA) jAne nA|
tinii vA~cAna, tinii mArena evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
he mAnuSa! tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke upadezavANI o antarera vyAdhira cikitsA evaM muminadera janya pathanirdeza o anugraha (koraAna) eseche|
vala, “(tA) AllAhara daYA o anugrahe (eseche); ataeva, tArA yena ete Anandita haYa|” tArA yA saJcaYa karache tAra ceYe tA uttama|

vala, “AmAke vala to, AllAha tomAdera janya ye jIvikA dAna karechena tomarA tAra madhye kichu hArAma o kichu hAlAla sAvyasta karale!” vala, “AllAha ki tomAderake (eTA karAra) anumati diYechena, nAki tomarA AllAhara nAme mithyA vAniYe valacha?”

yArA AllAhara nAme mithyA vAniYe vale keYAmatera dina samvandhe tAdera dhAraNA ki? (tArA ki sedina pAra peYe yAve?) nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla; kintu tAdera anekei kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|

tumi ye avasthAYai thAka kiMvA koraAnera ye aMza thekei pATha karo athavA tomarA ye kAjai karo, Ami tomAdera (sava kAjera) sAkSI thAki, yakhana tomarA tA karate thAka| jamine kiMvA AsamAne aNu parimANa jinisao tomAra prabhura gocarera vAire naYa| era thekeo choTa kiMvA var3a sava jinisai ekaTi spaSTa dalile lipivaddha Ache|
jene rAkha! AllAhara priYa vAndAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
yArA (AllAhake) vizvAsa kareche o (tA~ke) bhaYa kare
tAdera janya pRthivIra jIvane o parakAle (sAphalyera) susaMvAda raYeche| AllAhara kathAra kona nar3acar3a haYa nA| eTAi var3a sAphalya|
tAdera kathAYa tumi duHkha peYo nA| Asale yAvatIYa zakti AllAhara| tinii savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

jene rAkha! yArA AsamAne Ache Ara yArA jamine Ache savAi AllAhara (kartRtvAdhIna)| Ara yArA AllAha vyatIta anya kichuke (tA~ra) zarIkarUpe DAke tArA kisera anusaraNa kare? tArA to kevala AndAjera anusaraNa kare evaM tArA zudhu mithyA vAniYe vale|

tinii tomAdera janya rAta vAniYechena yAte tomarA takhana vizrAma karate pAra evaM dina vAniYechena yAte tomarA savakichu dekhate pAra| ete emana lokadera janya nidarzana Ache yArA zunate pAYa (gabhIrabhAve cintA kare)|

tArA (kApherarA) vale, “AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena|” tini (esava theke) pavitra, tini (savakichura) abhAvamukta| AsamAne yA kichu Ache evaM jamine yA kichu Ache sava tA~rai| (AllAha samparke tomarA ye emana kathA valacha) tomAdera to era kona pramANa nei| tomarA ki AllAha samvandhe yA jAna nA tAi valacha?
vala, “yArA AllAha samvandhe mithyA vAniYe vale tArA kakhanao saphala have nA|”
duniYAYa (tAdera janya raYeche) kSaNikera bhogavilAsa| tArapara AmAra kAchei tAdera pratyAvartana nirdhArita Ache| takhana Ami tAderake tAdera kupharira kAraNe kaThora zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

Ara tAderake nUhera vRttAnta par3e zonAo| se tAra lokaderake valechila, “he AmAra lokerA! Ami ye tomAdera mAjhe Achi evaM tomAderake AllAhara nidarzanasamUha smaraNa kariYe dicchi eTA yadi tomAdera kAche kaSTakara mane haYa tAhale Ami AllAhara oparai nirbhara karalAma| ekhana tomarA tomAdera kAja Thika karo evaM (praYojane) tomAdera zarIkadera Deke lao! pare yena tomAdera kAja tomAdera kaSTera kAraNa nA haYa| tArapara AmAra vyApAre siddhAnta nAo, AmAke kona avakAza dio nA|”

“Ara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo (AmAra kathA mAnate rAji nA hao) tAhale (jene rAkha) Ami tomAdera kAche kona vinimaYa cAini; AmAra vinimaYa to AllAhara kAchei raYeche; Ara AmAke (AllAhara) anugata thAkAra nirdeza deoYA haYeche|”

kintu tArA tAke avizvAsa karala| pare Ami tAke o tAra saGge naukAYa yArA chila tAderake uddhAra kari o vaMza-paramparAYa (pRthivIra) vAsindA vAnAi evaM yArA AmAra vidhAnasamUha amAnya karechila tAderake DuviYe dei| sutarAM lakSya karo, yAderake satarka karA haYechila tAdera kemana pariNati haYechila!

nUhera pare Ami yAra yAra samapradAYera kAche Aro rasUla pAThiYechi| tArA tAdera kAche nidarzana niYe esechila| kintu tArA (avizvAsIrA) pUrve yA avizvAsa karechila (pareo) tA vizvAsa karate prastuta chila nA| ebhAvei Ami vAr3AvAr3ikArIdera antara sila kare dei|
tAdera pare Ami mUsA o hArUnake AmAra nidarzanasaha pherAuna o tAra pANDAdera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma| kintu tArA uddhata AcaraNa kare, Ara tArA chila katipaYa aparAdhI loka|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra pakSa theke satya ela takhana tArA valala, “eTA to pariSkAra yAdu|”
mUsA valala, “tomAdera kAche satya AsAra para tomarA se samparke emana kathA valacha? eTA ki yAdu? yAdukarerA to saphala haYa nA|”

tArA valala, “tumi ki AmAdera kAche ejanya esecho ye, AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke ye vizvAsera opara peYechi tA theke AmAderake phiriYe Anave evaM pRthivIte tomAdera duJcajanera (mUsA o hArUna) pratipatti have? AmarA tomAdera duJcajanake vizvAsa kari nA|”
pherAuna (tAra lokaderake) valala, “tomarA pratiTi vijJa yAdukarake AmAra kAche niYe eso|”
tArapara yakhana yAdukarerA ela takhana mUsA tAderake valala, “tomarA yA nikSepa karate cAo nikSepa kara|”
ataHpara yakhana tArA nikSepa karala takhana mUsA valala, “tomarA yA enecho tA yAdu| acirei AllAha tA nasyAt kare devena| AllAha to anartha sRSTikArIdera karma Thika rAkhena nA|”
“evaM aparAdhIrA pachanda nA karaleo AllAha tA~ra vANI dvArA satyake pratiSThita kare thAkena|”

kintu pherAuna tAderake zAsti dite pAre vale tAra o tAdera pANDAdera bhaYe mUsAra samapradAYera katipaYa santAna chAr3A keu tAra prati vizvAsa vyakta karala nA| Ara pherAuna to pRthivIte eka pratApazAlI vyakti, se chila sImAlaMghanakArIdera ekajana|
mUsA valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomAdera yadi AllAhara prati vizvAsa thAke tAhale tA~ra opara bharasA karo, yadi tomarA (AllAhara icchAra kAche) AtmasamarpaNakArI hao|”
takhana tArA valala, “AmarA AllAhara opara bharasA karalAma| he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake jAlemadera niryAtanera zikAra vAniYo nA|
evaM tomAra kRpAYa AmAderake kApheradera hAta theke rakSA kara|”

Ami mUsA o tAra bhAiYera kAche nirdeza pAThAi, “tomarA tomAdera lokadera vasavAsera janya misare gharavAr3ira vyavasthA karo, tomAdera gharagulo kevalAmukhI karo evaM (tAte) nAmAya kAYema kara| Ara muminaderake susaMvAda dAo|”

mUsA valala, “he AmAdera prabhu! tumi to pherAuna o tAra pANDAderake pArthiva jIvane jA~kajamaka o dhanasampada diYecho; he AmAdera prabhu! tArA to (esava diYe lokaderake) tomAra patha theke vibhrAnta karave; he AmAdera prabhu! tumi tAdera dhanasampada dhvaMsa kare dAo evaM tAdera antara kaThora rekho, yAte tArA kaSTadAYaka zAsti nA dekhA paryanta ImAna nA Ane (arthAt ImAna AnAra pUrve zAsti dekhate pAYa)|”
tini valena, “tomAdera duJcajanera doYA kavula haYeche| ataeva, tomarA (nyAYera opara) sthira theko evaM yArA jAne nA kichutei tAdera patha anusaraNa karo nA|”

Ami vanI isarAIlake samudra pAra kare dilAma| takhana pherAuna o tAra sainyarA vAr3AvAr3i o sImAlaMghanera uddezye tAdera pechane pechane chuTala| avazeSe yakhana se Duvate lAgala takhana valala, “Ami vizvAsa karechi ye, yAra prati vanI isarAIla ImAna eneche tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| Ara Ami musalimaderai ekajana|”
ekhana (Duvate vase ImAnera kathA valacha)? athaca pUrve tumi viruddhAcaraNa karechile evaM tumi chile anartha sRSTikArIdera anyatama|
Aja Ami tomAra dehaTi rakSAra vyavasthA karachi, yAte tumi tomAra paravartIdera janya ekaTi nidarzana haYe thAka| Ara aneka mAnuSai AmAra nidarzanasamUhera prati ekevAre amanoyogI|

Ami vanI isarAIlake uttama vAsasthAne vasavAsera suyoga kare dilAma evaM utkRSTa jinisa theke tAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA karalAma| tArapara tAdera kAche jJAna nA AsA paryanta tArA matabheda kareni (arthAt jJAna AsAra para tArA matabheda karala)| ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karata nizcaYai tomAra prabhu keYAmatera dina tA mImAMsA kare devena|

Ami tomAra kAche yA nAyila karechi se samparke tomAra mane yadi kona sandeha thAke tAhale yArA tomAra pUrvavartI kitAva (tAorAta o inajIla) pATha kare tAderake jijJesa kara| Asale tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura pakSa theke satya eseche| tAi kichutei tumi sandihAna haYo nA|
yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhake avizvAsa kare tumi kakhano tAdera mata haYo nA; tAhale tumi kSatigrasta have|
yAdera vyApAre (kAphera avasthAYa mArA yAve vale) tomAra prabhura kathA cUr3Anta haYe Ache tArA ImAna Anave nA;
tAdera kAche pratiTi nidarzana eleo, yatakSaNa nA tArA kaSTadAYaka zAsti dekhate pAve|

tave kena emana ekaTi samapradAYao chila nA yArA (zAsti dekhAra para) ImAna enechila evaM tAdera ImAna tAdera upakAre esechila? ekamAtra iunusera samapradAYa vyatIta| tArA yakhana ImAna Anala takhana Ami pArthiva jIvane tAdera theke lAJchanAra zAsti tule nilAma evaM ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tAderake (jIvanasukha) upabhoga karate dilAma|
yadi tomAra prabhu cAitena tAhale to pRthivIte yArAi Ache tArA savAi ekatre ImAna Anata| ataeva, tumi ki mAnuSake ImAna AnAra janya javaradasti karave?
AllAhara hukuma chAr3A kAro pakSe ImAna AnA sambhava haYa nA| Ara yArA anudhAvana kare nA tini tAdera opara zAsti dhArya karena|
vala, “AsamAne o jamine yA kichu Ache tA dekha|” tave nidarzanasamUha o bhIti-pradarzana avizvAsIdera kona upakAre Ase nA|
ataeva, tArA ki tAdera pUrve yArA cale giYeche tAdera ghaTanAvalIra matai kona kichura janya apekSA karache? vala, “tAhale tomarA apekSA karo, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSA karachi|”
parizeSe Ami AmAra rasUladerake o yArA ImAna Ane tAderake rakSA kari| viSaYaTi emanai; AmAra dAYitva hisevei Ami muminaderake rakSA kari|

vala, “he mAnuSa! yadi AmAra dvIna (isalAma) samvandhe tomAdera kona sandeha thAke tAhale (jene rAkha) tomarA AllAhake chAr3A yAdera evAdata karo Ami tAdera evAdata karava nA| Ami evAdata kari AllAhara, yini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna| AmAke to mumina hate nirdeza deoYA haYeche|”
“Ara ei (nirdezao AmAke deoYA haYeche) ye, tumi ekaniSTha haYe dvInera prati tomAra mukhamaNDala sthira rAkha (arthAt sthIrabhAve dvInamukhI thAka) evaM kichutei muzarikadera dalabhukta haYo nA|”
“Ara AllAha chAr3A emana kichuke Deko nA yA tomAra kona upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAre nA| yadi (tA) karo tAhale avazyai tumi jAlemadera dalabhukta vale gaNya have|”

AllAha yadi tomAke kona kaSTa dena tAhale tini chAr3A keu tA AsAna karate pAre nA| AvAra tini yadi (svIYa anugrahe) tomAra kona kalyANa karate cAna tAhale keu tAra (se) anugraha ThekAte pAre nA| tA~ra vAndAdera madhye tini yAke cAna tAke tAra (se kalyANera) nAgAla pAiYe dena| tinii kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

vala, “he mAnuSa! tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke satya ese geche| ekhana ye saThika pathe calave se tAra nijera maGgala karave| Ara ye vipathagAmI have se tAra nijerai kSati karave| Ami to Ara tomAdera karmavidhAYaka nai!”
tomAra prati ye nirdeza pAThAno haYa tumi tA mene cala evaM AllAhara vicAra nA AsA paryanta dhairya dhara| tini halena zreSTha vicAraka|

Alipha lAma rAJca [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| (he navI! tumi vale dAo) eTi emana ekaTi kitAva yAra AYAtasamUha parama prAjJa o sarvajJa sattAra (AllAhara) pakSa theke sunipuNabhAve o bhAge bhAge vinyasta karA haYeche,
yAte tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro evAdata nA kara| nizcaYai Ami tomAdera janya tA~ra pakSa theke ekajana satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA|

Ara tomarA tomAdera prabhura kAche kSamA cAo o tA~ra dike phire eso| tAhale tini tomAderake eka nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta sundarabhAve (jIvanera sukha) bhoga karate devena evaM pratyeka maryAdAvAnake tAra (yathArtha) maryAdA devena| Ara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale avazyai Ami tomAdera janya eka bhaYAnaka dinera zAstira AzaGkA kari|
AllAhara kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana| Ara tini savakichu karate sakSama|

jene rAkha, tArA tA~ra kAcha theke lukAnora janya nijedera vuka ghuriYe rAkhe| jene rAkha, tArA yakhana vastrAvRtao haYa takhanao tArA yA gopana kare Ara yA prakAza kare tini tA (sava) jAnena| tini antarera gopana viSaYa bhAlabhAve avagata raYechena|
pRthivIte calamAna sakala prANIra jIvikAra dAYitva AllAhara| tini tAdera avasthAnasthala o saMrakSaNasthala jAnena| savakichui eka spaSTa granthe (lipivaddha) Ache|

tini sei sattA yini chaYa dine AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena, Ara takhana tA~ra siMhAsana chila pAnira opare, yAte tomAdera madhye kAje ke zreSTha tini tA parIkSA karate pArena| Ara tumi yadi (tAderake) vala, “mRtyura para tomAderake uThAno have” tAhale kApherarA avazyai valave, “eTA to spaSTa yAdu chAr3A Ara kichu naYa|”

Ara Ami yadi ekaTA nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta tAdera zAsti sthagita rAkhi tAhale tArA avazyai valave, “zAstiTA ATake rAkhache kise?” jene rAkha, yedina oTA ese par3ave sedina tAdera theke Ara tA phiriYe neYA have nA evaM tArA yA niYe ThATTA-maskarA karache tA tAderake ghire dharave|
Ara Ami yadi mAnuSake AmAra anugrahera svAda grahaNa karAi evaM pare tA pratyAhAra kare nei tAhale nizcaYai se bhISaNa hatAza o akRtajJa haYa|
Ara yadi duHkha-kaSTa sparza karAra para tAke Ami sukha AsvAdana karAi tAhale se vale, “AmAra duravasthA keTe giYeche|” se takhana khuva khuzI o ahaMkArI haYa|
tave yArA dhairyadhAraNa o satkAja kare tArA era vyatikrama| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA Ara var3arakama puraskAra|

ataeva, “kena tAra kAche kona bhANDAra nAyila karA haYani kiMvA kena tAra sAthe kona pherezatA Aseni?” tAdera e kathA valAra kAraNe tomAra kAche ohIra mAdhyame yA pAThAno haYa (tAdera kAche pracArera velAYa) haYato tAra kichuTA tumi cher3e deve evaM ejanya tomAra mana choTa have| (tave mane rAkhave) tumi to kevala ekajana satarkakArI| Ara savakichura dAYabhAra to AllAharai|

nAki tArA vale ye, ei koraAna se (muhAmmAda) nije vAniYeche? vala, “yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale tomarAo tAra anurUpa dazaTi sUrA vAniYe Ana evaM (e kAje sAhAyyera janya) AllAha chAr3A yAke pAra Deke lao|”

takhana tArA yadi tomAdera e kathAYa sAr3A nA deYa (Ara tA deveo nA) tAhale tomarA jAnave, yA nAyila karA haYeche tA (e koraAna) AllAhara jJAne raYeche evaM eTAo jAnave ye, tini chAr3A kona mAvuda nei| ataeva, tomarA ki musalima (AllAhara icchAra anugata) have?
yArA duniYAra jIvana o tAra cAkacikya cAYa Ami tAderake sekhAne tAdera kAjera puropuri phala diYe thAki, sekhAne tAderake (kona kichu) kama deoYA haYa nA|
odera janya parakAle jAhAnnAma chAr3A kichu nei| ekhAne tArA yA kichu kareche tA niSphala haYeche evaM tArA yesava kAja karata tA anyAYa|

tAi yArA tAdera prabhura pakSa theke Agata eka spaSTa pramANera (koraAnera) opara raYeche (tArA ki avizvAsIdera samAna hate pAre)? eTA to tA~ra pakSa theke ekajana sAkSI (jivarAIla) pATha kare zonAYa evaM tAra pUrveo dika-nirdezanA o anugrahasvarUpa mUsAra kitAva (tAorAta) raYeche| erA (musalamAnerA) tA vizvAsa kare| Ara ye sava dala tA avizvAsa kare, jAhAnnAmai tAdera sAkSAtasthala| se samvandhe tumi kona sandehera madhye theko nA| avazyai tA tomAra prabhura pakSa theke nirdhArita satya| tave adhikAMza mAnuSa vizvAsa kare nA|

yArA AllAhara nAme mithyA vAniYe vale tAdera ceYe var3a jAlema ke hate pAre? oderake odera prabhura sAmane hAjira karA have, Ara sAkSIrA valave, “erAi edera prabhura nAme mithyA valechila|” jene rAkha! jAlemadera opara AllAhara abhisampAta raYeche,
yArA AllAhara patha theke (lokaderake) virata rAkhe evaM tAte vakratA khu~je ver3AYa| Ara tArAi parakAle avizvAsI|

tArA pRthivIte AllAhake apAraga karate pArave nA (arthAt AllAhara zAsti theke pAlAte pArave nA)| AllAha vyatIta tAdera kona sAhAyyakArIo nei| tAdera zAsti dviguNa karA have| tArA (satya) zunateo peta nA evaM dekhatao nA|
orAi tArA yArA nijerA nijedera kSati kareche| Ara (upAsya hiseve) tArA yA kichu udbhAvana karata (parakAle) tA tAdera theke udhAo haYe yAve|
niHsandehe parakAle tArAi savaceYe vezi kSatigrasta have|
yArA ImAnadAra, satkarmazIla o nijedera prabhura prati vinaYI, tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI (have) evaM sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|
ubhaYa dalera tulanA ekajana andha o vadhira vyakti evaM Arekajana dRSTisampanna o zravaNazaktisampanna vyaktira mata| tulanAYa erA ubhaYa ki samAna haYa? tomarA ki tAhale zikSAgrahaNa karave nA?
Ami to nUhake tAra samapradAYera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma| (se tAderake valechila) “Ami tomAdera janya eka spaSTa satarkakArI|”
“yAte tomarA AllAha chAr3A Ara kAro evAdata nA kara| Ami tomAdera janya eka kaThina dinera zAstira AzaGkA karachi|”

takhana tAra samapradAYera avizvAsI netArA valala, “AmarA to tomAke AmAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa chAr3A vezi kichu mane kari nA| tAchAr3A AmAdera madhye spaSTata nikRSTa lokadera chAr3A kAuke tomAra Anugatya karateo dekhi nA| AmarA to (Asale) AmAdera opara tomAdera kona zreSThatva dekhate pAi nA, varaM tomAderake mithyAvAdI mane kari|”

se valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! vala dekhi, AmAra kAche yadi AmAra prabhura pakSa theke kona spaSTa pramANa thAke evaM tini yadi AmAke tA~ra pakSa theke eka vizeSa anugraha (navuoYAta) dAna kare thAkena Ara tA tomAdera dRSTigocara nA haYe thAke tAhale? (arthAt tAhale AmAra Ara kI karAra Ache)? tomarA tA apachanda karale AmarA ki tA tomAdera opara cApiYe dite pAri?”

“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! era vinimaYe Ami tomAdera kAche kona sampada cAi nA| AmAra puraskAra to AllAhara kAchei Ache| Ami to muminaderake tAr3iYe dite pAri nA| tArA avazyai tAdera prabhura sAkSAt lAbha karave| varaM Ami to dekhachi, tomarAi eka ajJa janagoSThI|”
“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! Ami yadi tAderake tAr3iYe dei tAhale AllAhara viruddhe ke AmAke sAhAyya karave (AllAhara hAta theke ke AmAke rakSA karave)? tomarA ki cintA kare dekha nA?”

“Ami tomAderake vali nA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara bhANDAra Ache| eTAo nA ye, Ami gAYeva jAni| emana kathAo vali nA ye, Ami ekajana pherezatA| Ara yAderake tomarA ghRNAra cokhe dekha tAdera samparkeo vali nA ye, AllAha tAderake kona kalyANa dAna karavena nA| tAdera mane ki Ache AllAhai tA bhAla jAnena| (sutarAM) amana kathA valale avazyai Ami jAlemadera antarbhukta hava|”
tArA valala, “he nUha! tumi AmAdera sAthe vitarka karecho evaM vezi karei vitarka karecho| sutarAM AmAderake ye zAstira bhaYa dekhAccha, tomAra kathA satya hale ekhana tA AmAdera kAche niYe eso|”
se valala, “AllAha icchA karale tinii tomAdera kAche tA niYe Asavena evaM tomarA (tA~ke) apAraga karate pArave nA (tA~ra zAsti er3Ate pArave nA)|”

“AllAha yadi tomAderake vipathagAmI karate cAna tAhale Ami tomAderake upadeza dite cAileo AmAra upadeza tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA| tini tomAdera prabhu evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|”
tArA ki vale ye, se nije tA (koraAna) vAniYeche? vala, “Ami yadi tA vAniYe thAki tAhale AmAra aparAdha AmAra opara vartAve| kintu tomarA ye aparAdha karo tAra sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei|”
nUhera kAche ohI pAThiYe valA hala, “tomAra samapradAYera yArA itimadhyei ImAna eneche tArA chAr3A Ara keu ImAna Anave nA; ataeva, tAdera kAjakarme tumi viSaNna haYo nA|”
“Ara AmAra najaradArite o AmAra pratyAdeza anusAre jAhAja tairI kara| Ara yArA anyAYa kareche tAdera janya AmAke kona anurodha karo nA| orA Duve marave|”

nUha jAhAja tairI karache| Ara (jAhAja tairIkAle) yakhanai tAra samapradAYera mor3alerA tAra kAcha diYe yeta takhanai tArA tAke upahAsa karata| se valechila, “tomarA yadi AmAderake upahAsa karo tAhale (yakhana tomAdera opara tuphAnera zAsti Asave takhana) tomAdera upahAsera mata AmarAo tomAderake upahAsa karava|”
“tomarA acirei jAnate pArave, kAdera opara lAJchanAkara zAsti Ase evaM kAdera opara sthAYI zAsti Apatita haYa|”

avazeSe yakhana AmAra nirdeza ese gela evaM culo pheTe pAni vera hala takhana Ami (nUhake) valalAma, “sava rakamera jor3Ara duTi kare (prANI) evaM yAdera vyApAre Agei siddhAnta haYeche tArA vyatIta tomAra parivAra-parijanake Ara yArA ImAna eneche tAderake jAhAje uThiYe nAo| vastuta alpa kaYekajanai tAra sAthe ImAna enechila|
se valala, “tomarA ei jAhAje ArohaNa kara| AllAhara nAmei eTA calave Ara thAmave| nizcaYai AmAra prabhu kSamAzIla o daYAmaYa|

jAhAjaTi tAderake niYe pAhAr3era mata (u~cu u~cu) DheuYera madhye calate lAgala| nUha tAra putrake DAka diYe valala, se dUre sare chila, “vatsa! AmAdera sAthe ArohaNa karo, kApheradera sAthe theko nA|”

putra valechila, “Ami ekaTi pAhAr3e AzraYa neva yA AmAke pAni theke rakSA karave|” nUha valechila, “AllAha yAke anugraha karavena tAke chAr3A (kAuke) Aja AllAhara nirdeza theke rakSA karAra keu nei|” erapara Dheu ese duJcajanera mAjhe yogAyoga vicchinna kare dila evaM se (putra) anyadera sAthe Duve gela|

erapara valA hala, “he pRthivI! tomAra pAni gile phela, Ara he AkAza! (varSaNa) vandha kara|” ataHpara pAni zukiYe gela, (nUhera samapradAYera kApheraderake DuviYe mArAra) kAja sampanna hala evaM jAhAja jUdI pAhAr3e giYe Thekala| Ara valA hala, “jAlemarA nipAta yAka!”
nUha tAra prabhuke DAkala Ara valala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra putra to AmAra parivArerai antarbhukta evaM tomAra oYAdAo to satya, Ara tumi hale savaceYe vijJa vicAraka|”

tini valalena, “he nUha! Asale se tomAra parivArabhukta naYa| se eka durAcArI| ataeva, tumi AmAra kAche emana kichu ceYo nA ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei| Ami tomAke ajJadera antarbhukta nA hate upadeza dicchi|”
se valala, “he prabhu! tomAra kAche emana kichu cAoYA theke Ami tomAra AzraYa cAcchi ye viSaYe AmAra kona jJAna nei| tumi yadi AmAke kSamA o anugraha nA karo tAhale Ami kSatigrasta hava|”

valA hala, “he nUha! tomAra prati o tomAra saGgI kataka lokera prati AmAra pakSa theke zAnti o kalyANa niYe (jAhAja theke) avataraNa kara| tave kataka lokake Ami (kichukAlera janya sukha) upabhoga karate deva, kintu tArapara tAderake AmAra pakSa hate yantraNAdAYaka zAsti bhoga karate have|
esava hala adRzyalokera saMvAda, yA Ami tomAke ohIra mAdhyame avahita karachi| era Age tumi esava jAnate nA, tomAra lokerAo nA| ataeva, dhairyadhAraNa kara| zubha pariNati mottAkIdera janyai|

Ara Ada jAtira kAche tAdera bhAi hUdake (pAThiYechilAma)| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara evAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| tomarA to kevala mithyA udbhAvana kara|”
“he AmAra samapradAYa! Ami era janya tomAdera kAche kona puraskAra cAi nA| AmAra puraskAra to tA~ra kAche yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?”

“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA tomAdera prabhura kAche kSamA cAo, tArapara tA~ra dike phire Asa; tini AsamAna theke tomAdera opara vAridhArA varSaNa karavena evaM tomAdera zaktira sAthe Aro zakti vAr3iYe devena| ataeva, aparAdhI haYe mukha phiriYe nio nA|”
tArA valala, “ohe hUda! tumi to AmAdera kAche kona pramANa niYe Asani| tomAra kathAYa AmarA AmAdera devatAdera tyAga karava nA| AmarA tomAke vizvAsa kari nA”

“AmarA to valava, AmAderai kona devatA tomAke kona azubha prabhAve AviSTa kareche|” se valala, “Ami AllAhake sAkSI rAkhachi Ara tomarAo sAkSI thAka, osavera sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei yAderake tomarA zarIka karo,
AllAhake chAr3A; ataeva, tomarA savAi AmAra viruddhe cakrAnta karo evaM AmAke kona avakAza dio nA|”

“Ami AllAhara opara bharasA rekhechi, yini AmAra prabhu evaM tomAderao prabhu| pratyeka prANIra lalATera kezaguccha tini dhare Achena (pratyeka prANI tA~rai niYantraNe raYeche)| AmAra prabhu saThika pathei Achena|”

“ ataeva, tomarA yadi mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale (AmAra kona kSati have nA; kAraNa) AmAke yA niYe tomAdera kAche pAThAno haYeche Ami tA tomAdera kAche pau~che diYechi| Ara AmAra prabhu anya ekadala lokake tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena| tomarA tA~ra konai kSati karate pArave nA| AmAra prabhu savakichura rakSaNAvekSaNakArI|”
ataHpara yakhana AmAra nirdeza ese gela takhana Ami hUdake o tAra saGgI muminaderake AmAra vizeSa anugrahe rakSA karalAma| Ami tAderake eka kaThina AjAva theke vA~ciYechilAma|

ei chila Ada jAti| erA tAdera prabhura nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karechila evaM tA~ra rasUladerake amAnya karechila Ara (tAdera netAdera madhye) pratyeka uddhata o dAmbhika vyaktira Adeza pAlana karechila|

ei duniYAYa abhizApake tAdera nityasaGgI karA haYeche, keYAmatera dineo| jene rAkha, Ada jAti tAdera prabhura sAthe kuphari karechila| jene rAkha, hUdera samapradAYa (ei) Ada jAtira (bhAgye) var3a durbhoga raYeche!

Ara chAmUda jAtira kAche (pAThiYechilAma) tAdera bhAi chAlehake| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara evAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| tini tomAderake mATi theke sRSTi karechena evaM tAtei tomAdera vasati dAna karechena| ataeva, tomarA tA~ra kAche kSamA cAo evaM tA~ra dike phire Asa| AmAra prabhu kAchei Achena, DAkale sAr3A dena|”

tArA valala, “he chAleha! era Age tumi AmAdera madhye AzAra pAtra chile (tomAke niYe AmAdera aneka AzA chila)| (ekhana) tumi ki AmAderake AmAdera vApadAdAra upAsyadera upAsanA karate vAraNa karacha? tumi AmAderake yA karate valacha se samparke AmarA eka vibhrAntikara sandehera madhye raYechi|”

se valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! vala dekhi, AmAra kAche yadi AmAra prabhura kona spaSTa pramANa thAke evaM tini yadi nijera pakSa theke AmAke kona anugraha dAna kare thAkena, ematAvasthAYa Ami yadi tA~ra avAdhyatA kari tAhale AmAke AllAhara viruddhe ke sAhAyya karave? tomarA to kevala AmAra kSatii vAr3Ave|”
“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! tomAdera janya eka nidarzanasvarUpa eTi AllAhara uSTrI| ataeva, oke AllAhara jamine care khete dAo| ora kona kSati karo nA; tAhale tomAdera opara Azu zAsti neme Asave|”
kintu tArA seTike hatyA karala| takhana chAleha valala, “tomarA tomAdera vAr3ite tina dina bhoga-vilAsa kara| eTA ekaTA oYAdA yA mithyA have nA|”

tArapara yakhana AmAra nirdeza ela takhana Ami AmAra vizeSa anugrahe chAlehake o tAra saGgI muminaderake rakSA karechilAma| Ara (rakSA karechilAma) sedinera lAJchanA theke| tomAra prabhu halena mahAzaktidhara o parAkramazAlI|
eka vikaTa zavda jAlemaderake pAkar3Ao karala, yAra phale tArA (mare) yAra yAra ghare upur3a haYe par3e thAkala|

(tArA emanabhAve nizcihna haYechila) yena tArA sekhAne (konadina) vasavAsai kareni| jene rAkha, chAmUda jAti tAdera prabhura sAthe kuphari karechila| jene rAkha, chAmUda jAtira janya var3a durbhoga raYeche!

AmAra dUtagaNa (pherezatArA) ivarAhImera kAche susaMvAda niYe esechila| tArA valala, jJasAlAmaJca; seo valala, jJasAlAmaJca| erapara (tAderake ApyAYanera janya) alpa-kSaNera madhye se ekaTi bhunAkRta vAchura niYe ela|

kintu se yakhana dekhala, tAdera hAta sedike yAcche nA, takhana tAderake khArApa (uddezye AgamanakArI) mane karala evaM tAdera samparke tAra mane bhItira saJcAra hala| (eTA vujhate pere) tArA valala, “bhaYa peYo nA; AmAderake lUtera samapradAYera kAche (tAderake zAsti deoYAra janya) pAThAno haYeche|

(sekhAne) tAra strI dA~r3Ano chila| (Agantukadera khAdyagrahaNa nA karate dekhe athavA lUtera samapradAYera zAstira kathAYa khuzI haYe athavA bhaYa dUra haoYAra kAraNe) se takhana hAsala| Ami takhana tAke (pherezatAdera mAdhyame) isahAkera evaM isahAkera pare iYAkUvera susaMvAda dilAma|
se valala, “hAYa AllAha! Ami eka vur3I, Ara AmAra ei vRddha svAmI, e avasthAYa AmAra santAna have? e to eka avAka kANDa|”

tArA (Agantuka pherezatArA) valala, “tumi AllAhara hukumera vyApAre avAka haccha? he (ivarAhImera) parivArera lokerA! tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o AzIrvAda raYeche| nizcaYai tini prazaMsita, gauravamaYa|”
ataHpara yakhana ivarAhImera (mana theke) bhaYa cale gela evaM tAra kAche susaMvAda ela takhana se lUtera samapradAYera vyApAre AmAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karate (tAdera pakSe kathA valate) lAgala|
Asale ivarAhIma (chila) ekajana suzIla, komalaprANa o AllAhamukhI mAnuSa|
he ivarAhIma! e viSaYaTi cher3e dAo| Asale tomAra prabhura nirdeza ese geche| odera janya emana eka zAsti Asache yA pherAno yAve nA|
erapara AmAra dUtagaNa lUtera kAche ele se tAderake niYe duzcintAYa par3ala evaM tAdera rakSAra vyApAre asahAYa vodha karala Ara valala, “e eka saGkaTamaYa dina|”

lUtera samapradAYera lokerA hur3amur3a kare tAra kAche ela| Ageo tArA apakarma karata| se valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! ei AmAra meYerA Ache| erA tomAdera janya adhikatara pavitra| sutarAM AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra mehamAnadera vyApAre AmAke lajjita karo nA| tomAdera madhye ki ekaTAo bhAla loka nei?”
tArA valala, “tomAra to jAnAi Ache ye, tomAra meYedera vyApAre AmAdera kona Agraha nei| Ara tumi avazyai jAna, AmarA ki cAi|”
se valala, “AmAra yadi tomAderake pratirodha karAra kSamatA thAkata! kiMvA Ami yadi kona zakta avalamvanera kAche AzraYa nite pAratAma!”

pherezatArA valala, “he lUta! AmarA tomAra prabhura dUta| erA tomAra kAche pau~chAte pArave nA| tumi rAtera kona eka samaYe tomAra parivAra-parijanake anyatra niYe yAo| tomAdera madhye keu yena phire nA tAkAYa| tomAra strIra kathA AlAdA| odera yA ghaTave tArao tAi ghaTave| odera (zAstira) nirdhArita samaYa hacche sakAla| sakAla ki kAche naYa?”
ataHpara yakhana AmAra nirdeza ela, takhana janapadaTike ekevAre ulaTiYe dilAma evaM tAra opara sAjiYe rAkhA zakta mATira kaGkara varSaNa karalAma,
(kaGkaragulo chila) tomAra prabhura kAche cihnayukta | segulo jAlemadera theke dUre chila nA|

Ara mAd‌iYAna samapradAYera nikaTa tAdera bhAi zoYAivake (pAThiYechilAma)| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara evAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona mAvuda nei| tomarA mApe o ojane kama dio nA| Ami tomAderake samRddhizAlI dekhate pAcchi, tave tomAdera janya eka pariveSTanakArI (vipadasaMkula) dinera zAstira AzaMkA karachi|”
“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! nyAYera sAthe mApa o ojana puropuri dio evaM mAnuSake tAdera jinisapatra kama dio nA Ara pRthivIte anAcAra kare ver3io nA|”
“(mAnuSake puropuri deoYAra para) AllAhara (anumodita) avaziSTAMzai tomAdera janya bhAla, yadi tomarA ImAnadAra hao| Ara Ami to tomAdera rakSaka nai|”

tArA valala, “he zoYAiva! tomAra nAmAya ki tomAke ei Adeza deYa ye, AmAdera vApa-dAdA yAdera upAsanA karata AmarA tAdera varjana kari? athavA AmAdera dhana-sampadera vyApAre AmarA yA karate cAi tA karA cher3e dei? tumi to khuva sahanazIla o nItivAna!” (kathATi tArA vidrUpa kare valechila|)

se valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! vala to, AmAra kAche yadi AmAra prabhura kona spaSTa pramANa thAke evaM tini yadi tA~ra pakSa theke AmAke uttama jIvikA dAna kare thAkena; (tAhale Ami tA~ra hukuma pAlana karava nA kena?) Ami tomAderake yA karate niSedha kari nije tA kare tomAdera virodhitA karate cAi nA| Ami zudhu AmAra sAdhyAnuyAYI saMskAra karate cAi| (tave) AmAra sAphalya kevala AllAhara sAhAyyei Asate pAre| (tAi) Ami tA~ra oparai bharasA rekhechi evaM tA~ra dikei manoniveza karachi|”

“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! AmAra (sAthe tomAdera) virodha tomAderake yena kichutei emana aparAdhe prarocita nA kare yAte tomAdera opara nUhera samapradAYa kiMvA hUdera samapradAYa athavA chAlehera samapradAYera mata zAsti neme Ase| Ara lUtera samapradAYa to tomAdera theke (vezi) dUrera naYa|”
“tomarA tomAdera prabhura kAche kSamA cAo, tArapara tA~ra pAne phire eso| nizcaYai AmAra prabhu daYAlu o snehaparAYaNa|”

tArA valala, “he zoYAiva! tumi yA vala tAra anekaTAi AmarA vujhi nA| Ara AmarA tomAke AmAdera madhye durvalai dekhate pAcchi| tomAra gotrera lokajana nA thAkale AmarA tomAke pAthara nikSepa kare mere phelatAma| tumi to AmAdera viruddhe zaktizAlI nao|”

se valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! AmAra gotrera lokajana ki tomAdera viruddhe AllAhara ceYeo zaktizAlI? tomarA to tA~ke avahelAbhare tomAdera pechane phele rekhecho| tomarA yA karo AmAra prabhu avazyai tA pariveSTana kare rekhechena (samyaka avagata raYechena)|”

“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA tomAdera jAYagAYa kAja kara| Amio AmAra kAja karachi| tomarA jAnate pArave, kAra opara lAJchanAkara zAsti Ase evaM ke mithyAvAdI| tomarA apekSAYa thAka, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSAYa Achi|”

tArapara yakhana AmAra nirdeza ela takhana Ami AmAra vizeSa anugrahe zoYAiva o tAra saGgI muminaderake rakSA karalAma evaM eka vikaTa zavda jAlemaderake pAkar3Ao karala, yAra phale tArA (mare) yAra yAra ghare upur3a haYe par3e thAkala|
(tArA emanabhAve nizcihna haYechila) yena tArA sekhAne (konadina) vasavAsai kareni| jene rAkha, mAd‌iYAna jAtira janya var3a durbhoga raYeche, yemana durbhoge par3echila chAmUda jAti|
Ara nizcaYai Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzana o spaSTa pramANasaha pAThiYechilAma,
pherAuna o tAra pAriSadavargera kAche; kintu tArA (AllAhara Adezera parivarte) pherAunera Adezai pAlana karechila| athaca pherAunera Adeza saThika chila nA|
keYAmatera dina se tAra lokadera Age Age thAkave evaM se tAderake jAhAnnAme niYe yAve| Ara ye jAYagAYa tAderake niYe yAoYA have tA var3ai khArApa!
e pRthivIteo tAdera pechane pechane abhisampAta raYeche evaM keYAmatera dineo| ye pratiphala tAderake deoYA have tA var3ai nikRSTa!
e hala janapadasamUhera kichu saMvAda yA Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karachi| esava janapadera madhye kataka avaziSTa Ache, Ara kataka nizcihna haYe giYeche|

Ami tAdera prati kona avicAra karini, varaM tArAi nijedera prati avicAra kareche| phale, yakhana tomAra prabhura nirdeza ese geche takhana AllAhake chAr3A tArA yesava upAsyake DAkata tArA tAdera konai kAje Aseni| tArA kevala tAdera sarvanAzai vRddhi kareche|
tomAra prabhu yakhana jAlema janapadasamUhake dharena takhana ebhAvei dhare thAkena| tA~ra dharA var3a kaSTadAYaka o kaThora|

yArA parakAlera AjAvake bhaYa kare tAdera janya Asalei ete var3a eka zikSA raYeche| seTA emana eka dina yakhana sakala mAnuSake ekatrita karA have| seTA emana eka dina yakhana sakalei upasthita thAkave|
kevala ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYera janyai Ami tA (se dinaTi) vilamvita karachi|
yedina tA Asave sedina keu tA~ra anumati chAr3A kathA valate pArave nA| tAi tAdera madhye keu have hatabhAgya evaM keu bhAgyavAna|
yArA hatabhAgya have tArA jAhAnnAme yAve| sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave AhAjAri Ara ArtanAda|

sekhAne tArA yatadina AsamAna-jamina thAkave (arthAt yugayuga dhare) sthAYIbhAve vAsa karave| tave tomAra prabhu icchA karale kona vyatikramao hate pAre| tomAra prabhu to yA icchA karena tAi kare thAkena|

Ara yArA bhAgyavAna have tArA jAnnAte yAve| sekhAne tArA yatadina AsamAna-jamina thAkave (arthAt yugayuga dhare) sthAYIbhAve vAsa karave| tave tomAra prabhu icchA karale kona vyatikramao hate pAre| eTA have eka niravacchinna dAna|

ataeva, orA yA kichura upAsanA karache se samparke tumi kona sandehe theko nA| pUrve odera vApa-dAdArA yemana (bhrAnta devatAdera) upAsanA karata orAo Thika tAi karache| Ami odera prApya (zAsti) kichu kama nA kare puropuri deva|

Ami to mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma| kintu tA niYe matabheda sRSTi haYechila| yadi tomAra prabhura pakSa theke ekaTi kathA Agei valA nA hata tAhale tAdera madhye mImAMsA haYe yeta| Asale tArA e (kitAvera) vyApAre vibhrAntikara sandehera madhye raYeche|
tAdera pratyekake tomAra prabhu avazyai yAra yAra karmera puropuri pratidAna devena| tArA yA kare nizcaYai tini tAra khavara rAkhena|
ataeva, yemana AdiSTa haYecho, tumi o tomAra sAthe yArA taovA kareche savAi (AllAhara pathe) sthira thAka evaM vAr3AvAr3i karo nA| tomarA yA karo nizcaYai tini tA dekhate pAna|
Ara jAlemadera dike jhu~kave nA; jhu~kale Aguna tomAderake sparza karave| Ara AllAha vyatIta tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nAi| ataeva, tomarA kAro sAhAyya pAve nA|

dinera dui prAntabhAge evaM rAtrira kaYekaTi aMze nAmAya AdAYa kara| nizcaYai bhAla kAjasamUha (puNyasamUha) khArApa kAjasamUhake (choTa pApasamUhake) dUra kare deYa| eTA upadeza grahaNakArIdera janya ekaTA upadeza|
tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo; kAraNa AllAha satkarmazIladera pratiphala naSTa karena nA|

ataeva, Ami yAderake rakSA karechilAma tAdera madhye muSTimeYa kichu loka chAr3A tomAdera pUrvavartI prajanmagulora madhye vuddhimAna vyaktivarga chila nA kena, yArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTite vAdhA dita! Ara yArA (ei dAYitva pAlana nA kare) anyAYa karechila tArA nijedera bhogavilAsera pechane chuTechila| Asale tArA aparAdhI chila|
adhivAsIrA satkarmazIla haoYA avasthAYa tomAra prabhu anyAYabhAve janapadasamUha dhvaMsa karate pArena nA|
tomAra prabhu yadi icchA karatena tAhale tini sava mAnuSake avazyai eka jAti karate pAratena, kintu tAteo tArA matabheda karatei thAkave|

tave yAderake tomAra prabhu anugraha karena tAdera kathA bhinna| ejanyai tini tAderake sRSTi karechena| tomAra prabhura ei kathA vAstavAYita havei, “Ami avazyai jvina o mAnuSa savAike diYe jAhAnnAma bhare deva|”
Ara rasUladera sava ghaTanA Ami tomAra kAche valachi, yAra dvArA Ami tomAra antara sudRr3ha karachi| Ara erai mAdhyame tomAra kAche eseche satya Ara muminadera janya upadeza Ara smArakapatra|
yArA vizvAsa kare nA tAderake vala, “tomarA tomAdera jAYagAYa kAja karo, AmarAo (AmAdera) kAja karachi|
Ara tomarA apekSA karo, AmarAo apekSA karachi|”

AllAhara kAche raYeche AsamAna o jaminera adRzya jJAna evaM tA~ra kAchei sakala viSaYa phiriYe neoYA have| ataeva, tumi tA~ra evAdata karo evaM tA~ra opara bharasA kara| tomarA yA karo tomAra prabhu se samparke anavahita nana|
Alipha lAma rA [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| egulo spaSTa granthera AYAta|
Ami eke AravI koraAnarUpe nAyila karechi, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
ohIra mAdhyame ei koraAna nAyila kare Ami tomAra kAche serA ghaTanA varNanA karachi| era Age tumi to kichui jAnate nA|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana iusupha tAra vAvAke valala, “vAvA! Ami (svapne) egAraTi tArakA evaM canadra o sUryake dekhechi| dekhalAma, tArA AmAke sejadA karache|”
se valala, “vatsa! tomAra ei svapnera kathA tomAra bhAiderake valo nA| tAhale tArA tomAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karave| zaYatAna to mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|

Ara ebhAvei tomAra prabhu tomAke manonIta karavena, tomAke svapnera tAvira (tAtparya-vyAkhyA) zekhAvena evaM tomAra prati o iYAkUvera parivAra-parijanera prati tA~ra anugraha pUrNa karavena; yemana tini tA itipUrve tomAra dui pUrvapuruSa ivarAhIma o isahAkera pratio pUrNa karechilena| nizcaYai tomAra prabhu mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|
yArA jAnate cAYa tAdera janya iusupha o tAra bhAidera ghaTanAYa avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tArA (iusuphera sat bhAiYerA) valechila, “avazyai iusupha o tAra bhAi (vin‌iYAmIna) AmAdera vAvAra kAche AmAdera ceYe adhika priYa, athaca AmarA ekaTi zaktizAlI dala| Asale AmAdera vAvA pariSkAra vibhrAntite raYechena|”
“tomarA iusuphake mere phela athavA tAke kothAo phele Asa, yAte tomAdera vAvAra manoyoga zudhu tomAdera janyai nivaddha haYa evaM erapara tomarA bhAla mAnuSa hate pAra|”
tAdera madhye ekajana valala, “iusuphake mero nA, yadi kichu karatei cAo tAhale tAke kona kUpera talAYa phele dAo; kona kAphelAra lokerA tAke tule neve|”
tArA valala, “he AmAdera pitA! iusuphera vyApAre tumi AmAderake vizvAsa karacha nA kena? AmarA to tAra hitAkAMkSI|”
“AgAmIkAla tumi tAke AmAdera sAthe pAThiYe dAo| se Amoda-phurti karave evaM khelAdhulA karave| Ara AmarA to tAke dekhezunei rAkhava|”
se valala, “tomarA tAke niYe gele Ami cintita thAkava| AmAra bhaYa haYa, tomarA yakhana tAra vyApAre vekheYAla thAkave takhana tAke nekar3e vAgha kheYe phelave|”
tArA valala, “AmarA ekaTA zaktizAlI dala haoYAra parao tAke yadi nekar3e vAghe khAYa tAhale to AmarA kSatigrastai hava (arthAt AmarA thAkate temanaTi haoYAra AzaGkA nei)|”

erapara tArA yakhana tAke niYe gela evaM savAi tAke kUpera talAYa phele dite ekamata hala (takhana tArA tAi karechila)| Ara Ami tAke jAniYe dilAma, “(ekadina) tumi oderake odera ei apakarma avahita karave, yakhana tArA (tomAke) cinave nA|”
sandhyAYa tArA kA~date kA~date tAdera vAvAra kAche ela|

tArA valala, “vAvA! AmarA daur3era pAllA dite giYechilAma evaM iusuphake AmAdera mAlapatrera kAche rekhe giYechilAma| takhana nekar3e vAgha tAke kheYe pheleche| AmarA satya kathA valaleo to Apani AmAderake vizvAsa karavena nA|”

tArA tAra jAmAYa mithyA rakta lAgiYe enechila| se (vAvA) valala, “(tomAdera kathA Thika naYa) varaM tomarA nijerA ekaTi ghaTanA sAjiYecho| ataeva, (AmAra janya) dhairyai zreYa| Ara tomarA yA valacha se vyApAre ekamAtra AllAharai sAhAyya cAoYA yAYa|”

ekaTi kAphelA ela| tArA tAdera pAnisaMgrAhakake (pAni Anate) pAThAla| se (kUpera madhye) tAra vAlati jhuliYe dila| (Ara amani) vale uThala, “kI dAruNa vyApAra! e dekhi ekaTi chele”| tArA tAke paNya hiseve lukiYe rAkhala| Ara tArA yA karachila AllAha tA bhAla karei avagata chilena|
tArA sastA mUlye mAtra kaYeka dirahAme tAke vikri kare diYechila| tArA tAke gurutvahIna mane karechila|

misarera ye vyakti tAke kine niYechila se tAra strIke valala, “ora thAkAra janya sammAnajanaka vyavasthA kara| sambhavata se AmAdera upakAre Asave| kiMvA AmarA tAke (nijedera) putra vAniYe rAkhava|” ebhAvei Ami pRthivIte iusuphake pratiSThita kari, yAte Ami tAke svapnera tAvira zikSA dite pAri| Ara AllAha to tA~ra kAje vijaYI haYe thAkena| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
iusupha yakhana yauvane upanIta haYa, takhana Ami tAke prajJA o jJAna dAna kari| ebhAvei Ami satkarmazIladera puraskRta kari|

se ye mahilAra ghare chila se tAke (kukarme) prarocita karala evaM darajA vandha kare diYe valala, “edike eso”| (takhana) se valala, “Ami AllAhara AzraYa cAi! tini (ApanAra svAmI) AmAra mAlika| tini AmAra vasavAsera suvyavasthA karechena| (ataeva, Ami kichutei tAra sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karava nA|) anyAYakArIrA kakhanao saphala haYa nA|”

Asale ai mahilA tAke niYe kucintA karechila| Ara seo tAke niYe kucintA karata yadi nA se tAra prabhura nidarzana dekhate peta| ebhAvei (tAke nidarzana dekhAno) haYechila, yAte Ami tAra theke anyAYa Ara apakarma dUre rAkhate pAri| se to AmAra manonIta vAndAderai anyatama|

tArA dujanei darajAra kAche daur3e gela| Ara mahilA pechana theke tAra (iusuphera) jAmA chi~r3e phelala| tArA dujane darajAra kAche (giYe) mahilAra svAmIke dekhate pela| takhana mahilA (tAra svAmIke) valala, “tomAra strIra sAthe ye anyAYa kAja karate ceYechila, tAke kArAruddha karA athavA yantraNAdAYaka kona zAsti deoYA chAr3A tAra Ara kI daNDa hate pAre?

iusupha valala, “se-i AmAke prarocita karechila|” takhana mahilAra parivArera ekajana sAkSI ebhAve sAkSya dila, “yadi tAra jAmATi sAmanera dika theke che~r3A thAke tAhale mahilAra kathA satya evaM iusupha mithyAvAdI|”
“Ara yadi tAra jAmA pechanera dika theke che~r3A thAke tAhale mahilAra kathA mithyA evaM iusupha satyavAdI|”
mahilAra svAmI yakhana iusuphera jAmATi pechana theke che~r3A dekhala takhana valala, “(he nArIrA!) nizcaYai eTA tomAdera cakrAnta| tomAdera cakrAnta to bhaYAnaka|”
“iusupha! viSaYaTi tumi bhule yAo| Ara (he nArI!) tumi tomAra pApera janya kSamAprArthanA kara| tumii to pApa karecho|”

nagarIte katipaYa mahilA valAvali karate lAgala, “AyIyera strI tAra yuvaka dAsake apakarme prarocita karache| (yuvakaTira prati) prema tAke unmatta kareche| AmarA to mane kari, se spaSTa bhrAntite nipatita|”

AyIyera strI mahilAdera ei cakrAntera kathA zune tAderake Deke pAThAla evaM tAdera janya ekaTi bhojasabhAra AYojana karala| se tAdera pratyekake (khAdyasAmagrI kATAra janya) ekaTi kare cAku dila evaM (iusuphake) valala, edera sAmane vera hao| tArA iusuphake dekhe tAra ucca prazaMsA karala evaM (tAra saundarye vimohita haYe cAku diYe khAdya kATAra parivarte) nijedera hAta keTe phelala Ara valala, “sov‌hAnAllAha! e to kona mAnuSa naYa| e to eka mahAna pherezatA|”

(takhana) AyIyera strI valala, “ei sei yuvaka yAra vyApAre tomarA AmAke bhartsanA karecho| Thikai Ami tAke prarocita karechi, kintu se nijeke pavitra rekheche| Ara Ami tAke yA karate vali se tA nA karale avazyai tAke kArAgAre pAThAno have evaM avazyai se lAJchitadera antarbhukta have|”

iusupha valala, “he AmAra prabhu! orA (ei nArIrA) AmAke yA karate valache tAra ceYe AmAra kAche kArAgArai pachandanIYa| tumi yadi AmAra theke tAdera cakrAnta rahita nA karo tAhale Ami ei nArIdera dike jhu~ke par3ava evaM ajJadera antarbhukta hava|
tAra prabhu takhana tAra nivedane sAr3A dena evaM tAra theke nArIdera cakrAnta rahita karena| nizcaYai tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
ataHpara pramANAdi dekhAra pare tArA tAke kichukAlera janya kArAgAre rAkhate manastha karala|

tAra saGge jele dui yuvaka praveza karechila| tAdera ekajana valala, “Ami svapne dekhalAma, mada (vAnAnora janya AGgura) niMr3Acchi|” anyajana valala, “Ami dekhalAma, mAthAYa ruTi vahana karachi Ara pAkhi tA theke khAcche|” (tArA valala) “AmAderake era tAtparya vale dina| AmarA ApanAke ekajana bhAla loka mane kari|”

se valala, “tomAderake ye khAvAra deoYA haYa tA tomAdera kAche AsAra Agei Ami tomAderake era tAtparya jAniYe deva| e jJAna AmAra prabhui AmAke zikSA diYechena| Ami sei samapradAYera dharma parityAga karechi yArA AllAhake vizvAsa kare nA evaM yArA parakAleo avizvAsI|”

“evaM Ami AmAra pUrvapuruSa ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYAkUvera dharma anusaraNa karechi| AmarA AllAhara sAthe kona kichu zarIka kari nA| eTA AmAdera prati o mAnuSera prati AllAhara anugraha| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|”
“he kArAgArera saGgIdvaYa! pRthaka pRthaka aneka prabhu bhAla nAki parAkramazAlI eka AllAha?”

“AllAha vyatIta tomarA to kevala katagulo nAmera pUjA karacha ye nAmagulo tomarA o tomAdera vApa-dAdArAi rekhecho| AllAha to ogulo samparke kona pramANa pAThAnani| kAryakara nirdeza to ekamAtra AllAharai| tini nirdeza diYechena yena tomarA zudhumAtra tA~rai upAsanA kara| eTAi saThika dharma| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|”

“he kArAgArera saGgIdvaYa! (evAra tomAdera svapnera tAtparya zona) tomAdera ekajana tAra manivake mada pAna karAve Ara anyajanake zUle car3Ano have evaM pAkhi tAra mAthA theke AhAra karave| tomarA ye vyApAre jAnate cAccha tAra niSpatti haYe geche|”

dujanera madhye ye jana mukti pAve vale iusupha mane karala tAke se valala, “tumi tomAra manivera kAche AmAra kathA ullekha karo|” kintu tAra manivera kAche tA ullekha karAra kathA zaYatAna tAke bhuliYe diYechila| sutarAM iusuphake (Aro) kaYekavachara kArAgAre thAkate hala|

(misarera) rAjA valala, “Ami (svapne) dekhalAma sAtaTi moTAtAjA garu, yeguloke sAtaTi zIrNakAYa garu kheYe phelache| Arao (dekhalAma) zasyera sAtaTi savuja ziSa o apara sAtaTi zukano ziSa| he pAriSadavarga! tomarA svapnera tAvira jAnale AmAke AmAra svapnera tAtparya vale dAo|”
tArA valala, “egulo elomelo svapna| Ara AmarA to svapnera tAtparya samparke avagata nai|

dujanera (iusuphera dui kArAsaGgIra) madhye ye jana mukti peYechila, dIrghakAla pare tAra (iusuphera kathA) smaraNa haoYAYa se valala, “Ami ApanAderake e svapnera tAtparya jAnAte pArava| ApanArA AmAke (iusuphera kAche kArAgAre) pAThAna|”

(se kArAgAre giYe valala) “he iusupha! he satyavAdI! —sAtaTi moTAtAjA garu, yAderake sAtaTi zIrNakAYa garu kheYe phelache evaM zasyera sAtaTi savuja ziSa o apara sAtaTi zukano ziSa— AmAderake erakama ekaTi svapnera tAtparya vale dAo, yAte Ami lokadera kAche phire yete pAri evaM tArA (tA) jAnate pAre|”
iusupha valala, “tomarA avirAma sAta vachara cASAvAda karave| e samaYe tomarA ye zasya keTe Anave tAra madhye tomAdera khAoYAra janya alpa parimANa chAr3A vAkiTA ziSera madhyei rekhe deve|”
“era pare sAtaTi kaThina vachara Asave yArA (yakhana lokerA) tomAdera itipUrve rekhe-deoYA (sava) khAvAra kheYe phelave; kevala sAmAnya parimANa vyatIta yA tomarA saMrakSaNa kare rAkhave|”
“era pare ekaTi vachara Asave, yakhana mAnuSa pracura vRSTipAta pAve evaM (utpanna zasya o phala) niMr3Ave|”

(esava zune) rAjA valala, “iusuphake AmAra kAche niYe Asa|” kintu dUta yakhana tAra kAche gela takhana se valala, “tumi tomAra manivera kAche phire yAo evaM tAke jijJesa karo, ye nArIrA nijedera hAta keTechila tAdera khavara ki? AmAra prabhu to tAdera cakrAnta samvandhe bhAlabhAve avahita Achena|”

rAjA (nArIderake) valala, “tomarA yakhana iusuphake prarocita karechile takhana tomAdera kI haYechila?” tArA valala, “mahimA AllAhara! tAra madhye AmarA kona doSa pAini|” AyIyera strI valala, “ekhana (sakalera kAche) satya prakAza haYeche| Asale Amii tAke prarocita karechilAma| Ara niHsandehe se satyavAdI|”

(iusupha valala) “eTA ejanya darakAra chila, yAte AyIya jAnate pAre ye, Ami tAra anupasthitite tAra sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karini| Ara AllAha vizvAsaghAtakadera Sar3ayantrake Thika pathe cAlAna nA (saphala karena nA)|”

“Ara Ami AmAra nijeke doSamukta vali nA| (mAnuSera) mana to kumantraNA diYei thAke| tave AmAra prabhu anugraha karale bhinna kathA (prabhura anugraha pele doSamukta thAkA sambhava)| nizcaYai AmAra prabhu kSamAzIla, daYAlu|”

rAjA valala, “tomarA tAke (iusuphake) AmAra kAche niYe eso, Ami tAke AmAra nijera janya rekhe deva| tArapara rAjAra yakhana iusuphera sAthe kathA haYa takhana se (tAke) vale, “Aja tumi AmAdera kAche maryAdAvAna o vizvasta|”
iusupha valala, “Apani AmAke dezera (misarera) koSAgArera dAYitva dina| Ami ekajana bhAla saMrakSaka evaM e vyApAre AmAra paryApta jJAnao Ache|”
ebhAvei Ami iusuphera janya ai deze zakta avasthAna dAna kari| sekhAne se yakhana yekhAne icchA sthAna nite pAre| Ami yAke cAi AmAra anugraha pAiYe dei| Ara Ami puNyavAnadera pratidAna naSTa kari nA|
ImAnadAra o mottAkIdera janya parakAlera pratidAnai zreSTha|
iusuphera bhAiYerA ela evaM tAra daravAre praveza karala| takhana se tAderake cinate pArala, kintu tArA tAke cinala nA|

se tAderake tAdera sAmagrIra yogAna diYe valala, “(parera vAre) tomarA tomAdera vAvAra kAcha theke tomAdera eka bhAike (vin‌iYAmInake) AmAra kAche niYe Asave| dekhacha nA, Ami (khAdyazasyera) pUrNa varAdda dicchi evaM Ami kata bhAla atithisevaka?”
“tomarA yadi tAke nA niYe Asa tAhale AmAra kAche kona varAdda pAve nA evaM AmAra kAcheo Asate pArave nA|”
tArA valala, “AmarA tAra vyApAre tAra vAvAke rAji karAnora ceSTA karava evaM AmarA (e kAjaTA) karavai|”

iusupha tAra lokaderake vale deYa, “odera paNyamUlya odera mAlapatrera madhye rekhe dio, yAte orA odera parivAra-parijanera kAche phire giYe tA jAnate pAre| tAhale odera AvAra AsAra sambhAvanA thAkave|”

ataHpara tArA tAdera vAvAra kAche phire giYe valala, “vAvA! (bhAike nA niYe gele) AmAdera varAdda vandha thAkave vale jAniYe deoYA haYeche| ataeva, AmAdera sAthe AmAdera bhAike pAThiYe dAo, yAte AmarA varAdda Anate pAri| AmarA avazyai tAra hephAjata karava|”

se (iYAkUva) valala, “pUrve tomAderake tAra bhAiYera vyApAre yemana vizvAsa karechilAma tAra vyApAre ki anyarakama vizvAsa karate pAri? (itipUrve iusuphake hephAjata karAra kathA vale tomarA vizvAsaghAtakatA karechile| vin‌iYAmInera kSetreo ye temana karave nA tAra nizcaYatA ki?) yAhoka AllAhai zreSTha hephAjatakArI evaM tinii savaceYe var3a daYAlu|”

tArA yakhana tAdera mAlapatra khulala takhana dekhate pela, tAdera paNyamUlya tAderake pherata deoYA haYeche| tArA valala, “vAvA! AmarA (Ara) ki AzA karate pAri? ei (dekha) AmAdera paNyamUlya AmAderake pherata deoYA haYeche| AmarA AmAdera parivAra-parijanera janya Aro khAdyazasya Anate pArava| AmarA AmAdera bhAike hephAjate rAkhava evaM atirikta eka uTera (vojhA parimANa) varAdda niYe Asava| oTA (have) eka sahaja varAdda| (bhAike niYe gele ai atirikta varAdda pAoYA sahaja have|)

se (iYAkUva) valala, “yatakSaNa tomarA AmAra kAche AllAhara nAme pratijJA nA karave ye, tomarA tAke AmAra kAche phiriYe Anavei, tatakSaNa Ami tAke tomAdera sAthe pAThAva nA; tave tomarA nijerA (vipada vA zatru dvArA) veSTita hale bhinna kathA|” erapara tArA yakhana tAra kAche pratijJA karala takhana se valala, “AmarA yA valachi, se vyApAre AllAha sAkSI|”

se vale dila, “he AmAra chelerA! tomarA ekai darajA diYe praveza karave nA, varaM vibhinna darajA diYe praveza karave| Ami kintu AllAhara vidhAnera viruddhe tomAdera janya kichu karate pArava nA| vidhAna ekamAtra AllAharai| Ami tA~rai opara bharasA kari| Ara tA~ra opara sakalerai bharasA karA ucita|”

tAdera pitA tAderake yebhAve nirdeza diYechila tArA sebhAve praveza karaleo tAte AllAhara icchAra vAire tAdera kona phala haYani| ete zudhu iYAkUvera manera ekaTi icchAi pUraNa hala| Ara Ami tAke zikSA diYechilAma vale se jJAnera adhikArI chila, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
tArA yakhana iusuphera kAche hAjira hala takhana se nijera bhAi (vin‌iYAmIna)ke kAche nila evaM valala, “Amii tomAra bhAi| tumi odera (satbhAidera) kRtakarmera janya duHkha karo nA|”

iusupha yakhana bhAidera sAmagrIra yogAna dila takhana se (kauzala hiseve) tAra (Apana) bhAiYera mAlapatrera madhye (svarNera) pAnapAtraTi rekhe dila| tArapara ekajana ghoSaka ghoSaNA karala, “he kAphelAra lokerA! nizcaYai tomarA curi karecho|”
iusuphera bhAiYerA ghoSaka o tAra saGgIdera dike phire valala, “tomarA ki jinisa hAriYecho?”
tArA valala, “AmarA rAjAra pAnapAtra pAcchi nA| ye eTi ene dite pArave se eka uTa vojhAi sAmagrI pAve| Ara Ami (ghoSaka) eTira jimmAdAra|”
tArA valala, “AllAhara zapatha! tomarA to jAna, AmarA edeze anartha ghaTAte Asini evaM AmarA corao nai|”
iusuphera lokerA valala, “yadi tomarA mithyuka (pramANita) hao tAhale tAra ki zAsti have?”
tArA (bhAiYerA) valala, “yAra mAlapatrera madhye seTi pAoYA yAve se-i tAra zAsti| (arthAt curira aparAdhe se-i zAsti pAve)| ebhAvei to AmarA anyAYakArIdera zAsti diYe thAki|”

ataHpara iusupha tAra (Apana) bhAiYera thalira pUrve satbhAidera thali diYe (tallAzi) zuru karala| tArapara tAra bhAiYera thali theke pAnapAtraTi vera karala| ebhAve Ami iusuphera janya kauzala avalamvana kari| AllAhara icchA nA hale se rAjAra Aine nijera bhAike (dAsa vAniYe) rAkhate pArata nA| Ami yAke cAi ucca maryAdA dAna kari| Ara sakala jJAnIra opare Achena eka mahAjJAnI|

iusuphera bhAiYerA valala, “se yadi curi kare thAke tAhale tAra eka bhAio (iusupha) itipUrve curi karechila|” iusupha takhana kathATi nijera mane gopana rAkhala, tAdera kAche prakAzye valala nA| se (mane mane) valala, “tomAdera avasthAna khuva nikRSTa| Ara tomarA yA valacha se samparke AllAha savaceYe bhAla avagata Achena|”
tArA valala, “zAsaka mahodaYa! tAra ekajana vaYovRddha pitA Ache| (se tAra janya kaSTa pAve|) tAra sthale Apani AmAdera ekajanake rekhe dina| AmarA mane kari, Apani ekajana mahAnubhava mAnuSa|
se valala, “nAuyuvillAha! yAra kAche AmarA AmAdera mAla peYechi tAke chAr3A AmarA Arekajanake dharava kena? tA karale AmarA to avazyai jAlema vale gaNya hava|”

tArA tAra kAcha theke nirAza haYe ekAnte gopana parAmarza karala| tAdera var3ajana valala, “tomarA ki jAna nA ye, tomAdera vAvA tomAdera theke AllAhara nAme pratijJA niYechena evaM era Age tomarA iusuphera vyApAre anyAYa karechile? ataeva, Ami ekhAna theke yAva nA, yatakSaNa nA vAvA AmAke (yAoYAra) anumati dena kiMvA AllAha AmAra janya (vin‌iYAmInera muktira) kona vyavasthA kare dena| tini to zreSTha vyavasthApaka|”

“tomarA tomAdera vAvAra kAche phire yAo evaM vala, vAvA! tomAra chele (vin‌iYAmIna) curi kareche| AmarA yA jenechi kevala tArai sAkSya dilAma| AmarA to Ara adRzya viSaYa jAnatAma nA| (arthAt se ye curi kareche tA to AmarA dekhei elAma| Ara tomAra kAche pratijJA karAra samaYa to Ara jAnatAma nA ye, se curi karave|)”
“ye janapade AmarA chilAma evaM ye kAphelAYa AmarA (phire) esechi tAra (lokadera) kAche jijJesa kare dekha| AmarA avazyai satya valachi|”

(putradera esava kathA zonAra para) iYAkUva valala, “(tomarA yA valacha tA Thika naYa) varaM tomAdera mana tomAdera janya ekaTi kathA sAjiYe diYeche (arthAt tomarA ekaTi managar3A kathA sAjiYe enecho)| ataeva, dhairyadhAraNai (AmAra janya) uttama| hate pAre, AllAha tAdera sakalake AmAra kAche niYe Asavena| nizcaYai tini mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|”
se putradera dika theke mukha phiriYe nila evaM valala, “hAYare AmAra iusupha!” zoke tAra cokhaduTo sAdA (dRSTihIna) haYe giYechila evaM se chila ekevArei viSaNna|

tArA valala, “AllAhara kasama! tumi maraNApanna kiMvA mRtadera antarbhukta nA haoYA paryanta iusuphera kathA smaraNa karatei thAkave| (iusuphera kathA smaraNa karate karate tumi maraNApanna haYe par3ave athavA marei yAve|)”
se valala, “Ami zudhu AmAra duHkha Ara manera kaSTa AllAhara kAche vyakta karachi, evaM Ami AllAhara kAcha theke emanakichu jAni yA tomarA jAna nA|”
