“he AmAra putrarA! tomarA yAo evaM iusupha o tAra bhAike tAlAza karo; Ara AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYo nA| vastuta kApherarA vyatIta AllAhara rahamata theke keu nirAza haYa nA|”

ataHpara tArA yakhana (AvAra) iusuphera kAche gela takhana valala, “zAsaka mahodaYa! AmarA o AmAdera parivAravarga khuva kaSTe par3echi evaM AmarA sAmAnya pu~ji niYe esechi| Apani AmAderake puro varAdda dina evaM AmAderake sad‌kA pradAna karuna| nizcaYai AllAha sad‌kA pradAnakArIdera pratidAna diYe thAkena|”
iusupha valala, “tomarA iusupha o tAra bhAiYera sAthe ki AcaraNa karechile tA ki jAna? tomarA to ajJa|”

tArA valala, “Asale tumii ki iusupha?” se valala, “Amii iusupha, Ara e hacche AmAra bhAi (vin‌iYAmIna)| AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karechena| Asale yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM dhairyadhAraNa kare AllAha sei satkarmazIladera pratidAna kichutei naSTa karena nA|”
tArA valala, “AllAhara kasama! avazyai AllAha tomAke AmAdera opara zreSThatva diYechena evaM nizcaYai AmarA aparAdhI chilAma|”
iusupha valala, “Aja Ara tomAdera viruddhe kona tiraskAra naYa| AllAha tomAderake kSamA karuna! tini savaceYe var3a daYAlu|”

“tomarA AmAra ei jAmATi niYe yAo| (vAr3ite pau~che) eTi AmAra vAvAra mukhamaNDalera opara rAkhave| (ete) tini tA~ra dRSTi phire pAvena| tArapara tomarA tomAdera parivAra-parijana sakalake niYe AmAra kAche eso|”
yakhana kAphelA raoYAnA hala takhana tAdera vAvA (iYAkUva) valala, “Ami to iusuphera ghrANa pAcchi, yadi tomarA AmAke mAnasika bhArasAmyahIna mane nA kara|”
upasthita lokerA valala, “AllAhara kasama! tumi Asale tomAra sei purAna vibhrAntira madhyei Acho|”

ataHpara susaMvAdadAtA ese iusuphera jAmATi iYAkUvera mukhamaNDale rAkhatei se dRSTizakti phire pela| takhana se vale uThala, “Ami tomAdera valechilAma nA ye, Ami AllAhara kAcha theke emanakichu jAni yA tomarA jAna nA?”
tArA (iYAkUvera putrarA) valala, “vAvA! tumi AmAdera pApagulo (AllAhara kAche) mApha kariYe nAo| AmarA Asalei pApI chilAma|”
se valala, “Ami AmAra prabhura kAche tomAdera janya kSamA cAiva| nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|”
tArapara tArA yakhana (AvAra) iusuphera kAche ela takhana se tAra pitAmAtAke nijera kAche Tene nila evaM valala, “tomarA AllAhara icchAYa nirApade misare praveza kara|”

iusupha tAra pitAmAtAke siMhAsanera opare vasAYa, Ara tArA (pitAmAtA o bhAiYerA) tAra sammAne sejadAYa luTiYe par3e| takhana se vale, “vAvA! eTAi to AmAra pUrvekAra svapnera tAtparya| AmAra prabhu tA satye pariNata karechena| tini AmAke kArAgAra theke vera kare evaM AmAra o AmAra bhAidera madhye zaYatAna kartRka vairitA sRSTira parao tomAderake marujIvana theke (ekhAne) niYe ese AmAra prati anugraha karechena| AmAra prabhu yA cAna nizcaYai tA nipuNabhAve sampanna karena| tinii mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|”

“he AmAra prabhu! tumi AmAke rAjya dAna karecho evaM kathAra (vA svapnera) tAtparya vyAkhyA zikhiYecho| he AsamAna o jaminera sraSTA! ihakAla o parakAle tumi AmAra abhibhAvaka| tumi AmAke musalima (tomAra prati anugata) avasthAYa mRtyu dio evaM sat lokadera sAthe milita karo|”

esava hacche adRzyalokera kichu saMvAda yA Ami ohIra mAdhyame tomAke jAnAcchi| Ara tArA yakhana ekatre tAdera karmaparikalpanA Thika karachila evaM cakrAnta karachila takhana tumi to tAdera kAche chile nA|
tumi kAmanA karaleo adhikAMza mAnuSa ImAnadAra have nA|
tumi to tAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAccha nA| eTA sArA vizvavAsIra janya eka upadeza vai naYa|
AsamAna o jamine kata nidarzana Ache! mAnuSa esavera opara diYei yAYa (esava dekhe), athaca egulo theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
tAdera adhikAMza zir‌ka karA vyatIta AllAhake vizvAsa kare nA|
tave ki tArA AllAhara AjAvasvarUpa tAdera opara kona duryoga neme AsA kiMvA tAdera ajJAtasAre akasmAt tAdera kAche keYAmata ese par3A theke nijederake nirApada mane karache?
vala, “ei AmAra patha| Ami jene vujhe (mAnuSake) AllAhara dike DAki, Ami o AmAra anusArIrA; AllAha mahimAnvita! Ara Ami muzarikadera antarbhukta nai|”

tomAra pUrve Ami janapadavAsIdera madhya theke puruSaderakei rasUla hiseve pAThiYechi| Ami tAdera kAche ohI pAThAtAma| tave ki tArA (avizvAsIrA) pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni evaM dekheni ye, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNati kemana chila? parakAlera nivAsai to mottAkIdera janya uttama| tave ki tomarA vojha nA?

avazeSe yakhana rasUlagaNa nirAza hata evaM mane karata ye tAderake mithyA pratipanna karA haYeche takhana tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya Asata evaM Ami yAderake cAitAma tArA rakSA peta| Ara aparAdhIdera theke AmAra zAsti pherAno yAYa nA|

tAdera ghaTanAvalIte vuddhimAna lokadera janya zikSA raYeche| ei koraAna kona vAnAno kathA naYa, varaM era sAmane ye AsamAni kitAva Ache (tAorAta o inajIla) tArai satyAYana, savakichura vistArita vyAkhyA evaM ImAnadAra lokadera janya eka dika-nirdezanA o anugraha|

Alipha lAma mIma rA [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| egulo mahAgranthera (koraAnera) AYAta| tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura pakSa theke yA nAyila karA haYeche tA satya| tave adhikAMza mAnuSa tA vizvAsa kare nA|

AllAha sei mahAna sattA yini kona stambha chAr3Ai AsamAnasamUha uttolana (Urdhvaloke tairI) karechena, yA tomarA dekhate pAccha| ataHpara tini siMhAsane adhiSThita haYechena evaM sUrya o candrake anugata (nirdeza motAveka AvartanazIla) karechena| pratyeke nirdiSTa samaYa motAveka calache| tini sakala viSaYa paricAlanA karena evaM nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA tomAdera prabhura (sAthe) sAkSAta samvandhe pratyaYI hao|

tinii sei sattA yini bhUmike vistRta karechena evaM tAte anar3a pAhAr3a-parvata o nada-nadI sthApana karechena| sekhAne tini pratyeka phalera duTi kare jor3A tairI karechena| tini dinake rAta dvArA AcchAdita karena| era madhye cintAzIla lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

pRthivIte paraspara saMlagna bhUkhaNDa, AGgurera vAgAna, zasyakSetra evaM ekAdhika mAthAviziSTa o eka mAthAviziSTa khejuragAcha Ache yA ekai pAni dvArA siJcita haYa; tave phalera svAde Ami egulora katakake katakera ceYe utkRSTa kare thAki| era madhye vuddhimAna lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

Ara tumi yadi (kona kichute) vismita hao tAhale (bheve dekha) avizvAsIdera e kathATio ekaTi vismaYa: “AmarA yakhana mATi haYe yAva takhana ki AmAderake natunabhAve sRSTi karA have?” orAi odera prabhuke avizvAsa kareche evaM oderai galAYa thAkave lohAra zikala| orA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI| sekhAne orA cirakAla thAkave|

aztiAsIrA tomAra kAche maGgalera (anugrahera) Age tAr3AtAr3i amaGgala (zAsti) cAYa| athaca tAdera Age anurUpa aneka zAstira ghaTanA saMghaTita haYeche| Ara mAnuSera anyAYa sattveo (anutapta hale) tomAra prabhu tAdera prati avazyai kSamAparAYaNa| AvAra (anyAYe anar3a thAkale) tomAra prabhu zAstipradAneo atyanta kaThora|
kApherarA vale, “tAra kAche tAra prabhura pakSa theke kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYani kena?” Asale tumi to ekajana satarkakArI mAtra| Ara pratyeka janagoSThIra janyai ekajana pathapradarzaka thAke|
pratyeka nArI (garbhe) yA vahana kare evaM garbhAzaYe yA kame Ara yA vAr3e AllAha tA (sava) jAnena| savakichui tA~ra kAche ekaTi nirdiSTa parimANe raYeche|
tini sava adRzya o prakAzya viSaYa jAnena; tini sumahAna o sarvocca maryAdAvAna|
tomAdera madhye ye kathA gopana kare Ara ye tA prakAza kare evaM ye rAte lukiYe thAke Ara ye dine avAdhe vicaraNa kare (tA~ra kAche) savAi samAna|

mAnuSera janya tAra sAmane o pechane raYeche ekera para eka AgamanakArI pherezatAvRnda| tArA AllAhara nirdeze tAke pAhArA diYe rAkhe| AllAha to kona janagoSThIra avasthA parivartana karena nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA nijerA nijedera avasthA parivartana kare| Ara AllAha yakhana kona janagoSThIke zAsti dite cAna takhana keu tA pherAte pAre nA| tini chAr3A tAdera kona vandhuo nei|
tinii tomAderake vidyut dekhAna (kakhanao) bhaYa o (kakhanao) AzAra vastu hiseve; evaM tinii bhArI (vRSTivAhI) megha sRSTi karena|

vajra tA~ra guNagAna o prazaMsA kare evaM tA~ra bhaYe pherezatArAo (tAi kare)| tini vajrapAta karena evaM era dvArA yAke cAna AghAta karena| tavuo tArA (avizvAsIrA) AllAha samparke vitarka kare, athaca tini pracaNDa pratApazAlI|

satyera DAka ekamAtra tA~ra janya (tA~ke chAr3A Ara kAuke prabhu hiseve DAkA yAve nA)| avizvAsIrA tA~ke chAr3A yAderake (yesava deva-devIke) DAke tArA kona sAr3A dite pAre nA; yemana pAni mukhe pau~chAve ei AzAYa keu pAnira dike hAta vAr3Ale (jar3a padArtha) pAni tAra mukhe pau~chAYa nA| kApheradera DAka kevala niSphalai haYe thAke|
AsamAna o jamine yArA Ache tArA evaM tAdera chAYAgulo icchAYa o anicchAYa sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhake sejadA kare|sejadA

vala, “AsamAna o jaminera prabhu ke?” tumi vala, “AllAha|” vala, “tAhale ki tomarA tA~ke chAr3A emana katipaYa abhibhAvaka nirdhAraNa karecho yAdera nijederai kona upakAra kiMvA kSati karAra kSamatA nei?” vala, “andha Ara dRSTisampanna ki samAna haYa? athavA andhakAra Ara Alo ki ekarakama hate pAre? nAki yAderake tArA AllAhara sAthe zarIka sAvyasta kareche tArAo AllAhara sRSTira mata (kichu) sRSTi kareche, yA dekhe tArA vibhrAntite par3eche?” (tArA to kichui sRSTi kareni; tAhale kon‌ yuktite tArA tAderake AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta karache?) tumi vale dAo, “AllAhai savakichura sraSTA evaM tinii ekaka o mahAparAkramazAlI|”

tini AkAza theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karena| yAra phale upatyakAsamUha yAra yAra parimANamata pravAhita haYa| tArapara srota aneka phenA bhAsiYe Ane| Ara mAnuSerA gahanA vA jinisapatra vAnAnora janya ye vastu Agune jvAla deYa tA thekeo anurUpa ekaprakAra phenA tairI haYa| ebhAvei AllAha (rUpaka vyavahArera mAdhyame) satya Ara mithyA spaSTa karena| phenA to srotavAhita AvarjanAra mata udhAo haYe yAYa| Ara yA mAnuSera upakAre Ase tA bhUmite theke yAYa| AllAha ebhAvei upamA diYe thAkena|

yArA tAdera prabhura DAke sAr3A deYa tAdera janya uttama pratidAna (jAnnAta) raYeche| Ara yArA tA~ra DAke sAr3A deYa nA tAdera yadi pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA sava thAkata evaM tAra sAthe Aro samaparimANa thAkata tAhale avazyai tArA tA (zAsti theke vA~cAra janya) muktipaNasvarUpa dite cAita| (yadio tAte kona kAja hata nA|) tAdera janya raYeche kaThina hisAva| tAdera AvAsa have jAhAnnAma| katai nA khArApa vizrAmasthala!

ataeva, ye jAne ye, tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura kAcha theke yA avatIrNa haYeche tA satya, se ki ai vyaktira mata, ye andha? (emana dui vyakti ekarakama naYa|) vastuta vuddhimAnerAi upadeza grahaNa kare thAke;
yArA AllAhara oYAdA pUraNa kare evaM pratijJA bhaGga kare nA;
evaM yArA AllAha yA saMyukta rAkhAra nirdeza diYechena tA saMyukta rAkhe (AtmIYatA samparka vajAYa rAkhe), nijedera prabhuke bhaYa kare o kaThina hisAvera AzaMkAYa thAke|

Ara yArA tAdera prabhura santuSTira AzAYa dhairyadhAraNa kare, nAmAya sampAdana kare, Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tA theke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare evaM bhAla dvArA mandake pratirodha kare pariNAme tAdera janya raYeche utkRSTa AvAsa (jAnnAta);
sthAYI jAnnAta, yAte tArA praveza karave evaM tAdera vAvAdera, strIdera o santAnadera madhye yArA satkarmazIla tArAo (praveza karave)| Ara pherezatArA pratiTi darajA diYe tAdera kAche praveza karave|
(Ara valave) “tomarA yehetu dhairyadhAraNa karechile, tAi tomAdera opara zAnti varSita hoka! pariNAma hisAve katai uttama ei AvAsa!”

Ara yArA AllAhara sAthe pAkkA oYAdA karAra para tA bhaGga kare evaM AllAha yA saMyukta rAkhAra (AtmIYatA samparka vajAYa rAkhAra) nirdeza diYechena tA chinna kare Ara pRthivIte azAnti sRsTi kare tAdera janyai abhisampAta; Ara tAdera janya raYeche nikRSTa AvAsa (jAhAnnAma)|
AllAha yAra janya cAna jIvikA vAr3iYe dena evaM (yAra janya cAna tA) saMkucita karena| tArA pArthiva jIvana niYe Ananda kare, athaca ei pArthiva jIvana parakAlera tulanAYa kSaNikera bhogamAtra|
kApherarA vale, “tAra kAche tAra prabhura pakSa theke kona nidarzana Aseni kena?” vala, “AllAha yAke cAna vibhrAntite rAkhena evaM ye phire Ase (taovA kare) tini tAke tA~ra dike patha dekhAna|”
(AllAhara pathera sandhAnaprApta tArAi) yArA ImAna eneche evaM yAdera antara AllAhara smaraNe prazAnta haYa; jene rAkha, AllAhara smaraNei antarasamUha prazAnta haYe thAke|
yArA ImAna Ane Ara satkAja kare tAdera janya Ache sukha Ara sundara pratyAvartanasthala|

ebhAvei Ami tomAke ekaTi mAnavagoSThIra kAche pAThiYechi yAra pUrve Aro aneka mAnavagoSThI atikrAnta haYeche, yena tomAra kAche Ami ye ohI pAThiYechi tumi tA tAderake par3e zonAo; athaca tArA parama daYAlu AllAhake avizvAsa karache| vala, “tinii AmAra prabhu| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| Ami tA~rai opara bharasA karechi evaM tA~ra kAchei AmAra pratyAvartana|”

yadi emanao ekaTi koraAna hata yAra sAhAyye pAhAr3a cAlAno yeta kiMvA jamina TukarA TukarA karA yeta athavA mRtaderake kathA valAno yeta (tAhaleo avizvAsIrA tA vizvAsa karata nA)| tave sava viSaYa AllAharai ekhatiYArabhukta| tAhale ki yArA ImAna eneche tArA ekhanao jAnate pAreni ye, AllAha yadi cAitena tAhale sava mAnuSake satpathe paricAlita karatena? Ara nijedera kRtakarmera janyai kApheradera vipada ghaTate thAkave kiMvA ei vipada tAdera vAr3igharera kAche neme Asate thAkave, yatakSaNa nA AllAhara oYAdA (tAdera mRtyu/keYAmata) ese par3e| AllAha to oYAdA bhaGga karena nA|
tomAra pUrveo rasUladera sAthe ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYeche| takhana (prathame) Ami kApheraderake kichuTA avakAza diYechi| tArapara tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi| tAhale AmAra zAstiTA kemana chila!

tAhale ki yini (AllAha) pratiTi mAnuSera yAvatIYa kAjakarma tadAraka karena (tini tAdera mata hate pArena yArA tA kare nA)? athaca tArA AllAhara zarIka sAvyasta kareche| vala, “tomarA tAdera (ai zarIkadera) nAma vala| tomarA ki AllAhake emanakichu (nAma) jAnAve yA ei duniYAYa (Ache vale) tini jAnena nA? nAki zudhu (asAra) vAhyika kathA dvArA (edera nAmakaraNa kare thAka)?” Asale kApheradera pratAraNAke tAdera dRSTite zobhana karA haYeche evaM tAderake satpatha theke virata rAkhA haYeche| Ara AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena tAra janya kona pathapradarzaka nei|
duniYAra jIvanei tAdera janya zAsti Ache| parakAlera zAsti to Aro kaThina| AllAhara hAta theke tAderake rakSA karAra mata keu nei|

mottAkIderake ye jAnnAtera oYAdA karA haYeche tAra varNanA: tAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| tAra khAdyasAmagrI (phala-phalAdi) o chAYA cirasthAYI| yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kareche eTA tAdera pratiphala| Ara kApheradera pratiphala jAhAnnAma|

Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA (Ahale kitAvera keu keu) tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte khuzI, kintu (tAdera) dalagulora madhye keu keu AvAra tAra kichu aMza asvIkAra kare| vala, “AmAke to Adeza deoYA haYeche yena AllAhara ivAdata kari evaM tA~ra sAthe zarIka nA kari| Ami tA~ra dikei (mAnuSake) DAki evaM tA~ra kAchei AmAra pratyAvartana|”

ebhAve Ami koraAnake AravI bhASAYa ekaTi vidhAnarUpe nAyila karechi| tomAra kAche jJAna AsAra para yadi tumi tAdera kathAmato cala tAhale AllAhara vipakSe tomAra kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA rakSaka thAkave nA|

Ami tomAra pUrveo aneka rasUla pAThiYechilAma evaM tAderake strI o santAna-santati diYechilAma| AllAhara hukuma nA hale kona rasUla kona nidarzana niYe Asata nA| pratyeka samaYera janya ekaTi likhita (nirdiSTa) vidhAna Ache|
AllAha yA icchA nizcihna karena evaM (yA icchA) Thika rAkhena| Ara tA~rai kAche raYeche mUla grantha (lAohe muh‌phUya)|

Ami tAderake yA (ye zAstira) oYAdA karachi tAra kichuTA yadi tomAke dekhAi athavA yadi (tAra Agei) tomAra jIvanAvasAna ghaTAi tAhaleo tomAra kartavya to zudhu (satyera vANI) pau~che deoYA| hisAva neoYAra dAYitva to AmAra|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami (tAdera) bhUmike caturdika theke saMkucita kare Anachi? AllAha hukuma dena| keu tA~ra hukuma pechane rAkhate pAre nA| Ara tini khuva druta hisAva niYe thAkena|
tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArAo kauzala karechila, tave sava kauzala AllAhara| pratyeka vyakti yA upArjana kare tini tA jAnena| Ara kApherarA zigagirai jAnave zeSa (zubha) pariNAma kAdera janya|
kApherarA vale, “tumi prerita (rasUla) nao|” vala, “AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve AllAha evaM yAdera kitAvera jJAna Ache tArAi yatheSTa|”

Alipha lAma rA [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| (eTi) ekaTi kitAva, yA Ami tomAra kAche nAyila karechi, yAte tumi mAnuSake tAdera prabhura hukume andhakAra theke vera kare Alote Anate pAra, arthAt mahAparAkramazAlI o sarvamaYa prazaMsAra mAlikera (AllAhara) pathe niYe Asate pAra|
sei AllAhara pathe yini AsamAna o jaminera savakichura mAlika| Ara kApheradera janya raYeche mahA durbhoga arthAt kaThina zAsti|
yArA AkherAtera ceYe duniYAra jIvanake vezi bhAlavAse, AllAhara pathe calate (mAnuSake) vAdhA deYa evaM tAte vakratA anveSaNa kare| orA sudUraprasArI vibhrAntira madhye raYeche|

Ami pratyeka rasUlake tAra svajAtira bhASA niYe (bhASAbhASI kare) pAThiYechi, yAte se tAdera kAche (AllAhara vArtA) vujhiYe valate pAre| tArapara AllAha yAke cAna vipathagAmI karena evaM yAke cAna saThika patha dekhAna| tinii parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzana niYe pAThiYechilAma Ara valechilAma, “tomAra lokaderake andhakAra theke vera kare Alote niYe eso evaM tAderake AllAhara dinasamUha smaraNa kariYe dAo|” nizcaYai ete pratyeka dhairyazIla o kRtajJa vyaktira janya nidarzana raYeche|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana mUsA tAra lokaderake valechila, “tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa karo, yakhana tini tomAderake pherAunera lokadera theke rakSA karechilena| tArA tomAderake nikRSTa dharanera zAsti dita: tomAdera chelederake javAi karata Ara nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| Ara ete chila tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke eka mahAparIkSA|”
(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAdera prabhu ghoSaNA karechilena, “yadi tomarA kRtajJa thAka tAhale tomAderake Aro deva, kintu yadi akRtajJa hao tAhale (mane rAkhave) avazyai AmAra zAsti var3a kaThora|”
Ara mUsA valechila, “tomarA evaM pRthivIra savAi kuphari karaleo AllAha avazyai amukhApekSI o sakala prazaMsAra adhikArI|”

tomAdera pUrve ye nUha, Ada o chAmUdera samapradAYa chila evaM tAdera pare yArA chila tAdera saMvAda ki tomAdera kAche Aseni? AllAha chAr3A keu tAdera kathA jAne nA| tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa pramANa niYe esechila; kintu tArA (rAge kAmar3Anora janya) nijedera hAta mukhe diYechila Ara valechila, “tomAderake yA niYe pAThAno haYeche AmarA tA avizvAsa kari evaM tomarA ye dike AmAderake DAkacha se vyApAre AmarA eka vibhrAntrikara sandehera madhye Achi|”

tAdera rasUlagaNa valechila, “AsamAna o jaminera sRSTikartA AllAha samparke ki kona sandeha Ache? tini tomAderake tomAdera pApa kSamA karAra janya evaM tomAderake ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAza deoYAra janya DAka dicchena|” tArA valata, “tomarA to AmAdera matai mAnuSa chAr3A anya kichu nao| AmAdera vApa-dAdArA yAdera upAsanA karata tomarA tAdera theke AmAderake virata rAkhate cAccha| Thika Ache, tomarA tAhale (tomAdera dAvira samarthane) spaSTa pramANa niYe Asa|”

tAdera rasUlagaNa tAderake valechila, “AmarA tomAdera matai mAnuSa chAr3A anya kichu nai Thikai, tave AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati cAna anugraha karena| Ara AllAhara hukuma chAr3A tomAdera kAche kona pramANa niYe AsA AmAdera kAja naYa| AllAhara oparai muminadera bharasA karA ucita|”

“AmarA AllAhara opara bharasA karava nA kena? tinii to AmAderake patha dekhiYechena| tomarA AmAderake ye kaSTa diccha AmarA tAte avazyai dhairya dharava| AllAhara oparai bharasAkArIdera (sakalera) bharasA karA ucita|”

Ara kApherarA tAdera rasUladera valechila, “AmarA tomAderake AmAdera bhUmi theke vera kare deva athavA tomarA AmAdera dharme phire Asave|” takhana rasUladera kAche tAdera prabhu ohI pAThiYechilena, “Ami jAlemaderake avazyai dhvaMsa karava|”
“evaM tAdera pare avazyai tomAderake jaminera adhivAsI karava| eTA tAdera janya yArA (keYAmatera dina) AmAra sAmane dA~r3Anoke bhaYa kare, Ara bhaYa kare AmAra (zAstira) humakike|”
rasUlagaNa (tAdera zatrura viruddhe AllAhara kAche) vijaYa kAmanA karechila evaM pratyeka dAmbhika svecchAcArI vyartha haYechila|
tAra pechane (bhAgye) raYeche jAhAnnAma evaM (sekhAne) tAke pAnira sthale pu~ja pAna karAno have|

se tA Dhoka gile (anicchAYa) pAna karave evaM tA gelA sahajasAdhya have nA| Ara sava dika theke tAra kAche mRtyu (mRtyura yantraNA) Asate thAkave, kintu se marave nA| tAra pechane (bhAgye) raYeche kaThina zAsti|

yArA tAdera prabhuke avizvAsa kare tAdera (kAjakarmera) upamA: tAdera kAjasamUha chAiYera (stupera) mata, yAra opara diYe jhar3era dine pravala vAtAsa vaYe yAYa| tArA tAdera upArjana diYe kichui karate pAre nA| eTAi sudUraprasArI vibhrAnti|
AllAha ye AsamAna o jamina yathArthabhAve sRSTi karechena tA ki tumi lakSya karani? tini yadi cAna tAhale tomAderake niYe giYe (tomAdera jAYagAYa) eka natuna sRSTi niYe Asate pArena|
eTA AllAhara janya kaThina kichu naYa|

(keYAmatera dina) tArA savAi AllAhara sAmane dA~r3Ave| takhana yArA nijederake var3a mane karata durvalerA tAderake (tAdera sei ahaMkArI netAderake) valave, “AmarA to tomAderai anusArI chilAma| tAi (ekhana) AllAhara AjAva theke vA~cate tomarA ki AmAdera kona upakAre Asave?” tArA valave, “yadi AllAha AmAderake patha dekhAtena tAhale AmarAo tomAderake avazyai patha dekhAtAma| ekhana AmarA asthira hai kiMvA dhairya dhari (ubhaYai) AmAdera janya samAna| AmAdera kona rehAi nei|”

yakhana viSaYaTi phaYasAlA haYe yAve takhana zaYatAna valave, “AllAha tomAdera sAthe satya oYAdA karechilena| Ara Amio tomAdera sAthe oYAdA karechilAma| tave Ami AmAra se oYAdA bhaGga karechi| Ami tomAderake DAka diYechilAma Ara tomarA AmAra se DAke sAr3A diYechile— echAr3A tomAdera opara AmAra to kona hAta chila nA| ataeva, tomarA AmAke tiraskAra karo nA, varaM nijederakei tiraskAra kara| (ekhana) Amio tomAderake sAhAyya karate pArava nA Ara tomarAo AmAke sAhAyya karate pArave nA| Age (duniYAYa) tomarA ye AmAke (AllAhara sAthe) zarIka karechile Ami (ekhana) tA asvIkAra karachi| avazyai anyAYakArIdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|”

Ara yArA ImAna enechila evaM satkAja karechila tAderake jAnnAte sthAna deoYA have, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| tArA sekhAne tAdera prabhura anumatikrame cirakAla thAkave| sekhAne tAdera abhivAdana have jJasAlAma (zAnti)Jca|
AllAha kIbhAve eka ekaTi upamA diYechena tumi ki tA lakSya karani? ekaTi bhAla kathA ekaTi bhAla gAchera mata, yAra zikar3a khuva majavuta evaM yAra zAkhA-prazAkhA AkAze (aneka opare) vistRta|
ye gAcha tAra prabhura nirdeze savasamaYe phala deYa| AllAha mAnuSera janya upamA dena, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ara ekaTi khArApa kathA ekaTi khArApa gAchera mata, yA mATi theke upar3e phelA haYeche, yAra kona sthiti nei|
AllAha dRr3ha kathA (taohIdera kalemA) dvArA muminaderake pArthiva jIvana o parakAle dRr3ha rAkhena| AllAha jAlemaderake vipathagAmI karena| AllAha yA cAna tAi kare thAkena|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani yArA AllAhara neYAmatake (asvIkRtira mAdhyame) avizvAse parivartana kareche evaM nijedera lokaderake dhvaMsera vAr3ira vAsindA kareche?
jAhAnnAmera (vAsindA); tArA tAte dagdha have (athavA praveza karave)| kata khArApa ei AvAsasthala!
tArA (mAnuSake) AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karAra uddezye tA~ra samakakSa dA~r3a kariYeche| vala, “bhoga kare nAo| kAraNa, tomAdera gatipatha to jAhAnnAmera dike|”

AmAra ye vAndArA ImAna eneche tAderake vala, tArA yena nAmAya par3e evaM Ami tAderake ye jIvikA diYechi tA theke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare, emana dina AsAra Age yakhana kona kraYa-vikraYa kiMvA vandhutva thAkave nA|

AllAha hacchena sei mahAna sattA yini AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena evaM AsamAna theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa kare tA dvArA tomAdera jIvikAra janya phalaphalAdi utpanna karechena| tini nauyAnake tomAdera kAje lAgAra upayogI karechena, tAi tA~ra hukumei tA samudre (pAnite) calate pAre| tini nada-nadIkeo tomAdera kAje lAgiYechena|
tini avirAma karmarata sUrya o canadrake tomAdera kAje lAgiYechena| tini rAta o dinakeo tomAdera kAje lAgiYechena|
tomarA tA~ra kAche yA yA ceYecho tini tomAderake tA savai diYechena| tomarA yadi AllAhara neYAmata gaNanA karo, tAhale tA guNe zeSa karate pArave nA| mAnuSa Asalei var3a jAlema, var3a akRtajJa|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana ivarAhIma valechila, “he AmAra prabhu! ei nagarIke zAntipUrNa (o nirApada) kare dAo evaM AmAke o AmAra putraderake mUrtipUjA theke dUre rAkha|”
“he AmAra prabhu! erA (mUrtigulo) aneka mAnuSake pathabhraSTa kareche| ataeva, ye AmAra kathA mene cale se AmAra loka| Ara ye AmAke amAnya kare tAra vyApAre tumi kSamAzIla, daYAlu|”

“he AmAdera prabhu! Ami AmAra santAnadera (vaMzadharadera) madhya theke (ekajanake) tomAra pavitra gharera (kAvAra) kAche eka phasalahIna upatyakAYa vAsindA karechi, he AmAdera prabhu! yAte tArA nAmAya kAYema kare; ataeva, tumi katipaYa mAnuSera antara tAdera prati AkRSTa kare dio evaM phalaphalAdi dvArA tAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA kare dio, yAte tArA kRtajJatA prakAza kare|”
“he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA yA gopana kari Ara yA prakAza kari tumi tA savai jAna| jamine kiMvA AsamAne kona kichui AllAhara kAche gopana thAke nA|”
“sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini vRddha vaYase AmAra janya (dui putra) isamAIla o isahAkake dAna karechena| AmAra prabhu avazyai prArthanA zune thAkena|”
“he AmAra prabhu! AmAke nAmAyI karo, evaM AmAra santAnadera madhya thekeo| he AmAdera prabhu! Ara tumi AmAra doYA kavula kara|”
“he AmAdera prabhu! yedina hisAva have sedina AmAke, AmAra pitAmAtAke o muminaderake kSamA karo|”

jAlemarA yA karache se vyApAre AllAhake kakhanao vekhavara mane karo nA| Asale tini tAderake sei (kaThina hAzarera) dina paryanta avakAza dicchena yakhana (tAdera) cakSusamUha (bhaYe) sthira haYe yAve|

(bhIta-santrasta avasthAYa) nijedera mAthA UrdhvamukhI kare tArA chuTochuTi karate thAkave| tAdera dRSTi nijedera dike phirave nA (tArA nijedera dike tAkAveo nA)| Ara (pracaNDa bhaYe) tAdera antara thAkave (kona kichu bhAvavAra zakti theke) ekevAre zUnya|

sei dina samparke mAnuSake satarka kare dAo yedina tAdera kAche zAsti Asave Ara jAlemarA valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake alpakAlera janya avakAza dAo, AmarA tomAra AhavAne sAr3A deva evaM rasUladera kathA mene calava|” tomarA itipUrve zapatha kare valechile nA ye, tomAdera kona patana nei?

tomarA tAderai vAsasthAne vasavAsa karecho yArA nijedera prati juluma karechila| Ara tomarA bhAlabhAvei jenecho, Ami tAdera sAthe kirUpa AcaraNa karechilAma| Ami tomAdera janya dRSTAnta upasthApana karechi|
tArA tAdera (sarvAtmaka) cakrAnta kareche, tave tAdera cakrAnta AllAhara jAnA Ache; yadio tAdera cakrAnta chila pAhAr3a vilupta haoYAra mata (gurutara)|
tumi kakhanao AllAhake tA~ra rasUladera sAthe oYAdA bhaGgakArI mane karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, pratizodha grahaNakArI|
(sei dina) yedina ei jaminake anya jamine parivartana karA have; AsamAnasamUhakeo (parivartana karA have); evaM mAnuSa ekaka, parAkramazAlI AllAhara sAmane upasthita have|
sedina tumi pApIderake ekatre zikala-parAno avasthAYa dekhate pAve|
tAdera pozAka have AlakAtarAra evaM Aguna tAdera mukhamaNDala Acchanna karave|
ebhAve AllAha pratyekake tAra karmera pratiphala devena| AllAha to druta hisAva grahaNakArI|
ei koraAna mAnuSera janya ekaTi vArtA; yAte era dvArA tAderake satarka karA yAYa, yAte tArA jAnate pAre ye, tinii ekamAtra upAsya evaM yAte vuddhimAnerA zikSAgrahaNa kare|

Alipha lAma rA [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| egulo pavitra grantha o suspaSTa eka koraAnera AYAta|
(keYAmatera dina nijedera pariNAma jAhAnnAma Ara musalamAnadera pariNAma jAnnAta dekhe) kApherarA prAYaza kAmanA karave, tArA yadi musalamAna hata!
oderake khete, bhoga karate Ara AzAYa bhule thAkate dAo| orA (ekadina) jAnate pArave|
Ami ye janapadakei dhvaMsa karechi, tAra janya chila ekaTi nirdiSTa likhita samaYakAla|
kona jAti tAra nirdiSTa samaYakAla AgAte kiMvA pichAte pAre nA|
Ara avizvAsIrA valeche, “he sei vyakti yAra kAche koraAna nAyila karA haYeche! (koraAnaprAptira dAvidAra he muhAmmAda!) Asale tumi ekaTA pAgala|
tumi yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale AmAdera kAche pherezatAdera niYe Asa nA kena?”

(Asale) vAstava praYojana chAr3A Ami pherezatAdera pAThAi nA| (yakhana kona samapradAYake tAtkSaNika zAsti deoYA praYojana haYa, kevala takhanai Ami pherezatA pAThiYe thAki|) takhana tAderake Ara avakAza deoYA haYa nA|
Amii koraAna nAyila karechi evaM avazyai Ami tA saMrakSaNa karava|
Ami to tomAra Age pUrvavartI samapradAYagulora madhye rasUla pAThiYechilAma|
(tave) tAdera kAche ye rasUlai Asata tArA tAke niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
ebhAvei Ami pApIdera antare eTA (avizvAsa-pravaNatA) DhukiYe dei|
orA ete (koraAne) vizvAsa karave nA| pUrvavartIrAo erakama AcaraNa karechila|
Ara Ami yadi odera janya AsamAnera (Urdhvalokera) kona darajA khule dei evaM orA tAte (dinabhara) ArohaNa karate thAke (Ara sekhAnakAra savakichu dekhe Ase)
tAraparao orA valave, “Asale AmAdera dRSTivibhrama ghaTAno haYechila, varaM AmarA yAdugrasta haYechilAma|
AsamAne Ami rAzicakra sthApana karechi evaM paryavekSakadera janya tAke suzobhita karechi|
Ara pratyeka vitAr3ita zaYatAna theke tAke hephAjata karechi|
avazya ye curi kare (gopana kathA) zone tAra kathA AlAdA; tave pradIpta ulkA tAra pazcAddhAvana kare|
Ara jaminake Ami suvistRta karechi, sekhAne parvatamAlA sthApana karechi evaM tAte pratiTi parimita vastu utpanna karechi|
sekhAne tomAdera janya jIvikAra vyavasthA karechi; Ara tomarA yAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA karo nA tAdera janyao|
AmAra kAchei sava jinisera bhANDAra raYeche; evaM Ami tA nirdiSTa parimANei pAThiYe thAki|
Ami garbhavatI (vRSTira megha vahanakArI) vAtAsa pAThAi, tArapara AkAza theke pAni varSaNa kari evaM tomAderake tA pAna karAi; tomarA tAra bhANDArarakSaka (niYantraka) nao|
nizcitabhAve Amii jIvana dAna kari o mRtyu ghaTAi evaM Amii (savakichura) prakRta uttarAdhikArI (cUr3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI)|
Ami tomAdera madhye pUrve AgamanakArIderakeo jAni evaM pare Agamana-kArIderakeo jAni|
tomAra prabhui tAderake ekatrita karavena| nizcaYai tini prajJAmaYa, mahAjJAnI|
Ami mAnuSake (prathama mAnuSa Adamake) sRSTi karechi durgandhamaYa kardamera zukano ThanaThane mATi theke|
Ara tAra Age jvinake sRSTi karechi pracaNDa uSNa Aguna theke|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAra prabhu pherezatAdera valechilena, “Ami durgandhamaYa kardamera zukano ThanaThane mATi theke ekajana mAnuSa sRSTi karava|”
“yakhana Ami tAra pUrNa AkRti pradAna karava evaM tAra madhye AmAra (sRSTa) prANa saJcArita karava takhana tomarA tAra sammAne sejadAvanata have|”
(e nirdeza mene) pherezatArA savAi sejadA karala;
kintu ivalIsa vAda raila; se savAra sAthe (Adamake) sejadA karate asvIkAra karala|
AllAha valalena, “ivalIsa! savAra sAthe tumi sejadA karale nA kena?”
se valala, “Ami to ekajana mAnuSake sejadA karate pAri nA, yAke tumi durgandhamaYa kardamera zukano ThanaThane mATi theke sRSTi karecho|”
AllAha valalena, “tAhale tumi jAnnAta theke veriYe yAo, kAraNa tumi vitAr3ita (abhizApaprApta)|”
“Ara tomAra opara vicArera dina paryanta abhizApa thAkave|”
se valala, “he prabhu! tAhale AmAke sei dina paryanta samaYa dAo yedina mRtaderake uThAno have|”
tini valalena, “tomAke samaYa deoYA hala;
nirdiSTa samaYera dina paryanta|”
se valala, “he prabhu! yehetu tumi AmAke vipathagAmI karecho, tAi Ami pRthivIte mAnuSera sAmane avazyai (pApera patha) sAjiYe rAkhava evaM tAdera savAike avazyai vipathagAmI karava;
tAdera madhya theke tomAra manonIta vAndAdera chAr3A|”
tini valena, “eTA AmAra kAche pau~chAnora sojA patha|
AmAra (khA~Ti) vAndAdera opara tomAra kona kartRtva thAkave nA| tave ye vipathagAmIrA tomAra anusaraNa karave tAdera kathA AlAdA|”
Ara jAhAnnAmai hala tAdera (vipathagAmIdera) sakalera pratizruta sthAna|
era sAtaTi darajA Ache| pratiTi darajAra janya raYeche odera ekaTi bhAga-karA (nirdiSTa) aMza|
mottAkIrA thAkave jAnnAte o jharanAsamUhera mAjhe|
(valA have) “ete tomarA zAntira sAthe nirApade praveza kara|”
Ami tAdera antarera vidveSa dUra kare deva| tArA bhAibhAiYera mata sAmanAsAmani Asane vasave|
sekhAne tAdera kona klAnti Asave nA evaM sekhAna theke tAderake verao karA have nA|
AmAra vAndAderake jAniYe dAo, Amii kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|
Ara AmAra zAstii yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tAderake ivarAhImera (kAche Agata) mehamAnadera (pherezatAdera) kathA vala|
yakhana tArA tAra kAche (vAr3ite) praveza kare valala, “sAlAma”| se valala, “AmarA to ApanAderake dekhe bhaYa pAcchi|”
tArA valala, “bhaYa pAvena nA| AmarA ApanAke ekajana jJAnavAna putra-santAnera susaMvAda dicchi|”
se valala, “AmAra vArdhakya ese yAoYA sattveo ApanArA AmAke (ei) susaMvAda dicchena? ApanArA kisera susaMvAda dicchena?”
tArA valala, “AmarA ApanAke saThika susaMvAdai diYechi| ataeva, Apani nirAza havena nA|”
se valala, “vipathagAmIrA vyatIta keu tAra prabhura anugraha theke nirAza haYa nA|”
ivarAhIma valala, “he dUtagaNa! ApanAdera Asala kAjaTA ki (ye janya ApanAderake pAThAno haYeche)?”
pherezatArA valala, “Asale AmAderake eka aparAdhI samapradAYera (lUtera samapradAYera) kAche (tAderake zAsti deoYAra janya) pAThAno haYeche|”
“lUtera parivAravarga vyatIta| AmarA tAdera savAike rakSA karava|
tave tAra strIke naYa| AmarA Thika karechi ye, se avazyai pechane theke-yAoYAdera (arthAt dhvaMsaprAptadera) antarbhukta have|”
ataHpara yakhana dUtagaNa lUtera parivArera kAche ela
takhana se (lUta) valala, “ApanArA to dekhachi kaYekajana acenA mAnuSa|”
tArA valala, “AmarA Asale ApanAra kAche (avizvAsIdera janya) sei zAsti niYe esechi ye samparke tArA sandeha karata|
AmarA ApanAra kAche satya (vArtA) niYe esechi evaM avazyai AmarA satya valachi|

ataeva, Apani ApanAra parivAravargasaha rAtera kona eka samaYe veriYe par3avena evaM Apani tAdera pazcAdbhAge calavena| ApanAdera keu yena (pechane) nA tAkAYa| Ara ApanAderake yekhAne yete valA hacche sekhAne cale yAna|”
Ara Ami tAke (lUtake) se viSaYaTi jAniYe dilAma ye, sakAlei tAdera (tAra samapradAYera pApIdera) zikar3a keTe deoYA have (tAderake samUle dhvaMsa karA have)|
(pApI) zaharavAsIrA (katipaYa taruNera AgamanavArtA zune) Ananda karate karate upasthita hala|
lUta valala, “erA AmAra atithi| ataeva, (edera sAthe azobhana AcaraNa kare) tomarA AmAke lajjita karo nA|”
“Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAke lAJchita karo nA|”
tArA valala, “AmarA tomAke duniYAra savAike AzraYa dite mAnA karini?”
lUta valala, “tomarA yadi kichu karatei cAo tAhale (vidhisammatabhAve viYe karAra janya) ei AmAra meYerA raYeche|”
(he muhAmmAda) tomAra jIvanera zapatha! tArA tAdera mAtAlatAYa dizehArA haYechila|
ataHpara sUryodaYakAle pracaNDa eka AoYAja tAderake pAkar3Ao (AghAta) karala|
Ara Ami (tAdera) janapadaTira oparera dikake nice kare (ulTe) dilAma evaM tAdera opara pAthara varSaNa karalAma|
ete cintAzIladera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
Ara janapadaTi eka sthAYI (vilupta haYe yAYani emana) pathera pAzei vidyamAna|
ete muminadera janya avazyai eka nidarzana Ache|
Ara AikAra adhivAsIrA (zoYAivera sampradAYa) avazyai jAlema chila|
tAi Ami tAderake zAsti diYechilAma| Ara ubhaYa janapada eka spaSTa pathera pAzei vidyamAna|
hij‌ravAsIrAo (chAmUda sampradAYa) rasUladera prati mithyAropa karechila|
Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzana diYechilAma; kintu tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
tArA pAhAr3a keTe gharavAr3i vAniYe nirApade vasavAsa karata|
tArapara eka sakAle pracaNDa eka AoYAja tAderake pAkar3Ao (AghAta) karala|
takhana tAdera upArjanasamUha (dhana-sampada) tAdera kona kAje Ase ni|
AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichu Ami yathArthai sRSTi karechi| Ara keYAmata avazyai Asave| ataeva, tumi (tAdera doSatruTi) kSamAsundara dRSTite dekho|
tomAra prabhui suvijJa sRSTikartA|
Ami to tomAke vAravAra pATha karAra sAtaTi AYAta (sUrA phAtihA) o mahAna koraAna dAna karechi|

Ami tAdera kaYeka zreNIke ye bhogera sAmagrI diYechi tumi tAra dike cokha vAr3Ave nA (tAkAve nA), tAdera janya duHkha karave nA evaM muminadera janya nijera vAhu nicu karave (muminadera prati sadaYa thAkave)|
Ara valave, “Amii to spaSTa satarkakArI|”
yemana (nAnArakama anyAYa) zapathakArIdera (ihudi o khriSTAnadera) oparao nAyila karechilAma|
yArA koraAnake (vibhinna bhAge) vibhakta kareche (koraAnera kona viSaYa tAdera pachanda hale tA vizvAsa kareche Ara kona viSaYa apachanda hale tA avizvAsa kareche)|
ataeva, tomAra prabhura zapatha! avazyai Ami tAdera sakalake jijJAsA karava,
tArA yA kichu karata se samparke|
ataeva, tomAke ye nirdeza deoYA haYeche tA prakAzye ghoSaNA karo evaM muzarikadera theke mukha phiriYe nAo|
vidrUpakArIdera viruddhe tomAra janya Amii yatheSTa|
yArA AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsya sAvyasta kare tArA (era pariNAma) jAnate pArave|
Ami avazyai jAni ye, tAdera kathAYa tomAra mana saMkucita hacche;
sutarAM tumi tomAra prabhura saprazaMsa pavitratA varNanA karo evaM sejadAkArIdera antarbhukta hao|
Ara tomAra prabhura ivAdata karate thAka, yatakSaNa nA tomAra kAche nizcita vastu (mRtyu) upasthita haYa|
AllAhara nirdeza ese geche (avazyai Asave)| ataeva tomarA tAra janya tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| tini mahAmahima| Ara tArA (tA~ra sAthe) yA kichu zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|

tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke yAdera kAche cAna, tA~ra ei nirdezera ohI niYe pherezatA pAThAna ye, tomarA (mAnuSake) satarka kare diYe (AmAra pakSa theke) valave, “Ami chAr3A kona upAsya nei, ataeva AmAke bhaYa kara|”
tini yathAyathabhAve AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena| tArA (tA~ra sAthe) yA kichu zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|
tini mAnuSa sRSTi karechena eka pho~TA zukra theke| athaca ei mAnuSai prakAzya virodhI haYe yAYa|
tini tomAdera janya gavAdipazu sRSTi karechena| egulote tomAdera janya tApagrahaNera (zItavastra tairira) upakaraNa o Aro aneka upakAra Ache| edera theke tomarA khAdyao peYe thAka|
egulote tomAdera janya saundaryao Ache, yakhana vikele ederake cAraNabhUmi theke niYe Asa evaM yakhana sakAle ederake cAraNabhUmite niYe yAo|
erA tomAdera vojhA (mAlAmAla) emana aJcale vaYe neYa yekhAne tomarA prANAntakara kaSTa vyatIta pau~chAte pArate nA| tomAdera prabhu avazyai anugrahazIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara ghor3A, khaccara o gAdhA (sRSTi karechena) tomAdera ArohaNera janya o zobhAsvarUpa| tini Arao aneka kichu sRSTi karena yA tomarA jAna nA|
sarala patha dekhAno AllAhara dAYitva; tave pathera madhye vA~kA pathao Ache| Ara tini yadi icchA karatena tAhale avazyai tomAdera sakalake satpatha dekhAtena|
tinii AsamAna theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karena| tAte tomAdera pAnIYera vyavasthA haYa evaM gAchapAlA janme yAte tomarA pazu carAo|
ai vRSTi dvArA tini tomAdera janya (nAnArakama) zasya evaM jalapAi, khejura, AGgura o savarakama phala utpanna karena| ete cintAzIla lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|
tini rAta o dina evaM sUrya o candrake tomAdera janya kAje lAgiYechena| tArakArAo tA~ra nirdeze kAje niYojita| ete vuddhimAna lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|
Arao nAnAvarNera yesava vastu tini pRthivIte sRSTi karechena; esavera madhyeo cintAzIla lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|

tinii samudrake (tomAdera) adhIna kare diYechena, yAte tomarA sekhAna theke khAoYAra janya TATakA mAMsa (mAcha) evaM paridhAnera janya alaMkAra AharaNa karate pAra| sekhAne tumi pAni cire jAhAja calate dekhave| Ara yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM (tA~ra prati) kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
tini jamine sudRr3ha parvatamAlA sthApana karechena, yAte tA tomAderake niYe hele nA par3e; evaM nadanadI o patha tairI karechena yAte tomarA gantavye pau~chAte pAra|
(dine calAra janya tini) pathacihna sthApana karechena evaM (rAte) lokerA tArakAra sAhAyye pathera sandhAna pAYa|
ataeva, yini sRSTi karena tini ki tAra mata havena ye sRSTi kare nA? eraparao ki tomarA cintA karave nA?
tomarA yadi AllAhara neYAmata gaNanA karate cAo tAhale tA gaNanA karate pArave nA| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomarA yA gopana karo Ara yA prakAza karo tA (savai) AllAha jAnena|
tArA AllAha chAr3A yAderake DAke tArA to kichui sRSTi karate pAre nA, varaM tAderakei sRSTi karA haYa|
tArA mRta, jIvita naYa| Ara kakhana tAderake uThAno have tArA tAo jAne nA|
tomAdera prabhu ekaka prabhu| ataeva, yArA parakAla vizvAsa kare nA tAdera antara satyavimukha evaM tArA ahaMkArI|
kona sandeha nei ye, tArA yA gopana kare Ara yA prakAza kare AllAha tA (savai) jAnena| tini ahaGkArIderake pachanda karena nA|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “tomAdera prabhu kI avatIrNa karechena?” tArA vale, “pUrvavartIdera kesasA-kAhini|”

tArA keYAmatera dina nijedera (pApera) vojhA puropuri vahana karave evaM tAderao kataka vojhA (vahana karave) yAderake jJAna nA thAkAYa tArA vibhrAnta karache| jene rAkha, ye vojhA tArA vahana karave tA khuvai khArApa|

tAdera pUrvavartIrA cakrAnta karechila| AllAha tAdera (cakrAntera) bhavanera bhittimUle AghAta karechilena| phale opara theke tAdera mAthAYa (bhavanera) chAda bheGge par3echila evaM ajJAta sthAna theke tAdera opara AjAva esechila|

erapara keYAmatera dina tini tAderake lAJchita karavena Ara valavena, “kothAYa AmAra sei zarIkerA, yAdera niYe tomarA (ImAnadAradera sAthe) virodha karate?” (takhana) yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYechila tArA valave, “Ajakera dine lAJchanA Ara duravasthA kApheradera janyai|”

nijedera prati juluma karate thAkA avasthAYa pherezatArA yAdera jAnakavaja kare| tArapara tArA (kRtrima) AtmasamarpaNa kare valave, “AmarA to khArApa kichu karatAma nA|” avazyai! tomarA yA karate AllAha tA bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|
tomarA tAi jAhAnnAmera darajAYa Dhuke par3a| ekhAne tomarA cirakAla thAkave| ahaMkArIdera (ei) AvAsasthala var3a khArApa!

Ara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karechila tAderake valA have, “tomAdera prabhu kI nAyila karechilena?” tArA valave, “kalyANa”| yArA satkAja kare tAdera janya e duniYAtei maGgala raYeche| Ara parakAlera ghara to Arao bhAla| mottAkIdera ghara var3ai uttama!
tArA cirasthAYI jAnnAte praveza karave, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa evaM sekhAne tArA yA cAYa tAi Ache| ebhAvei AllAha mottAkIdera puraskAra diYe thAkena|
pavitra thAkA avasthAYa pherezatArA yAdera jAnakavaja kare| tArA vale, “tomAdera prati zAnti varSita hoka! tomarA yesava (bhAla) kAja karate tAra pratidAnasvarUpa jAnnAte praveza kara|”

tArA ki tAdera kAche pherezatAdera Agamana kiMvA tomAra prabhura (zAstira) nirdeza Agamanerai apekSAYa Ache? tAdera pUrvavartIrAo emanaTi karechila| AllAha to tAdera prati juluma karenani, varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati juluma kareche|
tAi tAdera opara nijedera apakarmera pratiphala Apatita hala evaM tArA yA niYe vidrUpa karata tAo tAderake veSTana karala|

muzarikarA valala, “AllAha yadi icchA karatena tAhale AmarA o AmAdera vApa-dAdArA tA~ke chAr3A kona kichurai upAsanA karatAma nA evaM tA~ra nirdeza chAr3A nijerA kona kichu hArAma (niSiddha) karatAma nA|” tAdera pUrvavartIrAo emanaTi karechila| ataeva, pariSkArabhAve vArtA pau~che deoYA chAr3A rasUladera ki Ara kona dAYitva Ache?

Ami to pratyeka jAtira kAchei ei dAoYAta niYe ekajana rasUla pAThiYechi, “tomarA AllAhara ivAdata karo evaM tAgUta (mithyA upAsya) theke dUre thAka|” anantara tAdera madhye katakake AllAha supathe enechena evaM katakera janya vipathagAmitA avadhArita haYeche| ataeva, tomarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekha, (satyake) mithyA pratipannakArIdera kirUpa pariNati haYeche|
tumi tAdera hedAYeta kAmanA karaleo AllAha yAderake vipathe nevena tAderake tini hedAYeta karavena nA evaM tArA kona sAhAyyakArIo pAve nA|
tArA AllAhara nAme dRr3ha zapatha kare vale, “yArA mare yAYa AllAha tAderake punarutthita karavena nA|” avazyai (karavena), eTA tA~ra satya oYAdA; tave adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
(tini mRtaderake punarutthita karavena) yAte tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karata tini tA prakAza karate pArena evaM yAte kApherarA jAnate pAre ye, tArAi mithyAvAdI chila|
Ami yakhana kona kichu karate icchA kari takhana tAke zudhu “hao” vali, amani tA haYe yAYa|
niryAtita haoYAra para yArA AllAhara janya hijarata kareche, duniYAYa Ami tAderake uttama vAsasthAna deva| Ara AkherAtera puraskAra to Arao var3a| yadi tArA jAnata!
(erA tArAi) yArA dhairyadhAraNa kareche evaM tAdera prabhura opara bharasA kare|
tomAra pUrveo Ami mAnuSaderakei rasUla hiseve pAThiYechilAma| tAdera kAche ohI pAThAtAma| yadi tomAdera jAnA nA thAke tAhale (AsamAni kitAvera) jJAnasampanna vyaktidera kAche jijJAsA kare dekha|

(rasula pAThiYechilAma) spaSTa nidarzana o (AsamAni) kitAvasaha| Ara tomAra kAche smaraNikA (koraAna) avatIrNa karechi, yAte mAnuSera kAche yA nAyila karA haYeche tA tAderake pariSkAra kare vujhAte pAra evaM yAte tArA cintA kare|
yArA durabhisandhi kare tArA ki ei bhaYa theke mukta ye, AllAha tAderakesaha jamina dAviYe devena? kiMvA emana dika theke AjAva ese tAderake pAkar3Ao karave yA tArA jAne nA?
athavA tAdera ghorAghurira madhyei tini tAderake pAkar3Ao karavena? tArA to (eTA karate AllAhake) apAraga karate pArave nA|
kiMvA (tArA ki e bhaYa theke mukta ye,) bhIta avasthAYa tini tAderake pAkar3Ao karavena? (tAderake tAtkSaNikabhAve esava zAsti nA deoYAra kAraNa) tomAdera prabhu avazyai snehaparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|
AllAha ye sava jinisa sRSTi karechena tArA ki segulora prati lakSya kareni, (kIbhAve) tAdera chAYA AllAhara uddezye vinItabhAve sejadAvanata haYe DAne o vAme jhu~ke par3e?
AsamAne yA kichu Ache o jamine ye sava jIvajanta Ache tArA savAi AllAhake sejadA kare; pherezatArAo; tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|
tArA nijedera opara theke tAdera prabhuke bhaYa kare evaM ye nirdeza pAYa tA pAlana kare thAke|sejadA
AllAha valalena, “tomarA dujana upAsya grahaNa karo nA| upAsya to ekajanai| ataeva, AmAkei bhaYa kara|”
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai, evaM avirAma Anugatya kevala tA~rai prApya| tavuo ki tomarA AllAha chAr3A anyake bhaYa karave?
tomAdera kAche ye neYAmata raYeche tA AllAhara pakSa thekei| AvAra yakhana tomarA kona kaSTe par3a takhana tA~rai kAche phariYAda kara|
tArapara tini yakhana tomAdera kaSTa dUra karena, takhani tomAdera ekaTi dala tAdera prabhura sAthe zarIka sAvyasta kare|
Ami tAderake yA diYechi tA asvIkAra karAra janya (emanaTi kare thAke)| Thika Ache! bhoga kare nAo; ekadina jAnate pArave|

Ami tAderake ye riyika diYechi tArA tAra ekaTi aMza tAdera (bhuYA upAsyadera) janya nirdhArita kare yAdera samparke tArA jAne nA| AllAhara zapatha! tomarA yA kichu mithyA udbhAvana karate se samparke avazyai tomAderake prazna karA have|
tArA AllAhara janya nirdhAraNa kare kanyA— tini (e theke) pavitra— Ara nijedera janya Thika kare tAi yA tArA kAmanA (pachanda) kare|
tAdera kAuke yakhana kanyA-santAna janmera saMvAda deoYA haYa takhana tAra cehArA kAlo (malina) haYe yAYa evaM se viSaNna haYe par3e|

tAke ye saMvAda deoYA haYeche tArai glAnite se lokadera theke nijeke lukiYe rAkhe Ara bhAve, lAJchanA niYe se ki tAke rekhe deve nAki mATite pu~te phelave? jene rAkha! tArA ye vicAra kare tA atyanta jaghanya|
yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA tArA nikRSTa avasthAne Ache| pakSAntare AllAhara avasthAna sarvocca| tinii mahAparAkrama-zAlI, parama prajJAvAna|

AllAha yadi mAnuSake tAdera anyAYera janya (saGge saGge) pAkar3Ao karatena (zAsti ditena) tAhale pRthivIte kona calamAna (jIvanta) prANI rAkhatena nA| vastuta tini tAderake ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAza dena| yakhana tAdera samaYa Ase takhana tArA eka muhUrtao vilamva karate kiMvA egiYe Asate pAre nA|

tArA yA apachanda kare tAi AllAhara janya nirdhAraNa kare evaM tAdera jihavA ebhAve mithyA varNanA deYa ye, bhAla jinisagulo tAderai have| kona sandeha nei ye, tAdera janyai jAhAnnAma, evaM tAderakei Age Age nikSepa karA have|

AllAhara zapatha! Ami tomAra Age vibhinna jAtira kAche rasUla pAThiYechi; kintu zaYatAna tAdera (khArApa) kAjaguloke tAdera dRSTite zobhana kareche| ataeva, Aja se-i tAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tomAra kAche kitAva nAyila karechi zudhu ejanya ye, tArA ye viSaYe matabheda kare tumi tAdera janya tA spaSTa karave; Ara ImAnadAra lokadera janya tA eka patha-nirdeza o anugrahasvarUpa have|
AllAha AsamAna theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karena evaM era dvArA bhUmi niSaprANa haoYAra para tA sajIva karena| ye lokerA zone tAdera janya nizcaYai ete nidarzana raYeche|

gavAdipazura madhyeo tomAdera janya zikSA raYeche| Ami tAdera peTera bhitarera govara o raktera madhya theke khA~Ti dudha (vera kare) tomAderake pAna karAi, yA pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu o tRptidAYaka|
Ara khejuragAchera phala (khejura) o AGgura theke tomarA mAdaka o uttama khAdya grahaNa kare thAka| vuddhimAna lokadera janya ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
tomAra prabhu maumAchike valechena, “tomarA ghara vAnAo pAhAr3e, gAche Ara mAnuSerA yA nirmANa kare tAte|”

“tArapara savarakama phala theke AhAra karo evaM tomAdera prabhura sugama pathasamUhe cala|” ei maumAchira peTa theke vibhinna raGera pAnIYa (madhu) vera haYa, yAte mAnuSera janya Arogya Ache| era madhye cintAzIla lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|

AllAha tomAderake sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena| tomAdera madhye katakake jIvanera savaceYe khArApa aMze (vArdhakye) upanIta karA haYa, yAte tArA jAnAra para kichui nA jAne (aneka kichu jAnAra para AvAra sava bhule yAYa)| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, sarvazaktimAna|

jIvikAra (sampadera) vyApAre AllAha tomAdera katakake katakera ceYe agrAdhikAra diYechena| yAderake agrAdhikAra deoYA haYeche tArA tAdera jIvikA nijedera adhInastha dAsa-dAsIderake e janya deYa nA ye, tArA tAte samAna haYe yAve| tave ki tArA AllAhara neYAmata asvIkAra kare?

AllAha tomAdera janya tomAdera nijedera thekei jor3A tairI karechena, tomAdera jor3A theke putra-pautradera sRSTi karechena evaM tomAderake uttama jIvikA dAna karechena| tA sattveo ki tArA vAtile (mithyA deva-devIte) vizvAsa kare? (Asale) tArA AllAhara neYAmata asvIkAra kare|
tArA AllAha chAr3A emana upAsyadera upAsanA kare yArA tAdera janya AsamAna o jamina theke kona jIvikA deoYAra mAlika naYa evaM tAdera se kSamatAo nei|
ataeva, tomarA AllAhara kona upamA dio nA| vastuta AllAha (savakichu) jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|

(vizvAsI Ara avizvAsIdera pArthakya vujhAnora janya) AllAha (duijana lokera) upamA peza karachena: ekajana anyera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsa (avizvAsI), yAra nijera kichu karAra kSamatA nei| Arekajana emana loka (vizvAsI) yAke Ami AmAra pakSa theke uttama jIvikA dAna karechi evaM se nijera thekei gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare| ei dui dharanera mAnuSa ki samAna have? sakala prazaMsA AllAhara; tave tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

(viSaYaTi vujhAnora janya) AllAha Arao dui vyaktira upamA peza karachena: tAdera ekajana vovA (avizvAsI), ye kichui karate pAre nA evaM se tAra mAlikera opara ekaTi vojhA| mAlika tAke yekhAnei (ye kAjei) pAThAYa, se bhAla kichu karate pAre nA| ei vyakti Ara ai vyakti (vizvAsI) ki samAna have, ye nyAYera Adeza deYa evaM se (nijeo) saThika pathe Ache|
AsamAna o jaminera adRzya rahasya AllAhara kAchei raYeche| keYAmatera vyApAraTi to kevala cokhera palakera mata, kiMvA tA Aro kAchera (druta)| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
AllAha tomAderake tomAdera mAYera peTa theke vera karechena| takhana tomarA kichui jAnate nA| tini tomAderake kAna, cokha o hRdaYa diYechena, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
tArA ki zUnya AkAze uDDaYanarata pAkhidera dekhe nA? AllAhai to tAderake dhare (AkAze bhAsamAna) rAkhachena| ete ImAnadAra lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

AllAha tomAdera janya tomAdera ghare vasavAsera vyavasthA karechena| tini tomAdera janya pazura cAmar3A theke ghara (tA~vu) tairira vyavasthA karechena— yA tomarA bhramaNakAle o kothAo avasthAnakAle hAlakA (sahaje vahanayogya) pAccha— evaM tAra pazama, loma o cula theke AsavAvapatra o kichukAlera janya bhogyasAmagrI tairira vyavasthA karechena|

AllAha tA~ra sRSTa vastu theke tomAdera janya chAYAra vyavasthA karechena, pAhAr3e AzraYasthala vAniYe diYechena, emana pozAka diYechena yA tomAderake tApa theke rakSA kare, AvAra emana pozAkao (varma) diYechena yA tomAderake yuddhera samaYa rakSA kare| ebhAvei tini tomAdera janya tA~ra neYAmata pUrNa karechena, yAte tomarA (tA~ra kAche) AtmasamarpaNa kara|
tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale (jene rAkha,) tomAra dAYitva kevala spaSTabhAve (vArtA) pau~che deoYA|
tArA AllAhara neYAmata cene; tAraparao tA asvIkAra kare| tAdera adhikAMzai kAphera|
(smaraNa karo) yedina Ami pratyeka jAti theke ekajana sAkSI dA~r3a karAva; takhana kApheraderake (kona kaiphiYata peza karAra) anumati deoYA have nA evaM tAderake taovA karArao suyoga deoYA have nA|
Ara jAlemarA yakhana zAsti dekhate pAve takhana tA Ara laghu karA have nA evaM tAderake kona avakAzao deoYA have nA|

Ara yArA zarIka karata tArA (muzarikarA) yakhana tAdera zarIkaderake dekhate pAve takhana valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! erAi AmAdera seisava zarIka yAderake AmarA tomAra parivarte DAkatAma|” takhana ai zarIkarA muzarikadera dike kathATi chu~r3e mArave (tAtkSaNikabhAve vale uThave), “tomarA avazyai mithyAvAdI|”
sedina tArA AllAhara kAche AtmasamarpaNa karave evaM tArA yA kichu mithyA vAnAto tA (mithyA deva-devI ityAdi) tAdera theke udhAo haYe yAve|
yArA kuphari kare o AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare, Ami tAderake AyAvera para AjAva vRddhi karava; kAraNa tArA azAnti sRSTi karata|

Ara (smaraNa karo) yedina Ami pratyeka jAtira mAjhe tAdera nijedera madhya thekei tAdera viruddhe ekajana sAkSI dA~r3a karAva evaM edera viruddhe tomAke sAkSI hiseve niYe Asava| Ami tomAra kAche savakichura suspaSTa varNanA evaM AtmasamarpaNakArIdera janya patha-nirdeza, anugraha o susaMvAdarUpe kitAva (koraAna) nAyila karechi|

nizcaYai AllAha nyAYaparAYaNatA, satkAja o AtmIYa-svajanake dAna karAra nirdeza dena evaM azlIlatA, asatkAja o vAr3AvAr3i karate niSedha karena| tini tomAderake sadupadeza dena, yAte tomarA zikSAgrahaNa kara|
tomarA yakhana oYAdA karo takhana AllAhara oYAdA pUraNa karave evaM AllAhake jAmina kare dRr3ha zapatha karAra para tA bhaGga karave nA| tomarA yA karo AllAha tA nizcaYai jAnena|

tomarA ai nArIra mata haYo nA ye tAra sutA zakta kare pAkAnora para tA TukarA TukarA kare chi~r3e naSTa kare| tomarA ekadala anyadalera ceYe adhika lAbhavAna haoYAra janya parasparake dho~kA deoYAra kauzala hiseve nijedera zapathake vyavahAra kare thAka| Asale era dvArA AllAha tomAderake parIkSA karena| Ara tomarA ye viSaYe matabheda karate keYAmatera dina tini tA tomAdera janya avazyai spaSTa kare devena|

icchA karale AllAha tomAdera savAike eka jAti kare dite pAratena, kintu tini yAke cAna pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke cAna pathera sandhAna dena| Ara tomarA yA karate se samparke tomAderake prazna karA have|

tomarA parasparake dho~kA deoYAra janya nijedera zapathake vyavahAra karo nA| tAte pA sthira haoYAra para pichale yAve evaM AllAhara pathe (mAnuSake) vAdhA deoYAra kAraNe tomarA zAsti AsvAdana karave| tomAdera janya bhaYAnaka zAsti raYeche|

tomarA AllAhara (sAthe kRta) oYAdAra vinimaYe sAmAnya mUlya grahaNa karo nA (tuccha jAgatika svArthe AllAhara oYAdA vikiYe dio nA)| Asale AllAhara kAche yA Ache tomAdera janya tA-i uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate|
tomAdera kAche yA Ache tA niHzeSa haYe yAve, pakSAntare AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA sthitizIla| yArA dhairyadhAraNa kare tAderake avazyai Ami tAdera zreSTha kAjera puraskAra deva|
ye puruSa vA nArI ImAnadAra avasthAYa satkAja karave tAke Ami uttama jIvana dAna karava evaM avazyai tAderake tAdera zreSTha kAjera puraskAra deva|
ataeva, yakhana koraAna pATha karave takhana vitAr3ita (abhizapta) zaYatAna theke AllAhara AzraYa cAive|
Asale tAra (zaYatAnera) sei sava lokadera opara kona Adhipatya nei yArA (satyake) vizvAsa kare evaM tAdera prabhura opara bharasA kare|
tAra Adhipatya Ache kevala tAderai opara yArA tAke vandhurUpe grahaNa kare evaM yArA AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare|

Ami yakhana (koraAnera) ekaTi AYAtake ArekaTi AYAtera sthale parivartana kari—AllAha yA nAyila karena se samparke to tinii bhAla jAnena—takhana tArA vale, “tumi to kevala managar3A kathA vala|” (tAdera e kathA Thika naYa) varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

tumi vale dAo ye, pavitra AtmA (jivarAIla) muminaderake sudRr3ha karAra janya evaM musalamAnadera janya patha-nirdeza o susaMvAdasvarUpa tomAra prabhura pakSa theke satyasaha ei koraAna niYe esechena|
Ami jAni, tArA valache, “Asale tA~ke ekajana mAnuSa zikSA deYa|” tArA ye lokaTira dike iGgita kare emana kathA vale tAra bhASA to zuddha AravI naYa; athaca ei koraAnera bhASA spaSTa AravI bhASA|
yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha vizvAsa kare nA tAderake AllAha patha pradarzana karena nA evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
yArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha vizvAsa kare nA vastuta tArAi mithyA racanA kare evaM tArAi mithyAvAdI;

(tAdera opara AllAhara krodha raYeche) yArA ImAna AnAra para AllAhara sAthe kuphari kare, tArA vyatIta yAdera opara valapraYoga karA haYa (arthAt yAderake kuphari karate vAdhya karA haYa) athaca ImAne tAdera mana prazAnta; varaM yArA kupharite mana khule deYa (arthAt mana thekei kuphari kare), tAdera oparai AllAhara krodha| edera janya bhaYAnaka zAstio raYeche|
eTA ejanya ye, tArA parakAlera ceYe duniYAra jIvanake adhika pachanda kare, Ara AllAha kApheraderake supatha dekhAna nA|
orA to tArAi yAdera antara, kAna o cokha AllAha sIla kare diYechena evaM orAi amanoyogI|
kona sandeha nei ye, parakAle orAi kSatigrasta have|
yArA niryAtana bhogera para hijarata kareche, tArapara jehAda kareche o dhairya dhareche, tAdera janya esavakichura pare avazyai tomAra prabhu kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
(se dinaTi smaraNa karo) yedina pratyekei AtmapakSa samarthana karAra janya upasthita have, pratyekake tAra kAjera phala puropuri deoYA have evaM tAdera prati kona anyAYa karA have nA|

AllAha ekaTi janapadera (makkA) udAharaNa dicchena| janapadaTi chila nirApada o nizcinta| sekhAne sava jAYagA theke paryApta jIvikA Asata| tArapara seTi (tAra adhivAsIrA) AllAhara neYAmatasamUhera prati akRtajJatA prakAza karala| takhana AllAha tAdera kRtakarmera janya janapadaTike kSudhA o bhItira svAda AsvAdana karAlena|
tAdera kAche tAdera madhya thekei ekajana rasUla ela| tArA tAke asvIkAra karala| phale AjAva oderake pAkar3Ao karala| Ara orA chila jAlema|
ataeva, AllAha tomAderake yesava hAlAla o pavitra vastu dAna karechena tA theke AhAra karo Ara AllAhara neYAmatera zukariYA AdAYa karo, yadi tomarA kevala tA~rai ivAdata kara|

AllAha to tomAdera janya mRtaprANIra mAMsa, rakta, zUkarera mAMsa evaM ye prANI AllAha chAr3A anyera nAme javAi karA haYa tAra mAMsa hArAma karechena| tave keu yadi avAdhya nA haYe kiMvA sImAlaMghana nA kare (era konaTi khete) nitAnta vAdhya haYa tAhale nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
tomAdera jihavA mithyAYa abhyasta vale AllAhara nAme mithyA Aropa karAra janya vala nA, “eTA hAlAla Ara eTA hArAma”| yArA AllAhara nAme mithyA Aropa kare tArA kakhanao saphala haYa nA|
(tAdera) svalpakAlIna bhogamAtra| (tArapara) tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
ihudidera janya Ami yA kichu hArAma karechilAma tA tomAra kAche pUrvei varNanA karechi| Ami tAdera prati kona juluma karini, kintu tArAi nijedera prati juluma karata|
yArA ajJatAvazata khArApa kAja kare evaM parakSaNei taovA kare Ara bhAla kAja kare tAdera janya nizcaYai tomAra prabhu kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
nizcaYai ivarAhIma chila ekaTi jAtira pratIka, AllAhara anugata o ekaniSTha| se muzarikadera dalabhukta chila nA|
se chila AllAhara neYAmatasamUhera prati kRtajJa| tini tAke manonIta karechilena evaM saThika pathe paricAlita karechilena|
Ami tAke duniYAYa kalyANa diYechilAma| Ara AkherAteo se satkarmazIladera antarbhukta have|
ataHpara tomAra kAche pratyAdeza pAThiYechi ye, ekaniSTha ivarAhImera matAdarza anusaraNa kara| se muzarikadera antarbhukta chila nA|

zanivAra (udayApana) to tAdera janyai vidhivaddha karA haYechila yArA se vyApAre matabheda karechila| Ara tArA ye vyApAre matabheda karata, tomAra prabhu keYAmatera dina tAdera madhye avazyai tA mImAMsA karavena|

prajJA o sadupadeza dvArA (mAnuSake) tomAra prabhura pathe DAkave evaM tAdera sAthe utkRSTatama panthAYa vitarka karave| tomAra prabhura patha theke ye vicyuta haYeche tAke tinii savaceYe vezi jAnena| AvAra yArA saThika pathe raYeche tAderakeo tinii savaceYe vezi jAnena|
yadi tomarA (zatruderake) zAsti dAo tAhale ye zAsti tomAderake deoYA haYeche tomarAo tAra anurUpa zAsti deve| Ara yadi dhairyadhAraNa karo tAhale dhairyazIladera janya seTAi uttama|
tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo| tomAra dhairya to AllAhara sAhAyya chAr3A naYa| Ara tAdera AcaraNe duHkhita haYo nA evaM tArA ye cakrAnta karache sejanya kaSTa peYo nA|
AllAha to tAdera sAthei Achena yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM yArA satkarmazIla|

pavitratA o mahimA sei mahAna sattAra, yini tA~ra vAndAke rAte bhramaNa kariYechena (makkAra) mAsajidula hArAma theke (jerujAlemera) mAsajidula AkasA paryanta—yAra AzapAza Ami varakatamaYa karechi—tAke AmAra nidarzanasamUha dekhAnora janya| nizcaYai tini savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma evaM eke vanI isarAIlera janya ekaTi dika-nirdezanA kare diYechilAma, (ei nirdeza diYe) ye, “tomarA AmAke chAr3A anya kAuke karmavidhAYaka vAnio nA|”
“he tAdera vaMzadharagaNa, yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe (jAhAje) ArohaNa kariYechilAma! nizcaYai se chila (AmAra) eka parama kRtajJa vAndA|”
Ami vanI isarAIlera prati kitAve ghoSaNA diYechilAma ye, duniYAYa tomarA duJcavAra viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM var3arakama auddhatya pradarzana karave|

ataHpara yakhana aiduTora prathamaTira oYAdA esechila takhana Ami tomAdera viruddhe AmAra pracaNDa zaktizAlI vAndAderake pAThiYechilAma| tArA (zAsti deoYAra janya tomAdera) gharavAr3ira bhitare praveza karechila| eTA ekaTA kAryakara oYAdA chila|
tArapara tAdera viruddhe AvAra tomAdera pAlA (kSamatA) phiriYe diYechilAma; dhana-sampada o putrasantAna dvArA tomAderake sAhAyya karechilAma evaM tomAderake saMkhyAgariSTha karechilAma|

tomarA bhAla kAja karale nijedera janyai karave, Ara khArApa kAja karale tAo nijedera janyai (karave)| tArapara yakhana (ai duTora) dvitIYaTira oYAdA esechila takhana (tAderake pAThiYechilAma) yAte tArA tomAdera mukhamaNDala vikRta kare, prathamavAra yebhAve praveza karechila sebhAve masajide praveza kare evaM yAtei car3Ao haYa sava tachanacha kare deYa|

haYato tomAdera prabhu tomAdera prati anugraha karavena (yadi tomarA tAra kathAmato cala)| kintu yadi AvAra Agera AcaraNa (avAdhyatA) karo tAhale Amio AvAra Agera AcaraNa (zAstira vyavasthA) karava| Ara jAhAnnAmake Ami kApheradera janya kArAgAra vAniYechi|
nizcaYai ei koraAna sarvAdhika saThika patha dekhAYa evaM satkarmazIla muminaderake ei susaMvAda deYa ye, tAdera janya var3a puraskAra raYeche|
Ara yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA tAdera janya Ami yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta rekhechi|
mAnuSa yebhAve kalyANa kAmanA kare sebhAve akalyANao kAmanA kare| mAnuSa var3ai tAr3Ahur3ApravaNa|

Ami rAta o dinake duJcaTi nidarzana vAniYechi| ataHpara rAtera nidarzanake (andhakAra dvArA) niSaprabha karechi Ara dinera nidarzanake Alokaprada karechi; yAte tomarA tomAdera prabhura anugraha (jIvikA) sandhAna karate pAra evaM vacharera saMkhyA o hisAva jAnate pAra| Ami to savakichui vistAritabhAve varNanA karechi|
Ami pratyeka mAnuSera kAja tAra galAYa ve~dhe rekhechi| Ara keYAmatera dina tAra janya ekaTi kitAva (likhita vivaraNa) vera karava yA se kholA avasthAYa pAve|
(tAke valA have) “tomAra kitAvaTi par3a| Aja tomAra viruddhe hisAva grahaNakArI hiseve tumi nijei yatheSTa|”

ye satpathe cale se nijera kalyANera janyai satpathe cale| AvAra ye vipathagAmI haYa se nijera akalyANera janyai vipathagAmI haYa| ekajana Arekajanera bhAra vahana kare nA| Ara rasUla nA pAThAno paryanta Ami (kAuke) zAsti dei nA|

Ami yakhana kona janapada dhvaMsa karate manastha kari takhana tAra vilAsajIvana yApanakArIderake (AmAra Anugatyera) nirdeza dei, kintu tArA sekhAne pApAcAra kare; takhana tAra viruddhe daNDAjJA avadhArita haYe yAYa evaM Ami tAke ekevAre dhvaMsa kare dei|
nUhera para Ami kata prajanma dhvaMsa karechi! nijera vAndAdera pApera khavara rAkhA o tA dekhAra janya tomAra prabhui yatheSTa|
ye duniYA (duniYAra sukha-zAnti) cAYa tAra janya Ami yAke yA dite cAi druta diYe dei| tArapara tAra janya jAhAnnAma nirdhAraNa kari, yAte se nindita-vitAr3ita avasthAYa praveza karave|
Ara ye AkherAta cAYa evaM tAra janya ImAna sahakAre yathAyatha ceSTA kare, emana lokadera ceSTA prazaMsita (puraskArayogya) haYe thAke|
Ami ederake evaM oderake pratyekake tomAra prabhura dAna theke sAhAyya kare thAki| tomAra prabhura dAna (kAro janya) niSiddha naYa|
lakSya karo, Ami kIbhAve tAdera katakake katakera opara zreSThatva diYechi| Ara maryAdAYa o zraSeThetva to parakAlai var3a|
AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsya sAvyasta karo nA| tAhale tumi nindita o lAJchita haYe par3ave|

tomAra prabhu Adeza karechena ye, tomarA kevala tA~rai ivAdata karave evaM pitAmAtAra prati sadvyavahAra karave| yadi tAdera ekajana athavA ubhaYajana tomAra kAche (tomAra saMsAre athavA tomAra jIvaddazAYa) vArdhakye upanIta haYa tAhale tAderake (virakti kiMvA asammAnasUcaka zavda) jJauph‌Jca valave nA evaM tAdera sAthe dhamakera sure kathA valave nA; varaM tAdera sAthe bhAla (sammAnajanaka) kathA valave|

Ara mamatAYa tAdera prati vazyatAra DAnA nata kare deve (tAdera sAthe vinIta AcaraNa karave) Ara valave, “he prabhu! AmAra pitAmAtAra prati daYA karo, yemana tArA AmAke choTa thAkate (daYA diYe) lAlanapAlana karechena|”
tomAdera prabhu tomAdera manera kathA bhAla kare jAnena| tomarA yadi sat hao tAhale avazyai tini taovAkArIdera prati kSamAzIla raYechena|
AtmIYake tAra haka diYe dAo; misakIna o musAphirakeo; Ara moTeo apavyaYa karo nA|
apavyaYakArIrA zaYatAnadera bhAi| Ara zaYatAna tAra prabhura prati var3ai akRtajJa|

Ara tomAra prabhura kAcha theke pratyAzita kona anugrahera apekSAYa thAkAkAle yadi tAdera theke (kakhanao) mukha phiriYe rAkha (ApAtata tAderake kichu dite nA pAra) tAhale tAdera sAthe namrabhAve kathA valave|
tomAra hAta grIvAYa Avaddha rekho nA (ekevAre vyaYakuNTha haYo nA) kiMvA tA puropuri prasArita karo nA (ekevAre muktahasta haYo nA)| tAhale tiraskRta kiMvA niHsva haYe par3ave|
tomAra prabhu yAke cAna tAra jIvikA vAr3iYe dena AvAra saMkucita karena| nizcaYai tini tA~ra vAndAdera sava khavara rAkhena evaM tAdera savakichu dekhena|
abhAvera bhaYe tomarA tomAdera santAnaderake hatyA karo nA| Amii tAdera rujira vyavasthA kari; evaM tomAderao| tAderake hatyA karA nizcaYai ekaTi var3a pApa|
vyabhicArera kAcheo yeYo nA| eTA ekaTA khArApa kAja evaM nikRSTa patha|

AllAha yAke hatyA karA niSiddha karechena nyAyya kAraNa chAr3A tAke hatyA karo nA| yAke anyAYabhAve hatyA karA haYa tAra uttarAdhikArIke to Ami (kesAsa vA diYAta grahaNa athavA kSamA karAra) kSamatA diYechi; tave se yena hatyAra vyApAre vAr3AvAr3i nA kare| (isalAmera vidhAne) nizcaYai se sAhAyyaprApta|
vaYoprApta nA haoYA paryanta sundaratama paddhati chAr3A etimera sampadera kAcheo yAve nA| Ara oYAdA pUraNa karave| oYAdA samparke nizcaYai jijJAsA karA have|
mApera samaYa tomarA mApa puropuri deve evaM saThika niktite ojana karave| eTAi kalyANakara evaM pariNAme eTAi zreYatara|
ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei tAra pechane lego nA| kAna, cokha o antara egulora pratyekaTi samparke jijJAsA karA have|
jamine dambhabhare calo nA| tumi to jaminake vidIrNa karate pArave nA kiMvA parvatera uccatAYao pau~chAte pArave nA|
esavera madhye pratiTi khArApa kAja tomAra prabhura kAche apachandanIYa|
eTi tomAra prabhu kartRka tomAke ohIra mAdhyame pradatta ekaTi hekamata| AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsya dA~r3a karo nA| tAhale abhiyukta o pratyAkhyAta avasthAYa jAhAnnAme nikSipta have|
tomAdera prabhu ki putra grahaNera janya tomAderake manonIta karechena evaM tini nije pherezatAdera madhya theke kanyA grahaNa karechena? nizcaYai tomarA ekaTA gurutara kathA valacha|
avazyai Ami ei koraAne (savakichu) vistAritabhAve varNanA karechi, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare| kintu ete (dekhachi) kevala tAdera virUpa manobhAvai vRddhi pAcche|
vala, “yadi tA~ra sAthe Aro upAsya thAkata, yemanaTi orA valache, tAhale avazyai tArA Arazera mAlika (AllAha) paryanta pau~chAra patha anveSaNa karata|”
tini pavitra evaM tArA yA valache tA theke aneka Urdhve|

sAta AsamAna o pRthivI evaM egulora madhye yArA Ache savAi tA~ra pavitratA varNanA karache| emana kichu nei yA tA~ra pavitratA o prazaMsA varNanA kare nA| tave tomarA tAdera pavitratA varNanAra bhASA vujhate pAra nA| nizcaYai tini atyanta sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|
tumi yakhana koraAna pATha karo takhana Ami tomAra madhye o yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA tAdera madhye ekaTi pracchanna pardA sthApana kari (yAte tArA zunate nA pAYa)|

Ara tAdera antarera opara AvaraNa diYe dei yena tArA tA (koraAna) vujhate nA pAre evaM tAdera kAne diYe dei vadhiratA| (phale) koraAne tumi yakhana tomAra ekaka prabhura kathA AlocanA karo takhana tArA vimukhatAYa pRSTha pradarzana kare|
tArA tomAra kathA zravaNakAle yA zone Ami tA bhAla jAni evaM tArA gopane AlocanAkAle jAlemarA ye vale, “tomarA to eka yAdugrasta vyaktira anusaraNa karacha” Ami tAo jAni|
dekha, orA tomAra janya kIbhAve upamA peza karache| ataeva, orA pathabhraSTa haYeche; tAi kona patha pAcche nA|
tArA vale, “AmarA yakhana hAr3agor3a o dhvaMsAvazeSa haYe yAva tAraparao ki AmarA eka natuna sRSTirUpe punarutthita hava?”
vala, “tomarA pAthara kiMvA lohA hao,

athavA anya kona sRSTavastu yA tomAdera cintAYa (punarAYa sRSTira janya) var3a mane haYa (tAraparao tomAderake punarAYa sRSTi karA have)|” tArA valave, “ke AmAderake AvAra sRSTi karave?” vala, “tinii, yini tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechena|” takhana tArA tomAra sAmane mAthA nAr3ave Ara valave, “tA kave?” vala, “haYato zigagirai have|”
“yedina tini tomAderake DAka devena Ara tomarA tA~ra prazaMsA karate karate tA~ra DAke sAr3A deve; evaM tomAdera mane have, (pRthivIte) tomarA khuva kama samaYera janya avasthAna karechile|”
Ara AmAra vAndAderake valave, tArA yena tAi vale yA savaceYe bhAla| nizcaYai zaYatAna tAdera madhye vibheda sRSTira prarocanA deYa| zaYatAna to mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|
tomAdera prabhu tomAdera samvandhe bhAla jAnena| tini yadi cAna tomAdera prati anugraha karavena kiMvA yadi cAna tomAderake zAsti devena| Ami tomAke tAdera karmavidhAYaka kare pAThAini|
AsamAna o jamine yArA Ache tomAra prabhu tAdera samvandhe bhAla jAnena| Ami navIdera katakake katakera opara maryAdA diYechi evaM dAudake yAvUra diYechi|
vala, “AllAha vyatIta tomarA yAderake upAsya mane karo tAderake DAka| dekhave, tArA tomAdera kaSTa dUra karAra kiMvA tA parivartana karAra kSamatA rAkhe nA|”

tArA yAderake DAke tArA nijerAi to ke nikaTatara have sejanya tAdera prabhura naikaTyalAbhera upAYa anveSaNa kare, tA~ra anugraha kAmanA kare evaM tA~ra zAstira bhaYa kare| tomAra prabhura zAsti to bhaYerai vastu|
emana kona janapada nei yAke Ami keYAmatera Age dhvaMsa karava nA kiMvA (tAra adhivAsIderake) kaThora zAsti deva nA| e kathA kitAvei lipivaddha Ache|

Ami kevala ejanyai nidarzana pAThAno theke virata thekechi ye, pUrvavartIrA tA asvIkAra karechila| spaSTa eka nidarzana hiseve Ami chAmUda jAtike uSTrI diYechilAma, kintu tArA tAra sAthe anyAYa AcaraNa karechila| Ami bhaYa dekhAnora janyai nidarzana pAThiYe thAki|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami tomAke valechilAma, “tomAra prabhu to mAnuSake pariveSTana kare Achena|” Ara Ami tomAke ye dRzya dekhiYechi seTi evaM koraAne ullikhita abhizapta gAchaTi kevala mAnuSake parIkSAra janyai diYechi| Ami tAderake bhaYa dekhAi, kintu ete tAdera ghora avAdhyatAi vRddhi pAYa|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valechilAma, “tomarA Adamake sejadA kara|” takhana ivalIsa vyatIta savAi sejadA karala| se valala, “ yAke tumi mATi dvArA sRSTi karecho Ami ki tAke sejadA karava?”

se valala, “eTA kemana kathA? tumi AmAra opara eke maryAdA dile! (Thika Ache) tumi yadi AmAke keYAmatera dina paryanta samaYa dAo tAhale alpa kaYekajana vyatIta Ami era vaMzadharaderake samUle vinAza kare chAr3ava (ekevAre pathabhraSTa kare phelava)|”
tini valalena, “yAo, tAdera madhye yArA tomAke anusaraNa karave, jAhAnnAmai have tomAdera (sakalera) pratiphala, eka paripUrNa pratiphala|”

“tAdera madhya theke yAke pAra tomAra AoYAja dvArA prarocita karo, tomAra azvArohI o padAtika vAhinI niYe tAdera opara AkramaNa karo, dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite tAdera aMzIdAra haYe yAo evaM tAderake pratizruti dAo|” zaYatAna tAderake ye pratizruti deYa tA dho~kA chAr3A kichu naYa|
“Asale AmAra (khA~Ti) vAndAdera opara tomAra kona kartRtva nei evaM karmavidhAYaka hiseve tomAra prabhui yatheSTa|”
tomAdera prabhu halena tini yini tomAdera janya samudre nauyAna cAlita karena, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha (jIvikA) sandhAna karate pAra| nizcaYai tini tomAdera prati daYAvAna|

Ara yakhana samudre (calAkAle) tomAdera opara vipada Ase takhana ekamAtra tini chAr3A (anya) yAderake tomarA DAka tArA (sava) udhAo haYe yAYa| tArapara tini yakhana tomAderake uddhAra kare bhUmite (tIre) Anena takhana tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo (tA~ra avAdhya hao)| mAnuSa hacche var3a akRtajJa|

tomarA ki tAhale nizcinta ye, tini tomAderake niYe tIrabhUmira prAnta dAviYe devena nA kiMvA tomAdera opara zilAjhar3a pAThAvena nA? takhana tomarA nijedera janya (ai AjAva theke rakSAkArI) kona abhibhAvaka pAve nA|

athavA tomarA ki nizcinta ye, tini tomAderake ArekavAra samudre phiriYe niYe tomAdera opara pravala vAtAsa pAThAvena nA evaM kuphari karAra kAraNe tomAderake nimajjita karavena nA? takhana sekhAne tomarA AmAra viruddhe nijedera janya kona sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|

avazyai Ami Adama-santAnaderake (mAnavajAtike) sammAnita karechi, tAderake sthale o sAgare calAcalera vAhana diYechi, utkRSTa dravyAdi theke tAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA karechi evaM Ami yAderake sRSTi karechi tAdera anekera ceYe tAderake adhika maryAdA diYechi|

(smaraNa karo) yedina Ami sava mAnuSake yAra yAra netAsaha (athavA AmalanAmA kiMvA AsamAni kitAvasaha) DAkava| takhana yAderake tAdera AmalanAmA DAna hAte deoYA have tArA tAdera AmalanAmA pATha karave| tAdera prati sAmAnyao avicAra karA have nA|
Ara ei duniYAYa ye andha (arthAt AllAhara nidarzanasamUha dekhate pAYa nA evaM tA~ra pathe cale nA) se parakAleo andha o adhikatara pathabhrAnta|

Ami tomAra kAche ohIra mAdhyame yA pAThiYechi tA theke tArA to tomAke sariYe AnAra upakrama karechila, yAte tumi AmAra viruddhe tAra viparIta kichu mithyA vAniYe vala| Ara tAhalei tArA tomAke vandhurUpe grahaNa karata|
Ami yadi tomAke avicala nA rAkhatAma tAhale tumi tAdera dike kichuTA prAYa jhu~kei par3ate|
tAhale to Ami tomAke jIvane dviguNa Ara mRtyura para dviguNa (zAsti) AsvAdana karAtAma| takhana tumi AmAra viruddhe nijera janya kona sAhAyyakArI pete nA|
tArA to tomAke e bhUkhaNDa theke bhaYa dekhiYe vera kare deoYAra upakrama karechila| tave yadi tAi hata tAhale tomAra pare tArA nijerAo sekhAne alpa kichukAla chAr3A avasthAna karate pArata nA|
tomAra pUrve Ami yesava rasUla pAThiYechilAma tAdera kSetreo e niYamai chila| tumi AmAra niYamera kona parivartana pAve nA|
sUrya Dhale par3Ara samaYa theke rAtera andhakAra paryanta nAmAya AdAYa karave evaM bhore koraAna pATha karave| bhorera koraAna pAThera aneka sAkSI thAke|
nijera janya atirikta ivAdata hiseve kichu rAtrijAgaraNa karave| tomAra prabhu tomAke eka prazaMsita sthAne unnIta karavena|
vala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAke bhAlabhAve praveza karAo evaM bhAlabhAve vera kara| Ara AmAra janya tomAra pakSa theke eka sahAYaka zaktira vyavasthA kara|”
vala, “satya ese geche Ara mithyA avalupta haYeche| mithyA to avalupta haoYArai kathA|”
Ami koraAne emana viSaYa nAyila kari yA muminadera janya Arogya o anugraha| Ara tA jAlemadera zudhu kSatii vRddhi kare|
Ami yakhana mAnuSake neYAmata dAna kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa evaM (ahaMkAre) dUre sare yAYa, kintu yakhana se vipade par3e takhana dAruNa hatAzAgrasta haYa|
vala, “pratyekei nijera svabhAva anuyAYI kAja kare; tave kAra patha saThikatara, tomAra prabhui tA bhAla jAnena|”
tArA tomAke rUha (AtmA) samparke prazna kare| vala, “rUha hala AmAra prabhura Adezera vyApAra| (e samparke) tomAderake sAmAnyai jJAna deoYA haYeche|”
tomAra kAche ohIra mAdhyame yA pAThiYechi (koraAna), icchA karale Ami tA avazyai phiriYe nite pAratAma| takhana ai vyApAre tumi nijera janya AmAra viruddhe kona karmavidhAYaka pete nA|
tave tomAra prabhura anugrahera kAraNe (tA phiriYe neoYA haYani)| nizcaYai tomAra prati tA~ra virATa anugraha raYeche|
vala, “mAnuSa o jinerA yadi ei koraAnera anurUpa kona grantha tairI karAra janya ekatrita haYa evaM eke aparake sAhAyya kare tavuo tArA tAra anurUpa grantha tairI karate pArave nA|”
ei koraAne Ami mAnuSera janya pratiTi dRSTAnta nAnAbhAve varNanA karechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (satyake) asvIkAra kareche, tArA zudhu avizvAsai kareche|
tArA valechila, “AmarA tomAra kathA vizvAsa karava nA, yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera janya bhUmi theke ekaTi jharanA pravAhita karave;
kiMvA tomAra khejura o AGgurera ekaTi vAgAna have evaM tAra mAjhe tumi yathArthabhAve nadInAlA pravAhita karave;
athavA tumi yemanaTi vale thAka, AsamAnake TukarA TukarA kare AmAdera opara phelave; kiMvA AllAha o pherezatAderake (AmAdera) sAmanA-sAmani niYe Asave;

athavA tomAra svarNera ekaTi ghara have; kiMvA tumi AsamAne ArohaNa karave, tave AmarA tomAra (AsamAne) ArohaNao vizvAsa karava nA yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera janya ekaTi kitAva niYe Asave yA AmarA par3e dekhava|” vala, “AmAra prabhura mahimA! Ami to ekajana mAnuSa o ekajana rasUla chAr3A Ara kichu nai|”
mAnuSera kAche yakhana hedAYeta eseche takhana “AllAha ki ekajana mAnuSake rasUla kare pAThiYechena?” tAdera emana uktii tAderake ImAna AnA theke virata rekheche|

vale dAo, pRthivIte yadi kichu pherezatA thAkata yArA (mAnuSera mata) hA~TAcalA kare evaM (sekhAne) sthirabhAve vAsa kare tAhale Ami tAdera kAche AsamAna theke ekajana pherezatAkei rasUla kare pAThAtAma|
vala, “AmAra o tomAdera mAjhe sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa| tini tA~ra vAndAdera sava khavara rAkhena, tAdera savakichu dekhena|”

AllAha yAke patha dekhAna se pathaprApta haYa, Ara tini yAderake pathabhraSTa karena tAdera janya tumi tA~ra parivarte anya abhibhAvaka pAve nA| keYAmatera dina Ami tAderake mukhera opara bhara-karA avasthAYa evaM andha, vovA o vadhira avasthAYa ekatrita karava| tAdera AvAsasthala have jAhAnnAma| yakhanai tA stimita haYe Asave Ami takhanai tAdera janya Aguna vAr3iYe deva|
eTAi tAdera pratiphala; kAraNa tArA AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra karechila Ara valechila, “hAr3agor3a o dhvaMsAvazeSa haYe yAvAra parao ki AmAderake natuna sRSTirUpe uThAno have?”

tArA ki mane kare nA ye, ye AllAha AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena tini tAdera mata mAnuSao (punarAYa) sRSTi karate sakSama? tini tAdera janya ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda Thika kare diYechena, yAte kona sandeha nei| tavuo jAlemarA (mAnate) asvIkAra kareche, tArA kevala avizvAsai kareche|
vala, “yadi tomarA AmAra prabhura anugraha-bhANDArera adhikArI hate, tavuo tomarA kharacera bhaYe tA dhare rAkhate| mAnuSa to var3ai kRpaNa|”

Ami to mUsAke naYaTi spaSTa nidarzana diYechilAma| vanI isarAIlake jijJAsA kare dekha| se yakhana tAdera kAche esechila takhana pherAuna tAke valechila, “he mUsA! Ami to tomAke yAdugrastai mane kari|”
mUsA valala, “tumi to jAna ye, AsamAna o jaminera prabhui pratyakSa pramANasvarUpa esava nidarzana nAyila karechena| Ara he pherAuna! AmAra nizcita dhAraNA, tumi dhvaMsera dvAraprAnte upanIta|”
takhana se vanI isarAIlake bhaYa dekhiYe deza theke utkhAta karate cAila| kintu Ami tAke o tAra saGge yArA chila tAdera savAike DuviYe dilAma;

Ara tAra (mRtyura) pare vanI isarAIlake valalAma, “tomarA e dezei vasavAsa kara| ataHpara yakhana parakAlera oYAdA Asanna have takhana tomAderake joTavaddha avasthAYa (sakalake ekatre) upasthita karava|”
Ami satyasaha tA (koraAna) nAyila karechi evaM satyasaha tA nAyila haYeche| Ara tomAke to ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hisevei pAThiYechi|
Ami koraAnake bhAga bhAga kare avatIrNa karechi, yAte tA virati diYe diYe mAnuSera sAmane par3ate pAra| Ara Ami tA dhApe dhApe avatIrNa karechi|
vala, “tomarA ei koraAna vizvAsa karo vA nA karo, era Age (ihudi o khriSTAnadera madhye) yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche tAdera sAmane yakhana eTA pATha karA haYa takhana tArA sejadAYa luTiYe par3e|”
Ara tArA vale, “AmAdera prabhura mahimA! AmAdera prabhura oYAdA vAstavAYita havei|”
tArA sejadAYa par3e kA~date thAke evaM eTA tAdera vinaYa vRddhi kare|sejadA

vala, “tomarA AllAhake DAka athavA karuNAmaYake DAka, tomarA yAkei DAka (AllAhake ye nAmei DAka), sundara sundara nAmagulo tA~rai|” tumi tomAra nAmAya jora galAYa kiMvA niHzavde par3o nA; era mAjhAmAjhi ekaTi patha avalamvana kara|

vala, “sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini kona santAna grahaNa karenani, kartRetva yAra kona aMzIdAra nei evaM asammAna theke rakSAra janya yAra kona abhibhAvaka nei (nije mahAsammAnita haoYAYa yAra temana abhibhAvakera praYojana nei)|” Ara tA~ra yathAyatha mahimA varNanA kara|
sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini tA~ra vAndAra prati ei kitAva nAyila karechena evaM tAte kona vakratA rAkhenani|

(varaM) eke sarala-sojA karechena, (avizvAsIderake) tA~ra pakSa theke kaThina zAstira (jAhAnnAmera) bhaYa dekhAnora janya; satkarmazIla muminaderake uttama pratidAnera (jAnnAtera) susaMvAda deoYAra janya,
yAte tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave
evaM yArA vale, “AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena” tAderake satarka karAra janya|
e vyApAre tAdera kona jJAna nei, tAdera vApa-dAdAderao chila nA| tAdera mukha theke ye kathA vera haYa tA kI sAMghAtika! tArA zudhu mithyAi vale|
tArA ei vANI (koraAna) vizvAsa nA karale duHkhe tumi haYato tAdera pechane nijera jIvana zeSa kare deve|
pRthivIra savakichu Ami tAra zobhAYa pariNata karechi, yAte lokaderake parIkSA karate pAri, ke tAdera madhye kAje serA|
AvAra tAra savakichu Ami zUnya-zuSka mATi kare deva|
tumi ki mane karo ye, guhA o phalakaoYAlArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ekaTi vismaYa chila?
