(smaraNa karo) yakhana yuvakerA guhAYa AzraYa niYechila; takhana tArA valechila, “he AmAdera prabhu! tomAra pakSa theke AmAderake rahamata dAna karo evaM AmAdera saThika kAja AmAdera janya sahaja kare dAo|”
ataHpara guhAra madhye kaYeka vacharera janya tAdera kAna AcchAdita kare dilAma (tAderake ghumanta avasthAYa rAkhalAma)|
tArapara tAderake (ghuma theke) uThAlAma eTA jAnAra (parIkSA karAra) janya ye, (guhAYa) tAdera avasthAnakAla samparke dui dalera madhye kon‌Tira hisAva saThikatara haYa|
Ami tomAra kAche tAdera vRttAnta yathArthai varNanA karachi| tArA chila kaYekajana yuvaka, yArA tAdera prabhura prati ImAna enechila evaM Ami tAdera supatha anusaraNera icchA joradAra karechilAma|

Ara tAdera antare dRr3hatA ene diYechilAma, yakhana tArA (dIrgha nidrAra para) uThechila evaM valechila, “AsamAna o jaminera prabhui AmAdera prabhu| AmarA tA~ke chAr3A anya kona upAsyake DAkava nA| yadi DAki, tAhale avazyai AmarA eka anyAYa kathA valava|”

“erAi AmAdera svajAti| erA AllAhara parivarte anyAnya upAsya grahaNa kareche| erA tAdera samparke spaSTa pramANa upasthita kare nA kena? AllAhara viruddhe ye mithyA Aropa kare tAra ceYe var3a jAlema ke Ache?”

(yuvakerA eke anyake valechila,) “yakhana tomarA tAdera theke evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdata kare tAdera theke vicchinna haYecho takhana guhAYa AzraYa grahaNa kara| tomAdera prabhu tomAdera janya tA~ra karuNA char3iYe devena evaM tomAdera kAja tomAdera janya sahaja kare devena|”

tArA yakhana guhAra ekaTi phA~kA jAYagAYa avasthAna karata takhana tumi (thAkale) dekhate, sUrya yakhana udita haYa takhana tA tAdera guhAke pAza kATiYe DAnadike cale yAYa Ara yakhana asta yAYa takhana tAderake atikrama kare vAmadike cale yAYa| seTA chila AllAhara anyatama ekaTi nidarzana| AllAha yAke patha dekhAna se pathera sandhAna pAYa| Ara yAke tini pathabhraSTa karena tAra janya tumi kona pathapradarzanakArI abhibhAvaka pAve nA|

tumi tAderake (dekhale) mane karate, tArA jAgrata; athaca tArA chila ghumanta| Ami tAderake DAne o vAme epAza-opAza karAtAma| tAdera kukuraTi (guhAra) pravezapathe sAmanera pA duJcaTo vichiYe (praharArata) thAkata| tumi yadi tAdera dike tAkAte tAhale avazyai (bhaYa peYe) tAdera theke pAlAnora janya pechane phire Asate evaM tAdera bhaYe paripUrNa (sampUrNa bhIta) haYe yete|

Ara ebhAve Ami tAderake (sudIrgha nidrA theke) jAgrata karalAma, yAte tArA (nijedera avasthAnakAla jAnAra janya) eke aparake prazna kare| tAdera ekajana valala, “tomarA katadina avasthAna karecho?” kaYekajana valala, ekadina kiMvA ekadinera kichu aMza avasthAna karechi|” kaYekajana valala, “Asale tomAdera avasthAnakAla tomAdera prabhui savaceYe bhAla jAnena| ekhana tomAdera ekajanake ei raupyamudrATi niYe nagare pAThAo; se yena sekhAne pavitra (hAlAla) khAdyadravya ki Ache tA dekhe tA theke tomAdera janya kichu khAvAra niYe Ase| se yena namratA pradarzana kare (athavA satarkatA avalamvana kare) evaM kichutei tomAdera kathA kAuke jAnate nA deYa|”
“tArA yadi tomAdera kathA jAnate pAre tAhale tomAderake haYa pAthara mere hatyA karave, athavA tAdera dharmamate phiriYe neve| Ara eTA hale to tomarA kakhanoi saphala have nA|”

ebhAve Ami tAdera viSaYaTi (mAnuSake) jAniYe dilAma, yAte tArA jAnate pAre ye, AllAhara oYAdA satya evaM keYAmatera vyApAre kona sandeha nei| (smaraNa karo) yakhana tArA (nagarIra lokerA) tAdera viSaYaTi niYe nijedera madhye vitarka karachila| (tAdera mRtyura para) keu keu valala, “tAdera opara (tAdera guhAra pravezapathe) ekaTi bhavana nirmANa kara| tAdera prabhui tAdera vyApAre bhAla jAnena|” tAdera vyApAre yAdera mata prAdhAnya peYechila tArA valala, “AmarA avazyai tAdera opara (tAdera guhAra pravezapathe) ekaTi masajida vAnAva|”

(guhAoYAlAdera saMkhyA) keu keu valave tinajana, yAdera caturthaTi tAdera kukura; keu keu valave pA~cajana, yAdera SaSThaTi tAdera kukura; esava AndAji kathA| AvAra keu keu valave, sAtajana evaM tAdera aSTamaTi tAdera kukura| vala, “tAdera saMkhyA AmAra prabhui bhAla jAnena; tAdera kathA alpa kaYekajana chAr3A anya keu jAne nA|” ataeva, zudhumAtra vAhyika vitarka chAr3A tumi tAdera vyApAre (gurugambhIra) vitarka karo nA evaM tAdera vyApAre edera (ei kitAvIdera) kAro mata jAnate ceYo nA|
kona vyApAre valave nA, “Ami eTA AgAmIkAla karava|”
“AllAha cAile” valA vyatIta| yakhana bhule yAo takhana tomAra prabhuke smaraNa karave Ara valave, “AzA kari, AmAra prabhu AmAke era ceYeo satyera nikaTatara patha dekhAvena|”
tArA tAdera guhAYa (sauravarSera hisAve) tinazata vachara o (cAnadravarSera hisAve) naYa vachara vezi avasthAna karechila|

vala, “tArA kata vachara avasthAna karechila tA AllAhai bhAla jAnena| AsamAna o jaminera adRzya viSaYera jJAna tA~ra kAchei Ache| tini (savakichu) kata bhAla dekhena evaM kata bhAla zonena! tini chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM tini tA~ra kartRetva kAuke aMzIdAra karena nA|”
tomAra prabhura ye kitAva (koraAna) tomAra kAche ohIra mAdhyame pAThAno haYeche tA pATha kara| tA~ra vANIsamUha keu parivartana karate pAre nA, evaM tA~ke chAr3A tumi kona AzraYasthala pAve nA|

tumi dhairya sahakAre nijeke tAdera sAthei rAkhave yArA tAdera prabhura santuSTira uddezye sakAla-sandhyAYa tA~ke DAke| pArthiva jIvanera cAkacikya kAmanAYa tAdera theke tomAra cokha phiriYe neve nA| Ara emana lokera Anugatya karave nA yAra antarake Ami AmAra smaraNa theke amanoyogI karechi, ye nijera pravRttira anusaraNa kare evaM yAra kAjai hala vAr3AvAr3i|

vala, “satya tomAdera prabhura pakSa theke (eseche)| ataeva, yAra icchA vizvAsa karuka Ara yAra icchA avizvAsa karuka|” Ami jAlemadera janya jAhAnnAma prastuta kare rekhechi yAra veSTanI tAderake ghire rAkhave| Ara tArA yadi pAnIYa cAYa tAhale tAderake galita dhAtura nyAYa pAnIYa deoYA have, yA (tAdera) mukhamaNDalasamUha dagdha karave| kata khArApa pAnIYa (eTA)! kata nikRSTa vizrAmasthala (ei jAhAnnAma)!
yArA vizvAsa kare Ara satkAja kare Ami to (sei) satkarmazIladera puraskAra naSTa kari nA|

oderai janya raYeche sthAYI jAnnAta, yekhAne tAdera taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita have| sekhAne tAderake svarNera vAjuvandha diYe alaMkRta karA have evaM tArA pAtalA o moTA rezamera savuja vastra paridhAna karave| tArA sekhAne siMhAsane helAna diYe thAkave| kata uttama pratidAna (eTA)! kata camatkAra vizrAmasthala (ei jAnnAta)!

(kAphera o muminadera avasthA vujhAnora janya) tAdera kAche (vanI isarAIlera) dui vyaktira udAharaNa peza karo (yAdera ekajana kAphera o anyajana mumina chila)| dujanera ekajanake (kAphera vyaktike) Ami AGgurera duTo vAgAna diYechilAma evaM se duToke khejuragAcha diYe ghire diYechilAma| duTo vAgAnera mAjhakhAne diYechilAma phasalera kSeta|
pratiTi vAgAnai tAra (kAMkSita) phala utpanna karechila evaM tAte etaTuku truTi kareni| vAgAnaduTora madhya diYe Ami ekaTi nadIo pravAhita karechilAma|
lokaTira aneka dhana-sampada chila| se tAra (mumina) sAthIra saGge AlApakAle tAke valechila, “tomAra ceYe AmAra sampada vezi evaM dalavalera dika diYeo Ami adhikatara zaktizAlI|”

se nijera prati julumakArI avasthAYa (arthAt AllAhara neYAmatera zukariYA AdAYera parivarte mane ahaGkAra Ara avizvAsa niYe) tAra vAgAne praveza karechila| se valechila, “Ami mane kari nA, ei vAgAna kakhanao dhvaMsa have|”
“Ami mane kari nA, keYAmata (kakhanao) saMghaTita have| Ara (Asalei) yadi AmAke AmAra prabhura nikaTa phiriYe neoYA haYa tAhale (sekhAne) Ami avazyai era ceYe bhAla pratyAvartanasthala pAva|”
tAra sAthe AlApakAle tAra (mumina) sAthI valechila, “tumi ki tA~ke avizvAsa karo yini tomAke mATi o pare vIrya theke sRSTi karechena evaM tArapara ekajana pUrNAGga mAnuSera AkRti diYechena?
tave Ami vizvAsa kari, tinii AllAha, AmAra prabhu| evaM Ami AmAra prabhura sAthe kAuke zarIka kari nA|”

“tumi yadi mane karo, tomAra ceYe AmAra sampada o santAna-santati kama tAhale tomAra vAgAne pravezakAle kena valale nA ye, AllAha yA ceYechena tAi haYeche evaM AllAha vyatIta (kAro) kona kSamatA nei?”

“haYato ejanyai AmAra prabhu AmAke tomAra vAgAnera ceYe bhAla kichu dAna karavena evaM tAra (tomAra vAgAnera) opara AsamAna theke vajra (vA Aguna) pAThAvena evaM tA picchila mRttikAYa (tRNavihIna bhUmite) pariNata have|”
“kiMvA tAra pAni bhUgarbhe cale yAve evaM tumi tA Ara khu~je pAve nA|”

lokaTira (vAgAnera sava) phala avaruddha (dhvaMsaprApta) haYechila| takhana se tAte yA vyaYa karechila tAra janya (AkSepe) duJcahAta ulTAte (kacalAte) lAgala, yakhana vAgAnaTi (vAgAnaTira sava phala) tAra mAcAsaha bheGge par3echila, Ara se valachila, “hAYa, Ami yadi AmAra prabhura sAthe kAuke zarIka nA karatAma!”
tAra emana kona vAhinI chila nA yArA tAke AllAhara vipakSe sAhAyya karate pAre, evaM se nijeo (AtmarakSAra mata) zaktizAlI chila nA|
orakama (kaThina) avasthAYa kartRtva AllAharai, yini prakRta prabhu| tini puraskAra pradAneo serA, pariNAma nirdhAraNeo serA|

tAdera kAche pArthiva jIvanera udAharaNao peza karo: yena (vRSTira) pAni, yA Ami AkAza theke varSaNa kari| tAte bhUmira zyAmala-ghana gAchapAlA utpanna haYa| ataHpara tA zuSka-bhagna haYe yAYa, yAke vAtAsa ur3iYe neYa| AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
dhana-sampada o santAna-santati hala pArthiva jIvanera (asthAYI) jaulusa| pakSAntare, sthAYI satkarmasamUha tomAra prabhura kAche puraskAra hiseveo serA evaM AzAra vastu hiseveo serA|
(smaraNa karo) yedina Ami (sthira) parvatasamUhake calamAna karava evaM pRthivIke tumi ekaTi samatalabhUmira mata dekhate pAve| Ara tAdera sakalake ekatrita karava, ekajanakeo vAda rAkhava nA|

tAderake tomAra prabhura sAmane sArivaddhabhAve hAjira karA have| (tini valavena) “evAra tomarA AmAra kAche ese giYecho, yemana tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma| tomarA to manei karechile ye, tomAdera janya Ami kona pratizruta samaYa nirdhAraNa karava nA|”

Ara kitAva (AmalanAmA) sAmane rAkhA have| takhana tAte yA (lekhA) raYeche tAra kAraNe tumi aparAdhIdera bhIta dekhave| tArA valave, “hAYa AmAdera kapAla! e kemana kitAva? e ye choTa-var3a kichui vAda dicche nA! varaM savai gune rekheche|” tArA yA kareche tA savai upasthita pAve| tomAra prabhu kAro prati avicAra karena nA|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami pherezatAderake valechilAma, “tomarA Adamake sejadA kara|” takhana tArA sejadA karechila, ivalIsa vyatIta| se chila jvinadera antarbhukta| se tAra prabhura Adeza amAnya karala| tavuo ki tomarA AmAke chAr3A tAke o tAra vaMzadharaderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karave? tArA to tomAdera zatru| jAlemadera vinimaYa kata nikRSTa!
Ami tAderake AsamAna o jamina sRSTira sAkSI karini, tAdera nijedera sRSTirao nA| tAchAr3A vibhrAntakArIdera (kona) sAhAyyao neini|

(smaraNa karo) yedina tini valavena, “tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate tAderake DAka| tArA tAderake DAkave, kintu tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A deve nA| Ami tAdera mAjhakhAne ekaTi dhvaMsa-gahavara rekhe deva|”
aparAdhIrA Aguna dekhe vujhate pArave ye, tArA tAte patita have evaM tA theke paritrANera kona patha pAve nA|
avazyai Ami ei koraAne mAnuSera janya savarakama udAharaNa varNanA karechi| kintu ei mAnuSai adhikatara tarkapriYa|

yakhana mAnuSera kAche patha-nirdeza (koraAna) eseche takhana pUrvavartIdera saGge kRta AcaraNera punarAvRtti vA sAmanA-sAmani AjAva Agamanera pratIkSAi tAderake ImAna AnaYana o tAdera prabhura kAche kSamAprArthanA theke virata rekheche|

Ami rasUladerake susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpei pAThiYe thAki| Ara kApherarA mithyA dvArA satyake khaNDana karAra janya mithyAra sAhAyye vitarka kare thAke| tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake o yesava jinisa dvArA tAderake satarka karA haYeche tAke ekaTA vidrUpera viSaYa vAniYeche|

ai vyaktira ceYe var3a jAlema ke Ache yAke tAra prabhura nidarzanasamUha smaraNa kariYe deoYAra para se tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa evaM Apana kRtakarma bhule yAYa? Asale Ami tAdera antarera opara AvaraNa diYe rekhechi, yAte tArA ei koraAna vujhate nA pAre| Ara tAdera kAne e~Te diYechi vadhiratA| tumi tAderake satpathe DAkaleo tArA kakhanao satpathe calave nA|

Ara tomAra prabhui kSamAzIla, daYAmaYa| tini yadi tAderake tAdera kRtarmera janya pAkar3Ao karatena tAhale avazyai tAdera zAsti tvarAnvita karatena| varaM tAdera janya ekaTi samaYa nirdhArita Ache, yA theke tArA palAYanera kona upAYa khu~je pAve nA|
Ara aisava janapadera adhivAsIrA yakhana anyAYa karechila takhana Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma evaM tAdera dhvaMsera janya ekaTi samaYa Thika kare rekhechilAma|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana mUsA tAra yuvaka saGgIke valechila, “dui samudrera milanasthale nA pau~chA paryanta Ami thAmava nA| ejanya lAgale yuga yuga dhare calate thAkava|”
ataHpara yakhana tArA dui samudrera milanasthale pau~chAla takhana tAdera mAchaTira kathA bhule gela| mAchaTi sur3aGgera mata nijera patha tairI kare samudre cale gela|
yakhana tArA (ai jAYagATi) atikrama karala takhana mUsA tAra yuvaka saGgIke valala, “AmAdera nAzatA Ana| AmarA to e saphare klAnta haYe par3echi|”

se valala, “dekhechena ki? AmarA yakhana pAtharaTite AzraYa niYechilAma takhana Ami mAchaTira kathA bhule giYechilAma| zaYatAnai AmAke tAra kathA ullekha karate bhuliYe diYechila| se AzcaryajanakabhAve nijera patha tairI kare samudre cale giYeche|”
mUsA valala, “oTAi to AmarA khu~jachilAma|” takhana tArA nijedera pAYera cihna dhare (pechane) phire calala|
pathimadhye tArA AmAra eka vAndAke (khiyirake) pela yAke Ami AmAra pakSa theke anugraha dAna karechilAma evaM yAke Ami AmAra pakSa theke jJAna zikhiYechilAma|
mUsA tAke valala, “ApanAke ye satpathera jJAna zekhAno haYeche tA theke AmAke kichu zikhAvena, ei uddezye Ami ki ApanAra saGgI hate pAri?”
se valala, “Apani AmAra sAthe (calAra) dhairya rAkhate pAravena nA|
Apani ye viSaYe jJAna rAkhena nA tA dekhe kIbhAve dhairya rAkhavena?”
mUsA valala, “AllAhara icchA thAkale Apani AmAke dhairyazIla pAvena evaM Ami ApanAra kona Adeza amAnya karava nA|”
khiyira valala, “Apani yadi AmAra anusaraNa karenai tAhale kona viSaYe AmAke prazna karavena nA, yatakSaNa nA Ami nije se samparke ApanAke kichu vali|”

ataHpara ubhaYe (khiyira o mUsA) calate thAkala| eka samaYe tArA yakhana naukAYa ArohaNa karala takhana khiyira naukATi phuTo kare dila| mUsA valala, “Apani ki naukAra ArohIdera DuviYe ditei eTi phuTo karechena? Apani to ekaTA khArApa kAja karalena|”
khiyira valala, “Ami valechilAma nA ye, Apani AmAra sAthe (calAra) dhairya rAkhate pAravena nA?”
mUsA valala, “AmAra bhulera janya AmAke zAsti devena nA evaM AmAra janya AmAra kAja kaThina kare devena nA|”

erapara tArA AvAra calate thAkala| eka samaYe ekaTi vAlakera sAthe tAdera dekhA hale khiyira vAlakaTike hatyA karala| mUsA valala, Apani kona prANanAzera aparAdha chAr3Ai ekaTi niSpApa prANa nAza karalena? Apani to ekaTA khArApa kAja karalena|
khiyira valala, “Ami valechilAma nA ye, Apani AmAra sAthe (calAra) dhairya rAkhate pAravena nA?”

mUsA valala, “erapara yadi Ami ApanAke kona vyApAre prazna kari tAhale Apani AmAke saGge rAkhavena nA| (se kSetre) Apani AmAra abhiyoga theke avyAhatilAbhera paryAYe pau~chechena| (arthAt erapara kona prazna karAra kAraNe AmAke ApanAra saGge nA rAkhale ApanAra viruddhe Ami kona abhiyoga karate pArava nA|)|”

ataHpara tArA AvAra calate thAkala| eka samaYe tArA eka janapadera adhivAsIdera kAche ese tAdera kAche khAvAra cAile tArA tAdera AtitheYatA karate asvIkAra karala| ataHpara tArA sekhAne ekaTi prAcIra dekhate pela, yA prAYa bheGge par3ate cAcchila| khiyira seTAke Thika kare dila| mUsA valala, “Apani icchA karale e kAjera janya pArizramika nite pAratena|”
khiyira valala, “ekhAnei AmAra o ApanAra madhye viccheda (ghaTave)| (tave) ye sava viSaYe Apani dhairya rAkhate pArenani Ami ApanAke tAra tAtparya jAnAcchi|”

“(prathamata) naukATi chila kaYekajana garIva mAnuSera| tArA sAgare kAja karata| Ami ceYechilAma naukATike truTiyukta kare dite; kAraNa, tAdera pechane chila emana eka rAjA ye pratiTi naukA jorapUrvaka chiniYe nita|”

“(dvitIYata) vAlakaTira pitAmAtA chila duJcajana ImAnadAra mAnuSa| AmAdera AzaMkA haYechila ye, se avAdhyatA Ara akRtajJatA dvArA tAderake kaSTa deve| (athavA se tAdera opara anyAYa Ara kuphari cApiYe deve|)”
“tAi AmarA cAilAma, tAdera prabhu tAderake ai chelera parivarte pavitratAYa zreYatara o mAYA-mamatAYa nikaTatara (anya) ekaTi chele dAna karuka|”

“Ara (tRtIYata) prAcIraTi chila nagarIra duJcajana anAtha vAlakera| ora nice chila tAdera eka dhanabhANDAra| Ara tAdera pitA chila ekajana satloka| tAi anugrahavazata ApanAra prabhura icchA hala, orA duJcajana vaYoprApta hoka evaM odera dhanabhANDAra vera karuka| kAjaTi Ami AmAra icchAYa karini| Apani ye sava viSaYe dhairya rAkhate pArenani ei hala tAra tAtparya|”
tArA tomAke yula-kAranAina samvandhe jijJAsA kare| vala, “Ami tomAderake tAra kichu vivaraNa zonAva|”
Ami tAke pRthivIte pratiSThita karechilAma evaM savakichura patha vale diYechilAma|
tAi se patha calate lAgala|

yete yete yakhana se sUryAstera jAYagAYa pau~chala takhana sUryake ekaTi paGkila (athavA uSNa) jharanAYa (athavA jalAzaYe) asta yete dekhala| Ara sekhAne se kichu mAnuSa dekhate pela| Ami valalAma, “he yula-kAranAina! tumi ki ei lokaguloke zAsti deve, nA edera sAthe bhAla AcaraNa karave?”
se valala, “ye anyAYa kare tAke AmarA zAsti deva| tArapara tAke tAra prabhura nikaTa phiriYe neoYA have| takhana tini tAke bhaYaMkara zAsti devena|”
“Ara ye (AllAhara prati) ImAna rAkhe o satkAja kare (era) pratidAnasvarUpa tAra janya raYeche mahAkalyANa| Ara AmarA tAra janya AmAdera sahaja kAja valava (tAke sahaja kAja karate deva)|”
se AvAra patha calate lAgala|

yete yete yakhana sUryodaYera jAYagAYa pau~chala takhana sUryake emana ekadala lokera kAche udita hate dekhala (udaYasthalera kAche emana ekadala loka dekhate pela) yAdera janya Ami sUryera tApa theke rakSAra mata kona Ar3Alera vyavasthA karini|
emanai (chila yula-kAranAinera ghaTanA)| Ara tAra savakichui Ami avagata Achi|
se AvAra patha calate lAgala|
yete yete yakhana dui vA~dhera (parvatera) mAjhe pau~chAla takhana sekhAne ekadala lokake pela yArA (tAra) kona kathAi yena vujhate pArachila nA|

tArA valala, “he yula-kAranAina! iYAjUja o mAjUja (jAti) dezera madhye var3a phetanA-phyAsAda karache| ataeva, AmarA ki ApanAke ei zarte kichu karo pradAna karava ye, Apani AmAdera o tAdera madhye ekaTi vAdhA (prAcIra) tairI kare devena?”

se valala, “AmAra prabhu AmAke ye sAmarthya diYechena (tomAdera karapradAnera ceYe) tAi bhAla| ataeva, tomarA AmAke zakti (janavala) diYe sAhAyya karo, Ami tomAdera o tAdera mAjhe ekaTi sudRr3ha vAdhA (majavuta prAcIra) tairI kare deva|”

“tomarA AmAke lauhapiNDa ene dAo|” ataHpara (lauhapiNDa dvArA) dui pAhAr3era madhyavartI phA~kA jAYagA bhare diYe se valala, “tomarA phu~ dAo (vAtAsa chAr3a)|” ebhAve tA (uttapta kare) Agune pariNata kare se valala, “era opara DhAlAra janya tomarA AmAke (galita) tAmA ene dAo|”
phale (ebhAve u~cu o majavuta kare tairI karAYa) iYAjUja o mAjUja ai prAcIra DiGgAte pAreni evaM tAte chidra karate pAreni|

yula-kAranAina valala, “eTA AmAra prabhura pakSa theke eka anugraha| tave yakhana AmAra prabhura pratizruti ese yAve takhana tini eke samAna kare (mATite miziYe) devena| AmAra prabhura pratizruti satya|”

sedina Ami tAderake (iYAjUja o mAjUjake) emana avasthAYa cher3e deva ye, ekadala Arekadalera opara taraGgera mata Achar3e par3ave| tArapara ziGgAYa phu~ deoYA have evaM Ami tAdera sakalakei ekatrita karava|
Ara sedina kApheradera (cokhera) sAmane jAhAnnAmake upasthita karava;
(tAdera sAmane) yAdera cokhera opara ekadharanera AvaraNa thAkAYa tArA AmAra smArakagrantha (koraAna) dekhate pAYa nA evaM (kichu) zunateo pAYa nA|
kApherarA ki tAhale mane kare ye, tArA AmAra parivarte AmAra vAndAderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karave? ei kApheradera ApyAYanera (!) janya Ami jAhAnnAmake prastuta rekhechi|
vala, Ami ki tomAderake emana lokadera kathA jAnAva, yAdera karmasamUha savaceYe vezi kSatigrasta?
(erA to tArAi) yAdera praceSTA pArthiva jIvane viphala haYeche; athaca tArA mane kare ye, tArA bhAla kAjai karache|

erA to tArAi yArA tAdera prabhura nidarzanasamUha o tA~ra sAthe sAkSAtake asvIkAra kare| phale tAdera karmasamUha niSphala haYe giYeche| tAi keYAmatera dina Ami tAdera janya kona ojana (gurutva) nirdhAraNa karava nA|
seTAi have tAdera pratiphala—jAhAnnAma; kAraNa, tArA kuphari kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUha o rasUladerake vidrUpera vastu vAniYeche|
yArA (satyake) vizvAsa kare o satkAja kare (parakAle) tAdera AtitheYatAra janya raYeche vehezatera vAga-vAgicA|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave; (kakhanao) sekhAna theke sthAna parivartana kAmanA karave nA|

vala, “AmAra prabhura kathAsamUha lekhAra janya yadi goTA samudrao kAli haYa tavuo AmAra prabhura kathA (lekhA) zeSa haoYAra Age samudrai phuriYe yAve; (ei lekhAra kAje) sAhAyyera janya AmarA tAra mata Aro ekaTi samudra niYe Asaleo|”

vala, “Ami to tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa| AmAra kAche ohI Ase ye, tomAdera prabhui ekamAtra prabhu| ataeva, ye tAra prabhura sAkSAt kAmanA kare se yena satkAja kare evaM tAra prabhura ivAdate kAuke aMzIdAra nA kare|”
kApha hA iYA jJaAina chAda [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
(eTA) tA~ra vAndA yAkAriYAra prati tomAra prabhura anugrahera vivaraNa;
yakhana se tAra prabhuke gopane Dekechila|
se valechila, “he prabhu! (vaYasera bhAre) AmAra zarIrera hAr3a durvala haYeche evaM mAthAra cula sAdA haYeche| he prabhu! tomAra kAche prArthanA kare Ami (kakhano) hatabhAgya thAkini|”
“Ami AmAra pare svagotrIYaderake bhaYa kari; Ara AmAra strIo vandhyA| ataeva, AmAke tomAra pakSa theke (tomAra vizeSa anugrahe) ekajana uttarAdhikArI dAna karo;
ye AmAra uttarAdhikAritva karave o iYAkUva-parivArera uttarAdhikAritva karave| Ara he prabhu! tumi tAke (tomAra) santoSabhAjana karo|”
he yAkAriYA! Ami tomAke ekaTi putrera susaMvAda dicchi| tAra nAma iYAhaiYA| era Age tAra nAme kAro nAmakaraNa karini|
se valala, “he prabhu! AmAra putra have kIbhAve? AmAra strI to vandhyA| Ara Amio to ekevAre vRddha haYe giYechi|”
tini valalena, “tAi have| tomAra prabhu valachena: eTA AmAra pakSe sahaja| era Age Ami tomAkeo to sRSTi karechi, yakhana tumi kichui chile nA|”
se valala, “he prabhu! AmAra janya (putra haoYAra) ekaTi pUrvalakSaNa Thika kare dAo|” tini valalena, “tomAra (se) pUrvalakSaNa ei ye, sustha thekeo tumi tina rAta mAnuSera sAthe kathA valave nA|”
kakSa theke vera haYe se tAra samapradAYera lokadera kAche ela evaM izArAYa tAderake valala ye, tomarA sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara pavitratA ghoSaNA kara|
(tAra putra iYAh‌iYAke valA haYechila) “he iYAh‌iYA! dRr3hatAra sAthe ei kitAva (tAorAta) dhAraNa kara|” Ami tAke zaizavei jJAnavuddhi dAna karechilAma|
evaM AmAra pakSa theke (mAnuSera prati) sahAnubhUti o pavitratA (diYechilAma)| Ara se chila khodAbhIru
o pitAmAtAra prati sadAcArI; uddhata o avAdhya chila nA|
tAra opara zAnti varSita hoka, yedina se janmagrahaNa kare, yedina mArA yAve evaM yedina jIvitAvasthAYa punarutthita have|
kitAve (ullikhita) mariYamera ghaTanA varNanA karo; yakhana se tAra parivAra-parijana theke pRthaka haYe pUrvadikera eka jAYagAYa ThA~i nila|

tArapara tAdera theke nijeke Ar3Ala karAra janya ekaTi pardA TAGgiYe dila| takhana Ami tAra kAche AmAra AtmAke (pherezatA jivarAIlake) pAThAlAma| se tAra sAmane eka suThAma mAnuSera AkAre AtmaprakAza karala|
mariYama valala, “Ami karuNAmaYera kAche tomAra theke AzraYa cAi, yadi tumi AllAhake bhaYa kara|”
se valala, “Ami to tomAra prabhura dUta; tomAke eka pavitra putra dAna karAra ghoSaNA dite (esechi)|”
mariYama valala, “AmAra putra have kIbhAve, AmAke to kona mAnuSa (puruSa) sparzai kareni evaM Ami asatIo nai?”
jivarAIla valala, “ebhAvei (have)| tomAra prabhu valechena: eTA AmAra janya sahaja; Ara tAke Ami mAnuSera janya eka nidarzana o AmAra anugrahera AdhAra vAnAte cAi| eTA ekaTA sthirIkRta viSaYa|”
erapara se tAke (putra IsAke) garbhe dhAraNa karala| tArapara tAke (peTe) niYe dUravartI ekaTi jAYagAYa cale gela|
tArapara prasava-vedanA tAke eka khejuragAchera kANDera kAche niYe ela| se valala, “hAYa, Ami yadi era Age mare yetAma evaM ekevAre vismRta (lokera smRti theke vilupta) haYe yetAma!”
emana samaYa tAra nica theke jivarAIla tAke DAka diYe valala, “duHkha karo nA| tomAra prabhu tomAra nice ekaTi jaladhArA pravAhita karechena|”
“Ara khejuragAchera kANDaTi nijera dike nAr3A dAo| dekhave, gAcha tomAra opara tAjA tAjA pAkA khejura phelate thAkave|”
“takhana khAo, pAna karo Ara cakSu zItala kara| Ara yadi kona mAnuSa dekha tAhale valave: Ami karuNAmaYa AllAhara janya royA mAnata karechi| tAi Aja kona mAnuSera sAthe kathA valava nA|”
ataHpara se putrake niYe tAra samapradAYera kAche gela| tArA valala, “he mariYama! tumi to eka adbhuta kAja karecho|”
“he hArunera vona! tomAra vAvA khArApa loka chila nA evaM tomAra mAo asatI chila nA|”
ataHpara mariYama putrera dike iGgita karala| tArA valala, “AmarA kolera zizura sAthe kIbhAve kathA valava?”
zizu (IsA) vale uThala, “Ami AllAhara vAndA| tini AmAke kitAva diYechena, AmAke navI kare pAThiYechena|”
“Ami yekhAnei thAki, AmAke varakatamaYa karechena| Ara yatakSaNa jIvita thAki, AmAke nAmAya o yAkAtera nirdeza diYechena|”
“tini AmAke AmAra mAYera anugata karechena; AmAke uddhata o hatabhAgya karenani|
AmAra opara (AllAhara pakSa theke sthAYI) zAnti thAkuka: yedina Ami janmagrahaNa karechi, yedina mArA yAva evaM yedina AmAke jIvanta uThAno have!”
ei hala mariYamera putra IsA (IsAra prakRta ghaTanA)| eTAi satya kathA, ye vyApAre tArA sandeha poSaNa (athavA vitarka) kare|
AllAhara janya kona santAnagrahaNa samIcIna naYa| tini mahiYAna! tini yakhana kona kichu karAra siddhAnta nena takhana zudhu valena, “hao”, amani tA haYe yAYa|
(IsA valala,) “Ara AllAhai AmAra prabhu evaM tomAderao prabhu| ataeva, tA~ra ivAdata kara| eTAi saThika patha|”

ataHpara tAdera madhya theke dalagulo matabheda karala| (IsAra vyApAre khriSTAnarA bhinna bhinna mata poSaNa kare vibhinna dale vibhakta hala|) ataeva, eka bhaYAnaka dinera (keYAmatera) upasthitikAle avizvAsIdera janya var3ai durbhoga raYeche!
yedina tArA AmAra kAche Asave sedina kata pariSkAra zunate o dekhate pAve! kintu Aja jAlemarA spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye raYeche|
duHkhera dina samparke tumi tAderake satarka kare dAo; yakhana sakala viSaYa mImAMsita haYe yAve| (ekhana) tArA vekhavara avasthAYa Ache evaM tArA vizvAsa kare nA|
pRthivI o tAra opare yArA Ache Amii tAdera mAlika thAkava| Ara tAderake AmAra kAchei phiriYe AnA have|
kitAve (ullikhita) ivarAhImera kathAo smaraNa kara| vastuta se chila satyaniSTha o eka navI|
yakhana se tAra vAvAke valechila, “vAvA! tumi emana vastura upAsanA karo kena, yA zunate pAYa nA, dekhate pAYa nA evaM tomAra kona kAjeo Ase nA?”
“vAvA! AmAra kAche sei jJAna eseche yA tomAra kAche Aseni| tAi tumi AmAra kathA mene nAo, Ami tomAke saThika patha dekhAva|”
“vAvA! zaYatAnera ivAdata karo nA| zaYatAna to AllAhara avAdhya|”
“vAvA! AmAra to bhaYa hacche ye, tomAra opara AllAhara kona AjAva Asave evaM tumi zaYatAnera saGgI haYe yAve|”

vAvA valala, “ivarAhIma! tumi ki AmAra devatAdera theke mukha phiriYe niccha? yadi tumi (erUpa AcaraNa theke) virata nA hao tAhale Ami avazyai tomAke pAthara mere hatyA karava| tumi AmAra kAcha theke ciradinera janya dUra haYe yAo|”
ivarAhIma (tAra vAvAke) valala, “tomAra opara zAnti varSita hoka! Ami tomAra janya AmAra prabhura kAche kSamA cAiva| nizcaYai tini AmAra prati anugrahazIla|”
“Ara Ami tomAdera theke evaM tomarA AllAhake chAr3A yAderake DAka tAdera theke pRthaka haYe yAcchi| Ami AmAra prabhuke DAkava| AzA kari, AmAra prabhuke DAkale hatabhAgya hava nA|”

ataHpara se yakhana tAdera theke evaM tArA AllAhake chAr3A yAdera upAsanA karachila tAdera theke pRthaka haYe gela takhana Ami tAra janya isahAka o iYAkUvake dAna karalAma| Ami (edera) pratyekake navIo karechilAma|
Ara Ami tAderake AmAra anugraha dAna karalAma evaM tAdera janya ucca sukhyAti varAdda karalAma|
kitAve (ullikhita) mUsAra kathAo smaraNa kara| vastuta se chila eka manonIta vyakti evaM chila ekajana rasUla o navI|
Ami tUra pAhAr3era DAna dika theke tAke samvodhana karechilAma evaM ekAnta AlApera janya tAke kAche niYe esechilAma|
Ara AmAra anugrahe tAra bhAi hArunakeo navIrUpe tAra janya dAna karechilAma|
kitAve (ullikhita) isamAIlera kathAo smaraNa kara| vastuta se chila satya oYAdAkArI evaM chila ekajana rasUla o navI|
se tAra parivAra-parijanake nAmAya o yAkAtera nirdeza dita| evaM se chila tAra prabhura kAche pachandanIYa|
kitAve (ullikhita) idarIsera kathAo smaraNa kara| vastuta se chila satyaniSTha o ekajana navI|
Ara Ami tAke eka ucca avasthAne unnIta karechilAma|

erAi sei sava navI yAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechena| erA Adamera vaMzadhara evaM tAderai uttarasurI yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe (naukAYa) vahana karechilAma| erA ivarAhIma o isarAIlera vaMzadhara evaM tAderai dalabhukta yAderake Ami satpatha dekhiYechilAma o manonIta karechilAma| edera sAmane yakhana AllAhara AYAtasamUha telAoYAta karA hata takhana tArA sejadAYa luTiYe par3ata evaM kA~date thAkata|sejadA
kintu tAdera pare emana eka prajanma ela yArA nAmAya (nAmAyera cetanA) naSTa karala evaM pravRttira vazavartI hala| ataeva, tArA bhraSTatAra pariNati dekhate pAve|
tave yArA taovA kareche, satyake vizvAsa kareche evaM satkAja kareche tArA era vyatikrama| emana lokerA jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tAdera prati etaTuku avicAra karA have nA|
cirasthAYI jAnnAte, karuNAmaYa AllAha tA~ra vAndAderake adRzye yAra pratizruti diYechena| tini to sei sattA yAra pratizruti avazyambhAvI|
sekhAne tArA kona vAje kathA zunave nA, zunave kevala jJazAntiJca| sekhAne sakAla-sandhyAYa tAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA thAkave|
AmAra vAndAdera madhye yArA mottAkI tAderakei Ami ai jAnnAtera adhikArI karava|

(jivarAIla valala) “AmarA (pherezatArA) ApanAra prabhura Adeza chAr3A avataraNa kari nA| AmAdera sAmane yA Ache, AmAdera pechane yA Ache evaM yA era mAjhakhAne Ache savakichui tA~ra| Ara ApanAra prabhu kichui bholena nA|”
tini AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichurai prabhu| ataeva, tA~ra ivAdata karo evaM tA~ra ivAdate avicala thAka| tumi ki tA~ra samatulya kAuke jAna?
mAnuSa vale, “Ami yakhana mare yAva, tArapara ki AmAke jIvita uThAno have?”
AcchA, tAhale mAnuSa ki smaraNa kare nA ye, itipUrve yakhana Ami tAke sRSTi karechilAma takhana se kichui chila nA?
sutarAM tomAra prabhura zapatha! avazyai Ami tAderake evaM zaYatAnaderake ekatrita karava, tArapara tAderake hA~Tute bhara-karA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera cArapAze niYe Asava|
ataHpara Ami pratiTi dala theke avazyai vera karava, ke tAdera madhye parama karaNAmaYera savaceYe var3a avAdhya|
tArapara nizcaYai Ami tAdera samvandheo samyaka avagata yArA jAhAnnAme dagdha haoYAra adhika yogya|
Ara tomAdera pratyekakei sekhAne yete have| eTA tomAra prabhura cUr3Anta siddhAnta|
ataHpara yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karechila Ami tAderake uddhAra karava evaM jAlemaderake hA~Tute bhara-karA avasthAYa sekhAne rekhe deva|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra spasTa AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana kApherarA muminaderake vale, “dui dalera kon‌Ti maryAdAYa zreSTha evaM majalisa AYojane utkRSTa?”
tAdera pUrve Ami kata prajanmake dhvaMsa kare diYechi! tArA sampade o saundarye (tAdera tulanAYa) zreSThatara chila|

vala, “yArA vibhrAntira madhye Ache AllAha tAderake yatheSTa avakAza devena| avazeSe yakhana tArA pratizruta zAsti athavA keYAmata pratyakSa karave takhanai jAnate pArave, ke maryAdAYa nikRSTa o lokalaskare durvala|”
yArA satpathe cale AllAha tAdera satpathe thAkAra kSamatA vAr3iYe dena| Ara sthAYI satkarmaguloi tomAra prabhura kAche pratidAnera dika theke uttama evaM pariNAmera dika thekeo uttama|
tumi ki sei lokaTike dekhecho, ye AmAra nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kareche Ara valeche, “(Ami yadi punarjIvita hai tAhale) avazyai AmAke dhana-sampada o santAna-santati deoYA have?”
se ki gAYeva jene geche, nAki AllAhara kAcha theke kona oYAdA niYeche?
kichutei nA| se yA vale Ami tA likhe rAkhava evaM tAra zAsti vAr3iYe deva|
Ara se yA vale tAte (tAra dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite) Amii tAra uttarAdhikArI hava evaM se AmAra kAche ekA Asave|
tArA AllAha vyatIta anyAnya upAsya grahaNa kareche, yAte tArA tAdera (sahAYaka) zakti haYa|
kakhanao naYa; (varaM) tArA tAdera upAsanA asvIkAra karave evaM tAdera viruddhe avasthAna neve|
tumi ki dekha nA ye, kApheraderake prarocita karAra janya Ami zaYatAnaderake cher3e diYechi?
ataeva, tAdera vyApAre tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| Ami to Thikamatai tAdera samaYa gaNanA karachi|
(smaraNa karo) yedina Ami mottAkIderake karuNAmaYera daravAre eka (sammAnita) pratinidhidalera nyAYa ekatrita karava;
Ara aparAdhIderake pAnira dike tAr3ita (tRSNArta) pazupAlera nyAYa jAhAnnAmera dike tAr3iYe neva|
tArA keu (kAro janya) supAriza karAra adhikArI have nA; kevala se chAr3A ye karuNAmaYera kAcha theke pratizruti grahaNa kareche|
tArA vale, “karuNAmaYa (AllAha) santAna grahaNa karechena|”
tomarA to Asalei ekaTA gurutara viSaYera avatAraNA karecho;
yAra kAraNe haYato AsamAnasamUha pheTe yAve, pRthivI khaNDa-vikhaNDa have evaM parvatamAlA bheGge par3ave|
e kAraNe ye, tArA karuNAmaYera prati santAna Aropa kareche|
athaca santAna grahaNa karA karuNAmaYera janya samIcIna naYa|
AsamAna o jamine yArA Ache tAdera pratyekei ekajana vAndA hiseve karuNAmaYera kAche upasthita have|
tini tAdera parisaMkhyAna rekhechena o tAderake bhAlabhAve gaNanA karechena|
Ara tAdera pratyeke keYAmatera dina ekAkI avasthAYa tA~ra kAche Asave|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare karuNAmaYa tAdera janya bhAlavAsA sRSTi karavena|
Ami to eke (ei koraAnake) tomAra javAne sahaja kare diYechi, yAte tumi era dvArA mottAkIderake susaMvAda dite evaM jhagar3ATe lokaderake satarka karate pAra|
tAdera pUrve Ami kata prajanmake dhvaMsa kare diYechi! tumi ki tAdera kAuke Tera pAo kiMvA tAdera kona kSINa AoYAja zunate pAo?
tvA hA [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
tumi kaSTa pAve, ejanya Ami tomAra kAche koraAna nAyila karini;
varaM yArA (AllAhake) bhaYa kare tAdera upadezera janya (tA nAyila karechi)|
(eTA) tA~rai kAcha theke avatIrNa yini jamina o suucca AsamAna sRSTi karechena|
karuNAmaYa to Araze (siMhAsane) samAsIna haYechena|
AsamAne yA kichu Ache, jamine yA kichu Ache, e duJcaYera mAjhe yA kichu Ache evaM mATira nice yA kichu Ache, sava tA~rai mAlikAnAdhIna|
yadi tumi jore kathA vala (valate pAra), tave (jene rAkhave,) tini gopana o adhikatara lukkAYita viSaYao jAnena|
AllAha sei mahAna sattA yini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| savaceYe sundara nAmasamUha tA~rai|
tomAra kAche mUsAra vRttAnta eseche ki?

yakhana se Aguna dekhala takhana tAra parivAravargake valala, “tomarA ekhAne avasthAna karo, Ami ekaTA Aguna dekhate peYechi| Ami haYato tA theke tomAdera janya ekaTu Aguna saMgraha kare Anate pArava natuvA ai Agunera kAche giYe kona pathera sandhAna pAva|”
ataHpara se yakhana Agunera kAche ela takhana tAke DAka deoYA hala, “he mUsA!
Amii tomAra prabhu| tumi tomAra jutA khola| tumi pavitra jJatuoYAJca upatyakAYa raYecho|”
“evaM Ami tomAke manonIta karechi| ataeva, ye ohI pAThAno haYa tA manoyoga diYe zona|
Amii AllAha| Ami chAr3A kona upAsya nei| ataeva, AmAra ivAdata karave evaM AmAra smaraNe nAmAya AdAYa karave|”
keYAmata avazyai Asave| (tave) Ami tA gopana rAkhate cAcchi, yAte pratyeke tAra ceSTAra phala pete pAre|
ataeva, keYAmate vizvAsa kare nA evaM nija pravRttira vazavartI haYa emana keu yena tomAke tA theke (keYAmatera kathA smaraNa rAkhA theke) virata nA kare| tAhale tumi dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
(AllAha mUsAke valechilena,) “he mUsA! tomAra DAnahAte oTA ki?”
se valala, “eTA AmAra lAThi| Ami eTAte bhara dei Ara eTA diYe AmAra meSapAlera janya gAchera pAtA pAr3i| eTAte AmAra Arao kichu praYojana raYeche|”
AllAha valalena, “mUsA! tumi oTA nikSepa kara|”
mUsA seTi nikSepa karala, Ara amani tA ekaTi sApa haYe daur3Ate lAgala|
AllAha valalena, “oTA dhare phela; bhaYa peYo nA| Ami oke ora pUrvera avasthAYa phiriYe nicchi|”
“Ara tomAra (DAna) hAta tomAra (vAma) vagalera sAthe lAgiYe dhara, tA zubhrojjvala haYe yAve—kona rogera kAraNe naYa—ArekaTi nidarzanarUpe|
yAte tomAke AmAra var3a var3a kichu nidarzana dekhAte pAri|
tumi pherAunera kAche yAo| se var3a vAr3a ver3eche|”
mUsA valala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra vakSa AmAra janya khule dAo (AmAra mane sAhasa yogAo);
AmAra kAja AmAra janya sahaja kare dAo;
Ara AmAra jihavA theke jar3atA dUra kare dAo;
yAte tArA AmAra kathA vujhate pAre|”
“evaM AmAra parivAra theke AmAra janya ekajana sAhAyyakArI dAo;
AmAra bhAi hArUnake|
tAra dvArA AmAra zakti joradAra kara|”
“evaM tAke AmAra kAje aMzIdAra karo;
yAte AmarA vezi kare tomAra pavitratA varNanA karate pAri
evaM vezi kare tomAke smaraNa karate pAri|
tumi to AmAdera savakichu bhAla kare dekhate pAo|”
AllAha valalena, “mUsA! tumi yA ceYecho tomAke tA deoYA hala|
Ara Ami to tomAra prati Arao ekavAra anugraha karechilAma|”
“yakhana Ami tomAra mAYera kAche ye pratyAdeza pAThAvAra chila tA pAThiYechilAma:

ye, tAke (zizu mUsAke) sindukera madhye rAkha; tArapara tA nadIte (nIlanade) bhAsiYe dAo; ataHpara nadI tAke tIre chu~r3e deve evaM AmAra o tAra eka zatru tAke uThiYe neve| Ara Ami tomAke AmAra nijera pakSa theke bhAlavAsA diYechilAma evaM yAte tumi AmAra cokhera sAmane (pratyakSa tattvAvadhAne) ver3e uThate pAra (sei vyavasthA karechilAma)|”

“yakhana tomAra vona calate calate giYe valala: Ami ki tomAderake emana ekajanera kathA valava, ye era lAlanapAlanera dAYitva nite pAre? ebhAve Ami tomAke tomAra mAYera kAche phiriYe dilAma; yAte tAra cakSu zItala haYa evaM se viSaNnatAYa nA bhoge| tumi ekajanake hatyA kare vasale| tArapara Ami tomAke duzcintA theke mukti diYechilAma evaM Ami tomAke var3arakama parIkSAYa phelechilAma| tArapara tumi kaYeka vachara mAd‌iYAnavAsIdera madhye chile| ataHpara he mUsA! nirdhArita samaYe tumi (ekhAne) esecho|”
“Ami tomAke AmAra nijera janya tairI karechi|
tumi o tomAra bhAi AmAra nidarzanasaha yAo evaM AmAra smaraNe (AmAra dvIna pracAre) truTi karo nA|”
“tomarA dujana pherAunera kAche yAo, se var3a vAr3a ver3eche|
tAra sAthe namrabhAve kathA valave; haYato se upadeza grahaNa karave kiMvA (AllAhake) bhaYa karave|”
tArA valala, “he prabhu! AmarA to AzaMkA karachi, se AmAdera prati vAr3AvAr3i karave kiMvA sImAlaMghana karave|”
tini valena, “bhaYa karo nA; Ami to tomAdera saGge Achi; Ami (sava) zunachi o dekhachi|”

“ataeva, tAra kAche yAo Ara vala: AmarA tomAra prabhura dUta| tumi vanI isarAIlake AmAdera saGge yete dAo evaM tAderake niryAtana karo nA| AmarA tomAra prabhura kAcha theke eka nidarzana niYe esechi| Ara ye satpathe calave tAra opara zAnti Asave|”
“AmAderake ohIra mAdhyame jAnAno haYeche ye, zAsti tAra oparai Asave ye avizvAsa kare Ara (satya theke) mukha phiriYe neYa|”
pherAuna valala, “mUsA! tAhale tomAdera duJcajanera prabhu ke?”
mUsA valala, “AmAdera prabhu halena tini, yini pratiTi vastuke tAra (nijasva) AkRti diYechena, tArapara (saThika) patha dekhiYechena|”
pherAuna valala, “tAhale prAcIna prajanmasamUhera avasthA (khavara) ki?”
mUsA valala, “tAdera khavara AmAra prabhura kAche likhita raYeche| AmAra prabhu bhula karena nA evaM bhuleo yAna nA|”

“yini tomAdera janya jaminake ekaTi vichAnA (vichAnAra mata) vAniYechena, tAte tomAdera janya patha tairI kare diYechena evaM AsamAna theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karechena|” era dvArA Ami vibhinna prakAra gAchapAlA utpanna karechi|
(jaminera gAchapAlA theke) tomarA nijerA khAo evaM tomAdera pazuderakeo (tAte) carAo| nizcaYai ete vuddhimAnadera janya nidarzana Ache|
mATi theke tomAderake sRSTi karechi, mATite tomAderake phiriYe neva evaM mATi thekei AvAra tomAderake vera karava|
Ami to tAke (pherAunake) AmAra sava nidarzana dekhiYechi; kintu se tA avizvAsa o amAnya kareche|
se valala, “he mUsA! tumi ki tomAra yAdu dvArA AmAderake AmAdera bhUkhaNDa theke vera kare dite esecho?”

“tAhale AmarAo tomAra sAmane anurUpa eka yAdu upasthita karava| ataeva, eka unmukta sthAne AmAdera o tomAra madhye (yAdu-pratiyogitAra janya) ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa Thika karo, yA AmarA laMghana karava nA evaM tumio nA|”
mUsA valala, “(Thika Ache,) tomAdera nirdhArita samaYa utsavera dina evaM (sedina) sakAlavelAYa lokaderake samaveta karA have|”
pherAuna uThe gela, nijera kauzala Thika karala evaM tArapara phire ela|

mUsA tAderake valala, “tomAdera amaGgala hoka! tomarA AllAhara nAme mithyA udbhAvana karo nA| tA karale tini tomAderake eka AjAva diYe ekevAre dhvaMsa kare devena| Ara ye (AllAhara viruddhe) mithyA udbhAvana kare se viphalamanoratha havei|”
ataHpara tArA tAdera kAja niYe nijedera madhye vitarka karala evaM gopane parAmarza karala|

(se parAmarze) tArA valala, “nizcaYai erA dujana (mUsA o hArUna) yAdukara| erA nijedera yAdura sAhAyye tomAderake tomAdera bhUkhaNDa theke vera kare dite cAYa evaM tomAdera utkRSTa jIvanapaddhatira vilopa ghaTAte cAYa|”
“tomarA tomAdera kauzala susaMhata kara| tArapara sArivaddhabhAve upasthita hao| Aja ye jaYI have sei prakRta saphala have|”
tArA valala, “mUsA! haYa tumi nikSepa karo, nA haYa AmarAi Age nikSepa kari|”
mUsA valala, “varaM tomarAi nikSepa kara|” amani tAdera (nikSipta) razi o lAThigulo tAdera yAdura prabhAve daur3Acche vale tAra mane hala|
ete mUsA tAra mane kichuTA bhIti anubhava karala|
Ami valalAma, “bhaYa peYo nA, tumii vijaYI have|

tumi tomAra DAna hAte yA Ache tA nikSepa karo, (dekhave) tArA yA kichu tairI kareche eTA tA sava gile phelave| tArA yA tairI kareche tA to kevala yAdukarera kauzala| yAdukara yekhAnei Asuka (yAduvidyAYa yatai pAradarzI hoka), saphala haYa nA|”
(pherAunera) yAdukarerA (mUsAra sAthe parAjita haYe) sejadAYa par3e gela| tArA valala, “AmarA hArUna o mUsAra prabhura prati ImAna AnalAma|”

pherAuna valala, “Ami tomAderake anumati deoYAra Agei tomarA mUsAra pakSe ImAna Anale? nizcaYai se tomAderai guru, ye tomAderake yAdu zikhiYeche| ataeva, Ami avazyai tomAdera hAta-pA viparIta dika theke keTe deva evaM tomAderake khejuragAchera kANDe zUlaviddha karava| Ara avazyai tomarA jAnate pArave, AmAdera madhye kAra zAsti kaThoratara o adhikatara sthAYI|”

tArA valala, “AmAdera kAche yesava spaSTa pramANa eseche tAra opara evaM AmAderake yini sRSTi karechena tA~ra opara AmarA tomAke kichutei prAdhAnya deva nA| ataeva, tumi ye vicAra karate cAo karate pAra| tumi to kevala ei pArthiva jIvanera vyApArei vicAra karave|”
“AmarA AmAdera prabhura prati ImAna enechi, yAte tini AmAdera sAdhAraNa pApasamUha evaM tumi ye AmAderake yAdu praYoge vAdhya karecho tAra pApa kSamA kare dena| AllAhai zreSTha o zAzvata|”
aparAdhI avasthAYa ye tAra prabhura kAche upasthita have tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAma| sekhAne se maraveo nA, vA~caveo nA|
Ara yArA ImAnadAra avasthAYa satkarma kare tA~ra kAche upasthita have tAdera janya raYeche suucca maryAdA;
sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTA tAderai puraskAra yArA (pApa theke) pavitra thAke|

Ami mUsAra kAche ohI pAThiYe valechilAma, “AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAte veriYe par3a evaM tAdera janya samudrera madhye ekaTi zukano patha tairI kare nAo| (pechana theke ese pherAunera) dhare phelAra bhaYa karave nA kiMvA (samudre Duve yAoYAra bhaYe) bhIta have nA|”
ataHpara pherAuna tAra senAdala niYe mUsA o tAra saGgIderake anusaraNa karala| takhana samudrera pAni pherAuna o tAra sainyaderake puropuri Dheke dila (nimajjita karala)|
pherAuna tAra lokaderake vipathagAmI karechila, se (tAderake) satpatha dekhAYani|
he vanI isarAIla! Ami tomAderake zatrura hAta theke rakSA karechilAma, tUra pAhAr3era DAna pAze tomAderake pratizruti diYechilAma evaM tomAdera kAche mAn‌ o sAl‌oYA pAThiYechilAma|

tomarA AmAra deoYA pavitra khAdyasAmagrI khAo evaM e vyApAre sImAlaMghana karo nA| tAhale tomAdera opara AmAra gayava (krodha) neme Asave| Ara yAra opara AmAra gayava neme Ase, se avazyai dhvaMsa haYe yAYa|
Ara ye taovA kare, (satyera prati) vizvAsa rAkhe, satkAja kare Ara saThika patha anusaraNa kare, tAra prati Ami avazyai kSamAzIla|
Ara he mUsA! tumi tomAra lokaderake rekhe tAr3Ahur3A karale kena?
se valala, “ai to tArA AmAra pechanei Ache| he prabhu! Ami ekaTu tAr3AtAr3i tomAra kAche esechi, yAte tumi khuzI hao|”
tini valalena, “Ami to tomAra (cale AsAra) pare tomAra lokaderake parIkSAYa phelechi evaM sAmirI tAderake pathabhraSTa kareche|”

takhana mUsA kruddha o kSuvdha haYe tAra lokadera kAche phire gela| se valala, “he AmAra lokerA! tomAdera prabhu ki tomAdera sAthe ekaTi bhAla oYAdA karenani? tave ki se oYAdA tomAdera janya dIrgha haYeche? nAki tomarA ceYecho, tomAdera opara tomAdera prabhura gayava neme Asuka, ye kAraNe tomarA AmAra (sAthe kRta) oYAdA bhaGga karale?”

tArA valala, “AmarA tomAra oYAdA AmAdera icchAYa bhaGga karini; varaM AmAdera opara (pherAunera) lokadera alaMkArera bhAra cApAno haYechila evaM AmarA tA (Agune) nikSepa karechi| ekaibhAve sAmirIo nikSepa kareche|”

tArapara se tAdera janya emana ekaTi vAchurera mUrti tairI kare, yAra madhye ekaprakAra hAmvArava chila| tArA valala, “eTA tomAdera upAsya evaM mUsArao upAsya; kintu mUsA (tAra upAsyake) bhule geche|”
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, eTA tAdera kona kathAYa sAr3A deYa nA evaM tAdera kona kSati kiMvA upakAra karate pAre nA?

era Age hArUna tAderake valechila, “he AmAra lokerA! Asale eTA dvArA tomAderake parIkSAYa phelA haYeche| tomAdera prabhu to parama karuNAmaYa| ataeva, tomarA AmAra anusaraNa karo evaM AmAra Adeza mene cala|”
(javAve) tArA valechila, “mUsA AmAdera kAche phire nA AsA paryanta AmarA eTira upAsanAYa nivedita thAkava|”
mUsA valala, “hArUna! yakhana tumi oderake vipathagAmI hate dekhale takhana tomAke kise vAdhA diYechila,
ye (kAraNe) tumi AmAra nIti anusaraNa karale nA? tave ki tumi AmAra Adeza amAnya karecho?”

hArUna valala, “ore AmAra mAYera chele (bhAi)! tumi AmAra dAr3i o mAthAra cula dhare Teno nA| Ami to bhaYa karechilAma ye, (oderake vezi kichu valale) tumi ese valave, “tumi vanI isarAIlera madhye vibheda sRSTi karecho evaM AmAra kathAra sammAna rAkhani|”
(erapara) mUsA (sAmirIke) valala, “ei sAmirI! tomAra viSaYaTA ki? (tumi amana kAja karale kena?)”

se valala, “Ami ekaTA vyApAra dekhechilAma, yA anyarA dekheni| takhana sei dUtera (jivarAIlera ghor3Ara) pAYera chApa theke ekamuTho (mATi) niYe tA nikSepa karalAma| ebhAvei AmAra mana AmAke praNodita karechila|”

mUsA valala, “tAhale tumi dUra haYe yAo! jIvaddazAYa tomAra janya eTAi zAsti ye, tumi valave: AmAke sparza karo nA| (arthAt sArAjIvana tumi aspRzya haYe mAnuSa theke dUre thAkave|) Ara tomAra janya (bhaviSyat zAstira) ekaTA oYAdAo raYeche yAra kona vyatikrama karA have nA| evAra tomAra sei upAsyera (vAchurera mUrtira) dike tAkAo yAra upAsanAYa tumi nivedita chile| AmarA eTAke avazyai pur3iYe phelava evaM era bhasmAvazeSa samudre char3iYe deva|”
tomAdera (prakRta) upAsya to AllAha, yini chAr3A anya kona upAsya nei| savakichui tA~ra jJAnera AotAbhukta|
pUrve yA ghaTeche tAra saMvAda ebhAvei Ami tomAra kAche varNanA kari| Ara Ami tomAke AmAra pakSa theke ekaTi smaraNikA (koraAna) dAna karechi|
e theke ye mukha phiriYe neve se keYAmatera dina (pApera) ekaTi (bhArI) vojhA vahana karave|
tArA tAte (tAra aparihArya pariNati jAhAnnAme) cirakAla thAkave| keYAmatera dina eTA tAdera janya khuva khArApa ekaTA vojhA have;
yedina ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have| Ara sedina Ami aparAdhIderake nIla cakSuviziSTa (dRSTihIna) avasthAYa ekatrita karava|
tArA nijedera madhye cupicupi valAvali karave, “(pRthivIte) tomarA dazadinera vezi avasthAna karani|”
tArA ki valave Ami tA khuva bhAla kare jAni, yakhana tAdera madhye utkRSTatara jIvanapaddhatira anusArI vyakti valave, tomarA ekadinera vezi avasthAna karani|
tArA tomAra kAche pAhAr3a-parvata samvandhe prazna kare| tumi vala, “AmAra prabhu seguloke visphorita kare char3iYe-chiTiYe devena|
tArapara seguloke tRNavihIna samatalabhUmi kare rAkhavena|
tAte tumi kona vakratA vA asamatA dekhave nA|”

sedina mAnuSerA (AllAhara pakSa theke) AhavAnakArIra kathAmato calave| tAra kathAra moTeo edika-odika karate pArave nA| karuNAmaYa AllAhara bhaYe sava zavda nicu haYe yAve| sutarAM phisaphisAni chAr3A tumi Ara kichu zunave nA|
karuNAmaYa AllAha yAke anumati devena evaM yAra kathA tini pachanda karavena kevala se chAr3A anya kAro supAriza sedina kona kAje Asave nA|
tAdera sAmane yA Ache o tAdera pechane yA Ache tA (sava) tini jAnena; kintu tArA tA~ke (nijedera) jJAnera AotAYa Anate pAre nA|
ciraJjIva cirasthAYI sattA AllAhara sAmane sakala mukhamaNDala avanamita have| Ara ye julumera bhAra (pApa) vahana kareche se vyartha have|
ImAnadAra avasthAYa ye satkAja kare se kona avicAra kiMvA kSatira AzaMkA karave nA|
Ara ebhAvei Ami AravI bhASAYa koraAna nAyila karechi evaM tAte vistAritabhAve satarkavANI vivRta karechi, yAte tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare athavA tA tAdera janya zikSAgrahaNera upAdAna yogAYa|
prakRta adhipati AllAha ati mahAna! tomAra prati tA~ra ohI sampUrNa haoYAra pUrve koraAna niYe tAr3Ahur3A karave nA| Ara valave, “he prabhu! AmAra jJAna vAr3iYe dAo|”
Ami itipUrve Adama theke oYAdA niYechilAma; kintu se (tA) bhule giYechila| Ami tAra dRr3hatAra paricaYa pAini|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami pherezatAdera valechilAma, “tomarA Adamake sejadA karo (Adamera sammAne mAthAnata karo)|” takhana tArA sejadA karechila; kintu ivalIsa kareni; se (sejadA karate) asvIkAra karala|
takhana Ami valalAma, “he Adama! ei vyATA tomAra o tomAra strIra zatru| ataeva, (sAvadhAna theko) se yena tomAdera duJcajanake jAnnAta theke vera karate nA pAre| tAte tumi kaSTa pAve|
tomAke kathA deoYA hala, jAnnAte tumi kSudhArtao have nA, vivastrao have nA|
sekhAne tomAra tRSNAo lAgave nA, sUryatApera kaSTao have nA|
ataHpara zaYatAna tAke kumantraNA dila| se valala, “Adama! Ami ki tomAke amaratva-vRkSa o akSaYa rAjyera sandhAna deva?”

ataHpara tArA dujane gAchaTira phala khela| takhana tAdera sAmane tAdera lajjAsthAna unmocita haYe gela| tArA (tAdera Avaru rakSAra janya) nijedera gAYe jAnnAtera gAchera pAtA jar3Ate lAgala| Adama tAra prabhura nirdeza amAnya karechila valei se vibhrAnta haYechila|
ataHpara tAra prabhu tAke manonIta karena evaM tAra taovA kavula karena o (tAke) dika-nirdezanA dena|

tini valena, “tomarA ubhaYe ekatre jAnnAta theke (pRthivIte) neme yAo| tomarA kataka katakera zatru (haYe thAkave)| tArapara yadi tomAdera kAche AmAra pakSa theke dika-nirdezanA Ase, takhana ye AmAra dika-nirdezanA anusaraNa karave se pathabhraSTa have nA evaM kaSTao pAve nA|”
Ara ye AmAra smaraNa theke vimukha have tAra janya raYeche kaSTera jIvana; evaM Ami tAke keYAmatera dina andha avasthAYa uThAva|
se valave, “prabhu! AmAke tumi andha avasthAYa uThAle kena? Ami to (Age) cokhe dekhatAma|”
tini valavena, “ebhAvei tomAra kAche AmAra nidarzanasamUha esechila, kintu tumi tA bhule giYechile (tAra prati kona gurutva dAoni)| Aja tAi sebhAvei tomAkeo bhule yAoYA have|”
ebhAvei Ami sei vyaktira pratiphala diYe thAki ye vAr3AvAr3i kare evaM tAra prabhura nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kare| Ara parakAlera zAsti to avazyai kaThinatara o adhikatara sthAYI (have)|
Ami ye edera pUrve vahu janagoSThIke dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yAdera vAsasthAnasamUhe erA calAcala karache, tAteo ki edera hedAYeta hala nA? era madhye to vuddhimAnadera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|
yadi Age thekei tomAra prabhura ekaTi kathA (siddhAnta) evaM ekaTi nirdhArita samaYasImA nA thAkata tAhale nizcaYai (tAdera zAsti ei pRthivItei) avazyambhAvI hata|

sutarAM tArA yA vale tAte dhairyadhAraNa karo evaM sUryodaYera pUrve, sUryAstera pUrve, rAtera kichu samaYe evaM dinera prAntasamUhe tomAra prabhura pavitratA o prazaMsA varNanA karo; yAte tumi (tA~ra deoYA puraskAre) santuSTa hate pAra|

parIkSA karAra uddezye Ami tAdera vibhinna zreNIke pArthiva jIvanera cAkacikyasvarUpa yesava bhogera sAmagrI diYechi, tumi tAra dike cokha vAr3iYo nA| tomAra prabhura deoYA jIvikAi zreSTha o adhikatara sthAYI|
tomAra parivAra-parijanake nAmAyera Adeza dAo evaM nije tAte avicala thAka| Ami tomAra kAche kona jIvikA cAcchi nA| Amii tomAke jIvikA diYe thAki| Ara zubha pariNAma to tAkaoYArai|
tArA vale, “se tAra prabhura kAcha theke AmAdera janya kona nidarzana (pramANa) niYe Ase nA kena?” tave ki pUrvavartI granthasamUhe yA kichu (lekhA) Ache tAra pramANa tAdera kAche Aseni?

Ara Ami yadi era Agei AjAva dvArA tAderake dhvaMsa kare ditAma tAhale tArA valata, “he AmAdera prabhu! tumi AmAdera kAche ekajana rasUla pAThAle nA kena? tAhale AmarA lAJchita o apamAnita haoYAra pUrve tomAra nidarzanasamUha mene calatAma|”
vala, “savAi pratIkSA karache| ataeva, tomarAo pratIkSA kara| tomarA zigagirai jAnate pArave, kArA saThika pathera anusArI evaM kArA hedAYetaprApta haYeche|”
mAnuSera hisAvagrahaNera samaYa ghaniYe eseche; athaca tArA udAsInatAYa mukha phiriYe Ache|
tAdera kAche tAdera prabhura pakSa theke natuna ye upadezai Ase, tArA tA zone khelAra chale,
udAsIna antare| tArA gopane valAvali kareche, yArA jAlema tArA, “se to tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa vai naYa| tavuo ki tomarA cokhe dekheo (tAra) yAdura kAche Asave? (tAra yAdute AkRSTa have?)”
se (muhAmmAda) valeche, “AmAra prabhu AsamAna o jaminera yAvatIYa kathA jAnena| tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|”

tArA Aro valeche, “(tAra ohIra viSaYaTi) elomelo svapna| kiMvA se nije esava vAniYeche| nA haYa se ekajana kavi| ataeva, se (tAra satyatA pramANera janya) AmAdera kAche kona nidarzana niYe Asuka, yemana pUrvavartIrA (pUrvavartI rasUlagaNa nidarzanasaha) prerita haYechila|”
edera Age yesava janapada Ami dhvaMsa karechi tAra adhivAsIrA ImAna Aneni| ataeva, erA ki ImAna Anave?
tomAra pUrve Ami mAnuSakei rasUla kare pAThiYechilAma, yAdera kAche ohI pAThAtAma| tomarA yadi nA jAna tAhale yAdera AsamAni kitAvera jJAna Ache tAdera kAche jijJesa kara|
Ami tAderake emana kona deha vAnAini ye tArA khAvAra kheta nA| tArA amarao chila nA|
ataHpara Ami tAderake deoYA oYAdA satye pariNata karechi evaM tAderake o (tAdera sAthe) yAderake icchA rakSA karechi Ara sImAlaMghana-kArIderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi|
Ami to tomAdera kAche ekaTi kitAva nAyila karechi, yAte tomAdera (janya) upadeza raYeche| tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?
Ami kata janapada dhvaMsa kare diYechi, yArA jAlema chila! evaM tAdera pare anya janagoSThI sRSTi karechi|
ataHpara tArA yakhana AmAra zAsti (zAstira Agamana) Tera pela, takhanai sekhAna theke chuTe pAlAte lAgala|
pAliYo nA| yekhAne tomarA vilAsajIvana yApana karecho sekhAne evaM nijedera vAsasthAne phire eso, yAte tomAderake jijJAsA karA yete pAre|
tArA valala, “hAYa AmAdera kapAla! nizcaYai AmarA jAlema chilAma|”
tAdera ei ArtanAda avyAhata chila| avazeSe Ami tAderake kartita zasya (dhvaMsaprApta) o nirvApita (mRta) kare diYechi|
AsamAna o jamina evaM edera mAjhakhAne yA kichu Ache tA Ami (zudhumAtra) khelAra janya sRSTi karini|
Ami yadi vinodanera upakaraNa vAnAte cAitAma tAhale tA nijera thekei vAnAtAma; Ami tA karini|

varaM Ami satya dvArA mithyAra opara AghAta kari; takhana satya mithyAke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare deYa Ara takhanai mithyA vilupta haYe yAYa| Ara tomarA (AllAhara nAme) yA valacha tAra kAraNe tomAdera janya var3ai durbhoga raYeche!
AsamAna o jamine yArA Ache tArA tA~rai| Ara yArA tA~ra nikaTe Ache tArA (pherezatArA) ahaGkAravazata tA~ra ivAdata theke virata thAke nA evaM tArA klAntao haYa nA|
tArA rAtadina (AllAhara) guNagAna kare, (kakhanao tAte) avahelA kare nA|
nAki tArA (avizvAsIrA) mATi theke tairI emana upAsya grahaNa kareche yArA (mRtadera) jIvita karate pAre?
yadi AsamAna o jamine AllAha chAr3A anyAnya upAsya thAkata tAhale ubhaYaTii dhvaMsa haYe yeta| ataeva, tArA (tA~ra nAme) yA vale, Arazera mAlika AllAha tA theke pavitra|
tini yA karena se vyApAre tA~ke jijJAsA karA yAYa nA, varaM (tArA yA kare se vyApAre) tAderake jijJAsA karA have|

nAki tArA tA~ke chAr3A anyAnya upAsya grahaNa kareche? vala, “tomAdera pramANa upasthita kara| eTA AmAra saGge yArA Ache tAdera janya upadeza evaM AmAra pUrve yArA chila tAdera janyao upadeza|” tave tAdera adhikAMzai (prakRta) satya jAne nA; tAi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
tomAra pUrve Ami ye rasUlai pAThiYechi tAke ohIra mAdhyame ekathAi valechi ye, Ami chAr3A anya kona upAsya nei; ataeva, tomarA AmAra ivAdata kara|
tArA valeche, “karuNAmaYa (AllAha) santAna grahaNa kareche|” (tAdera ei mithyAropa theke) tini pavitra| varaM (tArA yAderake AllAhara santAna valache tArA tA~ra) sammAnita vAndA|
tArA tA~ra Age kathA vale nA evaM tArA tA~ra Adeze kAja kare|
tAdera sAmane yA Ache evaM tAdera pechane yA Ache tini tA jAnena| tArA kevala tAra janyai supAriza karate pAre yAra prati tini santuSTa| Ara tArA tA~ra bhaYe AtaGkita thAke|
tAdera madhye ye vale, “AllAha vyatIta Amii ekajana upAsya,” tAke Ami jAhAnnAmera zAsti deva| ebhAvei Ami jAlemaderake zAsti diYe thAki|

avizvAsIrA ki dekheni ye, AsamAna o jamina ekaTi selAikRta (ekatre milita) vastu chila, tArapara Ami tAderake pRthaka kare diYechi? evaM pAni theke Ami pratiTi jIvanta vastu sRSTi karechi| tAraparao ki tArA vizvAsa karave nA?
pRthivIte Ami sudRr3ha parvatamAlA sthApana karechi, yAte tA tAderake niYe jhu~ke nA par3e| Ami tAte prazasta pathao tairI karechi, yAte tArA patha calate pAre|
Ami AkAzake eka surakSita chAda vAniYechi| athaca tArA AkAzera nidarzanasamUha theke mukha phiriYe Ache|
tinii rAta, dina, candra o sUrya sRSTi karechena| pratyeke nija nija kakSapathe bhAsache|
tomAra pUrveo Ami kona mAnuSake ananta jIvana deini| ataeva, tumi yadi mare yAo tAhale tArA ki cirakAla ve~ce thAkave?
pratyekei mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave| Ami tomAderake manda o bhAla dvArA vizeSabhAve parIkSA kare thAki| Ara AmAra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe AnA have|

kApherarA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana tomAke tArA ThATTAra pAtrarUpei grahaNa kare (Ara vale), “ei ki sei vyakti ye tomAdera upAsyadera samAlocanA kare?” athaca erAi karuNAmaYera kathA ullekha karateo asvIkAra kare|
mAnuSake tAr3Ahur3Ara upAdAna diYe sRSTi karA haYeche (sRSTigatabhAvei mAnuSa tAr3Ahur3ApravaNa)| Ami zigagirai tomAderake AmAra nidarzanasamUha dekhAva| ataeva, AmAke tAr3AtAr3i karate valo nA|
tArA vale, “tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao (tAhale vala), ei oYAdA kave (Asave)?”
kApherarA yadi sei samaYera kathA jAnata, yakhana tArA tAdera mukhamaNDala o pRSThadeza theke Aguna pratihata karate pArave nA evaM tArA kona sAhAyyao pAve nA!
varaM Aguna tAdera kAche atarkite ese tAderake hatavAka kare deve| tAi tArA tA rodhao karate pArave nA evaM tAderake samaYao deoYA have nA|
tomAra pUrveo rasUladera sAthe ThATTA-vidrUpa karA haYeche| tave yA niYe tArA tAdera sAthe vidrUpa karata tA (arthAt zAsti) sei vidrUpakArIdera opara Apatita haYechila|
vala, “ke tomAderake rAte o dine karuNAmaYa theke (tA~ra zAsti theke) rakSA karave?” varaM tArA tAdera prabhura smaraNa theke mukha phiriYe rAkhe|
tave ki tAdera anyAnya upAsya Ache yArA tAderake AmAra (zAsti) theke rakSA karate pAre? tArA to nijederakei sAhAyya karate pAre nA| AmAra (zAsti) thekeo tArA rakSA pAve nA|

varaM Amii tAderake o tAdera vApa-dAdAke bhogera sAmagrI diYechilAma| emanaki tAdera AYuSkAlao dIrgha haYechila| tAhale tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami caturdika theke (tAdera niYantraNAdhIna) bhUmi hrAsa kare Anachi? tAraparao ki tArA vijaYI have?
vala, “tomAderake to Ami ohIra mAdhyamei satarka karachi|” tave vadhiraderake yakhana satarka karA haYa takhana tArA se DAka zone nA|
Ara yadi tomAra prabhura zAstira eka zvAsao (sAmAnya parimANao) tAderake sparza kare tAhale avazyai tArA valave, “hAYa AmAdera durbhoga! nizcaYai AmarA jAlema chilAma|”

keYAmatera dina Ami nyAYavicArera mAnadaNDa sthApana karava| tAi kAro prati kona avicAra karA have nA| kAro yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANao kAja (Amala) thAke, Ami tA upasthita karava| hisAva grahaNera janya Amii yatheSTa|
Ami to mUsA o hArUnake satya-mithyAra pArthakyakArI grantha Ara ujjvala eka Alo diYechilAma evaM tAkaoYA avalamvanakArIdera janya upadeza dAna karechilAma;
yArA nA dekheo tAdera prabhuke bhaYa kare; Ara keYAmata samparke tArA bhIta thAke|
eTA AmArai nAyila-karA eka varakatamaYa upadeza| tavuo ki tomarA tA asvIkAra karave?
itipUrve Ami ivarAhImake tAra supatha dAna karechilAma evaM Ami tAra samparke avagata chilAma|
yakhana se tAra pitAke o samapradAYake valala, “tomarA ye ei mUrtigulora pUjA karacha egulo ki?”
tArA valala, “AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke egulora pUjA karate dekhechi|”
se valala, “Asale tomarA o tomAdera vApa-dAdArA spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye raYecho|”
tArA valala, “tumi ki AmAdera kAche satya niYe esecho, nAki majA karacha?”
se valala, “(nA,) varaM tomAdera prabhu AsamAna o jaminera prabhu, yini egulo sRSTi karechena| Ara Ami se viSaYerai anyatama sAkSI|”
“AllAhara kasama! tomarA piTha phiriYe cale yAvAra para Ami avazyai tomAdera mUrtigulora vyApAre (segulo bheGge phelate) ekaTA kauzala avalamvana karava|”
ataHpara se mUrtigulo cUrNa-vicUrNa kare dila; tave odera var3aTike bhAGgalo nA, yAte tArA oTAra kAche phire Ase|
tArA valala, “AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe ei AcaraNa ke kareche? nizcaYai se ekaTA jAlema|”
keu keu valala, “AmarA eka yuvakake tAdera samAlocanA karate zunechi| tAra nAma ivarAhIma|”
tArA valala, “tAke janasamakSe upasthita karo, yAte tArA (tAke) dekhate pAre|”
tArA valala, “ivarAhIma! AmAdera upAsyadera sAthe ei AcaraNa ki tumi karecho?”
se valala, “eTA varaM odera ei var3aTAi kareche| tomarA odera kAchei jijJesa karo, yadi orA kathA valate pAre|”
takhana tArA (viSaYaTi niYe) mane mane cintA karala| tArapara (nijederakei) valala, “Asale jAlema to tomarAi|”
erapara tArA tAdera mAthA nata karala (Ara valala), “(ivarAhIma! tumi to jAnai, erA kathA valate pAre nA|”
ivarAhIma valala, “tAhale ki tomarA AllAhake vAda diYe emana kichura upAsanA karo yA tomAdera kona upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAre nA?”
“dhika tomAderake evaM AllAha vyatIta tomarA yAdera upAsanA karo tAderake! tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?”
tArA valala, “eke (ivarAhImake) pur3iYe dAo evaM tomAdera upAsyadera sAhAyya karo, yadi tomarA kichu karate cAo|”
Ami valalAma, “he Aguna! tumi ivarAhImera janya zItala o nirApada haYe yAo|”
tArA tAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karate (tAra kSati karate) cAila, kintu Ami tAderakei savaceYe kSatigrasta karalAma|
Ara Ami tAke o lUtake uddhAra kare sei bhUkhaNDe niYe gelAma yAke Ami vizvavAsIra janya varakatamaYa karechi|
ivarAhImera janya (putra) isahAkake o vAr3atirUpe (pautra) iYAkUvake dAna karechilAma| Ara (edera) pratyekakei satkarmazIla karechilAma|

Ami tAderake netA vAniYechilAma, yArA AmAra nirdeze (mAnuSake) patha dekhAta| Ami tAderake satkAja karAra, nAmAya kAYema karAra o yAkAta pradAna karAra pratyAdeza pAThiYechilAma| tArA AmArai ivAdata karata|
Ara lUtake Ami prajJA o jJAna diYechilAma evaM tAke sei janapada theke uddhAra karechilAma yAra vAsindArA kukarma karata| nizcaYai tArA chila pApI Ara durAcArI eka janagoSThI|
Ami tAke (lUtake) AmAra anugrahera antarbhukta karechilAma| nizcaYai se chila satkarmazIladera anyatama|
Ara nUhera kathA smaraNa karo, yakhana se pUrve (AmAke) Dekechila| Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma evaM tAke o tAra anusArIderake mahAvipada theke uddhAra karechilAma|
evaM tAke sei lokadera viruddhe sAhAyya karechilAma yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karechila| nizcaYai tArA chila eka pApI janagoSThI| tAi Ami tAdera sakalake DuviYe merechilAma|

evaM smaraNa karo dAuda o solAYamAnera kathA, yakhana tArA (ekajanera meSapAla dvArA kSatigrasta Arekajanera) zasyera kSeta samparke vicAra karachila, yAte rAtera velAYa lokadera meSapAla carechila| Ara Ami tAdera vicArera sAkSI chilAma|

Ami solAYamAnake viSaYaTi samvandhe saThika vujha dAna karechilAma| (tAdera) pratyekakei Ami prajJA o jJAna diYechilAma| Ara parvatasamUha o pAkhiderake Ami dAudera adhIna karechilAma; tArA (AmAra) pavitratA varNanA karata| esava Amii karechilAma|
Ami tAke tomAdera janya varma tairI karA zikhiYechilAma, yAte tA yuddhe tomAderake rakSA kare| tomarA ki (tAra janya) kRtajJa?
Ara solAYamAnera adhIna karechilAma pravala vAtAsake, yA tAra Adeze sei bhUkhaNDera dike pravAhita hata yAke Ami varakatamaYa karechi| Ami savakichui avagata Achi|
(tAra adhIna karechilAma) katipaYa zaYatAnake (duSTa jvinake) yArA tAra janya DuvurIra kAja karata evaM e chAr3A anya kAjao karata; Ara Ami tAderake praharAYa rAkhatAma|
Ara Aiuvera kathAo smaraNa karo, yakhana se tAra prabhuke DAka diYe valechila, “(he prabhu!) Ami var3a kaSTe par3echi, Ara tumi hale savaceYe var3a daYAlu|”

Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYe tAra kaSTa dUra kare dilAma evaM AmAra pakSa theke anugrahasvarUpa o ivAdatakArIdera janya upadezasvarUpa tAke tAra (hAriYe yAoYA) parivAra-parijana phiriYe dilAma o tAdera sAthe tAdera anurUpa Aro dilAma|
isamAIla, idarIsa o yula-kiph‌lakeo smaraNa kara| (erA) pratyekei dhairyazIladera antarbhukta (chila)|
Ami tAderake AmAra anugrahera AotAYa enechilAma| nizcaYai tArA satkarmazIladera antarbhukta|

yuna-nUnera (iunusera) kathAo smaraNa karo, yakhana se (svIYa samapradAYera opara) kruddha haYe cale giYechila Ara mane karechila, Ami tAra truTi dharava nA (athavA Ami tAke vipade phelava nA)| ataHpara se andhakArera mAjhe (AmAke) DAka diYe valechila, “tumi chAr3A kona upAsya nei, tumi mahAna! nizcaYai Ami jAlemadera dalabhukta|”
Ami tAra DAke sAr3A dilAma evaM tAke kaSTa theke rakSA karalAma| muminaderake Ami ebhAvei rakSA kari|
yAkAriYAra kathAo smaraNa karo, yakhana se tAra prabhuke DAka diYechila, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAke ekA (niHsantAna) rekho nA| tumi to zreSTha uttarAdhikArI|”

Ami tAra DAke sAr3A dilAma, tAra janya iYAhaiYAke dAna karalAma evaM tAra janya tAra strIke (santAna dhAraNera) yogya karalAma| tArA bhAla bhAla kAje jhA~piYe par3ata evaM (mane) AzA o bhaYa niYe AmAke DAkata| Ara tArA chila AmAra prati vinaYAvanata|
sei nArIkeo (mariYamake) smaraNa karo ye tAra satItva rakSA karechila| Ami tAra mAjhe AmAra rUha phu~ke dilAma evaM tAke o tAra putrake vizvavAsIra janya nidarzana vAnAlAma|
ei hala tomAdera dharma, eka dharma; Ara Ami halAma tomAdera prabhu; ataeva, AmAra ivAdata kara|
kintu mAnuSerA tAdera karme (dharmera vyApAre) nijedera madhye vibheda sRSTi kareche| savAi to AmAra kAchei phire Asave|
ataeva, ye ImAna sahakAre satkAja kare tAra praYAsa agrAhya havAra naYa| nizcaYai Ami tA tAra janya likhe rAkhi|
ye janapada Ami dhvaMsa karechi tAra vAsindAdera janya (phire AsA) niSiddha haYeche, tArA phire Asave nA|
takhana paryanta, yakhana iYAjUja-mAjUjake (vandI avasthA theke) cher3e deoYA have, Ara tArA pratiTi uccabhUmi theke druta neme Asave|

satya oYAdA (keYAmata) ghaniYe Asache dekhei (bhaYe) kApheradera cokha sthira haYe yAve| (tArA valave,) “hAYare AmAdera durbhoga! e vyApAre AmarA ekevAre vekhavara chilAma; (nA nA,) varaM AmarA jAlema chilAma|”
tomarA evaM AllAhake chAr3A tomarA yAdera upAsanA karo tArA to jAhAnnAmera jvAlAni| tomarA savAi tAte praveza karave|
erA yadi upAsyai hata tAhale jAhAnnAme praveza karata nA| savAi sekhAne cirakAla thAkave|
tArA sekhAne vilApa karave evaM tArA sekhAne (kichui) zunate pAve nA|
yAdera janya AmAra pakSa theke Agei kalyANa nirdhArita haYeche tAderake jAhAnnAma theke dUre rAkhA have|
tArA tAra mRdu zavdao zunave nA| tAdera mana yA cAYa tArA cirakAla tAra madhyei thAkave (tAi bhoga karave)|

(keYAmatera) savaceYe var3a AtaMkao tAderake cintita karave nA| Ara pherezatArA tAderake abhyarthanA jAnAve| (tArA valave,) “ei to tomAdera sei dina, (duniYAte) tomAderake yAra pratizruti deoYA hata|”
yedina Ami vaiYera kAgaja pe~cAnora mata AsamAnake pe~ciYe rAkhava| yebhAve Ami prathamavAra sRSTi karechilAma, sebhAve AvAra sRSTi karava| eTA AmAra oYAdA| Ami tA avazyai karava|
Ami saMrakSita phalakera (lAohe mAh‌phUyera) para AsamAni kitAveo likhe diYechi ye, jaminera uttarAdhikArI have AmAra yogya (athavA satkarmaparAYaNa) vAndArA|
nizcaYai ete (ei koraAne) dharmaprANa lokadera janya ekaTi vANI raYeche|
tomAke Ami sArA vizvavAsIra janya rahamatarUpei pAThiYechi|
vala, “AmAra kAche to ei marmei ohI Ase ye, tomAdera upAsyai ekamAtra upAsya| ataeva, tomarA ki (tA~ra kAche) AtmasamarpaNa karave?”

tave tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale valave, “Ami tomAderake yathArthabhAve (AmAra vaktavya) jAniYe diYechi| Ara tomAderake ye (zAstira) oYAdA deoYA hacche tA ki kAche nA dUre, AmAra tA jAnA nei|”
tini (AllAha) prakAzya kathA to nizcaYai jAnena, tomarA yA gopana karo tini tAo jAnena|
Ami jAninA, haYato eTA (ei vilamva) tomAdera janya ekaTi parIkSA o kichukAlera janya bhogera suyoga hate pAre|
se (muhAmmAda) valechila, “prabhu! tumi nyAyya vicAra kara| AmAdera prabhu parama karuNAmaYa evaM (he avizvAsIrA!) tomarA yA kichu valacha se vyApAre AmarA tA~rai sAhAyya cAi|”
he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera prabhuke bhaYa kara| nizcaYai keYAmatera kampana eka bhaYAnaka vyApAra|

yedina tomarA tA (keYAmata) dekhave sedina pratyeka stanyadAtrI tAra dudhera zizura kathA bhule yAve evaM pratyeka garbhavatI tAra garbha phele deve; Ara mAnuSake tumi nezAgrastera mata dekhate pAve, yadio tArA nezAgrasta thAkave nA| vastuta AllAhara AjAva var3a kaThina|
mAnuSera madhye emana mAnuSao Ache ye AllAha samparke nA jene tarka kare evaM pratyeka avAdhya zaYatAnera anusaraNa kare|
zaYatAna samvandhe likhe deoYA haYeche ye, ye tAke vandhurUpe grahaNa karave tAke se pathabhraSTa karave o doyakhera AyAvera dike niYe yAve|

he mAnuSa! punarutthAna samvandhe tomAdera yadi kona sandeha thAke tAhale (bheve dekha,) Amii to tomAderake (prathama mAnuSa Adamake) mATi theke, tArapara (anyAnyaderake) vIrya theke, tArapara jamATa raktapiNDa theke, tArapara sugaThita o sugaThita naYa emana mAMsakhaNDa theke sRSTi karechi; tomAdera kAche (AmAra kSamatA) prakAza karAra janya| Ami yA (sRSTi karate) cAi tA ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta mAtRgarbhe rekhe dei; tArapara tomAderake zizu avasthAYa vera kare Ani; pare yAte tomarA pUrNa zaktira vaYase upanIta hao| tomAdera madhye kataka (alpa vaYase) mArA yAYa, AvAra tomAdera madhye katakake nikRSTatama vaYase (jarAjIrNa vArdhakye) upanIta karA haYa, yAte tArA jAnAra pare AvAra kichui nA jAne (savakichu bhule yAYa)| Ara tumi jaminake dekhate pAo mRta, tArapara Ami yakhana tAte pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa kari takhana tA nar3e (jIvita haYe) oThe, ver3e oThe Ara savarakama sundara udbhida ud‌gata kare|
esava ejanya ye, AllAha satya, tini mRtake jIvita karena, tini savakichu karAra kSamatA rAkhena,
keYAmata avazyai Asave yAte kona sandeha nei evaM yArA kavare Ache AllAha tAderake punarAYa uThAvena|
mAnuSera madhye emana mAnuSao Ache yAra kAche kona jJAna, pathanirdeza kiMvA dika-nirdezanA pradAnakArI kitAva nA thAkA sattveo se AllAhara vyApAre vitarka kare;
(ahaMkAre) nijera kA~dha vA~kA kare, AllAhara patha theke (mAnuSake) vipathe neoYAra uddezye| tAra janya e duniYAYa raYeche lAJchanA| Ara keYAmatera dina Ami tAke Agune por3Ara zAsti AsvAdana karAva|
eTA tomAra nijera kRtakarmera janyai; kAraNa, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati juluma karena nA|

mAnuSera madhye emana mAnuSao Ache, ye eka prAnte (sandehera madhye) theke AllAhara ivAdata kare| yadi tAra bhAla kichu haYa tAhale se tAte santuSTa thAke| Ara yadi tAra opara kona parIkSA ese par3e tAhale se nijera mukhera opara (Agera kupharira avasthAYa) phire yAYa| se duniYA o AkherAta duToi hArAYa| eTAi hala prakAzya kSati|
se AllAhake chAr3A emana kichuke DAke yA tAra kona kSati karate pAre nA evaM yA tAra kona upakArao karate pAre nA| eTAi hala sudUra (carama) vibhrAnti|
se emana kichuke DAke yAra kSati tAra upakArera ceYe nikaTatara (Age pau~che)| kata khArApa ei vandhu, kata khArApa ei saGgI!
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare nizcaYai AllAha tAderake jAnnAte sthAna devena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| nizcaYai AllAha yA cAna tAi karena|

ye mane kare ye, AllAha tAke (rasUlake) duniYA o AkherAte sAhAyya karavena nA, se yena AkAzera dike ekaTi razi prasArita kare (gharera chAdera sAthe ekaTi razi jhuliYe galAYa phA~sa diYe nijera zvAsarodha kare), tArapara tA keTe deYa evaM dekhe, tAra ei kauzala tAra krodha dUra kare kinA|
ebhAvei Ami spaSTa nidarzanarUpe ei koraAna nAyila karechi, Ara nizcaYai AllAha yAke cAna satpatha dekhAna|
ImAnadAra (musalamAna), ihudi, sAviYI, khriSTAna, agnipUjaka o muzarikadera madhye nizcaYai AllAha keYAmatera dina phaYasAlA karavena| AllAha savakichurai sAkSI|

tumi ki dekhani ye, yArA AsamAne Ache tArA o yArA jamine Ache tArA evaM sUrya, candra, tArakArAji, pAhAr3a-parvata, gAchapAlA, jIvajantu o aneka mAnuSa AllAhake sejadA kare? AvAra anekei Ache, yAdera opara zAsti dhArya haYe Ache| Ara AllAha yAke lAJchita karena tAke sammAnita karAra keu nei| nizcaYai AllAha yA cAna tAi karena|sejadA

erA (vizvAsI Ara avizvAsIrA) dui pratipakSa| tArA tAdera prabhu samvandhe paraspara vitarka kare| ataeva, avizvAsIdera janya Agunera pozAka tairI karA haYeche| tAdera mAthAra opara theke phuTanta pAni Dhele deoYA have|
era dvArA tAdera peTera vastu o cAmar3A galiYe deoYA have|
Ara tAdera (zAsti deoYAra) janya thAkave (vA~kA kare tairI) lohAra A~kar3A|
yakhanai tArA kaSTa theke vA~cAra janya jAhAnnAma theke vera hate cAive takhanai tAderake sekhAne pherata pAThAno have| Ara valA have, “agnidahanera yantraNA AsvAdana kara|”

yArA ImAna Ane o satkarma kare nizcaYai AllAha tAderake jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita have| sekhAne tAderake sonAra kA~kana o muktAra alaMkAra parAno have| Ara sekhAne tAdera pozAka have rezamera|
(duniYAYa) tArA uttama kathAra prati dika-nirdezanA peYechila evaM parama prazaMsita AllAhara pathe paricAlita haYechila|

yArA kuphari kare evaM AllAhara pathe calate o (makkAra) sei pavitra masajide praveza karate (mAnuSake) vAdhA deYa yAke Ami sekhAnakAra sthAYI vAsindA o (Agantuka) maruvAsI (nirvizeSe) sava mAnuSera janya samAna karechi (tAderake Ami kaThora zAsti deva); Ara ye sekhAne dharmadrohitA o anyAYa kAja karate cAYa Ami tAke yantraNAdAYaka zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami ivarAhImake (kAvA) gharera jAYagA cihnita kare diYechilAma (Ara valechilAma,) “kona kichuke AmAra zarIka karave nA; Ara yArA taoYApha kare, yArA nAmAye dA~r3AYa evaM yArA ruku-sejadA kare tAdera janya AmAra ghara pavitra rAkhave|”
Ara mAnuSera madhye hajjera ghoSaNA pracAra karo; tArA tomAra kAche Asave pAYe he~Te o pratiTi ArohaNera pazute car3e, yArA gabhIra giripatha dhare (dUra-dUrAnta theke) cale Asave;
(yula-hijjAha mAsera 10, 11 o 12 tArikhe) AllAhara deoYA catuSpada jantusamUha (koravAnira janya) javAikAle tA~ra nAma smaraNa kare| tomarA segulora mAMsa (nijerA) khAo evaM garIva-duHkhIke khAoYAo|
tArapara tArA yena tAdera maYalA (nakha, cula ityAdi) apasAraNa sampanna kare, mAnata pUraNa kare evaM prAcIna ghara (kAvA) pradakSiNa kare|

eTAi (karaNIYa)| Ara ye vyakti AllAhara pavitra vidhAnasamUhera sammAna karave, tAra prabhura nikaTa seTA tAra janya uttama| Ara tomAdera kAche yegulo pATha karA have (vyatikrama hiseve ullekha karA have) segulo chAr3A (sava) catuSpada jantu tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche| ataeva, tomarA mUrtipUjAra paGkilatA varjana karo evaM mithyA kathA parihAra karo;

AllAhara prati ekaniSTha haYe, tA~ra sAthe zarIka nA kare| Ara ye AllAhara sAthe zarIka kare (tAra avasthA emana ye,) se yena AkAza theke par3ala, Ara pAkhirA tAke cho~ mere niYe gela kiMvA vAtAsa tAke kona dUravartI sthAne nikSepa karala|
eTAi (karaNIYa)| Ara yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera sammAna karave, niHsandehe seTA have (tAdera) antarera tAkaoYAra paricAYaka|

catuSpada jantudera madhye tomAdera janya nirdiSTa kAla paryanta kichu upakAritA Ache| ataHpara tAdera koravAnira sthAna prAcIna gharera nikaTe| (pazuderake ekaTA samaYa paryanta kAje lAgAnora para hajjera samaYa tAderake kAvAgharera nikaTavartI minAsaha hArAmera sImAnAYa niYe koravAni karA haYa|)

Ara pratyeka jAtira janya Ami ekaTi ivAdata-paddhati (athavA koravAnira vidhAna) Thika kare diYechi; yena AllAha tAderake yesava catuSpada jantu dAna karechena tAdera opara (tAderake javAikAle) tArA AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare; kenanA tomAdera upAsyai to ekamAtra upAsya, ataeva, tomarA tA~ra kAche AtmasamarpaNa karo evaM tumi vinaYIderake susaMvAda dAo;
yAdera antarasamUha AllAhara kathA zunale bhIta haYa, yArA vipada ele dhairyadhAraNa kare, nAmAya kAYema kare evaM tAderake yA kichu dAna karechi tA theke vyaYa kare|

koravAnira pazuke tomAdera janya AllAhara anyatama nidarzana karechi| era madhye tomAdera janya maGgala Ache| ataeva, sArivaddha thAkA avasthAYa tomarA tAdera opara (tAderake javAi karAra samaYa) AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kara| tArA yakhana (javAiYera para) kAta haYe par3e yAYa takhana tomarA tAdera mAMsa nijerA khAo evaM parituSTake o minatira sAthe yAcJAkArIke khete dAo| ebhAvei tAderake tomAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechi, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

tAdera mAMsa kiMvA rakta (kichui) AllAhara kAche pau~chAve nA, varaM tA~ra kAche pau~chAve tomAdera tAkaoYA| ebhAvei tini tAderake tomAdera vazIbhUta karechena, yAte tomarA AllAhara gaurava varNanA karo, yehetu tini tomAderake saThika patha dekhiYechena| Ara satkarmazIladera susaMvAda dAo|
AllAha muminaderake rakSA karena| AllAha kona vizvAsaghAtaka akRtajJake pachanda karena nA|

yAdera sAthe yuddha karA hacche tAderake (AkramaNakArIra viruddhe yuddha karAra) anumati deoYA hala; e kAraNe ye, tAdera prati juluma karA haYeche| Ara AllAha tAderake (majaluma muminaderake) sAhAyya karate avazyai sakSama;

yAderake kevala “AmAdera prabhu AllAha” valAra kAraNe tAdera ghar3avAr3i theke anyAYabhAve vera kare deoYA haYeche| Ara AllAha yadi ekadala mAnuSake Arekadala mAnuSa dvArA pratihata nA karatena tAhale (sannyAsIdera) Azrama, (khriSTAnadera) gIrjA, (ihudidera) upAsanAlaYa o (musalamAnadera) masajidasamUha— yekhAne AllAhara nAma adhika parimANe smaraNa karA haYa— avazyai vi&sta haYe yeta| AllAha nizcaYai tAderake sAhAyya karavena yArA tA~ke sAhAyya kare| AllAha to avazyai zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

tArA (AllAhara sAhAyyaprAptarA) emana loka ye, Ami yadi tAderake pRthivIte kSamatA dei tAhale tArA nAmAya kAYema karave, yAkAta deve, bhAla kAjera Adeza deve o khArApa kAja karate niSedha karave| AllAhara hAtei savakichura pariNati|
tArA yadi tomAke mithyAvAdI vale tave (avAka havAra kichu nei, kAraNa) tAdera pUrveo (nijedera navIke) mithyAvAdI valechila nUhera samapradAYa, Ada o chAmUda jAti,
ivarAhImera samapradAYa, lUtera samapradAYa

o mAd‌iYAnera adhivAsIrA| Ara mUsAkeo mithyAvAdI valA haYechila| tave Ami kApheraderake (kichukAlera janya) avakAza diYechilAma, tArapara tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma| ataeva, (bheve dekha) AmAke asvIkAra karAra zAstiTA kemana chila!
ebhAve aneka jAlema janapada Ami dhvaMsa kare diYechi| segulo dhvaMsastUpe pariNata haYeche; aneka kUpa akejo kare diYechi evaM aneka sudRr3ha prAsAda dhvaMsa kare diYechi|

tArA ki jamine bhramaNa kareni? karale tAdera antaragulo emana hata yA diYe tArA vujhate pArata; athavA kAnagulo emana hata yA diYe tArA zunate peta| kenanA, cokha to (Asale) andha haYa nA, varaM vukera bhitarera antarai (prakRta) andha haYe thAke|
avizvAsIrA tomAke zAsti druta Anate vale, tave AllAha tA~ra oYAdAra viparIta karavena nA| Ara tomAra prabhura kAche ekaTi dina (samaYera vyAptite) tomAdera gaNanAra hAjAra vacharera mata|
aneka jAlema janapadake Ami (kichukAlera janya) avakAza diYechi; tArapara tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi| Ara (sakalera cUr3Anta) pratyAvartana to AmAra kAchei|
vala, “he mAnuSa! Asale Ami tomAdera janya ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|”
ataeva, yArA (satyake) vizvAsa kare evaM satkAja kare tAdera janya raYeche mArjanA Ara sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha vyartha karAra ceSTA kare, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI (have)|

tomAra pUrve Ami yata rasUla o navI pAThiYechi tAdera keu yakhanai kichu pratyAzA kareche, takhanai zaYatAna tAra pratyAzAYa kichu (mithyA) mizrita kareche| tave zaYatAna yA mizrita kare AllAha tA vilupta karena, tArapara AllAha tA~ra vANIsamUha sudRr3ha karena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

(navIdera pratyAzAYa zaYatAnera mithyAmizraNa evaM AllAha kartRka tA viluptakaraNa) e janya ye, zaYatAna yA mizrita kare tini tA sei lokadera janya parIkSAra vastu vAnAvena yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache evaM yArA kaThorahRdaYa| Ara jAlemarA to dustara (carama) virodhera madhye raYeche|

evaM (tA) e janyao ye, yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche tArA jAnave ye, ei koraAna tomAra prabhura pakSa theke Agata satya evaM tArA tA vizvAsa karave o tAdera antara tAra prati avanata have| Ara AllAha avazyai muminadera saThika patha pradarzanakArI|

Ara kApherarA tAra (koraAnera) vyApAre sandeha poSaNa karate thAkave, yatakSaNa nA tAdera kAche AkasmikabhAve keYAmata upasthita haYa athavA tAdera opara eka vandhyA (tAdera janya kalyANavihIna) dinera (keYAmatera) zAsti ese par3e|
sedina kartRtva (thAkave) AllAharai| tinii tAdera vicAra karavena| ataHpara yArA ImAna eneche o satkarma kareche tAdera sthAna have neYAmatapUrNa jAnnAte|
Ara yArA kuphari kareche o AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA valeche tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|
yArA AllAhara pathe hijarata (dezatyAga) kareche, tArapara nihata haYeche kiMvA mArA giYeche, AllAha avazyai tAderake uttama riyika (vinimaYa) dAna karavena| nizcaYai AllAha sarvottama riyikadAtA|
tini tAderake emana eka jAYagAYa (jAnnAte) sthAna devena yA tArA pachanda karave| Ara AllAha to avazyai suvijJa, sahanazIla|

tAi have| Ara niryAtita haYe keu yadi anurUpa pAlTA niryAtana kare, ataHpara tAra opara AvAra vAr3AvAr3i karA haYa, tAhale AllAha tAke nizcaYai sAhAyya karavena| AllAha to avazyai mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|
tA ejanya ye, AllAha rAtake dinera madhye evaM dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAna| Ara AllAha to savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|
tA ejanyao ye, AllAhai satya evaM AllAhake chAr3A tArA yAke DAke tA mithyA| Ara AllAha to sarvocca sattA, mahAmahima|
