tumi ki dekhani ye, AllAha AsamAna theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karena, Ara tAi jamina savuja-zyAmala haYe oThe? nizcaYai AllAha atizaYa daYAlu, mahAvijJa|
AsamAna-jamine yA kichu Ache, sava tA~rai| Ara niHsandehe AllAhai to amukhApekSI, sakala prazaMsAra adhikArI|

tumi ki dekhani ye, AllAha pRthivIra savakichuke evaM (vizeSa kare) tA~ra hukume samudre calamAna nauyAnaguloke tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena? Ara tini AsamAnake (tAra jAYagAYa) dhare rekhechena, yAte tA tA~ra nirdeza chAr3A pRthivIra opara par3e nA yAYa| nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati snehazIla, daYAlu|
tinii tomAderake jIvana diYechena; ataHpara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, tArapara AvAra tomAderake jIvita karavena| Asale mAnuSa var3ai akRtajJa|

pratyeka jAtira janya Ami ekaTi ivAdata-paddhati (athavA koravAnira vidhAna) Thika kare diYechi, yA tArA anusaraNa karave| ataeva, tArA yena e vyApAre tomAra sAthe vitarka nA kare| tumi (tAderake) tomAra prabhura dike DAka| nizcaYai tumi saThika pathei Acha|
Ara tArA yadi tomAra sAthe vitarka karei, tAhale valave, “tomarA yA karacha AllAha tA bhAla kare jAnena|”
tomarA yA niYe matabheda karate se vyApAre keYAmatera dina AllAha tomAdera madhye mImAMsA kare devena|
tumi ki jAna nA ye, AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache AllAha tA jAnena| tA to ekaTi kitAve (lAohe mAh‌phUye) likhita Ache| nizcaYai eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|
AllAhara parivarte tArA emana kichura upAsanA kare yAra samvandhe AllAha kona pramANa pAThAnani; se samvandhe tAdera kona jJAnao nei| ei jAlemadera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

yakhana tAdera sAmane AmAra spaSTa AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana kApheradera cehArAYa tumi asvIkRtira chApa dekhate pAve| yArA tAdera sAmane AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha kare, tAderake tArA AkramaNa karate udyata haYa| vala, “tAhale ki Ami tomAderake era ceYe khArApa kichura saMvAda deva? (tA hala jAhAnnAmera) Aguna; AllAha kApheraderake era oYAdA diYechena| (tA) var3a khArApa gantavya!”

he mAnuSa! ekaTi upamA deoYA hacche, manoyoga diYe zona: AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAderake DAka tArA savAi ekatrita haYeo ekaTi mAchi sRSTi karate pArave nA| Ara mAchi yadi tAdera kAcha theke kichu chiniYe neYa, tArA tA tAra kAcha theke uddhAra karateo pArave nA| prArthI o prArthita (bhaNDa upAsanAkArI o upAsya) ubhaYai durvala|
tArA AllAhara yathAyogya maryAdA upalavdhi kareni| nizcaYai AllAha mahAzaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|
AllAha pherezatAdera madhya theke dUta manonIta karena; mAnuSera madhya thekeo| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|
tAdera sAmane yA Ache evaM tAdera pechane yA Ache tini tA jAnena| Ara AllAhara kAchei sakala viSaYa phiriYe neoYA have|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA ruku o sejadA karo (nAmAya par3a), tomAdera prabhura ivAdata karo evaM (anyAnya) satkarma karo; yAte saphalakAma hate pAra|

Ara AllAhara pathe yathArthabhAve saMgrAma kara| tini tomAderake manonIta karechena, tave dvInera vyApAre tomAdera opara kona kaSTa cApiYe denani| tomAdera pitA (pUrvapuruSa) ivarAhImera dharme kAYema thAka| tini (AllAha) tomAderake musalima nAma diYechena, era Ageo evaM ei koraAneo; yAte rasUla tomAdera sAkSI haYa evaM tomarA mAnuSera sAkSI hao| ataeva, tomarA nAmAya susampanna karo, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAhake zaktabhAve dhara (AllAhara prati avicala AsthA rAkha)| tinii tomAdera abhibhAvaka| kata uttama avibhAvaka evaM kata uttama pRSThapoSaka (tini)!
Asale muminarAi saphala;
yArA tAdera nAmAye ekaniSTha;
yArA phAlatu kathA o kAja theke virata;
yArA yAkAta dAna kare;
evaM yArA tAdera guptAGga saMyata rAkhe,
tave tAdera strI o mAlikAnAdhIna dAsIdera kSetre saMyata nA rAkhale kona doSa have nA|
kintu era vAire (anyadera) kAmanA karale tArA sImAlaMghanakArI have|
Ara (mumina tArA) yArA tAdera AmAnata o oYAdA rakSA kare;
evaM yArA tAdera nAmAyera vyApAre ya.vAna thAke|
erAi hala (prakRta) uttarAdhikArI;
yArA vehezatera uttarAdhikArI have, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|
mAnuSake to Ami mATira niryAsa theke sRSTi karechi|
tArapara tAke eka nirApada AdhAre (nArIra garbhe) zukravindurUpe sthApana karechi|

tArapara zukravinduke jamATavaddha rakte evaM jamATavaddha raktake mAMsapiNDe pariNata karechi| tArapara mAMsapiNDa theke hAr3a sRSTi karechi evaM hAr3aguloke AvAra mAMsa dvArA AcchAdita karechi| avazeSe tAke anya eka sRSTirUpe tairI karechi| ataeva, sarvottama sRSTikartA AllAha kata mahAna!
tArapara avazyai tomarA mArA yAve|
ataHpara keYAmatera dina AvAra tomAderake uThAno have|
Ami tomAdera opare sAta stara AsamAna sRSTi karechi| Ara Ami to sRSTi samvandhe amanoyogI nai|
Ami AsamAna theke parimANamata pAni varSaNa karechi evaM tA jamine dhare rekhechi| AvAra Ami tA sariYe niteo avazyai sakSama|
ai pAni dvArA Ami tomAdera janya khejura o AGgurera vAgAna tairI karechi| tAte tomAdera janya aneka phala raYeche evaM tA theke tomarA AhAra kare thAka|
Ara ekaTi gAcha (jalapAi gAcha) sRSTi karechi yA sinAi parvate janmAYa evaM AhArakArIdera janya (bhojya) tela o sugandha masalA utpanna kare|

gavAdipazura madhyeo tomAdera janya zikSaNIYa viSaYa Ache| tAdera peTera madhye yA Ache tA theke tomAderake (dudha) pAna karAi| tAdera madhye tomAdera janya aneka upakAritA Ache| tomarA tAdera mAMsa khAo|
tAdera piThe o nauyAne tomAderake vahana karA haYa|
Ami nUhake tAra samapradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera Ara kona upAsya nei| tavuo ki tomarA bhaYa karave nA?”

takhana tAra samapradAYera kAphera netArA valala, “e lokaTA to tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa vai naYa| se tomAdera opara zreSThatva lAbha karate cAYa| AllAha cAile to pherezatAi pAThAte pAratena| AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera mAjhe erakama zunini|”
“e to emanai eka loka yAra madhye pAgalAmi raYeche| ataeva, tomarA tAra vyApAre kichukAla apekSA kara|”
nUha valechila, “he prabhu! AmAke sAhAyya karo, kAraNa erA AmAke avizvAsa karache|”

takhana Ami tAra kAche Adeza pAThAlAma ye, tumi AmAra dRSTira sAmane o AmAra Adeza motAveka naukA tairI kara| tArapara yakhana AmAra Adeza Asave evaM culo uthale uThave (culora talA bheda kare pAni veriYe Asave) takhana pratyeka jIvera eka eka jor3A evaM tomAra parivAra-parijanake se naukAYa tule neve; tave tAdera madhya theke yAdera viruddhe pUrve siddhAnta haYe Ache tAderake naYa| Ara yArA anyAYa kareche tAdera vyApAre AmAke kichu valo nA| tArA avazyai nimajjita have|
tumi o tomAra saGgIrA yakhana naukAYa ArohaNa karave takhana valo, “sakala prazaMsA sei mahAna AllAhara yini AmAderake jAlema lokadera kavala theke rakSA karechena|”
Aro valo, “he AmAra prabhu! (naukA theke) AmAke bhAlabhAve nAmAra vyavasthA kare dio, kAraNa tumii savaceYe bhAlabhAve nAmAte pAra|”
era madhye avazyai nidarzana Ache| Ara (e ghaTanA dvArA) Ami avazyai (mAnuSake) parIkSA karechi|
ataHpara tAdera pare Ami Areka prajanmake (Ada jAtike) sRSTi karechilAma|
Ara tAdera madhye tAderai ekajanake (hUdake) rasUla kare pAThiYechilAma; ei vANI niYe ye, “tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara| tini chAr3A tomAdera Ara kona upAsya nei| tavuo ki tomarA bhaYa karave nA?”

tAra samapradAYera netArA yArA kAphera chila o parakAlera sAkSAtke avizvAsa karata evaM yAderake Ami pArthiva jIvane sukha-svAcchandya dAna karechilAma tArA valala, “e lokaTA to tomAdera mata ekajana mAnuSa vai naYa| se to tomarA yA khAo tAi khAYa evaM tomarA yA pAna karo tAi pAna kare|”
“Ara tomarA yadi tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSera Anugatya karo tAhale to avazyai kSatigrasta have|
se ki tomAdera kAche emana oYAdA kare ye, yakhana tomarA mare yAve evaM mATi o hAr3agor3a haYe yAve takhana AvAra tomAderake (jIvita) vera karA have?”
“tomAdera kAche ei ye oYAdA karA hacche tA to aneka dUrera kathA|
AmAdera ei pArthiva jIvana chAr3A Ara kichu nei| (ekhAnei) AmarA mari o vA~ci| (marAra para) AmAderake punarAYa uThAno have nA|”
“se emanai ekaTA loka ye AllAhara nAme mithyA vAniYe valeche| AmarA tAke vizvAsa karava nA|”
se (hUda) valala, “he prabhu! AmAke sAhAyya karo, kAraNa erA AmAke avizvAsa karache|”
AllAha valalena, “alpadinera madhyei tArA avazyai anutapta have|”
tArapara vikaTa AoYAja Thikai tAderake ghAYela karechila evaM Ami tAderake AvarjanAYa pariNata karechilAma| ataeva, akalyANa raYeche jAlema samapradAYera janya|
ataHpara tAdera pare Ami Aro (aneka) prajanma sRSTi karechilAma|
kona jAti tAra nirdhArita samaYake egiYe Anate pAre nA, kiMvA tA vilamvitao karate pAre nA|

ataHpara Ami ekera para eka AmAra rasUladera pAThiYechi| yakhanai kona jAtira kAche tAra rasUla eseche takhanai tArA tAke avizvAsa kareche| Amio tAderake ekera para eka dhvaMsa karechi evaM tAderake itihAse pariNata karechi| ataeva, akalyANa raYeche avizvAsI lokadera janya|
ataHpara Ami mUsA o tAra bhAi hArUnake pAThiYechi, AmAra nidarzana o spaSTa pramANasaha;
pherAuna o tAra sabhASadadera kAche| kintu tArA nijederake var3a mane karala| Ara tArA chila eka uddhata janagoSThI|
tArA valala, “AmarA ki AmAdera matai duTi lokera kathAYa vizvAsa karava, athaca tAdera lokerA AmAderai dAsatva kare thAke?”
ebhAvei tArA tAderake avizvAsa karala evaM dhvaMsaprApta hala|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, yAte tArA hedAYeta pAYa|
Ara mariYamera putra o tAra mAke ekaTi nidarzana vAniYechilAma evaM tAderake avasthAnayogya o jharanAviziSTa eka uccabhUmite AzraYa diYechilAma|
he rasUlagaNa! tomarA hAlAla khAdyasAmagrI theke AhAra karo evaM satkAja kara| tomarA yA karo avazyai Ami tA bhAlabhAve avagata Achi|
Ara eTAi tomAdera dharma, ekai dharma; Ara Ami tomAdera prabhu; ataeva, AmAke bhaYa kara|
kintu mAnuSerA tAdera dharmake nijedera madhye vahubhAge vibhakta kareche| pratyeka dalai nijera vizvAsa niYe Anande Ache|
ataeva, tAderake kichukAlera janya tAdera ajJatAra madhye thAkate dAo|
tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami ye dhana-sampada o santAna-santati dvArA tAderake sAhAyya karachi,
tAte druta tAdera kalyANa sAdhana karachi? (Asale tA naYa) varaM tArA vujhate pArache nA (ye, eTA tAdera janya ekaTA parIkSA)|
yArA tAdera prabhura bhaYe bhIta thAke,
yArA tAdera prabhura nidarzanasamUha vizvAsa kare,
yArA tAdera prabhura sAthe zarIka kare nA
evaM yArA kona kichu dAna karAra samaYe tArA ye tAdera prabhura kAche phire yAve ei vizvAse antare bhaYa poSaNa kare
tArAi kalyANakara kAje dhAvita haYa evaM tArAi tAte agragAmI thAke|
Ami kAuke tAra sAdhyera atIta kAja cApiYe dei nA; AmAra kAche ekaTi rekarDa raYeche yA (sarvadA) satya vale; Ara tAdera prati kona juluma karA have nA|
varaM era (koraAnera) vyApAre tAdera antarasamUha ajJAnatAYa Acchanna| tAchAr3A tAdera Aro kichu (khArApa) kAja Ache yA tArA kare thAke|
eka paryAYe yakhana Ami tAdera madhye vilAsajIvana yApanakArIderake AjAva dvArA pAkar3Ao kari takhana tArA citkAra zuru kare|
Aja citkAra karo nA; tomarA AmAra sAhAyya pAve nA|
tomAdera sAmane AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA hata, kintu tomarA ulTo dike haTe Asate (tA mAnate asvIkAra karate);
ahaMkArI haYe, tAra samparke (koraAna samparke) rAtera ADDAYa AjevAje kathA vale|
tAhale ki tArA AllAhara kathA (avatIrNa vANI) bheve dekheni, nAki tAdera kAche emana kichu eseche yA tAdera pUrvapuruSadera kAche Aseni?
nAki tArA tAdera rasUlake cinate pAreni, tAi tArA tAke asvIkAra karache?
nAki tArA vale ye, tAra madhye pAgalAmi Ache| Asala kathA hala, se tAdera kAche satya niYe eseche evaM tAdera adhikAMzai satyake apachanda kare|

Ara satya yadi tAdera icchAra anugAmI hata tAhale AsamAna-jamina o tAra mAjhera savakichu naSTa haYe yeta| varaM Ami tAderake upadezera vastu dAna karechi, kintu tArA tAdera se upadezera vastu theke mukha phiriYe nicche|
nAki tumi tAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAo? vastuta tomAra prabhura pratidAnai zreSTha evaM tinii zreSTha riyikadAtA|
Ara tumi to tAderake saThika pathera dikei DAkacha|
yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA tArA to (saThika) patha theke vicyuta|
Ami yadi tAdera prati daYAo kari evaM tAdera sava kaSTa lAghavao kari tavuo tArA pathahArA avasthAYa nijedera avAdhyatAYa aTala thAkave|
Ami tAderake AjAva dvArA pAkar3Ao karechilAma| kintu tArA tAdera prabhura kAche natisvIkAra kareni evaM minatio kareni|
yAra phale Ami yakhana tAdera janya kaThora zAstira darajA khule deva takhana tAte tArA hatabhamva haYe yAve|
tinii tomAdera janya kAna, cokha o antara sRSTi karechena| (kintu ejanya) tomarA khuva kamai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
tinii tomAderake pRthivIte char3iYe diYechena evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAderake ekatrita karA have|
tinii jIvana dena o mRtyu ghaTAna| rAtadinera parivartana tA~rai ekhatiYAre| tavuo ki tomarA vujhave nA?
varaM tArA temanai vale yemana pUrvavartI lokerA valechila|
tArA vale, “marAra para AmarA yakhana mATi o hAr3agor3a haYe yAva takhana ki AmAderake AvAra uThAno have?”
“AmAderake to ei oYAdA karA haYeche evaM (AmAdera) pUrve AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderakeo| eTA to pUrvavartIdera kAhini chAr3A kichui naYa|”
vala, “ei pRthivI evaM ete yArA Ache tArA kAra? yadi tomarA jAna (tAhale vala)|”
tArA valave, “(savai) AllAhara”| vala, “tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karave nA?”
vala, “ke sAta AsamAnera mAlika evaM ke mahAna Arazera mAlika?”
tArA valave, “(savai) AllAhara”| vala, “tavuo ki tomarA (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?”
vala, “ke sei sattA yAra hAte savakichura kartRtva, Ara yini (savAike) AzraYa dena evaM yAra opara diYe kAuke AzraYa deoYA yAYa nA? yadi tomAdera jAnA thAke (tAhale vala)|”
tArA valave, “(savai) AllAhara”| vala, “tAhale tomarA kemana kare yAdugrasta (mohagrasta) haccha?”
Asale Ami tAderake satya ene diYechilAma, kintu tArA nitAntai mithyAvAdI|

AllAha kona santAna grahaNa karenani| tA~ra sAthe (anya) kona upAsyao nei| thAkale pratyeka upAsya tAra sRSTi niYe AlAdA haYe yeta evaM ekajana Arekajanera opare sthAna kare nita| tArA yA valache AllAha tA theke pavitra|
tini adRzya o dRzyamAna vastura (savakichura) jJAna rAkhena| ataeva, tArA (tA~ra sAthe) yA kichu zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve (tA theke pavitra)|
vala, “he AmAra prabhu! tAderake yAra oYAdA deoYA hacche yadi AmAke tA (sei zAsti) dekhAte!
he prabhu! tave AmAke jAlemadera antarbhukta karo nA|”
tAderake yAra oYAdA dicchi Ami tA avazyai tomAke dekhAte sakSama|
yA bhAla tA diYe khArApera pratikAra kara| tArA yA vale Ami tA bhAla kare jAni|
Ara vala, “he AmAra prabhu! zaYatAnadera kumantraNA theke Ami tomAra AzraYa cAi|
he prabhu! AmAra kAche tAdera upasthiti thekeo Ami tomAra AzraYa cAi|”
avazeSe yakhana tAdera kAro mRtyu upasthita haYa takhana se vale, “prabhu! AmAke (duniYAYa) pherat pAThAo,

yAte Ami yA rekhe esechi sekhAne (duniYAra jIvane) bhAla kAja karate pAri|” kichutei tA havAra naYa, eTA to ekaTA kathA yA se valavei| (mRtyura para theke) yedina tAderake punarAYa uThAno have sedina (keYAmatera dina) paryanta tAdera pechane ekaTi prativandhaka thAkave|
tArapara yakhana ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have sedina tAdera madhye vaMza-samparka thAkave nA evaM tArA eke aparake kichu jijJAsAo karave nA|
takhana yAdera (puNyera) pAllA bhArI have tArAi saphalakAma have|
Ara yAdera (puNyera) pAllA hAlakA have tArAi nijedera kSati kareche; tArA jAhAnnAme cirakAla thAkave|
Aguna tAdera mukhamaNDala pur3e phelave evaM sekhAne tAdera cehArA vIbhatsa have|
(AllAha tAderake valavena,) “tomAdera sAmane ki AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA hata nA? takhana to tomarA segulo avizvAsa karate|”
(uttare) tArA valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera durbhAgya AmAderake parAbhUta karechila evaM AmarA chilAma eka vibhrAnta janagoSThI|”
“he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake jAhAnnAma theke vera kara| ataHpara AmarA yadi punarAYa pApera kAja kari tAhale avazyai AmarA jAlema vale gaNya hava|”
AllAha valavena, “tomarA ekhAnei lAJchita avasthAYa thAka evaM AmAra sAthe kona kathA valo nA|”
AmAra vAndAdera madhye ekadala valata, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA ImAna enechi; ataeva, tumi AmAderake kSamA o daYA kara| tumi to zreSTha daYAkArI|”

kintu tomarA tAderake (muminaderake) ThATTAra pAtra vAniYechile| emanaki tArA tomAderake AmAra smaraNa bhuliYe diYechila (tAderake ThATTA karAra samaYa AmAra kathA tomAdera mane thAkata nA)| Ara tomarA tAderake niYe hAsAhAsi karate|
Aja Ami tAderake tAdera dhairyera emana pratidAna diYechi ye, tArAi (Aja) saphalakAma|
AllAha valavena, “pRthivIte tomarA kata vachara avasthAna karechile?”
tArA valave, “AmarA avasthAna karechilAma ekadina athavA ekadinera kichu aMza| tumi gaNanAkArIderake jijJesa kare dekha|”
tini valavena, “tomarA (sekhAne) alpakAlai avasthAna karechile, yadi tA jAnate!”
tomarA ki mane karechile ye, Ami tomAderake ayathA sRSTi karechi evaM tomAderake AmAra kAche phiriYe AnA have nA?
AllAha mahimAnvita, yini prakRta adhipati| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| tini mahAna Arazera (siMhAsanera) mAlika|
ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsyake DAke, ye vyApAre tAra kAche kona pramANa nei, tAra prabhura kAche avazyai tAra hisAva have| kApherarA kichutei saphala have nA|
Ara vala, “he prabhu! kSamA karo o daYA kara| tumii to zreSTha daYAkArI|”
(eTi koraAnera) ekaTi sUrA| eTi Ami avatIrNa o AvazyakIYa karechi| e sUrAYa aneka spaSTa AYAta avatIrNa karechi; yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

vyabhicAriNI Ara vyabhicArI, edera pratyekake tomarA ekaza kare cAvuka mArave| AllAhara (zAstira) vidhAna kAryakara karate tomarA yena tAdera prati daYAra vazavartI nA hao, yadi tomarA AllAha o parakAle vizvAsI haYe thAka| Ara muminadera ekaTi dala yena tAdera zAsti pratyakSa kare|
vyabhicArI kevala kona vyabhicAriNI athavA muzarika nArIkei viYe karave evaM vyabhicAriNIke kevala kona vyabhicArI athavA muzarika puruSai viYe karave| muminadera janya ederake niSiddha karA haYeche|
yArA satI nArIdera nAme apavAda deYa evaM (e vyApAre) cArajana sAkSI upasthita kare nA tAderake AziTi cAvuka mArave evaM kakhanao tAdera sAkSya grahaNa karave nA| orAi phAseka|
tave pare yArA taovA kare evaM satkarma kare, (tAdera kSetre) AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

Ara yArA nijedera strIdera nAme apavAda deYa evaM tArA nijerA chAr3A (e vyApAre) tAdera kona sAkSI thAke nA tAdera pratyekera sAkSya hala, AllAhara nAma niYe cAravAra sAkSya deve ye, se yA valache tA avazyai satya;
evaM paJcamavAre valave ye, se mithyA vale thAkale tAra opara AllAhara lAnata par3ave|
Ara strIra zAsti rahita have yadi se AllAhara nAma niYe cAravAra sAkSya deYa ye, tAra svAmI avazyai mithyA valeche;
evaM paJcamavAre valave ye, yadi svAmIra kathA satya haYa tAhale tAra nijera opara AllAhara gayava par3ave|
yadi tomAdera opara AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata (tAhale dekhate tomAdera kI avasthA hata)! Ara nizcaYai AllAha taovA kavulakArI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYai yArA (rasUlera strI AYezAra nAme) mithyA apavAda eneche tArA tomAderai ekaTi dala| viSaYaTike tomarA tomAdera janya khArApa mane karo nA; varaM eTi tomAdera janya maGgala| tAdera madhye ye yA pApa kareche tA tArai thAkave| Ara ai kAje tAdera madhye yAra var3a bhUmikA Ache tAra janya raYeche virATa zAsti|
yakhana tomarA eTA (apavAdera kathATA) zunale takhana ImAnadAra nArI-puruSerA kena nijedera lokadera samparke bhAla dhAraNA karala nA evaM valala nA ye, eTA ekaTA spaSTa mithyA?
tArA e vyApAre cArajana sAkSI upasthita kareni kena? yehetu tArA sAkSIdera upasthita kareni, tAi AllAhara kAche tArA mithyAvAdI|
duniYA o AkherAte yadi tomAdera opara AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata tAhale tomarA yA uccAraNa karecho (ye apavAdera kathA valecho) tAra janya tomAdera kaThina zAsti hata;

kenanA tomarA eTA tomAdera mukhe mukhe pracAra karachile Ara nijedera mukha diYe emana (jaghanya) kathA uccAraNa karachile ye samvandhe tomAdera kona jJAna chila nA| tomarA eTAke ekaTA tuccha viSaYa mane karechile; athaca AllAhara kAche eTA ekaTA gurutara vyApAra|
tomarA yakhana eTA zunale takhana valale nA kena ye, e viSaYe AmAdera kathA valAra adhikAra nei; (he AllAha!) tumi mahimAnvita! eTA ekaTA gurutara apavAda?
AllAha tomAderake upadeza dicchena yena tomarA punarAYa erakama kAja kakhano nA karo, yadi tomarA ImAnadAra hao|
Ara AllAha tomAdera janya nidarzanasamUha spaSTa kare dena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|
yArA cAYa, muminadera madhye azlIlatAra prasAra ghaTuka, tAdera janya duniYAYa o AkherAte yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche| AllAha (savakichu) jAnena, tomarA jAna nA|
yadi tomAdera opara AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata (tAhale dekhate tomAdera kI avasthA hata)! Ara nizcaYai AllAha snehaparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karo nA (kathAmato calo nA)| ye zaYatAnera padAGka anusaraNa karave tAke to zaYatAna azlIlatA o manda kAjera nirdeza devei| yadi tomAdera opara AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkata tAhale tomAdera keu kakhano pavitra thAkate pArata nA| tave AllAha yAke icchA karena pavitra rAkhena| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

tomAdera madhye maryAdA o prAcuryera adhikArIrA yena AtmIYaderake, niHsvaderake evaM AllAhara pathe hijaratakArIderake dAna nA karAra zapatha nA kare| tArA yena kSamA kare Ara (doSatruTi) upekSA kare| tomarA ki cAo nA ye, AllAha tomAderake kSamA karuna? AllAha to kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA satI amanoyogI (saralamanA) ImAnadAra nArIdera prati apavAda Aropa kare tArA e duniYAYa evaM parakAle abhizapta| tAdera janya kaThora zAsti raYeche|
yedina tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe tAdera jihavA, tAdera hAta o tAdera pA tAderai viruddhe sAkSya deve|
sedina AllAha tAdera yathArtha karmaphala puropuri devena evaM tArA jAnave ye, AllAhai satya evaM savakichu prakAzakArI|

khArApa nArIrA khArApa puruSadera janya evaM khArApa puruSerA khArApa nArIdera janya| temani bhAla nArIrA bhAla puruSadera janya evaM bhAla puruSerA bhAla nArIdera janya| lokerA yA vale (ye khArApa ukti kare) tA theke erA sampUrNa nirdoSa| edera janya raYeche kSamA Ara sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA paricita nA haYe evaM gRhavAsIderake sAlAma nA diYe nijedera ghara vyatIta anya ghare praveza karo nA| eTAi tomAdera janya uttama, yAte tomarA smaraNa rAkha|

ghare yadi kAuke nA pAo tAhale tAte praveza karave nA, yatakSaNa nA tomAderake (pravezera) anumati deoYA haYa| Ara yadi tomAderake valA haYa, “phire yAo” tAhale phire yAve| eTAi tomAdera janya nyAyyatara| tomarA yA karo AllAha tA bhAla jAnena|
ye sava ghare keu vAsa kare nA sekhAne tomAdera mAlAmAla thAkale tAte praveza karAYa tomAdera kona pApa nei| tomarA yA prakAza karo Ara yA gopana karo AllAha tA jAnena|
muminaderake valave, tArA yena tAdera dRSTi avanata rAkhe evaM tAdera guptAGgera hephAjata kare| eTAi tAdera pavitra thAkAra janya adhikatara sahAYaka| tArA yA kichu kare AllAha se samparke avahita|

mumina nArIderakeo valave, tArA yena tAdera dRSTi avanata rAkhe; tAdera guptAGgera hephAjata kare; (sAdhAraNata) yeTuku prakAzita haYa tA chAr3A tAdera saundarya prakAza nA kare; vukera opara or3anA diYe rAkhe evaM nijedera svAmI, vAvA, svAmIra vAvA (zvazura), chele, svAmIra chele, bhAi, bhAiYera chele, vonera chele, nijedera (musalima) mahilA, mAlikAnAdhIna dAsI, adhInastha yauna cAhidAmukta (vRddha) puruSa kiMvA nArIsaMsarge anAsakta zizudera vyatIta anyadera kAche nijedera saundarya prakAza nA kare| e chAr3Ao tArA yena nijedera Dheke-rAkhA sAja-sajjA prakAza haYe par3e emanabhAve nijedera pA nA phele (jore jore nA hA~Te)| he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA savAi AllAhara kAche taovA karo, yAte tomarA saphala hao|

tomAdera madhye yAdera svAmI vA strI nei tAdera viYera vyavasthA karo, tomAdera dAsa-dAsIdera madhye yArA sat o yogya tAderao| tArA yadi daridra haYa tAhale AllAhai nija anugrahe tAderake sacchala kare devena| AllAha mahA dAnazIla, mahAjJAnI|

yArA (Arthika kAraNe) viYe karate pAre nA tArA yena saMyama avalamvana kare, yatakSaNa nA AllAha tA~ra anugrahe tAderake sacchalatA dAna karena| Ara tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsa-dAsIdera madhye yArA (nijedera muktira janya tomAdera sAthe) likhita cukti karate cAYa tAdera sAthe tomarA likhita cukti karate pAra, yadi jAna ye, tAdera madhye kalyANa (satatA) Ache| adhikantu, tomAderake AllAha tA~ra ye sampada dAna karechena tA theke tAderake dAna karave| Ara tomAdera dAsIrA nijedera satItva rakSA karate cAile tomarA pArthiva jIvanera sAmagrIra (sampadera) lobhe tAderake vyabhicAre vAdhya karave nA| keu tA karale tAderake vAdhya karAra para AllAha (ai dAsIdera prati) kSamAzIla o meheravAna havena|
Ami to tomAdera kAche avatIrNa karechi (savakichu) suspaSTakArI AYAta, tomAdera pUrve yArA cale giYeche tAdera dRSTAnta evaM mottAkIdera janya upadeza|

AllAha halena AsamAna o jaminera nUra (Alo)| tA~ra nUrera upamA erakama: yena ekaTi dIpAdhAra, yAte ekaTi pradIpa Ache| pradIpaTi ekaTi kA~cera (pAtrera) madhye| kA~caTi yena ekaTi ujjvala tArakA| pradIpaTi ekaTi varakatamaYa yaYatuna (jalapAi) gAchera tela dvArA jvAlAno haYa, yA pUrverao naYa pazcimerao naYa| pradIpaTite Agunera sparza chAr3Ai ai gAchera tela ujjvala Alo char3iYe deYa| nUrera opara nUra| AllAha yAke cAna tA~ra nUrera patha dekhAna| tini mAnuSera janya nAnArakama upamA peza kare thAkena| AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve jAnena|
AllAha yesava ghara tule (masajida vAniYe) tAte tA~ra nAma smaraNa karAra nirdeza diYechena sekhAne sakAla-sandhyAYa tA~ra pavitratA varNanA kare

emana lokerA yAderake vyavasA-vANijya o kraYa-vikraYa AllAhara smaraNa theke, nAmAya kAYema karA theke o yAkAta deoYA theke virata rAkhe nA| tArA sei dinaTike (keYAmatera dinake) bhaYa kare yakhana (mAnuSera) antara o dRSTisamUha olaTapAlaTa (viparyasta) haYe yAve|
(tArA AllAhara pavitratA varNanA kare) yAte AllAha tAderake tAdera kAjera serA pratidAna dena evaM svIYa anugraha theke tAderake Aro vezi dAna karena| AllAha yAke cAna vine hiseve jIvikA dAna karena|

Ara yArA kuphari kare tAdera karma marubhUmira marIcikAra mata, yAke tRSNArta vyakti pAni mane kare; kintu se yadi tAra kAche yAYa tAhale dekhave kichui nei| se nijera kAche AllAhake pAve| tini tAke tAra hisAva puropuri miTiYe devena| AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

athavA (tAdera karma) atala samudrera mAjhe gAr3ha andhakArera mata, yAke Acchanna kare Ache taraGgera opara taraGga, tAra opara megha| andhakArera opara andhakAra| se nijera hAta vera karaleo (ai andhakAre) tA dekhate pAve nA| AllAha yAra janya kona Alo tairI karenani se kona Alora sandhAna pAve nA|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AsamAne o jamine yArA Ache tArA evaM sArivaddhabhAve ur3anta pAkhirA AllAhara guNagAna karache? pratyekei tA~ra ivAdata o guNagAnera paddhati jAne| Ara tArA yA kare AllAha tA bhAlabhAve jAnena|
AsamAna o jaminera sArvabhaumatva AllAharai| Ara AllAhara kAchei (savAra) pratyAvarta|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha megha saJcAlita karena, tArapara tA ekatrita karena, tArapara tA ekaTi stupe pariNata karena| ataHpara tumi dekhate pAo, tAra madhya theke vRSTi vera haYe Ase| tini AkAzera zilAparvata theke zilA varSaNa karena evaM tA dvArA yAke cAna AghAta karena evaM yAke (rakSA karate) cAna tAra theke tA sariYe dena| meghera vidyutjhalaka dRSTi ker3e neoYAra upakrama kare|
AllAha rAta o dina parivartana karena| ete antardRSTisampannadera janya nizcaYai ekaTi zikSA raYeche|

AllAha sakala jIvake pAni dvArA sRSTi karechena| tAdera madhye katagulo peTe bhara diYe cale, katagulo dui pAYe hA~Te, AvAra katagulo cAra pAYe hA~Te| AllAha yA icchA sRSTi karena| AllAha savakichui karate sakSama|
Ami to suspaSTa AYAta nAyila karechi| AllAha yAke icchA saThika patha pradarzana karena|
tArA vale, “AmarA AllAha o rasUlera prati ImAna enechi evaM (tAdera) Anugatya svIkAra karechi|” tArapara tAdera madhye ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa| Asale tArA ImAnadAra naYa|
rasUla tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare devena, ei uddezye yakhana tAderake AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera dike DAkA haYa takhanai tAdera madhye ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa|
kintu satya yadi tAdera pakSe haYa tAhale tArA (rasUlera) AjJAnuvartI haYe tAra dike cale Ase|
tAdera antare ki kona vyAdhi Ache, nAki tArA sandeha poSaNa kare, nAki tArA bhaYa kare ye, AllAha o tA~ra rasUla tAdera prati avicAra karavena? varaM tArAi to jAlema|

rasUla tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare devena, ei uddezye yakhana tAderake AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera dike DAkA haYa takhana muminadera kathA haYa eTAi: tArA vale, “AmarA zunechi o mene niYechi|” Ara tArAi hala saphalakAma|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kare evaM AllAhake bhaYa kare o tA~ra avAdhyatA theke ve~ce thAke tArAi saphalakAma|

tArA dRr3hatAra sAthe AllAhara (nAme) zapatha kare vale ye, tumi yadi tAderake Adeza dAo tAhale tArA (jehAdera janya) vera have| tumi vala, “tomarA zapatha karo nA| (e to) paricita (bhaNDa) Anugatya| tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|”

vala, “tomarA AllAhara Anugatya karo evaM rasUlera Anugatya kara| kintu yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale rasUlera opara arpita dAYitvera janya se dAYI evaM tomAdera opara arpita dAYitvera janya tomarA dAYI| tomarA yadi tAra Anugatya karo tAhale saThika patha pAve| rasUlera dAYitva kevala spaSTabhAve (vANI) pau~che deoYA|”

tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna Anave o satkAja karave tAderake AllAha oYAdA diYechena ye, tini avazyai tAderake pRthivIte (zAsakadera) sthalAbhiSikta karavena, yemana tAdera pUrvavartIderake (tAdera pUrvavartI zAsakadera) sthalAbhiSikta karechilena; tini tAdera janya ye (isalAma) dharmake pachanda karechena tA tAdera janya avazyai supratiSThita karavena evaM tAdera bhaYera para tAra parivarte avazyai tAderake nirApattA dAna karavena| tArA AmArai ivAdata karave, AmAra sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karave nA| Ara erapara yArA kuphari karave tArAi (AllAhara) avAdhya|
tomarA nAmAya kAYema karo, yAkAta dAna karo evaM rasUlera Anugatya karo, yAte tomarA (AllAhara) anugraha lAbha karate pAra|
tumi kApheraderake pRthivIte apAragakArI (pravala parAkramazAlI) mane karo nA| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| avazyai tA var3a khArApa gantavyasthala!

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera dAsa-dAsIrA evaM tomAdera madhye yArA sAvAlaka haYani tArA yena (tomAdera kakSe pravezakAle) tina samaYe tomAdera kAche anumati cAYa: phajarera nAmAyera pUrve, yakhana tomarA dupure tomAdera pozAka khule rAkha takhana evaM ezAra nAmAyera para: tomAdera ekAnte thAkAra tinaTi samaYa| ei tina samaYera para (tArA tomAdera kakSe praveza karale tAte) tomAdera o tAdera kona pApa have nA| tomAdera to eke aparera kAche yAtAYAta karatei haYa| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya vidhAnasamUha spaSTa kare dena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

tomAdera zizurA yakhana sAvAlaka have takhana tArAo yena anumati cAYa, yemana tAdera pUrvavartIrA (vaYojyeSTharA) anumati ceYe thAke| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra vidhAnasamUha spaSTa kare dena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

vaYasavRddhira kAraNe santAna haoYA vandha haYe giYeche emana nArIrA, yArA Ara viYera AzA kare nA, saundarya pradarzanera icchA chAr3A nijedera (oparera) paricchada khule rAkhale tAdera kona pApa have nA| tave (e theke) virata thAkalei tAdera janya bhAla| AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

andha, leMr3A o rogIra janya kona vAdhA nei; tomAdera nijedera janyao nijedera ghare kiMvA tomAdera vAvA, mA, bhAi, vona, cAcA, phuphu, mAmA vA khAlAdera ghare athavA tomAdera kAche cAvi Ache emana ghare kiMvA kona vandhura ghare AhAra karAYa kona vAdhA nei| savAi ekasAthe khAo kiMvA AlAdA AlAdAbhAve khAo tAteo tomAdera kona pApa nei| tave yakhana kona ghare praveza karave takhana (ghare avasthAnakArI) tomAdera lokadera prati AllAhara pakSa theke varakatamaYa pavitra abhivAdanasvarUpa sAlAma deve| ebhAvei AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra vidhAnasamUha vistAritabhAve varNanA karena, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

vastuta ImAnadAra tArAi yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa rAkhe evaM yakhana tArA kona sarvajanIna kAje rasUlera saGge thAke takhana tAra anumati nA niYe cale yAYa nA| yArA (praYojanIYa kona kAje yete hale) tomAra kAche anumati cAYa tArAi AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati vizvAsa rAkhe| ataeva, tArA yadi nijedera kona kAjera janya tomAra kAche anumati cAYa tAhale tAdera madhye yAke tumi cAo anumati dio evaM tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karo| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|

tomarA rasUlera AhavAnake tomAdera eke aparera prati AhavAnera mata mane karo nA| tomAdera madhye yArA (kothAo) AzraYa pAoYAra janya saTake par3e AllAha tAderake jAnena| ataeva, yArA tAra Adezera viruddhAcaraNa kare tArA yena tAdera opara kaThina parIkSA kiMvA kaSTadAYaka AjAva AsAra vyApAre satarka thAke|

jene rAkha, AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tA (savai) AllAhara| tini tomAdera avasthA jAnena; Ara (se dinera kathAo tini jAnena) yedina tAderake tA~rai kAche phiriYe neoYA have, sedina tini tAderake tAdera atIta karmasamUha avahita karavena| AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve jAnena|
parama kalyANamaYa sei sattA yini svIYa vAndAra prati (satya-mithyAra) pArthakyakArI grantha (koraAna) avatIrNa karechena, yAte se vizvavAsIra janya satarkakArI hate pAre|
AsamAna o jaminera rAjatva tA~rai| tini kona santAna grahaNa karenani| rAjetva tA~ra kona aMzIdAra nei| tini pratiTi vastu sRSTi kare tA parimApamata sunirdhArita karechena|

tArA tA~ke chAr3A emana kichu upAsya grahaNa kareche yArA kichui sRSTi kare nA, varaM tArA nijerAi sRSTa| adhikantu, tArA tAdera nijederai kona kSati kiMvA upakAra karAra mAlika naYa evaM kona mRtyu, jIvana kiMvA punarutthAnera adhikAra rAkhe nA|

kApherarA (koraAna samparke) vale, “eTA ekaTA mithyA chAr3A kichui naYa, yA se (muhAmmAda) udbhAvana kareche evaM e kAje tAke anya kichu loka sAhAyya kareche| avazyai tArA ekaTA anyAYa o mithyA (vaktavya) upasthApana kareche|”
tArA vale, “(egulo) pUrvavartIdera kAhini, yA se likhe rekheche| likhe rAkhAra janya egulo sakAla-sandhyAYa tAra kAche pATha karA haYa|”
tumi vala, “eTA tinii nAyila karechena yini AsamAna o jaminera rahasya jAnena| nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|”
tArA vale, “e kemana rasUla, ye (AmAdera matai) khAvAra khAYa o hATe-vAjAre calApherA kare? tAra kAche ekajana pherezatA pAThAno hala nA kena, ye satarkakArI hiseve (sArAkSaNa) tAra saGge thAkata?

“athavA tAra kAche kona bhANDAra deoYA haYa nA kena kiMvA tAra janya kona vAgAna nei kena, yekhAna theke se AhAra karata?” jAlemarA Aro vale, “Asale tomarA ekajana yAdugrasta lokerai anusaraNa karacha|”
bheve dekha, tomAra janya tArA kIsava udAharaNa varNanA karache! sutarAM tArA pathabhraSTa haYe giYeche, phale ekhana Ara kona patha khu~je pAcche nA|

AllAha kata mahiYAna! tini yadi icchA karena tAhale tomAra janya tAra ceYeo utkRSTa vastu varAdda karavena: (tA hala) jAnnAta, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| (jAnnAte) tini tomAra janya dAlAnakoThAo varAdda karavena|
varaM tArA keYAmata avizvAsa kareche| Ara keYAmata avizvAsakArIra janya Ami (jAhAnnAmera) Aguna prastuta kare rekhechi|
Aguna yakhana tAderake dUra theke dekhate pAve takhana tArA tAra kruddha garjana o niHzvAsa zunate pAve|
Ara yakhana tAderake zikalavaddha avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera kona saMkIrNa sthAne nikSepa karA have takhana sekhAne tArA (nijedera) dhvaMsa DAkave (kAmanA karave)|
Aja tomarA ekaTi dhvaMsa Deko nA, varaM aneka dhvaMsa DAka|
vala, “seTA (jAhAnnAmera sei zAsti) bhAla nAki cirakAla vasavAsera sei jAnnAta (bhAla), yAra pratizruti mottAkIderake deoYA haYeche?” eTAi tAdera puraskAra o cUr3Anta gantavyasthala|
tArA yA cAive sekhAne tAdera janya tAi thAkave evaM tArA sekhAne cirakAla vAsa karave| eTA tomAra prabhura eka avazyapUraNIYa oYAdA|

Ara yedina tini tAderake o AllAhara parivarte tArA yAdera upAsanA karata tAderake ekatra karavena sedina tini (upAsyaderake) valavena, “tomarAi ki AmAra ei vAndAderake vibhrAnta karechile, nAki tArA nijerAi pathabhraSTa haYechila?”

tArA valave, “tumi kata mahAna! AmAdera janya to tomAra parivarte anya abhibhAvaka grahaNa karA samIcIna chila nA; varaM tumii to tAderake o tAdera pitRpuruSaderake bhogera sAmagrI diYechile; phale tArA upadeza bhule giYechila evaM eka adhaHpatita janagoSThIte pariNata haYechila|”

tomarA yA vala se vyApAre tArA (tomAdera mithyA upAsyarA) ebhAve tomAderake mithyuka sAvyasta karave| sutarAM tomarA zAsti er3Ate kiMvA sAhAyya lAbha karate pArave nA| tomAdera madhye ye keu anyAYa (mithyA upAsya grahaNa) karave Ami tAke gurutara zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

tomAra pUrve Ami yata rasUla pAThiYechi tArA sakalei to khAvAra kheta o hATe-vAjAre calApherA karata| Ami tomAdera katakake katakera janya parIkSAra mAdhyama vAniYechi| tomarA ki dhairyadhAraNa karave? tomAra prabhu savakichui dekhena|

yArA AmAra sAkSAt kAmanA kare nA tArA vale, “AmAdera kAche pherezatA nAyila karA haYani kena? athavA AmarA AmAdera prabhuke dekhi nA kena?” Asale tArA nijederake khuva var3a mane kareche evaM dAruNa auddhatya pradarzana kareche|
yedina tArA pherezatAdera dekhave sedina (tAdera pakSa theke) pApIdera janya kona susaMvAda thAkave nA| tArA valave, “sava rakamera susaMvAda (tomAdera janya) niSiddha|”
tArA yesava kAja kareche Ami tAra dike manoniveza karava evaM seguloke vikSipta dhUlikaNAYa pariNata karava|
sedina jAnnAtavAsIrAi utkRSTa vAsasthAna o zreSTha vizrAmasthalera adhikArI have|
Ara (smaraNa karo) yedina AsamAna meghasaha TukarA TukarA haYe yAve evaM vyApakabhAve pherezatA nAmAno have|
sedina satyikAra rAjatva have karuNAmaYera evaM kApheradera janya have ekaTi kaThina dina|
Ara (smaraNa karo) yedina anyAYakArI nijera dui hAta kAmar3Ave Ara valave, “hAYa, Ami yadi rasUlera sAthe ekaTi patha grahaNa karatAma!”
“hAYare AmAra durbhAgya, Ami yadi amukake vandhurUpe grahaNa nA karatAma!
AmAra kAche upadeza (koraAna) AsAra para se-i to AmAke tA theke vipathe niYechila| Ara zaYatAna savasamaYa mAnuSake vipadakAle dho~kA diYe thAke|”
rasUla valave, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra lokerA to ei koraAnake phele rekhechila”
emanibhAve Ami pratyeka navIra janya aparAdhIderake zatru karechilAma| tave (tomAra janya) tomAra prabhui pathapradarzaka o sAhAyyakArI hiseve yatheSTa|

kApherarA vale, “tAra kAche goTA koraAna ekavAre nAyila karA hala nA kena?” ebhAvei (vAre vAre ekaTu ekaTu kare tA nAyila karA haYeche); tAra dvArA Ami tomAra antarake sudRr3ha karava vale| Ara Ami tA krame krame dhApe dhApe AvRtti (nAyila) karechi|
tArA tomAra kAche kakhanao kona upamA niYe elei Ami tomAke (se samparkita) saThika tathya o (tAra) yathArtha vyAkhyA jAniYe dei|
yAderake mukha thuvar3e par3e-thAkA avasthAYa jAhAnnAme niYe jar3o karA have tAdera jAYagA var3a nikRSTa evaM tArA adhikatara pathabhraSTa|
Ami mUsAke kitAva (tAorAta) diYechilAma evaM tAra sAthe sAhAyyakArI hiseve tAra bhAi hArUnake diYechilAma|
Ara Ami (tAderake) valechilAma, “tomarA sei lokadera kAche yAo yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA abhihita kareche|” tArapara Ami tAderake ekevAre dhvaMsa kare diYechi|

nUhera samapradAYakeo (dhvaMsa karechi); yakhana tArA rasUladerake avizvAsa karala Ami takhana tAderake DuviYe dilAma evaM mAnavajAtira janya tAderake eka nidarzana vAniYe rAkhalAma| Ami jAlemadera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
(dhvaMsa karechi) Ada o chAmUda jAtike, rAs‌ (uttara Aravera iYAmAmAYa avasthita chAmUda jAtira kona eka gotrera vasavAsera elAkA)-era vAsindAderake evaM edera mAjhera Aro aneka prajanmake|
Ami pratyekera sAmanei dRSTAnta peza karechilAma, tave (avizvAsa Ara apakarmera kAraNe) pratyekakei sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa kare diYechi|
tArA to (lUtera) sei janapadera opara diYei eseche yAra opara khArApa vRSTi par3echila| tArA ki tA dekheni? Asale tArA punarutthAna pratyAzA kare nA|
tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana tomAke niYe zudhu ThATTA-vidrUpai kare; (Ara vale) “ei ki sei lokaTi yAke AllAha rasUla kare pAThiYechena?”

“se to AmAderake pathabhraSTa kare AmAdera upAsyadera theke sariYe nevAra upakrama karechila, yadi nA AmarA tAderake A~kar3e thAkatAma|” tArA yakhana (nijedera) AjAva dekhate pAve takhana jAnate pArave ke adhika pathabhraSTa|
tumi ki tAke dekhecho ye tAra upAsya vAniYeche nijera pravRttike? tavuo ki tumi tAra jimmAdAra have?
nAki tumi mane karo, tAdera adhikAMza zone kiMvA vojhe? tArA Asale pazudera matai; varaM tArA Aro vezi pathabhraSTa|
tumi ki tomAra prabhuke dekhani, tini kIbhAve chAYAke vistRta karena? icchA karale tini eke sthira rAkhate pAratena; tave Ami sUryake tAra nirdezaka (niYantraka) karechi|

tArapara Ami eke AmAra dike Aste Aste guTiYe Ani| (AllAhara hukume sUrya savakichura chAYA niYantraNa kare| phale, sUryodaYakAle savakichura chAYA savaceYe pralamvita thAke| tArapara kramAnvaYe choTa haYe dviprahare tA savaceYe choTa haYe yAYa| tArapara ulTo dike var3a hate thAke evaM sUryAstera kAle AvAra tA savaceYe pralamvita haYa| AYAtaduTote ei viSaYaTira iMgita raYeche|)
tinii tomAdera AcchAdanera janya rAta, vizrAmera janya ghuma evaM (kAjakarme) uThe par3Ara janya dina diYechena|
tinii tA~ra rahamatera (vRSTira) pUrvAbhAsasvarUpa vAtAsa pAThAna| Ara AsamAna theke Ami vizuddha pAni varSaNa kari;
yAte Ami tAra sAhAyye niSaprANa bhUmite prANa saJcAra karate pAri evaM AmAra sRSTa aneka pazu o mAnuSake tA pAna karAte pAri|
Ami ei pAni tAdera madhye vitaraNa karechi yAte tArA (AmAra anugraha) smaraNa kare; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kevala akRtajJatAi prakAza kare|
icchA karale Ami pratyeka janapade ekajana kare satarkakArI pAThAte pAratAma|
ataeva, tumi kApheradera icchAnuyAYI kAja karo nA; varaM tAdera viruddhe era (ei koraAnera) sAhAyye var3a rakama lar3Ai cAlAo|
tinii dui samudra (dui prakAra pAni) samAntarAle pravAhita karechena| ekaTi miSTa o supeYa evaM ArekaTi lonA o tikta| evaM ubhaYera mAjhakhAne eka antarAYa o sudRr3ha vAdhA sthApana kare diYechena|
tinii pAni theke mAnuSa sRSTi karechena evaM tAra janya vaMza o vaivAhika samparka nirdhAraNa kare diYechena| tomAra prabhu atyanta kSamatAvAna|
tArA (avizvAsIrA) AllAhara parivarte emana kichura upAsanA kare yA tAdera kona upakAra kiMvA kSati karate pAre nA| avizvAsI mAtrai tAra prabhura viruddhe (apazaktira) sAhAyyakArI|
Ami to tomAke ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpei pAThiYechi|
vale dAo, “Ami tomAdera kAche era janya kona pratidAna cAi nA| Ami kevala cAi, (tomAdera madhye) ye cAYa se yena tAra prabhura patha avalamvana kare|”
Ara tumi sei ciraJjIva sattAra opara nirbhara karo yAra mRtyu nei evaM tAra prazaMsA o guNagAna kara| tA~ra vAndAdera pApera khavara rAkhAra janya tinii yatheSTa;

yini AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhye yA kichu Ache tA chaYadine sRSTi karechena; ataHpara Araze (siMhAsane) samAsIna haYechena| tini karuNAmaYa| kona avagata vyaktira kAche tA~ra samparke jijJesa kara|

tAderake yakhana valA hala, “karuNAmaYake sejadA karo” takhana tArA valala, “karuNAmaYa AvAra ki? tumi yAke sejadA karAra Adeza deve AmarA ki tAkei sejadA karava?” ete tAdera vimukhatAi vRddhi peYeche|sejadA
varakatamaYa sei sattA, yini AkAze rAzicakra sthApana karechena evaM tAte ekaTi virATa pradIpa (sUrya) o ekaTi Alokaprada candra sthApana karechena|
Ara tinii rAta o dinake paramparAgata karechena, emana vyaktira janya ye upadeza grahaNa karate cAYa kiMvA kRtajJatA prakAza karate cAYa|

karuNAmaYera (yathArtha) vAndA tArAi yArA pRthivIte namrabhAve calApherA kare, evaM mUrkharA yakhana tAderake (abhadrabhAve) samvodhana kare takhana tArA vale, “zAnti”| (tArA bhadrabhAve mUrkhadera abhadra samvodhanera javAva deYa|)
yArA tAdera prabhura uddezye sejadArata o daNDAYamAna avasthAYa rAta kATAYa|
yArA vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera theke jAhAnnAmera AjAvake dUre rekho| nizcaYai tAra AjAva ekaTA var3a sarvanAza|”
nizcaYai tA vAsasthAna o avasthAnasthala hiseve var3ai nikRSTa|
yArA vyaYa karAra samaYa apavyaYa kare nA evaM kArpaNyao kare nA; varaM tA (tAdera vyaYa) haYa era mAjhAmAjhi ekaTA madhyama parimANe|
yArA AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsyake DAke nA, AllAha yAke hatyA karA niSiddha karechena yathArtha kAraNa chAr3A tAke hatyA kare nA evaM vyabhicAra kare nA| ye tA kare se pApera zAsti bhoga karave|
keYAmatera dina tAra zAsti dviguNa karA have evaM tAra madhyei se lAJchita avasthAYa cirakAla thAkave;
sei sava lokerA vyatIta yArA taovA kare, vizvAsa rAkhe evaM satkAja kare; AllAha emana lokadera pApasamUha puNya dvArA parivartana kare devena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ye taovA kare o satkAja kare se to puropuri AllAhara dikei phire Ase|
Ara ye lokerA mithyA sAkSya deYa nA; apakarmera kAcha diYe gamanakAle (nijedera) sammAna niYe cale yAYa;
yAderake tAdera prabhura AYAtasamUha smaraNa kariYe dile se samvandhe vadhira o andha haYe thAke nA (nA zonAra o nA dekhAra bhAna kare nA);

evaM yArA vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera janya AmAdera strI o santAnadera dika theke cokhera zAnti dAna karo (emana strI o santAna dAo yAdera dekhale AmAdera cokha jur3iYe yAYa) Ara AmAderake mottAkIdera imAma (anusaraNIYa netA) vAniYe dAo”
emana lokaderake tAdera dhairyera pratidAne (jAnnAte) kakSa deoYA have evaM sekhAne tAderake abhivAdana o sAlAma diYe abhyarthanA jAnAno have|
tArA sekhAne cirakAla vAsa karave| vAsasthAna o avasthAnasthala hiseve tA var3ai uttama|
vala, “tomarA yadi AmAra prabhuke nA DAka tAhale tini tomAdera dike manoyoga dena nA| tomarA to (tA~ke) avizvAsai karecho; tAi zAsti have (tomAdera janya) aparihArya|”
tvA sIna mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavda-saMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
egulo suspaSTa kitAvera (koraAnera) AYAta|
tArA ImAna Anache nA vale manera duHkhe tumi yena Atmahanana karate cAo|
Ami yadi icchA kari tAhale tAdera kAche AsamAna theke kona nidarzana pAThAte pAri, yAra sAmane tArA tAdera ghAr3agulo nata kare deYa (tArA nati svIkAra kare)|
karuNAmaYera pakSa theke tAdera kAche kona natuna upadeza elei tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
ataeva, tArA (satyake) avizvAsai kareche| tAi tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tAra saMvAda tArA zigagirai jAnave|
tArA ki bhUmira dike ceYe dekheni? tAte Ami kata rakama utkRSTa udbhida utpanna karechi!
nizcaYai tAra madhye ekaTi nidarzana Ache, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsI naYa|
tomAra prabhu avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAra prabhu mUsAke Deke valalena, “jAlema lokadera kAche yAo;
pherAunera lokadera kAche| tArA ki bhaYa kare nA?”
mUsA valala, “prabhu! AmAra AzaGkA haYa, tArA AmAke avizvAsa karave|
tAchAr3A AmAra mana saMkIrNa haYe yAYa (Ami sAhasa hAriYe pheli) evaM AmAra jihavA druta cale nA (Ami sAvalIlabhAve kathA valate pAri nA)| ataeva, hArUnera kAche vArtA (ohI) pAThAo|”
“AmAra viruddhe tAdera ekaTi abhiyogao Ache| ataeva, AmAra bhaYa haYa, tArA AmAke hatyA karave|”
AllAha valena, “nA, tomarA dujanai AmAra nidarzana niYe yAve| Ami to tomAdera saGge Achii, (ke ki vale) sava zonava|”
tomarA pherAunera kAche giYe valave, “AmarA vizvajagatera prabhura dUta|
(AmAdera vaktavya,) vanI isarAIlake AmAdera sAthe yete dAo|”
pherAuna valala, “AmarA ki tomAke ekaTi zizu hiseve AmAdera madhye lAlanapAlana karini? Ara tumi to tomAra vaYasera anekagulo vachara AmAdera madhye kATiYecho|”
“Ara tumi tomAra sei karmaTio karechile (ghuSi mere ekaTi mAnuSa hatyA karechile)| tumi var3a akRtajJa|”
mUsA valala, “kAjaTi Ami vibhrAnta (ajJAta) avasthAYa karechilAma|”
“ataHpara Ami tomAdera bhaYe tomAdera theke pAliYe yAi| tArapara AmAra prabhu AmAke prajJA dAna karechena evaM AmAke rasUla karechena|”
“Ara tumi AmAke ye anugrahera khoTA diccha tA to ei ye, tumi vanI isarAIlake dAsa vAniYe rekhecho|”
pherAuna valala, “vizvajagatera prabhu AvAra ki jinisa?”
mUsA valala, “tini AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichura prabhu, yadi tomarA vizvAsa kara|”
pherAuna tAra cArapAzera lokaderake valala, “tomarA ki zunacha nA?”
mUsA valala, “tini tomAdera prabhu evaM tomAdera pUrvavartI pitRpuruSaderao prabhu|”
pherAuna valala, “tomAdera kAche prerita tomAdera rasUla Asale ekaTA pAgala|”
mUsA valala, “tini pUrva-pazcima o tAra madhyavartI savakichura prabhu, yadi tomarA vujhate|”
pherAuna valala, “tumi yadi AmAke chAr3A anya kona prabhu grahaNa karo tAhale Ami avazyai tomAke kArAruddha karava|”
mUsA valala, “Ami yadi tomAra kAche (pramANasvarUpa) spaSTa kona jinisa niYe Asi tavuo?”
pherAuna valala, “tAhale tA niYe eso, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|”
takhana mUsA tAra lAThiTi nikSepa karala, dekhA gela, seTi ekaTi spaSTa ajagara|
tArapara se tAra hAta vera karala, sAthe sAthe darzakarA dekhala, hAtaTi sAdA haYe geche|
pherAuna tAra cArapAzera netAdera valala, “nizcaYai e eka vijJa yAdukara|
se tAra yAdura vale tomAderake tomAdera bhUkhaNDa theke vera kare dite cAYa| ataeva, tomarA ekhana ki karate vala?”
tArA valala, “tAke o tAra bhAike kichuTA avakAza dina evaM nagaragulote (yAdukara) saMgrahakArIdera pAThiYe dina;
yAte tArA pratyeka vijJa yAdukarake ApanAra kAche niYe Ase|”
ataHpara eka nirdiSTa dinera nirdhArita samaYe yAdukaradera ekatra karA hala|
Ara lokaderake valA haYechila, “tomarA samaveta haccha to? (tomarA yathAsamaYe upasthita theko;)
yena AmarA yAdukaradera anusaraNa karate pAri, yadi tArA vijaYI haYa|”
tArapara yakhana yAdukarerA ela takhana tArA pherAunake valala, “yadi AmarAi vijaYI hai tAhale AmAdera janya ki avazyai kona puraskAra thAkave?”
se valala, “hyA~, Ara tomarA takhana (AmAra) nikaTajanadera madhye gaNya have|”
mUsA tAderake (yAdukaraderake) valala, “tomarA yA nikSepa karate cAo tA nikSepa kara|”
tArA takhana tAdera dar3i Ara lAThigulo nikSepa karala Ara valala, pherAunera zaktira zapatha, AmarAi vijaYI hava|

takhana mUsA tAra lAThiTi nikSepa karala, Ara sahasAi dekhA gela, tArA yA vAniYechila se tA sava gile phelache| (yAdukaradera nikSipta dar3i Ara lAThigulo tAdera yAduvale ye choTa choTa sApe pariNata haYechila, mUsAra nikSipta lAThiTi AllAhara deoYA alaukika kSamatAvale virATa ajagare pariNata haYe seguloke gile phelala|)
takhana yAdukarerA sejadAYa par3e gela|
tArA valala, “AmarA vizvajagatera prabhura prati ImAna AnalAma,
yini mUsA o hArUnera prabhu|”

pherAuna valala, “Ami tomAderake anumati deoYAra Agei tomarA tAra kathAYa vizvAsa karecho| nizcaYai se tomAdera guru, ye tomAderake yAdu zikhiYeche| (era pariNAma) tomarA jAnate pArave| Ami avazyai tomAdera hAta o pA viparIta dika theke keTe deva evaM avazyai tomAdera sakalake zUle car3Ava|
tArA valala, “kona kSati nei| AmarA to AmAdera prabhura kAchei phire yAva|
AmarA AzA kari, AmAdera prabhu AmAdera pApasamUha mArjanA kare devena; kAraNa, AmarAi halAma ImAna AnaYanakArIdera madhye prathama|”
Ami mUsAke ei vale ohI pAThAlAma, “tumi AmAra vAndAdera niYe rAte veriYe par3a; nizcaYai tomAdera pazcAddhAvana karA have (pherAunera lokerA tomAdera pechane pechane Asave)|”
ataHpara pherAuna nagaragulote (loka) saMgrahakArIdala pAThAYa,
(se vale,) “Asale erA (vanI isarAIla) to alpasaMkhyaka mAnuSera kSudra ekaTi dala,
“tave erA AmAderake (nAnAbhAve) kSepiYe tuleche|
Ara AmarA savAi (edera kAraNe) satarkAvasthAYa raYechi|”
ataHpara Ami tAderake (pherAuna o tAra dalavalake) vera kare dilAma vAga-vAgicA o jharNArAji theke;
Ara dhana-bhANDAra o sammAnajanaka sthAna theke|
tAi haYechila; Ara esava kichura uttarAdhikArI kare dilAma vanI isarAIlake|
ataHpara sUryodaYakAle pherAunera lokerA mUsAra lokadera pechane ese par3ala|
ubhaYa dala yakhana eke aparake dekhate pela takhana mUsAra saGgIrA valala, “AmarA ye (zatrura) nAgAlera madhye ese gelAma!”
mUsA valala, “kakhano naYa, AmAra sAthe AmAra prabhu Achena; tini AmAke zigagirai patha dekhAvena|”
ataHpara Ami mUsAke Adeza dilAma, “tomAra lAThi diYe samudre AghAta kara|” ete samudra vidIrNa hala evaM pratyeka bhAga vizAla parvatera mata haYe gela|
tArapara Ami anyaderake (pherAuna o tAra dalaTike) sekhAne AnalAma|
Ami mUsA o tAra sakala saGgIke vA~ciYe dilAma|
tArapara anyaderake (pherAuna o tAra dalaTike) DuviYe dilAma|
e ghaTanAra madhye avazyai eka var3a nidarzana Ache| tave tAdera adhikAMza vizvAsI chila nA|
Ara tomAra prabhu avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ara tAdera kAche ivarAhImera ghaTanA varNanA kara|
yakhana se tAra vAvA o nija samapradAYake valala, “tomarA kisera ivAdata karo?”
tArA valala, “AmarA mUrtidera pUjA kari evaM sArAkSaNa tAdera prati nivedita thAki|”
se valala, “tomarA yakhana (tAderake) DAka tArA ki tomAdera DAka zunate pAYa?”
“kiMvA tArA ki tomAdera upakAra kiMvA apakAra karate pAre?”
tArA valala, “(nA,) tave AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke emanai karate dekhechi|”
ivarAhIma valala, “tomarA ki tAdera samvandhe bheve dekhecho yAdera pUjA kare Asacha;
tomarA o tomAdera pUrvavartI vApa-dAdArA?”
“tArA to AmAra zatru, sRSTijagatera prabhu (eka AllAha) vyatIta;
yini AmAke sRSTi karechena, Ara tinii AmAke patha pradarzana karena;
tinii AmAke khAoYAna o pAna karAna|”
“Ara Ami yakhana asustha hai takhana tinii AmAke sustha karena|
tinii AmAra mRtyu devena, tArapara AmAke jIvita karavena|
evaM vicArera dine tinii AmAra aparAdha kSamA karavena vale Ami AzA kari|”
“he AmAra prabhu! AmAke prajJA dAna karo evaM AmAke satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta kara|
paravartIdera madhye AmAra janya sukhyAti dAna kara|”
“AmAke sukhera jAnnAtera anyatama uttarAdhikArI kara|
Ara AmAra vAvAke kSamA kare dAo, tini to pathabhraSTadera antarbhukta chilena|”
“yedina lokaderake punarAYa uThAno have sedina (punarutthAna divase) AmAke lAJchita karo nA;
yedina sampada o putragaNa kAro upakAre Asave nA;
kevala se chAr3A ye AllAhara kAche ekaTi vizuddha antara niYe Asave|”
jAnnAtake mottAkIdera kAche AnA have
evaM jAhAnnAmake vipathagAmIdera sAmane unmocita karA have|
Ara tAderake valA have, “kothAYa tArA (tomAdera sei mithyA upAsyarA), tomarA yAdera upAsanA karate
AllAhara parivarte? tArA ki tomAderake athavA tAdera nijederake sAhAyya karate pArache?”
ataHpara adhomukhI kare tAderake jAhAnnAme nikSepa karA have; anyAnya vipathagAmIderakeo
evaM ivalIsera vAhinIgulora sakalakeo|
tArA sekhAne (bhrAnta upAsyadera sAthe) vitarke lipta haYe valave,
“AllAhara zapatha! nizcaYai AmarA spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye chilAma”
yakhana tomAderake vizvajagatera prabhura samAna sAvyasta karatAma|
aparAdhIrAi AmAderake vibhrAnta karechila|”
“ekhana AmAdera kona supArizakArI nei|
kona ghaniSTha vandhuo nei|
(hAYa!) AmarA ekavAra yadi (duniYAYa) phire yAoYAra suyoga petAma tAhale ImAnadAra haYe yetAma|”
era madhye avazyai eka nidarzana Ache, kintu tAdera adhikAMza ImAnadAra naYa|
Ara tomAra prabhu to avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nUhera samapradAYa rasUladerake mithyuka AkhyAYita karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi nUha tAderake valala, “tomAdera ki (AllAhara) bhaYa nei?”
“Ami tomAdera janya ekajana vizvasta rasUla|
ataeva, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|”
“Ami era janya tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA| vizvajagatera prabhui AmAra pratidAna devena|
ataeva, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|”
tArA valala, “yekhAne nimnazreNIra lokerA tomAra anusaraNa karache sekhAne AmarA tomAra prati ImAna Ani kIbhAve?”
se valala, “tArA ki karata Ami tAra ki jAni?”
“tAdera hisAva to AmAra prabhura kAchei Ache, yadi tomarA jAnate!
Ami muminaderake tAr3iYe dite pAri nA|
Ami kevala ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|”
tArA valala, “he nUha! tumi yadi virata nA hao tAhale tomAke pAthara mere hatyA karA have|”
se valala, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra lokerA to AmAke avizvAsa karala|”
“ataeva, AmAra o tAdera mAjhe ekaTA phaYasAlA kare dAo evaM AmAke o AmAra saGge ye muminarA Ache tAderake rakSA kara|”
takhana Ami tAke o tAra saGge yArA chila tAderake vojhAikRta naukAYa (naukAYa vojhAi kare) rakSA karalAma|
erapara avaziSTaderake DuviYe dilAma|
era madhye avazyai ekaTi nidarzana Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai ImAnadAra chila nA|
Ara tomAra prabhu to avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
Ada samapradAYa rasUladerake avizvAsa karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi hUda tAderake valala, “tomAdera ki (AllAhara) bhaYa nei?”
“Ami tomAdera janya ekajana vizvasta rasUla|
ataeva, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami era janya tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA| vizvajagatera prabhui AmAra pratidAna devena|”
tomarA ki pratiTi u~cu jAYagAYa ayathA nidarzana (smRtistamva) nirmANa karacha?
tomarA prAsAda vAnAccha, yena cirakAla (tAte) vAsa karave|”
“Ara tomarA yakhana (kAuke) dhara takhana svecchAcArI haYe (niSThurabhAve) dhara|
tomarA varaM AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
bhaYa karo tA~ke yini tomAderake sei sava jinisa dvArA sAhAyya karechena yA tomarA jAna|”
“tini tomAderake sAhAyya karechena pazusampada o putradera dvArA;
evaM vAgAna o jharanA dvArA|
Ami tomAdera janya eka bhaYAnaka dinera zAstira AzaMkA kari|”
tArA valala, “tumi AmAderake upadeza dAo Ara nA dAo AmAdera janya ubhaYai samAna|
e to pUrvavartIdera svabhAva vai (natuna kichu) naYa|
Asale AmAderake zAsti deoYA have nA|”
ebhAve tArA tAke pratyAkhyAna karala Ara Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare dilAma| era madhye avazyai ekaTi nidarzana Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai ImAnadAra chila nA|
Ara tomAra prabhu to avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
chAmUda samapradAYa rasUladerake avizvAsa karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi chAleha tAderake valala, “tomAdera ki (AllAhara) bhaYa nei?”
“Ami tomAdera janya ekajana vizvasta rasUla|
ataeva, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami era janya tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA| vizvajagatera prabhui AmAra pratidAna devena|”
“tomAderake ki e duniYAra bhoga-sAmagrIra madhye nirApade rekhe deoYA have?
udyAna Ara jharanAra madhye?
(savuja) phasalera kSeta Ara komala maJjarIviziSTa khejura-vAgAnera madhye?”
“tomarA pAhAr3a keTe sudakSabhAve ghara tairI karacha|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|”
“sImAlaMghanakArIdera Adeza mAnya karo nA;
yArA pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare, bhAla kAja kare nA|”
tArA valala, “Asale tumi yAdugrasta lokadera antarbhukta|
tumi AmAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa vai to nao| Thika Ache, tumi yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale (tomAra dAvira samarthane) ekaTi nidarzana upasthita kara|”
se valala, “ei ekaTi uSTrI| era pAni pAnera adhikAra Ache evaM tomAderao nirdhArita dine pAni pAnera adhikAra Ache|
tomarA era kona kSati karo nA| tAhale tomAdera opara eka bhaYAnaka dinera zAsti Asave|”
kintu tArA seTike hatyA kare paravartIte anutapta haYechila|
ataHpara tAdera opara zAsti esechila| era madhye avazyai ekaTi nidarzana Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMza ImAnadAra chila nA|
Ara tomAra prabhu to avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
lUtera samapradAYa rasUladerake avizvAsa karechila|
yakhana tAdera bhAi lUta tAderake valala, “tomarA ki (AllAhake) bhaYa karo nA?”
“Ami tomAdera janya ekajana vizvasta rasUla|
ataeva, AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami era janya tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA| vizvajagatera prabhui AmAra pratidAna devena|”
“tomarA ki (yauna cAhidA pUraNera janya) sRSTijagatera (mAnavajAtira) puruSaderakei vyavahAra karo?
Ara tomAdera prabhu tomAdera janya tomAdera ye strIdera sRSTi karechena tAderake varjana karo? tomarA to eka sImAlaMghanakArI samapradAYa|”
tArA valala, “he lUta! tumi yadi virata nA hao tAhale avazyai tomAke vera kare deoYA have|”
se valala, “Ami tomAdera e (jaghanya) kAjake ghRNA kari|
he AmAra prabhu! AmAke o AmAra parivArake erA yA karache tA theke (tAra pariNAma theke) rakSA kara|”
Ami tAke o tAra parivArera sakalake rakSA karalAma|
eka vRddhA vyatIta, yArA pechane raYe giYechila se tAdera antarbhukta chila|
tArapara Ami anyaderake dhvaMsa kare dilAma|
tAdera opara eka (zAstira) vRSTi varSaNa karalAma| yAderake satarka karA haYechila tAdera (opara) e vRSTi var3ai khArApa chila|
era madhye avazyai eka nidarzana Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai ImAnadAra chila nA|
Ara tomAra prabhu to avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
(mAd‌iYAnera nikaTavartI) AikAra adhivAsIrA rasUladerake avizvAsa karechila|
yakhana zoYAiva tAderake valala, “tomarA ki (AllAhake) bhaYa karo nA?”
“Ami tomAdera janya ekajana vizvasta rasUla|
ataeva, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
Ami era janya tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA| vizvajagatera prabhui AmAra pratidAna devena|”
“tomarA mApe puropuri deve, yArA mApe kama deYa tomarA tAdera dalabhukta have nA|
Ara saThika dA~r3ipAllAYa ojana karave|”
“mAnuSake tAdera jinisapatra kama deve nA evaM pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi karave nA|
Ara sei mahAna sattAke bhaYa karave, yini tomAderake o pUrvavartI mAnuSaderake sRSTi karechena|”
tArA valala, “Asale tumi yAdugrastadera antarbhukta|”
“tumi to AmAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa| AmAdera dhAraNA, tumi ekajana mithyAvAdI |
yadi tumi satyavAdI hao tAhale AmAdera opara AkAzera ekaTi khaNDa phela dekhi|”
se valala, “tomarA yA karo tA AmAra prabhu bhAla jAnena|”
ataHpara tArA tAke avizvAsa karala| phale meghAcchanna dinera zAsti tAderake pAkar3Ao karala| seTA chila eka bhaYAnaka dinera zAsti|
era madhye avazyai ekaTi nidarzana Ache; tave tAdera adhikAMza ImAnadAra chila nA|
Ara tomAra prabhu to avazyai parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
ei koraAna vizvajagatera prabhura nikaTa theke avatIrNa|
vizvasta AtmA (jivarAIla) tA niYe eseche,
tomAra antare, yAte tumi (lokaderake) satarka karate pAra;
(tA avatIrNa haYeche) spaSTa AravI bhASAYa|
pUrvavartIdera kitAvasamUhe (tAorAta o inajIle) era ullekha raYeche|
tAdera janya eTA ki ekaTA nidarzana naYa ye, vanI isarAIlera vidvAna vyaktirA era samparke avagata Ache?
Ami yadi e koraAna kona anAravera opara nAyila karatAma
evaM se tA tAderake par3e zonAta tAhale tArA tA vizvAsa karata nA|
ebhAvei Ami aparAdhIdera antare eTA (avizvAsa) DhukiYe diYechi|
tArA eke (koraAna) vizvAsa karave nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA kaSTadAYaka zAsti dekhate pAYa|
tAdera kAche ei zAsti haThAt ese par3ave, tArA vujhatei pArave nA|
tArA takhana valave, “AmAderake ki avakAza deoYA have?”
tave ki tArA AmAra zAsti druta kAmanA kare?
vala dekhi, Ami yadi tAderake aneka vachara (duniYAra sukha) upabhoga karate dei,
tArapara tAdera kAche tAdera pratizruta zAsti Ase (tAte ki tAdera kona lAbha Ache)?
tArA yA kichu upabhoga karata tA tAdera kona kAje Asave nA|
Ami kona janapada dhvaMsa karini yAra janya satarkakArIdala chila nA;
smaraNa karAnora janya; Ami kona avicAra karini|
zaYatAnerA e koraAna niYe avatIrNa haYani|
eTA tAdera janya samIcIna naYa evaM tArA tA pAreo nA|
tAderake (era) zravaNa theke dUre sariYe deoYA haYeche|
ataeva, AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsyake Deko nA, pAche tumi zAstiprAptadera antarbhukta hao|
Ara tomAra nikaTAtmIYaderake satarka kare dAo|
tomAra anusArI muminadera prati vinaYI hao|
yadi tArA tomAra avAdhya haYa tAhale valave, “tomarA yA karacha tAra sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei|”
Ara parAkramazAlI o daYAmaYera opara bharasA rekho;
yini tomAke dekhate pAna yakhana tumi (nAmAye) dA~r3Ao
evaM (dekhate pAna) sejadAkArIdera madhye tomAra oThAvasA|
nizcaYai tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
Ami ki tomAderake jAniYe deva, zaYatAnerA kAdera kAche avatIrNa haYa?
tArA avatIrNa haYa pratyeka mithyAvAdI o pApIra kAche|
tArA kAna pAte evaM tAdera adhikAMza mithyAvAdI|
kavidera anusaraNa kare vibhrAnta vyaktirA|
tumi ki dekhani ye, tArA (kavirA) pratyeka upatyakAYa ud‌bhrAnta haYe ghure ver3AYa (pratyeka viSaYe satya-mithyA kathA vale)?
evaM (dekhani ye,) tArA tAi vale yA nijerA kare nA?

tave tAdera kathA bhinna, yArA (satye) vizvAsa kare, satkAja kare, AllAhake vezi kare smaraNa kare evaM atyAcArita haoYAra para pratizodha grahaNa kare| atyAcArIrA zigagirai jAnave, tArA kon‌ gantavyasthale phire yAve|

tvA sIna [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]; egulo koraAna o eka spaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
(egulo) muminadera janya pathanirdeza o susaMvAda|
yArA nAmAya kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa| Ara tArAi parakAlake dRr3habhAve vizvAsa kare|
yArA parakAla vizvAsa kare nA Ami tAdera karmakANDake tAdera kAche zobhanIYa karechi; tAi tArA vibhrAnta haYa|
tAdera janyai raYeche nikRSTa zAsti evaM tArAi parakAle sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
tomAke koraAna deoYA hacche parama prAjJa mahAjJAnI AllAhara pakSa theke|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana mUsA tAra parivArake valechila, “Ami ekaTA Aguna dekhate peYechi; sekhAna theke tomAdera janya ekaTA khavara niYe Asava, athavA tomAdera janya jvalanta aGgAra niYe Asava, yAte tomarA tApa nite pAra|”
ataHpara se yakhana ai Agunera kAche ela takhana tAke samvodhana kare valA hala, “varakatamaYa tini, yini Agunera madhye Achena evaM yArA tAra AzepAze Achena| vizvajagatera prabhu AllAha kata mahAna!
he mUsA! e to Ami AllAha, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

“tumi tomAra lAThiTi nikSepa kara|” ataHpara se yakhana seTike sApera mata nar3ate dekhala takhana ghure cale ela evaM pechane tAkAlo nA| (tAke valA hala,) “he mUsA! bhaYa peYo nA; AmAra kAche (Ami kAche thAkate) rasUlerA bhaYa pAYa nA|”
“kintu ye anyAYa kare phele tAra kathA bhinna| avazya pare se manda kAjera parivarte bhAla kAja karale (tAra prati) Ami kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

“evaM tomAra hAta tomAra vagale DhukAo; dekhave, kona truTi chAr3Ai tA sAdA haYe veriYe Asave| egulo pherAuna o tAra samapradAYera nikaTa (AnIta) naYaTi nidarzanera antargata| tArA chila avAdhya eka janagoSThI|”
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra spaSTa nidarzanAvalI esechila takhana tArA valechila, “e to pariSkAra yAdu|”
tArA segulo anyAYabhAve o ahaGkAravazata pratyAkhyAna karechila, tave tAdera mana tA satya vale vizvAsa karechila| ataeva dekha, azAnti sRSTikArIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila!
avazyai Ami dAuda o solAYamAnake jJAna diYechilAma| tArA valechila, “sakala prazaMsA sei mahAna AllAhara yini AmAderake tA~ra aneka mumina vAndAra opara zreSThatva diYechena|”

solAYamAna dAudera (jJAnera) uttarAdhikArI haYechila| se valechila, “he mAnuSa! AmAderake pAkhidera bhASA zekhAno haYeche evaM AmAderake savakichui deoYA haYeche| avazyai eTA (AllAhara) spaSTa anugraha|”
solAYamAnera sAmane tAra jvina, mAnuSa o pAkhi vAhinIguloke jar3o karA hala| ataHpara tAderake bhAge bhAge vinyasta karA hala (yuddhera janya prastuta karA hala)|
yakhana tArA pi~par3Adera upatyakAYa ela takhana ekaTi pi~par3A valala, “he pi~par3ArA! tomarA nijedera ghare praveza karo; yAte solAYamAna o tAra sainyarA ajJAtasAre tomAderake piSe nA phele|”

pi~par3ATira kathA zune solAYamAna mRdu hAsala Ara valala, “he prabhu! AmAke zakti dAo, yena Ami tomAra sei neYAmatera zokara karate pAri yA tumi AmAke o AmAra pitAmAtAke diYecho evaM yena tomAra pachandamata satkAja karate pAri| Ara tumi svIYa anugrahe AmAke tomAra sat o yogya vAndAdera antarbhukta kara|”
solAYamAna pAkhidera sandhAna nila evaM valala, “ki vyApAra, hudahudake dekhachi nA ye! nAki se anupasthita?”
“avazyai Ami tAke kaThora zAsti deva kiMvA javAi kare phelava; athavA se AmAra kAche (anupasthitira) spaSTa kAraNa upasthita karave|”
alpakSaNera madhyei hudahuda ese hAjira hala evaM (solAYamAnake) valala, “Apani jAnena nA emana ekaTi tathya Ami jene esechi| Ami ApanAra kAche sAvA (rAjya) theke ekaTi nizcita saMvAda niYe esechi|”
“Ami dekhate peYechi, ekajana nArI (vilakIsa) tAdera (sAvAra adhivAsIdera) opara rAjatva karache| tAke savakichui deoYA haYeche (tAra savakichui Ache) evaM tAra ekaTi virATa siMhAsana Ache|”

“Ami dekhalAma, se o tAra lokerA AllAhara parivarte sUryake sejadA karache| zaYatAna tAdera kAjakarmake tAdera kAche zobhanIYa kareche evaM tAderake satpatha theke phiriYe rekheche; tAi tArA pathera sandhAna pAcche nA|”

(zaYatAna tAderake satpatha theke phiriYe rekheche) yAte tArA AllAhake sejadA nA kare, yini AsamAna o jaminera gopana vastu prakAza karena evaM tomarA yA gopana karo evaM yA prakAza karo tA (savai) jAnena|
AllAha emana ye, tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| tini mahAna Arazera (siMhAsanera) mAlika|sejadA
solAYamAna valala, “AmarA dekhava, tumi ki satya valecho, nAki tumi mithyAvAdI|”
“AmAra e patraTi niYe yAo; eTi tAdera kAche deve, tArapara tAdera kAcha theke sare par3ave| dekha, tArA (era) ki javAva deYa|”
vilakIsa valala, “he pAriSadavarga! AmAra kAche ekaTi sammAnita patra pAThAno haYeche|”
“seTi solAYamAnera pakSa theke (pAThAno haYeche)| patraTi hala, “karuNAmaYa o parama daYAlu AllAhara nAme:
tomarA AmAra avAdhya haYo nA, varaM Anugatya svIkAra kare AmAra kAche Asa|”

vilakIsa valala, “he pAriSadavarga! AmAra ei vyApAraTite tomarA AmAke parAmarza dAo| Ami to kona vyApAre cUr3Anta siddhAnta grahaNa kari nA, yatakSaNa nA tomarA AmAra kAche upasthita hao (evaM AmAke praYojanIYa parAmarza dAo|)”
tArA valala, “AmarA to kSamatAvAna o pracaNDa zaktidhara (jAti); tave siddhAnta grahaNera (vA Adeza deoYAra) kSamatA ApanAra kAche; ataeva bheve dekhuna, ki Adeza devena|”
se valala, “rAjA-vAdazArA yakhana kona janapade praveza kare takhana tArA tAke tachanacha kare deYa evaM sekhAnakAra sammAnita lokaderake lAJchita kare| erAo tAi karave|”
“Ami tAdera kAche kichu upahAra pAThAte cAi evaM dekhate cAi, dUterA ki niYe phire Ase|”

dUta yakhana solAYamAnera kAche ela takhana se valala, “tomarA ki AmAke sampada dvArA sAhAyya karacha? AllAha AmAke yA diYechena tA tomAderake yA diYechena tAra ceYe bhAla| (AmAke upahAra dite have nA) tomarA varaM tomAdera upahAra niYe Ananda kara|”
“tAdera kAche phire yAo| AmarA avazyai tAdera kAche senAdala niYe Asava, yAdera mokAvelA karAra zakti tAdera nei| AmarA avazyai tAderake sekhAna theke lAJchita o apadastha avasthAYa vera kare deva|”
se valala, “he pAriSadavarga! tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare AmAra kAche AsAra Age tomAdera madhye ke AmAke tAra (vilakIsera) siMhAsana ene dite pArave?”
jvinadera eka daitya valala, “Apani ApanAra jAYagA theke oThAra Agei Ami tA ApanAra kAche niYe Asachi| Ara e kAja karAra janya avazyai Ami zaktimAna o vizvasta|

yAra kAche kitAvera jJAna chila se valala, “ApanAra cokha ApanAra dike pherAra Agei (cokhera palakera madhyei) Ami ApanAke tA ene deva|” ataHpara solAYamAna yakhana tAra sAmane siMhAsanaTi sthira dekhate pela takhana valala, “eTA AmAra prabhura anugraha; Ami kRtajJa hai, nA akRtajJa hai tA parIkSA karAra janya (tini AmAke ei anugraha karechena)| ye kRtajJa haYa se tAra nijera bhAlora janyai kRtajJa haYa; Ara ye akRtajJa haYa tAra jAnA ucita, AmAra prabhu abhAvamukta, mahAnubhava|”

se valala, “vilakIsera siMhAsanaTira AkRti pAlTe dAo; dekhava, se saThika dizA pAYa, nA dizAhArAdera antarbhukta haYa (arthAt parivartita AkRtite se nijera siMhAsana cinate pAre kinA AmarA tA dekhava)|”

ataHpara yakhana vilakIsa ela takhana tAke jijJAsA karA hala, “tomAra siMhAsanaTi ki erakama?” se valala, “Thika yena eTAi|” (solAYamAna valala,) “vilakIsera Agei AmarA jJAna lAbha karechi evaM musalamAna (AllAhara Anugatya svIkArakArI) haYechi|”
AllAhara parivarte se (vilakIsa) yAra pUjA karata sei tAke (AllAhara Anugatya theke) virata rekhechila| nizcaYai se kApheradera antarbhukta chila|

tAke valA hala, “ei prAsAde praveza kara|” yakhana se prAsAdaTi dekhala, takhana seTike ekaTi gabhIra jalAzaYa mane karala evaM (paranera kApar3a opare tule) dui pAYera nalA unmocana karala| solAYamAna valala, “eTA to kA~cera pralepayukta ekaTi prAsAda|” vilakIsa valala, “he AmAra prabhu! (etadina ImAna nA ene) Ami AmAra nijera prati anyAYa karechi| Ami solAYamAnera sAthe vizvajagatera prabhu AllAhara kAche AtmasamarpaNa karalAma|”
Ami chAmUda samapradAYera kAche tAdera bhAi chAlehake ei vale pAThiYechilAma ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdata kara| kintu tArA dui dala haYe jhagar3AYa lipta haYechila|
chAleha valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA kalyANera (AllAhara anugrahera) Age druta akalyANa (zAsti) cAccha kena? kena AllAhara kAche kSamA cAccha nA, yAte tomarA anugraha pete pAra?”

tArA valala, “AmarA tomAke o tomAra saGgIderake azubha mane kari|” chAleha valala, “tomAdera azubha AllAhara kAche (AllAhara kAche tomarAi azubha vale vivecita)| varaM tomarA emana eka samapradAYa yAderake parIkSA karA hacche|”
(tAdera) zahare emana naYa vyakti chila, yArA jamine azAnti sRSTi kare ver3Ata evaM satkAja karata nA|

tArA valala, “tomarA paraspara AllAhara nAme zapatha nAo ye, AmarA tAra (chAleha) o tAra parivArera opara rAte AkramaNa karava; tArapara tAra abhibhAvakake valava ye, AmarA tAra parivArera dhvaMsa pratyakSa karini| AmarA avazyai satyavAdI|”
(ebhAve) tArA ekaTi cakrAnta karechila evaM Amio ekaTi pAlTA kauzala avalamvana karechilAma, athaca tArA (tA) vujhate pAreni|
ataeva dekha, tAdera cakrAntera pariNati kemana chila| Ami tAderake o tAdera samapradAYera sakalake dhvaMsa kare diYechi|
ai ye tAdera gharavAr3i, tAdera apakarmera kAraNe janazUnya avasthAYa par3e Ache| ete jJAnI lokadera janya avazyai eka nidarzana Ache|
tave yArA ImAna enechila evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karechila tAderake Ami rakSA karechi|
Ara (smaraNa karo) lUtake, yakhana se tAra samapradAYake valechila, “tomarA ki nijedera cokhera sAmane (athavA pariNati upalavdhi kareo) azlIla kAja karacha?”
“tomarA ki yauna kAmanA caritArtha karate nArIdera parivarte puruSadera vyavahAra karacha? Asale tomarA eka varvara janagoSThI|”
era javAve tAra samapradAYa kevala eTAi valechila, “tomarA lUtera parivArake tomAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo; kAraNa tArA var3a pAka-pavitra (!) mAnuSa|”
ataHpara Ami lUta o tAra parivArake rakSA karalAma; tave tAra strIke naYa| yArA pechane raYe giYechila tAdera (athavA dhvaMsaprAptadera) ekajana vale tAke Ami nirdiSTa kare rekhechilAma|
Ara tAdera opara eka (zAstira) vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma| yAderake satarka karA haYechila tAdera (opara) ei vRSTi var3ai khArApa chila|
vala, “sakala prazaMsA AllAhara janya evaM zAnti varSita hoka tA~ra manonIta vAndAdera opara| zreSTha ki AllAha, nA tArA yAderake orA (AllAhara) zarIka sAvyasta kare?”

nAki tinii zreSTha (tinii to zreSTha), yini AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janya AkAza theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karechena| ataHpara Ami tAra sAhAyye sundara sundara vAgAna (vAgAnera gAchapAlA) utpanna karechi| tomarA tAra gAchapAlA utpanna karate pArate nA| AllAhara sAthe (anya) kona upAsya Ache ki? varaM tArA emana eka janagoSThI yArA (AllAhara) samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa (athavA yArA satya theke vicyuta haYa)|

nAki tinii zreSTha (tinii to zreSTha), yini pRthivIke ekaTi vAsasthAna vAniYechena, tAra madhye nada-nadI tairI karechena, tAte sudRr3ha parvatamAlA sthApana karechena evaM (lonA o miThA pAnira) dui samudrera mAjhakhAne ekaTi antarAYa rekhechena| AllAhara sAthe (anya) kona upAsya Ache ki? varaM tAdera adhikAMzai (satya) jAne nA|

nAki tinii zreSTha (tinii to zreSTha), yini Artera DAke sAr3A dena, vipada dUra karena evaM tomAderake pRthivIra uttarAdhikArI karena| AllAhara sAthe (anya) kona upAsya Ache ki? varaM tomarA alpai upadeza grahaNa kara|

nAki tinii zreSTha (tinii to zreSTha), yini tomAderake sthale o samudre (sthalapathe o naupathe) andhakAre patha dekhAna evaM yini svIYa anugrahera (vRSTira) Age susaMvAda (pUrvAbhAsa) hiseve vAtAsa preraNa karena| AllAhara sAthe (anya) kona upAsya Ache ki? tArA (tA~ra sAthe) yA kichu zarIka kare, AllAha tAra Urdhve|

nAki tinii zreSTha (tinii to zreSTha), yini prathamavAra sRSTi karena, tArapara tAra punarAvRtti karavena evaM yini tomAderake AsamAna o jamina theke jIvikA dAna karena| AllAhara sAthe (anya) kona upAsya Ache ki? vala, “tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale tomAdera (dAvira pakSe) pramANa niYe Asa|”
vala, “AllAha chAr3A AsamAna o jaminera keu adRzya viSaYa jAne nA evaM tArA kakhana punarutthita have tAo jAne nA|”
varaM parakAla samparke tAdera jJAna phuriYe geche; varaM e viSaYe tArA sandihAna; varaM e viSaYe tArA andha|
kApherarA vale, “AmarA yakhana mATi haYe yAva, AmAdera vApa-dAdArAo, tAraparao ki AmAderake (kavara theke) vera karA have?”
“AmAderake to ei oYAdAi karA haYeche; AmAdera pUrve AmAdera vApa-dAdAderakeo| eTA pUrvavartIdera upakathA chAr3A Ara kichu naYa|”
vala, “pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekha, aparAdhIdera kI pariNati haYechila!”
Ara tAdera janya duHkha karo nA evaM tAdera Sar3ayantre manaHkSuNna haYo nA|
tArA vale, “tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao, tAhale vala, ei oYAdA kave pUrNa have?”
vale dAo, “tomarA yA tAr3AtAr3i dekhate cAo tAra kichuTA haYato tomAdera piThera opara (khuva kAche) ese geche|”
nizcaYai tomAra prabhu mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla; kintu tAdera adhikAMza (aneke) kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
tAdera antara yA lukiYe rAkhe evaM tArA yA prakAza kare tomAra prabhu nizcaYai tA jAnena|
AsamAna o jamine emana kona adRzya vastu nei yAra kathA eka spaSTa granthe (lAohe mAh‌phUye) lekhA nei|
vanI isarAIla ye sava viSaYe matabheda kare ei koraAna tAra adhikAMzai tAdera janya varNanA kare thAke|
Ara tA muminadera janya avazyai eka dika-nirdezanA o anugraha|
tomAra prabhu tA~ra vidhAna anuyAYI tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare devena| tini parAkramazAlI, mahAjJAnI|
ataeva, AllAhara opara nirbhara kara| nizcaYai tumi spaSTa satyera opara raYecho|
tumi to mRta kiMvA vadhirake DAka zonAte pArave nA, yakhana tArA piTha ghuriYe cale yAYa|

tumi andhaderakeo tAdera pathabhraSTatA theke supathe Anate pArave nA| tumi kevala tAderakei (kathA) zonAte pArave yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha (athavA AYAtasamUha) vizvAsa kare; kAraNa tArA (satyera janya) nivedita|

yakhana tAdera viruddhe (zAstira) oYAdA vAstavAYita have (tAdera zAstira samaYa have) takhana Ami tAdera janya bhUmi theke ekaTi prANI vera karava, ye tAdera sAthe kathA valave; ejanya ye, mAnuSa AmAra nidarzanasamUha dRr3habhAve vizvAsa karata nA|
(smaraNa karo) yedina Ami pratyeka jAti theke ekaTi kare dala ekatrita karava, tAdera theke yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa karata; ataHpara tAderake bhAge bhAge vinyasta karA have|
avazeSe tArA yakhana (AllAhara sAmane) upasthita have takhana tini valavena, “tomarA ki bhAlabhAve nA jenei AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA valechile? nAki tomarA anya kichu karachile?”
tAdera viruddhe (zAstira) oYAdA vAstavAYita havei, kAraNa tArA anyAYa kareche; tAi tArA (nijedera pakSe) kathA valate pArave nA|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami rAta diYechi tAdera vizrAma karAra janya evaM dina diYechi (savakichu) dekhAra janya| ete ImAnadAra lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|
(smaraNa karo) yedina siGgAYa phu~ deoYA have evaM AllAha yAderake cAivena tArA vyatIta AsamAna o jaminera savAi ghAvar3e yAve Ara vinIta avasthAYa savAi tA~ra kAche Asave|

tumi pAhAr3a dekhe tAke nizcala mane karo, athaca (siGgAYa phu~ dile) tA meghera mata calamAna have| AllAhara kAja, yini savakichu nipuNabhAve karechena| tomarA yA kichu karo nizcaYai tini tA avagata Achena|
yArA bhAla kAja niYe Asave tArA tAra ceYeo bhAla pratidAna pAve evaM sedina tArA bhaYa theke nirApada thAkave|
Ara yArA khArApa kAja niYe Asave tAderake adhomukha kare jAhAnnAme nikSepa karA have| (tAderake valA have) “tomarA yA karate tomAderake kevala tArai pratiphala deoYA have|”

(vala,) “AmAke Adeza deoYA haYeche yena ei nagarIra prabhura ivAdata kari, yini eke pavitra karechena| tinii savakichura mAlika| AmAke Arao Adeza deoYA haYeche yena musalimadera (AtmasamarpaNakArIdera) antarbhukta hai;
Ara koraAna telAoYAta kari|” ataeva, ye satpatha anusaraNa kare se nijera kalyANera janyai satpatha anusaraNa kare| Ara keu vipathagAmI hale tumi valo, “Ami to kevala ekajana satarkakArI|”
Ara vala, “sakala prazaMsA AllAhara| tini acirei tomAderake tA~ra nidarzana dekhAvena evaM tomarA tA cinate pArave|” tomarA yA karo se samparke tomAra prabhu vekhavara nana|”
tvA sIna mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
egulo spaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
Ami muminadera janya tomAra kAche mUsA o pherAunera kichu satya ghaTanA varNanA karachi|

pherAuna jamine avAdhya haYechila evaM tAra adhivAsIderake vibhinna dale vibhakta kare tAdera ekaTi dalake (vanI isarAIlake) durvala kare rekhechila| se tAdera chelederake hatyA karata evaM nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| se chila azAnti sRSTikArIdera anyatama|
yAderake jamine durvala kare rAkhA haYechila Ami cAilAma tAdera prati anugraha karate, tAderake netA vAnAte, tAderake (jaminera) uttarAdhikArI karate,
jamine tAdera avasthAna zaktizAlI karate evaM pherAuna, hAmAna o e duJcajanera vAhinIke tAdera pakSa theke tAi dekhAte yA tArA bhaYa karata|

Ami mUsAra mAYera kAche Adeza pAThAlAma, “tAke vukera dudha pAna karAo| (tave) yakhana tAra janya (vipadera) AzaMkA karave takhana tAke nadIte phele dio| (kona) bhaYa kiMvA duHkha karo nA| Ami tAke tomAra kAche phiriYe deva evaM tAke ekajana rasUla vAnAva|”
ataHpara pherAunera parivAra zizu mUsAke (nadI theke) tule nila, (bhaviSyate) ye tAdera zatru o duHkhera kAraNa have| nizcaYai pherAuna, hAmAna o tAdera vAhinI aparAdhI chila|

pherAunera strI valala, “(zizuTi) AmAra o tomAra naYanera prazAnti| eke mero nA| se AmAdera upakAre Asate pAre, nA haYa AmarA tAke santAna hiseve grahaNa karava|” Asale tArA (era pariNAma) vujhate pAreni|
mUsAra mAYera mana (anya sava bhAvanA theke) zUnya haYe gela| se to chelera paricaYa prakAza karei dita, yadi nA Ami tAra mana zakta kare ditAma, yAte se AsthAzIla thAke|
se mUsAra vonake valechila, “oke anusaraNa karo (dekhe rAkha)|” se tAke dUra theke dekhata| tArA (pherAunera lokerA) tA vujhate pArata nA|

Ami Age thekei (dhAtrIdera) stanyapAna theke tAke virata rekhechilAma| tAi mUsAra vona (pherAunera parivArera lokaderake) valala, “Ami ki ApanAderake emana ekaTi parivArera sandhAna deva yArA ApanAdera janya oke lAlanapAlanera dAYitva neve evaM tArA ora hitAkAMkSIo have?”
ebhAve Ami tAke tAra mAYera kAche phiriYe dilAma, yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa evaM se duHkha nA kare Ara nizcita haYa ye, AllAhara oYAdA satya; tave aneka mAnuSa (tA) jAne nA|
mUsA yakhana pariNata vaYase upanIta hala evaM supuruSa hala takhana Ami tAke prajJA o jJAna dAna karalAma| ebhAvei Ami satkarmazIladera puraskAra diYe thAki|

vAsindArA asatarka thAkAkAle mUsA zahare praveza karala| sekhAne se duJcajana lokake mArAmAri karate dekhe| ekajana tAra nijera dalera (vanI isarAIlera) evaM anyajana tAra zatrupakSera| tAra nijera dalera lokaTi tAra zatrupakSera lokaTira viruddhe tAra sAhAyya cAYa| mUsA takhana lokaTike ghuSi mere hatyA kare vase| (sAthe sAthe) se vale, “eTA zaYatAnera kAja| nizcaYai se (mAnuSera janya) eka vibhrAntakArI spaSTa zatru|”
se valala, “he AmAra prabhu! Ami to AmAra nijera prati anyAYa kare phelechi| ataeva, tumi AmAke kSamA kara|” takhana tini tAke kSamA kare dena| nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
