se valala, “he AmAra prabhu! yehetu tumi AmAke anugraha karecho, tAi Ami kakhanao aparAdhIdera sAhAyyakArI hava nA|”

(paradina) sakAle zahare se bhaYe bhaYe savakichu paryavekSaNa karachila| emana samaYa haThAt zunate pAYa, ye lokaTi gatakAla tAra kAche sAhAyya ceYechila se (Ajao AvAra) tAra sAhAyyera janya citkAra karache| mUsA tAke valala, “tumi to ekaTA Asta vipathagAmI loka|”

tArapara se yakhana sei lokaTike dharate cAila ye tAdera duJcajanerai zatru, takhana se valala, “he mUsA! tumi ki AmAke hatyA karate cAo nAki, yemana gatakAla ekajanake hatyA karecho? tumi to kevala duniYAYa eka secchAcArI hate cAo, zAnti sthApanakArI hate cAo nA|”

(e samaYa) zaharera dUra prAnta theke eka vyakti chuTe ela| se valala, “he mUsA! (rAjyera) pAriSadavarga tomAke hatyA karAra janya zalA-parAmarza karache| ataeva, tumi (zahara theke) vera haYe yAo| Ami tomAra ekajana hitAkAMkSI|”
takhana se bhaYe bhaYe sekhAna theke vera haYe cArapAzera ghaTanAvalI paryavekSaNa karate thAke| (takhana) se valala, “prabhu! AmAke jAlema lokadera (hAta) theke rakSA kara|”
yakhana se mAd‌iYAna abhimukhe raoYAnA karala takhana valala, “AzA kari AmAra prabhu AmAke saThika patha dekhAvena|”

Ara yakhana se mAd‌iYAnera pAnira (kUpera) kAche gela takhana sekhAne dekhala, ekadala loka (tAdera pazuderake) pAni pAna karAcche| tAdera pAzei se dujana mahilAkeo dekhala, yArA (tAdera pazuguloke) sariYe rAkhache| mUsA mahilAdvaYake valala, “tomAdera vyApAra ki?” tArA valala, “AmarA (AmAdera pazuguloke) pAni pAna karAte pArachi nA, yatakSaNa nA rAkhAlerA (tAdera pazuderake) vera kare neYa| AmAdera pitA ekajana ati vRddha mAnuSa|”

mUsA takhana tAdera haYe (tAdera pazuderake) pAni pAna kariYe deYa| tArapara se chAYAra dike cale yAYa evaM vale, “prabhu! tumi AmAke ye kalyANai dAo nA kena Ami tAra abhAvI (Ami tomAra ye kona dAnerai mukhApekSI)|”

erapara mahilAdvaYera (dui vonera) ekajana salajja padakSepe tAra kAche ela evaM valala, “Apani ye AmAdera haYe (AmAdera pazudera) pAni pAna kariYechena tAra puraskAra dite AmAra vAvA ApanAke DAkachena|” tArapara se yakhana tAra kAche ela evaM (nijera) sava vRttAnta tAra kAche khule valala takhana se valala, “bhaYa karo nA; tumi jAlema lokadera kavala theke rakSA peYecho|”
dui vonera ekajana valala, “vAvA! eke tumi kAje rekhe dAo| era mata zaktizAlI o vizvasta lokai tomAra savaceYe bhAla kAjera loka have|”

se valala, “Ami AmAra ei dui meYera ekajanake tomAra sAthe ei zarte viYe dite cAi ye, tumi ATa vachara AmAra kAja karave| (kAjera meYAda) tumi yadi (nijera icchAYa) daza vachara pUrNa karo tAo karate pArave| tave Ami tomAke kaSTa dite cAi nA| AllAhara icchAYa AmAke tumi ekajana satloka hisevei pAve|”
mUsA valala, “AmAra o ApanAra mAjhe ai cuktii thAkala| Ami dui meYAdera ye konaTi pUrNa karale AmAra prati kona avicAra karA yAve nA| AmarA yA valachi AllAha tAra jAmina|”

mUsA yakhana tAra (kAjera) meYAda pUrNa kare saparivAre yAtrA karala takhana (pathimadhye) tUra parvatera dika theke ekaTA Aguna dekhate pela| se tAra parivArake valala, “tomarA (ekhAne) thAka; Ami ekaTA Aguna dekhate peYechi; haYato sekhAna theke kona saMvAda Anate pArava athavA Aguna theke eka TukarA jvalanta kATha niYe Asate pArava, yAte tomarA tApa nite pAra|”
ataHpara se yakhana Agunera kAche gela takhana pavitra bhUkhaNDe upatyakAra DAna dikera gAcha theke tAke samvodhana kare valA hala, “he mUsA! Amii vizvajagatera prabhu AllAha|”

Aro valA hala, “tomAra lAThiTA nikSepa kara|” ataHpara se yakhana lAThiTAke ekaTA sApera mata nar3Acar3A karate dekhala takhana se ghure cale ela, Ara phire tAkAlo nA| (tAke valA hala,) “he mUsA! sAmane agrasara hao, bhaYa karo nA; tumi avazyai AzaMkAmukta|”

“tomAra hAta tomAra vagale DhukAo; dekhave, kona truTi chAr3Ai tA sAdA haYe veriYe Asave| Ara bhaYa dUra karAra janya tomAra vAhu (hAta) nijera (vukera) sAthe lAgiYe dhara| e duTi hala tomAra prabhura pakSa theke pherAuna o tAra pAriSadavargera janya duTi pramANa| orA to katagulo pApAcArI mAnuSa|”
mUsA valala, “prabhu! Ami to odera ekajanake hatyA karechi| sejanya Ami bhaYa karachi, orA AmAke mere phelave|”
“Ara AmAra bhAi hArUna, tAra bhASA AmAra ceYe adhika sAvalIla| ataeva, AmAke samarthana karAra janya ekajana sAhAyyakArI hiseve tAke AmAra sAthe pAThAo| AmAra AzaMkA, tArA AmAke avizvAsa karave|”

AllAha valalena, “avazyai Ami tomAra bhAiYera dvArA tomAra vAhu (hAta) zaktizAlI karava evaM tomAdera duJcajanake kSamatA deva, yAte tArA tomAdera kAche pau~chAte nA pAre| AmAra nidarzanAvalIra jore tomarA evaM tomAdera anusArIrAi vijaYI have|”
ataHpara mUsA yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra spaSTa nidarzanasamUha niYe ela takhana tArA valala, “e to udbhAvita yAdu chAr3A Ara kichu naYa| AmarA AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera mAjhe to esava zunini|”
mUsA valala, “AmAra prabhu savaceYe bhAla jAnena, ke tA~ra kAcha theke hedAYeta niYe eseche evaM parakAle kAra pariNati bhAla have| nizcaYai jAlemarA saphala have nA|”

pherAuna valala, “he pAriSadavarga! Ami chAr3A tomAdera anya kona upAsyera kathA AmAra jAnA nei| hAmAna! tumi AmAra janya iTa por3Ao evaM ekaTi u~cu TAoYAra tairI karo, yAte Ami (sekhAna theke) mUsAra upAsyake dekhate pAri| tave Ami tAke avazyai ekajana mithyAvAdI mane kari|”
pherAuna o tAra sainyarA pRthivIte anyAYa ahaMkAra karechila evaM tArA bhevechila, tAderake AmAra kAche phiriYe AnA have nA|
tAi Ami tAke o tAra sainyaderake pAkar3Ao kari evaM tAderake samudre nikSepa kari| ataeva dekha, jAlemadera pariNati kemana haYechila|
tAderake Ami netA vAniYechilAma, yArA (mAnuSake) jAhAnnAmera dike DAkata| keYAmatera dina tAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|
ei duniYAYa Ami tAdera pechane lAgiYe rekhechi eka abhizApa; Ara keYAmatera dina tArA have durdazAgrasta|
pUrvavartI prajanmasamUhake dhvaMsa karAra para Ami mUsAke mAnuSera janya jJAnavartikA, pathanirdeza o rahamatasvarUpa kitAva (tAorAta) diYechi, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
yakhana Ami mUsAra kAche nirdeza pau~che diYechilAma takhana tumi (tUra pAhAr3era) pazcima prAnte chile nA evaM tumi pratyakSadarzIo chile nA|

kintu Ami (mUsAra para) aneka prajanma sRSTi karechi evaM tAdera opara diYe aneka samaYao ativAhita haYeche| Ara mAd‌iYAnavAsIderake AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha kare zonAnora janya tumi tAdera madhye vasavAsa karani| kintu Ami rasUla preraNakArI chilAma|

Ami yakhana (mUsAke) samvodhana karechilAma takhana tumi tUra pAhAr3era pAze chile nA| kintu (tomAke pAThAno haYeche) tomAra prabhura pakSa theke rahamatasvarUpa, yAte tumi emana eka samapradAYake satarka karate pAra yAdera kAche tomAra pUrve kona satarkakArI Aseni, yena tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

yadi (tomAke pAThAno) nA hata tAhale tAdera kRtakarmera janya tAdera kona vipada ele tArA valata, “he AmAdera prabhu! tumi AmAdera kAche kona rasUla pAThAle nA kena? tAhale AmarA tomAra AYAtasamUha mene calatAma evaM muminadera antarbhukta hatAma|”

kintu yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra pakSa theke satya ela takhana tArA valala, “mUsAke yA deoYA haYechila e rasUlake temanaTi deoYA haYani kena?” pUrve mUsAke yA deoYA haYechila tArA ki tA avizvAsa kareni? tArA valeche, “(tAorAta o koraAna) duTi yAdu, yAdera ekaTi ArekaTira sahAYaka|” tArA Aro valeche, “AmarA pratyekaTi avizvAsa kari|”
vala, “tAhale tomarA AllAhara kAcha theke ai dui kitAva theke bhAla dika-nirdezaka kona kitAva Ana, Ami tA anusaraNa karava; yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|”

takhana yadi tArA tomAra kathAYa sAr3A nA deYa tAhale jAnave, tArA zudhu nijedera pravRttirai anusaraNa kare| Ara AllAhara pathanirdeza nA mene ye nija pravRttira anusaraNa kare tAra ceYe adhika pathabhraSTa ke Ache? AllAha jAlemaderake patha dekhAna nA|
Ami to tAdera kAche vANI pau~che diYechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
koraAnera pUrve Ami yAderake kitAva diYechilAma tArA eke vizvAsa kare|

yakhana tAdera kAche eTA (ei koraAna) pATha karA haYa takhana tArA vale, “AmarA eTA vizvAsa karechi| nizcaYai eTA AmAdera prabhura kAcha theke Agata satya| AmarA era Ageo musalima (AtmasamarpaNakArI) chilAma|”
yehetu tArA kaSTa sahya kareche tAi tAderake duivAra puraskAra deoYA have| tArA bhAla dvArA manda pratihata kare evaM tAderake yA dAna karechi tA theke vyaYa kare|
tArA yakhana vAje kathA zone takhana tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa Ara vale, “AmAdera janya AmAdera kAja evaM tomAdera janya tomAdera kAja| tomAderake sAlAma| AmarA mUrkhadera (saGga) cAi nA|”
tumi yAke pachanda karo (icchA karalei) tAke supathe Anate pAra nA; varaM AllAhai yAke cAna supathe Anena| Ara tinii supathaprAptadera bhAla jAnena|

tArA vale, “AmarA yadi tomAra sAthe supatha anusaraNa kari tAhale AmAderake AmAdera bhUmi theke utkhAta karA have|” Ami ki tAdera janya ekaTi nirApada pavitra sthAna (makkA nagarI) pratiSThita karini, yekhAne AmAra deoYA jIvikAsvarUpa savarakamera phala-phalAdi niYe AsA haYa?” kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|

Ami kata janapada dhvaMsa karechi, yAra adhivAsIrA tAdera jIvanopakaraNa niYe dambha karata! ai to tAdera gharavAr3i| okhAne tAdera pare khuva kama lokai vasavAsa kareche| Amii (tAra) uttarAdhikArI Achi|

tomAra prabhu janapadasamUha dhvaMsa karena nA, yatakSaNa paryanta tAra kenedra tini ekajana rasUla nA pAThAna, ye lokaderake AmAra AYAtasamUha par3e zonAYa| temani adhivAsIrA jAlema nA hale Ami kona janapada dhvaMsa kari nA|
tomAderake yA deoYA haYeche tA to kevala pArthiva jIvanera bhoga Ara zobhA| pakSAntare, AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA Aro bhAla o sthAYI| tavu ki tomarA vojha nA?

yAke Ami uttama (puraskArera) oYAdA diYechi, yA se pAvei, se ki emana vyaktira samAna, yAke Ami pArthiva jIvanera bhogera sAmagrI diYechi evaM pare (tAra hisAvera janya) tAke keYAmatera dina hAjira karA have?
(smaraNa karo) yedina AllAha tAderake Deke valavena, “tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka vale dAvi karate tArA (Aja) kothAYa?”

yAdera vyApAre zAstira kathA avadhArita haYeche tArA valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! ederakei AmarA vibhrAnta karechilAma| AmarA ederake vibhrAnta karechilAma, yemana AmarA nijerAo vibhrAnta haYechilAma| (Aja) AmarA tomAra sAmane (tAdera vyApAre) dAYamukta hate cAi| (Asale) tArA AmAdera ivAdata karata nA|”
valA have, “tomAdera zarIkadera DAka|” tArA tAderake DAkave; kintu tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A deve nA evaM tArA AjAva dekhate pAve| hAYa! tArA yadi saThika pathe calata!
Ara (smaraNa karo) yedina AllAha tAderake Deke valavena, “tomarA rasUladerake kI javAva diYechile?”
takhana tAdera kAche (AtmapakSa samarthanera janya praYojanIYa) sakala tathya aspaSTa haYe yAve evaM tArA eke aparake jijJAsAo karate pArave nA|
tave ye taovA karechila evaM ImAna enechila o satkAja karechila, AzA karA yAYa, se saphalakAma have|
tomAra prabhu yA icchA Ara pachanda karena tAi sRSTi karena| tAdera kona pachandera svAdhInatA nei| AllAha kata mahAna! tArA (tA~ra sAthe) yA zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|
Ara tAdera antara yA lukiYe rAkhe evaM tArA yA prakAza kare tomAra prabhu tA (sava) jAnena|
tinii AllAha| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| prathame o zeSe (ihakAla o parakAle) sakala prazaMsA tA~rai| hukumao tA~rai evaM tA~rai kAche tomAderake phire yete have|
vala, “AmAke vala, AllAha yadi rAtake tomAdera janya keYAmatera dina paryanta avirAma karena tAhale AllAha chAr3A kon‌ upAsya Ache ye tomAderake Alo ene dite pAre? tavuo ki tomarA zunave nA?”

vala, “AmAke vala, AllAha yadi dinake tomAdera janya keYAmatera dina paryanta avirAma karena tAhale AllAha chAr3A kon‌ upAsya Ache ye vizrAmera janya tomAderake rAta ene dite pAre? tavuo ki tomarA (bheve) dekhave nA?”

tini tA~ra anugrahe tomAdera janya rAta o dina tairI karechena yena tomarA tAte (rAtrikAle) vizrAma nite pAra o (dinera velAYa) tAra anugraha (jIvikA) sandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
(smaraNa karo) yedina tini tAderake Deke valavena, “tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka vale dAvi karate tArA (Aja) kothAYa?”

Ami pratyeka samapradAYa theke ekajana sAkSI vera karava evaM valava, “tomAdera pramANa niYe esa|” takhana tArA jAnate pArave ye, satya (ekamAtra) AllAhara pakSe, evaM tArA (upAsya vale) yA kichu udbhAvana karata tA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe yAve|

kArUna chila mUsAra dalerai ekajana| kintu se tAdera prati uddhata AcaraNa karechila| Ami tAke eta dhanabhANDAra diYechilAma yAra cAvi vahana karate ekadala zaktizAlI lokao klAnta hata| (smaraNa karo) yakhana tAra lokerA tAke valechila, “(sampada niYe) eta ullAsa karo nA; AllAha ullAsakArIdera pachanda karena nA|”

“AllAha tomAke yA dAna karechena tA diYe parakAlera (sukhera) AvAsa sandhAna kara| duniYAYa tomAra aMza (vaidha bhogera parimANa) bhule yeYo nA| AllAha tomAra prati yemana anugraha karechena tumio (mAnuSera prati) temana anugraha kara| Ara jamine golayoga sRSTi karate ceYo nA| AllAha golayoga sRSTikArIdera pachanda karena nA|”

se valala, “AmAra jJAna Ache valei AmAke sampada deoYA haYeche|” se ki jAnate pAreni ye, AllAha tAra pUrvavartI prajanmasamUhera emana lokaderao dhvaMsa kare diYechena yArA tAra ceYe vezi zaktizAlI o adhika janavalera adhikArI chila? aparAdhIderake tAdera aparAdha samparke jijJesa karA have nA| (AllAha sava jAnena vale aparAdhIderake jijJesa nA karei tAdera aparAdhera zAsti devena|)

ataHpara se (kArUna) tAra vezabhUSA niYe tAra samapradAYera lokadera sAmane vera hala| yArA pArthiva jIvana (jIvanera bhoga-vilAsa) kAmanA karata tArA valala, “AhA, kArUnake yemana (aizvarya) deoYA haYeche AmAdera yadi temanaTi thAkata! nizcaYai se var3a bhAgyavAna|”

kintu yAderake jJAna deoYA haYechila tArA valala, “dhika tomAderake! yArA (AllAha o tA~ra vidhAnake) vizvAsa kare evaM satkAja kare tAdera janya AllAhara puraskArai uttama| e puraskAra kevala dhairyazIlarAi pAve|”
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra vAr3igharake bhUgarbhe dAviYe dilAma| takhana AllAhara (icchAra) vipakSe tAke sAhAyya karAra janya kona dala chila nA evaM se nijeo nijeke rakSA karate pArala nA|

yArA Agera dinai tAra mata haoYAra AkAMkSA vyakta karechila tArA valate lAgala, “Are! AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA jIvikA prasArita karena evaM (yAra janya icchA tA) sImita karena| AllAha yadi AmAdera prati anugraha nA karatena tAhale (kArUnera mata) AmAderakeo bhUgarbhe dAviYe ditena| Are! kApherarA saphalakAma haYa nA|”
sei parakAlera AvAsa (jAnnAta) Ami tAdera janyai varAdda karava yArA pRthivIte auddhatya dekhAte kiMvA phesAda sRSTi karate cAYa nA| Ara (bhAla) pariNAma mottAkIdera janya|
yArA bhAla kAja kare tArA tAra ceYeo bhAla phala (puraskAra) pAve; Ara yArA khArApa kAja kare tArA yA kareche kevala tArai phala (zAsti) pAve|

yini tomAra opara koraAna (koraAnera vidhAna) pharaya karechena tini avazyai tomAke pherAra jAYagAYa (janmabhUmi makkAYa athavA mRtyura para jAnnAte) phiriYe nevena| vala, “AmAra prabhu bhAla kare jAnena, ke hedAYeta niYe eseche evaM ke spaSTa vibhrAntite raYeche|”
tomAra prabhura anugraha nA hale tomAra kAche ye kitAva nAyila karA have eTA to tumi AzAo karate nA| ataeva, kichutei tumi kApheradera sAhAyyakArI haYo nA|
Ara tomAra kAche AllAhara AYAta nAyila haoYAra para tA theke tArA yena tomAke phiriYe nA rAkhe| tumi tomAra prabhura dike (mAnuSake) DAka evaM kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA|
AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsyake Deko nA| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| ekamAtra tA~ra sattA chAr3A Ara savakichui dhvaMsa haYe yAve| siddhAnta tA~rai, evaM tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phire yete have|
Alipha lAma mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, “AmarA ImAna enechi” valalei tAderake avyAhati deoYA have evaM tAderake parIkSA karA have nA?
tAdera pUrve yArA chila Ami to tAderakeo parIkSA karechilAma| AllAha avazyai satyavAdI Ara mithyAvAdIderake (suspaSTabhAve) jene nevena|
nAki yArA khArApa kAja kare tArA mane kare ye, tArA AmAke pechane phelave? tAdera ei dhAraNA kata khArApa!
ye AllAhara sAkSAt AzA kare se jene rAkhuka, AllAhara nirdhArita samaYa avazyai Asave| tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
ye ceSTA kare se nijera janyai ceSTA kare| (kAro ceSTAra phala AllAha bhoga karavena nA|) AllAha to vizvajagat theke amukhApekSI|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare Ami tAdera aparAdhasamUha mArjanA kare deva evaM tArA ye (bhAla) kAja karata tAra utkRSTatama pratidAna deva|

Ami mAnuSake tAra pitAmAtAra sAthe bhAla AcaraNa karate valechi| tave tArA yadi tomAke AmAra sAthe emana kichu zarIka karate vale ye samparke tomAra kona jJAna nei tAhale tumi tAdera Anugatya karave nA| AmAra kAchei tomarA phire Asave| takhana avazyai Ami tomAderake tomAdera atIta kRtakarma avahita karava|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare Ami avazyai tAderake satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karava|

kichu mAnuSa Ache yArA vale, “AmarA AllAhara prati ImAna enechi|” kintu yakhana tArA AllAhara pathe nipIr3ita haYa takhana tArA mAnuSera nipIr3anake AllAhara AyAvera nyAYa gaNya kare| Ara yakhana tomAra prabhura pakSa theke kona sAhAyya (vA vijaYa) Ase takhana tArA vale, “AmarA to tomAdera sAthei chilAma|” AllAha ki vizvavAsIra antarera kathA samyaka avagata nana?
avazyai AllAha muminaderakeo jAnena Ara monAphekaderakeo jAnena|
kApherarA muminaderake vale, “tomarA AmAdera patha anusaraNa karo; AmarA tomAdera pApa vahana karava|” Asale tArA tAdera (muminadera) kona pApa vahana karave nA| tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
tArA vahana karave tAdera (nijedera) vojhA evaM tAdera vojhAra sAthe Aro kichu vojhA| Ara tArA ye sava mithyA udbhAvana karata se samparke tAderake keYAmatera dina jijJAsA karA have|

Ami to nUhake tAra samapradAYera kAche (navI hiseve) pAThiYechilAma| se tAdera mAjhe eka hAjAra vacharera ceYe paJcAza vachara kama (naYazata paJcAza vachara) avasthAna karechila| ataHpara tArA plAvanera kavale par3ala| Ara tArA chila jAlema|
Ami tAke o (tAra sAthe) jAhAjera ArohIderake rakSA karalAma evaM jAhAjaTike sArA vizvavAsIra janya ekaTi nidarzana vAniYe rAkhalAma|
Ara (smaraNa karo) ivarAhImera kathA; yakhana se tAra samapradAYake valechila, “tomarA AllAhara ivAdata karo evaM tA~ke bhaYa kara| eTAi tomAdera janya bhAla, yadi tomarA jAnate|”

“tomarA to AllAhara parivarte katagulo mUrtira pUjA karacha Ara mithyA udbhAvana karacha| AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAdera pUjA karacha tArA to tomAdera jIvikAra mAlika naYa| ataeva, tomarA AllAhara kAche jIvikA cAo evaM tA~ra ivAdata karo o tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phire yete have|”

“tomarA yadi (tomAdera rasUlake) avizvAsa karo tAte avAka haoYAra kichu nei; kAraNa tomAdera pUrvavartI jAtiguloo (tAdera rasUladerake) avizvAsa karechila| spaSTabhAve vArtA pau~che deoYA chAr3A rasUlera kona dAYa-dAYitva nei|”
tArA ki (cintA kare) dekheni, kIbhAve AllAha sRSTi zuru karena, tArapara tAra punarAvRtti karena? eTA to AllAhara janya sahaja|
vala, “tomarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo Ara dekha, kIbhAve tini sRSTi zuru karechilena|” AllAha AvAra sRSTi karavena paravartI sRSTi| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
tini yAke icchA zAsti dena evaM yAke icchA anugraha karena| Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
tomarA jamine kiMvA AsamAne AllAhake akSama karate pArave nA (tA~ra zAsti theke pAlAte pArave nA)| Ara AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI nei|
yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha o tA~ra sAkSAt avizvAsa kare tArAi AmAra rahamata theke nirAza haYa evaM tAderai janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

(ivarAhIma tAra samapradAYake AllAhara dvInera dAoYAta deoYAra para) tAra samapradAYa kona javAva nA diYe zudhu valala, “tAke hatyA karo athavA pur3iYe dAo”| AllAha tAke Aguna theke rakSA karechilena| ai ghaTanAra madhye ImAnadAra lokadera janya avazyai aneka nidarzana Ache|

ivarAhIma valechila, “tomarA to pArthiva jIvane nijedera pArasparika bhAlavAsAra khAtire AllAhara parivarte katagulo mUrtike (upAsyarUpe) grahaNa karecho| kintu keYAmatera dina tomarA eke aparake asvIkAra karave evaM eke aparake abhizApa deve| Ara tomAdera vAsasthAna have jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|”
takhana lUta tAra prati ImAna Anala| ivarAhIma valala, “Ami AmAra prabhura uddezye dezatyAga karachi| nizcaYai tini parAkramazAlI, mahAjJAnI|”

Ami tAra janya isahAka o iYAkUvake dAna karalAma, tAra vaMzadharadera madhye navuoYAta o kitAva (deva vale) nirdhAraNa karalAma evaM duniYAYa tAke tAra (yogya) puraskAra dilAma| Ara AkherAteo se nizcaYai sat lokadera antarbhukta have|
Ara (smaraNa karo) lUtera kathA; yakhana se tAra samapradAYake valechila, “nizcaYai tomarA emana eka azlIla kAja karacha yA tomAdera pUrve sArA viztera keu kareni|”

“tomarA ki (kAma-lAlasA pUraNe nArIdera parivarte) puruSaderake vyavahAra karo, rAhAjAni karo evaM nijedera majalise ghRNya kAja karo?” era javAvera parivarte tAra samapradAYa zudhu valala, “tumi satyavAdI hale AmAdera opara AllAhara AjAva niYe Asa|”
lUta valala, “prabhu! anartha sRSTikArI lokadera viruddhe AmAke sAhAyya kara|”
yakhana AmAra dUterA ivarAhImera kAche susaMvAda niYe ela takhana tArA valala, “AmarA ei janapadera adhivAsIderake dhvaMsa kare deva| nizcaYai era adhivAsIrA jAlema|”

ivarAhIma valala, “sekhAne to lUta Ache|” tArA valala, “sekhAne ke Ache AmarA tA bhAla jAni| AmarA tAke o tAra parivArake avazyai rakSA karava| tave tAra strIke naYa| se pechane theke-yAoYA (zAsti kavalita) lokadera madhye thAkave|”

yakhana AmAra dUterA lUtera kAche ela takhana se tAderake niYe cintAYa par3ala evaM tAdera vyApAre saMkaTApanna vodha karala| (kuabhyAsagrasta lokadera hAta theke sudarzana Agantukadera rakSAra vyApAre AzaMkita hala|) tArA valala, “bhaYa karavena nA, cintAo karavena nA| AmarA ApanAke o ApanAra parivArake rakSA karava| tave ApanAra strIke naYa| se pechane theke-yAoYA (zAsti kavalita) lokadera madhye thAkave|”
“AmarA ei janapadera adhivAsIdera opara tAdera pApAcArera kAraNe AsamAna theke zAsti nAyila karava|”
vuddhimAna lokadera janya Ami ai janapadera ekaTi spaSTa nidarzana rekhe diYechi|

Ara mAd‌iYAnera (adhivAsIdera) prati tAdera bhAi zoYAivake pAThiYechilAma| se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ivAdata karo, zeSa dinera (puraskArera) AzA rAkha evaM pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi karo nA|”
kintu tArA tAke mithyAvAdI vale| ataHpara tAdera opara bhUmikampera AghAta Ase evaM tArA nijedera vAr3ighare upura haYe par3e thAke|

Ara (Ami dhvaMsa karechi) Ada o chAmUdakeo| tAdera (dhvaMsaprApta) vAr3ighara theke tomAdera kAche tA spaSTa haYeche| zaYatAna tAdera (khArApa) kAjakarma tAdera kAche zobhanIYa karechila evaM tAderake satpatha avalamvana theke virata rekhechila, athaca tArA dRSTisampanna chila|
(Ami dhvaMsa karechi) kArUna, pherAuna o hAmAnake| mUsA tAdera kAche pramANa upasthita karechila| takhana tArA jamine ahaMkAra karechila; kintu Age yete pAreni (zAsti er3Ate pAreni|)

pratyekakei tAra aparAdhera janya dharechilAma (zAsti diYechilAma)| tAdera madhye katakera opara zilAjhar3a pAThiYechilAma; katakake ghAYela karechila bhaYaMkara AoYAja; katakake bhUgarbhe dAviYe diYechilAma; AvAra katakake pAnite DuviYe diYechilAma| AllAha tAdera opara kona juluma karena ni; varaM tArAi nijedera opara juluma karechila|

yArA AllAhara parivarte anyAnya abhibhAvaka grahaNa kare tAdera avasthA hala mAkar3asAra avasthAra mata, ye (nijera janya) ekaTi ghara vAnAYa| Ara mAkar3asAra gharai hala savaceYe durvala ghara, yadi tArA jAnata!
AllAhara parivarte yata kichukei tArA DAke AllAha tA jAnena| tini parAkrama-zAlI, mahAjJAnI|
Ara esava udAharaNa Ami mAnuSera janya diYe thAki; tave kevala jJAnIrAi tA vujhate pAre|
AllAha AsamAna o jamina yathArthabhAve sRSTi karechena| ete muminadera janya avazyai eka nidarzana Ache|

tomAra kAche ye kitAva (koraAna) nAyila karA haYeche tA pATha karo evaM nAmAya kAYema kara| nizcaYai nAmAya azlIlatA o khArApa kAja theke virata rAkhe| AllAhara smaraNai savaceYe var3a| Ara tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tA jAnena|

kitAvadhArIdera (ihudi o khriSTAnadera) sAthe kevala uttama panthAYa (bhadrabhAve o yukti sahakAre) vitarka karave; tave tAdera madhye yArA jAlema tAdera sAthe naYa| Ara valave, “AmAdera kAche yA nAyila karA haYeche (koraAna) evaM tomAdera kAche yA nAyila karA haYeche (tAorAta o inajIla) AmarA tA vizvAsa kari| AmAdera upAsya o tomAdera upAsya ekajanai (AllAha) evaM AmarA tA~rai anugata|”

ebhAvei Ami tomAra kAche kitAva (koraAna) nAyila karechi| Ara yAderake (itipUrve) kitAva (tAorAta o inajIla) diYechilAma tArA (ihudi o khriSTAnarA) tA vizvAsa kare| edera (vartamAna makkAvAsIdera) madhyeo keu keu tA vizvAsa kare thAke| zudhumAtra kApherarAi AmAra AYAtasamUha asvIkAra kare|

tumi to era (ei koraAnera) Age kona kitAva pATha karani| nijera hAteo tumi tA likhacha nA| temana hale nA haYa vAtilapanthIrA sandeha poSaNa karate pArata| (yehetu temana naYa, tAi tAdera sandehapoSaNa ekevArei ayauktika|)
varaM e hala jJAnIdera antare (rakSita) spaSTa nidarzana| zudhumAtra jAlemarAi AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra kare|
tArA vale, “tAra kAche tAra prabhura pakSa theke nidarzana pAThAno haYani kena?” vala, “nidarzana AllAhara kAchei Ache| Ami to kevala ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|”
Ami ye tomAra kAche kitAva (koraAna) nAyila karechi yA tAderake par3e zonAno haYa, eTA ki tAdera janya yatheSTa naYa? ImAnadAra lokadera janya era madhye avazyai rahamata o upadeza Ache|

vala, “AmAra o tomAdera mAjhe sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa| AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tini tA (savai) jAnena| Ara yArA mithyAYa vizvAsa kare evaM AllAhake avizvAsa kare tArAi (prakRta) kSatigrasta|”

tArA tomAke (tAdera janya) druta zAsti niYe Asate vale| yadi ekaTi samaYa nirdhArita nA thAkata tAhale zAsti tAdera opara esei yeta| nizcaYai tA tAdera opara haThAt neme Asave, yA tArA jAnatei pArave nA|
tArA tomAke druta zAsti niYe Asate vale, athaca jAhAnnAma kApheraderake pariveSTana karavei;
(sedina) yedina tAdera opara zAsti ese par3ave tAdera mAthAra opara theke evaM tAdera pAYera nica theke, evaM AllAha valavena, “tomarA tomAdera kRtakarmera svAda grahaNa kara|”
he AmAra ImAnadAra vAndArA! AmAra jamina to prazasta; ataeva, tomarA AmArai ivAdata kara|
pratyekei mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave| tArapara tomAderake AmAra kAchei phiriYe AnA have|

yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare Ami tAderake avazyai jAnnAtera suucca prAsAde vasavAsera vyavasthA karava, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita| sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| satkarmazIladera pratidAna kata uttama!
yArA dhairyadhAraNa kare evaM tAdera prabhura opara bharasA kare|
aneka jIvajantu Ache yArA nijedera riyika (khAdya) saGge rAkhe nA| AllAhai tAdera riyika dAna karena, tomAderao| tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
tumi yadi tAderake prazna karo, “ke AsamAna o jamina sRSTi kareche evaM (ke) sUrya o canadrake anugata kareche?” tAhale avazyai tArA valave, “AllAha”| ematAvasthAYa tArA vipathagAmI haYa kIbhAve?
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya cAna jIvikA prasArita karena evaM yAra janya cAna tA saMkucita karena| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|

tumi yadi tAdera kAche jijJesa karo, “ke AsamAna theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa kare evaM tAra sAhAyye mRta (zuSka) bhUmike jIvita (sajIva) kare?” uttare tArA avazyai valave, “AllAha”| vala, “sakala prazaMsA AllAhara|” tave tAdera adhikAMzai vojhe nA|
ei pArthiva jIvana to majA Ara khelA chAr3A kichu naYa| parakAlera AvAsai prakRta (zAzvata) jIvana; yadi tArA jAnata!

yakhana tArA naukAYa (vA jAhAje) ArohaNa kare takhana (vipada dekhale) AllAhara prati ekaniSTha vizvAsa niYe tA~ke DAke| tArapara tini yakhana tAderake uddhAra kare sthale (tIre) niYe Asena, amani tArA zir‌ka karate Arambha kare;
Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tAra prati akRtajJa thAkAra janya evaM bhoge matta thAkAra janya| tave tArA (era pariNAma) jAnate pArave|

tArA ki dekheni ye, Ami (makkAke) ekaTi nirApada pavitra sthAna karechi, athaca tAdera AzapAza theke mAnuSake (AkramaNa kare) chiniYe neoYA hacche? tave ki tArA mithyAYa vizvAsa kare Ara AllAhara neYAmata asvIkAra kare?
ye AllAhara nAme mithyA vAniYe vale kiMvA tAra kAche satya AsAra para tA avizvAsa kare tAra ceYe var3a jAlema ke Ache? jAhAnnAmai ki kApheradera AvAsa naYa?
yArA AmAra janya saMgrAma kare Ami tAderake avazyai AmAra pathe paricAlita karava| AllAha to satkarmazIladera saGgei Achena|
Alipha lAma mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
romAnarA parAjita haYeche,
nikaTavartI aJcale (siriYA, irAka, jarDAna o philistIna); evaM tArA tAdera parAjaYera para zigagirai vijaYI have;
kaYeka vacharera madhyei| Agera o parera viSaYa AllAhara hAte| Ara sedina muminarA (musalamAnarA) Anandita have;
AllAhara sAhAyya peYe| tini yAke icchA sAhAyya karena| tini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
(eTA) AllAhara oYAdA| AllAha tA~ra oYAdA khelApha karena nA; tave adhikAMza loka jAne nA|
tArA pArthiva jIvanera vAirera rUpai jAne| Ara parakAla samvandhe tArA ekevArei vekhavara|

tArA ki nijedera samparke bheve dekhe nA? AllAha to AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichu yathArthabhAve o ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYera tare sRSTi karechena| kintu aneka mAnuSai (mRtyura para) tAdera prabhura sAthe sAkSAtake asvIkAra kare|

erA ki pRthivIte ghure dekheni ye, edera pUrvavartIdera pariNati kemana haYechila? tArA edera ceYe adhika zaktizAlI chila| tArA pRthivIte kRSikAja karechila evaM edera ceYe adhika parimANe tAke AvAda karechila| tAdera rasUlerA tAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANa niYe esechila| ataeva, AllAha tAdera prati kona juluma karena ni; varaM tArAi tAdera nijedera prati juluma karata|
ataHpara yArA manda kAja karechila tAdera pariNati mandai haYechila; kAraNa tArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhake mithyA valechila evaM tA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
AllAha prathamavAra sRSTi karena, tArapara tini punarAYa sRSTi karavena| ataHpara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
yedina keYAmata have sedina aparAdhIrA nirAza have|
tAdera zarIkadera (devatAdera) keu tAdera janya supAriza karave nA| tArAo tAdera zarIkaderake asvIkAra karave|
yedina keYAmata have sedina mAnuSa bhinna bhinna haYe yAve|
yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche tArA takhana eka udyAne (jAnnAte) samAdRta have|
Ara yArA kuphari kareche o AmAra nidarzanasamUha Ara parakAlera sAkSAtake asvIkAra kareche tAderake AyAvera sammukhIna karA have|
ataeva, tomarA AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA varNanA karo sandhyAYa (mAgariva o ezA) o sakAle (phajara)|
AsamAna o jamine sakala prazaMsA tA~rai| evaM (tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA varNanA karo) vikele (Achara) o dupure (johara)|
tini mRta theke jIvitake vera karena evaM jIvita theke mRtake vera karena Ara mRta (zuSka) bhUmike jIvita (sajIva) karena| ebhAvei tomAderake (kavara theke) vera karA have|
tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ekaTi ei ye, tini tomAderake (tomAdera Adi pitA Adamake) mATi theke sRSTi karechena, tArapara ekhana tomarA aneka mAnuSa (pRthivIte) char3iYe Acha|

tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ArekaTi ei ye, tini tomAdera janya tomAdera madhya thekei tomAdera strIdera sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA tAdera kAche zAnti pAo| tini tomAdera madhye pArasparika samaprIti o daYAo sRSTi kare diYechena| era madhye cintAzIla lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ArekaTi hala AsamAna o jaminera sRSTi evaM tomAdera bhASA o varNera vibhinnatA| era madhye jJAnIdera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ArekaTi hala rAte o dine tomAdera nidrA evaM tA~ra anugraha anveSaNa| era madhye zravaNazaktisampanna mAnuSera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ArekaTi ei ye, tini tomAderake vidyutera jhalaka dekhAna bhaYa o AzAra vastu hiseve evaM AsamAna theke pAni varSaNa kare tAra sAhAyye mRta (zuSka) bhUmike jIvita (sajIva) karena| era madhye vuddhimAna mAnuSera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ArekaTi ei ye, AsamAna o jamina tA~ra hukume dA~r3iYe Ache| ataHpara tini yakhana tomAderake jamina theke (veriYe AsAra janya) ekavAra DAka devena, amani tomarA veriYe Asave|
AsamAna o jamine yArA Ache savAi tA~rai mAlikAnAdhIna| savAi tA~ra anugata|

tinii prathamavAra sRSTi karena, tArapara tini punarAYa sRSTi karavena| eTA tA~ra janya adhikatara sahaja| AsamAna o jamine (guNAvalIra) sarvocca varNanA tA~rai janya| Ara tinii parAkramazAlI, mahAjJAnI|

tini tomAdera janya tomAdera nijederai ekaTi dRSTAnta peza karachena: Ami tomAderake ye jIvikA diYechi tAte ki tomAdera dAsa-dAsIdera madhya theke tomAdera aMzIdAra Ache? tomarA (tomarA o tomAdera dAsa-dAsIrA) ki tAte samAna (adhikArI)? tomarA ki tAderake temana bhaYa karo yemana nijederake (nijedera lokaderake) bhaYa kare thAka? ebhAvei Ami vuddhimAna lokadera janya nidarzanasamUha varNanA kari|
(avazyai nA;) varaM jAlemarA ajJAnatAra kAraNei tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa kare thAke| tAi AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAke patha dekhAve ke? tAdera kona sAhAyyakArIo nei|

ataeva, ekaniSTha haYe nijeke (saThika) dharme pratiSThita kara| AllAhara svAbhAvika rIti (mene cala), ye anuyAYI tini mAnuSa sRSTi karechena| AllAhara sRSTira kona parivartana nei| eTAi saThika dvIna; tave adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|
tomarA tA~ra dike pratyAvartana karo, tA~ke bhaYa karo, nAmAya kAYema karo evaM muzarikadera antarbhukta haYo nA,
yArA nijedera dharme vibheda sRSTi kareche evaM vibhinna dale vibhakta haYeche| pratyeka dalai yAra yAra mata niYe Anandita|

mAnuSa yakhana kona kaSTe par3e takhana tAdera prabhura dike phire ese tA~kei DAke| tArapara yakhana tini tAderake tA~ra anugraha AsvAdana karAna, amani tAdera ekadala tAdera prabhura sAthe zir‌ka karate Arambha kare,
Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tAra prati akRtajJatA prakAzera janya| Thika Ache, bhoga karate thAka; AgAmIte (era phala) jAnate pArave!
nAki Ami tAdera kAche kona pramANa nAyila karechi yA tAderake zir‌ka karate vale?
yakhana Ami mAnuSake (AmAra) anugraha AsvAdana karAi takhana tArA tAte Anandita haYa| Ara yadi tAdera kRtakarmera phale tAdera kona amaGgala haYa, amani tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, AllAha yAra janya cAna jIvikA prasArita karena evaM (yAra janya cAna tA) saMkucita karena| era madhye ImAnadAra lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
ataeva, AtmIYake tAra pAonA diYe dAo; misakIna o pathikakeo| eTA tAdera janya bhAla yArA AllAhara santuSTi cAYa, Ara tArAi saphalakAma|

(tomAdera sampada) vRddhi pAve ei AzAYa mAnuSera sampade tomarA ye suda diYe thAka AllAhara kAche tA vRddhi pAYa nA| Ara AllAhara santuSTira AzAYa tomarA ye yAkAta dAo (seTAi varaM vRddhi pAYa); Ara tArAi (yAkAta dAnakArIrAi) nijedera sampada dviguNa vRddhi kare neYa|

AllAhai sei mahAna sattA yini tomAderake sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tomAderake jIvikA diYechena; erapara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, tArapara AvAra jIvita karavena| tomAdera zarIkadera keu ki esavera kona kichu karate pAre? tini pavitra; Ara tArA yA kichu zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|
mAnuSera kRtakarmera daruna sthale o jale viparyaYa dekhA diYeche; tini cAna tAderake tAdera katipaYa karma (karmera zAsti) AsvAdana karAte, yAte tArA phire Ase|
vala, “tomarA pRthivIte bhramaNa karo evaM dekha, tomAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kemana haYechila|” tAdera adhikAMzai muzarika chila|

ataeva, AllAhara pakSa theke ekaTi avazyambhAvI dina (keYAmata) AsAra Age nijeke saThika dharme pratiSThita kara| se dina mAnuSa dvidhAvibhakta haYe yAve| (ekadala yAve jAnnAte evaM Arekadala yAve jAhAnnAme|)
ye kuphari kare tAra kuphari tAra oparai vartAve (tAra kupharira zAsti se-i bhoga karave)| Ara yArA satkAja kare tArA tAdera nijedera (kalyANera) janya patha tairI kare;
yAte tini (AllAha) ImAnadAra o satkarmazIladerake svIYa anugraha theke puraskAra dite pArena| tini kApheraderake pachanda karena nA|

tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye ArekaTi ei ye, tini susaMvAdavAhI vAtAsa pAThAna; yAte tomAderake tA~ra daYA AsvAdana karAte pArena, yAte tA~ra Adeze jAhAja cale evaM yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karo o (tA~ra prati) kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

Ami to tomAra pUrve rasUladerake yAra yAra samapradAYera kAche pAThiYechilAma| tArA tAdera kAche spaSTa pramANa niYe esechila| ataHpara yArA aparAdha karechila tAderake Ami zAsti diYechilAma| Ara muminaderake sAhAyya karA AmAra dAYitva chila|

AllAha sei mahAna sattA yini vAtAsa pAThAna| ataHpara ei vAtAsa megha uThiYe Ane| tArapara tini yebhAve icchA ei megha AkAze char3iYe dena evaM tA khaNDa khaNDa karena| erapara tumi dekhate pAo, ei meghera madhya theke vRSTi nirgata haYa| tini yakhana tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA ei vRSTi pau~che dena takhani tArA Anandita haYa|
Ara itipUrve ei vRSTi varSita haoYAra Age tArA to (e samparke) nirAzai chila|

ataeva, AllAhara rahamatera nidarzanasamUha dekha; bhUmira mRtyura para tini tA kIbhAve jIvita karena (zuSka haYe yAvAra para sajIva karena)| eTA yini karena tini avazyai mRtaderake jIvita karavena| Ara tini savakichui karate sakSama|
Ara Ami yadi emana (kSatikara) vAtAsa pAThAi yAra phale tArA phasalera kSeta halade haYe yete dekhe tAhale tArapara (tAdera khuzI haoYAra para) avazyai tArA akRtajJa haYe par3e|
ataeva, tumi mRta kiMvA vadhira lokaderake kichutei AhavAna zonAte pArave nA, yakhana tArA mukha phiriYe cale yAYa|
tumi andhaderakeo tAdera pathabhraSTatA theke pathe Anate pArave nA| tumi kevala tAderakei (AhavAna) zonAte pArave yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha vizvAsa kare, kAraNa tArA (AmAra) anugata|

AllAha sei mahAna sattA yini tomAderake (prathame) durvala avasthAYa sRSTi karena, ataHpara durvalatAra para (tomAderake) zakti dena, tArapara zaktira para (AvAra) durvalatA o zubhra keza (vArdhakya) dena| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena| tini mahAjJAnI, sarvazaktimAna|
yedina keYAmata saMghaTita have sedina aparAdhIrA zapatha kare valave ye, tArA kichukSaNera vezi (duniYAYa) avasthAna kareni| ebhAvei tArA satyavicyuta hata|

yAderake jJAna o ImAna deoYA haYeche tArA valave, “tomarA to AllAhara likhana (vidhAna) anuyAYI punarutthAna divasa paryanta avasthAna karecho| Ara eTAi hala punarutthAna divasa, kintu tomarA jAnate nA|”
sedina anyAYakArIdera ojara-Apatti tAdera kAje Asave nA evaM tAderake taovA kare AllAhara santuSTi arjanera suyogao deoYA have nA|
Ami ei koraAne mAnuSera janya savarakama dRSTAntai diYechi| tumi yadi tAdera kAche kona nidarzana niYe Asa tAhale avazyai kApherarA (muminaderake) valave, “tomarA to kevala mithyAra anusArI|”
emanibhAve AllAha ajJadera antare chApa mere dena|
ataeva, tumi dhairya dhara, nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya; yArA dRr3ha vizvAsa poSaNa kare nA tArA yena tomAke (tomAra risAlatera dAYitva pAlane) nirudyama nA kare|
Alipha lAma mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
egulo jJAnagarbha kitAvera (koraAnera) AYAta;
satkarmaparAYaNadera janya patha-nirdeza o anugrahasvarUpa;
yArA nAmAya kAYema kare o yAkAta deYa; Ara tArAi parakAlera opara dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe|
erAi tAdera prabhura kAcha theke AsA saThika pathe Ache evaM erAi saphalakAma|

kataka loka Ache yArA (mAnuSake) AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karAra janya ajJAnatAvazata (vinodanamUlaka) AjevAje kathA saMgraha kare evaM AllAhara patha niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa kare| tAdera janyai raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|

erakama kona vyaktira sAmane yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana se dambhabhare mukha phiriYe neYa, yena se tA zunatei pAYani, yena tAra dui kAne vadhiratA raYeche| ataeva, tAke kaSTadAYaka AyAvera susaMvAda (!) dAo|
yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare tAdera janya raYeche neYAmatapUrNa jAnnAta|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| AllAhara oYAdA satya| tini parAkramazAlI, parama prAjJa|

tini kona khu~Ti vyatIta AsamAnasamUha sRSTi karechena, yA tomarA dekhate pAccha evaM jamine parvatamAlA sthApana karechena, yAte tA tomAderake niYe hele nA par3e| jamine tini savarakama jIvajantuo char3iYe diYechena| Ami AsamAna theke pAni varSaNa karechi evaM (tAra sAhAyye) jamine pratiTi bhAla jAtera udbhida utpanna karechi|
eTA AllAhara sRSTi| tini vyatIta anyarA kichu sRSTi kare thAkale AmAke tA dekhAo to| jAlemarA varaM spaSTa vibhrAntira madhyei nipatita (raYeche)|

Ami lokamAnake prajJA dAna karechilAma Ara valechilAma, “AllAhara prati kRtajJa thAka|” ye kRtajJa thAke se nijera upakArera janyai kRtajJa thAke (tAte tAra nijerai upakAra haYa)| Ara keu akRtajJa hale tAte AllAhara kona kSati haYa nA; kAraNa AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana lokamAna tAra putrake upadeza dite giYe valechila, “vatsa! AllAhara sAthe (kona kichuke) zarIka karo nA| nizcaYai zir‌ka ekaTi mahA anyAYa|”

Ami mAnuSake tAra pitAmAtAra vyApAre nirdeza diYechi| tAra mA tAke kaSTera para kaSTa kare garbhe dhAraNa kareche| Ara tAra dudha chAr3Ano haYa duJcavachare| nirdeza diYechi ye, AmAra prati o tomAra pitAmAtAra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| pratyAvartana to AmAra kAchei|

kintu tArA (pitAmAtA) yadi ei ceSTA kare, yAte tumi AmAra sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karo, ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei, tAhale tumi tAdera Anugatya karave nA; tave duniYAYa tAderake sauhArdyera sAthe saGga deve| Ara ye AmAra dike phire eseche tAra patha anusaraNa karave| avazeSe AmAra kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana (nirdhArita Ache)| takhana Ami tomAderake tomAdera atIta kRtakarma avahita karava|

(lokamAna tAra putrake upadeza dite giYe valechila) “he vatsa! kona vastu yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANao (kSudra) haYa evaM tA kona pAtharera madhye kiMvA AsamAne athavA bhUgarbheo thAke, AllAha tA upasthita karavena| nizcaYai AllAha sUkSmadarzI, sarvajJa|”
“he vatsa! nAmAya kAYema karave, bhAla kAjera Adeza deve, manda kAja karate niSedha karave evaM vipade dhairyadhAraNa karave| egulo nizcaYai AvazyakIYa kAryAvalIra antarbhukta|”
“mAnuSa theke mukha phiriYe nio nA (mAnuSake avajJA karo nA) evaM jamine dambhabhare calo nA| AllAha kona dAmbhika ahaMkArIke pachanda karena nA|”
“calane madhyapanthA avalamvana karo evaM tomAra kaNThasvara nicu rekho| savaceYe khArApa (karkaza) svara hala gAdhAra kaNThasvara|

tomarA ki dekha nA ye, AllAha AsamAna o jaminera savakichui tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena evaM tomAderake tA~ra prakAzya o aprakAzya neYAmatasamUha pracura parimANe diYechena| kichu loka Ache yArA kona jJAna, pathanirdeza kiMvA Alokaprada grantha (granthera nirdezanA) chAr3Ai AllAha samparke vitarka kare|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “AllAha yA nAyila karechena tA anusaraNa karo” takhana tArA vale, “AmarA varaM tArai anusaraNa karava yAra opara AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera peYechi|” zaYatAna yadi tAderake jAhAnnAmera zAstira dike DAke tavuo?
ye nijeke AllAhara kAche samarpaNa kare evaM satkarmazIla haYa se to savaceYe majavuta raziTii A~kar3e dhareche| Ara AllAhara kAchei sakala kAjera pariNati|

Ara ye kuphari kare tAra kuphari yena tomAke cintita nA kare; (kenanA) AmAra kAchei tAdera pratyAvartana (nirdhArita Ache)| takhana Ami tAderake tAdera yAvatIYa kRtakarma avahita karava| AllAha (mAnuSera) antarera khavara bhAla karei jAnena|
Ami tAderake alpakAlera janya (duniYAra sukha) upabhoga karate deva| tArapara tAderake eka kaThina zAsti bhoga karate vAdhya karava|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa karo, “AsamAna o jamina ke sRSTi kareche?” takhana tArA avazyai valave, “AllAha”| vala, “sakala prazaMsA AllAhara”| tave tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara| AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|

yadi pRthivIra sava gAcha kalama haYa o samudra tAra kAli haYa evaM samudrera sAthe Aro sAta samudra yukta haYa (evaM tA diYe AllAhara kathA lekhA haYa) tavuo AllAhara kathA phurAve nA| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomAdera (sakalera) sRSTi o punarutthAna (AllAhara kAche) ekaTimAtra prANIra (sRSTi o punarutthAnera) mata (sahaja)| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha rAtake dinera madhye o dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAna? tini sUrya o candrake niYamera adhIna karechena| (niYamAnusAre) pratyekaTii ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta calache| Ara tomarA yA karacha nizcaYai AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|
eTA ejanya ye, ekamAtra AllAhai satya evaM tini chAr3A yata kichuke tArA DAkache tA savai mithyA| Ara nizcaYai AllAha sarvocca, sumahAna|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAhara anugrahe samudre jAhAja cale, yAte tini tomAderake tA~ra kichu kichu nidarzana dekhAte pArena? vastuta ete pratyeka dhairyazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira janya avazyai nidarzana Ache|

(samudre calAcalakAle) yakhana meghera chAYAra mata taraGga tAderake Acchanna kare phele takhana tArA kAYamanovAkye AllAhake DAke| tArapara yakhana tini tAderake nirApade sthale (tIre) niYe Asena takhana tAdera madhye keu keu madhyamapanthI haYe yAYa (kupharira carama stara theke kichuTA namanIYa stare neme Ase)| vizvAsaghAtaka, akRtajJa chAr3A keu AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra kare nA|

he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera prabhuke bhaYa karo evaM bhaYa karo emana ekaTi dinera yakhana nA kona pitA tAra santAnera upakAre Asave evaM nA kona santAna tAra pitAra kona upakAra karate pArave| AllAhara oYAdA satya| ataeva, pArthiva jIvana yena tomAderake dho~kAYa nA phele; Ara pratAraka zaYatAna yena tomAderake AllAha samparke pratArita nA kare|

keYAmatera jJAna AllAhara kAchei Ache| tini vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM mAtRgarbhe yA (santAna) Ache tA jAnena| keu jAne nA AgAmI kAla se ki upArjana karave evaM keu jAne nA kon‌ bhUkhaNDe se mArA yAve| AllAhai savakichu jAnena, savakichura khavara rAkhena|
Alipha lAma mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
ei kitAva (koraAna) vizvajagatera prabhura nikaTa theke avatIrNa, ete kona sandeha nei|

nAki tArA vale, “eTA se mithyA vAniYe valeche?” (nA,) varaM eTA tomAra prabhura kAcha theke Agata eka mahAsatya; (eTA eseche) yAte tumi emana ekadala lokake satarka karate pAra yAdera kAche tomAra pUrve kona satarkakArI Aseni, yena tArA pathera sandhAna pAYa|

AllAha sei mahAna sattA yini AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichu chaYadine sRSTi karechena evaM tArapara Araze (tA~ra Asane) samAsIna haYechena| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA supArizakArI nei| tavu ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
tini AsamAna theke jamina paryanta yAvatIYa viSaYa paricAlanA karena| ataHpara eka (vizAla) dine savakichu tA~ra kAche uThe yAve yAra parimANa have tomAdera gaNanAra hAjAra vacharera samAna|
adRzya o dRzyamAna savakichu tA~ra jAnA| tini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
yini pratyekaTi jinisa sundara kare sRSTi karechena evaM mATi theke mAnuSa sRSTi zuru karechena (prathama mAnuSa Adamake sRSTi karechena)|
ataHpara tAra vaMzadhara sRSTi karechena eka tuccha pAnira sArAMza (vIrya) theke|

(mATi dvArA vAnAnora) pare tini tAke suSama dehaviziSTa karechena evaM tAra madhye tA~ra (sRSTa) rUha phu~ke diYechena| tini tomAderake kAna, cokha o antarao diYechena| (e savera janya) tomarA khuva kamai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
tArA vale, “(mRtyura para) AmarA yakhana mATite hAriYe yAva tAra parao ki AmAderake natuna kare sRSTi karA have?” Asale tArA tAdera prabhura (sAthe) sAkSAtake avizvAsa kare|
vala, “tomAdera (jAna kavajera) janya niYojita mRtyura pherezatA tomAdera jAna kavaja karave| ataHpara tomAderake tomAdera prabhura nikaTa phiriYe neoYA have|”

yadi tumi dekhate! yakhana aparAdhIrA tAdera prabhura sAmane mAthAnata kare valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! (ekhana) AmarA (savakichu) dekhalAma o zunalAma| ekhana AmAderake (duniYAYa) pherat pAThAo, AmarA satkAja karava| (ekhana) AmarA dRr3habhAve vizvAsa kari|”
Ami yadi cAitAma tAhale pratyekakei tAra saThika pathera sandhAna ditAma, kintu AmAra e kathA to satya ye, jvina o mAnuSa savAike diYe Ami jAhAnnAma pUrNa karavai|

ataeva, yehetu tomarA tomAdera e dinaTira (sAthe) sAkSAtake bhule giYechile, tAi (zAsti) AsvAdana kara| Amio tomAderake bhule gelAma| tomarA tomAdera kRtakarmera janya cirasthAYI zAsti bhoga karate thAka|
AmAra nidarzanasamUha tArAi vizvAsa kare yAderake segulora kathA smaraNa kariYe dile tArA sejadAYa luTiYe par3e o tAdera prabhura prazaMsA o pavitratA varNanA kare evaM tArA ahaMkAra kare nA|sejadA

tAdera pArztadeza vichAnA theke pRthaka haYa (ivAdatera janya tArA zayyA cher3e uThe Ase)| (zAstira) bhaYa o (puraskArera) AzA niYe tArA tAdera prabhuke DAke evaM Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tA theke vyaYa kare|
tAdera kRtakarmera puraskArasvarUpa tAdera janya ye sava cokha-jur3Ano vastu lukiYe rAkhA haYeche tA keu jAne nA|
tAi ekajana ImAnadAra ki ekajana phAsekera mata haYa? tArA samAna haYa nA|
yArA ImAnadAra o satkarmaparAYaNa tAdera kRtakarmera AtitheYatAsvarUpa tAderake jAnnAte vAsasthAna deoYA have|

Ara yArA phAseka tAdera vAsasthAna (have) jAhAnnAma| yakhanai tArA sekhAna theke vera hate cAive takhanai tAderake sekhAne phiriYe deoYA have Ara valA have, “jAhAnnAmera ye AjAvake tomarA mithyA valate (ekhana) tA AsvAdana kara|”
Ara Ami tAderake (AkherAtera) var3a zAstira pUrve avazyai (duniYAra) choTa choTa zAsti (nAnArakama vipadApada) AsvAdana karAva, yAte tArA (saThika pathe) phire Ase|
tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke Ache, yAke tAra prabhura nidarzanasamUha smaraNa kariYe deoYAra para se tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa? aparAdhIderake Ami avazyai zAsti deva|

Ami mUsAke kitAva (tAorAta) diYechilAma| ataeva, tumi (merAjera rAte) tAra (sAthe) sAkSAt samvandhe sandehera madhye theko nA| Ara Ami tAke (mUsAra kAche avatIrNa kitAvake) vanI isarAIlera janya ekaTi dika-nirdezanA karechilAma|

tAdera madhya theke Ami netA manonIta karechilAma, yArA AmAra nirdeza anuyAYI patha pradarzana karata, yakhana tArA dhairyazIla haYechila| tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhera pratio dRr3ha vizvAsa poSaNa karata|
tArA ye sava viSaYe matabheda karata se vyApAre tomAra prabhui keYAmatera dina tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare devena|

eTA ki tAdera janya ekaTA dika-nirdezanA naYa ye, Ami tAdera pUrve aneka prajanmake dhvaMsa kare diYechi yAdera vAr3ighare erA calApherA karache? ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche| tavuo ki tArA zunave nA?
tArA ki dekheni ye, Ami tRNavihIna (zuSka) bhUmite pAni niYe ese tAra sAhAyye zasya utpanna kari yA tAdera pazurA o tArA nijerA khAYa? tavuo ki tArA dekhave nA|
tArA vale, “yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale (vala) ei mImAMsA kave have?”
vala, “mImAMsAra dina kApheradera ImAna (AnaYana) tAdera kona kAje Asave nA evaM tAderake avakAzao deoYA have nA|”
ataeva, tAdera theke phire eso evaM apekSA karo, nizcaYai tArAo apekSA karache|
he navI! tumi AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM kAphera o monAphekadera kathAmato kAja karo nA| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prAjJa|
tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura pakSa theke ye ohI Ase tA anusaraNa karave| tomarA yA karo se samvandhe AllAha avahita Achena|
Ara AllAhara opara bharasA rAkhave| karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

AllAha kona mAnuSera janya tAra bhitare duJcaTi hRtpiNDa vAnAnani; tomarA tomAdera ye strIdera sAthe yihAra karo (yihAra hala: strIra sAthe samparka chinna karAra janya tAke valA, “tumi AmAra kAche AmAra mAYera piThera mata niSiddha”) tAderake tomAdera mA kare denani evaM tomAdera poSyaputraderake tomAdera putra kare denani| egulo hacche tomAdera mukhera (phAlatu) kathA| AllAha yathArtha kathA valena evaM tini saThika patha dekhAna|

tomarA tAderake (tomAdera poSyapuutraderake) tAdera pitAdera nAme DAka| eTAi AllAhara kAche nyAyyatara| yadi tomarA tAdera pitRparicaYa nA jAna tAhale tArA tomAdera dvInI bhAi o vandhu (vale gaNya have)| e vyApAre tomarA bhula karale tomAdera kona pApa have nA; kintu icchAkRtabhAve anyAYa karale bhinna kathA (pApa have); tave AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

navI muminadera kAche tAdera nijedera ceYe agragaNya evaM tA~ra sahadharmiNIrA tAdera mA samatulya| Ara (uttarAdhikAra vanTanera kSetre) AllAhara vidhAne sAdhAraNa mumina o muhAjiradera ceYe AtmIYarA eke aparera kAche agragaNya| tave tomarA tomAdera vandhudera prati sahRdaYatA pradarzana karate pAra| eTA kitAve (lAohe mAh‌phUye) likhita Ache|
Ara (smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami navIdera theke aGgIkAra niYechilAma, vizeSa kare tomAra theke evaM nUha, ivarAhIma, mUsA o mariYamaputra IsA theke| Ami tAdera theke dRr3ha aGgIkAra niYechilAma;
yAte tini satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditA samparke jijJAsA karate pArena| Ara kApheradera janya tini kaSTadAYaka zAsti prastuta rekhechena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa karo, yakhana (khandakera yuddhe) tomAdera dike (zatrupakSera) sainyarA esechila| Ami tAdera viruddhe (jhar3o) vAtAsa evaM emana senAdala (pherezatA) pAThiYechilAma yAderake tomarA dekhani| tomarA yA karo AllAha tA dekhate pAna|

yakhana tomAdera oparera dika theke o tomAdera nicera dika theke tArA (zatrupakSera sainyarA) tomAdera dike esechila, yakhana (bhaYe tomAdera) dRSTisamUha nisteja haYe esechila o hRtpiNDagulo galAra kAche cale esechila evaM tomarA AllAha samparke nAnArakama sandeha poSaNa karate zuru karechile|
sekhAnei muminarA parIkSAYa nipatita haYechila evaM dAruNabhAve kampita haYechila|
evaM yakhana monAphekarA o yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tArA valachila, “AllAha o tA~ra rasUla AmAderake ye pratizruti diYechena tA zudhui pratAraNA|”

evaM yakhana tAdera ekadala valechila, “he iYAch‌rivavAsI (madInAra Agera nAma iYAch‌riva)! tomAdera to avasthAnera kona jAYagA nei (ekhAne tomarA zatrura sAmane Tikate pArave nA); ataeva, phire cala|” tAdera madhye ekadala (phire yAvAra janya) navIra kAche anumati cAcchila| tArA valachila, “AmAdera gharagulo arakSita”, athaca tA arakSita naYa; Asale tArA pAlAtei cAcchila|

yadi nagarIra caturdika theke tAdera opara zatrura praveza ghaTata, tArapara tAderake arAjakatA (svapakSera viruddhe vidroha) karate valA hata, tAhale tArA avazyai tA karata| tAte tArA khuva sAmAnyai vilamva karata|
athaca tArA pUrvei AllAhara sAthe oYAdA karechila ye, tArA pRSThapradarzana karave nA| AllAhara e oYAdA samparke avazyai jijJAsA karA have|
vala, “tomarA mRtyu athavA hatyAra bhaYe pAliYe geleo e palAYana tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA| Ara se kSetre tomAderake sAmAnyai bhoga karate deoYA have|”

vala, “emana ke Ache ye tomAderake AllAha theke rakSA karate pAre yadi tini tomAdera kSati karate cAna, kiMvA (tomAdera kSati karate pAre) yadi tini tomAderake anugraha karate cAna?” tArA AllAhake chAr3A nijedera janya Ara kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI pAve nA|
AllAha tomAdera madhye tAderake bhAla kare jAnena, yArA (AllAhara pathe yuddha karate lokaderake) vAdhA deYa evaM yArA tAdera bhAiderake vale, “AmAdera kAche esa”, athaca tArA yuddhe kamai aMza neYa;

(AllAhara pathe sAhAyya karAra prazne) tomAdera prati kRpaNa haoYAra kAraNe| Ara yakhana bhaYa Ase takhana tumi dekhate pAo, tArA mRtyura prAkkAle mUrchita vyaktira nyAYa cokha ghuriYe tomAra dike tAkAYa| tArapara yakhana bhaYa cale yAYa takhana sampadera lobhe tomAderake tIkSNa bhASAYa AkramaNa kare| erA ImAna Aneni| tAi AllAha edera karmasamUha niSphala kare diYechena| eTA karA AllAhara janya khuvai sahaja|

tArA mane kare, (zatrupakSera) vAhinIgulo cale yAYani| vAhinIgulo yadi AvAra Ase tAhale tArA cAYa maruvAsI veduInadera mAjhe theke tomAdera saMvAda jene nite| Ara tArA tomAdera mAjhe thAkaleo sAmAnyai yuddha karata|
tomAdera janya AllAhara rasUlera mAjhe uttama eka Adarza raYeche; (kevala) tAra janya ye AllAha o zeSa dinera (sAkSAtera) AzA rAkhe evaM AllAhake adhika smaraNa kare|

muminarA yakhana (zatrupakSera) vAhinIguloke dekhala takhana valala, “e to tAi, yAra pratizruti AllAha o tA~ra rasUla AmAderake diYechilena| AllAha o tA~ra rasUla satyai valechilena|” Ara ete tAdera ImAna o Anugatya Aro vRddhi pela|

muminadera madhye kataka loka AllAhara sAthe kRta (jehAdera) oYAdA pUrNa kareche| tAdera madhye keu keu prANa diYeche, AvAra keu keu (prANa deoYAra) apekSAYa Ache| kintu tArA (tAdera saMkalpera) kona parivartana kareni;
yAte AllAha satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditAra puraskAra dite pArena evaM monAphekaderake yadi cAna zAsti dite kiMvA kSamA kare dite pArena| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAha kApheraderake tAdera krodha niYei phiriYe dilena| tArA kona kalyANa pAYani| yuddhe muminadera (sAhAyya karAra) janya AllAhai yatheSTa| Ara AllAha halena mahA zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|

kitAvadhArIdera madhye yArA (madInAra ihudirA) tAderake (kApheraderake) sAhAyya karechila AllAha tAderake tAdera durga theke nAmiYe dilena evaM tAdera antare bhaYa DhukiYe dilena| (phale tAdera) ekadalake tomarA hatyA karacha evaM ekadalake vandI karacha|

tini tomAderake tAdera bhUmi, gharavAr3i o dhana-sampadera uttarAdhikArI karechena evaM emana ekaTi bhUkhaNDerao (mAlika kare diYechena), yekhAne tomarA era Age yAoni| AllAha savakichui karate sakSama|
he navI! tomAra strIderake vala, “tomarA yadi pArthiva jIvana o tAra cAkacikya cAo tAhale esa, Ami tomAdera bhogera vyavasthA kare dei evaM uttama panthAYa tomAderake mukta kare (tAlAka diYe) dei|”
“Ara yadi AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake cAo evaM parakAlera (sukhera) nivAsa pratyAzA karo tAhale AllAha tomAdera madhye satkarmaparAYaNAdera janya eka var3a puraskAra (jAnnAta) prastuta kare rekhechena|”
he navIra strIgaNa! tomAdera madhye keu yadi prakAzya azlIla kAja kare tAhale tAra zAsti dviguNa vAr3iYe deoYA have| eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|

(he navIra strIgaNa!) tomAdera madhye ye AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera anugata thAkave evaM satkAja karave Ami tAke duJcavAra tAra puraskAra deva| Ara tAra janya Ami eka sammAnajanaka jIvikA (jAnnAta) prastuta kare rekhechi|

he navIra strIgaNa! tomarA to anya kona nArIra mata nao| (ataeva) tomarA yadi mottAkI haYe thAka tave (anya lokera sAthe) narama kare kathA valave nA; tAte antare vyAdhigrasta kona (puruSa) loka praluvdha hate pAre; tave bhadrabhAve kathA valave|

tomarA tomAdera ghare thAkave evaM Agera ajJatAyugera mata nijedera saundarya pradarzana karave nA| nAmAya kAYema karave, yAkAta deve evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera kathA mene calave| he navI-parivArera lokerA! AllAha to cAna tomAdera theke paGkilatA dUra karate evaM tomAderake puropuri pavitra karate|
(he navIra strIgaNa!) tomAdera ghare AllAhara ye AYAtasamUha o jJAnera kathA pATha karA haYa tA smaraNa rAkhave| nizcaYai AllAha parama daYAmaYa o sarvaviSaYe avagata|

(AllAhara kAche) AtmasamarpaNakArI puruSa o nArI, ImAnadAra puruSa o nArI, (AllAhara) anugata puruSa o nArI, satyavAdI puruSa o nArI, dhairyazIla puruSa o nArI, vinIta puruSa o nArI, dAnazIla puruSa o nArI, royAdAra puruSa o nArI, yauna pavitratA rakSAkArI puruSa o nArI, AllAhake adhika smaraNakArI puruSa o nArI— AllAha edera janya kSamA o eka mahAna puraskAra (jAnnAta) prastuta rekhechena|

AllAha o tA~ra rasUla kona kichu siddhAnta nile kona ImAnadAra puruSa kiMvA nArIra pakSe bhinna kichu karAra kSamatA thAke nA| Ara ye AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera avAdhya haYa se spaSTatai pathabhraSTa haYa|

(smaraNa karo,) yakhana tumi sei lokaTike valechile (tomAra AyAdakRta dAsa yAYeda ivane hArichAke valechile) yAra prati AllAha anugraha karechena evaM tumio anugraha karecho, “tomAra strIke tomAra kAche rAkha evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara|” tumi tomAra mane ekaTi kathA (AllAhara ei siddhAntera kathA ye, tini yAYedera strI yaYanavake tomAra strI kare devena) lukiYe rekhechile yA AllAha prakAza kare devena| (e kSetre) tumi mAnuSake bhaYa karechile (arthAt mAnuSera ei kathAke bhaYa karechile ye, muhAmmAda nijera AyAdakRta dAsera tAlAka-deoYA strIke viYe kareche), athaca tomAra bhaYa karAra kathA to AllAhake| ataHpara yAYeda yakhana tAra sAthe (strI yaYanavera sAthe) samparka chinna karala takhana Ami tAke tomAra sAthe vivAhavandhane Avaddha karalAma; yAte (bhaviSyate) poSyaputrarA tAdera strIdera sAthe samparka chinna karale tAdera vyApAre (tAderake viYe karate) muminadera kona vAdhA nA thAke| Ara AllAhara Adeza kAryakara haYei thAke|
navIra janya AllAha yA vidhivaddha kare diYechena tAte tAra kona pApa nei| pUrve yArA (ye sava navIrA) cale giYechena tAdera kSetreo ekai vidhAna| AllAhara Adeza sunirdhArita|
yArA (navIrA) AllAhara vArtA pracAra karata o tA~ke bhaYa karata| tArA AllAha chAr3A kAuke bhaYa karata nA| hisAva grahaNera janya AllAhai yatheSTa|
muhAmmada tomAdera puruSadera kAro pitA naYa (tAra kona vaYaska chele nei); varaM se AllAhara rasUla o zeSa navI| AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve jAnena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA vezi kare AllAhake smaraNa kara|
Ara sakAla-sandhyAYa tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA varNanA kara|

tinii tomAdera prati anugraha karena, Ara tA~ra pherezatArA tomAdera janya (AllAhara) anugraha prArthanA kare; yAte tini tomAderake andhakAra theke Alote vera kare Anate pArena| tini muminadera prati parama daYAlu|
yedina tArA AllAhara sAthe milita have sedina tAdera (prati) abhivAdana have jJasAlAmaJca (tomAdera janya zAnti)! tini tAdera janya eka mahAna pratidAna (jAnnAta) prastuta kare rekhechena|
he navI! Ami tomAke pAThiYechi ekajana sAkSI, susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hiseve;
evaM AllAhara Adeze tA~ra dike ekajana AhavAnakArI o ujjvala eka pradIparUpe|
tumi muminaderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya AllAhara pakSa theke eka virATa anugraha raYeche|
Ara kAphera o monAphekadera icchAnuyAYI kAja karo nA, tAdera niryAtana upekSA karo evaM AllAhara opara bharasA kara| karmavidhAYaka hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA ImAnadAra nArIderake viYe karAra para tAderake sparza karAra (tAdera sAthe yauna milanera) Agei yadi tAlAka dAo tAhale tAdera vyApAre tomAdera kona iddata gaNanA karate have nA (tAdera kona iddata pAlana karate have nA)| takhana tomarA tAderake kichu jinisapatra diYe sundarabhAve vidAYa karave|

he navI! Ami tomAra janya vaidha karechi tomAra strIderake, yAderake tumi moharAnA diYecho evaM tomAra mAlikAnAdhIna dAsIderake, yAderake AllAha tomAra janya dAna karechena| Ara (viYe karAra janya vaidha karechena) tomAra cAcAto, phuphAto, mAmAto o khAlAto vonaderake yArA tomAra sAthe hijarata kareche evaM (vinA moharAnAYa viYe karA vaidha karechena) emana kona mumina nArIke ye nijeke navIra kAche samarpaNa kare, yadi navI tAke viYe karate icchuka haYa| (ei vinA moharAnAYa viYe karA) kevalamAtra tomAra janya (vaidha), (sAdhAraNa) muminadera janya naYa| tAdera strI o dAsIdera vyApAre tAdera opara yA dhArya karechi tA to AmAra jAnAi Ache| (moharAnAra vyApAre tomAra janya vizeSa vyavasthA rAkhA haYeche) yAte tomAra kona asuvidhA nA haYa| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tumi tAdera madhya theke yAke icchA dUre rAkhate evaM yAke icchA tomAra kAche rAkhate pAra| AvAra yAderake dUre rekhecho tAdera madhya theke kAuke pete cAile tomAra kona doSa have nA| eTAi zreYatara| ete tAdera cokha zItala have, tArA duHkha pAve nA evaM tumi tAderake yA deve tAte tArA savAi santuSTa thAkave| tomAdera antare yA Ache AllAha tA jAnena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, sahanazIla|

erapara (era vAire) anya nArIrA tomAra janya vaidha naYa evaM tomAra strIdera parivarteo anya strI grahaNa karA tomAra janya vaidha naYa, anya nArIdera saundarya tomAke mugdha karaleo; tave tomAra mAlikAnAdhIna dAsIdera kSetre ei vidhiniSedha prayojya naYa| AllAha savakichura opara sajAga dRSTi rAkhena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA navIra ghare praveza karo nA| avazya tomAderake khAdya grahaNera janya anumati deoYA hale sekhAne praveza karate pAra| tave tA eta Age naYa ye, khAvAra samaYa haoYA paryanta apekSamAna thAkave| varaM tomAderake yakhana DAkA have takhanai praveza karave| erapara yakhana khAoYA zeSa karave takhana veriYe par3ave| kathAvArtAYa mazagula have nA| tAte navIra kaSTa haYa, kintu se tomAderake (uThiYe dite) saMkoca kare| tave AllAha satyakathA valate saMkoca karena nA| Ara tomarA navIra strIdera kAche kona jinisa cAile tA pardAra Ar3Ala theke cAive| ete tomAdera mana o tAdera mana adhikatara pavitra thAkave| rasUlake kaSTa deoYA evaM tAra pare tAra strIderake kakhano viYe karA tomAdera janya vaidha naYa| tomAdera erakama kAja AllAhara kAche ekaTA gurutara aparAdha|
tomarA kona kichu prakAza karo kiMvA gopana rAkha, AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve jAnena|

navIra strIdera janya tAdera vAvA, chele, bhAi, bhAiYera chele, vonera chele, nijedera mahilA o mAlikAnAdhIna dAsadAsIdera sAthe pardA nA karAYa kona pApa nei| (he navIra strIgaNa!) tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYai AllAha savakichurai sAkSI|

AllAha (tA~ra) navIke anugraha karena; tA~ra pherezatArAo tAra janya (AllAhara) anugraha prArthanA kare| (ataeva) he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarAo tAra janya (AllAhara) anugraha prArthanA karo evaM tAke yathAyathabhAve sAlAma jAnAo|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake kaSTa deYa AllAha tAderake duniYA o AkherAte abhizapta karena| tini tAdera janya lAJchanAkara zAstio prastuta kare rekhechena|
Ara yArA ImAnadAra naranArIke kona aparAdha chAr3Ai kaSTa deYa tArA apavAda o spaSTa pApera vojhA vahana kare|

he navI! tumi tomAra strI o kanyAderake evaM muminadera strIderake vala, tArA yena nijedera gAYe AvaraNa Tene deYa (zarIra AcchAdita rAkhe)| ete tAdera (sambhrAnta mahilA hiseve) paricita hate suvidhA have evaM utyakta nA haoYAra adhikatara sambhAvanA thAkave| AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

monAphekarA, antare vyAdhigrasta vyaktirA o madInAYa gujava raTanAkArIrA yadi (tAdera apakarma theke) virata nA haYa tAhale avazyai Ami tAdera viruddhe tomAke jAgiYe tulava| ataHpara tArA sekhAne (madInAYa) tomAra prativezi hiseve kamai thAkate pArave|
(tArA) abhizapta avasthAYa (thAkave); tAderake yekhAnei pAoYA yAve sekhAnei dharA have evaM AcchA kare hatyA karA have|
yArA pUrve atIta haYe giYeche tAdera kSetreo AllAhara ei rItii chila| tumi AllAhara rItira kona parivartana pAve nA|
mAnuSa tomAke keYAmata samparke jijJAsA kare| vala, “tAra kathA kevala AllAhai jAnena|” tumi kI jAna? keYAmata haYato zigagirai have|
kApheraderake AllAha abhizapta karechena evaM tAdera janya jvalanta Aguna (jAhAnnAma) prastuta rekhechena|
tArA tAra madhye cirakAla thAkave, (emana avasthAYa ye, kaSTa lAghavera janya) kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArIo pAve nA|
yedina Agune tAdera mukhamaNDala ulTAno have sedina tArA valave, “hAYa, AmarA yadi (duniYAYa) AllAha o rasUlera kathA mene calatAma!”
tArA Aro valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA to AmAdera netAdera o var3adera kathA mene calechilAma, kintu tArAi AmAderake vipathagAmI kareche|
he AmAdera prabhu! (ekhana) tAderake dviguNa zAsti dAo evaM tAderake var3arakama abhisampAta dAo|”
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA yArA mUsAke kaSTa diYechila| tArA (tAra samparke) yA valechila AllAha tAke tA theke nirdoSa pramANa karechilena| se chila AllAhara kAche maryAdAvAna|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM saThika kathA vala;
tAhale tini tomAdera karmasamUha Thika kare devena evaM tomAdera pApa kSamA kare devena| Ara keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera kathA mene calale avazyai se var3a sAphalya lAbha karave|

Ami to AsamAna, jamina o parvatarAjira kAche ei AmAnata (Adeza-niSedha pAlanera dAYitva) peza karechilAma| tArA tA vahana karate asvIkAra karala evaM eke (vahana karate) bhaYa pela| kintu mAnuSa tA vahana karala| nizcaYai se var3a anyAYakArI, dAruNa ajJa|

ejanya ye, AllAha monApheka puruSa o monApheka nArI Ara muzarika puruSa o muzarika nArIke zAsti devena evaM ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArIke kSamA karavena| (kAraNa) AllAha kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu|
sakala prazaMsA sei sattAra yini AsamAna o jaminera savakichura mAlika| parakAleo sakala prazaMsA tA~rai| tini prajJAvAna, sarvajJa|
bhUmite yA praveza kare, bhUmi theke yA vera haYa, AkAza theke yA neme Ase Ara AkAze yA uThe yAYa, tini savakichui jAnena| tinii parama daYAlu, kSamAzIla|

kApherarA vale, “AmAdera opara keYAmata Asave nA|” vala, “avazyai; AmAra prabhura zapatha, tomAdera opara tA Asavei| tini gAYeva jAnena| AsamAna kiMvA jamine aNu parimANa vA tAra ceYe choTa kiMvA var3a kona kichui tA~ra theke dUre (tA~ra agocare) naYa; varaM savai eka spaSTa granthe (lAohe mAh‌phUye) lipivaddha Ache|”
(keYAmata avazyai Asave) kenanA, yArA ImAnadAra o satkarmaparAYaNa tAderake tini puraskAra devena| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA Ara sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
tave yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha pramANera ceSTA kare tAdera janya raYeche eka bhaYAnaka yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Ara yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche tArA jAne, tomAra kAche tomAra prabhura pakSa theke nAyilakRta koraAna satya; evaM tA parAkramazAlI o samasta prazaMsAra adhikArI AllAhara patha dekhAYa|

avizvAsIrA vale, “AmarA ki tomAderake emana eka vyaktira (muhAmmada) sandhAna deva ye tomAderake valave: tomAdera deha (kavarera mATite) sampUrNarUpe chinna-vicchinna haYe mize geleo AvAra tomAderake natunabhAve sRSTi karA have?”

se ki AllAha samparke mithyA vAniYe valeche, nAki tAra madhye pAgalAmi Ache? (kakhanao naYa) varaM yArA parakAla vizvAsa kare nA tArAi AyAve (nizcita AyAvera apekSAYa) o dAruNa vibhrAntira madhye Ache|

tArA ki tAdera sAmanera o pechanera AkAza o bhUmira dike tAkiYe dekhe nA? Ami yadi icchA kari tAhale tAderake saha bhUmi dAviYe deva athavA AkAzera ekaTi khaNDa tAdera opara phele deva| era madhye pratyeka taovAkArI vAndAra janya avazyai kona nidarzana raYeche|

Ami dAudake AmAra pakSa theke anugraha dAna karechilAma| (valechilAma,) he parvatarAji! tomarA tAra (dAudera) sAthe AmAra mahimA varNanA kara| Ara he pAkhirA! tomarAo| Ami tAra janya lohAkeo narama kare diYechilAma|
(Ara valechilAma,) “prazasta varma tairI karo, (tAte) parimApamata AMTA lAgAo Ara satkAja kara| tomarA yA kichu karo Ami tA dekhate pAi|”

solAYamAnera janya vAtAsake tAra AjJAnuvartI kare diYechilAma, yAra sakAla ekamAsa Ara vikela ekamAsa (sakAla-vikela mile sArAdine vAtAsera sAhAyye se duimAsera patha atikrama karate pArata)| Ami tAra janya (galita) tAmAra ekaTi jharanA pravAhita karechilAma| kataka jvina tAra sAmanei tAra prabhura nirdeze kAja karata| tAdera madhye keu AmAra Adezera anyathA karale Ami tAke jvalanta Agunera (jAhAnnAmera) zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

solAYamAna yA cAita jvinerA tAra janya tAi tairI kare dita| esava jinisera madhye raYeche: var3a var3a koThA, bhAskarya, hAujera mata var3a var3a gAmalA o majavuta Dega| (Ami valechilAma,) “he dAudera parivAra! tomarA kRtajJatAra sAthe kAja kara|” tave AmAra vAndAdera madhye alpasaMkhyakai kRtajJa|

tArapara yakhana Ami solAYamAnera mRtyu ghaTAlAma takhana jvinaderake keu tAra mRtyura kathA jAnAte pAreni, ekamAtra mATira pokA r(ghuNa) chAr3A, yA tAra lAThiTi kheYe phelachila| ataHpara se yakhana par3e gela takhana jvinerA vujhate pArala ye, tArA yadi gAYeva jAnata (Agei solAYamAnera mRtyura kathA jAnate pArata) tAhale tArA (etadina) lAJchanAkara zAstira madhye avasthAna karata nA (icchAra viruddhe nirmANakAje niYojita thAkata nA)|

sAvA gotrera janya tAdera vAsasthAne ekaTi nidarzana chila: duTo vAgAna, (ekaTi) DAna dike o (ekaTi) vAma dike| (tAderake valA haYechila,) “tomAdera prabhura deoYA jIvikA theke AhAra karo evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara|” eka sundara bhUkhaNDa o eka kSamAzIla prabhu|

ataHpara tArA (AllAhara Anugatya theke) mukha phiriYe nila| takhana Ami tAdera viruddhe vA~dha-bhAGgA Dhala pAThAlAma evaM tAdera vAgAnaduToke emana duTo vAgAne parivartana kare dilAma yAte utpanna hala visvAda phalamUla, jhAugAcha o sAmAnya kichu kulagAcha|
tAdera kuphari karAra kAraNe Ami tAderake ai zAsti diYechilAma| akRtajJa vyatIta kAuke Ami (emana) zAsti dei nA|

tAdera (sAvA janapadera) o (siriYAYa) ye sava janapade Ami varakata diYechilAma tAdera mAjhakhAne Aro dRzyamAna janapada sthApana karalAma evaM sekhAne bhramaNa dhArya kare dilAma| (valalAma), “tomarA sekhAne rAte o dine nirApade bhramaNa kara|”

kintu tArA valala, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera sapharera mAjhakhAnera vyavadhAna vAr3iYe dAo|” tArA tAdera nijedera prati juluma karechila| Ami tAi tAderake kAhinite pariNata karechi evaM tAderake ekevAre chinnabhinna kare diYechi| era madhye pratyeka dhairyazIla o kRtajJa vyaktira janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
tAdera vyApAre ivalIsa tAra cintA (tAderake vibhrAnta karAra parikalpanA) satya pramANita karala| phale muminadera ekaTi dala vAde savAi tAra patha anusaraNa karala|

(mUlata) tAdera opara tAra (zaYatAnera) kona kartRtva chila nA; tave (tAra sAphalyera kAraNa ei ye,) Ami ceYechi, ke parakAle vizvAsa kare Ara ke tAra vyApAre sandihAna, tA parIkSA karate| tomAra prabhu savakichurai saMrakSaNakArI|

vala, “tomarA AllAha vyatIta yAderake upAsya mane karate tAderake DAka| tArA AsamAne o jamine aNu parimANa vasturao mAlika naYa, sekhAne tAdera kona aMzao nei evaM tAdera madhye tA~ra (AllAhara) kona sahAYakao nei|”

tA~ra kAche supAriza kAro upakAre Asave nA, kevala ai vyakti chAr3A yAra janya tini (supAriza karAra) anumati devena| avazeSe yakhana tAdera antara theke bhaYa dUra have takhana tArA (eke aparake) valave, “tomAdera prabhu kI valalena?” uttare tArA valave, “tini satya valechena| tini sarvocca, mahAmahima|”
vala, “AsamAna o jamina theke ke tomAdera jIvikAra vyavasthA kare?” vala, “AllAha| Ara AmarA athavA tomarA avazyai saThika pathe athavA spaSTa vibhrAntite Achi|”
vala, “AmarA ye aparAdha kari se samparke tomAderake jijJAsA karA have nA evaM tomarA yA karo se samparkeo AmAderake jijJAsA karA have nA|”
vala, “AmAdera prabhu (keYAmatera dina) AmAderake ekatrita karavena, ataHpara tini AmAdera madhye saThikabhAve (virodha) mImAMsA kare devena| tinii var3a mImAMsAkArI, mahAjJAnI|”
vala, “tomarA yAderake zarIka hiseve tA~ra sAthe yukta karecho tAderake AmAke dekhAo to| kichutei nA (AllAhara kona zarIka nei), varaM tinii parAkrama-zAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAha|”
Ami to tomAke sava mAnuSera janya susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe pAThiYechi; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (tA) jAne nA|
tArA vale, “tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, ei oYAdA kakhana vAstavAYita have?”
vala, “tomAdera janya ekaTi dinera nirdhArita samaYa Ache, yAke tomarA eka muhUrtera janyao vilamvita karate kiMvA egiYe Anate pAra nA|”

kApherarA vale, “AmarA ei koraAne vizvAsa karava nA, era pUrvera kitAveo naYa|” ei jAlemaderake yakhana tAdera prabhura sAmane dA~r3a karAno have takhana tumi yadi (tAderake) dekhate! tArA takhana paraspara vAdAnuvAda karave| yAderake durvala mane karA hata tArA ahaMkArIderake valave, “yadi tomarA nA hate tAhale avazyai AmarA ImAnadAra hatAma|”
ahaMkArIrA durvaladerake valave, “tomAdera kAche hedAYeta AsAra para AmarA ki tomAderake tA grahaNa karate vAdhA diYechilAma? tomarAi varaM pApI chile|”

durvalarA ahaMkArIderake valave, “varaM (eTA to tomAderai) rAtera o dinera cakrAnta (chila), yakhana AmAderake Adeza dite, yena AmarA AllAhake asvIkAra kari evaM tA~ra zarIka sAvyasta kari|” tArA yakhana zAsti dekhate pAve takhana anutApa gopana rAkhave| Ara Ami kApheradera galAYa ver3i parAva| tAderake tAdera karmerai pratiphala deoYA have|
Ami yakhanai kona janapade kona satarkakArI pAThiYechi takhanai tAra vittavAna vAsindArA valeche, “tomAderake yA niYe pAThAno haYeche AmarA tA vizvAsa kari nA|”
tArA Aro valeche, “AmarA adhikatara dhana-sampada o santAna-santatira adhikArI; tAi AmAderake zAsti deoYA have nA|”
vala, “AmAra prabhu yAra janya icchA karena jIvikA vAr3iYe dena o (yAra janya icchA karena tA) sImita karena; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (tA) jAne nA|”

tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati tomAderake AmAra nikaTavartI karave nA, yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche tArA vyatIta| tAdera janya raYeche tAdera karmera dviguNa pratidAna| evaM tArA suucca vAsasthAne (jAnnAte) nirApade thAkave|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha pramANera ceSTA kare tAderake zAstira sAmane hAjira karA have|

vala, “AmAra prabhu tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA karena jIvikA vAr3iYe dena o (yAra janya icchA karena tA) sImita karena| tomarA (AllAhara rAstAYa) yA kichu vyaYa karo tini tA AvAra diYe dena (tAra vinimaYa diYe tA puSiYe dena)| tini zreSTha rijikadAtA|
(sedinera kathA smaraNa karo) yedina tini tAdera savAike ekatrita karavena evaM pherezatAderake jijJesa karavena, “erA ki tomAdera pUjA karata?”
pherezatArA valave, “tumi mahIYAna! tumii AmAdera mitra, orA naYa| orA varaM jvinadera pUjA karata| odera adhikAMza tAdera prati vizvAsI|”
ataeva, Aja tomAdera keu kAro kona upakAra kiMvA kSati karAra mAlika naYa| Ami jAlemaderake valava, “sei Agunera (jAhAnnAmera) zAsti AsvAdana karo yAke tomarA mithyA valate|”

yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra spaSTa AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana tArA (pAThakArI rasUla samparke) vale, “e to emanai eka loka ye tomAderake tomAdera vApa-dAdAra upAsyadera (upAsanA) theke pherAte cAYa|” tArA Aro vale, “e to vAnAno mithyA chAr3A kichu naYa|” kApheradera kAche yakhana satya ela takhana tArA se samparke valala, “e to eka spaSTa yAdu”|
tAderake kona kitAva deini yA tArA par3ave evaM tomAra pUrve tAdera kAche kona satarkakArIo pAThAini|

tAdera pUrvavartIrAo avizvAsa karechila| Ami tAderake yA diYechilAma erA to tAra dazabhAgera eka bhAgao pAYani| tAraparao tArA AmAra rasUladerake mithyA valechila| ataeva, kemana (bhaYAnaka) chila AmAra zAsti!

vala, “Ami tomAderake ekaTi (kAjera) upadeza dicchi: tomarA AllAhara janya duJcajana duJcajana kare o ekajana ekajana kare dA~r3iYe yAo, tArapara cintA karo; tomAdera saGgIra madhye kona pAgalAmi nei| se to eka kaThina zAstira sAmane tomAdera janya ekajana satarkakArI mAtra|”
vala, “Ami tomAdera kAche ye pratidAna cAite pAratAma tA tomAderai thAka| (Ami to tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAini)| AmAra pratidAna (puraskAra) devena to AllAha| tini savakichurai sAkSI|”
vala, “AmAra prabhu satya (ohI) preraNa karena| tini adRzya viSaYasamUha bhAla kare jAnena|”
vala, “satya ese geche| Ara mithyA nA pAre (kona kichu) natuna sRSTi karate, Ara nA pAre (kona sRSTira) punarAvRtti karate|”

vala, “Ami yadi vipathagAmI hai tAhale nijera kSatira janyai vipathagAmI hava (tAte AmAra nijerai kSati have)| Ara yadi supathe thAki tAhale tA ejanya ye, AmAra kAche AmAra prabhu ohI pAThiYe thAkena| tini savakichu zonena, (savAra) kAchei thAkena|”
yadi tumi (keYAmate tAderake sei avasthAYa) dekhate, yakhana tArA bhItasantrasta have evaM pAlAteo pArave nA! Ara nikaTavartI kona jAYagA theke tAderake dhare AnA have|
tArA valave, “AmarA tAra (satyera) prati ImAna AnalAma|” kintu eta dUra theke tArA (tAra) nAgAla pAve kIbhAve?
athaca Age (duniYAYa) tArA tA avizvAsa karechila| tArA dUra theke adRzya viSaYe AndAje mantavya karata|
tAdera o tArA yA cAYa tAra madhye antarAla sRSTi karA haYeche, yemana pUrve tAdera satIrthadera kSetreo karA haYechila| nizcaYai tArA vibhrAntikara sandehe nipatita chila|

AsamAna o jaminera sRSTikartA AllAhara janya sakala prazaMsA; yini dui dui, tina tina o cAra cAra DAnAviziSTa pherezatAderake vArtAvAhaka karechena| tini (tA~ra) sRSTira madhye yA cAna vRddhi karena| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
AllAha mAnuSera janya (tA~ra) anugraha theke yA khule dena tA keu dhare rAkhate pAre nA, AvAra tini yA dhare rAkhena tArapara tA keu khule dite pAre nA| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he mAnuSa! tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara neYAmata smaraNa kara| (bheve dekha,) AllAha chAr3A kona sRSTikartA Ache ki, ye tomAderake AsamAna o jamina theke jIvikA dAna kare? tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| ataeva, kIbhAve tomarA (tA~ra theke) phire yAccha?
erA yadi tomAra prati mithyA Aropa kare tAhale mane karave, tomAra pUrveo rasUladera prati mithyA Aropa karA haYechila| AllAhara kAchei yAvatIYa viSaYa phiriYe neoYA have|
he mAnuSa! nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya; ataeva, pArthiva jIvana yena tomAke dho~kAYa nA phele| temani var3a dho~kAvAja (zaYatAna) yena tomAke AllAha samparke dho~kA dite nA pAre|
zaYatAna tomAdera zatru; tAi tAke zatrui mane karave| se tAra dalake jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI haoYAra janya DAke|
yArA kAphera tAdera janya kaThora zAsti raYeche| Ara yArA ImAnadAra o satkarmazIla tAdera janya raYeche kSamA Ara mahAna eka puraskAra (jAnnAta)|

yAke tAra manda kAja zobhanIYa kare dekhAno haYa evaM se nijeo tAke bhAla mane kare se ki (tAra samAna ye saThika pathe Ache)? nizcaYai AllAha yAke cAna vipathagAmI karena evaM yAke cAna saThika patha dekhAna| ataeva, tAdera janya AkSepe yena tomAra prANa cale nA yAYa| tArA yA kichu kare AllAha tA bhAla kare jAnena|

AllAhai vAtAsa pAThiYe dena| ei vAtAsa megha ur3iYe Ane| Ami tA kona mRta (zuSka) bhUkhaNDera dike niYe yAi evaM tAra sAhAyye bhUmike tAra mRtyura para jIvita kari (zuSka bhUmike sajIva kare tuli)| ebhAvei punarutthAna have (mRtyura para AvAra jIvita kare uThAno have)|

ye sammAna cAYa tAra jAnA ucita, AllAhara janyai sakala sammAna| tA~rai dike satvAkya ArohaNa kare evaM satkarma tAke (satvAkyake) uThiYe deYa| (satkarma vyatIta zudhu satvAkya AllAhara kAche pau~che nA|) yArA khArApa kAjera cakrAnta kare tAdera janya kaThina zAsti raYeche| tAdera cakrAnta vyartha havei|

AllAha tomAderake mATi o vIrya theke sRSTi karechena (prathama mAnuSake mATi theke o tAra vaMzadharaderake vIrya theke sRSTi karechena), tArapara tomAderake (nArI-puruSera) jor3A vAniYechena| nArI ye garbhadhAraNa kare o santAna prasava kare tA AllAhara jJAtasArei haYa| vaYaska vyakti ye adhika vaYasa pAYa kiMvA tAra vaYasa theke yA hrAsa karA haYa tAo kitAve (lAohe mAh‌phUye) likhita Ache| nizcaYai eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|

duJcaTi samudra ekarakama haYa nA| ekaTi (ekaTira pAni) sumiSTa o supeYa evaM anyaTi lonA o titA| pratyekaTi theke tomarA tAjA mAMsa (mAcha) AhAra karo evaM tomAdera paridhAnera alaMkAra (maNimuktA) AharaNa kara| tumi tAte (tAra) vuka cire jAhAja calate dekha, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha anveSaNa karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA (tA~ra prati) kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
