tini rAtake dinera madhye praveza karAna o dinake rAtera madhye praveza karAna| (arthAt nirdiSTa niYame sUryera caturdike pRthivIra Avartanera kAraNe choTa-haoYA rAtera hrAsakRta samaYa dinera samaYera sAthe yoga kare dinake var3a karena evaM choTa-haoYA dinera hrAsakRta samaYa rAtera samaYera sAthe yoga kare rAtake var3a karena|) tini sUrya o canadrake (niYamera) adhIna kare diYechena| pratyekaTi (nija niYame) ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta chuTe caleche| inii AllAha, tomAdera prabhu| rAjatva (kartRtva) tA~rai| tini vyatIta tomarA yAderake DAka tArA to khejura-vIcira pAtalA AvaraNerao mAlika naYa|

tomarA tAderake DAkale tArA tomAdera DAka zone nA| zonaleo, tomAdera DAke sAr3A deYa nA| keYAmatera dina tArA tomAdera zir‌ka (tomarA ye tAderake AllAhara zarIka karechile tA) asvIkAra karave| Ara mahAvijJera (AllAhara) nyAYa keu tomAke avahita karave nA|
he mAnuSa! tomarA to AllAhara mukhApekSI; kintu AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita|
tini yadi icchA karena tAhale tomAderake sariYe (tomAdera jAYagAYa) eka natuna sRSTi niYe Asavena|
eTA AllAhara pakSe kaThina kichu naYa|

kona vojhA vahanakArI anyera vojhA vahana karave nA| Ara gurutara bhAragrasta keu tAra bhAra vahanera janya anyake DAkale tAra kichui vahana karA have nA, yadi se nikaTAtmIYao haYa| tumi to kevala tAderakei satarka karate pAra yArA tAdera prabhuke nA dekheo bhaYa kare evaM nAmAya kAYema kare| ye nijeke parizodhana kare se to nijera (kalyANera) janyai tA kare| Ara AllAhara kAchei (sakalera) pratyAvartana|
samAna naYa andha Ara dRSTimAna;
samAna naYa andhakAra Ara Alo;
samAna naYa chAYA Ara roda;
evaM samAna naYa jIvita Ara mRta| AllAha yAke cAna zonAte pArena, kintu yArA kavare Ache tAderake tumi zonAte pAra nA|
tumi to kevala ekajana satarkakArI|
Ami to tomAke pAThiYechi satyasaha ekajana susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe| emana kona jAti nei yAdera madhye kona satarkakArI Aseni|

yadi tArA tomAra prati mithyA Aropa kare tAhale (kichu mane karonA, kAraNa) tAdera pUrvavartIrAo (tAdera rasUladera prati) mithyA Aropa karechila| tAdera rasUlagaNa tAdera kAche spaSTa nidarzana, sahIphA o Alokaprada grantha niYe esechila|
ataHpara Ami kApheraderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma| takhana kemana chila AmAra zAsti!

tumi ki dekhani ye, AllAha AkAza theke vRSTi varSaNa karechena| ataHpara tAra sAhAyye Ami vibhinna varNera phalamUla utpanna karechi| Ara pAhAr3era madhye Ache sAdA, lAla vibhinna varNera giripatha evaM kAlo kAlo pAhAr3a|
emanibhAve vibhinna varNera mAnuSa, jIvajantu o catuSpada pazu Ache| AllAhara vAndAdera madhye kevala jJAnIrAi tA~ke bhaYa kare| nizcaYai AllAha parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|
yArA AllAhara kitAva pATha kare, nAmAya kAYema kare Ara Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tA theke gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare tArA emana eka vyavasA AzA kare yA naSTa have nA;
ejanya ye, tini tAderake tAdera karmaphala puropuri devena evaM nija anugrahe Aro vezi devena| nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, pratidAnadAtA|
Ami tomAra kAche ye kitAva avatIrNa karechi tA satya evaM tAra pUrvavartI kitAvera samarthaka| nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera savakichu jAnena o dekhena|

ataHpara Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhya theke yAderake pachanda karechi tAderake kitAvera uttarAdhikArI karechi| tave tAdera madhye keu nijera prati julumakArI, keu madhyapanthA avalamvanakArI evaM keu AllAhara hukume kalyANakara kAjakarme agragAmI| eTA (kitAvera uttarAdhikAra) ekaTA var3a anugraha|
tArA (kalyANakara kAjakarme agragAmIrA) sthAYI jAnnAte praveza karave| sekhAne tAderake sonAra kA~kana o muktAra alaMkAra parAno have| sekhAne tAdera pozAka have rezamera|
Ara tArA valave, “prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAdera duHkha dUra kare diYechena| nizcaYai AmAdera prabhu kSamAzIla, pratidAnadAtA|”
yini nija anugrahe AmAderake sthAYI vasavAsera ghara diYechena; yekhAne kona kaSTa AmAderake sparza kare nA evaM yekhAne kona klAnti AmAderake sparza kare nA|

kintu yArA avizvAsa kareche tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna| tAdera mRtyurao phaYasAlA deoYA have nA ye, tArA mare yAve; evaM tAdera theke jAhAnnAmera zAstio lAghava karA have nA| ebhAvei Ami pratyeka avizvAsIke zAsti diYe thAki|

sekhAne tArA Arta citkAra kare valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake (jAhAnnAma theke) vera karo, AmarA bhAla kAja karava, Age yA karatAma tA theke anya kichu|” (AllAha valavena,) “Ami ki tomAderake tataTuku vaYasa diYechilAma nA, yAte keu upadeza grahaNa karate cAile upadeza grahaNa karate pArata? tomAdera kAche to satarkakArIo esechila| ataeva, (zAsti) AsvAdana kara| jAlemadera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|”
AllAha AsamAna o jaminera adRzya viSaYa avagata Achena| tini antarera viSaYa samparkeo bhAlabhAve avahita raYechena|

tinii tomAderake pRthivIte pratinidhi karechena| ataeva, ye kuphari karave tAra kupharira pariNati tAra opara vartAve| Ara kApheradera kuphari tAdera janya kevala tAdera prabhura ghRNAi vRddhi kare evaM kApheradera kuphari kevala tAdera kSatii vAr3AYa|

vala, “AllAha vyatIta tomarA yAderake DAka, tomAdera sei zarIkadera kathA ki bheve dekhecho? tomarA AmAke dekhAo to, tArA pRthivIte kI sRSTi kareche? nAki AsamAne tAdera kona aMza Ache?” nAki Ami tAderake kona kitAva diYechi ye tArA tAra pramANera opara raYeche? Asale jAlemarA kevala eke anyake pratAraNAmUlaka oYAdA diYe thAke|

AllAha AsamAna o jaminake dhare rAkhena, yAte tArA sthAnacyuta nA haYa| Ara yadi tArA sthAnacyuta haYa tAhale tA~ra pare (tini chAr3A) keu tAderake dhare rAkhate pArave nA| tini sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|

tArA dRr3hatAra sAthe AllAhara zapatha kare valechila ye, yadi tAdera kAche kona satarkakArI (rasUla) Ase tAhale avazyai tArA ye kona jAtira ceYe satpathera vezi anusArI have| ataHpara yakhana tAdera kAche (satyai) ekajana satarkakArI (muhAmmAda sa.) ela takhana tArA vezi kare vimukha hala;

duniYAYa ahaMkAra o kucakrera kAraNe| tave kucakra tAra hotAderakei pariveSTana kare| tave ki tArA pUrvavartIdera (kSetre praYogakRta zAstira) vidhAnerai pratIkSA karache? tAhale tumi AllAhara vidhAne kona parivartana pAve nA evaM AllAhara vidhAne kona vyatikramao pAve nA|

erA ki duniYAYa ghure dekheni? tAhale to dekhate peta, edera pUrvavartIdera pariNati kemana haYechila| tArA to edera ceYe vezi zaktizAlI chila| AsamAna o jaminera kona kichui AllAhake apAraga karate pAre nA| nizcaYai tini mahAjJAnI, parama zaktimAna|

AllAha yadi mAnuSake tAdera kRtakarmera janya (kar3Akar3ibhAve) pAkar3Ao karatena tAhale duniYAra vuke calamAna kAukei rAkhatena nA| vastuta tini tAderake eka nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAza diYe thAkena| yakhana tAdera sei nirdiSTa samaYa ese yAYa takhana AllAha tA~ra vAndAderake bhAlabhAvei dekhate pAna| (arthAt takhana tAdera viruddhe vyavasthA nite tA~ra kona asuvidhA haYa nA|)
iYA sIna [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
prajJApUrNa koraAnera zapatha!
tumi avazyai rasUladera ekajana|
sarala pathera anusArI|
(ei koraAna) mahAparAkramazAlI, parama karuNAmaYa (AllAha) kartRka avatIrNa,
yAte tumi emana ekadala lokake satarka karate pAra yAdera pUrvapuruSaderake satarka karA haYani; yAra phale tArA amanoyogI (haYe Ache)|
Asale tAdera adhikAMzera kSetre sei (zAstira) kathA avadhArita haYeche| ataeva, tArA ImAna Anave nA|
Ami tAdera galAYa civuka paryanta lohAra ver3i (galavandhanI) lAgiYe diYechi; phale tAdera mAthA khAr3A haYe Ache|
Ara tAdera sAmane ekaTi deYAla o pechane ekaTi deYAla sthApana karechi evaM tAderake Dheke diYechi; phale tArA (kichui) dekhate pAYa nA|
tAderake tumi satarka karo kiMvA nA karo, tAdera janya (ubhaYai) samAna; tArA ImAna Anave nA|
tumi kevala tAkei satarka karate pAra ye upadeza (koraAna) mene cale evaM nA dekheo parama karuNAmaYake bhaYa kare| ataeva, tumi tAke kSamA o eka mahAna puraskArera (jAnnAtera) susaMvAda dAo|

Amii mRtaderake jIvana dAna kari evaM tArA yA sAmane pAThAYa o yA pechane rekhe yAYa tA (tAdera sAmane-pAThAno o rekhe-yAoYA yAvatIYa satkarma) Ami likhe rAkhi| savakichu Ami eka spaSTa kitAve saMrakSita rekhechi|
tumi tAdera janya (entAkiYA) janapadera adhivAsIdera ekaTi udAharaNa peza karo: yakhana sekhAne rasUlagaNa esechila|

(prathame) Ami tAdera kAche pechane duJcajanake pAThAlAma| kintu tArA tAderake mithyAvAdI valala| takhana Ami tRtIYa ekajanake diYe (tAdera) zaktivRddhi karalAma| rasUlerA valala, “AmarA tomAdera nikaTa prerita (haYechi)|”
adhivAsIrA valala, “tomarA to AmAdera matai mAnuSa| karuNAmaYa (AllAha) kichui nAyila karenani| tomarA zudhu mithyA valacha|”
rasUlerA valala, “AmAdera prabhu jAnena, AmarA avazyai tomAdera nikaTa prerita (haYechi)|”
kevala spaSTa pracArai AmAdera kAja|

adhivAsIrA valala, “AmarA tomAderake azubha mane kari| tomarA yadi virata nA hao tAhale avazyai AmarA tomAderake pAthara mere hatyA karava evaM AmAdera pakSa theke tomAdera opara eka kaSTadAYaka (bhaYAnaka) zAsti neme Asave|”
rasUlerA valala, “tomAdera azubha tomAdera sAthei (raYeche)| tomAderake upadeza deoYA haYeche valei ki (tomarA erUpa valacha)? Asale tomarA eka sImAlaMghanakArI janagoSThI|”
ekaTi loka nagarIra prAnta theke daur3Ate daur3Ate ela| se valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA rasUladera kathA mene nAo|
yArA tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAYa nA evaM nijerA hedAYetaprApta tAdera kathA mene nAo|”
“Ami kena sei mahAna sattAra ivAdata karava nA, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena? Ara tomAderakeo to tA~ra kAchei phire yete have|”
“Ami ki tA~ra parivarte anyAnya upAsya grahaNa karava? karuNAmaYa yadi AmAra kona kSati cAna tAhale tAdera supAriza AmAra kona kAje Asave nA evaM tArA AmAke uddhArao karate pArave nA|
Ami takhana spaSTa vibhrAntira zikAra hava|”
“Ami tomAdera prabhura prati ImAna enechi; ataeva, tomarA AmAra kathA zona|”
(tAke) valA hala, “jAnnAte praveza kara|” se valala, “hAYa, AmAra samapradAYa yadi jAnata
ye, AmAra prabhu AmAke kSamA karechena evaM AmAke sammAnitadera antarbhukta karechena!”
tAra (mRtyura) pare tAra samapradAYera viruddhe Ami AsamAna theke kona vAhinI pAThAini evaM AmAra tA pAThAnora praYojanao chila nA|
ekaTimAtra (vikaTa) AoYAja (&nita hala)| Ara amani tArA nistavdha haYe gela|
var3a Aphasosa (AmAra) vAndAdera janya! tAdera kAche ye rasUlai Asata tAra sAthei tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata|
tArA ki dekheni, Ami tAdera pUrve kata prajanmake dhvaMsa kare diYechi? tArA to Ara tAdera kAche phire Asave nA|
(tave keYAmate tAdera) savAike AmAra sAmane hAjira karA have|
tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana hala mRta jamina| Ami tA jIvita kari o tA theke zasya utpanna kari evaM tArA tA theke AhAra kare|
jamine Ami khejura o AGgurera vAgAna sRSTi karechi evaM sekhAne jharanA pravAhita karechi;
yAte tArA era phala khete pAre; athaca eTA tAdera hAtera sRSTi naYa| tavuo ki tArA kRtajJatA prakAza karave nA?
mahimA sei pavitra sattAra, yini jamina theke utpanna udbhidera o tAdera nijedera (arthAt mAnuSera) evaM tArA yAdera kathA jAne nA tAdera sava jor3A sRSTi karechena|
Ara tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana hala rAta| Ami tA theke dina sariYe dei (dinera Alo pratyAhAra kare nei), amani tArA andhakArAcchanna haYe par3e|
sUrya tAra nirdiSTa gantavyera pAne chuTe cale| eTA parAkramazAlI, mahAvijJa AllAhara nirdhArita niYama|
Ara candrera janya Ami nirdhAraNa karechi kaYekaTi kalA (hrAsavRddhira AkRti: SolakalA), yAra phale tA (saru hate hate eka paryAYe) khejuragAchera purAtana DAlera mata haYe yAYa|
sUryera pakSe candrera nAgAla pAoYA sambhava naYa evaM rAtao dinera Age yete pAre nA| pratyekei AkAze (nija nija kakSapathe) bhese ver3AYa|
Ara tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, Ami tAdera vaMzadharaderake (pitRpuruSaderake) (nUhera) vojhAi naukAYa ArohaNa kariYechilAma|
tAdera janyao ai naukAra anurUpa yAnavAhana sRSTi karechi yAte tArA ArohaNa kare|
Ami yadi icchA kari tAhale tAderake DuviYe dite pAri| takhana tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA evaM tAderake uddhArao karA have nA|
tave AmAra pakSa theke anugrahavazata evaM eka nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta (duniYAra sukha) bhoga karate deoYAra janya (tA kari nA)|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “tomAdera sAmane yA Ache (duniYAra zAsti) evaM pechane yA Ache (AkherAtera zAsti) tAke bhaYa karo, yAte tomarA anugraha lAbha karate pAra” (takhana tArA tA agrAhya kare)|
yakhanai tAdera kAche tAdera prabhura kona nidarzana Ase takhanai tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa|

yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “AllAha tomAderake yA diYechena tA theke vyaYa karo” takhana kApherarA momenaderake vale, “AmarA ki emana kAuke khAoYAva, yAke AllAha icchA karale khAoYAte pArena? tomarA to spaSTa vibhrAntira madhyei raYecho|”
tArA vale, “tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale (vala) ei pratizruti kave pUrNa have?”
tArA kevala ekaTA AoYAjerai apekSAYa Ache, yA tAderake jhagar3AYa lipta thAkA avasthAYa pAkar3Ao karave|
takhana tArA nA pArave kona asiYata karate, Ara nA pArave tAdera parivAra-parijanera kAche phire yete|
Ara ziGgAYa phu~ka deoYA have; amani tArA kavara theke (uThe) tAdera prabhura dike chuTe calave|
tArA valave, hAYare AmAdera durbhoga! AmAderake AmAdera zayyA theke ke uThAlo? karuNAmaYa to erai oYAdA karechilena evaM rasUlagaNao satya kathAi valechilena|
kevalamAtra ekaTi AoYAja have| sAthe sAthe tAdera sakalake AmAra kAche hAjira karA have|
sedina kAro prati kona juluma karA have nA| evaM tomarA (duniYAYa) yA karate tomAderake kevala tArai pratiphala deoYA have|
jAnnAtavAsIrA sedina Amoda-Anande vyasta thAkave|
tArA o tAdera strIrA (zItala) chAYAYa (ArAmadAYaka) Asane helAna diYe vasave|
sekhAne tAdera janya phalamUla thAkave evaM tArA yA cAive tAi pAve|
parama karuNAmaYa prabhura pakSa theke (tAderake) valA have “sAlAma”|
Ara (aparAdhIderake valA have:) he aparAdhIrA! Aja tomarA pRthaka haYe yAo|
he vanI Adama! Ami ki tomAderake vale deini ye, tomarA zaYatAnera dAsatva karave nA, se tomAdera spaSTa zatru?
Ara (vale deini ye,) AmArai ivAdata karave? eTAi to sarala patha|
se (zaYatAna) tomAdera vahusaMkhyaka lokake vipathagAmI karechila| tomarA ki tA vujhate pArani?
ei sei jAhAnnAma, tomAderake yAra pratizruti deoYA haYechila|
Aja tomarA tAte praveza karo, kAraNa tomarA kuphari karate|
Aja Ami tAdera mukhe mohara mere deva evaM tAdera hAta AmAra sAthe kathA valave o tAdera pA tAdera kRtakarmera sAkSya deve|
Ami yadi icchA karatAma tAhale avazyai tAdera cokha vilupta (andha) kare ditAma| takhana patha calate cAile tArA dekhata kIbhAve?
Ami yadi icchA karatAma tAhale avazyai tAdera jAYagAYa tAdera rUpa pAlTe ditAma| takhana tArA nA (sAmane) calate pArata, nA (pechane) phire yete pArata|
Ami yAke dIrghajIvI kari tAke sRSTira pUrvAvasthAYa (zaktizAlI haoYAra para AvAra durvala avasthAYa) niYe yAi| tavuo ki tArA vojhe nA?
Ami tAke (rasUlake) kavitA zikhAini, tAra janya tA samIcInao naYa| ei kitAva to eka smArakapatra Ara spaSTa koraAna|
yAte se jIvita (antaraviziSTa ImAnadAra) vyaktike satarka karate pAre evaM (mRta antaraviziSTa) kApheradera viruddhe zAstira kathA saThika pramANita haYa|
tArA ki dekhe nA ye, Ami tAdera janya nijera (kudaratI) hAte tairI catuSpada jantu sRSTi karechi evaM tArA tAra mAlika haYeche?
eguloke Ami tAdera vazIbhUta karechi| phale edera madhye kataka tAdera vAhana (hiseve kAja kare) Ara kataka tArA khAYa|
tArA egulo theke Aro upakAra o pAnIYa (dudha) peYe thAke| tavuo ki tArA zukariYA AdAYa karave nA?
tArA AllAhara parivarte anyAnya upAsya grahaNa kareche; ei AzAYa ye, tArA (tAdera kAcha theke) sAhAyyaprApta have|
(Asale) tArA tAderake sAhAyya karate sakSama have nA; varaM tArA have tAdera (virodhI) vAhinI, yAderake (hisAvera samaYa) upasthita karA have|
ataeva, tAdera kathAYa tumi duHkha peYo nA| tArA yA gopana kare Ara yA prakAza kare Ami to tA jAni|
mAnuSa ki dekhe nA ye, Ami tAke (nApAka) vIrya theke sRSTi karechi? Ara se kinA haYe yAYa prakAzya jhagar3ATe|
se AmAra samvandhe eka upamA peza kare evaM nijera sRSTira kathA bhule yAYa| se vale, “(mRtera) kSaYaprApta hAr3agulo ke jIvita karave?”
vala, segulo tinii jIvita karavena yini tA prathamavAra sRSTi karechena| pratiTi sRSTii tini bhAlabhAve jAnena|
yini tomAdera janya savuja gAcha theke Aguna utpanna karena; takhana tA theke tomarA (Aguna) jvAlAo|
yini AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena tini ki tAdera anurUpa (anya kichu) sRSTi karate sakSama nana? avazyai; tinii to sarvajJa mahAsraSTA|
tini yakhana kona kichu karate cAna takhana tAke zudhu “hao” vale nirdeza dena, Ara amani tA haYe yAYa|
ataeva, pavitra o mahIYAna tini, yAra hAte raYeche sava jinisera kartRtva| Ara tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
zapatha sArivaddha pherezatAdera,
tArapara (megha) paricAlanAkArI pherezatAdera,
tArapara koraAna (athavA tAsavIha) pAThakArI pherezatAdera!
tomAdera upAsya to ekajanai|
yini AsamAnera, jaminera o tAdera madhyavartI savakichura prabhu evaM (sUryera) udaYasthalasamUhera prabhu|
Ami nikaTavartI AsamAnake tArakArAji dvArA sundara kare sAjiYechi
evaM tAke pratyeka vidrohI zaYatAna theke rakSA karechi|
tArA sarvocca pAriSadera (AllAhara daravAre pherezatAdera) AlocanAYa kAna pAtate pAre nA| tAdera prati sava dika theke (ulkA) nikSipta haYa;
(tAderake) tAr3iYe deoYAra janya| Ara tAdera janya raYeche avirAma zAsti|
tave keu (curi kare) haThAt kichu zune phelale jvalanta ulkA tAra pechane choTe|
ataeva, tumi tAdera kAche jAnate cAo, sRSTi hiseve tArA zaktizAlI, nA Ami (anya) yAderake sRSTi karechi tArA? Ami to tAderake AThAlo mATi thekei sRSTi karechi|
varaM (tAdera auddhatye) tumi vismaYa vodha karo, Ara tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa kare|
yakhana tAderake mane kariYe deoYA haYa, tArA mane rAkhe nA|
Ara yakhana tArA kona nidarzana dekhate pAYa takhana (tA niYe) vidrUpa kare|
Ara vale, “e to pariSkAra yAdu chAr3A kichu naYa|”
“AmarA mare giYe mATi o hAr3agor3e pariNata haoYAra parao ki AmAderake (kavara theke) uThAno have?
AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderakeo?”
vala, “hyA~; Ara tomarA lAJchita avasthAYa thAkave|”
vastuta seTA have ekaTimAtra vikaTa zavda| Ara takhanai tArA dekhate pAve|
tArA valave, “hAYa AmAdera durbhAgya! eTAi to pratidAnera dina|”
(valA have,) “eTAi sei phaYasAlAra dina yAke tomarA mithyA valate|”
(pherezatAderake valA have,) “jAlemaderake, tAdera dosaraderake o tArA yAdera ivAdata karata tAderake ekatrita karo;
(tArA yAdera ivAdata karata) AllAha vyatIta| tArapara tAderake jAhAnnAmera pathe niYe yAo|”
“Ara tAderake thAmAo; kAraNa tAderake prazna karA have:
tomAdera kI hala ye, eke aparake sAhAyya karacha nA?”
varaM tArA sedina AtmasamarpaNa karave|
evaM ekadala Arekadalera mukhomukhi haYe saoYAla-jaoYAva karave|
ekadala valave, “tomarA to AmAdera kAche DAna dika diYe Asate (arthAt AmAdera kalyANa have vale AmAderake diYe anyAYa kAja karAte)|”
apara dala valave, “(Asale tA naYa) varaM tomarA ImAnadAra chile nA|”
“tomAdera opara AmAdera kona kartRtva chila nA; varaM tomarA chile sImAlaMghana-kArI ekadala loka|”
“AmAdera samvandhe AmAdera prabhura kathAi saThika haYeche| AmAderake avazyai (zAsti) AsvAdana karate have|
kenanA AmarA tomAderake vipathagAmI karechilAma, AmarA nijerAo vipathagAmI chilAma|”
tArA (savAi) sedina zAstira aMzIdAra have|
aparAdhIdera sAthe Ami erUpa AcaraNai kari|
yakhana tAderake vala hata, “AllAha chAr3A kona upAsya nei” takhana tArA ahaMkAra karata
Ara valata, “AmarA ki eka pAgala kavira kathAYa AmAdera upAsyadera tyAga karava?”
(ekadama vAje kathA;) varaM se to satya niYe eseche evaM (anya) rasUladerake satya vale ghoSaNA kareche|
tomarA avazyai kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karave|
tomarA yA karate, tArai pratiphala pAve| (arthAt anyAYa kAjera zAsti pAve|)
tave AllAhara vAchAikRta vAndArA naYa| (tArA tAdera satkAjera puraskAra pAve|)
tAdera janya (jAnnAte) nirdiSTa jIvikA raYeche:
phalamUla; Ara tArA sammAnita have,
sukhera vAgAne (jAnnAte);
gadite paraspara mukhomukhi haYe|
tAderake vizuddha zarAvera pAtra parivezana karA have|
yA have zubhrojjvala evaM pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu|
tAte kSatikara kichu thAkave nA evaM tA pAna karale tArA mAtAlao have nA|
tAdera pAze thAkave saMyatadRSTi o DAgaracakSu ramaNIrA;
(saundarye) tArA yena surakSita Dima|
tArA eke aparera mukhomukhi haYe paraspara jijJAsA karave|
tAdera ekajana valave, “AmAra ekajana saGgI chila|
se valata: tumi ki vizvAsa karo ye,
AmarA mare giYe mATi o hAr3agor3e pariNata haoYAra parao (kavara theke uThiYe) AmAderake pratiphala deoYA have?”
AllAha valavena, “tomarA ki dekhate cAo?”
takhana se tAkAve evaM tAke (tAra saGgITike) jAhAnnAmera mAjhakhAne dekhate pAve|
se valave, “AllAhara kasama! AmAke to tumi prAYa dhvaMsa kare diYechile!”
“AmAra prabhura anugraha nA hale Amio to (jAhAnnAmera sAmane) upasthitakRtadera antarbhukta hatAma|
(erapara) AmAdera to Ara mRtyu have nA,
prathamavArera mRtyu chAr3A; evaM AmAderake zAstio deoYA have nA| (arthAt AmarA cirakAla jAnnAtera sukha bhoga karate thAkava|)”
nizcaYai eTAi hala mahAsAphalya|
emanaTi pAoYAra janya savAi kAja karuka|
ApyAYanera janya ki ei jAnnAta bhAla, nA (jAhAnnAmera) yAk‌kUma gAcha? (yAk‌kUma: tikta phalaviziSTa ekaprakAra kA~TAoYAlA gAcha)
jAlemaderake kaSTa deoYAra janya Ami tA sRSTi karechi|
eTA emana ekaTA gAcha yA jAhAnnAmera mUle (taladeze) ud‌gata haYa|
era zISa yena zaYatAnadera mAthA|
jAhAnnAmIrA ai gAcha theke khAdyagrahaNa kare peTa bhare phelave|
tAra opare tAderake garama pAnira mizraNa deoYA have|
tArapara tAdera pratyAvartana ghaTave avazyai jAhAnnAmera dike|
nizcaYai tArA tAdera pUrvapuruSaderake vipathagAmI peYechila|
ataeva, tArAo tAdera pechane pechane chuTe caleche|
Asale tAdera Age pUrvavartIdera adhikAMza vipathagAmI haYechila|
tave Ami tAdera madhye yathArIti satarkakArI (navI-rasUla) pAThiYechilAma|
ataeva lakSya karo, yAderake satarka karA haYechila tAdera pariNati kemana (bhaYAnaka) haYechila;
AllAhara vAchAikRta vAndArA vyatIta|
nUha AmAke Dekechila| Ami (tAra DAke) kata uttama sAr3A diYechi!
Ami tAke o tAra parivAravargake mahAvipada theke rakSA karechi|
(mahApralaYera para kevala) tAra vaMzadharaderakei (duniYAYa) avaziSTa rekhechi|
tAra kathA paravartIdera smaraNe rekhe diYechi|
nUhera opara jagatmaYa zAnti varSita hoka!
ebhAvei Ami nekakAraderake puraskRta kari|
nizcaYai se AmAra mumina vAndAdera anyatama|
tArapara Ami anyaderake DuviYe diYechilAma|
Ara tAra anusArIderai ekajana ivarAhIma|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana se khA~Ti antare tAra prabhura daravAre hAjira haYechila|
yakhana se tAra vAvA o nija samapradAYake valechila, “tomarA kisera upAsanA karo?”
tomarA ki AllAhara parivarte mithyA anyAnya upAsya cAo?
tAhale vizvajagatera prabhu samparke tomAdera dhAraNA ki?
ataHpara se (AkAzera) tArakAdera dike ekavAra tAkAla
evaM (kauzala hiseve) valala, “Ami asustha|”
tArapara tArA (tAra roge AkrAnta haoYAra bhaYe) tAke rekhe cale gela|
takhana se tAdera devatAdera kAche (ghare) gopane praveza kare (tAdera uddezye) valala, “tomarA khAccha nA?
tomAdera kI haYeche ye, kathA valacha nA?”
tArapara se tAra DAna hAta dvArA AghAta karate karate tAdera opara jhA~piYe par3ala|
takhana pujArIrA tAra dike druta egiYe ela|
se (tAderake) valala, “tomarA ki nijedera tairI-karA bhAskaryera pUjA karo?”
athaca tomAderake o tomarA yA kichu tairI karo tA AllAhai sRSTi karechena|
tArA valala, “tAra janya ekaTi kAThAmo (agnikuNDa) tairI karo evaM (sekhAne) tAke jvalanta Agune nikSepa kara|”
tArA tAra viruddhe ekaTi cakrAnta karate ceYechila; kintu Ami tAderakei heYa (parAjita) karalAma|
(Aguna theke rakSA peYe) ivarAhIma valala, “Ami AmAra prabhura kAche yAi, tini AmAke patha dekhAvena|”
“he prabhu! AmAke sat santAna dAna kara|”
Ami tAke eka dhairyazIla chelera (isamAIla) susaMvAda dilAma|

ataHpara yakhana se vAvAra sAthe chuTochuTi karAra vaYase upanIta hala takhana (ekadina) ivarAhIma valala, “vatsa! Ami svapne dekhi ye, Ami tomAke javAi (AllAhara nAme koravAni) karachi| ataeva bheve vala, tomAra mata ki?” se valala, “vAvA! tomAke yA karate valA hacche tAi kara| AmAke tumi inazAAllAha dhairyazIla pAve|”
tArapara yakhana tArA duJcajanei (AllAhara icchAra kAche) AtmasamarpaNa karala evaM vAvA cheleke (koravAni karAra janya) kapAle bhara kariYe zAYita karala,
takhana Ami tAke Deke valalAma, “he ivarAhIma!
tumi svapnake satya pratipanna karecho (svapnake satya nirdeza mane kare tA pAlana karecho)| Ami ebhAvei satkarmazIladera puraskRta kare thAki|”
nizcaYai eTA ekaTA prakAzya parIkSA (chila)|
Ami putrera parivarte ekaTi virATa javAiYera pazu (dumvA) diYechilAma|
tAra ghaTanAke Ami paravartIdera janya (smAraka hiseve) rekhe diYechi|
ivarAhImera opara zAnti varSita hoka!
ebhAvei Ami satkarmazIladera puraskRta kare thAki|
nizcaYai se AmAra mumina vAndAdera antarbhukta|
Ami tAke isahAkera susaMvAda diYechilAma: satkarmazIladera madhya theke ekajana navIrUpe|
Ami tAke o isahAkake varakata dAna karechilAma| tAdera vaMzadharadera madhye keu chila satkarmazIla, AvAra keu chila nijera prati spaSTa julumakArI|
Ami mUsA o hArUnera prati anugraha karechilAma;
evaM tAderake o tAdera samapradAYake mahAvipada theke uddhAra karechilAma|
Ami tAderake sAhAyya karechilAma, yAra phale tArAi vijaYI haYechila|
tAdera duJcajanake Ami spaSTa kitAva diYechilAma;
evaM saThika pathe paricAlita karechilAma|
tAdera duJcajanera ghaTanAke Ami paravartIdera janya (smAraka hiseve) rekhe diYechi|
mUsA o hArUnera prati zAnti varSita hoka!
Ami to ebhAvei satkarmazIladera puraskRta kare thAki|
nizcaYai tArA duJcajana AmAra mumina vAndAdera antarbhukta|
Ara iliYAsa avazyai ekajana rasUla|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana se tAra samapradAYake valala, “tomarA ki (AllAhake) bhaYa karave nA?”
“tomarA ki vAjJala (devatA)-ke DAkave, Ara sarvottama sraSTAke parityAga karave?
(arthAt) tomAdera prabhu o tomAdera pUrvapuruSadera prabhu AllAhake (parityAga karave)?”
takhana tArA tAke mithyAvAdI valala| tAi tAderake avazyai (zAstira janya) upasthita karA have;
AllAhara vAchAikRta vAndAdera vyatIta|
tAra ghaTanAke Ami paravartIdera janya (smAraka hiseve) rekhe diYechi|
il‌iYAsInera (iliYAsera) opara zAnti varSita hoka!
Ami ebhAvei satkarmazIladera puraskRta kare thAki|
nizcaYai se AmAra mumina vAndAdera antarbhukta|
Ara lUtao avazyai ekajana rasUla|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana Ami tAke o tAra parivArera savAike uddhAra karechilAma;
eka vRddhA chAr3A, ye pechane avasthAna-kArIdera madhye chila| (se chila lUtera avAdhya strI| se lUtera saGgI nA haYe anyadera sAthe pechane raYe giYechila|)
ataHpara Ami anyaderake dhvaMsa kare diYechilAma|
tomarA tAdera dhvaMsAvazeSera opara diYe yAtAYAta karo sakAle
o rAte| tavuo ki tomarA vojha nA?
Ara iunusao avazyai ekajana rasUla|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana se vojhAi naukAra dike pAliYe giYechila|
ataHpara se bhAgya parIkSAra laTArite aMza neYa evaM parAsta (haYe doSI sAvyasta) haYa|
(ye kAraNe tAke naukA theke nadIte phele deoYA haYa|) ataHpara ekaTi var3a mAcha tAke gile phele| takhana se nijeke bhartsanA kare|
(ai avasthAYa) se yadi tAsavIha nA par3ata (AllAhara guNagAna nA karata)
tAhale keYAmatera dina paryanta mAchera peTei theke yeta|
ataHpara Ami tAke rugna avasthAYa tRNavihIna prAntare nikSepa kari|
evaM (tAke chAYA devAra janya) tAra kAche ekaTi lAugAcha janmAi|
Ami tAke eka lakSa kiMvA tArao vezi lokera kAche (dvIna pracArera janya) pAThiYechilAma|
tArA ImAna enechila; tAi Ami tAderake kichukAlera janya bhogera suyoga diYechilAma|
ekhana tAdera kAche jAnate cAo, tomAra prabhura janya kanyA Ara tAdera janya putra?
nA ki tArA dekhachila ye, Ami pherezatAderake nArIrUpe sRSTi karechi?
jene rekho! tArA avazyai managar3A mithyA vale ye,
AllAha santAna janma diYechena| tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
tini ki (tAhale) putrera ceYe kanyA vezi pachanda karechena?
tomAdera haYeche ki? tomarA kemana vicAra karo?
tave ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?
nAki tomAdera kAche (tomAdera dAvira pakSe) kona spaSTa pramANa Ache?
tAhale tomAdera kitAva niYe Asa, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
tArA AllAha o jvinadera madhye ekaTA AtmIYatA-samparka AviSkAra kareche; athaca jvinerA jAne ye, tAderake (hisAvera janya AllAhara daravAre) hAjira karA have|
tArA (AllAha samparke) ye sava kathA vale AllAha tA theke pavitra|
tave AllAhara vAchAikRta vAndArA naYa| (tArA osava bhittihIna kathA vale nA|)
ataeva, tomarA evaM tomAdera upAsyarA,
tomarA (keui) AllAhara vyApAre (kAuke) vibhrAnta karate pArave nA;
ekamAtra tAke chAr3A ye jAhAnnAme praveza karave|
(pherezatAdera kathA:) AmAdera pratyekera janyai nirdiSTa sthAna raYeche;
AmarA avazyai (nAmAye) sArivaddha hai|
Ara AmarA avazyai AllAhara pavitratA varNanA kari|
tArA (Arava pauttalikarA) to valatai,
“yadi AmAdera kAche pUrvavartIdera mata kona upadeza (kitAva) thAkata,
tAhale avazyai AmarA AllAhara vAchAikRta vAndA hatAma|”
kintu ekhana (ei koraAna AsAra para) tArA eke avizvAsa karala| ataeva, tArA (era pariNAma) jAnate pArave|
AmAra prerita vAndAdera (rasUladera) janya AmAra kathA Agei Thika haYe Ache:
tArA avazyai sAhAyyaprApta have;
evaM AmAra sainikerAi vijaYI have|
ataeva, kichukAlera janya tumi tAdera theke phire thAka;
Ara tAderake dekhate thAka| tArA (tAdera pariNAma) dekhate pAve|
tArA ki AmAra zAsti tAr3AtAr3i pete cAYa?
kintu zAsti yakhana tAdera AGginAYa neme Asave takhana yAderake satarka karA haYeche tAdera sakAlaTA kata khArApa have!
kichukAlera janya tAdera theke phire thAka;
Ara (tAderake) dekhate thAka| tArA (tAdera pariNAma) dekhate pAve|
tArA ye sava kathA vale, sammAna o zaktira mAlika tomAra prabhu tA theke pavitra|
rasUladera prati zAnti varSita hoka!
nikhila jagatera mAlika AllAhara janyai sakala prazaMsA|
chAda [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| upadezapUrNa koraAnera zapatha!
tave yArA kAphera, tArA (mithyA) ahaMkAra o virodhitAYa lipta|
tAdera pUrve Ami kata janagoSThIke dhvaMsa kare diYechi! takhana tArA citkAra kareche, kintu palAYanera kona samaYa chila nA|
tArA (pauttalikarA) ejanya vismaYavodha karala ye, tAdera kAche tAdera madhya thekei ekajana satarkakArI eseche| Ara kApherarA valala, “e to eka yAdukara, mithyAvAdI|”
“se ki vahu upAsyake eka upAsya kare diYeche? e to eka adbhuta vyApAra!”
tAdera mor3alerA ei vale cale gela, “tomarA giYe tomAdera upAsyadera upAsanAYa aTala thAka| nizcaYai eTA (tomAdera viruddhe) ekaTA uddezyamUlaka vyApAra|”
“AmarA to sarvazeSa dharme (khriSTAna dharme) ekathA zunini! eTA mithyA udbhAvana chAr3A kichu naYa|”
“AmAdera madhya theke tAra kAchei ki upadeza (koraAna) avatIrNa hala?” Asale orA AmAra upadeza samparke sandehera madhye Ache| varaM orA (ekhano) AmAra zAsti AsvAdana kareni|
nAki tAdera kAche tomAra parAkramazAlI dAnazIla prabhura anugrahera bhANDAra Ache?
nAki AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichura kartRtva tAderai? tAhale tArA razi dhare (AsamAne) ArohaNa karuka|
se kSetre (tAdera) ye vAhinIi hoka, tA (atItera) var3a var3a dalera mata parAjita have|
tAdera pUrve rasUladerake avizvAsa karechila nUhera samapradAYa, Ada jAti, kIlakaoYAlA (senA-zivirera adhikArI) pherAuna,
chAmUda, lUtera samapradAYa o AikAra adhivAsIrA (AikA: zoYAiva A.-era elAkAra nAma)| tArAi hala (atItera) var3a var3a dala|
erA savAi rasUladerake avizvAsa karechila, tAi (tAdera opara) AmAra zAsti jarurI haYe par3echila|
erA ekaTimAtra vikaTa AoYAjera apekSAYa Ache, yAte kona virati thAkave nA| (arthAt AoYAja haoYAra sAthe sAthe ekamAtra AllAha chAr3A savakichu dhvaMsa haYe yAve|)
tArA vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! hisAva-divasera pUrvei Age Age AmAdera prApya AmAderake diYe dAo|”
tAdera kathAYa dhairyadhAraNa karo evaM AmAra zaktizAlI vAndA dAudake smaraNa kara| nizcaYai se AllAhara dike pratyAvartanakArI (AllAhara anugata)|
Ami pAhAr3a-parvatake tAra sAthe vikele o sakAle AmAra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karAra janya niYojita karechilAma|
Ara pAkhiderakeo, yArA (tAra kAche) ekatrita hata| pratyekei tAra abhimukhI (anugata)|
Ara Ami tAra rAjyake sudRr3ha karechilAma evaM tAke prajJA (navuoYAta) o saThika vicArazakti dAna karechilAma|

Ara tomAra kAche ki vivadamAna lokadera vRttAnta eseche (tumi ki vivadamAna lokadera vRttAnta jenecho), yakhana tArA deYAla DiGgiYe (dAudera) ivAdatera jAYagAYa (athavA ekAnta kakSe) praveza karechila?

tArA yakhana dAudera kAche praveza karala takhana se tAderake dekhe bhaYa pela| tArA valala, “bhaYa karavena nA| AmarA dui vivadamAna pakSa| AmAdera eka pakSa apara pakSera viruddhe vAr3AvAr3i kareche| Apani AmAdera madhye nyAyya mImAMsA kare dina, avicAra karavena nA| Ara AmAderake saThika patha pradarzana karuna|”

(Agantukadera ekajana Arekajana samvandhe valala,) “ei lokaTi AmAra bhAi| tAra nirAnavvaiTi bher3I Ache, Ara AmAra Ache mAtra ekaTi bher3I| tAraparao se vale: oTi AmAra jimmAYa diYe dAo| se AmAke kathAYa hAriYe diYeche|”

dAuda valala, “tomAra bher3ITA tAra bher3Igulora sAthe milAte ceYe se avazyai tomAra prati avicAra kareche| (ebhAve) zarIkadera anekei eke anyera viruddhe vAr3AvAr3i kare thAke; avazya ImAnadAra o satkarmazIlarA era vyatikrama, tave tArA saMkhyAYa kama|” dAuda dhAraNA karala ye, Ami tAke parIkSA karechi| tAi se tAra prabhura kAche kSamA cAila evaM sejadAYa luTiYe par3e taovA karala|sejadA
Ami tAra se aparAdha kSamA karalAma| Ara tAra (dAuda) janya to AmAra kAche naikaTya (maryAdA) o uttama pratyAvartanasthala (jAnnAta) Achei|

he dAuda! Ami tomAke pRthivIte ekajana pratinidhi karechi| ataeva, mAnuSera madhye nyAyya mImAMsA kara| pravRttira anusaraNa karo nA; tAhale se tomAke AllAhara patha theke vicyuta karave| yArA AllAhara patha theke vicyuta haYa tAdera janya kaThora zAsti raYeche; kAraNa tArA hisAvera dinake bhule giYeche|
AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI kona kichu Ami ahetuka sRSTi karini| eTA kApheradera dhAraNA| ataeva, kApheradera janya jAhAnnAmera durbhoga raYeche|
Ami ki ImAnadAra o satkarmazIladerake pRthivIte golayoga sRSTikArIdera samAna gaNya karava? nAki mottAkIderake pApAcArIdera samAna gaNya karava?
eTi ekaTi varakatamaYa kitAva, yA Ami tomAra kAche avatIrNa karechi, yAte mAnuSa tAra AYAtasamUha gabhIrabhAve cintA kare evaM vuddhimAnerA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ami dAudera janya (putra) solAYamAnake dAna karechi| se eka uttama vAndA| nizcaYai se AllAha-abhimukhI|
(smaraNa karo) yakhana aparAhne tAra sAmane utkRSTa ghor3Agulo upasthita karA haYechila,

takhana se valala, “Ami to AmAra prabhura smaraNa (vikelera nAmAya) bhule sampadera (ghor3Agulora) mohe AkRSTa haYechi| yAra phale sUrya pardAra Ar3Ale lukiYe giYeche (evaM nAmAyera samaYa zeSa haYe giYeche)|
ogulo (ghor3Agulo) AmAra kAche phiriYe Ana|” ataHpara se segulora nalA (pA) o galA kATate Arambha karala|
Ami solAYamAnake parIkSA karalAma evaM tAra siMhAsanera opara ekaTi deha rekhe dilAma| ataHpara se (bhula theke) phire ela|
se valala, “prabhu! AmAke kSamA karo evaM AmAke emana eka rAjya dAna karo yA AmAra pare Ara kAro nA haYa| tumii to mahAna dAtA|”
takhana Ami vAtAsake tAra adhIna kare dilAma, se yekhAne cAita tAra hukume tA zAntabhAve sekhAne pravAhita hata|
Ara (tAra adhIna kare dilAma) zaYatAnadera madhye pratyeka bhavana nirmANakArI o DuvurIke
evaM zikale ve~dhe-rAkhA Aro anekake|
(Ami solAYamAnake valechilAma,) “esava AmAra dAna| egulo tumi vine hiseve vyaYa karate kiMvA rekhe dite pAra|”
Ara tAra (solAYamAna) janya to AmAra kAche naikaTya (maryAdA) o uttama pratyAvartanasthala (jAnnAta) Achei|
AmAra vAndA Aiuvera kathA smaraNa kara| yakhana se tAra prabhuke samvodhana kare valala, “zaYatAna AmAke durbhoga Ara kaSTe phele diYeche|”
(Ami tAke valalAma,) “tomAra pA diYe (mATite) AghAta kara| (mATi theke pAni vera hala|) ei to gosalera ThANDA pAni Ara pAnIYa| (e pAni dvArA gosala karo evaM tA pAna kara|)”
AmAra pakSa theke anugrahasvarUpa o vuddhimAnadera janya zikSAgrahaNera upAdAnasvarUpa Ami tAra janya tAra parivAravargake phiriYe dilAma evaM tAdera sAthe tAdera mata Aro anekake dAna karalAma|

(tAke valechilAma,) “ekamuTho tRNa hAte nAo evaM tA diYe (tomAra strIke) prahAra karo evaM zapatha bhaGga karo nA|” (kona kAraNe Aiuva A. tA~ra strIra prati kruddha haYe tAke ekazata vetrAghAta karAra zapatha karechilena| AllAha tA~ke vizeSa vyavasthAYa zapatha Thika rekhe zAsti laghu karAra upAYa vale diYechena|) Ami tAke dhairyazIla pelAma| kata uttama vAndA se! nizcaYai se AllAhara dike pratyAvartanakArI (AllAhamukhI)|
AmAra vAndA ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYAkUvera kathA smaraNa kara| tArA chila hAta o cokhera adhikArI (arthAt zaktizAlI o dUradRSTisampanna)|

ekaTi vizeSa guNa jJaparalokera smaraNaJca diYe Ami tAderake vAchAi karechilAma| (arthAt tAdera pratyekake ei guNaTi deoYA haYechila| phale, tArA nijerA savasamaYa paralokera smaraNa karata evaM lokaderakeo tA smaraNa kariYe dita|)
tArA AmAra kAche manonIta zreSTha vAndAdera antarbhukta|
isamAIla, Ala-iYAsA o yula-kiph‌lera kathAo smaraNa kara| erAo pratyeke zreSThadera antarbhukta|
e hala eka smaraNIYa varNanA| Ara mottAkIdera janya raYeche uttama pratyAvartanasthala|
cirasthAYI vasavAsera jAnnAta, yAra darajA tAdera janya unmukta|
sekhAne tArA helAna diYe vasave, sekhAne tArA aneka phalamUla o pAnIYa cAive|
tAdera kAche thAkave saMyatadRSTi ekavaYasI ramaNIrA;
hisAva-divasera janya tomAderake erai pratizruti deoYA hacche|
nizcaYai eTA AmAra deoYA jIvikA, yA kakhano niHzeSa have nA|
eTA (mottAkIdera janya); Ara sImAlaMghanakArIdera (pApIdera) janya raYeche nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|
jAhAnnAma, yAte tArA praveza karave| kata khArApa vizrAmasthala!
eTA (sImAlaMghanakArIdera janya); tArA tA AsvAdana karuka: garama pAni Ara pu~ja|
Aro Ache, ekairakama kaYekaprakAra (zAsti)|
ei to ekadala tomAdera sAthe (jAhAnnAme) praveza karache| edera janya kona abhyarthanA nei| erA to Agune jvalave|
anusArIrA (netAderake) valave, “varaM tomarA; tomAdera janyai kona abhyarthanA nei| tomarAi AmAdera janya eTA (ei zAsti) niYe esecho| kata khArApa AvAsasthala (ei jAhAnnAma)!”
tArA valave, “he prabhu! ye AmAdera janya eTA niYe eseche jAhAnnAme tumi tAra zAsti dviguNa vAr3iYe dAo|”
tArA Arao valave, “AmAdera kI haYeche? ye lokaguloke AmarA khArApa gaNya karatAma tAderake ye dekhate pAcchi nA!”
“AmarA ki tAderake ThATTAra pAtra vAniYechilAma, nA ki (AmAdera) cokha tAderake dekhate bhula kareche?”
eTA arthAt jAhAnnAmIdera ei jhagar3A avazyai satya (vAstavei ghaTave)|
vala, “Ami to kevala ekajana satarkakArI| Ara ekaka o parama pratApazAlI AllAha chAr3A kona upAsya nei|
tini AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichura prabhu evaM mahAparAkramazAlI o parama kSamAzIla|”
vala, “eTi (ei koraAna) ekaTi mahAsaMvAda,
yA theke tomarA mukha phiriYe niccha|”
“sarvocca pAriSada (AllAhara daravAre pherezatAdera samAveza) samparke AmAra kona jJAna chila nA (Ami kichui jAnatAma nA), yakhana tArA vAdAnuvAda karachila|
AmAra kAche ye ohI Ase tA theke Ami zudhu etaTuku jAni ye, Ami kevala ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|”
(smaraNa karo) yakhana tomAra prabhu pherezatAderake valalena, “Ami (Thika karechi,) mATi theke mAnuSa sRSTi karava|
sutarAM yakhana Ami tAra AkRti Thika kare tAte AmAra (sRSTa) prANa phu~ke deva takhana tomarA tAra sammAne sejadAYa par3e yeYo|”
(ei nirdezamata) pherezatArA savAi (Adamake) sejadA karala|
kintu ivalIsa karala nA| se (mATira tairI mAnuSera ceYe) nijeke var3a mane karala evaM (AllAhara nirdeza amAnya kare) kApheradera dalabhukta haYe gela|
AllAha valalena, “ivalIsa! Ami yAke nija hAte sRSTi karechi tAra sammAne sejadA karate ke tomAke niSedha karala? tumi ki nijeke var3a mane karo, nA ki tumi khuva uccamaryAdAsampanna?”
se valala, “Ami tAra ceYe zreSTha| (kAraNa) AmAke tumi Aguna theke sRSTi karecho, Ara tAke sRSTi karecho mATi theke|”
tini valalena, “tAhale tui ekhAna theke vera haYe yA; kAraNa tui vitAr3ita haoYArai yogya|
Ara tora opara AmAra abhizApa thAkave vicArera dina paryanta|”
se valala, “he prabhu! tAhale (mAnuSake pathabhraSTa karAra janya) AmAke sedina paryanta avakAza dAo yedina tAderake (kavara theke) uThAno have|”
tini valalena, “toke avakAza deYA hala,
nirdiSTa samaYa AsAra dina paryanta|”
se valala, “tomAra kSamatAra zapatha! Ami tAdera sakalake pathabhraSTa karava|
kevala tAdera madhya theke tomAra vAchAikRta vAndAdera chAr3A|”
tini valalena, “tAhale to Thikai Ache, Ara Ami Thikai vali,
tora dvArA evaM tAdera madhye yArA tora anusArI have tAdera sakalera dvArA Ami avazyai jAhAnnAma bhare phelava|”
(he navI!) vala, “Ami era janya (arthAt koraAnera janya) tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAi nA evaM Ami kona bhAnakArIo nai|”
e to sArA vizvavAsIra janya eka upadeza mAtra|
kichukAla parai tomarA era saMvAda (ete varNita yAvatIYa tathyera satyatA) avazyai jAnate pArave|
ei kitAva nAyila haYeche parAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna AllAhara pakSa theke|
Ami tomAra kAche satyasaha (ei) kitAva nAyila karechi| ataeva, dvInake kevala AllAhara janya nivedita kare tumi tA~ra ivAdata kara|

jene rAkha, khA~Ti dvIna kevala AllAharai| Ara yArA tA~ra parivarte (anyaderake) abhibhAvaka (upAsya) grahaNa kare, (tArA vale,) “AmarA to kevala e janyai tAdera upAsanA kari yAte tArA AmAderake AllAhara nikaTavartI kare deYa|” nizcaYai AllAha tAdera matabhedera vyApAre tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare devena| ye mithyAvAdI Ara var3a avizvAsI AllAha tAke hedAYeta karena nA|
AllAha yadi santAna grahaNa karate cAitena tAhale tini yA sRSTi karena tA theke avazyai yA icchA veche nitena| tini pavitra o mahAna! tini ekaka o parama pratApazAlI AllAha|

tini AsamAna o jamina ThikaThikabhAve sRSTi karechena| tini dinera opara rAtake ghuriYe Anena evaM rAtera opara dinake ghuriYe Anena| tini sUrya o canadrake kAje niYojita karechena| pratyekaTi (yAra yAra kakSapathe) ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta calache| jene rAkha, tinii mahAparAkramazAlI, parama kSamAzIla|

tini tomAderake ekajana mAnuSa (Adama) theke sRSTi karechena| tini tAra theke tAra strI (hAoYA)-ke sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janya ATa jor3A gavAdipazu pAThiYechena| tini tomAderake tomAdera mAYera peTe tina starera andhakArera mAjhe dhApe dhApe sRSTi karena| tinii tomAdera prabhu AllAha| kartRtva tA~rai| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nAi| tAhale kemana kare tomarA (tA~ra theke) mukha phiriYe nAo?

yadi tomarA akRtajJa hao tAhale (jAnave,) AllAha tomAdera mukhApekSI nana| tini tA~ra vAndAdera akRtajJatA pachanda karena nA| Ara yadi kRtajJa hao, tAhale tini tomAdera ei kRtajJatA pachanda karena| ekajana vojhA vahanakArI Arekajanera vojhA vahana karave nA| ataHpara tomAdera prabhura kAchei tomAdera pratyAvartana| takhana tini tomAderake tomAdera kRtakarma avahita karavena| nizcaYai tini antarera viSaYa samyaka avagata Achena|

mAnuSera yakhana kaSTa Ase takhana se tAra prabhura prati ekaniSTha haYe tA~ke DAke| tArapara yakhana tini tAke tA~ra kona neYAmata dAna karena takhana ye janya itipUrve se tA~ke Dekechila tA bhule yAYa evaM AllAhara patha theke (mAnuSake) vicyuta karAra janya tA~ra samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa| vala, “kichukAlera janya tumi tomAra kuphari bhoga kare lao (kupharira madhye theke Ananda kare nAo)| tumi to jAhAnnAmerai vAsindA have|

ye vyakti rAtera velAYa sejadArata vA dA~r3Ano avasthAYa (nAmAyera madhye) theke AllAhara prati anugata thAke Ara parakAlera bhaYa kare o nija prabhura anugraha kAmanA kare, se ki (tAra samAna have, ye emanaTi kare nA)? vala, “yArA jAne Ara yArA jAne nA, tArA ki samAna hate pAre?” vastuta vuddhimAnerAi upadeza grahaNa kare thAke|

(AmAra e kathATi) vale dAo, “he AmAra ImAnadAra vAndArA! tomarA tomAdera prabhuke bhaYa kara| yArA e duniYAYa satkAja kare tAdera janya kalyANa Ache| Ara AllAhara jamina prazasta| dhairyadhAraNakArIderake vine hiseve tAdera puro puraskAra deoYA have|”
vala, “AmAke nirdeza deoYA haYeche, yena dvInake kevala AllAhara janya nivedita kare tA~ra ivAdata kari|
evaM AmAke nirdeza deoYA haYeche, yena Ami (AllAhara kAche) prathama AtmasamarpaNakArI hai|”
vala, “Ami eka bhaYAnaka dinera zAstira bhaYa kari, yadi AmAra prabhuura avAdhya hai|”
vala, “Ami AmAra dvInake kevala AllAhara janya nivedita kare tA~ra ivAdata kari|
tomarA tA~ke chAr3A yAra icchA tAra upAsanA karo giYe|” vala, “kSatigrasta tArAi, yArA keYAmatera dina tAdera nijedera o parivAra-parijanera kSati karave| jene rAkha, seTAi have spaSTa kSati|”
tAdera janya tAdera opare o tAdera nice Agunera AcchAdana thAkave| AllAha tAra vAndAderake era bhaYa dekhAcchena| ataeva, he AmAra vAndArA! tomarA AmAke bhaYa kara|
Ara yArA tAgUtera (deva-devIra) pUjA karA theke dUre thAke evaM AllAhara dike mukha phirAYa (manoniveza kare), tAdera janya susaMvAda raYeche| ataeva, AmAra (erUpa khA~Ti) vAndAderake susaMvAda dAo|
yArA mana diYe kathA zone evaM bhAla kathA mene cale| oderakei AllAha patha dekhiYechena evaM orAi vuddhimAna|
yAra opara zAstira hukuma dhArya haYe geche tumi ki sei jAhAnnAmIke rakSA karate pArave?
tave yArA tAdera prabhuke bhaYa kare, tAdera janya nirmita Ache prAsAdera opara prAsAda, yAra taladeza diYe pravAhita haYa nadI| (eTA) AllAhara oYAdA| AllAha (tA~ra) oYAdA khelApha karena nA|

tumi ki dekha nA ye, AllAha AsamAna theke pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karena, tArapara tA jamine jharNArUpe pravAhita karena, tArapara tA diYe vibhinna raGera phasala utpanna karena, tArapara (ekasamaYa) tA zukiYe yAYa evaM tumi tAke halade (vivarNa) dekha, tArapara tini tAke khar3akuTAYa pariNata karena? ete vuddhimAnadera janya avazyai upadeza raYeche|

tAi AllAha yAra antara isalAmera janya khule diYechena, yAra phale se tAra prabhura deoYA (ImAnera) AloYa Alokita, se ki (tAra samAna ye ImAnera Alo pAYani)? ataeva, AllAhake smaraNa karAra velAYa yArA kaThinahRdaYa, tAdera janya durbhoga Ache! orA pariSkAra vibhrAntira madhye raYeche|

AllAha sarvazreSTha vANI arthAt ekaTi kitAva (koraAna) avatIrNa karechena, yAra aMzasamUha paraspara sAdRzyapUrNa evaM yA vAravAra paThita haYa| yArA tAdera prabhuke bhaYa kare, e vANIte (ei kitAva pATha kiMvA zravaNa karale) tAdera cAmar3A (zarIra) ke~pe oThe| tArapara tAdera zarIra o antara AllAhara smaraNe vinamra haYa| eTA AllAhara pathanirdeza| era dvArA tini yAke icchA patha pradarzana karena| Ara AllAha yAke vipathe nena tAra janya kona pathapradarzaka nei|

tAi ye vyakti keYAmatera dina nijera mukhamaNDala dvArA bhaYaMkara zAsti ThekAte cAive se ki (tAra mata, ye nirApade jAnnAte praveza karave)? Ara jAlemaderake valA have, “tomarA yA karate tAra svAda grahaNa kara|”
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo (satyake) mithyA valechila| tAi tAdera opara emanabhAve zAsti esechila ye, tArA anubhavao karate pAreni|
ebhAve AllAha tAderake pArthiva jIvanei lAJchanA AsvAdana karAlena| Ara parakAlera zAsti to Arao gurutara| yadi tArA jAnata!
ei koraAne Ami mAnuSera janya sava dRSTAnta varNanA karechi, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
(eke) vakratAmukta eka AravI koraAna (hiseve nAyila karechi), yAte tArA (sahaje) tAkaoYA avalamvana kare calate pAre|

AllAha ekaTi dRSTAnta varNanA karachena: ekajana lokera (dAsera) mAlika kaYekajana jhagar3ATe aMzIdAra (vahu deva-devIra pUjArIra pratIka), Arekajana loka zudhu eka vyaktira mAlikAnAdhIna (eka AllAhara ivAdatakArIra pratIka)| ei dujanera avasthA ki ekarakama? sakala prazaMsA AllAhara| varaM tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
nizcaYai tomAra mRtyu have evaM nizcaYai tAderao mRtyu have|
tArapara keYAmatera dina nizcaYai tomarA tomAdera prabhura sAmane vitarka karave|

ye vyakti AllAha samvandhe mithyA vale evaM tAra kAche satya AsAra para tAke avizvAsa kare tAra ceYe var3a jAlema ke Ache? jAhAnnAme ki kApheradera janya kona AvAsasthala nei? (avazyai Ache evaM sekhAnei tArA vAsa karave|)
Ara yArA satya niYe eseche evaM yArA tA vizvAsa kareche tArAi mottAkI|
tArA yA cAive, tAdera prabhura kAche tAi pAve| seTAi satkarmazIladera puraskAra|
yAte AllAha tAdera manda kAjagulo kSamA kare dena evaM tAdera bhAla kAjagulora janya tAderake puraskRta karena|
AllAha ki tA~ra vAndAra janya yatheSTa nana? athaca tArA tomAke tini chAr3A anya upAsyadera bhaYa dekhAYa| AllAha yAke vipathagAmI karena tAke keu patha dekhAte pAre nA|
Ara AllAha yAke patha dekhAna tAke keu vipathagAmI karate pAre nA| AllAha ki parAkramazAlI, zAsti pradAnakArI nana?

tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa karo, “AsamAna o jamina ke sRSTi kareche?” tArA avazyai valave, “AllAha”| vala, “tAhale AmAke vala, tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka, AllAha yadi AmAra kona kSati cAna tAhale tArA ki tA~ra se kSati dUra karate pArave? kiMvA tini yadi AmAke kona anugraha karate cAna tAhale tArA ki tA~ra se anugraha rodha karate pArave?” vala, “AmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| nirbharakArIrA tA~ra oparai nirbhara kare|”
vala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA tomAdera avasthAne kAja karo, Amio (AmAra avasthAne) kAja karachi| tArapara tomarA jAnave
kAra opara lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti Ase evaM cirasthAYI zAsti Apatita haYa|”

Ami mAnuSera kalyANera janyai tomAra prati satyasaha kitAva nAyila karechi| ataeva, ye supathagAmI haYa se nijera upakArera janyai tA kare, Ara ye vipathagAmI haYa se nijera kSatira janyai vipathagAmI haYa| tumi tAdera karmavidhAYaka nao|

AllAha AtmAsamUha niYe nena tAdera mRtyura samaYa; Ara yegulora mRtyura samaYa Aseni seguloo tAdera ghumera samaYe (niYe rAkhena)| tArapara yegulora mRtyura phaYasAlA karena segulo rekhe dena evaM anyaguloke eka nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta (ve~ce thAkAra janya) cher3e dena| nizcaYai era madhye cintAzIla lokadera janya nidarzana raYeche|
tArA ki AllAha vyatIta anyAnya supArizakArI grahaNa kareche? vala, “tArA kona kichura kSamatA nA rAkhaleo evaM tAdera kona vuddhi nA thAkaleo ki (tAderake tArA supArizakArIrUpe grahaNa karave)!”
vala, “sakala supArizera mAlika AllAha| AsamAna o jaminera rAjatva tA~rai| ataHpara tomAderake tA~ra kAchei phiriYe neoYA have|”
eka AllAhara kathA Alocita hale parakAla avizvAsIdera antara saMkucita haYa| Ara tini chAr3A anyadera (mithyA upAsyadera) kathA Alocita halei tArA khuzI haYa|
vala, “he AllAha, AsamAna o jaminera sraSTA, adRzya o dRzyamAna viSaYa samvandhe jJAta sattA! tumii tomAra vAndAdera madhye tAdera matavirodhera viSaYe mImAMsA karate pAra|”

pRthivIte yA kichu Ache, jAlemadera yadi tA savao thAke evaM tAra sAthe Aro samaparimANa yukta haYa, tAhale keYAmatera dina kaThina zAsti theke vA~cAra janya tArA tA muktipaNa hiseve diYe deve| Ara (sedina) tArA AllAhara pakSa theke emana kichu (zAsti) dekhate pAve yA tArA dhAraNAo karata nA|
tArA tAdera apakarmasamUha dekhate pAve evaM yA niYe tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tA tAderake ghire dharave|

mAnuSa yakhana kona kaSTe par3e takhana AmAke DAke| AvAra yakhana Ami tAke AmAra pakSa theke kona neYAmata dAna kari takhana vale, “AmAke to eTA AmAra jJAnera kAraNei deoYA haYeche|” (Asale tA naYa,) varaM oTA ekaTA parIkSA; tave tAdera adhikAMzai jAne nA|
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo o rakama valechila| tave tAdera kRtakarma tAdera kona upakAre Aseni|
tAdera apakarmasamUha tAderake AghAta karechila| edera madhyeo yArA anyAYa kare tAdera kRtakarmao tAderake AghAta karave| tArA kichutei pAlAte pArave nA|
tArA ki jAne nA ye, AllAha yAra janya icchA jIvikA prazasta karena (vAr3iYe dena) evaM (yAra janya icchA tA) saMkucita karena| ete mumina lokadera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|

(AmAra ei kathA lokaderake) vale dAo, “he AmAra vAndArA, yArA nijedera opara vAr3AvAr3i karecho! AllAhara rahamata theke nirAza haYo nA| AllAha to sava gunAha mApha kare dena| nizcaYai tini parama kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|”
“tomAdera opara zAsti AsAra Age tomarA tomAdera prabhura abhimukhI hao evaM tA~ra kAche AtmasamarpaNa kara| tAra pare (kintu) tomAderake sAhAyya karA have nA|”
“AkasmikabhAve o ajJAtasAre zAsti ese par3Ara Age tomAdera prabhura nikaTa theke tomAdera prati avatIrNa uttama viSaYera (arthAt koraAnera vidhAnasamUhera) anusaraNa kara|”
yAte kAuke valate nA haYa, “AllAhara prati kartavye avahelA karechi vale hAYa AmAra Aphasosa! Ara Ami to (satyera prati) upahAsakArIdera antarbhukta chilAma|”
athavA keu nA vale, “AllAha yadi AmAke patha dekhAtena tAhale to avazyai Ami mottAkIdera antarbhukta hatAma|”
athavA keu zAsti dekhAra samaYa nA vale, “Ami yadi ArekavAra pRthivIte phire satkarmazIladera antarbhukta hate pAratAma!”
hyA~, tomAra kAche AmAra nidarzanasamUha esechila, kintu tumi tAke mithyA AkhyAYita karechile| tumi ahaMkAra karechile evaM kApheradera antarbhukta haYechile|
yArA AllAhara viruddhe mithyA vale, keYAmatera dina tumi tAdera mukhamaNDala kAlo dekhave| jAhAnnAme ki ahaMkArIdera janya kona AvAsasthala nei? (avazyai Ache evaM sekhAnei tArA vAsa karave|)
AllAha mottAkIderake tAdera sAphalyasaha nAjAta devena| amaGgala tAderake sparza karave nA evaM tAdera kona duHkhao thAkave nA|
AllAha savakichura sRSTikartA evaM tini savakichura karmavidhAYaka|
AsamAna o jaminera cAvi tA~ra kAchei| Ara yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kare tArAi kSatigrasta|
vala, “he mUrkhera dala! tomarA ki AmAke AllAha vyatIta anyera ivAdata karate Adeza diccha?”

tomAra prati o tomAra pUrvavartIdera prati avazyai ohI pAThAno haYeche ye, yadi zir‌ka (AllAhara sAthe kAuke aMzIdAra sAvyasta) karo tAhale avazyai tomAra karmasamUha niSphala haYe yAve evaM tumi kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|
varaM AllAharai ivAdata karo evaM (tA~ra prati) kRtajJatA prakAzakArIdera dalabhukta thAka|

tArA AllAhara yathAyogya maryAdA deYani| keYAmatera dina goTA pRthivI tA~ra hAtera muThoYa thAkave evaM AsamAnasamUha tA~ra DAna hAte bhA~ja-karA avasthAYa thAkave| tini pavitra o mahAna| tArA (tA~ra sAthe) yA kichu zarIka kare tini tAra Urdhve|

(keYAmatera dina) ziMgAYa phu~ka deoYA have; takhana AllAhara marjimAphika vyatikrama chAr3A AsamAna o jaminera savAi vehu~za haYe yAve| ataHpara AvAra tAte phu~ka deoYA have; Ara takhani tArA uThe dA~r3iYe tAkAte thAkave|
pRthivI tAra prabhura nUre ujjvala have, AmalanAmA (sAmane) rAkhA have, navI o sAkSIderake niYe AsA have evaM sakalera madhye nyAYavicAra karA have| tAdera prati anyAYa karA have nA|
pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pratiphala puropuri deoYA have| tArA yA kichu kare tini tA bhAla kare jAnena|

kApheraderake dale dale jAhAnnAmera dike tAr3iYe neoYA have| yakhana tArA tAra kAche Asave takhana tAra darajAgulo khule deoYA have evaM tAra rakSIrA tAderake valave, “tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera madhya theke rasUla Aseni, yArA tomAderake tomAdera prabhura AYAtasamUha pATha kare zonAta evaM tomAderake Ajakera dinera sAkSAt samparke satarka karata?” tArA valave, “hyA~”, tave kApheradera viruddhe zAstira hukuma cUr3Anta haYe geche|”
valA have, “jAhAnnAmera darajAYa praveza karo, sekhAne cirakAla thAkAra janya| ataeva, kata khArApa ahaMkArIdera ei vAsasthAna!”

Ara yArA tAdera prabhuke bhaYa karata, tAderake dale dale jAnnAtera dike niYe yAoYA have| yakhana tArA tAra kAche Asave takhana tAra darajAgulo khule deoYA have evaM tAra rakSIrA tAderake valave, “tomAdera opara zAnti varSita hoka, tomarA khuzI hao evaM cirakAla thAkAra janya ekhAne praveza kara|”

(praveza kare) tArA valave, “sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AmAdera sAthe satya oYAdA karechilena| tini (tA~ra oYAdA motAveka) AmAderake (jAnnAtera) ei bhUmira adhikArI karechena| AmarA jAnnAtera yekhAne icchA nivAsa sthApana karate pAri| ataeva, kata uttama satkarmIdera ei puraskAra!”

tumi pherezatAderake Arazera cArapAza ghire tAdera prabhura pavitratA o prazaMsA varNanA karate dekhave| tAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karA have| Ara valA have, “sakala prazaMsA nikhila jagatera prabhu AllAhara|”
hA mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
ei kitAva AllAhara pakSa theke nAyila haYeche; yini parAkramazAlI, mahAjJAnI,
pApa kSamAkArI o taovA kavulakArI, kaThora zAstidAtA evaM kSamatAvAna| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| tA~ra kAchei (sakalera) cUr3Anta pratyAvartana|
AllAhara nidarzana samparke zudhu kApherarAi vitarka kare| sutarAM janapadasamUhe tAdera avAdha vicaraNa yena tomAke vibhrAnta nA kare|

edera pUrve nUhera samapradAYa evaM tAdera pare anyAnya dalao (tAdera navIderake) avizvAsa karechila| pratyeka (avizvAsI) jAti tAdera rasUlake pAkar3Ao karAra abhisandhi kareche evaM mithyAra sAhAyye satyake vyartha karAra uddezye vitarke lipta haYeche| takhana Amio tAderake pAkar3Ao karechi| ataeva, kemana haYechila AmAra zAsti!
Ara ebhAvei kApheradera kSetre tomAra prabhura kathA satya haYeche ye, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

yArA AllAhara Araza vahana kare evaM yArA tAra cArapAza ghire thAke tArA (sei pherezatArA) tAdera prabhura pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare, tA~ke vizvAsa kare evaM muminadera janya (tA~ra kAche) kSamA prArthanA kare| (tArA vale,) “he AmAdera prabhu! anugraha o jJAna dvArA tumi savakichu dhAraNa kare Acho| ataeva, yArA taovA kare o tomAra patha anusaraNa kare tAderake kSamA karo evaM jAhAnnAmera AjAva theke rakSA kara|”

“he AmAdera prabhu! tAderake cirakAla vasavAsera jAnnAte sthAna dAo, tumi tAderake yAra oYAdA karecho; evaM tAdera vAvA-mA, svAmI-strI o santAna-santatira madhye yArA satkarmaparAYaNa tAderakeo (jAnnAte sthAna dAo)| nizcaYai tumi parAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|”
“Ara tAderake amaGgala (zAsti) theke rakSA kara| tumi yAke sedina amaGgala theke rakSA karave tAke to avazyai anugraha karave| Ara seTAi hacche mahAsAphalya|”

(hAzarera dina) kApheraderake DAka diYe valA have, “(Aja) tomAdera nijedera prati nijedera asantoSera ceYe (duniYAYa tomAdera prati) AllAhara asantoSa var3a chila, yakhana tomAderake ImAna AnAra janya AhavAna jAnAno hata Ara tomarA tA asvIkAra karate|”

tArA valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! tumi AmAderake duJcavAra mRtyu diYecho evaM duJcavAra jIvana diYecho| ekhana AmarA AmAdera aparAdha svIkAra karachi| tAi (ekhana jAhAnnAma theke AmAdera) vera havAra ki kona patha Ache?”

(tAderake valA have,) “tomAdera ei zAsti to e janya ye, yakhana eka AllAhake DAkA hata takhana tomarA avizvAsa karate, Ara yadi tA~ra sAthe kona zarIka sAvyasta karA hata tAhale tomarA vizvAsa karate| sutarAM vicArera kSamatA to AllAhara; yini sarvocca, mahAmahima|”
tinii tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanasamUha dekhAna evaM AsamAna theke tomAdera janya jIvikA pAThAna| yArA AllAhara dike phire Ase kevala tArAi upadeza grahaNa kare|
ataeva, dvInake kevala tA~ra janya nivedita kare tomarA AllAhake DAka, yadio kApherarA tA apachanda kare|
tini ucca maryAdAra adhikArI o Arazera mAlika| tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA nija Adeze ohI pAThAna, yAte se sAkSAtera (keYAmatera) dina samparke (mAnuSake) satarka karate pAre;
yedina tArA savAi vera haYe par3ave| (sedina) AllAhara kAche tAdera kichui gopana thAkave nA| Aja kAra rAjatva? pravala parAkrAnta eka AllAhara|
Aja pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pratidAna deoYA have| Aja (kAro prati) kona avicAra nei| nizcaYai AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|

tAderake nikaTavartI keYAmatera dina samparke satarka karo, yakhana (kaSTe tAdera) prANasamUha kaNThAgata have evaM dama vandha haYe Asave| jAlemadera janya kona vandhu nei evaM emana kona supArizakArIo nei yAra kathA zonA have|
tini (AllAha) cokhera curi (gopana cAhani) o antarera sava gopana kathA jAnena|
AllAha saThika vicAra karena| Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A yAderake DAke tArA to kichui vicAra karate pAre nA| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

erA ki jamine bhramaNa kare nA? tAhale dekhata tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNati kemana haYechila| pRthivIte tAdera zakti o kIrti edera ceYe vezi chila| tAraparao tAdera pApera kAraNe AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilena| AllAhara zAsti theke tAderake rakSA karAra keu chila nA|
eTA ejanya ye, tAdera rasUlerA tAdera kAche spaSTa nidarzana niYe ele tArA tA avizvAsa karechila| phale AllAha tAderake pAkar3Ao karena| nizcaYai tini zaktizAlI, kaThora zAstidAtA|
Ami AmAra nidarzana o spaSTa pramANa niYe mUsAke pAThiYechilAma
pherAuna, hAmAna o kArunera kAche| kintu tArA valala, “(lokaTA) eka yAdukara, var3a mithyAvAdI|”

yakhana se AmAra pakSa theke satya niYe tAdera kAche ela takhana tArA valala, “tAra sAthe yArA ImAna eneche tAdera putraderake mere phela evaM tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkha|” kintu kApheradera ei cakrAnta vyarthai haYechila|
pherAuna valala, “tomarA AmAke chAr3a, Ami mUsAke hatyA kari Ara se tAra prabhuke DAkuka| (kAraNa) AmAra bhaYa haYa, se tomAdera dharma parivartana kare deve athavA duniYAYa azAnti char3Ave|”
mUsA valala, “hisAvera dina vizvAsa kare nA, emana pratyeka ahaMkArI vyakti theke Ami AmAra prabhu o tomAderao prabhu AllAhara kAche AzraYa niYechi|”

pherAunera vaMzera eka ImAnadAra loka ye tAra ImAna gopana rekhechila valala, “tomarA ki ekajana lokake jJaAmAra prabhu AllAhaJca valAra kAraNe hatyA karave? athaca se tomAdera kAche tomAdera prabhura nikaTa theke spaSTa nidarzana niYe eseche| se yadi mithyAvAdI haYa tAhale tAra mithyAra dAYa tAra opara vartAve| Ara yadi satyavAdI haYa tAhale se ye (zAstira) bhaYa dekhAcche tAra katakaTA to tomAdera opara Asavei|” AllAha kakhano emana vyaktike pathe Anena nA ye sImAlaMghanakArI, mithyAvAdI|

“he AmAra samapradAYa! deze Aja tomAdera rAjatva, tomarAi vijaYI| kintu AmAdera opara AllAhara zAsti Asale takhana ke AmAderake sAhAyya karave?” pherAuna valala, “Ami yA dekhi tomAderake tAi dekhAi| (arthAt Ami yA saThika mane kari tomAderake tAi vali|) Ami tomAderake saThika pathai nirdeza kari|”
ImAnadAra lokaTi valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! Ami tomAdera janya (pUrvera) maitrIvaddha dalagulora (durdazAra) dinera mata (pariNatira) AzaMkA karachi;”
“nUhera samapradAYa, Ada o chAmUda jAti evaM tAdera paravartIdera avasthAra mata| AllAha (tA~ra) vAndAdera prati kona juluma karate cAna nA|”
“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! Ami tomAdera janya DAkADAkira dina (keYAmatera dina)-ke bhaYa kari;
yedina tomarA pechanera dike chuTe pAlAve| takhana AllAhara zAsti theke tomAderake rakSA karAra keu thAkave nA| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAke patha dekhAvAra keu nAi|”

itipUrve iusupha tomAdera (pUrvavartIdera) kAche spaSTa nidarzanasaha esechila| kintu se tomAdera kAche yA niYe esechila se samparke tomarA kevalai sandeha karecho| avazeSe yakhana se mArA yAYa takhana tomarA valecho, “tAra pare AllAha Ara kona rasUla pAThAvena nA|” ebhAvei AllAha pratyeka vAr3AvAr3ikArI o saMzaYa poSaNakArIke pathabhraSTa karena;

yArA tAdera kAche Agata kona pramANa chAr3Ai (ayauktikabhAve) AllAhara nidarzana samparke vitarka kare| eTA AllAha o muminadera kAche var3ai apachandanIYa| ebhAvei AllAha pratyeka ahaMkArI o svecchAcArIra antare sila mere dena|
pherAuna valala, “hAmAna! tumi AmAra janya ekaTA TAoYAra vAnAo, yAte Ami patha peYe yAi,

AsamAnera patha; evaM mUsAra upAsyake dekhate pAi; tave Ami tAke mithyAvAdIi mane kari|” ebhAvei pherAunera kAche tAra khArApa kAja zobhanIYa karA haYechila evaM tAke (saThika) patha theke virata rAkhA haYechila| pherAunera cakrAnta (tAra janya) dhvaMsai Deke enechila|
ImAnadAra lokaTi valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomarA AmAra anusaraNa karo, Ami tomAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karava|
he AmAra samapradAYa! ei pArthiva jIvana to kevala (asthAYI) upabhogera vastu| Ara parakAlai hacche sthAYI nivAsa”

“keu kona khArApa kAja karale se kevala ai kAjera anurUpa pratiphala pAve, Ara kona puruSa kiMvA nArI mumina avasthAYa kona bhAla kAja karale, tArA jAnnAte praveza karave evaM sekhAne tAderake vinA hisAve jIvikA saravarAha karA have|”
“Ara he AmAra samapradAYa! e kemana vyApAra, Ami tomAderake DAki nAjAtera dike, athaca tomarA AmAke DAkacha jAhAnnAmera dike!”
“tomarA AmAke valacha AllAhake avizvAsa karate evaM tA~ra sAthe emana kichuke zarIka karate ye samparke AmAra kona jJAna nei, athaca Ami tomAderake parAkrama-zAlI, kSamAzIla AllAhara dike DAkachi|”

“sandeha nei, tomarA AmAke tAra dikei DAkacha, yAra kona DAka (zonAra kSamatA) nei, nA duniYAYa evaM nA AkherAte| AmAdera pratyAvartana to AllAharai kAche| sImAlaMghanakArIrAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI (have)|”
“Ami tomAderake yA valachi, tomarA tA acirei smaraNa karave| Ami AmAra vyApAra AllAhara kAche nyasta karachi| nizcaYai AllAha (tA~ra) vAndAderake dekhate pAna|”
ataHpara AllAha tAke tAdera kucakra theke rakSA karena evaM pherAunera vaMzera opara ghora zAsti neme Ase|
tAderake sakAle o sandhyAYa Agunera sAmane rekhe deoYA haYa| Ara yedina keYAmata have sedina valA have, “pherAunera vaMzake kaThoratama zAstira madhye DhukiYe dAo|”

(smaraNa karo) yakhana tArA (jAhAnnAmera) Agunera madhye paraspara jhagar3A karave| durvalerA ahaMkArIderake valave, “AmarA to tomAderai anusArI chilAma| ataeva, tomarA ki AmAdera theke Agunera ekaTA aMza nite pAra?”
ahaMkArIrA valave, “AmarA savAi to Agunera madhyei Achi| AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye vicAra-mImAMsA kare diYechena|”
yArA Agunera madhye thAkave tArA jAhAnnAmera rakSIderake valave, “tomarA tomAdera prabhura kAche ekaTu doYA karo, tini yena AmAdera (antata) ekadinera zAsti lAghava kare dena|”
tArA valave, “tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera rasUlerA spaSTa nidarzana niYe Asata nA?” tArA valave, “hyA~”| rakSIrA valave, “tAhale tomarAi doYA kara|” Ara kApheradera doYA niSphalai haYe thAke|
Ami avazyai AmAra rasUladerake o yArA ImAna Ane tAderake ei pArthiva jIvane o yedina sAkSIrA (sAkSya deoYAra janya) dA~r3Ave sedina (arthAt keYAmatera dina) sAhAyya karava;
yedina jAlemadera ojara-Apatti tAdera upakAre Asave nA| Ara tAdera janya thAkave abhizApa evaM tAdera janya thAkave nikRSTa AvAsa|
Ami mUsAke pathera sandhAna diYechilAma| Ara vanI isarAIlake kitAvera uttarAdhikArI karechilAma,
vuddhimAnadera janya pathanirdeza o upadezasvarUpa|
ataeva, tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo; nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya| Ara tomAra truTi-vicyutira janya kSamAprArthanA karo evaM vikele o sakAle tomAra prabhura pavitratA o prazaMsA varNanA kara|

nijedera kAche kona yukti nA eleo yArA AllAhara nidarzana samparke vitarka kare| tAdera antare ahaMkAra chAr3A kichu nei| tArA sekhAne pau~chAte (arthAt tAdera abhilASa caritArtha karate) pArave nA| ataeva, tumi AllAhara AzraYa cAo| nizcaYai tini savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|
nizcaYai AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karA mAnuSa sRSTi karAra ceYe var3a| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa (tA) jAne nA|
andha Ara dRSTisampanna samAna naYa; (samAna) naYa ImAnadAra o satkarmazIlagaNa Ara anyAYakArIo| tomarA kamai upadeza grahaNa kare thAka|
keYAmata avazyai Asave, se samparke kona sandeha nei; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa vizvAsa kare nA|
tomAra prabhu valechena, “tomarA AmAke DAka, Ami tomAdera DAke sAr3A deva| yArA ahaMkAravazata AmAra ivAdata theke virata thAke tArA lAJchita avasthAYa jAhAnnAme praveza karave|”
AllAhai tomAdera vizrAmera janya rAta evaM dekhAra janya dina diYechena| AllAha to mAnuSera prati avazyai anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA prakAza kare nA|
inii AllAha, tomAdera prabhu, savakichura sraSTA| tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| ataeva, tomarA kIbhAve (tA~ra theke) phire Asa?
ebhAve to tArAi phire Asata yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karata|

AllAha to sei mahAna sattA, yini pRthivIke tomAdera vAsasthAna karechena, AkAzake chAda vAniYechena, tomAdera AkAra gar3echena, tomAdera AkArake sundara karechena evaM tomAderake utkRSTa jIvikA dAna karechena| inii AllAha, tomAdera prabhu| vizvajagatera prabhu ei AllAha kata mahAna!
tini ciraJjIva, tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| ataeva, tA~kei DAka, dvInake kevala tA~rai janya nivedita kare| sava prazaMsA AllAhara, yini nikhila jagatera prabhu|

vala, “AmAra kAche AmAra prabhura nikaTa theke yakhana spaSTa pramANa ese geche, takhana tomarA AllAha vyatIta Ara yAderake DAka tAdera ivAdata karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche evaM Ami nikhila jagatera prabhura vazyatA svIkAra karate AdiSTa haYechi|”

tinii tomAderake (Adamake) mATi dvArA, tArapara (Adamera santAnaderake) zukravindu dvArA o tArapara jamATa rakta dvArA sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tomAderake (mAYera peTa theke) zizurUpe vera karena| tArapara (var3a kare tolena) yAte pUrNa zaktira vaYase (yauvane) upanIta hao, tArapara vRddha hao— yadio tomAdera keu keu tAra Agei mArA yAYa— Ara yAte ekaTi nirdhArita samaYakAle pau~chAte pAra, evaM yAte tomarA (savakichu bhAlabhAve) vujhate pAra|
tinii jIvana o mRtyu dAna karena| Ara yakhana kona kichu karAra siddhAnta nena takhana tAke valena, jJahaoJca, Ara tA haYe yAYa|
tumi ki tAderake dekhani yArA AllAhara nidarzana samparke vitarka kare? tArA kIbhAve vipathagAmI hacche?
(nidarzana samparke tArAi vitarka kare) yArA kitAvake evaM yA niYe Ami rasUladerake pAThiYechi tAke mithyA vale| tArA (era pariNAma) jAnate pArave,
yakhana (jAhAnnAme) tAdera galAYa ver3i Ara zikala thAkave| tAderake Tene niYe yAoYA have
phuTanta pAnite, tArapara Agune por3Ano have|
ataHpara tAderake valA have, “sesava kothAYa, yA tomarA zarIka karate
AllAha vyatIta?” tArA valave, “tArA AmAdera theke udhAo haYe geche| varaM AmarA era Age kona kichukei DAkatAma nA|” ebhAvei AllAha kApheraderake pathabhraSTa karena|
era kAraNa, tomarA pRthivIte anyAYabhAve AnandollAsa karate evaM dambha karate|
tomarA jAhAnnAmera darajAYa praveza karo, sekhAne cirakAla thAkAra janya| kata khArApa dAmbhikadera ei AvAsasthala!

ataeva, (he navI!) tumi dhairya dhara| nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya| Ami tAderake ye (zAstira) oYAdA karachi tAra kichuTA yadi tomAke dekhAi kiMvA tomAra mRtyu ghaTAi, tavuo to tAderake AmAra kAchei phiriYe AnA have|

Ami to tomAra pUrveo aneka rasUla pAThiYechilAma| tAdera madhye kAro kAro ghaTanA tomAra kAche varNanA karechi evaM kAro kAro ghaTanA tomAra kAche varNanA karini| AllAhara anumati chAr3A kona nidarzana niYe AsA kona rasUlera pakSei sambhava chila nA| tave yakhana AllAhara nirdeza Asave takhana saThikabhAve phaYasAlA haYe yAve| Ara takhana mithyAra anusArIrAi kSatigrasta have|
AllAhai tomAdera janya catuSpada pazu sRSTi karechena, yAte tomarA segulora kona konaTite ArohaNa karo evaM kona konaTi theke khAdya grahaNa kara|

ogulote tomAdera janya (Aro aneka) upakAra raYeche| Ara (AllAha ogulo ejanyao sRSTi karechena) yAte ogulora mAdhyame tomarA tomAdera manera kona cAhidA pUraNa karate pAra| ogulote Ara nauyAne tomAderake (eka jAYagA theke Areka jAYagAYa) vahana karA haYa|
AllAha tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanasamUha dekhiYe thAkena| ataeva, tomarA tA~ra kon‌ nidarzanaTi asvIkAra karave?

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kare dekheni, tAdera pUrvavartIdera kemana pariNati haYechila? tArA edera ceYe saMkhyAYa vezi chila evaM duniYAYa tAdera zakti o kIrtio pravalatara chila| tAraparao tAdera upArjanasamUha (karmasamUha) tAdera kona kAje Aseni|

yakhana tAdera rasUlagaNa tAdera kAche spaSTa pramANa niYe esechila takhana tArA tAdera (pArthiva viSaYera) jJAnei santuSTa chila| tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata tAi tAderake veSTana kare niYechila (tAdera zAstira kAraNa haYechila)|
ataHpara yakhana tArA AmAra zAsti dekhate pela takhana valala, “AmarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna AnalAma evaM tA~ra sAthe yA kichu zarIka karatAma tA pratyAkhyAna karalAma|”
yakhana tArA AmAra zAsti dekhate pela takhana tAdera ei ImAna tAdera kona upakAre elo nA| AllAhara e niYamai tA~ra vAndAdera kSetre cale eseche| Ara sekhAnei kApherarA kSatigrasta haYeche|
hA mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
(ei kitAva) karuNAmaYa, daYAlu AllAhara pakSa theke avatIrNa|
(e) emana eka kitAva, yAra AYAtasamUha vistAritabhAve vivRta haYeche, eka AravI koraAna hiseve, jJAnI lokadera janya,
susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hiseve; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mukha phiriYe niYeche (tA mAnate asvIkAra kareche); tAi tArA zunate pAYa nA|

tArA vale, “AmAdera antara AvaraNera madhye raYeche, ye kAraNe sekhAne AmAdera prati tomAra AhavAna praveza kare nA| adhikantu AmAdera kAne vadhiratA Ache evaM AmAdera o tomAra mAjhe ekaTi antarAla raYeche| sutarAM tumi tomAra kAja karo, AmarA AmAdera kAja kari|”

vala, “Asale Ami tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa| AmAra kAche ei marme ohI Ase ye, tomAdera prabhu ekajana prabhu (AllAha)| ataeva, tomarA tA~ra dike sthira thAka evaM tA~ra kAche kSamA cAo|” Ara muzarikadera janya (var3a) durbhoga raYeche,
yArA yAkAta deYa nA; Ara tArAi parakAlake asvIkAra kare|
yArA mumina o satkarmazIla, tAdera janya raYeche niravacchinna eka puraskAra|
vala, tomarA ki satyai sei mahAna sattAke avizvAsa karo o tA~ra samakakSa dA~r3a karAo, yini duidine jamina (pRthivI) sRSTi karechena? tinii to nikhila jagatera prabhu|

Ara (yini) tAra uparibhAge anar3a parvatamAlA sthApana karechena, tAte varakata dAna karechena o tAra (adhivAsIdera) jIvikAra vyavasthA karechena cAradine, puropuribhAve (nA kama, nA vezi); (eTA) praznakArIdera janya| (arthAt yArA prazna kare ye, AllAha kaYadine pRthivI sRSTi karechena, eTA tArai javAva|)
ataHpara tini AsamAnera dike manoyoga dena, yA chila dho~YA; evaM tAke o pRthivIke valena, “tomarA ubhaYe eso, icchAYa kiMvA anicchAYa|” tArA valala, “AmarA svecchAYa elAma|”

takhana tini duidine sAta AsamAna sRSTi karena evaM pratyeka AsamAnake tAra kAja jAniYe dena| Ami nikaTatama (prathama) AsamAnake pradIpamAlA (tArakArAji) diYe susajjita karechi o tAke saMrakSita karechi| eTA parAkramazAlI, mahAjJAnI AllAhara vyavasthApanA|
kintu tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa, tAhale valave, “Ami tomAderake Ada o chAmUda jAtira vajrAghAtera mata eka vajrAghAtera bhaYa dekhAcchi|”

yakhana tAdera sAmanera dika theke o tAdera pechanera dika theke rasUlagaNa ese valachila, “tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro ivAdata karo nA” takhana tArA valechila, “yadi AmAdera prabhu temanaTi cAitena tAhale tini avazyai pherezatA pAThAtena| ataeva, tomarA yA niYe prerita haYecho (vale dAvi karacha) AmarA tA asvIkAra kari|”

Ada jAti to pRthivIte nAhaka dambha karechila Ara valechila, “AmAdera ceYe adhika zaktidhara AvAra ke?” tArA ki dekhe ni ye, ye AllAha tAderake sRSTi karechena tini tAdera ceYe adhika zaktidhara? Ara tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karata|

tAi Ami tAderake ei duniYAra jIvanei lAJchanAkara zAsti AsvAdana karAnora janya katipaYa azubha dine tAdera opara pracaNDa vAtAsa pAThiYechilAma| Ara AkherAtera zAsti to Aro vezi lAJchanAkara| (sekhAne) tArA kona sAhAyya pAve nA|

Ara chAmUda jAtike to Ami satpatha dekhiYechilAma, kintu tArA satpathe calAra parivarte andha thAkAi pachanda karechila| tAi tAderai kRtakarmera phale tAderake lAJchanAkara zAstira vajrAghAta pAkar3Ao karechila|
Ara yArA ImAna enechila evaM (tadanuyAYI) tAkaoYA avalamvana kare calata Ami tAderake rakSA karechilAma|
(smaraNa karo) yedina AllAhara zatruderake ekatrita kare jAhAnnAmera dike neoYA have, tArapara tAderake vibhinna dale bhAga karA have|
avazeSe tArA yakhana sekhAne (jAhAnnAme) pau~che yAve takhana tAdera kAna, tAdera cokha o tAdera tvaka tAdera karma samvandhe tAderai viruddhe sAkSya deve|

tArA tAdera tvakake valave, “tomarA AmAdera viruddhe sAkSya diccha kena?” javAve tvaka valave, “AllAha AmAderake kathA valAra kSamatA diYechena, yini savakichukei kathA valAra kSamatA diYechena| tinii tomAderake prathamavAra sRSTi karechilena Ara (ekhana) tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe AnA hacche|”

tomAdera kAna, tomAdera cokha kiMvA tomAdera tvaka tomAdera vipakSe sAkSya deve nA— ei vizvAse tomarA (tAdera kAche) kichu gopana karate nA| tave tomarA dhAraNA karechile ye, tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra aneka kichu jAnena nA|
tomAdera prabhu samvandhe tomAdera ei dhAraNAi tomAderake dhvaMsa kareche evaM tomarA (ejanyai) kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYecho|
(ekhana) yadi tArA kaSTa sahya kare tavuo jAhAnnAmai tAdera AvAsasthala thAkave; Ara yadi (AllAhara) anugraha pete cAYa tAhale (tA~ra) anugraha pAve nA|

Ami tAdera janya saGgI nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma| saGgIrA tAdera sAmanera o pechanera savakichu (Agera o parera kAjakarma) tAdera dRSTite zobhanIYa karechila| (tAi) tAdera janya zAsti nyAYasaGgata, yemana tA nyAYasaGgata chila tAdera pUrvavartI prajanmera jvina o mAnuSera janya| nizcaYai tArA kSatigrasta chila|
kApherarA vale, “tomarA ei koraAna zunave nA evaM tA AvRttikAle gaNDagola karave, yAte tomarA jaYI hao|”
Ami avazyai kApheraderake kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karAva evaM tAderake tAdera khArApa kAjera pratiphala deva|
tA hala AllAhara zatrudera pratiphala, jAhAnnAma| sekhAne tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI AvAsa, AmAra nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karAra pratiphalasvarUpa|

kApherarA valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! jvina o mAnuSera madhye yArA AmAderake pathabhraSTa kareche tAderake dekhiYe dAo, AmarA tAderake AmAdera pAYera talAYa piSTa karava, yAte tArA heYa pratipanna haYa|”

yArA vale, “AmAdera prabhu AllAha”, ataHpara (satyera opara) aTala thAke, tAdera kAche (mRtyura samaYa) pherezatArA avatIrNa haYa evaM vale, “tomarA bhaYa karo nA evaM cintita haYo nA; Ara tomAderake ye jAnnAtera oYAdA karA hata tAra susaMvAda zune nAo|”
“pArthiva jIvane o parakAle AmarA tomAdera vandhu| tomAdera mana yA kAmanA kare sekhAne tomAdera janya tAi Ache evaM sekhAne tomarA yA cAo tAi pAve|
eTA kSamAzIla, parama karuNAmaYera AtitheYatA|”
tAra ceYe bhAla kathA ke vale, ye AllAhara dike (mAnuSake) DAke, satkAja kare evaM vale “Ami ekajana musalima (AllAhara kAche AtmasamarpaNa-kArI)”?
bhAla kAja Ara manda kAja samAna naYa| bhAla kAjaTi diYe (manda kAjera) javAva deve| dekhave, yAra sAthe tomAra zatrutA chila se yena eka antaraGga vandhu haYe giYeche|
e guNaTi kevala dhairyazIladerakei deoYA haYa, e guNaTi kevala parama bhAgyavAnakei deoYA haYa|
yadi zaYatAnera kona prarocanA tomAke prarocita kare tAhale AllAhara kAche AzraYa cAive| nizcaYai tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
rAta, dina, sUrya o canadra tA~rai eka ekaTi nidarzana| tomarA sUrya kiMvA canadrake sejadA karo nA| sejadA karave AllAhakei, yini egulo sRSTi karechena, yadi tomarA kevala tA~rai evAdatakArI hao|

yadi tArA ahaMkAra kare (evaM ei Adeza amAnya kare) tAhale (jene rAkhave) yArA tomAra prabhura sAnnidhye raYeche tArA (arthAt pherezatArA) rAtadina tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karache evaM tArA (kakhano) klAnta haYa nA|sejadA

tA~ra ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, tumi (eka samaYe) bhUmike mRta (anurvara) dekhate pAo| tArapara Ami yakhana tAra opara pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa kari takhana tA nar3e (jIvita haYe) oThe evaM (gAchapAlAYa) ver3e oThe| yini ei bhUmike jIvita karena tini mRtaderakeo avazyai jIvita karavena| tini savakichui karate sakSama|

yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhera vyApAre vakratAra AzraYa neYa tArA AmAra agocara naYa| tAhale ke bhAla, ye jAhAnnAme nikSipta have se, nA ye keYAmatera dina nirApade Asave se? tomarA yA icchA tA karate pAra; tave tomarA yA-i karo, nizcaYai tini tA dekhena|
yArA tAdera kAche upadeza (koraAna) AsAra para tA avizvAsa kareche (tArA avazyai zAsti bhoga karave); e to eka sammAnita grantha|
ete mithyA Asate pAre nA, nA tAra sAmane theke evaM nA tAra pechana theke (arthAt kona dika theke)| eTA eka prajJAmaYa, prazaMsita sattAra (AllAhara) pakSa theke avatIrNa|
tomAra pUrvavartI rasUladerake yA valA haYechila tomAkeo tAi valA hacche| nizcaYai tomAra prabhu (muminadera janya) kSamAzIla o (kApheradera janya) yantraNAdAYaka zAstidAtA|

Ami yadi eke ekaTi AjamI koraAna vAnAtAma (AravI chAr3A anya bhASAYa koraAna avatIrNa karatAma) tAhale tArA avazyai valata, “era AYAtasamUha (AmAdera bhASAYa) vistAritabhAve vyAkhyA karA hala nA kena? AjamI Ara Arava? (arthAt kitAva AjamI Ara rasUla Arava, e kemana vyApAra?)” vala, “eTA muminadera janya pathanirdeza Ara (tAdera rogera) cikitsA| tave yArA mumina naYa tAdera kAne vadhiratA Ache evaM e koraAna tAdera janya andhatva| oderake (yena) dUravartI kona jAYagA theke AhavAna karA hacche|”

Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma| tArapara tAra vyApAre matabheda karA haYa| yadi tomAra prabhura pakSa theke pUrvei ekaTi kathA (tAderake zAsti devAra siddhAnta) nA thAkata tAhale tAdera madhye mImAMsA haYe yeta| nizcaYai tArA e (koraAnera) vyApAre vibhrAntikara eka sandehera madhye raYeche|
ye satkAja kare tAra suphala se-i pAve evaM ye khArApa kAja kare tAra kuphala tAra oparai par3ave| Ara tomAra prabhu to (tA~ra) vAndAdera janya julumakArI nana|

keYAmatera jJAna kevala tA~ra kAchei Ache| tA~ra ajJAte kona phala AvaraNa theke vera haYa nA evaM kona nArI garbhadhAraNa o santAna prasava kare nA| yedina tini tAderake Deke jijJesa karavena, “AmAra zarIkerA kothAYa?” sedina tArA valave, “AmarA tomAke jAnAcchi ye, AmAdera madhye (e vyApAre) kona sAkSI nei| (arthAt AmAdera madhye keu valache nA ye, tArA tomAra zarIka|)”
pUrve (duniYAYa) tArA (AllAha vyatIta) yAderake DAkata tArA tAdera kAcha theke udhAo haYe yAve evaM tArA vujhate pArave ye, tAdera kona niSkRti nei|
maGgala (sukha-zAnti) cAoYAYa mAnuSa klAnta haYa nA; kinta yadi tAke amaGgala (duHkha-kaSTa) sparza kare tAhalei se ekevAre nirAza haYe par3e|

duHkha-kaSTa sparza karAra para tAke yadi Ami AmAra pakSa theke kona anugraha AsvAdana karAi tAhale se avazyai valave, “eTA to AmAra pAonA| Ara keYAmata have vale AmAra mane haYa nA| tave ekAntai yadi AmAke AmAra prabhura kAche phiriYe neoYA haYa tAhale AmAra janya tA~ra kAche avazyai kalyANa thAkave|” ataeva, avazyai Ami kApheraderake tAdera kRtakarma avahita karava evaM avazyai tAderake kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karAva|
yakhana Ami mAnuSera prati anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa evaM dUre sare yAYa| Ara yakhana amaGgala tAke sparza kare takhana se lamvA-caor3A prArthanA zuru kare|

(oderake) vala, “AmAke vala dekhi, yadi ei koraAna AllAhara pakSa theke ese thAke Ara tomarA tA avizvAsa kare thAka tAhale tAra ceYe adhika pathabhraSTa ke hate pAre, ye (e vyApAre) ghora virodhitAYa lipta?”

Ami tAderake (pRthivIra) dika-digante o tAdera nijedera madhye AmAra nidarzanasamUha dekhAva, yAte ei koraAna ye satya tA tAdera kAche spaSTa haYe yAYa| tomAra prabhura vyApAre ki eTA yatheSTa naYa ye, tini savakichura ekajana sAkSI?
jene rAkha, tArA tAdera prabhura sAthe sAkSAtera vyApAre sandihAna| jene rAkha, tini savakichu pariveSTana kare Achena|
hA mIma,
jJaAina sIna kvApha [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavda-saMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
parAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna AllAha ebhAvei tomAra kAche o tomAra pUrvavartIdera kAche ohI pAThAna|
