AsamAne o jamine yA kichu Ache sava tA~rai| tinii sarvocca, mahAmahima|

AsamAnasamUha tAdera oparera dika theke pheTe yAvAra upakrama haYa evaM pherezatArA tAdera prabhura prazaMsA o pavitratA varNanA kare Ara jaminera adhivAsIdera janya kSamA prArthanA kare| jene rAkha, AllAhai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA AllAha vyatIta anyAnya abhibhAvaka grahaNa kare, AllAha tAderake dekhe rAkhena| tumi tAdera karmavidhAYaka nao|

Ara ebhAvei Ami tomAra kAche eka AravI koraAna nAyila karechi, yAte tumi mUla janapada (makkA nagarI) o tAra AzapAzera lokaderake satarka karate pAra| satarka karate pAra samAvezera (keYAmatera) dina samparke, ye vyApAre kona sandeha nei| (sedina) ekadala yAve jAnnAte evaM ekadala yAve jAhAnnAme|
AllAha icchA karale tAderake (sava mAnuSake) eka jAti karate pAratena| kintu tini yAke icchA tA~ra rahamatera antarbhukta karena| Ara jAlemadera janya kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI nei|
nAki tArA tA~ke chAr3A anyAnya abhibhAvaka grahaNa kareche? Asale to AllAhai (ekamAtra) abhibhAvaka| tini mRtaderake jIvita karena| tini savakichui karate sakSama|
tomarA ye viSaYei matabheda karo, tAra phaYasAlA AllAhara kAche| (vala,) “tinii AllAha, AmAra prabhu| Ami tA~ra oparai nirbhara kari evaM tA~ra dikei phire Asi|”

(tini) AsamAna o jaminera sraSTA| tini tomAdera madhya theke tomAdera janya jor3A evaM catuSpada jantudera janyao jor3A nirdhAraNa karechena| ei paddhatitei tini tomAderake sRSTi kare thAkena| kona kichui tA~ra mata naYa| tini savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|
tA~ra kAchei AsamAna o jaminera cAvi| tini yAra janya cAna jIvikA prazasta karena (vAr3iYe dena) o (yAra janya cAna) saMkucita karena (kamiYe dena)| tini savakichui jAnena|

tini tomAdera janya sei dvInai vidhivaddha karechena yAra Adeza diYechilena nUhake, yA Ami tomAra kAche nAyila karechi evaM yAra Adeza diYechilAma ivarAhIma, mUsA o IsAkeo; ei vale ye, “tomarA dvIna pratiSThita karo evaM tAte vibheda sRSTi karo nA|” tumi muzarikaderake yA karate vala tA tAdera kAche var3a (kaThina) mane haYa| AllAha yAke icchA ei dvInera janya manonIta karena evaM ye (tA~ra dike) phire Ase tAkei tA~ra patha pradarzana karena|

tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra parai tArA pArasparika jidavazata vibheda sRSTi kareche| yadi tomAra prabhura pakSa theke ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAzera pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkata tAhale viSaYaTi tAdera madhye (Agei) phaYasAlA haYe yeta| tAdera pare yArA kitAvera uttarAdhikAra lAbha kareche tArA se samparke eka vibhrAntikara sandehera madhye raYeche|

ataeva, tumi (lokaderake) sei (vidhAnera) dike DAka evaM (nije tAte) aTala thAka, yebhAve tumi AdiSTa haYecho| tAdera icchAra anusaraNa karo nA| vala, “AllAha ye kitAva nAyila karechena Ami tA vizvAsa karechi| AmAke tomAdera madhye nyAYavicAra karAra Adeza deoYA haYeche| AllAha AmAdera prabhu evaM tomAderao prabhu| AmAdera janya AmAdera karma evaM tomAdera janya tomAdera karma| AmAdera o tomAdera madhye kona vivAda nei| AllAha AmAderake ekatrita karavena| tA~ra kAchei (AmAdera sakalera) pratyAvartana|”
AllAhake mene neoYAra para yArA tA~ra vyApAre vitarka kare tAdera yukti tAdera prabhura kAche asAra| tAdera opara (AllAhara) krodha evaM tAdera janya kaThora zAsti raYeche|
AllAhai satyasaha kitAva (pavitra koraAna) o (satyera) mAnadaNDa nAyila karechena| keYAmata haYato nikaTavartI, tumi tA jAnave kIbhAve?

yArA tA vizvAsa kare nA tArAi tA tAr3AtAr3i kAmanA kare| Ara yArA vizvAsa kare tArA tAke bhaYa pAYa| (kAraNa) tArA jAne ye, tA satya| jene rAkha, keYAmata samparke yArA vitarka kare tArA avazyai dAruNa vibhrAntite raYeche|
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati daYAlu| tini yAke cAna jIvikA dAna karena| tini mahAzaktidhara, mahAparAkramazAlI|
ye parakAlera phasala (puraskAra) cAYa tAra janya Ami tAra phasala vAr3iYe dei| Ara ye ihakAlera phasala cAYa tAke Ami tA thekei (kichu) diYe dei| parakAle tAra kona aMza thAkave nA|

nAki tAdera katipaYa zarIka (devatA) Ache, yArA tAdera janya emana kona dvIna pravartana kare diYeche, AllAha yAra anumati denani? yadi cUr3Anta kathA (siddhAnta) nA thAkata tAhale tAdera vyApAre phaYasAlA haYe yeta| nizcaYai jAlemadera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

tumi jAlemaderake tAdera kRtakarmera janya bhItasantrasta dekhave| Ara tA (kRtakarmera zAsti) tAdera opara Apatita havei| pakSAntare yArA ImAnadAra o satkarmazIla, tArA thAkave jAnnAtera vAgAne| tArA yA cAive, tAdera prabhura kAche tAi pAve| eTAi to (prabhura) var3a anugraha|

AllAha tA~ra ImAnadAra o satkarmazIla vAndAderake (jAnnAtera) ei susaMvAdai diYe thAkena| vala, “Ami ejanya (tomAderake AllAhara pathe DAkAra janya) tomAdera kAche AtmIYatAra sauhArdya chAr3A kona (jAgatika) pratidAna cAi nA|” keu kona bhAla kAja karale Ami tAra janya tAte kalyANa vAr3iYe dei| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, pratidAna dAnakArI|

nAki tArA vale ye, se (navI) AllAhara viruddhe mithyA vAniYe valeche? (tAhale to) AllAha icchA karale tomAra antare mohara mere ditena| AllAha mithyAke muche dena evaM nija vANI dvArA satyake pratiSThita karena| nizcaYai tini (mAnuSera) antarera viSaYa bhAlabhAve jAnena|
tinii tA~ra vAndAdera taovA kavula karena evaM (tAdera) pApasamUha kSamA karena| Ara tomarA yA kichu karo tini tA jAnena|
tini ImAnadAra o satkarmazIladera DAke sAr3A dena evaM tAdera janya svIYa anugraha vAr3iYe dena| Ara kApheradera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti|

AllAha yadi tA~ra vAndAdera janya paryApta parimANe jIvikA dAna karatena tAhale tArA pRthivIte avazyai vAr3AvAr3i karata, tAi tini tA~ra icchAnuyAYI parimANamata (jIvikA) nAyila karena| nizcaYai tini tA~ra vAndAdera sava khavara rAkhena, tAdera savakichu dekhate pAna|
tArA nirAza haoYAra para tinii vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM (tAdera janya) nijera anugraha char3iYe dena| tinii (tAdera) abhibhAvaka, sakala prazaMsAra adhikArI|
AsamAna o jamina sRSTi evaM e duiYera mAjhe tini yesava jIvajantu char3iYe diYechena tA tA~ra anyatama nidarzana| tini yakhana cAna tAderake ekatrita karate sakSama|
tomAdera ye vipada Ase tA tomAdera kRtakarmerai phala| tini tomAdera aneka aparAdha kSamAo kare dena|
pRthivIte tomarA (AllAhake) apAraga karate (AllAhara zAsti er3Ate) pArave nA| AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI nei|
tA~ra nidarzanasamUhera madhye raYeche samudre calamAna pAhAr3era mata (u~cu) jAhAjasamUha|
tini yadi cAna vAtAsake thAmiYe dena| takhana jAhAjagulo sumudrapRSThe sthira haYe thAke| nizcaYai ete pratyeka dhairyazIla o kRtajJa vyaktira janya (aneka) nidarzana Ache|
athavA tAdera kRtakarmera janya segulo dhvaMsa kare dena| tini aneka kichu kSamAo kare dena|
yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha niYe vitarka kare tArA jene rAkhuka, tAdera kona niSkRti nei|
tomAderake yA kichu deoYA haYeche tA zudhu pArthiva jIvanera bhoga| Ara AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA tAdera janya Aro bhAla o vezi dIrghasthAYI yArA ImAna eneche o nijedera prabhura opara bharasA rAkhe,
yArA var3a pApa (kavIrAha gunAha) o azlIla kAja parihAra kare o yakhana (kona vyApAre) rege yAYa takhana kSamA kare deYa,
yArA tAdera prabhura DAke sAr3A deYa (Adeza pAlana kare), nAmAya kAYema kare, pArasparika parAmarzakrame kAja kare o Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tA theke vyaYa kare
evaM yArA tAdera prati anyAYa karA hale tArA pratizodha grahaNa kare|
khArApera pratiphala tAra matai khArApa; tave ye kSamA kare deYa o miTamATa kare neYa AllAhara kAche tAra puraskAra raYeche| tini jAlemaderake pachanda karena nA|
yArA atyAcArita haoYAra para pratizodha grahaNa kare tAdera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei|
abhiyoga kevala tAdera viruddhe yArA mAnuSera opara atyAcAra kare evaM anyAYabhAve pRthivIte vAr3AvAr3i kare| tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
ye dhairyadhAraNa kare o kSamA kare deYa tAra e kAja avazyai dRr3ha saGkalpera (sAhasikatAra) paricAYaka|

Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janya tini chAr3A kona abhibhAvaka nei| tumi jAlemaderake dekhave, tArA yakhana zAsti dekhate pAve takhana valave, “(pRthivIte AmAdera) phire yAvAra ki kona upAYa Ache?”

tumi dekhave, tAderake jAhAnnAmera sAmane upasthita karA hacche, yakhana tArA lAJchanAYa avanata thAkave evaM gopana (satarka) dRSTite tAkAve| Ara ImAnadArarA valave, “kSatigrasta tArAi yArA keYAmatera dine nijedera o parivAra-parijanera kSati kareche|” jene rAkha, jAlemarA sthAYI AyAvera madhyei thAkave|
tAderake sAhAyya karAra janya AllAha chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka thAkave nA| Ara AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janya kona patha nei|

AllAhara pakSa theke eka avazyambhAvI dina (keYAmata) AsAra Age tomarA tomAdera prabhura DAke sAr3A dAo (tA~ra Adeza pAlana karo)| sedina tomAdera kona AzraYasthala thAkave nA evaM tomAdera kona asvIkRti (aparAdha asvIkAra karAra upAYa) thAkave nA|

yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale (jAnave,) Ami to tomAke tAdera rakSaka kare pAThAini| tomAra kAja to zudhu (vANI) pau~che deoYA| Ami yakhana mAnuSake AmAra kona anugraha AsvAdana karAi takhana se Anandita haYa| Ara yadi tAderai kRtakarmera kAraNe tAdera kona amaGgala ghaTe tAhale ei mAnuSai var3a akRtajJa haYe yAYa|
AsamAna o jaminera rAjatva ekamAtra AllAhara| tini yA cAna tAi sRSTi karena| yAke icchA kanyAsantAna dAna karena evaM yAke icchA putrasantAna dAna karena,
athavA tAderake putra o kanyA ubhaYai dAna karena| AvAra yAke icchA niHsantAna rAkhena| nizcaYai tini mahAjJAnI, sarvazaktimAna|

kona mAnuSera sAthe AllAha sarAsari kathA valena nA; tave ohIra mAdhyame athavA pardAra antarAla theke valena; athavA tini kona rasUla pAThAna, ye tA~ra anumatikrame tini yA cAna tA pau~che deYa| nizcaYai tini sumahAna, prajJAmaYa|

ebhAvei Ami tomAra kAche AmAra Adezera ekaTi prANa (koraAna) pAThiYechi| (era Age) tumi to jAnate nA, kitAva ki Ara ImAna ki| tave Ami eke (ei koraAnake) ekaTi Alo karechi, yAra sAhAyye Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhye yAke cAi patha dekhAi| tumi to (mAnuSake) sarala pathai pradarzana karacha;
sei AllAhara patha yini AsamAna o jaminera savakichura mAlika| jene rAkha, (cUr3Anta siddhAntera janya) sakala viSaYa AllAhara kAchei yAve|
hA mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
spaSTa kitAvera zapatha!
Ami eke AravI (bhASAra) koraAna karechi, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
Ara ei koraAna to AmAra kAche mUla granthe (laohe mAh‌phUye) saMrakSita Ache| nizcaYai tA sumahAna, prajJApUrNa|
tomarA eka sImAlaMghanakArI samapradAYa vale Ami ki tomAdera theke ei upadeza (koraAna) pratyAhAra kare neva?
pUrvavartI lokadera mAjhe Ami kata navI pAThiYechilAma!
tAdera kAche ye navIi eseche tAra sAthei tArA ThATTA-vidrUpa kareche|
phale Ami edera ceYeo adhika zaktizAlIderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi evaM pUrvavartIdera sei udAharaNa (ghaTanA) atikrAnta haYeche|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa karo, “AsamAna o jamina ke sRSTi kareche?” tAhale avazyai tArA valave, “parAkramazAlI mahAjJAnI AllAhai esava sRSTi karechena|”
yini jaminake tomAdera janya ekaTi vichAnA kare diYechena (yekhAne tomarA vizrAma karate pAra) evaM sekhAne tomAdera janya rAstAghATa kare diYechena, yAte tomarA patha calate pAra|
evaM yini AkAza theke parimANamata pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa karechena| ataHpara tA dvArA Ami eka mRta bhUkhaNDake punarujjIvita karechi| ebhAvei tomAderake (kavara theke) vera karA have|
Ara yini (prANIdera) yAvatIYa jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera janya nauyAna o catuSpada jantu theke tomAdera vAhanera vyavasthA karechena;

yAte tomarA tAra piThe avasthAna karate pAra, ataHpara yakhana tAra opara avasthAna karo takhana yAte tomAdera prabhura neYAmata smaraNa karo Ara vala, “pavitra o mahAna tini, yini eke AmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena; AmarA to eke vazIbhUta karate pAratAma nA|”
“Ara AmarA AmAdera prabhura kAchei phire yAva|”
tArA tA~ra vAndAdera madhya theke (kAuke kAuke) tA~ra aMza sAvyasta kareche (tA~ra aMzIdAra kareche)| mAnuSa Asale spaSTa (var3a) akRtajJa|
tini ki tA~ra sRSTi theke (nijera janya) kanyA grahaNa karechena (kApherarA yemanaTi vale thAke) Ara tomAdera janya putra manonIta karechena?
tAdera kAuke yadi sei saMvAda (arthAt kanyA santAna janmera saMvAda) deoYA haYa, yA se karuNAmaYa AllAhara prati Aropa kare, tAhale tAra mukha kAlo haYe yAYa evaM se duHkhabhArAkrAnta haYa|
tArA ki AllAhara prati emana santAna Aropa kare, ye alaMkAra-parihita haYe lAlitapAlita haYa (arthAt nArI) evaM ye vitarke aspaSTa (spaSTa kathA valate apAraga)?

tArA pherezatAderake— yArA karuNAmaYa AllAhara vAndA— nArI sAvyasta kareche| tArA ki tAderake (nArIrUpe) sRSTi karate dekhechila? tAdera sAkSya (ehena ukti) likhe rAkhA have evaM (e janya) tAderake praznera sammukhIna karA have|
tArA vale, “yadi karuNAmaYa AllAha cAitena tAhale AmarA odera (deva-devIra) upAsanA karatAma nA” (Asale) se samparke tAdera kona jJAna nei| tArA zudhu AndAje kathA vale|
nAki Ami tAderake era (koraAnera) Age kona kitAva diYechi, yA tArA A~kar3e dhare Ache?
varaM tArA vale, “AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke ekaTi dharmamatera anusArI peYechi evaM AmarA tAderai padAMka anusaraNa kare calachi|”

emanibhAve tomAra pUrve yakhani kona janapade Ami kona satarkakArI pAThiYechi takhani tAra vittavAna lokerA valeche, “AmarA AmAdera vApa-dAdAke ekaTi dharmamatera anusArI peYechi evaM AmarA tAderai padAMka anusaraNa karachi|”

se (satarkakArI) valechila, “tomarA tomAdera vApa-dAdAke ye pathera anusArI peYecho Ami yadi tomAdera janya tAra ceYe uttama pathanirdeza niYe Asi tAhaleo (ki tomarA tAdera padAMka anusaraNa karave)?” (javAve) tArA valechila, “tomAke yA niYe pAThAno haYeche, AmarA tA asvIkAra kari|”
sutarAM Ami tAdera opara pratizodha niYechilAma| ataeva dekha, avizvAsIdera kirUpa pariNati haYechila!
(smaraNa karo) yakhana ivarAhIma tAra pitA o nija samapradAYake valechila, “tomarA yAdera upAsanA karo tAdera sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei|
tave yini AmAke sRSTi karechena tini era vyatikrama| (arthAt Ami zudhu tA~rai ivAdata kari|) nizcaYai tini AmAke supatha dekhAvena|”
ivarAhIma ei kathATike (tAra ei tAohIda-vAkyaTike) tAra paravartI vaMzadharadera janya ekaTi sthAYI vANIrUpe rekhe giYeche, yAte tArA (satpathe) phire Ase|
varaM Ami ederake o edera pUrvapuruSaderake (duniYAra sAmagrI) bhoga karate diYechilAma| avazeSe tAdera kAche satya (koraAna) o spaSTa varNanAkArI eka rasUla eseche|
yakhana tAdera kAche satya (ei koraAna) ela takhana tArA valala, “e to yAdu, AmarA eke vizvAsa kari nA|”
tArA Aro valala, “e koraAna dui janapadera (makkA o tAYephera) kona eka var3a (prabhAvazAlI) vyaktira opara nAyila hala nA kena?”

tArA ki tomAra prabhura anugraha vaNTana kare? pArthiva jIvane Amii to tAdera madhye tAdera jIvikA vaNTana kari evaM maryAdAYa tAdera katakake katakera opare uThAi, yAte tAdera kataka katakake sevaka vAnAte pAre| tomAra prabhura anugraha tArA yA saJcaYa kare tAra ceYe uttama|

yadi emana (AzaMkA) nA hata ye, sava mAnuSa ekaTi zreNIbhukta haYe yete pAre, tAhale karuNAmaYa AllAhake avizvAsakArIdera janya Ami tAdera ghare rupora tairI chAda o tAdera opare oThAra si~r3i ditAma;
tAdera ghare (rupora tairI) darajA o tAdera helAna deoYAra pAlaGka ditAma;
Ara (sonAra) kArukAjao (ditAma)| esava to pArthiva jIvanera bhogera sAmagrI chAr3A kichu naYa| mottAkIdera janya raYeche tomAra prabhura kAche parakAla (parakAlera sukha)|
karuNAmaYa AllAhara smaraNa theke ye virata thAke tAra janya Ami eka zaYatAnake niYojita kari| ataHpara se-i haYa tAra sahacara|
tArAi tAderake (zaYatAnerAi mAnuSaderake) satpatha theke virata rAkhe; Ara mAnuSerA mane kare ye, tArA satpathe Ache|

avazeSe mAnuSa yakhana AmAra kAche Asave takhana se (tAra sahacara zaYatAnake) valave, “hAYa, AmAra o tomAra madhye yadi dui pUrvera (athavA pUrva o pazcimera) dUratva thAkata!” kata khArApa sahacara se!
yehetu tomarA juluma karecho, tAi zAstite tomarA (tomarA o tomAdera sahacara zaYatAnerA) zarIka haleo Aja tomAdera kona lAbha have nA|
tumi ki vaYarAderake zonAte pArave? kiMvA andhaderake evaM ye spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye Ache tAke patha dekhAte pArave?
Ami yadi tomAke niYeo yAi tavu tAderake zAsti devai|
athavA tAderake ye zAstira oYAdA diYechi tA yadi tomAke dekhAi tavu tAdera opara AmAra pUrNa kSamatA raYeche|
ataeva, tomAra kAche ye ohI pAThAno haYa tA dRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhara| nizcaYai tumi saThika pathe Acho|
Ara e koraAna to tomAra janya o tomAra samapradAYera janya ekaTi upadeza, evaM tomAderake (e vyApAre) jijJAsA karA have|
Ami tomAra pUrve AmAra yesava rasUla pAThiYechilAma tAderake jijJesa kare dekha, ivAdata karAra janya karuNAmaYa AllAha chAr3A Ami ki anyAnya upAsya Thika kare diYechilAma?
Ami mUsAke AmAra nidarzanasaha pherAuna o tAra pAriSadavargera kAche pAThiYechilAma| mUsA valechila, “Ami vizvajagatera prabhura rasUla|”
se tAdera kAche AmAra nidarzanasamUha peza karatei tArA tA niYe hAsi-ThATTA karate lAgala|
Ami tAderake ye nidarzanaTii dekhAi seTi tAra mata ArekaTi theke var3a| Ara tAderake Ami zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karechi, yAte tArA (satpathe) phire Ase|
tArA (mUsAke) valala, “he yAdukara! tomAra prabhu tomAra kAche yA oYAdA karechena AmAdera janya tA~ra kAche tA cAo| (tAhale) avazyai AmarA satpatha avalamvana karava|”
kintu yakhana Ami tAdera theke zAsti sariYe nilAma takhani tArA oYAdA bhaGga karala|
pherAuna tAra samapradAYake Deke valala, “he AmAra samapradAYa! mizarera rAjatva o AmAra nica diYe pravAhita esava nadI ki AmAra naYa? tomarA ki tAhale dekha nA?”
“ei hIna lokaTi (mUsA) theke ki Ami zreSTha nai? se to spaSTa kare kathAo valate pAre nA|”
“(se yadi AllAhara navIi have) tAhale kena tAke sonAra kaGkaNa deoYA hala nA? kenai vA tAra sAthe dala ve~dhe pherezatArA ela nA?”
ebhAve se (pherAuna) tAra samapradAYake vokA vAnAla evaM tArA tAra kathA mene nila| nizcaYai tArA chila eka avAdhya janagoSThI|
yakhana tArA AmAke rAgAnvita karala takhana Ami tAderake zAsti dilAma evaM savAike DuviYe dilAma|
ebhAve Ami tAderake atIta itihAsa o paravartI prajanmera janya ekaTi dRSTAnta vAniYe rAkhalAma|
yakhana mariYama-tanaYera (IsAra) dRSTAnta peza karA haYa takhani tomAra lokerA haicai zuru kare|
Ara vale, “AmAdera upAsyarA bhAla, nA se?” tArA kevala vitarkera janyai tomAke okathA vale| Asale tArA eka jhagar3ATe samapradAYa|
se (AmAra) ekajana vAndA vai naYa| Ami tAke anugraha karechi evaM vanI isarAIlera janya ekaTi dRSTAnta vAniYechi|
yadi Ami cAitAma tAhale tomAdera theke pherezatA sRSTi karate pAratAma yArA pRthivIte (tomAdera) pratinidhitva karata|
Ara se (IsA) to keYAmatera ekaTi nizcita nidarzana| ataeva, tomarA tAte (keYAmate) moTeo sandeha karo nA evaM AmAra kathA mene cala| eTAi sarala patha|
zaYatAna yena tomAderake (sarala patha theke) phiriYe nA rAkhe| se kintu tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

IsA yakhana nidarzanasamUha niYe ela takhana valala, “Ami tomAdera kAche esechi prajJA (navuoYAta) niYe evaM tomarA yesava viSaYe matabheda karo tAra kona konaTi tomAdera kAche pariSkAra kare devAra janya| ataeva, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM AmAra kathA mene cala|”
“AllAhai to AmAra prabhu evaM tomAderao prabhu| ataeva, tA~ra ivAdata kara| eTAi sarala patha|”
ataHpara tAdera madhya theke vibhinna dala matabheda karala| sutarAM jAlemadera janya raYeche kaSTera dinera zAstira durbhoga|
tArA tAdera ajJAtasAre haThAt keYAmata ese par3Arai (yena) apekSA karache|
vandhurA sedina eke aparera zatru have; tave mottAkIrA naYa|
he AmAra vAndArA! Aja tomAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tomarA duHkhitao have nA|
(AmAra sei vAndArA) yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha vizvAsa karechila evaM (AmAra kAche) AtmasamarpaNa karechila|
(ei nekakAra vAndAdera sedina valA have:) tomarA o tomAdera strIrA khuzImane jAnnAte praveza kara|
(sekhAne khAdyabharA) sonAra thAlA o pAnapAtra niYe tAderake pradakSiNa karA have| (tAdera) mana yA cAYa evaM cokhe yA bhAla lAge tA savai tAte thAkave| Ara tomarA sekhAne cirakAla avasthAna karave|
e to sei jAnnAta, tomAderake yAra uttarAdhikArI karA haYeche tomAdera (duniYAra) karmera janya|
sekhAne tomAdera janya pracura phalamUla Ache, yA theke tomarA (icchAmato) AhAra karave|
(pakSAntare) aparAdhIrA cirakAla jAhAnnAmera zAstira madhye avasthAna karave|
tAdera janya tA (zAsti) lAghava karA have nA evaM tArA tAra madhye hatAzAYa muhyamAna thAkave|
Ami to tAdera prati juluma karini, varaM tArAi jAlema chila|
tArA citkAra kare valave, “he mAleka (jAhAnnAmera rakSI)! tomAra prabhu yena AmAdera mRtyu ghaTAna|” (javAve) se (mAleka) valave, “Asale tomarA (ebhAvei ekhAne) cirakAla thAkave|”
Ami tomAdera kAche satya ene diYechi, kintu tomAdera adhikAMzai satyake apachanda kare|
nAki tArA kona vyApAre dRr3ha siddhAnta niYeche? tAhale Amio to dRr3ha siddhAnta neva|
nAki tArA mane kare ye, Ami tAdera gopana kathA o gopana parAmarza zuninA? avazyai zuni| adhikantu AmAra dUtagaNa (pherezatArA) tAdera kAche theke savakichu likhe rAkhe|
vala, “yadi karuNAmaYa AllAhara kona santAna thAkata tAhale Amii hatAma tAra prathama ivAdatakArI|”
tArA yA vale tA theke AsamAna o jaminera prabhu o Arazera prabhu pavitra|
ataeva, tAderake ye dinera oYAdA karA hacche (keYAmatera dina) tAra sammukhIna haoYA paryanta tAderake (AjevAje kathA) valate o khelate dAo|
tini sei AllAha yini AsamAneo ekamAtra upAsya evaM jamineo ekamAtra upAsya| tini prajJAmaYa, mahAjJAnI|

kata mahIYAna tini, yini AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichura mAlika! keYAmatera jJAna kevala tA~ra kAchei Ache (keYAmata kave have tA kevala tinii jAnena)| tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phiriYe neoYA have|
tArA AllAhake chAr3A yAderake DAke tAdera supArizera kSamatA nei| tave yArA jene satya sAkSya deYa tAdera kathA AlAdA|
yadi tAderake jijJAsA karo, ke tAderake sRSTi kareche, tAhale tArA avazyai valave, “AllAha”| tAhale kIbhAve tArA (AllAhara patha theke) phire thAkache?
rasUlera ei kathATio (tini jAnena), “he AmAra prabhu! erA eka veImAna janagoSThI”
sutarAM tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo (tAderake upekSA kare yAo) Ara vala “sAlAma”| tave tArA (tAdera pariNAma) jAnate pArave|
hA mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
spaSTa kitAvera zapatha!
Ami eke (ei koraAna) nAyila karechi eka varakatamaYa rAte (zave kadare)| nizcaYai Ami satarkakArI|
e rAte pratyeka prajJApUrNa viSaYa nirUpita haYa,
AmAra Adeze| Amii rasUla pAThiYe thAki,
tomAra prabhura anugrahasvarUpa| nizcaYai tini savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|
yini AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichura prabhu; yadi tomarA dRr3ha vizvAsI hao|
tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| tini vA~cAna, tini mArena| tini tomAdera prabhu evaM tomAdera pUrvapuruSaderao prabhu|
varaM tArAi sandehera madhye khelache|
ataeva, sedinera apekSA karo yedina AkAza spaSTa dho~YAYa cheYe yAve,
yA mAnuSake Dheke phelave| eTA eka yantraNAdAYaka AjAva|
(tArA valave,) “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera theke AjAva uThiYe nAo, AmarA ImAna Anachi|”
(AjAva ese yAoYAra para ekhana) tArA kIbhAve upadeza grahaNa karave? athaca (duniYAYa) tAdera kAche spaSTa varNanAkArI rasUla esechila|
tArapara tArA tAra theke mukha phiriYe niYechila Ara valechila, “e to (anyera dvArA) zikSAprApta eka unmAda loka|”
Ami (nA haYa) kichukAlera janya AjAva uThiYe neva, (kintu ) tomarA to (Agera avasthAYai) phire yAve|
yedina Ami (tomAderake) kaThinabhAve dharava sedina avazyai pratizodha neva|
tAdera Age Ami pherAunera lokaderake parIkSA karechi| tAdera kAche ekajana sammAnita rasUla (mUsA) esechila|
(se valechila,) “AllAhara vAndAderake (vanI isarAIlake) AmAra kAche arpaNa kara| Ami tomAdera janya ekajana vizvasta rasUla|
Ara tomarA AllAhara avAdhya haYo nA| Ami tomAdera kAche spaSTa pramANa niYe Asachi|”
“tomarA AmAke pAthara mere hatyA karate cAo vale Ami AmAra o tomAdera prabhura kAche AzraYa cAcchi|
yadi tomarA AmAke vizvAsa nA karo tAhale AmAra kAcha theke dUre thAka|”
ataHpara se (mUsA) tAra prabhuke DAkala, (Ara valala,) “erA to eka aparAdhI samapradAYa|”
(AllAha valalena,) tumi tAhale AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAte veriYe par3a| tave (mane rAkhave) tomAderake anusaraNa karA have (pherAuna o tAra vAhinI tomAdera pechane pechane chuTave)|
Ara samudrake zAnta thAkate dAo| tArA emana eka vAhinI yA nimajjita have|
tArA rekhe giYechila kata vAgAna o jharanA,
kata zasyakSeta o sundara jAYagA,
evaM kata sukha-sAmagrI, yAra madhye tArA Anandarata chila!
emanaTii ghaTechila| (paravartIte) Ami anyaderake esavera uttarAdhikArI karechilAma|
tAdera janya AsamAna o jamina kA~deni evaM tAderake avakAzao deoYA haYani|
Ami vanI isarAIlake lAJchanAkara zAsti theke uddhAra karechilAma;
pherAuna theke| se chila sImAlaMghanakArIdera madhye pravala|
tAderake (vanI isarAIlake) Ami jenezunei sArA vizvavAsIra opara zreSThatva diYechilAma|
Ara tAderake emana sava nidarzana diYechilAma yAte spaSTa parIkSA chila|
erA valache,
“AmAdera prathama mRtyu chAr3A Ara kichu nei evaM AmAderake Ara (kavara theke) uThAno have nA|”
“tomAdera kathA yadi satya haYa tAhale AmAdera pUrvapuruSaderake ene dekhAo to|”
tArA zreSTha nA tuvvA samapradAYa o tAdera pUrvavartIrA (zreSTha)? Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| (kAraNa) tArA aparAdhI chila|
AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI jinisagulo Ami khelAra janya sRSTi karini|
egulo Ami yathArtha uddezyei sRSTi karechi| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai (tA) jAne nA|
nizcaYai vicArera dina tAdera savAra janyai nirdhArita samaYa|
sedina vandhu vandhura upakAre Asave nA evaM tArA sAhAyyao pAve nA|
tave AllAha yAke anugraha karavena tAra kathA AlAdA| nizcaYai tini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
yAk‌kuma gAcha
pApIra khAdya (have);
galita tAmAra mata (garama), yA (tAdera) peTe (Tagavaga kare) phuTave
yemana garama pAni phoTe|
(jAhAnnAmera praharI pherezatAderake valA have) “pApITAke dhara evaM jAhAnnAmera (jvalanta Agunera) mAjhakhAne Tene niYe yAo|
tArapara tAra mAthAra opara phuTanta pAnira AjAva Dhele dAo (tAra mAthAra opara phuTanta pAni Dhele tAke AjAva dAo)|”
(tAke valA have) “svAda grahaNa karo, tumi to zaktizAlI, sambhrAnta! (yemanaTi tumi duniYAYa dAvi karate|)”
eTAi tAi, yAra vyApAre tomarA sandeha karate|
nizcaYai mottAkIrA eka nirApada sthAne (jAnnAte) thAkave;
udyAna o jharanAra mAjhe|
tArA mihi o puru rezamI kApar3a paridhAna karave evaM eke aparera sAmanAsAmani vasave|
emanai (have)| Ara tAderake sunaYanA sundarI strI deva|
sekhAne tArA prazAnta mane (nijedera janya) pratyeka prakArera phala Anate valave|
(duniYAra) prathama mRtyu chAr3A sekhAne tArA (Ara) mRtyu AsvAdana karave nA| evaM tini tAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti theke rakSA karavena;
tomAra prabhura anugrahe| eTAi to var3a sAphalya|
vastuta Ami eke (ei koraAnake) tomAra bhASAYa sahaja kare diYechi, yAte tArA mane rAkhate pAre|
ataeva, tumi apekSA karo, tArAo apekSA karache|
hA mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
ei kitAva parAkramazAlI o prajJAvAna AllAhara nikaTa theke avatIrNa|
nizcaYai AsamAna o jamine muminadera janya aneka nidarzana Ache|
AllAha ye tomAderake sRSTi karechena evaM (cAradike) ye sava jIvajantu char3iYe rekhechena tAte dRr3ha vizvAsIdera janya nidarzana Ache|

Ara rAta o dinera parivartane, AkAza theke AllAha ye jIvikA (jIvikAra upasarga vRSTi) varSaNa karena o tAra sAhAyye pRthivIke tAra mRtyura para punarjIvita karena (zuSka haYe yAvAra para sajIva karena) tAte evaM vAtAsera parivartane vuddhisampanna lokadera janya nidarzana Ache|
egulo AllAhara AYAta, yA Ami tomAra kAche saThikabhAve AvRtti karachi| sutarAM AllAha o tA~ra AYAtera para tArA kon‌ vANIte vizvAsa karave?
pratyeka mithyAvAdI o pApIra amaGgala hoka!
se AllAhara AYAtasamUhera telAoYAta zone, ataHpara ahaGkAravazata (anyAYera opara) jida dhare, yena se tA zunate pAYani| ataeva, tAke yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda dAo|
se yakhana AmAra kona AYAta jAnate pAre takhana tA niYe ThATTA kare| odera janyai raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|
tAdera pechanei jAhAnnAma| tArA yA upArjana kareche tA evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAderake abhibhAvaka vAniYeche tArA tAdera konai kAje Asave nA| tAdera janya raYeche eka virATa zAsti|
eTi (ei koraAna) ekaTi pathanirdeza| yArA tAdera prabhura AYAtasamUha avizvAsa kare tAdera janya raYeche eka kaThora yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
AllAhai samudrake tomAdera AYattAdhIna kare diYechena, yAte tA~ra Adeze tAte nauyAna calAcala kare evaM tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karo o (tA~ra prati) kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
AsamAne o jamine yA kichu Ache tA savai tini tA~ra pakSa theke tomAdera AYattAdhIna kare diYechena| nizcaYai ete cintAzIla lokadera janya nidarzana raYeche|
muminaderake vala, tArA yena seisava lokaderake kSamA kare deYa, yArA AllAhara dinasamUhera (tA~ra pratidAnasamUhera) pratyAzA kare nA; yAte tini lokaderake tAdera kRtakarmera pratidAna dite pArena|
ye bhAla kAja kare tAra suphala se nijei pAYa evaM ye khArApa kAja kare tAra kuphala tAra oparai vartAYa| ataHpara tomAderake tomAdera prabhura kAche phiriYe neoYA have|
Ami to vanI isarAIlake kitAva, zAsanakSamatA o navuoYAta dAna karechilAma, tAderake uttama jIvikA diYechilAma evaM sArA vizvavAsIra opara tAderake zreSThatva diYechilAma|

Ami tAderake dvInera vyApAre suspaSTa pramANAdi diYechilAma| tAdera kAche jJAna AsAra parao tArA pArasparika vidveSavazata matabheda kareche| tArA ye viSaYe matabheda karata se viSaYe keYAmatera dina tomAra prabhu avazyai tAdera madhye phaYasAlA karavena|
erapara Ami tomAke dvInera vyApAre ekaTi vidhAnera opara pratiSThita karechi| ataeva, tumi tArai anusaraNa karo, yArA jAne nA tAdera icchAra anusaraNa karo nA|
tArA AllAhara sAmane tomAra konai upakAre Asave nA| jAlemarA eke aparera vandhu| Ara mottAkIdera vandhu AllAha|
ei koraAna mAnuSera janya antardRSTi (divya jJAnera utsa) evaM dRr3ha vizvAsI lokadera janya pathanirdeza o ekaTi rahamata|
yArA apakarma kare tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami tAderake ImAnadAra o satkarma-zIladera mata gaNya karava? tAdera (savAra) jIvana o mRtyu ki samAna? tAdera vicAra kata khArApa (o ayauktika)!
AllAha yathAyathabhAve AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena, yAte pratyekei tAra karmera phala pAYa| tAdera prati (kona) juluma karA have nA|

tumi ki sei vyaktike dekhecho, ye tAra pravRttike tAra upAsya vAniYeche? AllAha jene zunei tAke pathabhraSTa karechena, tAra kAne o antare mohara mere diYechena evaM tAra cokhera opara ekaTi AvaraNa lAgiYe rekhechena| ataeva, AllAhara pare tAke Ara ke patha dekhAve? tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karave nA?

tArA vale, “AmAdera pArthiva jIvana chAr3A Ara kichu nei| AmarA mari evaM (mRtyura Aga paryanta) ve~ce thAki| kevala mahAkAlai AmAderake dhvaMsa kare|” (Asale) e vyApAre tAdera kona (vAstava) jJAna nei| tArA zudhu anumAnai kare|
yakhana tAdera kAche AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana tArA kona yukti nA peYe zudhu vale, “tomarA satyavAdI hale AmAdera pUrvapuruSadera ene dekhAo|”
vala, “AllAhai tomAderake vA~cAna o mArena| ataHpara tini tomAderake keYAmatera dina ekatrita karavena, tAte kona sandeha nei| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAne nA|”
AsamAna o jaminera rAjatva AllAharai| yedina keYAmata saMghaTita have sedina mithyAzraYIrA kSatigrasta have|
(sedina) pratyeka ummatake tumi natajAnu avasthAYa dekhave| pratyeka ummatake tAdera AmalanAmA dekhate DAkA have| (valA have) “tomarA (duniYAYa) yA karate Aja tomAderake tAra pratiphala deoYA have|”
“eTA AmAra (likhe rAkhA tomAdera) AmalanAmA| eTA tomAdera samparke satya kathA valave (athavA tomAdera viruddhe satya sAkSya deve)| tomarA yA karate Ami to tA likhe rAkhatAma|”
yArA ImAna eneche o satkAja kareche tAderake tAdera prabhu tA~ra rahamatera mAjhe praveza karAvena| seTAi hacche spaSTa (var3a) sAphalya|
Ara yArA kuphari kareche (tAderake valA have), “tomAdera kAche ki AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA hata nA? kintu tomarA ahaMkAra karechile; Ara tomarA chile eka aparAdhI janagoSThI|”

yakhana valA haYechila, “nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya evaM keYAmata samvandhe kona sandeha nei,” takhana tomarA valechile, “AmarA jAni nA keYAmata ki, AmarA zudhu ekaTA dhAraNA kari, (viSaYaTi samvandhe) AmarA nizcita nai|”
tAdera khArApa kAjagulo tAdera sAmane prakAza haYe par3ave evaM tArA yA niYe ThATTA karata tA (sei AjAva) tAderake ghire dharave|
Ara valA have (AllAha valavena), “Aja Ami tomAderake bhule yAva, yemana tomarA tomAdera e dinera sAkSAtake bhule giYechile| tomAdera vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera janya kona sAhAyyakArI nei|”

eTA e janya ye, tomarA AllAhara (koraAnera) AYAtasamUhake ThATTAra vastu vAniYechile evaM pArthiva jIvana tomAderake pratArita karechila| sutarAM Aja tAderake jAhAnnAma theke vera karA have nA evaM (duniYAYa phire giYe AllAhara) santuSTi lAbhera suyogao deoYA have nA|
ataeva, sakala prazaMsA AllAhara, yini AsamAnera prabhu, jaminera prabhu evaM sArA jAhAnera prabhu|
Ara AsamAna o jamine tA~rai mahimA| tinii parAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|
hA mIma [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavda-saMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]|
ei kitAva parAkramazAlI o asIma prajJAvAna AllAhara nikaTa theke avatIrNa|
AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichu Ami yathAyathabhAve o nirdiSTa samaYera janyai sRSTi karechi| Ara kApheraderake ye viSaYe satarka karA haYeche tArA tA upekSA kare|

vala, “AllAha vyatIta tomarA yAderake DAka tAdera kathA ki bheve dekhecho? AmAke dekhAo to, tArA pRthivIra ki sRSTi kareche? nAki AsamAna sRSTite tAdera kona aMzIdAritva Ache? tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale (tomAdera dAvira samarthane) era pUrvera kona kitAva athavA kona jJAnera nidarzana AmAra kAche upasthita kara|”
ye vyakti AllAhara parivarte emana kAuke DAke ye keYAmata paryanta tAra DAke sAr3A deve nA tAra ceYe adhika pathabhraSTa ke Ache? orA (mithyA upAsyarA) to edera DAka samparke avahitao naYa|
(keYAmate) yakhana mAnuSake ekatrita karA have takhana orA edera (upAsakadera) zatru have evaM edera upAsanA asvIkAra karave|
yakhana tAderake AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha par3e zonAno haYa takhana tAdera kAche ei satya (koraAna) pau~chAra parao kApherarA tAra samparke vale, “e to spaSTa yAdu|”

athavA tArA vale, “se (rasUla) eTA nije vAniYeche|” vala, “Ami yadi eTA vAniYe thAki tAhale tomarA AmAra janya AllAhara vipakSe kichui karate pArave nA (tA~ra zAsti theke AmAke rakSA karate pArave nA)| tomarA yA AlocanA karacha se samparke AllAha khuva bhAlabhAve avagata Achena| AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hiseve tinii yatheSTa| tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|”

vala, “Ami to rasUladera madhye natuna nai (Ami to prathama rasUla nai)| Ami jAnio nA, AmAra o tomAdera sAthe ki AcaraNa karA have| AmAra kAche ye ohI pAThAno haYa Ami zudhu tAi mene cali| ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI chAr3A Ami Ara kichu nai|”

vala, “tomarA ki bheve dekhecho, yadi ei koraAna AllAhara pakSa theke ese thAke Ara tomarA eke avizvAsa karo, athaca vanI isarAIlera ekajana sAkSI (AvdullAha ivane sAlAma) sAkSya deYa ye, anurUpa ArekaTi kitAvera (tAorAtera) matai eTi satya, evaM eke vizvAsa kare, Ara tomarA ahaMkAra karo (arthAt ahaMkArera kAraNe vizvAsa nA karo, tAhale tomAdera pariNAma ki have)?” AllAha jAlema lokaderake patha dekhAna nA|

kApherarA muminadera samparke vale, “e koraAna yadi bhAla kichu hata tAhale erA AmAdera Age tA vizvAsa karata nA| (arthAt AmarAi Age vizvAsa karatAma)|” yehetu tArA era mAdhyame hedAYeta pAYani, tAi zigagirai tArA valave, “e eka purano mithyA|”

era Age pathapradarzaka o (AllAhara) rahamatasvarUpa chila mUsAra kitAva (tAorAta)| Ara e kitAva (koraAna) tAra samarthaka| eTi AravI bhASAYa avatIrNa| era uddezya jAlemaderake satarka karA evaM satkarmazIladerake susaMvAda deoYA|
yArA vale, “AmAdera prabhu AllAha” evaM tArapara (satpathe) aTala thAke, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao have nA|
tArAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI| sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| (duniYAYa) tArA yesava bhAla kAja karata, eTA tArai puraskAra|

Ami mAnuSake tAra pitAmAtAra sAthe sadvyavahAra karAra nirdeza diYechi| tAra mA tAke kaSTa kare garbhe dhAraNa kareche evaM kaSTa kare prasava kareche| tAke garbhe dhAraNa o vukera dudha chAr3Ate triza mAsa (samaYa legeche)| avazeSe yakhana se valiSThatAra (pUrNa zArIrika zaktira) vaYase upanIta haYa evaM calliza vachare pau~che takhana vale, “he AmAra prabhu! tumi AmAke o AmAra pitAmAtAke ye neYAmata dAna karecho, AmAke tAra zukariYA AdAYa karAra o tomAra pachandanIYa satkAja karAra taophIka dAo evaM AmAra janya AmAra santAnadera madhye satkarmazIlatA dAna karo (AmAra santAnaderake satkarmazIla karo)| Ami tomAra dike phire esechi (tomAra kAche taovA karechi)| Ami ekajana musalima (tomAra ekajana anugata vAndA)|”
ederai bhAla kAjagulo Ami grahaNa karava evaM khArApa kAjagulo upekSA (kSamA) karava| tArA jAnnAtavAsIdera antarbhukta| tAderake ye pratizruti deoYA haYeche tA satya|

Ara emana lokao Ache ye, tAra pitAmAtAke vale, “dhika tomAderake! tomarA ki AmAke ei bhaYa dekhAo ye, AmAke (kavara theke) vera karA have, athaca AmAra pUrve aneka prajanma gata haYeche?” Ara pitAmAtA AllAhara kAche phariYAda kare| (Ara tAke vale,) “tomAke dhika! tumi ImAna Ana| nizcaYai AllAhara oYAdA satya|” takhana se vale, “esava to Agera lokadera upakathA chAr3A kichu naYa|”
edera pUrve yesava jvina o mAnavajAti gata haYeche tAdera mata edera kSetreo AllAhara (zAstira) kathA satya| nizcaYai tArA kSatigrasta haYechila|
pratyekera janya tAdera kRtakarma anuyAYI maryAdAra vibhinna stara raYeche; ejanya ye, AllAha tAderake tAdera karmera puropuri pratiphala devena evaM tAdera prati (kona) juluma karA have nA|

sedinera kathA smaraNa karo, yedina kApheraderake jAhAnnAmera sAmane upasthita karA have| (tAderake valA have,) “tomarA tomAdera bhAla jinisagulo duniYAra jIvanei niYecho evaM tA upabhoga karecho| ataeva, Aja tomAderake lAJchanAkara zAstira pratiphala deoYA have; kAraNa, tomarA duniYAYa anyAYabhAve ahaMkAra karate evaM AllAhara Adezera virodhitA karate|”

Ada jAtira bhAiYera (hUdera) kathA smaraNa karo, yakhana se AhakApha upatyakAYa tAra samapradAYake satarka karechila| tAra Age-pareo satarkakArIrA esechila| (se ei vale satarka karechila ye,) “tomarA AllAha chAr3A kAro upAsanA karo nA| Ami tomAdera janya eka kaThina dinera zAstira AzaMkA karachi|”
tArA valala, “tumi ki AmAderake AmAdera upAsyadera theke pherAnora janya esecho? Thika Ache, tumi satyavAdI hale AmAderake yAra (ye zAstira) bhaYa dekhAccha tA niYe eso|”
se valala, “era jJAna to raYeche AllAhara kAche| AmAke yA niYe pAThAno haYeche Ami kevala tomAdera kAche tAi pau~che dei| tave Ami dekhate pAcchi, tomarA eka ajJa janagoSThI|”

ataHpara tArA yakhana tAdera upatyakAra dike ekaTi megha egiYe Asate dekhala takhana valala, “ei megha AmAdera janya vRSTi varSaNa karave|” (Asale tA naYa) varaM e hala sei zAsti yA tomarA tAr3AtAr3i pete ceYecho: ekaTi vAtAsa, yAra madhye Ache eka kaThina zAsti|
e vAtAsa tAra prabhura Adeze savakichu dhvaMsa kare deve| pare tAdera emana pariNati haYechila ye, tAdera gharavAr3i chAr3A Ara kichui dekhA yAYani| aparAdhI lokaderake ebhAvei Ami zAsti diYe thAki|

tAderake Ami emana kSamatA diYechilAma yA tomAderake deini| tAderake kAna, cokha o antara diYechilAma; kintu tAdera kAna, cokha kiMvA antara tAdera kona kAje Aseni; kenanA tArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra karata| Ara tArA yA niYe ThATTA-vidrUpa karata sei zAsti tAderake ghire phelala|
Ami tomAdera cArapAzera janapadasamUha dhvaMsa kare diYechi evaM vAravAra (tAderake) nidarzanAvalI dekhiYechi, yAte tArA (satpathe) phire Ase|

tArA AllAha chAr3A yAderake (AllAhara) naikaTya lAbhera janya upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechila tArA tAderake sAhAyya kareni kena? varaM tArA tAdera theke udhAo haYe giYeche| oTA chila tAdera mithyA Ara alIka udbhAvana|

(sei ghaTanA smaraNa karo,) yakhana Ami tomAra kAche koraAna zonAra janya ekadala jvina pAThiYechilAma| tArA koraAna pAThera majalise upasthita haYe valala, “savAi cupa kare zona|” tArapara yakhana pATha samApta hala takhana tArA tAdera samapradAYera kAche phire giYe anyaderake satarka karate lAgala|
tArA valala, “he AmAdera samapradAYa! AmarA ekaTi kitAva zune esechi, yA mUsAra pare avatIrNa haYeche, pUrvavartI kitAvera satyatA samarthana karache evaM satya o sarala pathera sandhAna dicche|”

“he AmAdera samapradAYa! tomarA AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra (navIra) DAke sAr3A dAo evaM tAra kathAYa vizvAsa kara| tAhale AllAha tomAdera pApa mArjanA karavena evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAsti theke tomAderake rakSA karavena|”

Ara yArA AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra DAke sAr3A deve nA, tArA pRthivIte (AllAhake) akSama karate (arthAt AllAhara zAsti theke rehAi pete) pArave nA evaM tini chAr3A tAdera sAhAyyakArIo thAkave nA| tArA suspaSTa vibhrAntira madhye raYeche|

tArA ki dekhe nA ye, ye AllAha AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena evaM esava sRSTi karate klAnti vodha karenani, tini mRtaderake jIvita karate sakSama? hyA~, avazyai tini savakichu karAra kSamatA rAkhena|

yedina kApheraderake jAhAnnAmera sAmane upasthita karA have (sedina tAderake valA have,) “eTA ki satya naYa?” tArA valave, “hyA~, AmAdera prabhura kasama (satya)|” AllAha valavena, “tAhale zAsti AsvAdana karo, kAraNa tomarA avizvAsa karate|”

ataeva, tumi dhairyadhAraNa karo, yemana sthirasaMkalpa rasUlagaNa dhairyadhAraNa karechila| Ara tAdera janya tAr3Ahur3A karo nA| tArA yedina tAdera pratizruta zAsti dekhate pAve sedina tAdera mane have, yena tArA dinera eka muhUrtera vezi (pRthivIte) avasthAna kareni| ekaTi ghoSaNA (zona): avAdhya lokerAi dhvaMsaprApta have|
yArA kuphari kare o AllAhara pathe vAdhA sRSTi kare, AllAha tAdera karmasamUha vyartha kare dena|

Ara yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare evaM tAdera prabhura pakSa theke muhAmmAdera prati ye satya nAyila karA haYeche tA vizvAsa kare, AllAha tAdera aparAdhasamUha mArjanA karena evaM tAdera avasthA bhAla kare dena|

eTA ejanya ye, yArA kuphari kare tArA mithyAra anusaraNa kare, Ara yArA ImAna Ane tArA tAdera prabhura kAcha theke Agata satyera anusaraNa kare| ebhAvei AllAha mAnuSera janya tAdera udAharaNa peza karena|

ataeva, kApheradera sAthe yakhana (yuddhera maYadAne) tomAdera mokAvelA have takhana tAdera zirazcheda karave| avazeSe yakhana tomarA tAdera (anekera) raktapAta ghaTAve takhana (avaziSTaderake) kaSe vA~dhave (vandI karave)| tArapara haYa anukampA, nA haYa muktipaNa| (arthAt tAderake haYa anukampA dekhiYe cher3e deve, nA haYa muktipaNera vinimaYe mukti deve|) (tave tomarA tAdera viruddhe yuddha avyAhata rAkhave) yatakSaNa nA yuddha tAra vojhA nAmiYe rAkhe (zatru tAra astra samarpaNa kare)| eTAi (AllAhara nirdeza)| AllAha cAile tAdera theke pratizodha nite pAratena (tAderake zAsti dite pAratena), kintu tini cAna tomAdera katakake katakera dvArA parIkSA karate| tave yArA AllAhara pathe nihata (zahIda) haYa, tAdera karma tini kichutei naSTa karavena nA|
tini tAderake satpatha pradarzana karavena evaM tAdera avasthA bhAla karavena|
Ara tAderake sei jAnnAte praveza karAvena yAra kathA tini tAderake jAniYe diYechena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yadi AllAhake sAhAyya karo tAhale tinio tomAderake sAhAyya karavena evaM tomAdera pA (avasthAna) sudRr3ha karavena|
Ara yArA kAphera, tAdera janya durgati raYeche evaM tini tAdera karma niSphala kare devena|
eTA ejanya ye, AllAha yA nAyila karechena tArA tA apachanda kare| ejanyai tini tAdera karma niSphala kare devena|
tArA ki pRthivIte ghure dekheni ye, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNati kemana haYechila? AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechena| kApheraderao ekairakama pariNati have|
tA ejanya ye, AllAha muminadera abhibhAvaka, Ara kApheradera kona abhibhAvaka nei|

nizcaYai AllAha ImAnadAra o satkarmazIladerake jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita| Ara yArA kAphera, tArA bhoga-vilAse matta thAke evaM catuSpada jantura mata khete thAke| tAi jAhAnnAmai tAdera ThikAnA|
tomAra ye janapada (janapadera vAsindArA) tomAke vera kare diYeche tAra ceYe adhika zaktizAlI kata janapada chila! Ami tAderake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI chila nA|

ataeva, ye tAra prabhura kAcha theke Agata spaSTa pramANera opara raYeche, se ki tAra mata, yAra kAche tAra nijera khArApa kAja sundara vale pratIYamAna haYa? evaM (se ki tAdera mata) yArA nijedera pravRttira anusaraNa kare?

mottAkIderake ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deoYA haYeche tAra varNanA: tAte Ache vizuddha pAnira nahara, svAda parivartana haYani emana dudhera nahara, pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu zarAvera nahara o parizodhita madhura nahara| sekhAne tAdera janya Aro Ache savarakamera phalamUla o tAdera prabhura kSamA| (ei mottAkIrA ki) tAdera mata, yArA cirakAla jAhAnnAme thAkave evaM yAderake phuTanta pAni pAna karate deoYA have, yA tAdera nAr3Ibhu~r3i chinna-vicchinna kare deve?

tAdera madhye keu keu Ache, yArA tomAra kathAYa kAna pAte| ataHpara yakhana tomAra kAcha theke vera haYa takhana yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYeche tAdera kAche vale, “eimAtra uni ki valalena?” orAi tArA, yAdera antare AllAha mohara mere diYechena evaM yArA nijedera pravRttira anusaraNa kare|
Ara yArA saThika patha anusaraNa kare AllAha tAderake vezi vezi hedAYeta evaM tAkaoYA dAna karena|

Ara orA (avizvAsIrA) ki odera kAche akasmAt keYAmata ese par3Ara apekSAYa Ache? kintu tAra lakSaNasamUha to ese geche| yakhana tA (keYAmata) tAdera kAche esei par3ave takhana tArA upadeza grahaNa karave kemana kare?
ataeva, jene rAkha, AllAha chAr3A kona upAsya nei| nijera truTira janya o mumina nara-nArIdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara| AllAha tomAdera calApherA o ThikAnA jAnena|

yArA ImAna eneche tArA vale, “kona sUrA nAyila karA haYa nA kena?” kintu yakhana kona dvyarthahIna sUrA nAyila karA haYa, Ara tAte yuddhera ullekha (nirdeza) thAke, takhana yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tAderake dekhave, mRtyura yantraNAYa mUrchita mAnuSera dRSTite tomAra dike tAkAcche| kintu tAdera janya seTAi (yuddhera nirdeza pAlanai) bhAla chila|

(AllAhara prati) Anugatya o nyAYasaGgata kathA (tAdera janya bhAla chila)| ataeva, (jehAdera) viSaYaTi yakhana cUr3Anta have takhana yadi tArA AllAhara sAthe satya vale (arthAt AllAhara pathe jehAdera janya tAdera pratijJA pAlana kare) tAhale tAdera janya avazyai tA maGgalajanaka have|
tave ki tomarA kSamatA pele pRthivIte anartha sRSTi karave evaM tomAdera AtmIYatAra vandhana chinna karave?
oderakei AllAha abhizapta karechena, tArapara tAderake vadhira karechena o tAdera cokha andha kare diYechena|
tave ki tArA koraAna samparke cintA kare nA? nAki tAdera antare tAlA lAgAno Ache?
supatha spaSTa haoYAra para yArA pechane phire giYeche (supathe calate rAji haYani), zaYatAna tAderake prarocita kareche evaM tAdera AzA vAr3iYe diYeche|
eTA ejanya ye, yArA AllAhara avatIrNa kitAva apachanda kare tAderake erA valeche, “AmarA kona kona viSaYe tomAdera kathA mene calava|” tave AllAha edera gopana abhisandhi avagata Achena|
pherezatArA yakhana tAdera cehArAYa o piThe AghAta karate karate tAdera mRtyu ghaTAve takhana kemana have?
eTA ejanya ye, tArA sei kAja kareche yAte AllAha rAgAnvita hana evaM tA~ra santuSTike tArA apachanda kareche| tAi tini tAdera karma niSphala kare diYechena|
yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tArA ki mane kare ye, AllAha tAdera vidveSa prakAza karavena nA?

Ami yadi cAitAma tAhale tomAke avazyai tAderake dekhiYe ditAma| takhana tumi tAdera cihna dekhei tAderake cinate pArate| tave kathAra svare avazyai tumi tAderake cinate pArave| AllAha tomAdera karmasamUha avagata Achena|
Ami tomAderake avazyai parIkSA karava, yatakSaNa nA tomAdera madhya theke jehAdakArI o dhairyazIladera veche nei evaM (yatakSaNa nA) tomAdera tathyasamUha yAcAi kari|

yArA kuphari kare o AllAhara patha theke (mAnuSake) phiriYe rAkhe evaM nijedera kAche supatha spaSTa haoYAra parao rasUlera virodhitA kare tArA AllAhara kona kSati karate pArave nA; varaM tinii tAdera karmasamUha niSphala kare devena|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAha o rasUlera Anugatya karo evaM nijedera karmasamUha vinaSTa karo nA|
yArA kuphari kare o AllAhara patha theke (mAnuSake) phiriYe rAkhe, tArapara kAphera avasthAYa mArA yAYa, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA|

ataeva, tomarA durvala haYo nA o (zatrura saGge) sandhi karate ceYo nA| tomarAi opare (suvidhAjanaka avasthAne) raYecho evaM AllAha tomAdera sAthe Achena| tini tomAdera karmasamUha kamAvena nA (karmera puraskAra kama devena nA)|
Asale pArthiva jIvana hacche khelA Ara Ananda| tave tomarA yadi mumina o mottAkI hao tAhale AllAha tomAderake tomAdera pratidAna devena| Ara tini tomAdera kAche tomAdera sampada cAivena nA|
tini yadi tomAdera kAche tA cAna evaM tomAderake (sejanya) cApa dena tAhale tomarA kArpaNya karave evaM tini (takhana) tomAdera manera vakratA prakAza kare devena|

zona, tomAderakei AllAhara pathe vyaYa karate valA hacche; athaca tomAdera madhye keu keu kArpaNya karache| ye kArpaNya karache se to nijera pratii kArpaNya karache| AllAha abhAvamukta evaM tomarA abhAvagrasta| yadi tomarA (AllAhara nirdeza pAlana theke) mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale tini anya lokaderake tomAdera sthalAbhiSikta karavena evaM tArA tomAdera mata (avAdhya) have nA|
nizcaYai Ami tomAke eka spaSTa vijaYa diYechi (6STha hijarIte makkAra muzarikadera sAthe hudAiviYA nAmaka sthAne sampAdita rasUlullAhara sandhike AllAha spaSTa vijaYa AkhyAYita karechena);
ejanya ye, AllAha tomAke tomAra atIta o vartamAna truTisamUha mApha kare devena, tomAra prati tA~ra neYAmata pUrNa karavena o tomAke sarala pathe paricAlita karavena;
sarvopari, AllAha tomAke valiSThabhAve pRSThapoSakatA karavena|
tinii muminadera antare prazAnti dAna karechena, yAte tAdera ImAnera sAthe Aro ImAna vAr3e| AsamAna o jaminera vAhinIgulo AllAharai| AllAha mahAjJAnI, asIma prajJAvAna|

(ImAna vRddhira janya tini muminadera antare prazAnti dAna karechena) ejanya ye, tini mumina puruSa o mumina nArIderake jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita o yekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave evaM (ejanya ye,) tini tAdera pApasamUha mocana karavena| eTA AllAhara nikaTa eka virATa sAphalya|

Ara (ejanya ye,) tini monApheka puruSa o nArI evaM muzarika puruSa o nArIke zAsti devena, yArA AllAha samparke khArApa dhAraNA poSaNa kare| tAdera janya raYeche khArApa pariNati (lAJchanAkara zAsti)| AllAha tAdera opara rAgAnvita haYechena, tAderake abhizapta karechena evaM tAdera janya jAhAnnAma tairI kare rekhechena| seTA var3a khArApa gantavyasthala!
AsamAna o jaminera vAhinIgulo AllAharai| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAvAna|
Ami tomAke ekajana sAkSI, susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI hiseve pAThiYechi|
yAte tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati ImAna Ana, rasUlake sAhAyya o sammAna karo evaM sakAla-sandhyAYa AllAhara pavitratA varNanA kara|

yArA tomAra kAche vAiYAta (Anugatyera zapatha) kare, tArA vastuta AllAhara kAchei vAiYAta kare| tAdera hAtera opara AllAhara (kudaratI) hAta raYeche| sutarAM ye tA bhaGga kare se nijerai kSati kare| Ara ye AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra pUraNa kare tAke tini eka var3a puraskAra (jAnnAta) devena|

veduInadera madhye yArA pechane raYe giYeche tArA tomAke valave, “AmAdera dhana-sampada o parivAra-parijana AmAderake vyasta rekhechila| (ejanya AmarA ApanAra saGge yete pArini|) ataeva, Apani AmAdera janya (AllAhara kAche) kSamA prArthanA karuna|” tArA mukhe tAi vale yA tAdera antare nei| vala, “AllAha yadi tomAdera kona kSati kiMvA upakAra karate cAna tAhale ke tA~ra icchAra viruddhe tomAdera janya kichu karAra kSamatA rAkhe? varaM tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|”

“varaM tomarA dhAraNA karechile ye, rasUla o (tAra sahayogI) muminarA (raNAGgana theke ve~ce) kakhano tAdera parivAra-parijanera kAche phire Asate pArave nA, evaM ei dhAraNA tomAdera antare prItikara mane haYechila| tomarA khuva khArApa dhAraNA poSaNa karechile| tomarA haccha eka dhvaMsamukhI samapradAYa|”
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake vizvAsa kare nA, Ami sei kApheradera janya jvalanta Aguna (jAhAnnAma) prastuta kare rekhechi|
AsamAna o jaminera rAjatva AllAharai| tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti dena| AllAha asIma kSamAparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|

yakhana tomarA ganImata (yuddhalavdha sampada) saMgrahera janya yAve takhana yArA pechane raYe giYechila tArA valave, “AmAderakeo tomAdera sAthe yete dAo|” tArA AllAhara kathA parivartana karate cAYa| vale dAo, “tomarA kakhano AmAdera saGge yAve nA|” emanaTi AllAha Agei valechena| takhana tArA valave, “Asale tomarA AmAderake hiMsA karacha|” varaM tArA khuva kamai vojhe|

veduInadera madhye yArA pechane raYe giYechila tAderake vala, “tomAderake eka pravala parAkrAnta jAtira sAthe yuddha karate DAkA have| tomarA tAdera sAthe yuddha cAliYe yAve yatakSaNa nA tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare| tomarA yadi e nirdeza pAlana karo tAhale AllAha tomAderake eka uttama puraskAra devena| Ara yadi pechane phire Asa, yemana itipUrve phire esecho, tAhale tini tomAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAsti devena|”

(yuddhe aMzagrahaNa nA karAYa) andhera kona doSa nei, kho~r3Ara kona doSa nei evaM asustha vyaktirao kona doSa nei| ye keu AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya karave, tAke tini jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa| Ara ye pechane phire yAve, tAke tini yantraNAdAYaka zAsti devena|

muminarA yakhana gAchaTira nice tomAra kAche Anugatyera zapatha karachila AllAha takhana tAdera prati avazyai santuSTa haYechena| tini tAdera manera kathA jAnatena; tAi tAdera opara prazAnti varSaNa karena evaM pratidAnasvarUpa tAderake dena eka nikaTavartI vijaYa;
Ara aneka ganImata, yA tArA hastagata karave| AllAha mahAparAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|

AllAha tomAderake aneka ganImatera pratizruti diYechena, yA tomarA hastagata karave| tini egulo tomAderake druta diYechena evaM lokadera hAta tomAdera theke virata rekhechena, yAte tA muminadera janya eka nidarzana haYa evaM tini tomAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karena|
Aro (vijaYa o ganImata) Ache, yA tomarA (ekhano) lAbha karate pArani| AllAha tA veSTana kare rekhechena| AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|
kApherarA yadi tomAdera sAthe yuddha karata tAhale avazyai tArA pechane haTe yeta| ataHpara tArA kona abhibhAvaka kiMvA sAhAyyakArI peta nA|
eTAi AllAhara rIti, yA Age thekei cale eseche| tumi AllAhara rItira kona parivartana pAve nA|
tAdera opara tomAderake vijaYI karAra para tinii makkAra abhyantare tAdera hAta tomAdera theke evaM tomAdera hAta tAdera theke nivRtta rekhechena| tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tA dekhate pAna|

orAi kuphari karechila evaM tomAderake masajidula hArAme yete evaM Avaddha koravAnira pazuke nirdiSTa jAYagAYa pau~chate vAdhA diYechila| (makkAYa) kichusaMkhyaka ImAnadAra nArI-puruSa chila yAdera kathA tomarA jAnate nA| (yuddha hale) ajJAtasAre tomarA tAderake padadalita karate evaM tAdera kAraNe tomAdera kSati hata| yadi tArA nA thAkata (tAhale tomAderake yuddhera Adeza deoYA hata)| (yuddha er3Ano haYeche) ejanya ye, AllAha yAke cAna tA~ra anugrahera AotAYa niYe Asavena| yadi tArA (ImAnadAra nArI-puruSerA kApheradera theke) pRthaka thAkata tAhale (yuddhera Adeza diYe) tAdera madhya theke kApheraderake avazyai kaThina zAsti ditAma|

kenanA kApherarA tAdera antare ahamikA— ajJatAyugera ahamikA— poSaNa karechila| kintu AllAha tA~ra rasUlera o muminadera antare nijera (pakSa theke) prazAnti nAyila karena evaM tAderake tAkaoYAra vANIte aTala rAkhena| Ara tArAi era adhikatara yogya o upayukta chila| AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve jAnena|

AllAha tA~ra rasUlake satya svapnai dekhiYechena (athavA AllAha tA~ra rasUlake dekhAno svapnaTi yathAyathabhAve vAstavAYita karavena)| AllAha yadi cAna, avazyai tomarA nirApade masajidula hArAme praveza karave| tomAdera keu keu mAthAra cula muNDana karave, keu keu tA choTa karave| tomarA kAuke bhaYa karave nA| tomarA yA jAna nA AllAha tA jAnena| tA chAr3Ao tini (tomAdera janya) ekaTi nikaTavartI vijaYa maJjura karechena|
tinii tA~ra rasUlake pathanirdeza o satya dharmasaha pAThiYechena; ejanya ye, tini eke sava dharmera opara vijaYI karavena| Ara sAkSI hiseve AllAhai yatheSTa|

muhAmmAda AllAhara rasUla; Ara tAra saGgIrA kApheradera prati kaThora evaM nijerA parasparera prati sahAnubhUtizIla| AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi pratyAzAYa tAderake tumi ruku o sejadArata avasthAYa dekhate pAve| sejadAra dAgajanita tAdera (ImAnera) cihna tAdera cehArAYa vidyamAna| tAdera emanai varNanA Ache tAorAte| Ara inajIle tAdera varNanA erUpa: yemana ekaTi vIja, yA (vapana karAra para) tAra aMkura ud‌gata kare, ataHpara AllAha tAke zakta karena evaM aMkuraTi krame moTA haYa o nijera kANDera opara sojA haYe dA~r3AYa, yA vapanakArIderake mugdha kare| (ekaibhAve AllAha muminaderake krame zaktizAlI karena) yAte tini tAdera dvArA kApheraderake rAgiYe dite pArena| tAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane o satkAja kare AllAha tAderake kSamA o eka var3a puraskArera (jAnnAtera) pratizruti diYechena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAmane kona kichu egiYe dio nA (arthAt tAdera Age kona viSaYe siddhAnta nio nA)| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu jAnena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA navIra kaNThasvarera opara nijedera kaNThasvara u~cu karo nA evaM nijerA eke anyera sAthe yebhAve jore kathA vala sebhAve tAra sAthe jore kathA valo nA| tAte tomAdera karma niSphala haYe yAve evaM tomarA tA Terao pAve nA|
yArA AllAhara rasUlera sAmane nijedera kaNThasvara nicu rAkhe AllAha tAdera antara tAkaoYAra janya parIkSA karechena| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA Ara var3a eka puraskAra|
yArA tomAke kAmarAra pechana theke DAkADAki kare tAdera adhikAMzera vuddhi nei|
tumi vera haYe tAdera kAche AsA paryanta tArA yadi dhairya dharata, tAhale seTAi tAdera janya maGgalajanaka hata| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAnadAragaNa! yadi kona phAseka (pApAcArI) tomAdera kAche kona saMvAda niYe Ase tave tomarA tA yAcAi kare dekhave| tA nA hale tomarA ajJatAvazata mAnuSera kSati kare vasave evaM pare nijedera kRtakarmera janya anutApa karave|

jene rAkhave, tomAdera madhye AllAhara rasUla Achena| tini yadi aneka viSaYe tomAdera kathA mene nena tAhale tomarAi kaSTa pAve| kintu AllAha ImAnake tomAdera pachandanIYa karechena, tAke tomAdera antare zobhanIYa karechena evaM kuphari, pApAcAra o avAdhyatAke tomAdera apachandanIYa karechena| orAi hedAYetaprApta|
eTA AllAhara kRpA o anugraha| AllAha mahAjJAnI, asIma prajJAvAna|

yadi muminadera duTi dala mArAmAri kare tAhale tomarA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dio| ataHpara yadi tAdera ekadala anyadalera opara vAr3AvAr3i kare tAhale ye dala vAr3AvAr3i karave tomarA tAra viruddhe lar3ave, yatakSaNa nA tArA AllAhara nirdezera dike phire Ase (AllAhara nirdeza mene neYa)| yadi phire Ase tAhale tomarA ubhaYera madhye nyAYera sAthe mImAMsA kare deve evaM suvicAra karave| AllAha to suvicArakArI-derakei bhAlavAsena|
muminarA vastuta bhAibhAi| ataeva, tomarA tomAdera bhAidera madhye mImAMsA kare dio| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAte tomarA (tA~ra) anugraha lAbha karate pAra|

he ImAnadAragaNa! (tomAdera) ekadala yena Arekadalake upahAsa nA kare| haYato orAi edera ceYe (arthAt yAderake upahAsa karA haYa tArA upahAsakArIdera ceYe) bhAla| nArIrAo yena nArIderake upahAsa nA kare| haYato orAi edera ceYe bhAla| tomarA nijederake (eke aparake) doSAropa karo nA evaM parasparake khArApa upAdhite Deko nA| ImAnera para apanAma (pradAna) var3a khArApa! yArA (ehena kAja theke) taovA kare nA tArAi jAlema|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA aneka anumAna theke dUre theko| nizcaYai kona kona anumAna pApa| Ara guptacaravRtti karo nA (anyera gopanIYa viSaYa sandhAna karo nA)| tomAdera keu yena kAro asAkSAte nindA nA kare| tomAdera madhye keu ki tAra mRta bhAiYera mAMsa khAoYA pachanda karave? tomarA to tA apachandai kara| AllAhake bhaYa karave| nizcaYai AllAha taovA kavulakArI, parama daYAlu|

he mAnuSa! Ami tomAderake ekajana puruSa o ekajana nArI theke sRSTi karechi evaM tomAderake vibhinna jAti o gotre pariNata karechi, yAte tomarA paraspara paricita hao| tomAdera madhye ye savaceYe vezi tAkaoYAra adhikArI, se-i tomAdera savAra ceYe AllAhara kAche vezi maryAdAsampanna| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, sarvajJa|

veduInarA vale, “AmarA ImAna enechi|” vale dAo, “tomarA ImAna Anani, (tAi ImAna enechi nA vale) varaM vala, “AmarA AtmasamarpaNa karechi|” ImAna tomAdera antare ekhano praveza kareni| tomarA yadi AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya karo tAhale tini tomAdera karmera kichui kamAvena nA (puropuri phala devena)| nizcaYai AllAha parama kSamAzIla, asIma daYAlu|”
Asale mumina tArAi yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake vizvAsa kare, ataHpara (e vyApAre kona) sandeha poSaNa kare nA evaM nijedera sampada o jIvana diYe AllAhara pathe jehAda kare| tArAi hala satyavAdI|
vala, “tomarA ki tomAdera dvIna samparke AllAhake avahita karacha? athaca AsamAne yA Ache evaM jamine yA Ache AllAha tA jAnena| AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve avagata Achena|”

nijedera isalAma grahaNa karAke tArA tomAra prati anugraha mane kare| vala, “tomAdera isalAmake tomarA AmAra prati anugraha mane karo nA| varaM tomAderake ImAnera patha dekhiYe AllAhai tomAdera prati anugraha karechena; yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao (tAhale e satyaTA svIkAra karo)|”
nizcaYai AllAha AsamAna o jaminera adRzya viSaYa jAnena| Ara tomarA yA karo AllAha tA dekhena|
kvApha [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| gauravamaYa koraAnera zapatha!
varaM tAdera madhya thekei tAdera kAche ekajana satarkakArI AsAYa tArA vismaYa vodha kare| kApherarA vale, “e to eka Azcaryera viSaYa!
AmarA marAra para mATi haYe geleo ki (AmAderake uThAno have)? se to eka dUrera (sukaThina) pratyAvartana|”
mATi tAdera (mRtadehera) kataTuku kSaYa karave tA AmAra jAnA Ache| tA chAr3A, AmAra kAche eka saMrakSita kitAva (lAohe mAh‌phUya) to Achei|
varaM satya yakhana tAdera kAche ela, takhana tArA tAke asvIkAra karala| sutarAM tArA eka jaTila saMzaYera madhyei par3e Ache|
tArA ki tAdera (mAthAra) opare AsamAnera dike tAkiYe dekheni, Ami tA kIbhAve nirmANa karechi evaM kata sundara kare sAjiYe rekhechi? tAte kona phATalao nei|
jaminake Ami vistRta karechi evaM tAte sudRr3ha pAhAr3a-parvata sthApana karechi o savarakama manorama gAchapAlA utpanna karechi,
pratyeka nivedita vAndAra janya zikSA o upadezasvarUpa|
Ami AsamAna theke varakatamaYa pAni (vRSTi) varSaNa kari evaM tAra sAhAyye utpanna kari vAga-vAgicA o keTe AnAra (rakamAri) zasya;
Ara suucca khejuragAcha, yAte Ache stare stare sAjAno zISa (athavA sArisAri thokA)
vAndAdera jIvikAsvarUpa| adhikantu, vRSTira sAhAyye Ami mRta bhUkhaNDake jIvita kari| ebhAvei punarutthAna have|
edera pUrveo (satyake) avizvAsa karechila nUhera samapradAYa, rAs‌ (uttara Aravera iYAmAmAYa avasthita chAmUda jAtira kona eka gotrera vasavAsera elAkA)-era vAsindArA, chAmUda jAti,
Ada jAti, pherAuna, lUtera bhAiYerA (samapradAYa),
AikAra adhivAsIrA (AikA: zoYAiva A.-era elAkAra nAma) o tuvvA samapradAYa| tAdera pratyekei rasUladerake avizvAsa karechila| phale (tAdera janya) AmAra zAsti dhArya haYechila|
Ami ki tAhale prathama sRSTitei (prathamavAra sRSTi karei) klAnta haYe par3echi (ye AvAra sRSTi karate pArava nA)? varaM tArAi natuna sRSTira vyApAre sandehe raYeche|
Ami mAnuSa sRSTi karechi evaM tAra mana tAke ye kumantraNA deYa tA Ami jAni| ghAr3era zirAra ceYeo Ami tAra kAche raYechi|
smaraNa karo, dui grahaNakArI (pherezatA) (ekajana) DAne o (ekajana) vAme vase (tAra Amala) grahaNa karache|
se ye kathAi uccAraNa karuka (tA grahaNa karAra janya) tAra kAche ekajana sadAprastuta praharI raYeche|
mRtyuyantraNA satyai Asave| e viSaYaTAi tumi er3iYe yete|
ziGgAYa phu~ deoYA have| seTAi have zAstira (keYAmatera) dina|
(sedina) pratyekei ekajana cAlaka o ekajana sAkSI saGge niYe upasthita have|
tumi to Ajakera ei dinaTi samparke udAsIna chile| ekhana Ami tomAra (cokhera) AvaraNa khule diYechi| tAi tomAra dRSTi Aja tIkSNa (tumi Aja savakichu pariSkAra dekhate pAccha)|
tAra saGgI (pherezatA) valave, “AmAra kAche ye AmalanAmA Ache tA ei prastuta|”
(valA have,) “pratyeka avAdhya kApherake jAhAnnAme nikSepa karo,
ye bhAla kAje vAdhAdAnakArI, sImAlaMghanakArI o sandeha poSaNakArI|”
“ye AllAhara sAthe anya upAsya sAvyasta karechila| ataeva, tAke kaThina zAstite (jAhAnnAme) nikSepa kara|”
tAra saGgI (zaYatAna) valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! Ami tAke avAdhya vAnAini, varaM se nijei ghora vibhrAntite chila|”
AllAha valavena, “tomarA AmAra sAmane jhagar3A karo nA| Ami to Agei tomAderake bhaYa dekhiYechilAma|”
“AmAra kathAra nar3acar3a haYa nA evaM Ami vAndAdera prati kona avicAra kari nA|”
sedina Ami jAhAnnAmake valava, “tumi ki pUrNa haYecho?” se valave, “Aro Ache ki?”
jAnnAtake mottAkIdera kAche AnA have, dUre rAkhA have nA|
(valA have) tomAderake erai pratizruti deoYA haYechila| AllAhara dike pratyAvartanakArI o pratijJA rakSAkArI pratyekera janya ei pratizruti;
ye nA dekheo karuNAmaYa AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM vinIta antara niYe (tA~ra sAmane) upasthita haYa|
(tAderake valA have) zAntira sAthe tomarA ete (ei jAnnAte) praveza kara| eTAi ananta jIvana zurura dina|
tArA yA cAive ekhAne tAdera janya tAi Ache| AmAra kAche Arao vezi Ache|

Ami tAdera pUrve aneka prajanmake dhvaMsa kare diYechi| tArA edera ceYe vezi zaktizAlI chila| kintu (yakhana AmAra zAsti esechila takhana AzraYera janya) tArA deze deze ghureche| (tavu tAdera janya) palAYanera kona sthAna chila ki?
era madhye avazyai upadeza raYeche emana lokera janya, yAra (anudhAvana karAra mata) antara Ache athavA ye manoyoga sahakAre zravaNa kare|
Ami AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichu chaYa dine sRSTi karechi| (tAte) kona klAnti AmAke sparza kareni|
ataeva, tArA yA vale tAte tumi dhairya dhara evaM sUryodaYera pUrve o sUryAstera pUrve tomAra prabhura pavitratA o prazaMsA varNanA karo,
rAtera ekaTi aMzeo tA~ra pavitratA o prazaMsA varNanA karo evaM nAmAyera pareo|
Ara zona, yedina AhavAnakArI nikaTavartI sthAna theke AhavAna karave,
yedina mAnuSa satyai sei bhaYAvaha AoYAja zunate pAve, seTAi vera haoYAra dina (punarutthAna divasa)|
Amii vA~cAi, Amii mAri evaM AmAra kAchei (sakalera) pratyAvartana;
(ei pratyAvartana seidina have) yedina jamina pheTe tArA druta veriYe Asave| (sedinera) sei ekatritakaraNa AmAra janya eka sahaja kAja|
tArA yA vale Ami tA khuva bhAla kare jAni| tumi tAdera opara vala praYogakArI nao| tAi ye AmAra zAstike bhaYa kare tAke koraAnera mAdhyame upadeza dAo|
zapatha dhUli ur3Ano pravala jhaJjhAvAYura,
tArapara bhAravAhI meghamAlAra,
tArapara sahaje calamAna nauyAnasamUhera,
tArapara kAja vaNTanakArI pherezatAdera!
tomAderake ye pratizruti deoYA hacche tA avazyai satya;
Ara vicAra avazyai have|
(tArakAdera) pathaviziSTa AkAzera zapatha!
tomarA (koraAna samparke) nAnArakama kathA valacha|
ye satyavimukha se tA (koraAna) theke mukha phiriYe neYa|
mithyukerA maruka (dhvaMsa/abhizapta hoka),
yArA ajJa o (parakAla samvandhe) udAsIna|
tArA jijJAsA kare, “vicArera dina kave?”
yedina tAderake Agune (pur3iYe) zAsti deoYA have (sedinai vicArera dina)|
(mithyukaderake valA have) tomarA tomAdera zAsti AsvAdana kara| e to sei zAsti yA tomarA tAr3AtAr3i pete cAite|
nizcaYai mottAkIrA thAkave jAnnAte o (jAnnAtera) jharNAsamUhe;
tAdera prabhu tAderake yA diYechena tA grahaNarata avasthAYa| nizcaYai tArA tAra Age (duniYAYa) satkarmaparAYaNa chila|
tArA rAtera kama samaYai ghumAta|
zeSa rAte tArA kSamA prArthanA karata|
tAdera sampade dAnaprArthI o vaJcitadera prApya thAkata|
dRr3ha vizvAsIdera janya jamine (aneka) nidarzana Ache|
tomAdera nijedera madhyeo| tavuo tomarA ki (bheve) dekhave nA?
Ara AsamAne (AllAhara kAche) raYeche tomAdera jIvikA o tomAdera janya pratizruta savakichu|
tAi AsamAna o jaminera prabhura zapatha! esava kathA tomAdera kathAvArtAra matai nizcita satya|
tomAra kAche ki ivarAhImera sammAnita (pherezatA) mehamAnadera vRttAnta eseche?
yakhana tArA tAra kAche upasthita haYe valechila, “sAlAma”| javAve se-o valechila, “sAlAma, tomarA dekhachi acenA mAnuSa|”
tArapara ivarAhIma tAra parivArera kAche gela evaM ekaTi (rAnnAkarA) mAMsala vAchura niYe ela|
tArapara seTi mehamAnadera kAche rAkhala Ara valala, “tomarA khAve nA?”
ataHpara (mehamAnarA khAcche nA dekhe) se tAdera samparke bhaYa anubhava karala| tArA valala, “bhaYa karo nA|” erapara tArA tAke eka vijJa putrasantAnera susaMvAda dila|
takhana tAra strI citkAra diYe egiYe ela evaM nijera mukhamaNDala cApar3iYe valala, “vRddhA, vandhyA|” (arthAt Ami to vRddhA o vandhyA| AmAra santAna have ki kare?)
tArA (Agantuka pherezatArA) valala, “tavu emanai tomAra prabhu valechena| nizcaYai tini asIma prajJAvAna, mahAjJAnI|”
se (ivarAhIma) valala, “he dUtagaNa! tomAdera Asala uddezyaTA ki?
tArA valala, “AmAderake eka aparAdhI samapradAYera kAche pAThAno haYeche|”
“ejanya ye, AmarA tAdera opara zakta mATira DhilA nikSepa karava,”
yA tomAra prabhura kAche sImAlaMghanakArIdera janya cihnita Ache|
ataHpara sekhAne ye ImAnadArarA chila tAderake Ami vera kari|
tave sekhAne musalamAnadera ekaTimAtra ghara (lUtera parivAra) chAr3A Ara kAuke pAini|
yArA kaThina AjAvake bhaYa kare, Ami tAdera janya sekhAne ekaTi nidarzana rekhe diYechi|
mUsAra ghaTanAYao (nidarzana Ache); yakhana tAke spaSTa pramANasaha pherAunera kAche pAThiYechilAma|
kintu se tAra zaktira jore mukha phiriYe nila Ara (mUsAra kathA) valala, “(haYa se) yAdukara, nA haYa pAgala|”
ataHpara Ami tAke o tAra vAhinIke pAkar3Ao kari evaM samudre nikSepa kari| se chila eka tiraskArakArI (aparAdhI)|
(nidarzana Ache) Ada jAtira ghaTanAYao; yakhana tAdera viruddhe pracaNDa vAtAsa pAThiYechilAma|
yA kichura opara diYei tA vaYe giYeche tAkei curamAra kare diYeche|
chAmUda jAtira ghaTanAYao (nidarzana Ache); yakhana tAderake valA haYechila, “kichukAlera janya bhoga kare nAo”|
ataHpara tArA tAdera prabhura Adeza amAnya kare; yAra phale tArA vajrAghAtera kavale par3e, Ara tArA tA dekhachila|
tArA uThe dA~r3Ate pAreni evaM nijederake kona sAhAyyao karate pAreni|
era Age nUhera samapradAYake (dhvaMsa karechi)| nizcaYai tArA eka avAdhya samapradAYa chila|
(vizAla) AsamAnake Ami hAta (kSamatA) dvArA tairI karechi| nizcaYai Ami (era vizAlatAke) vistRta karate sakSama|
Ara jaminake Amii vichiYe diYechi| Ami kata sundara vichAte pAri!
savakichui Ami jor3AYa jor3AYa sRSTi karechi, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|
(vala,) “ataeva, tomarA AllAhara dike dhAvita hao| Ami tomAdera janya tA~ra pakSa theke eka spaSTa satarkakArI|
Ara AllAhara sAthe anya kona upAsya sAvyasta karo nA| Ami tomAdera janya tA~ra pakSa theke eka spaSTa satarkakArI|”
ekaibhAve tAdera pUrvavartIdera kAcheo ye rasUlai eseche tArA (tAke) valeche, “e eka yAdukara, nA haYa eka pAgala|”
tArA ki paramparAgatabhAve ei asiYatai kare geche? Asale orA eka avAdhya janagoSThI|
tAi tumi odera kathA Amale nio nA| (tumi to AllAhara vANI Thikamato pau~che diYecho; tAi) tomAra kona doSa nei|
tave upadeza dio; kAraNa upadeza muminadera upakAre Ase|
jvina o mAnuSake Ami AmAra ivAdata karAra janyai sRSTi karechi|
tAdera kAcha theke Ami kona jIvikA cAi nA evaM eTAo cAi nA ye, tArA AmAke khAoYAve|
AllAhai to jIvikA dAnakArI, kSamatAzAlI, mahAzaktimAna|
ataeva, (ei) jAlemadera janya tAdera (atIta) samamanAdera aMzera anurUpa (zAstira) aMza (nirdhArita) raYeche| tArA yena (tA) AmAra kAche tAr3AtAr3i nA cAYa|
kApheraderake ye dinera pratizruti deoYA hacche tAdera janya sei dinera durbhoga raYeche|
zapatha tUra parvatera,
zapatha emana eka kitAvera yA lipivaddha Ache
char3Ano kAgajera pAtAYa,
zapatha vAitula mAjJamUrera (AvAda vA janavahula gharera),
zapatha u~cu chAdera (arthAt AsamAnera)
evaM zapatha uttAla samudrera!
tomAra prabhura zAsti Asavei|
keu tA pratirodha karate pArave nA|
(zAsti yedina Asave) sedina AsamAna pravalabhAve Andolita have
evaM pAhAr3a-parvata druta calate zuru karave|
ataeva, sedina durbhoga raYeche avizvAsIdera janya,
yArA khelAra chale vAje kathA valAvali kare|
yedina tAderake dhAkkA dite dite jAhAnnAmera Agunera dike niYe yAoYA have,
(sedina valA have) “eTAi sei Aguna yAke tomarA mithyA valate|”
“eTA ki yAdu? nA ki tomarA (kichu) dekhate pAccha nA?
era bhitare praveza kara| tomarA sahya karate pAra vA nA pAra, (ubhaYai) tomAdera janya samAna| tomarA (duniYAYa) yA karate tomAderake kevala tArai pratiphala deoYA hacche|”
mottAkIrA jAnnAte o ArAmera madhye thAkave|
tAdera prabhu tAderake yA devena, tArA tA upabhoga karave| tini tAderake jAhAnnAmera AjAva theke rakSA karavena|
(tAderake valA have,) “tomarA (duniYAYa) yA karate tAra pratidAnasvarUpa tRpta haYe pAnAhAra kara|”
tArA sArivaddha Asane helAna diYe vasave| Ami tAderake DAgara DAgara cokhaviziSTa hUradera sAthe svAmI-strIra samparka kare deva|

yArA ImAna Ane evaM tAdera santAnerA ImAnera sAthe tAdera anusaraNa kare, tAdera sAthe Ami tAdera santAnadera milana ghaTAva evaM tAdera Amala ekaTuo hrAsa karava nA| pratyeka vyaktii nijera kRtakarmera sAthe dAYavaddha|
Ami tAderake tAdera AkAMkSA anusAre phalamUla o mAMsera yogAna deva|
sekhAne tArA eke aparera madhye zarAvera peYAlA AdAnapradAna karave, yAte kona asAra kathA kiMvA pApa nei (yA pAna karale mAtalAmi kiMvA kona pApera kAja karAra sambhAvanA nei)|
Ara surakSita muktAra mata (sudarzana) tAdera kizora sevakerA tAdera kAche ghorAghuri karave|
tArA eke aparera kAche ese (vibhinna viSaYa) jAnate cAive|
tArA valave, “AmarA to Age (duniYAra jIvane) AmAdera parivAra-parijanera mAjhe (AllAhara zAsti samparke) zaGkita chilAma|”
ataHpara AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karechena evaM AmAderake Agunera zAsti theke rakSA karechena|
AmarA Ageo AllAhake DAkatAma| nizcaYai tini parama dAnazIla, karuNAmaYa|
ataeva, tumi (lokaderake) upadeza dAo| tomAra prabhura anugrahe tumi (tAdera kathA anuyAYI) gaNakao nao, pAgalao nao|
nAki tArA vale, “se ekajana kavi, AmarA yAra vipadera pratIkSAYa Achi?”
vala, “tomarA pratIkSA karo, Amio tomAdera sAthe pratIkSA karachi|”
nAki tAdera vuddhi tAderake emanaTi valate vale? nAki tArA eka svecchAcArI janagoSThI?
nAki tArA vale, “se eTA (ei koraAna) nije racanA kareche?” Asale tArA (satyake) vizvAsa kare nA|
tArA tAhale era anurUpa ekaTi vANI racanA karuka, yadi tArA satyavAdI haYa|
nAki kona kichu chAr3A (kona sraSTA chAr3A) tAdera sRSTi haYeche? nAki tArAi sraSTA?
nAki tArA AsamAna o jamina sRSTi kareche? Asale tArA (satyake) dRr3habhAve vizvAsa kare nA|
nAki tAdera kAche tomAra prabhura bhANDAra raYeche? nAki tArAi sarvamaYa kSamatAra adhikArI?
nAki tAdera (AsamAne ArohaNera) kona si~r3i Ache, yAra mAdhyame tArA (pherezatAdera kathAvArtA) zone? temanaTi hale tAdera zravaNakArI kona suspaSTa pramANa upasthita karuka|
nAki tA~ra (AllAhara) janya meYe Ara tomAdera janya chele?
nAki tAdera kAche tumi majuri cAo, ye tAdera opara kona RNera vojhA Ache?
nAki tArA gAYeva jAne, ye tArA (tA) likhe rAkhe?
nAki tArA (tomAra viruddhe) kona Sar3ayantra karate cAYa? tave yArA kuphari kare tArA nijerAi nijedera Sar3ayantrera zikAra have|
nAki AllAha chAr3A tAdera kona upAsya Ache? tArA (tA~ra sAthe) yA kichu zarIka kare AllAha tA theke pavitra|
tArA yadi AkAzera kona khaNDa bheGge par3ate dekhata tAhale valata, “e to puJjIbhUta megha|”
ataeva, tAderake cher3e dAo (yA khuzi karate dAo), tAdera sei dina paryanta yedina tArA mUrchita haYe par3ave|
yedina tAdera Sar3ayantra tAdera kona kAje Asave nA evaM tArA sAhAyyao pAve nA|
jAlemadera janya echAr3Ao Aro zAsti Ache; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAne nA|
tumi tomAra prabhura nirdezera janya dhairya dhara; tumi to AmAra cokhera sAmanei (najarei) Acha| yakhana ghuma theke uThave takhana tomAra prabhura pavitratA ghoSaNA o prazaMsA karave;
tAchAr3A, rAtrikAle o tArakAdera asta yAoYAra samaYao tA~ra pavitratA ghoSaNA karave|
tArakAra zapatha, yakhana tA par3e yAYa (athavA astamita haYa)!
tomAdera saGgI (muhAmmAda) pathabhraSTa kiMvA vibhrAnta haYani|
se pravRttira tAr3anAYa (managar3A) kathAo vale nA|
ei koraAna ohIra mAdhyame (tAra kAche) pAThAno eka vArtA vai naYa|
tAke (eTA) zikSA diYeche pravala zaktimAna,
dhIzaktisampanna sattA (jivarAIla)| se nija AkRtite dekhA diYechila|
takhana se sarvocca digante|
tArapara se (tAra) nikaTavartI hala evaM (tAra dike) jhule par3ala (tAra ekevAre kAche cale ela)|
tAdera madhye (mAtra) dui dhanuka parimANa kiMvA tAra ceYeo kama dUratva chila|
takhana AllAha tA~ra vAndAra prati ye ohI pAThAvAra chila (jivarAIlera mAdhyame) tA pAThAlena|
(takhana) se yA dekhechila (tAra) antara tAke mithyA valeni|
tAhale (merAje) se yA dekhave se vyApAre tomarA ki tAra sAthe vitarka karave?
se to tAke (jivarAIlake) Aro ekavAra dekheche,
zeSa prAntera kulagAchera kAche|
tAra kAche raYeche (mottAkIdera) vasavAsera jAnnAta|
yakhana kulagAchaTi yA diYe AcchAdita thAkAra, AcchAdita chila|
(tAra) dRSTi anyadike yAYani evaM sImAo chAr3AYani|
se tAra prabhura var3a var3a nidarzana dekheche|
ataeva, tomarA ki lAta o uy‌yA (pauttalika Aravadera duTi devatAra nAma) samparke bheve dekhecho?
evaM tRtIYa ArekaTi (devatA): mAnAta samparke?
tomAdera janya ki putrasantAna Ara AllAhara janya kanyAsantAna?
eTA to tAhale ekaTA anyAyya bhAga!

egulo (lAta, mAnAta, uy‌yA) to emana katagulo nAma, yA tomarA o tomAdera vApa-dAdArAi rekhecho| AllAha to egulora samarthane kona pramANa pAThAnani| tArA to kevala anumAna Ara (tAdera) mana yA cAYa tArai anusaraNa kare; athaca tAdera kAche tAdera prabhura kAcha theke (saThika) pathanirdeza eseche|
mAnuSa yA AzA kare tA ki se pAve?
varaM zeSa o prathama (AkherAta o duniYA) AllAharai hAte|
AsamAne aneka pherezatA Ache, yAdera supAriza kona kAje Asave nA; tave AllAha yAra janya cAna evaM yAra opara tini santuSTa, tAra pakSe tini supAriza karAra anumati deoYAra parai (tA kAje Asave)|
yArA parakAle vizvAsa kare nA tArAi nArIdera nAme pherezatAdera nAma diYe thAke|
athaca tAdera kAche era kona jJAna nei| tArA kevala anumAnera pechane choTe| Ara anumAna diYe satyera kona kAja haYa nA|
ataeva, yArA AmAra smaraNa (koraAna) theke mukha phiriYe neYa evaM pArthiva jIvana chAr3A kichui cAYa nA, tAderake parihAra kare cala|
tAdera jJAnera daur3a ai paryantai| tomAra prabhui bhAla jAnena, ke tA~ra patha hAriYe pheleche; evaM tinii bhAla jAnena, ke saThika pathera sandhAna peYeche|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache tA AllAharai| tini cAna, yArA khArApa kAja kare tAderake tAdera karmaphala (zAsti) devena evaM yArA bhAla kAja kare tAderake uttama pratidAna (puraskAra) devena|

yArA choTakhATa aparAdha kare phelaleo var3a var3a pApa o yAvatIYa kukarma theke dUre thAke, (tAdera kSetre) tomAra prabhu vyApaka kSamAra adhikArI| tini tomAdera samparke bhAla jAnena, yakhana tomAderake (tomAdera Adi pitA Adamake) mATi theke sRSTi karechena evaM yakhana tomarA mAYera peTe bhrUNa chile| ataeva, tomarA nijedera sAphAi geYo nA| tini bhAla jAnena, ke tAkaoYA avalamvanakArI|
tumi ki sei vyaktike dekhecho, ye mukha phiriYe niYeche
evaM alpa dAna kareche o (pare dAna) vandha kare diYeche?
tAra ki adRzyera jJAna Ache ye, se (sava) dekhate pAYa?
nAki tAke se sava jAnAno haYani, yA Ache mUsAra kitAve
o ivarAhImera kitAve, ye puropuribhAve dAYitva pAlana karechila?
tA ei ye, ekajana Arekajanera (pApera) vojhA vahana karave nA;
mAnuSa yA (kAja) kare tA chAr3A tAra kichui thAke nA;
tAke tAra kAja dekhAno have;
ataHpara tAke (tAra kAjera) pUrNa pratidAna deoYA have;
tomAra prabhura kAchei (savakichura) samApti;
tinii hAsAna, tinii kA~dAna;
tinii mArena, tinii vA~cAna;
tinii nArI-puruSa jor3A sRSTi karena
vIrya theke, yakhana tA nirgata karA haYa;
punarutthAnera dAYitva tA~rai;
tinii abhAvamukta o sampadazAlI karena;
tinii luvdhakera (ekaTi nakSatrera nAma) prabhu;
tinii prathama (prAcIna) Ada jAtike dhvaMsa karechena;
chAmUda jAtikeo, tini (tAdera kAuke) avaziSTa rAkhenani;
tArao Age nUhera samapradAYakeo (dhvaMsa karechena), tArA chila adhikatara jAlema o avAdhya;
evaM ulTAno janapadake tinii nice phele diYechilena (lUtera samapradAYake dhvaMsa karAra janya tinii tAdera AvAsabhUmike opare tule ulTiYe nice phele diYechilena);
ataHpara tAke Acchanna karechila yA Acchanna karechila (arthAt bhaYAnaka zAsti)|
ataeva, tomAra prabhura kon‌ anugraha samparke tumi sandeha poSaNa karave?
ei navIo atItera satarkakArIdera matai ekajana satarkakArI|
keYAmata nikaTavartI haYeche|
(tave) AllAha vyatIta keu tA (saMghaTita havAra samaYa) prakAza karate pAre nA|
tomarA ki ei vANI (koraAna) zune vismaYa vodha karacha?
tomarA hAsi-ThATTA karacha, kA~dacha nA|
tomarA ahaMkArI (athavA krIr3A-kautuke lipta)|
ataeva, AllAhake sejadA karo evaM (tA~ra) evAdata kara|sejadA
keYAmata nikaTavartI haYeche evaM canadra vidIrNa haYeche|
tArA (avizvAsIrA) yadi kona nidarzana dekhe tAhale mukha phiriYe neYa Ara vale, “e to eka cirAcarita yAdu|”
tArA (satyake) avizvAsa kareche o nijedera pravRttira anusaraNa kareche| pratiTi viSaYai sthira pariNatira janya nirdhArita|
tAdera kAche emana saMvAda eseche yAte satarkavANI Ache|
e (koraAna) eka pUrNAGga jJAna, tave satarkakArIrA tAdera konai upakAre Ase nA|
ataeva, tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo| yedina AhavAnakArI tAderake eka apachandanIYa (bhaYaGkara) jinisera dike AhavAna karave,
sedina tArA dRSTi nicu kare vikSipta paGgapAlera nyAYa kavara theke veriYe Asave,
AhavAnakArIra dike daur3Ate daur3Ate| kApherarA valave, “e eka kaThina dina|”
tAdera pUrve nUhera samapradAYao avizvAsa karechila| tArA AmAra vAndA nUhake avizvAsa karechila Ara valechila, “e eka pAgala”| tAke humakio deoYA haYechila|
se tAra prabhuke Deke valala, “Ami to parAsta; tAi AmAke sAhAyya kara|”
takhana Ami muSaladhAre varSita vRSTira pAni dvArA (pAni varSaNera janya) AsamAnera darajA-samUha khule dilAma
evaM jamina phATiYe jharanA vera karalAma| ataHpara pUrvanirdhArita eka vizeSa lakSye (AsamAna o jaminera) pAni milita hala|

tinii tA~ra vAndAra prati spaSTa AYAta nAyila karena; e janya ye, tini tomAderake andhakAra theke Alote vera kare Anate cAna| nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera prati atyanta snehaparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|

tomAdera kI haYeche ye, AllAhara pathe vyaYa karo nA!
