AsamAna o jaminera uttarAdhikAra to AllAharai| tomAdera madhye yArA (makkA) vijaYera pUrve vyaYa kareche o yuddha kareche tArA (anyadera) samAna naYa| maryAdAYa erA tAdera ceYe var3a, yArA (tAra) pare vyaYa kareche o yuddha kareche| tave AllAha (edera) pratyekake kalyANera pratizruti diYechena| Ara tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|
emana ke Ache, ye AllAhake ekaTA bhAla RNa dite pAre? tAra janya tini tA vahuguNa vAr3iYe devena| uparantu, tAra janya raYeche eka sammAnajanaka puraskAra (jAnnAta)|

sedina tumi ImAnadAra puruSa o ImAnadAra nArIderake dekhave, tAdera sAmane o DAne tAdera Alo chuTache| (tAderake valA have) “Aja tomAdera janya jAnnAtera susaMvAda, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tomarA cirakAla thAkave| eTA eka mahAsAphalya|”

sedina monApheka puruSa o monApheka nArIrA muminaderake valave, “AmAdera janya ekaTu apekSA karo, AmarA tomAdera Alo theke kichu (Alo) saMgraha karava|” (tAderake) valA have, “tomarA tomAdera pechane phire yAo evaM Alora kho~ja kara|” ataHpara tAdera (ubhaYa dalera) mAjhe ekaTi prAcIra sthApana karA have, yAra ekaTi darajA thAkave| tAra bhitarera dike thAkave rahamata evaM vAirera dike AjAva|

tArA muminaderake Deke valave, “AmarA ki tomAdera sAthe chilAma nA?” muminarA valave, “hyA~ (chile), kintu tomarA nijerAi nijederake vipadagrasta karecho| tomarA (AmAdera amaGgalera) pratIkSA karecho o sandeha poSaNa karecho| Ara (miche) AzA tomAderake dho~kA diYeche| avazeSe AllAhara Adeza ese giYeche| (Asale) mahApratAraka (zaYatAna) tomAderake AllAha samparke pratArita kareche|”

ataeva, Aja tomAdera kAcha theke kona muktipaNa neoYA have nA; kApheradera kAcha thekeo nA (muktipaNa niYe kAuke rehAi deoYA have nA)| tomAdera vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma| oTAi tomAdera vandhu (yogya sthAna)| oTA katai nA khArApa ThikAnA!

AllAhara smaraNa o (tA~ra kAcha theke) avatIrNa satyera kalyANe muminadera janya ki samaYa haYani ye, tAdera antara vinamra have evaM tArA tAdera mata have nA yAderake itipUrve kitAva deoYA haYechila? ataHpara vahukAla atikrAnta haoYAYa tAdera antara zakta haYe giYeche| Ara tAdera madhye anekei avAdhya|
jene rAkha, AllAha jaminake tAra mRtyura para jIvita karena| Ami tomAdera janya nidarzanasamUha varNanA karechi, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
sad‌kA dAnakArI puruSa o nArIderake evaM yArA AllAhake uttama RNa dAna kare tAderake (pratidAne) vahuguNa vezi deoYA have| uparantu, tAdera janya raYeche eka sammAnajanaka puraskAra (jAnnAta)|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladera prati ImAna Ane tArAi tAdera prabhura kAche siddIka (khA~Ti ImAnadAra) o zahIda (dvIna pratiSThAra saMgrAme prANa dAnakArI) vale vivecita| tAdera janya raYeche tAdera puraskAra o tAdera Alo| Ara yArA kuphari kare o AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA vale tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI (have)|

tomarA jene rAkha, pArthiva jIvana to kevala khelA, Amoda-pramoda, sAja-sajjA, pArasparika ahamikA evaM sampada o santAna (dhanavala o janavala) vRddhira pratiyogitA chAr3A Ara kichu naYa| yemana ekaTA vRSTi, yAra (kalyANe utpanna) phasala kRSakaderake mugdha kare| tArapara tA zukiYe yAYa evaM tumi tAke halade (vivarNa) dekhate pAo| ataHpara tA khar3akuTA haYe yAYa| parakAle Ache kaThina zAsti (kApheradera janya), Ara AllAhara kSamA o santuSTi (muminadera janya)| pArthiva jIvana to pratAraNAmUlaka bhoga vyatIta kichu naYa|

tomarA tomAdera prabhura kSamA o sei jAnnAtera dike dhAvita haoYAra pratiyogitA karo yA AsamAna o jaminera nyAYa prazasta evaM tairI karA haYeche tAdera janya yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUladera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare| eTA AllAhara kRpA| tini yAke icchA tA dAna karena| AllAha mahAna kRpAra adhikArI|
pRthivIte kiMvA tomAdera nijedera madhye ye vipada Ase, Ami pRthivI sRSTi karAra Agei tA likhita Ache| nizcaYai eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|
(AllAha eTA ejanya valachena) yAte tomarA yA hArAo tAra janya duHkha nA karo evaM tini tomAderake yA dAna karena tA niYe ullasita nA hao| AllAha to dAmbhika ahaMkArIderake pachanda karena nA|

yArA (nijerA) kArpaNya kare evaM lokaderakeo kArpaNya karate vale (AllAha tAdera dAnera mukhApekSI nana)| Ara (dvInera patha theke) ye mukha phiriYe neYa, (tAra jAnA ucita) AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsita|

Ami spaSTa nidarzanasaha AmAra rasUladerake pAThiYechi evaM tAdera sAthe kitAva o (nyAYera) mAnadaNDa diYechi, yAte mAnuSa nyAYavicAra pratiSThA kare| Ami lohAo diYechi, yAra madhye (yuddhera janya sahAYaka) pracaNDa zakti o mAnuSera aneka kalyANa Ache; ejanya ye, AllAha jAnate (yAcAi karate) cAna, ke nA dekheo tA~ke o tA~ra rasUladerake sAhAyya kare| nizcaYai AllAha zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|
Ami nUha o ivarAhImake rasUla kare pAThiYechilAma evaM tAdera vaMzadharadera madhye navuoYAta o kitAva diYechilAma| tAdera madhye keu keu chila satpathaprApta| AvAra tAdera anekei chila avAdhya|

ataHpara tAdera pare AmAra rasUladerake tAdera anugAmI karechi| anugAmI karechi mariYamaputra IsAkeo evaM tAke in‌jIla diYechi| yArA tAra anusaraNa kareche tAdera antare diYechi sahAnubhUti o daYA| Ara vairAgya to tArAi udbhAvana kareche| Ami eTA tAdera opara dhArya karini, varaM AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera janya (tArA nijerAi eTA udbhAvana kareche)| kintu eTAo tArA saThikabhAve pAlana kareni| tAdera madhye yArA ImAna enechila Ami tAderake tAdera (nyAyya) puraskAra diYechi| tave tAdera madhye anekei chila avAdhya|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo evaM tA~ra rasUlake vizvAsa kara| tAhale svIYa anugrahe tini tomAderake dviguNa (pratidAna) devena evaM tomAderake emana eka Alo dAna karavena yAra sAhAyye tomarA patha calate pArave| Ara tini tomAderake kSamA kare devena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yAte kitAvadhArIrA (ihudi o khriSTAnarA) jAnate pAre ye, AllAhara alpa anugrahera oparao tAdera kona adhikAra nei evaM anugraha (savai) AllAhara hAte; tini yAke icchA tA dAna karena| AllAha virATa anugrahera mAlika|

ye mahilA (khAolAha vinate chAjJalAvAha) tAra svAmI (Aosa ivane chAmita) samvandhe tomAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda karache evaM AllAhara kAche abhiyoga peza karache, AllAha tAra kathA zunechena| AllAha tomAdera dujanera kathAvArtAi zunachena| nizcaYai AllAha savakichu zonena, savakichu dekhena|

tomAdera madhye yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe yihAra kare (strIra sAthe samparka chinna karAra janya tAke vale, "tumi AmAra janya AmAra mAYera piThera mata niSiddha") tAdera ei strIrA tAdera mA naYa; tAdera mA to tArAi yArA tAderake janmadAna kareche| vastuta tArA eka jaghanya kathA Ara mithyA vale thAke| tave AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|

yArA tAdera strIdera sAthe yihAra kare evaM pare tAdera kathA theke phire Ase (arthAt strIra sAthe samparka chinna karAra siddhAnta theke sare Ase) tAderake strIra saMsparze AsAra Age (kAph‌phArAsvarUpa) ekaTi dAsa mukta karate have| tomAderake ei upadezai deoYA hacche| tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

yAra se sAmarthya nei se strIra saMsparze AsAra Age ekAdhAre dui mAsa royA rAkhave| ye tAo pArave nA se SATajana misakIna khAoYAve| tomarA yAte AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati khA~Ti vizvAsa sthApana karo sejanya ei vidhAna| egulo AllAhara nirdhArita vidhAna| Ara kApheradera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare tAderake lAJchita karA have, yemana lAJchita karA haYeche tAdera pUrvavartIderake| Ami to suspaSTa AYAta nAyila karechi| Ara kApheradera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|
(smaraNa karo) yedina AllAha tAdera sakalake punarAYa uThAvena evaM tArA yA karata tAderake tA jAniYe devena| AllAha tAra hisAva rekhechena, yadio tArA tA bhule giYeche| AllAha sava kichurai sAkSI|

tumi ki (bheve) dekhani ye, AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache AllAha tA jAnena? ye kona tinajanera gopana kathA hale tini thAkena tAdera caturtha jana evaM pA~cajanera hale tini thAkena tAdera SaSThajana| AvAra era ceYe kama kiMvA vezi janera haleo tArA yekhAnei thAkuka, tini tAdera saGgei thAkena| ataHpara keYAmatera dina tini tAderake tAdera kRtakarma jAniYe devena| AllAha savakichui avagata Achena|

tumi ki tAdera kathA bheve dekhani, yAderake gopana parAmarza karate niSedha karA haYechila? ataHpara tAderake yA niSedha karA haYechila tArA AvAra tAi karache evaM pApa, vairitA o rasUlera viruddhAcaraNera janya gopana parAmarza karache| Ara tArA yakhana tomAra kAche Ase takhana emana kathA dvArA tomAke abhivAdana jAnAYa yA dvArA AllAha tomAke abhivAdana jAnAnani; Ara mane mane vale, “AmarA yA vali tAra janya AllAha AmAderake zAsti dena nA kena?” jAhAnnAmai tAdera (zAstira) janya yatheSTa| tArA tAte praveza karave| kata khArApa sei gantavya!

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yakhana gopane kathA vala takhana pApa, vairitA o rasUlera viruddhAcaraNera janya tA karave nA; varaM satkAja o tAkaoYAra viSaYe kathA valave| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karave, yA~ra kAche tomAderake ekatrita karA have|

(kApheradera) ei gopana parAmarza to zaYatAnera pakSa theke; muminaderake duHkha deoYAra janya; tave AllAhara anumati chAr3A se tAdera kona kSati karate pArave nA| ataeva, muminarA yena AllAhara opara bharasA kare|

he ImAnadAragaNa! yakhana tomAderake valA haYa, “majalise (anyadera janya) jAYagA kare dAo” takhana tomarA jAYagA kare deve; tAhale AllAha tomAdera janya jAYagA kare devena| Ara yakhana valA haYa, “uThe yAo” takhana uThe yAve; tAhale tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche o yAderake jJAna deoYA haYeche, AllAha tAdera maryAdA u~cu kare devena| Ara tomarA yA karo, AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yakhana rasUlera sAthe ekAnte kathA valate cAive takhana tomAdera ekAnta kathAra pUrve kichu sadakA deve| eTA tomAdera janya bhAla o pavitratara| tave yadi (sadakA karAra mata kichu) nA pAo tAhale (kSati nei, kAraNa) AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA ki (rasUlera sAthe) ekAnta kathAra pUrve sadakA dite bhaYa pAccha? Thika Ache, yadi emana haYa ye, tomarA sadakA dite pArale nA, Ara AllAha tomAderake mApha kare dilena, takhana nAmAya kAYema karo, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera Anugatya kara| tomarA yA karo, AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

tumi ki tAdera (monAphekadera) dike tAkiYe dekhani, yArA emana ekadala lokera sAthe (ihudidera sAthe) vandhutva kare, yAdera opara AllAhara krodha Ache? tArA tomAdera (musalamAnadera) lokao naYa, AvAra tAdera (ihudidera) lokao naYa| tArA jene vujhe mithyA viSaYe zapatha kare|
AllAha tAdera janya kaThina zAsti tairI kare rekhechena| tArA yA kare tA kata khArApa!
tArA nijedera zapathasamUhake DhAla vAniYeche evaM AllAhara pathe calate (mAnuSake) vAdhA diYeche; tAi tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAkara zAsti|
tAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati AllAhara zAsti theke rakSA pete moTeo kAje Asave nA| tArA jAhAnnAmerai adhivAsI (have), sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave|

(sedinera kathA smaraNa karo) yedina AllAha tAdera savAike punarAYa (kavara theke) uThAvena| takhana tArA tA~ra kAche zapatha karave, yemana (ekhana) tomAdera kAche zapatha karache| tArA mane kare ye, tArA ekaTA kichura opare Ache (bhAla kichu karache)| jene rAkha, tArAi mithyAvAdI|
zaYatAna tAderake vazIbhUta kareche evaM AllAhara smaraNa bhuliYe diYeche| orA zaYatAnera dala| jene rAkha, zaYatAnera dalai kSatigrasta|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera virodhitA kare tArA carama lAJchitadera dalabhukta|
AllAha likhe diYechena: Ami o AmAra rasUlagaNa avazyai vijaYI hava| nizcaYai AllAha zaktidhara, parAkramazAlI|

AllAha o zeSa dine (parakAle) vizvAsI kona samapradAYake tumi dekhate pAve nA ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera virodhIderake bhAlavAse; tArA tAdera vApa, chele, bhAi kiMvA jJAti haleo| AllAha tAdera antare ImAna likhe diYechena (supratiSThita karechena) evaM nijera pakSa theke eka (vizeSa) prANazakti dvArA tAderake zaktizAlI karechena| tini tAderake jAnnAte praveza karAvena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita; sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa evaM tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa| orAi AllAhara dala| jene rAkha, AllAhara dalai saphalakAma|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA varNanA kare| tini parAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|

tinii kitAvIdera (vanu nAyIra gotrera ihudidera) madhye yArA kAphera, tAderake prathamavArera mata ekatrita kare tAdera gharavAr3i theke vera kare diYechena| tomarA mane karani ye, tArA vera have| tArAo mane karechila ye, tAdera durgagulo tAderake AllAha (-ra zAsti) theke rakSA karave; kintu AllAhara zAsti tAdera opara emana eka jAYagA theke ela yA tAdera dhAraNAYa chila nA| tini tAdera antare bhIti saJcAra karalena| tArA tAdera hAte o muminadera hAte nijedera gharavAr3i dhvaMsa karachila| ataeva, he dRSTisampanna vyaktirA! tomarA zikSA grahaNa kara|
AllAha tAdera janya nirvAsana dhArya kare nA rAkhale duniYAte avazyai tAderake (anya) zAsti ditena| Ara AkherAte tAdera janya jAhAnnAmera zAsti to Achei|
era kAraNa, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera sAthe virodha kareche| Ara AllAhara sAthe ye virodha kare, AllAha to tAke kaThina zAsti devenai|
tomarA ye khejura gAchagulo keTecho Ara yegulo (nA keTe) mUlera opara dA~r3Ano avasthAYa rekhe diYecho tA to AllAharai nirdeze (haYeche); ejanya ye, tini avAdhyaderake lAJchita karavena|

AllAha tA~ra rasUlake tAdera (vanu nAyIrera ihudidera) kAcha theke ye phAYa (yuddhalavdha sampada) diYechena, se janya tomarA ghor3A kiMvA uTa choTAoni (ghor3A kiMvA uTe car3e yuddha karani)| tave AllAha yAdera opara cAna, tA~ra rasUladerake kSamatA dAna karena| AllAha savakichu karate sakSama|

AllAha tA~ra rasUlake (ihudi) janapadavAsIdera kAcha theke ye phAYa (yuddhalavdha sampada) diYechena, tA AllAha o rasUlera janya, (rasUlera) AtmIYa-svajanera janya, iYAtIma o misakInadera janya evaM pathika musAphiradera janya; yAte tA tomAdera dhanIdera madhye Avartita sampada nA haYa| rasUla tomAderake yA deYa tomarA tAi nio evaM yA nite vAraNa kare tA nio nA| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYai AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA|

(e sampada) dezatyAgI garIvadera janya (garIva mohAjeradera janya), yArA tAdera ghar3avAr3i o dhana-sampada theke vahiSkRta haYeche| tArA AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi kAmanA kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake sAhAyya kare| tArAi satyavAdI|

(tAdera janyao) yArA ei mohAjeradera Age e nagarIte (madInAYa) vasavAsa kareche o ImAna eneche (arthAt AnasAradera janyao)| tAdera kAche yArA hijarata kare eseche tArA tAderake bhAlavAse; tAderake yA deoYA haYeche tAra janya tArA antare kona cAhidA poSaNa kare nA evaM nijerA abhAvagrasta haleo nijedera opara (tAderake) agrAdhikAra deYa| Ara manera kArpaNya theke yAderake mukta rAkhA haYeche tArAi saphalakAma|

Ara (e sampada tAdera janyao) yArA tAdera pare eseche| tArA vale, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake o AmAdera ye bhAiYerA AmAdera Age ImAna eneche tAderake kSamA karo evaM AmAdera antare muminadera viruddhe kona vidveSa rekho nA| ogo prabhu! tumi to snehaparAYaNa, parama daYAlu|”

tumi ki monAphekaderake dekhani? tArA tAdera kitAvadhArI kAphera vandhuderake vale, “yadi tomAderake vera kare deoYA haYa tAhale AmarAo tomAdera sAthe vera haYe yAva evaM tomAdera vyApAre (vipakSe) AmarA kakhano kAro kathA mAnava nA| Ara yadi tomarA (yuddhe) AkrAnta hao tAhale AmarA avazyai tomAderake sAhAyya karava|” kintu AllAha sAkSya dicchena, tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|

yadi tAderake (kitAvadhArI kApheraderake) vera kare deoYA haYa tAhale tArA (ei monAphekarA) tAdera sAthe verao have nA evaM yadi tArA AkrAnta haYa tAhale tArA tAderake sAhAyyao karave nA| yadi sAhAyya karate Aseo tAhale tArA avazyai pRSThapradarzana karave (pAliYe yAve)| ataHpara tArA sAhAyyaprApta have nA|
tAdera antare AllAhara ceYe tomAdera bhaYai vezi| era kAraNa, tArA ekadala avujha loka|

tArA savAi ekatreo tomAdera viruddhe (sAmanAsAmani) yuddha karave nA| tave (tAdera) surakSita janapadera madhye athavA (durgera) deYAlera pechana theke (yuddha karate cAive)| tAdera nijedera madhyei pracaNDa yuddha haYa| tumi tAderake ekatAvaddha mane kara| Asale tAdera madhye manera mila nei| era kAraNa, tArA ekadala nirvodha loka|
erA tAdera matai, yArA (vanu korAYayAra ihudirA) edera alpa Age nijedera kRtakarmera khArApa pariNati AsvAdana (bhoga) kareche| (parakAleo) tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

(monAphekadera ihudi kApheraderake musalamAnadera viruddhe prarocita karAra udAharaNa) zaYatAnera kAjera mata; se mAnuSake vale, “kuphari karo”, tArapara mAnuSa yakhana kuphari kare takhana se vale, “tomAra sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei| Ami vizvajagatera prabhu AllAhake bhaYa kari|”
ataeva, (monApheka o ihudi kAphera) ubhaYera pariNati ei ye, tArA jAhAnnAme yAve; sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTAi jAlemadera zAsti|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| pratyeka vyaktirai (bheve) dekhA ucita, AgAmI kAlera janya se kI pAThAlo| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara| tomarA yA kichu karo, AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|
tomarA tAdera mata haYo nA, yArA AllAhake bhule giYeche, yAra phale AllAhao tAderake tAdera nijedera kathA bhuliYe diYechena| tArAi avAdhya|
jAhAnnAmera adhivAsIrA Ara jAnnAtera adhivAsIrA samAna naYa| jAnnAtera adhivAsIrAi saphalakAma|

Ami yadi ei koraAnake ekaTi pAhAr3era opara nAyila karatAma, tAhale pAhAr3aTike tumi AllAhara bhaYe vinIta o vidIrNa hate dekhate| Ami mAnuSera janya esava dRSTAnta varNanA kari, yAte tArA cintA kare|
tinii AllAha, yini vyatIta kona upAsya nei| tini adRzya o dRzyamAna (sakala) vastu samvandhe jAnena| tini parama karuNAmaYa, asIma daYAlu|

tinii AllAha, yini vyatIta kona upAsya nei| tini mahA adhipati, mahApavitra, zAntidAtA, nirApattA-vidhAYaka, sarvaniYantA, mahAparAkrama-zAlI, mahApratApazAlI, mahAmahima| tArA (tA~ra sAthe) yA kichu zarIka kare, AllAha tA theke pavitra|

tinii AllAha, mahAna sRSTikartA, mahAudbhAvaka, prakRta rUpakAra| uttama nAmasamUha tA~rai| AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache, (savai) tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAvAna|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AmAra o tomAdera zatruke (kApheraderake) vandhurUpe grahaNa karo nA| tomarA tAdera kAche vandhutvera vArtA pAThAo; athaca tomAdera kAche ye satya eseche, tArA tA pratyAkhyAna kareche| tomarA tomAdera prabhu AllAhara prati ImAna enecho vale tArA rasUlake o tomAderake (janmabhUmi theke) vera kare diYeche| tomarA yadi AmAra pathe jehAda karAra janya evaM AmAra santuSTi lAbhera uddezye vera haYe thAka, (tAhale kApheradera sAthe konarakama sauhArdya vajAYa rekho nA|) tomarA tAdera kAche gopane vandhutvera vArtA pAThAo; athaca tomarA yA gopana karo Ara yA prakAza karo, Ami tA bhAla kare jAni| tomAdera madhye ye eTA karache, se avazyai sarala patha theke vicyuta haYeche|

tArA yadi tomAderake nAgAle pAYa tAhale tomAdera zatrui have (kakhano vandhu have nA), khArApa uddezye tomAdera dike tAdera hAta o jihavA vAr3Ave (kAje o kathAYa tomAdera kSati karave) evaM cAive ye, tomarA kuphari kara|
tomAdera AtmIYa-svajana o santAna-santati keYAmatera dina tomAdera kona upakAre Asave nA| tini (AllAha) tomAdera madhye phaYasAlA karavena| tomarA yA karo, AllAha tA dekhate pAna|

tomAdera janya ivarAhIma o tAra saGgIdera madhye uttama Adarza raYeche| tArA tAdera samapradAYake valechila, “tomAdera sAthe evaM tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAra evAdata karo tAra sAthe AmAdera kona samparka nei| AmarA tomAderake pratyAkhyAna karalAma evaM AmAdera o tomAdera mAjhe cirakAlera janya zatrutA o vidveSa sRSTi hala; yatakSaNa nA tomarA eka AllAhara prati ImAna Ana|” tave ivarAhIma tAra vAvAke valechila, “Ami tomAra janya avazyai (AllAhara kAche) kSamA cAiva| yadio AllAhara sAmane tomAra janya AmAra kichu karAra kSamatA nei|” (ivarAhIma o tAra saGgIrA valechila,) “he AmAdera prabhu! AmarA tomAra oparai bharasA karechi, tomAra dikei mukha phiriYechi evaM tomAra kAchei (AmAdera) pratyAvartana|”
“he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake kApheradera janya parIkSAra pAtra karo nA| he AmAdera prabhu! AmAderake kSamA kara| tumii to mahAparAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|”

tomAdera janya tAdera (ivarAhIma o tAra saGgIdera) madhye uttama Adarza raYeche, avazya (tomAdera madhye) yArA AllAha o parakAla pratyAzA kare tAdera janya| Ara ye mukha phiriYe neYa tAra jAnA ucita, avazyai AllAha amukhApekSI, samasta prazaMsAra adhikArI|

sambhavata AllAha tomAdera madhye evaM tAdera madhya theke yAdera sAthe tomAdera zatrutA Ache tAdera madhye vandhutva sRSTi kare devena| AllAha savakichui karate sakSama| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

yArA dvInera vyApAre tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kareni evaM tomAderake tomAdera gharavAr3i theke vera kare deYani, tAdera sAthe sadAcAra karate o tAdera prati nyAYa-vicAra karate AllAha tomAderake niSedha karena nA| AllAha to nyAYavicArakArIdera bhAlavAsena|

vastuta AllAha tomAderake tAdera sAthe vandhutva karate niSedha karena yArA dvInera vyApAre tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kareche, tomAderake tomAdera gharavAr3i theke vera kare diYeche kiMvA tomAderake vera kare dite sAhAyya kareche| emana lokadera sAthe yArA vandhutva kare tArAi jAlema|

he ImAnadAragaNa! yakhana mumina nArIrA hijarata kare tomAdera kAche Ase takhana tomarA tAderake parIkSA karave| tAdera ImAna samparke AllAhai savaceYe bhAla jAnena| (tomAdera parIkSAYa) yadi tomarA tAderake mumina vale jAnate pAra, tAhale tAderake kApheradera kAche pherata pAThAve nA| (kAraNa) nA tArA kApheradera janya vaidha, evaM nA kApherarA tAdera janya vaidha| kApherarA (tAdera vAvada) yA vyaYa kareche tomarA tAderake tA diYe deve| Ara tomarA yadi ai nArIderake viYe karo, tAhale tomAdera kona pApa have nA, yadi tomarA tAderake tAdera moharAnA dAo| Ara tomarA kAphera nArIdera sAthe (pUrvera dAmpatya) samparka vajAYa rekho nA| tomarA (tAdera vAvada) yA vyaYa karecho tA ceYe nite pAra evaM kApherarAo (tAdera strIdera vAvada) yA vyaYa kareche tA ceYe nite pAre| eTAi AllAhara vidhAna| tini tomAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dena| AllAha mahAjJAnI, asIma prajJAvAna|

yadi tomAdera strIdera madhye keu hAtachAr3A haYe kApheradera dakhale cale yAYa, tArapara tomarA (pratipakSake) zAsti dite pAra (evaM tAdera sAthe yuddha kare yuddhalavdha sampada theke kSatigrasta vyaktike kSatipUraNa deoYAra suyoga pAo) tAhale yAdera strI cale giYeche tArA (strIdera vAvada) yA vyaYa kareche tAra samaparimANa tAderake diYe dAo| Ara AllAhake bhaYa karo, yAra prati tomarA vizvAsa rAkha|

he navI! yakhana mumina nArIrA tomAra kAche ese ei marme Anugatyera zapatha kare ye, tArA AllAhara sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karave nA, curi karave nA, vyabhicAra karave nA, tAdera santAnaderake hatyA karave nA, jenezune mithyA apavAda raTAve nA evaM bhAla kAje tomAra Adeza amAnya karave nA, takhana tumi tAdera Anugatya grahaNa karo evaM tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he ImAnadAragaNa! emana lokadera sAthe vandhutva karo nA, yAdera opara AllAha asantuSTa| tArA to parakAla samparke nirAza haYe par3eche, yemana kApherarA kavaravAsIdera (AvAra jIvita haoYAra) vyApAre nirAza haYe giYeche (athavA yemana kavaravAsI kApherarA parakAla samparke nirAza haYe giYeche)|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini mahAparAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yA karo nA, tA vala kena?
tomarA yA karo nA tA ye vala, eTA AllAhara kAche khuvai apachandanIYa|
AllAha tAderake bhAlavAsena, yArA tA~ra pathe (aTala theke) kAtAra ve~dhe yuddha kare, yena tArA eka sudRr3ha bhavana|

(smaraNa karo) mUsA tAra lokaderake valechila, “he AmAra lokerA! tomarA AmAke kaSTa dAo kena, athaca tomarA jAna ye, Ami tomAdera kAche (prerita) AllAhara rasUla?” kintu tArA yakhana vA~kA pathai dharala, takhana AllAhao tAdera antarake vA~kA kare dilena| AllAha avAdhya lokaderake hedAYeta karena nA|

(smaraNa karo) mariYamera putra IsA valechila, “he vanI isarAIla! Ami tomAdera kAche (prerita) AllAhara rasUla| AmAra sAmane ye tAorAta Ache, Ami tAke satya (kitAva) valachi evaM AmAra pare Ah‌mAda nAmera ekajana rasUla AsAra susaMvAda dicchi|” ataHpara se yakhana spaSTa pramANAdi niYe ela, takhana tArA valala, “e to pariSkAra eka yAdu|”
ye vyakti AllAhara viruddhe mithyA vAniYe vale, athaca tAke isalAmera dike DAka deoYA hacche, tAra ceYe var3a jAlema Ara ke? AllAha jAlemaderake hedAYeta karena nA|
tArA tAdera mukha diYe AllAhara Alo nibhiYe dite cAYa; kintu AllAha tA~ra Aloke paripUrNa karavena, kApherarA (tA) apachanda karaleo|
tinii tA~ra rasUlake pathanirdeza o satya dvInasaha preraNa karechena, sakala dvInera opara eke vijaYI karAra janya, muzarikarA (tA) apachanda karaleo|
he ImAnadAragaNa! Ami ki tomAderake emana eka vANijyera patha vale deva, yA tomAderake kaThina zAsti theke rakSA karave?
(tA ei ye,) tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera opara vizvAsa sthApana karave evaM nijedera dhana-sampada o jIvana diYe AllAhara pathe jehAda karave| eTAi tomAdera janya zreYa, yadi tomarA jAnate!

(yadi tA karo) tAhale tini tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA kare devena evaM taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita haYa emana jAnnAte Ara sthAYI jAnnAtera uttama vAsagRhe tomAderake praveza karAvena| eTAi var3a sAphalya|
(tini tomAderake devena) tomAdera pachandanIYa Arao ekaTi anugraha: (zatrura viruddhe) AllAhara sAhAyya o nikaTavartI eka vijaYa| muminaderake (tAra) susaMvAda dAo|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhara (dvInera) sAhAyyakArI hao; yemana mariYamaputra IsA (tAra) ziSyaderake valechila, “AllAra pathe kArA (Ache) AmAra sAhAyyakArI?” ziSyarA valechila, “AmarAi AllAhara (pathe) sAhAyyakArI|” ataHpara vanI isarAIlera ekaTi dala ImAna Anala evaM ekaTi dala kuphari karala| yArA ImAna enechila Ami tAderake tAdera zatrura viruddhe zakti yugiYechilAma, phale tArA vijaYI haYechila|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare, yini mahA adhipati, mahApavitra, mahAparAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|

tinii nirakSaradera madhye tAdera thekei ekajana rasUla pAThiYechena, ye tAdera kAche tA~ra AYAtasamUha pATha kare, tAderake kaluSamukta kare evaM tAderake kitAva o hekamata (prajJA) zikSA deYa| Age to tArA spaSTa vibhrAntira madhyei chila|
(tini tAke rasUla kare pAThiYechena) tAdera Aro lokadera janya, yArA ekhanao tAdera sAthe milita haYani| tinii mahAparAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|
eTA AllAhara anugraha, tini yAke icchA karena tAkei tA dAna karena| AllAha virATa anugrahera mAlika|

yAdera opara tAorAtera dAYitva arpaNa karA haYechila, kintu tArA tA vahana kareni, tAdera avasthA pustaka vahanakArI gAdhAra mata| ye lokerA AllAhara AYAtasamUha avizvAsa kare, tAdera avasthA kata khArApa! AllAha jAlemaderake satpatha dekhAna nA|
vala, “he ihudi samapradAYa! tomarA yadi dAvi karo ye, tomarAi AllAhara vandhu, anya mAnuSerA naYa, tAhale (satvara jAnnAta lAbhera janya) mRtyu kAmanA karo, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|”
kintu tArA nijedera kRtakarmera kAraNe kakhanao tA kAmanA karave nA| AllAha jAlemadera samparke bhAla kare jAnena|

vala, “tomarA ye mRtyu theke pAliYe thAkate cAccha, tAra sAthe tomAdera sAkSAt havei| ataHpara tomAderake adRzya o dRzyamAna vastu samparke avagata sattAra (sarvajJa AllAhara) kAche phiriYe neoYA have| takhana tomarA (duniYAYa) yA kichu karate, tini tomAderake tA jAniYe devena|”

he ImAnadAragaNa! yakhana zukravArera (jum‌Ara) nAmAyera janya DAka (AyAna) deoYA haYa, takhana tomarA AllAhara smaraNapAne chuTe Asave evaM kenAvecA vandha kare deve| eTAi tomAdera janya uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate|
ataHpara yakhana nAmAya samApta have, takhana jamine char3iYe par3ave evaM AllAhara anugraha (jIvikA) sandhAna karave o vezi kare AllAhake smaraNa karave, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao|

tArA yakhana kona vANijya athavA vinodana dekhate pAYa, takhana tAra dike chuTe yAYa evaM tomAke (khutavAYa) dA~r3Ano avasthAYa rekhe yAYa| vala, “AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA vinodana o vANijyera ceYe zreSTha| Ara AllAhai sarvazreSTha riyikadAtA|”

yakhana monAphekarA tomAra kAche Ase, takhana vale, “AmarA sAkSya dicchi ye, Apani avazyai AllAhara rasUla|” AllAha jAnena ye, tumi avazyai tA~ra rasUla; tave AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, monAphekarA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
tArA tAdera zapathake DhAla vAniYe (tAra Ar3Ale mAnuSake) AllAhara patha theke phiriYe rekheche| tArA yA karata tA kata khArApa!
eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA ImAna AnAra para AvAra kAphera haYeche| ye janya tAdera antare mohara mere deoYA haYeche| tAi tArA (kichu) vojhe nA|

tumi yakhana tAderake dekha, tAdera deha tomAke mugdha kare evaM tArA yadi kathA vale, tumi tAdera kathA zona| tArA deYAle ThekAno kAThera mata| tArA pratiTi AoYAjake tAdera viruddhe mane kare| tArAi zatru; ataeva, tAdera samparke satarka hao| AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa karuna (tArA dhvaMsa hoka)! tArA kIbhAve vibhrAnta hacche!
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “eso, AllAhara rasUla tomAdera janya (AllAhara kAche) kSamA cAivena” takhana tArA nijedera mAthA vA~kA kare evaM tumi dekhate pAo, tArA ahaMkAravazata mukha phiriYe neYa|
tumi tAdera janya kSamA cAo Ara nA cAo, (ubhaYai) tAdera janya samAna; AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena nA| AllAha avAdhya lokaderake hedAYeta karena nA|

tArAi vale, “yArA AllAhara rasUlera sAnnidhye Ache tAdera janya vyaYa karo nA, yatakSaNa nA tArA (tAra kAcha theke) sare yAYa|” athaca AllAhai AsamAna o jaminera dhana-bhANDArera mAlika; kintu monAphekarA (tA) vojhe nA|
tArA vale, “AmarA madInAYa phire gele sekhAna theke savala durvalake avazyai vera kare deve|” Asale zakti to AllAhara, tA~ra rasUlera o muminadera; kintu monAphekarA (tA) jAne nA|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati yena tomAderake AllAhara smaraNa theke dUre nA rAkhe| yArA tA kare (yAdera avasthA temana) tArAi kSatigrasta|

Ami tomAderake yA diYechi tA theke vyaYa karo, tomAdera kAro mRtyu AsAra pUrve| mRtyu ese par3ale to se valave, “prabhu! AmAke Aro kichukAla avakAza dile nA kena? tAhale Ami sad‌kA karatAma evaM sat lokadera antarbhukta hatAma|”
kintu yakhana kAro nirdhArita samaYa ese yAve, takhana AllAha tAke moTeo avakAza devena nA| Ara tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| rAjatva tA~rai, prazaMsAo tA~rai| tini savakichu karate sakSama|
tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena; ataHpara tomAdera madhye keu haYeche kAphera evaM keu mumina| tomarA yA kichu karo AllAha tA dekhate pAna|
tini yathAyathabhAve AsamAna o jamina sRSTi karechena, tomAdera AkRti diYechena evaM tomAdera AkRti sundara karechena| tA~ra kAchei (savAra) pratyAvartana|
AsamAna o jamine yA kichu Ache savai tini jAnena evaM tomarA yA gopana karo Ara yA prakAza karo tAo tini jAnena| AllAha antarera viSaYAdi samyaka avagata|
pUrve yArA kuphari karechila tAdera saMvAda ki tomAdera kAche pau~cheni? tArA tAdera karmera kuphala (duniYAtei) AsvAdana kareche| Ara (parakAleo) tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

tAra kAraNa, tAdera kAche tAdera rasUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzana niYe Asata evaM tArA valata, “mAnuSa ki AmAderake supatha dekhAve?” ebhAvei tArA avizvAsa karechila o (satya theke) mukha phiriYe niYechila| tave AllAhara to (tAdera kAche) kona praYojana chila nA| AllAha amukhApekSI, samasta prazaMsAra adhikArI|

kApherarA mane kare, tAderake (hisAvera janya) uThAno have nA| vala, “avazyai, AmAra prabhura zapatha! tomAderake avazyai uThAno have| ataHpara tomarA yA karecho, tomAderake tA avazyai avahita karA have| Ara eTA AllAhara pakSe (khuvai) sahaja|”
ataeva, AllAha o tA~ra rasUlera prati evaM ye Alo (koraAna) Ami nAyila karechi tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana kara| tomarA yA karo AllAha tAra khavara rAkhena|

(se dinake smaraNa karo) yedina arthAt samAvezera dina tini tomAderake ekatrita karavena| sedina have lAbha-lokasAnera (muminadera janya lAbhera evaM kApheradera janya lokasAnera) dina| yArA AllAhake vizvAsa kare o satkAja kare tini tAdera pApasamUha mocana karavena evaM tAderake jAnnAte sthAna devena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita have; sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTAi have var3a sAphalya|
Ara yArA kuphari kare o AmAra nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kare tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI have, sekhAne tArA cirakAla thAkave| eTA kata khArApa gantavya!
AllAhara hukuma chAr3A (kAro) kona vipada Ase nA| ye AllAhake vizvAsa kare tini tAra antarake saThika dika-nirdezanA dena| AllAha savakichui bhAlabhAve jAnena|
tomarA AllAhara Anugatya karo evaM rasUlera Anugatya kara| yadi tomarA (tA theke) mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale (jene rAkha) AmAra rasUlera dAYitva zudhu spaSTabhAve pau~che deoYA|
AllAha emanai eka sattA ye, tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei| muminarA yena AllAhara oparai nirbhara kare|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomAdera strI o santAnadera madhyei tomAdera zatru Ache| ataeva, tAdera vyApAre satarka theko| Ara yadi tomarA (tAdera doSatruTi) mArjanA karo, upekSA karo o kSamA karo tAhale (jene rAkha) AllAhao kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
vastuta tomAdera dhana-sampada o santAna-santati ekaTi parIkSA| Ara AllAhara kAchei Ache eka mahA puraskAra (jAnnAta)|

ataeva, yataTA pAra AllAhake bhaYa karo, (tA~ra kathA) zona, (tA~ra) Anugatya karo evaM (tA~ra pathe) vyaYa kara| ete tomAdera nijederai kalyANa raYeche| yArA manera kArpaNya theke mukta tArAi saphalakAma|

tomarA yadi AllAhake ekaTi uttama RNa dAo (AllAhara pathe artha vyaYa karo) tAhale tini tA tomAdera janya dviguNa kare devena evaM tomAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha parama pratidAnadAtA, mahA dhairyazIla|
tini adRzya o dRzyamAna (sakala) vastu samvandhe avagata, mahAparAkramazAlI, asIma prajJAvAna|

he navI! tomarA strIdera tAlAka dile tAdera iddatera (iddata: tAlAkaprApta mahilAdera nirdiSTa samaYakAla) prati lakSya rekhe tAlAka deve evaM (ThikabhAve) iddata gaNanA karave| Ara tomAdera prabhu AllAhake bhaYa karave| tAderake tAdera ghara theke vera kare deve nA evaM tArA nijerAo yena vera haYe nA yAYa| tave tArA kona prakAzya azlIla kAja karale bhinna kathA| egulo AllAhara sImArekhA (vidhAna)| ye vyakti AllAhara sImArekhA laMghana kare se tAra nijera oparai juluma kare| tumi jAna nA, AllAha haYato era pare (ei tAlAkera pare) kona ekaTi patha vera karavena|

ataHpara tArA (tAlAkaprApta strIrA) tAdera (iddatera) meYAdazeSe upanIta hale tomarA tAderake bhAlabhAve rekhe deve (pherata Anave) athavA bhAlabhAve AlAdA kare deve (vidAYa karave) evaM tomAdera madhya theke duJcajana nyAYaparAYaNa lokake sAkSI rAkhave; Ara tomarA AllAhara janya saThika sAkSya deve| ye AllAha o parakAla vizvAsa kare tAke ei upadeza deoYA hacche| Ara ye AllAhake bhaYa kare tini tAra janya (saMkaTa theke) vera haoYAra patha kare devena|

Ara tAke emana jAYagA theke jIvikAra vyavasthA karavena yA se dhAraNAo kare nA| ye AllAhara opara bharasA kare tAra janya tinii yatheSTa| AllAha nizcaYai tAra uddezya pUraNa karavena| AllAha savakichura janya ekaTi mAtrA Thika karechena|

tomAdera nArIdera madhye yArA RtusrAva haoYAra vyApAre nirAza haYeche (yAdera Ara RtusrAva haoYAra AzA nei) tAdera (iddata) samparke tomAdera yadi sandeha haYa tAhale tAdera iddata (dharave) tinamAsa; (vaYasa nA haoYAYa) yAdera RtusrAva haYa nA tAderao (tAi)| Ara garbhavatIdera iddata hala tAdera santAna prasava karA paryanta| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare AllAha tAra kAja sahaja kare dena|
eTA AllAhara hukuma, yA tini tomAdera prati nAyila karechena| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare, tini tAra pApasamUha mocana karavena evaM tAke var3a puraskAra devena|

tomarA tomAdera sAmarthya anuyAYI ye rakama vAsasthAne thAka tAdera janyao temana vAsasthAnera vyavasthA karave| tAderake saMkaTe phelAra janya tAdera kSati karave nA| tArA garbhavatI haYe thAkale santAna prasava karA paryanta tAdera kharaca vahana karave| yadi tArA tomAdera pakSe (tomAdera santAnaderake) vukera dudha khAoYAYa tAhale tAderake majuri deve evaM (e vyApAre) nijedera madhye saGgatabhAve parAmarza kare neve| (e kSetre) yadi tomarA ubhaYa pakSa eke aparera prati kaThora hao tAhale santAnera vAvAra pakSe anya kona nArI vukera dudha khAoYAve|

vittavAna vyakti tAra vitta anuyAYI vyaYa karave evaM yAra jIvikA sImita (saMkucita) karA haYeche, se vyaYa karave AllAha tAke yA diYechena tA theke| AllAha yAke yataTuku diYechena tAra ceYe vezi tini kAuke vyaYa karate valena nA| kaSTera para AllAha svAcchandya dAna karavena|

aneka janapada (janapadera adhivAsIrA) tAdera prabhu o tA~ra rasUladera nirdezera viruddhAcAraNa karechila| phale Ami tAdera theke kaThora hisAva niYechilAma evaM tAderake bhaYaMkara zAsti diYechilAma|
ataeva, tArA tAdera kRtakarmera khArApa pariNati AsvAdana karechila evaM kSatii chila tAdera karmera pariNati|
AllAha tAdera janya kaThina zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena| ataeva he vuddhimAna vyaktirA, yArA ImAna enecho! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa karo; AllAha to tomAdera kAche upadeza pAThiYechena|

ekajana rasUla (pAThiYechena), ye ImAnadAra o satkarmazIladerake andhakAra theke Alote AnAra janya tomAdera kAche AllAhara spaSTa AYAtasamUha pATha kare| ye AllAhake vizvAsa kare Ara satkAja kare AllAha tAke jAnnAte sthAna devena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita, sekhAne jAnnAtIrA anantakAla dhare vAsa karave| AllAha tAra janya uttama jIvikAra vyavasthA karechena|

AllAha sei mahAna sattA yini sAta AsamAna o tAdera matai (sAta) jamina sRSTi karechena| edera mAjhei (tA~ra) nirdeza avatIrNa haYa, yAte tomarA jAnate pAra ye, AllAha savakichui karate sakSama evaM AllAha savakichui (tA~ra) jJAnera AotAYa rekhechena|

he navI! AllAha tomAra janya yA hAlAla karechena, tumi tomAra strIdera santuSTi rakSAra janya tA hArAma karacha kena? AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu| [ekaTi ghaTanAra para rasUlullAha (sa) tA~ra kona kona strIra manarakSAra janya Ara madhu khAvena nA vale zapatha karechilena| e prasaGge AllAha tA~ra navIke nirdezanA dicchena ye, hAlAla khAdya nA khAoYAra zapatha Thika naYa evaM erakama zapatha bhaGga karA vAJchanIYa|]
AllAha tomAdera janya tomAdera zapatha theke avyAhatira vidhAna diYechena| AllAha tomAdera prabhu| tini mahAjJAnI, asIma prajJAvAna|

(smaraNa karo) yakhana navI tAra kona eka strIke (hAph‌sAke) gopane ekaTi kathA valechila| se yakhana (anyake: AYezAke) tA vale dila evaM AllAha navIra kAche tA prakAza kare dilena, takhana navI tAra katakaTA jAniYe dila Ara katakaTA (jAnAno) theke virata thAkala| se yakhana tA ai strIke (hAph‌sAke) jAnAlo takhana se valala, “ApanAke eTA ke jAniYeche?” (javAve) se valala, “yini savakichu jAnena, savakichura khavara rAkhena tinii (AllAha) AmAke jAniYechena|”

yadi tomarA duJcajana (hAph‌sA o AYezA) AllAhara kAche taovA karo, kenanA tomAdera antara (navIra icchAra virodhitA karAra dike) jhu~ke par3eche (tAhale tomAdera janya bhAla)| Ara yadi navIra viruddhe eke aparake sAhAyya karo tAhale (jene rAkha) AllAha tAra vandhu; jivarAIla o satkarmazIla muminarAo| tadupari, pherezatArAo (tAra) sAhAyyakArI|

se yadi tomAderake tAlAka deYa tAhale tAra prabhu tAke tomAdera parivarte tomAdera ceYe bhAla strI dite pArena, yArA have AtmasamarpaNakAriNI, ImAnadAra, AnugatyakAriNI, taovAkAriNI, ivAdatakAriNI, saMyamazIlA, akumArI o kumArI|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA tomAdera nijederake o tomAdera parivAra-parijanake (jAhAnnAmera) Aguna theke rakSA karo yAra jvAlAni have mAnuSa o pAthara, yAra dAYietva niYojita Ache nirdaYa o kaThora pherezatArA| tArA AllAhara nirdeza amAnya kare nA evaM yA karAra nirdeza pAYa tAi kare|
he kApherarA! tomarA Aja ajuhAta dekhio nA| tomarA yA karate, (Aja) tomAderake tArai pratiphala deoYA have|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhara kAche khA~Ti taovA kara| (tAhale) haYato tomAdera prabhu tomAdera pApasamUha mocana karavena evaM tomAderake jAnnAte sthAna devena, yAra taladeza diYe nadI pravAhita| AllAha sedina navI o tAra saGgI muminaderake lAJchita karavena nA| tAdera Alo tAdera sAmane o (AmalanAmAsaha) tAdera DAna hAte camakAve| tArA valave, “he AmAdera prabhu! AmAdera Alo pUrNa karo evaM AmAderake kSamA kara| nizcaYai tumi savakichu karate sakSama|”
he navI! kAphera o monAphekadera viruddhe jehAda karo evaM tAdera prati kaThora hao| tAdera ThikAnA jAhAnnAma| seTA katai nA khArApa gantavya!

kApheradera janya AllAha nUhera strI o lUtera strIra udAharaNa dicchena| tArA AmAra dui nekakAra vAndAra adhIne chila| kintu tArA tAdera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karechila| phale tArA duJcajana (nUha o lUta) tAdera duJcajanake (strIdvaYake) AllAhara hAta theke vA~cAte kichui karate pAreni| valA hala, “pravezakArIdera sAthe tomarA duJcajana jAhAnnAme praveza kara|”

Ara muminadera janya AllAha pherAunera strIra udAharaNa dicchena| se valechila, “he AmAra prabhu! AmAra janya tomAra kAche jAnnAte ekaTi ghara tairI karo evaM AmAke pherAuna o tAra apakarma theke vA~cAo| Ara AmAke jAlemadera (hAta) theke uddhAra kara|”

(tini) imarAnera kanyA mariYamerao (udAharaNa dicchena), ye tAra lajjAsthAna surakSita rekhechila (satItva rakSA karechila)| ataHpara Ami tAte AmAra rUha phu~ke diYechilAma| se tAra prabhura vANI o kitAvasamUhake satya vale vizvAsa karechila| Ara se chila anugata vAndAdera ekajana|
mahimAnvita sei sattA, yA~ra hAte yAvatIYa kartRtva| tini savakichu karate sakSama|
yini mRtyu o jIvana sRSTi karechena; e janya ye, tomAderake parakha kare dekhavena, ke tomAdera madhye kAje serA| tini parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla;

yini sAtaTi AsamAna sAmaJjasyapUrNabhAve (athavA stare stare) sRSTi karechena| karuNAmaYa AllAhara sRSTite tumi kona garamila dekhate pAve nA| dRSTi ghurAo to (tAkiYe dekha to); kona phATala (truTi) dekhacha ki?
ataHpara vAravAra dRSTi ghurAo, se dRSTi klAnta haYe hIna avasthAYa tomAra dikei phire Asave| (arthAt AllAhara sRSTite truTi kho~jAra janya vAravAra tAkAleo kona truTi khu~je pAve nA|)

Ami (pRthivIra) nikaTatama AsamAnake pradIpamAlA (tArakArAji) diYe susajjita karechi, seguloke zaYatAnadera (tAr3Anora) janya kSepaNAstra vAniYechi evaM tAdera janya jvalanta Agunera (jAhAnnAmera) zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
yArA tAdera prabhuke avizvAsa kare tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti| seTA kata khArApa gantavya!
tAderake yakhana tAra madhye nikSepa karA have takhana tArA tAra zvAsera zavda zunave evaM tA Tagavaga karave|
tA (jAhAnnAma) krodhe pheTe par3ate cAive| yakhanai tAte ekadala (mAnuSa) nikSepa karA have takhanai tAra rakSIrA tAderake jijJAsA karave, “tomAdera kAche ki kona satarkakArI Aseni?”
tArA valave, “hyA~, AmAdera kAche satarkakArI esechila, kintu AmarA avizvAsa karechilAma Ara valechilAma: AllAha kichui nAyila karenani| tomarA var3a eka vibhrAntira madhye Acho|”
tArA valave, “AmarA yadi zunatAma kiMvA vujhatAma, tAhale jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI hatAma nA|”
ebhAve tArA tAdera aparAdha svIkAra karave| ataeva, dUra hoka jAhAnnAmIrA! (akalyANa hoka jAhAnnAmIdera!)
(pakSAntare) yArA nA dekheo tAdera prabhuke bhaYa kare, tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o eka mahA puraskAra (jAnnAta)|
tomarA tomAdera kathA gopana rAkha athavA prakAza karo, (tini tA jAnena, kAraNa) tini to antarera viSaYAdi samyaka avagata|
yini sRSTi karechena tini ki jAnena nA? tini to sUkSmadarzI, mahAvijJa|

tini pRthivIke tomAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena; ataeva, tomarA tAra pathe-prAntare cala evaM AllAhara deoYA jIvikA theke AhAra kara| tA~ra kAchei (pratyAvartanera janya tomAdera) punarutthAna (have)|
yini AsamAne Achena (arthAt AllAha), tA~ra emana zAsti theke ki tomarA nirApada ye, tini tomAderake niYe jamina dAviYe devena evaM jamina takhana kA~pate thAkave?
nAki yini AsamAne Achena tomarA tA~ra ei zAsti theke nirApada ye, tini tomAdera opara zilAjhar3a pAThAvena evaM tomarA takhana jAnate pArave, AmAra satarkavANI kemana chila?
edera pUrvavartIrAo avizvAsa karechila; ataeva, (tAdera kSetreo) kemana haYechila AmAra asvIkRti (zAsti)?
tArA ki tAdera (mAthAra) opare DAnA char3iYe deoYA o guTiYe rAkhA pAkhiderake dekhe nA? karuNAmaYa AllAhai tAderake (tAdera gatipathe) dhare rAkhena (sthira rAkhena)| tini savakichui dekhate pAna|
tomAderake sAhAyya karAra janya karuNAmaYa AllAha vyatIta tomAdera ki kona sainyavAhinI Ache? kApherarA eka dho~kAra madhyei Ache|
tini yadi tA~ra riyika vandha kare dena, tAhale ke Ache ye tomAderake riyika dite pAre? (keu nei,) varaM (nirvodhera mata) tArA avAdhyatA o anIhAra madhye aTala raYeche|
ekajana upur3a haYe mukhamaNDale bhara diYe (patha) cale, Arekajana sojA haYe sarala pathe cale; duJcajanera madhye kAra patha calA saThika?
vala, “tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena evaM tomAderake kAna, cokha o antara diYechena| tomarA kamai kRtajJatA prakAza kara|”
vala, “tinii tomAderake pRthivIte char3iYe diYechena evaM tA~rai kAche tomAderake ekatrita karA have|”
tArA vale, “ei pratizruti kave (pUraNa) have? yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao (tAhale vala)|”
tumi vala, “(se) jJAna to AllAhara kAche Ache| Ara vastuta Ami halAma eka spaSTa satarkakArI|”
ataHpara tArA yakhana tA (pratizruta zAsti) kAchAkAchi dekhave takhana kApheradera mukhamaNDala malina haYe yAve Ara (takhana) valA have, “tomarA to eTAi cAcchile|”

vala, “tomarA AmAke vala to, AllAha yadi AmAke o AmAra saGgIderake dhvaMsa kare dena athavA AmAdera prati anugraha karena, (ye kona avasthAYa) kApheraderake kaThina zAsti theke ke rakSA karave?” (tAdera to kona rehAi nei|)
vala, “tini parama karuNAmaYa; AmarA tA~ke vizvAsa kari evaM tA~ra opara bharasA kari| tomarA acirei jAnave, ke spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye raYeche|”
vala, “tomarA AmAke vala to, yadi tomAdera (sava) pAni bhUgarbhe cale yAYa, tAhale (AllAha chAr3A) tomAdera janya pAnira pravAha ke niYe Asave?”

nUna [pavitra koraAne kona kona sUrAra zurute zavdasaMkSepera Adale sannivezita e jAtIYa vicchinna haraphamAlAra prakRta tAtparya AllAha chAr3A keu jAne nA]| kalamera zapatha evaM (era dvArA) tArA (pherezatArA) yA likhe rAkhe tAra zapatha!
tumi tomAra prabhura kRpAYa pAgala nao|
tomAra janya raYeche eka niravacchinna puraskAra|
Ara tumi eka mahAna caritrera adhikArI|
tumi zigagirai dekhave evaM tArAo dekhave,
tomAdera madhye ke pAgala|
nizcaYai tomAra prabhu bhAla jAnena ke tA~ra patha theke vicyuta, evaM tini eo bhAla jAnena kArA hedAYetaprApta|
sutarAM tumi avizvAsIdera kathAmato calave nA|
tArA cAYa, tumi (tAderake) toSAmoda karo, tAhale tArAo (tomAke) toSAmoda karave|
tumi emana vyaktirao kathAmato calave nA, ye adhika zapathakArI, itara,
gIvatakArI, kutsA raTanAkArI,
bhAla kAje vAdhAdAnakArI, sImAlaMghanakArI, pApI,
vadamejAja evaM sarvopari vejanmA;
ei vivecanAYa ye, tAra dhanavala o janavala Ache|
yakhana tAra kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa, takhana se vale, “(e to) Agera dinera lokadera kes‌sA-kAhini|”
Ami tAra zu~r3e (nAke) dAga diYe deva|
Ami to tAderake parIkSA karechi, yemana parIkSA karechilAma vAgAna-oYAlAderake, yakhana tArA zapatha karechila ye, tArA sakAle sei vAgAnera phala AharaNa karave;
tArA jJainazAAllAha (AllAha yadi cAna)Jca valachila nA|
ataHpara (rAte) tArA yakhana ghumiYe chila, takhana vAgAnaTira opara tomAra prabhura pakSa theke eka viparyaYa neme ela|
phale tA (agnidagdha haYe) rAtera mata (kAlo) haYe gela|
sakAle tArA eke aparake DAka dila
(Ara valala,) “phala AharaNa karate hale tomarA sakAla sakAla tomAdera kSete cala|”
tArapara tArA cupe cupe e kathA valate valate (kSetera dike) calala,
“Aja yena kichutei kona misakIna (abhAvI mAnuSa) tomAdera kAche vAgAne nA Dhoke|”
tArA (abhAvI mAnuSaderake) virata rAkhate sakSama have mane kare (phala AharaNera uddezye) sakAle (vAgAnera dike) raoYAnA hala|
kintu yakhana tArA (agnidagdha) vAgAna dekhala takhana valala, “nizcaYai AmarA bhula pathe esechi|”
“varaM AmarA (phala theke) vaJcita haYechi|”
tAdera madhye zreSTha vyakti valala, “Ami tomAderake (jJainazAAllAhaJca valate) valechilAma nA? (ekhano) tomarA AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karacha nA kena?”
takhana tArA valala, “AmarA AmAdera prabhura pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karachi| Asale AmarA anyAYakArI chilAma|”
ataHpara tArA eke anyera prati doSAropa karate zuru karala|
tArA valala, “hAYa Aphasosa! AmarA to sImAlaMghanakArI chilAma|”
“(AmAdera aparAdha kSamA karale) AmAdera prabhu haYato ei vAgAnera parivarte AmAderake era ceYeo bhAla kona vAgAna devena| AmarA AmAdera prabhura kAche (emanai) AzA karachi|”
zAsti emanai haYe thAke| Ara parakAlera zAsti to Aro var3a| yadi tArA jAnata!
mottAkIdera janya tAdera prabhura kAche raYeche sukhera jAnnAta|
Ami ki musalimaderake aparAdhIdera mata gaNya karava?
tomAdera kI hala? kemana vicAra karacha tomarA?
nAki tomAdera kona kitAva Ache yAte tomarA pATha karo (dekhate pAo)
ye, tAte tomAdera janya tAi Ache yA tomarA pachanda karo?
nAki AmAra kAcha theke keYAmata paryanta (ei marme) tomAdera zapatha (neoYA) Ache ye, tomarA yA siddhAnta neve tAi pAve|
tAderake jijJAsA karo, tAdera madhye era jimmAdAra ke?
nAki tAdera kona zarIka (AllAha vyatIta upAsya) Ache? tAhale tArA tAdera (sei) zarIkaderake niYe Asuka, yadi tArA satyavAdI haYa|
(sedinera kathA smaraNa karo) yedina pAYera nalA unmocita have (kaThina avasthAra sRSTi have) evaM lokaderake sejadA karate valA have, kintu avizvAsIrA (sejadA karate) pArave nA|
tAdera dRSTi avanata thAkave evaM lAJchanA tAderake Acchanna karave| tArA yakhana (duniYAra jIvane) sustha avasthAYa chila takhanao tAderake sejadA karate valA hata (kintu tArA tA kareni)|
ataeva, yArA ei vANI avizvAsa kare tAderake AmAra hAte cher3e dAo| Ami tAderake dhIre dhIre emanabhAve pAkar3Ao karava ye, tArA jAnatei pArave nA|
tAderake Ami avakAza deva| AmAra kauzala khuva majavuta|
nAki tAdera kAche tumi kona majuri cAo, yAra janya (yA parizodha karate) tArA RNagrasta haYe par3e?
nAki tAdera kAche adRzyera jJAna Ache, yA tArA likhe rAkhe?
ataeva, tumi tomAra prabhura nirdezera janya dhairya dhara evaM mAchaoYAlAra (iunusa navIra) mata (adhairya) haYo nA, yakhana se (mAchera peTe) viSaNna avasthAYa (AmAke) Dekechila|
yadi tAra kAche tAra prabhura anugraha ese nA par3ata tAhale to se nindita avasthAYa unmukta prAntare nikSipta hata|
ataHpara tAra prabhu tAke manonIta (pachanda) karechena evaM tAke satkarmazIladera antarbhukta karechena|

kApherarA yakhana koraAna zone takhana tArA tAdera dRSTi dvArA tomAke skhalita karAra upakrama kare (arthAt tomAra dike emana vidveSapUrNa dRSTite tAkAYa ye, pArale tomAke AchAr3a diYe phele deYa) Ara vale, “e to ekaTA pAgala”|
athaca tA (koraAna) vizvajagatera janya eka mahAna upadeza vai naYa|
avazyambhAvI vyApAra (mahApralaYa),
ki sei avazyambhAvI vyApAra?
tumi ki jAna sei avazyambhAvI vyApAraTA ki?
chAmUda o Ada samapradAYa mahApralaYake mithyA valechila|
chAmUdake to vajra dvArA dhvaMsa karA haYechila|
Ara Adake dhvaMsa karA haYechila eka pracaNDa jhar3o hAoYA dvArA|

tAdera opara AllAha tA kaThinabhAve (athavA ekAdhAre) sAta rAta o ATa dina vahAla rekhechilena| tumi (takhana sekhAne thAkale) dekhate, mAnuSagulo (mare) mATite par3e Ache; yena tArA zUnyagarbha khejuragAchera kANDa|
tumi ki tAdera kona avaziSTAMza (cihna) dekhate pAo?
pherAuna, tAra pUrve yArA chila tArA evaM ulTiYe-deoYA janapadagulo (janapadera adhivAsIrA) pApa karechila|
tArA tAdera prabhura dUtake amAnya karechila| yAra janya tini tAderake kaThorabhAve pAkar3Ao karechilena (kaThina zAsti diYechilena)|
(nUhera plAvane) yakhana pAni ver3e giYechila (jalocchvAsa haYechila), takhana Ami tomAderake (tatkAlIna ImAnadAra lokaderake) naukAYa ArohaNa kariYechilAma;
yAte se ghaTanA tomAdera janya ekaTi zikSAra viSaYa haYa evaM zravaNakArI kAna tA zune rAkhe|
yakhana ziGgAYa ekavAra (prathamavAra) phu~ deoYA have
evaM jamina o pAhAr3asamUha (sthAnacyuta kare) opare oThAno have o ekavArei cUrNa-vicUrNa kare deoYA have,
sedina keYAmata saMghaTita have
evaM AsamAna vidIrNa have; Ara sedina tA durvala thAkave|
pherezatArA thAkave AsamAnera prAntadeze| ATajana (pherezatA) sedina tomAra prabhura Arazake tAdera opare tule dharave|
sedina tomAderake (vicArera janya) upasthita karA have, tomAdera kona gopana tathyai Ara gopana thAkave nA|
yAra AmalanAmA tAra DAna hAte deoYA have se (anyaderake) valave, “ei nAo AmAra AmalanAmA, par3e dekha|
Ami jAnatAma ye, AmAke AmAra hisAvera sammukhIna hate have|”
ataeva, se sukhI jIvana yApana karave;
ucca (maryAdApUrNa) jAnnAte;
yAra phalasamUha thAkave hAtera kAche (nicu DAle)|
(jAnnAtIderake valA have) vigata dine tomarA yA kichu (satkAja) karecho, tAra phalasvarUpa (ekhAne) tRpti sahakAre khAo Ara pAna kara|
kintu yAra AmalanAmA tAra vAma hAte deoYA have se valave, “hAYa, (kata bhAla hata) yadi AmAke AmAra AmalanAmA nA deoYA hata!”
“Ami yadi AmAra hisAva nA jAnatAma!
hAYa, AmAra mRtyui yadi AmAra zeSa hata!
AmAra sampada AmAra konai kAje Asala nA|
AmAra kSamatAo to zeSa haYe gela|”
(pherezatAderake valA have) tAke dhara o tAra galAYa ver3i pariYe dAo|
tArapara tAke (jAhAnnAmera) jvalanta Agune nikSepa kara|
tArapara tAke sattara gaja lamvA ekaTi zikale ve~dhe rAkha|
se mahAna AllAhake vizvAsa karata nA
evaM misakInake khAoYAte utsAha dita nA|
tAi Aja ekhAne tAra kona vAndhava nei|
(tAra janya) kona khAdyao nei, ekamAtra pu~ja chAr3A|
yA kevala aparAdhIrAi khAve|
Ami seisava vastura zapatha kare valachi, yA tomarA dekhate pAo
evaM yA tomarA dekhate pAo nA!
nizcaYai ei koraAna eka sammAnita dUtera (jiv‌rAIlera athavA muhAmmAdera) kathA (yA se AllAhara kAcha theke niYe eseche)|
eTA kona kavira kathA naYa; tomarA khuva kamai vizvAsa kara|
(eTA) kona gaNakerao kathA naYa; tomarA khuva kamai cintA karo (athavA upadeza grahaNa karo)|
eTA vizvaprabhura kAcha theke avatIrNa|
se (muhAmmAda) yadi AmAra nAme kona kathA vAniYe valata
tave avazyai Ami tAra DAna hAta dhare phelatAma|
tArapara avazyai tAra hRdaYatantrI (mahAdhamanI) keTe ditAma|
takhana tomAdera keu tAke rakSA karate pArata nA|
ei koraAna mottAkIdera janya avazyai ekaTi upadeza|
Ami to jAni, tomAdera madhye keu keu (era prati) mithyA Aropa karave|
Ara kApheradera janya to eTA ekaTi anutApera kAraNa|
(tave) eTA nizcita satya|
ataeva, tumi tomAra mahAna prabhura nAmera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|
eka praznakArI zAsti samparke prazna karala, yA neme Asave
kApheradera opara, yAke keu pratihata karate pArave nA|
(yA Asave UrdhvArohaNera) si~r3ira adhikArI AllAhara pakSa theke|

tA~ra (Arazera) dike pherezatArA o (pavitra) AtmA (jivarAIla) ArohaNa kare thAke| (kApheradera opara ai zAsti neme Asave) emana eka dina (keYAmatera dina), yAra parimANa have (duniYAra samaYa gaNanAra hisAve) paJcAza hAjAra vachara|
ataeva, tumi bhAlabhAve dhairyadhAraNa kara|
tArA tAke (ai zAstike) dUre mane karache,
kintu Ami tA kAche dekhachi|
yedina (zAsti Asave sedina) AsamAna have galita tAmAra mata,
parvatagulo have pazamera (TukarAra) mata
evaM vandhu vandhuke (tAra khavara) jijJAsA karave nA|

(yadio) tAdera paraspara parasparake dekhAno have| (arthAt savAi savAike dekhaleo keu kAro kho~ja-khavara neve nA|) pApI vyakti sedinera zAsti theke vA~cAra janya muktipaNa dite cAive nijera cheledera dvArA,
nijera strI dvArA, nijera bhAi dvArA
nijera AtmIYa-svajana dvArA, yArA tAke AzraYa dita
evaM pRthivIra sakalera dvArA; tArapara se nijeke rakSA karave| (arthAt edera sakalera dvArA muktipaNa diYe haleo nijeke zAsti theke rakSA karate cAive|)
tA have nA; ekevAre jvalanta Aguna,
yA dehera cAmar3A tule neve|
se (jAhAnnAmera Aguna) sei lokake DAkave, ye (satyake) er3iYe giYechila, (satya theke) mukha phiriYe niYechila
evaM (sampada) saMgraha o saMrakSaNa karechila|
mAnuSa sRSTigatabhAve var3a adhairya|
yakhana se khArApa avasthAYa par3e takhana ghAvar3e yAYa,
Ara yakhana tAra avasthA bhAla haYa takhana kArpaNya kare|
tave era vyatikrama hala (sei) nAmAyIrA,
yArA tAdera nAmAye sarvadA niYamita (kakhanao nAmAya chAr3e nA);
yAdera sampade nirdiSTa haka (nyAyya adhikAra) Ache
yAcJAkArI o vaJcita vyaktira janya;
yArA pratidAnera dinake satya vale vizvAsa kare;
yArA tAdera prabhura zAstike bhaYa kare;
Asalei tAdera prabhura zAsti theke keu nirApada naYa;
yArA tAdera yaunAGga saMyata rAkhe,
tAdera strI kiMvA mAlikAnAdhIna dAsIdera saGge (yaunakarma) chAr3A, kenanA se kSetre tArA doSamukta;
kintu yArA edera vyatIta anyaderake kAmanA kare tArAi sImAlaMghanakArI;
yArA tAdera AmAnata o oYAdA rakSA kare;
yArA (saThikabhAve) tAdera sAkSyadAna sampanna kare;
evaM yArA tAdera nAmAyera prati ya.vAna thAke|
erAi sammAnera sAthe jAnnAte sthAna pAve|
ataeva, kApheradera ki hala ye, tArA tomAra dike chuTe Asache,
DAna dika theke o vAma dika theke, dale dale!
tAdera pratyekei ki AzA kare ye, tAke sukhera jAnnAte praveza karAno have?
kakhanao naYa, Ami tAderake yA theke sRSTi karechi tA tArA jAne|
Ami (sUrya) udita haoYAra o asta yAoYAra sthAnasamUhera prabhura (arthAt AmAra nijera) zapatha kare valachi! nizcaYai Ami sakSama
tAdera parivarte tAdera ceYe bhAla mAnuSa sRSTi karate; Ara Ami (tAte) pazcAvdartI (kAro ceYe pechane) nai|
ataeva, tAderake (asAra kathA) valate o khelatAmAzA karate dAo, yatakSaNa nA tArA tAdera sei (keYAmatera) dinaTira sAthe sAkSAt kare, yAra oYAdA tAderake deoYA hacche|
sedina tArA kavara theke druta vera have; (mane have) yena tArA kona lakSyera (athavA pratimAra) dike chuTache,
emana avasthAYa ye tAdera dRSTi avanata thAkave o lAJchanA tAderake Acchanna karave| eTAi sei dina, yAra oYAdA tAdera sAthe karA hata|
Ami nUhake tAra samapradAYera kAche vale pAThiYechilAma, “kaThina zAsti AsAra Age tomAra samapradAYake satarka kara|”
se valechila, “he AmAra samapradAYa! tomAdera janya Ami eka spaSTa satarkakArI|
tomarA AllAhara ivAdata karo, tA~ke bhaYa karo evaM AmAra Anugatya karo;

tAhale tini tomAdera pApasamUha kSamA karavena evaM tomAderake eka nirdiSTa samaYa paryanta avakAza devena| AllAhara (nirdiSTa) samaYa yakhana ese yAYa takhana tA Ara vilamvita karA haYa nA; tomarA yadi (tA) jAnate!”
se valechila, “he AmAra prabhu! Ami to AmAra samapradAYake dinarAta Dekechi,
kintu AmAra DAka zune tArA (hedAYetera pathe AsAra parivarte) Aro vezi palAYanapara haYeche|”

“Ami yakhanai tAderake Dekechi, yAte tumi tAderake kSamA karo, takhanai tArA (zunate nA ceYe) kAne AGgula diYe rekheche, kApar3a diYe nijederake Dheke rekheche, (anyAYera opara) jida dhare thekeche evaM dAruNa ahaGkAra kareche|”
“ataHpara Ami tAderake prakAzye DAka diYechi;
tArapara tAderake janasamakSe AhavAna jAniYechi evaM gopaneo Avedana karechi|
valechi: tomarA tomAdera prabhura kAche kSamA cAo, nizcaYai tini parama kSamAzIla|”
“tAhale tini tomAdera janya AkAza theke pracura vRSTi varSaNa karavena;
dhana-sampada o santAna-santati dvArA tomAdera zaktivRddhi karavena evaM tomAdera janya vAga-vAgicA o nada-nadI vAniYe devena|”
tomAdera kI hala ye, tomarA AllAhara maryAdA cAccha nA (arthAt AllAhara nirdeza pAlanera mAdhyame tA~ra yathArtha maryAdA dite kiMvA tA~ra kAcha theke maryAdA pete cAccha nA)!
athaca tini tomAderake (prathame vIrya, tArapara jamATavaddha rakta, tArapara mAMsapiNDa ityAdi) vibhinna paryAYe sRSTi karechena|
tomarA ki dekhani, AllAha kIbhAve stare stare sAta AsamAna sRSTi karechena?
evaM tAra mAjhe canadrake Alo o sUryake pradIpa vAniYechena?
AllAha tomAderake bhUmi theke ud‌gata karechena (mATi theke sRSTi karechena)|
(mRtyura para) tini AvAra tomAderake tAte phiriYe nevena evaM (hAzarera dina sekhAna theke) vera karavena|
AllAha tomAdera janya bhUmike vichAnA (vichAnAra mata samAna o prazasta) vAniYechena;
yAte tomarA tAra prazasta rAstAYa patha calate pAra|
nUha valala, “prabhu! orA (AmAra lokerA) AmAra kathA amAnya kareche evaM emana vyaktira anusaraNa kareche yAra dhana-sampada o santAna-santati kevala tAra kSatii vRddhi kareche|
Ara tArA eka var3a cakrAnta kareche|”
“tArA valeche: tomarA tomAdera deva-devIke kakhanao tyAga karo nA; tyAga karo nA oYAd‌ kiMvA suoYAjJake; athavA iYAgUcha, iYAjJaUka o nAs‌rake|
athaca tArA anekakei pathabhraSTa kareche| (ataeva, he prabhu!) tumi ei jAlemadera pathabhraSTatAi vAr3iYe dAo|”
tAdera pApera kAraNei tAderake DuviYe deoYA haYechila evaM pare Agune DhukiYe deoYA haYeche| ataHpara tArA nijedera janya AllAha vyatIta (Ara) sAhAyyakArI pAYani|
nUha valala, “he AmAra prabhu! kona kAphera adhivAsIke pRthivIte jIvita rekho nA|
tumi yadi tAderake jIvita rAkha, tAhale tArA tomAra vAndAderake vipathagAmI karave evaM zudhu pApAcArI kAphera janma deve|”
“he AmAra prabhu! AmAke, AmAra pitAmAtAke, AmAra ghare ImAnera sAthe ye praveza kare tAke evaM sava ImAnadAra puruSa o nArIke kSamA karo; Ara jAlemadera zudhu dhvaMsai vAr3iYe dAo|”
vala, “AmAke ohIra mAdhyame jAnAno haYeche ye, ekadala jvina kAna pete (koraAna) zuneche Ara valeche, “AmarA eka vismaYakara koraAna zunechi,
yA (sakalake) satpatha pradarzana kare; tAi AmarA tA vizvAsa karechi| AmarA AmAdera prabhura sAthe kAuke zarIka karava nA|
ucca hoka AmAdera prabhura maryAdA! tini kona saGginI (pa.I) kiMvA kona santAna grahaNa karena ni|”
“AmAdera nirvodherA AllAha samparke asaMyata mithyA valata;
athaca AmarA mane karechilAma ye, mAnuSa o jvina AllAha samparke mithyA valave nA|”
“kataka mAnuSa chila, yArA kataka jvinera kAche AzraYa nita; phale ei jvinerA ai mAnuSagulora pApa o anyAYa Aro vAr3iYe diYechila|
tArA mane karechila, yemana tomarAo mane karo ye, AllAha kAuke punarutthita karavena nA|”
“AmarA AsamAne giYe tAra (AsamAnera) tathya saMgraha karate ceYechilAma, kintu tAke kaThora praharA o ulkAYa paripUrNa dekhate peYechi|
AmarA AsamAnera vibhinna sthAne (sekhAnakAra kathAvArtA) zonAra janya vasatAma, kintu ekhana keu (tA) zunate cAile se tAra janya prastuta-rAkhA ulkA dekhate pAve|”
“AmarA jAni nA, pRthivIra adhivAsIdera amaGgala cAoYA haYeche, nA tAdera prabhu tAdera hedAYeta ceYechena|”
“AmAdera madhye kataka Ache satkarmaparAYaNa Ara kataka tAra vyatikrama| AmarA halAma nAnAna matera anusArI vibhinna dala|”
“AmarA mane karechi (vujhate perechi) ye, AmarA pRthivIte AllAhake parAsta karate (arthAt tA~ra zAsti theke vA~cate) pArava nA evaM pAliYeo tA~ke parAsta karate pArava nA|”
“AmarA yakhana hedAYetera kathA zunechi takhana tA vizvAsa karechi| ye tAra prabhuke vizvAsa kare se kona kSati kiMvA julumera AzaGkA kare nA|”
“AmAdera madhye (AllAhara kAche) AtmasamarpaNakArIrAo Ache, AvAra AmAdera madhye vipathagAmIrAo Ache|” yArA AtmasamarpaNa kareche tArAi saThika patha khu~je niYeche|
Ara yArA vipathagAmI, tArA have jAhAnnAmera jvAlAni|

Ara (ohIra mAdhyame Aro yA yA jAnAno haYeche tA) ei ye, tArA yadi (saThika) pathe thAkata tAhale Ami (AllAha) tAderake pracura pAni dvArA sikta karatAma (tAdera janya paryApta vRSTi varSaNa karatAma),
yAte era dvArA tAderake parIkSA karate pAri| Ara ye loka tAra prabhura abhijJAna (koraAna) theke mukha phiriYe neYa, tini tAke kaThina zAstira madhye (jAhAnnAme) praveza karAvena|
Ara masajidasamUha AllAharai (evAdatera) janya; ataeva, tomarA AllAhara sAthe kAuke Deko nA|
Ara AllAhara vAndA (rasUla) yakhana tA~ke DAkAra janya (nAmAye) dA~r3Ala, takhana tArA yena tAra kAche humar3i kheYe par3ala|
vala, “Ami kevala AmAra prabhukei DAki evaM tA~ra sAthe kAuke zarIka kari nA|”
vala, “AmAra kSamatA nei tomAdera kona kSati karAra kiMvA tomAderake satpathe AnAra|”
vala, “AmAke keu AllAhara zAsti theke rakSA karate pArave nA evaM tini vyatIta Ami kona AzraYasthalao pAva nA (yadi tA~ra Adeza nA mAni)|”

AmAra kAja zudhu AllAhara pakSa theke (tA~ra dvIna) pracAra karA o tA~ra vArtA pau~che deoYA| Ara AllAha o tA~ra rasUlake ye amAnya kare, tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna| tArA tAra madhye anantakAla thAkave|
ekasamaYa tArA yakhana tAdera pratizruta zAsti dekhave, takhana jAnate pArave, ke sAhAyyakArIra dika theke durvala Ara saMkhyAYa kama|
vala, “Ami jAninA, tomAdera pratizruta zAsti ki nikaTavartI, nA AmAra prabhu tAra janya kona (dUravartI) meYAda Thika karavena|”
tini gAYeva (adRzyera khavara) jAnena evaM svIYa gAYevera khavara kAro kAche prakAza karena nA,
tA~ra manonIta kona rasUla vyatIta| se kSetre tini tAra sAmane o pechane praharAra vyavasthA karena,

yena jAnate pArena (dekhate pAna) ye, tArA (rasUlerA) tAdera prabhura vArtA pau~che diYeche| tAdera kAche yA Ache tA tini veSTana kare Achena (svIYa jJAnera AotAdhIna karechena) evaM savakichui gune gune hisAva rekhechena|
he vastrAvRta (navI)!
rAte jege thAka (rAta jege evAdata karo), ekaTu samaYa vyatIta;
rAtera ardheka, athavA tAra thekeo ekaTu kamAo;
kiMvA tAra ceYe (kichu) vAr3Ao; Ara spaSTa o sundarabhAve koraAna telAoYAta kara|
Ami tomAra opara eka bhArI (gurutvapUrNa) vANI nAyila karava|
rAte oThA (evAdatera janya jAgrata haoYA) zaktabhAve (pravRttike) damane evaM saThikabhAve (doYA, telAoYAta ityAdi) uccAraNe sahAYaka|
dinera velAYa to tomAra dIrgha karmavyastatA Ache|
(tAi) tomAra prabhura nAma smaraNa karo evaM tA~ra prati vezi kare ekAgra hao|
tini pUrva o pazcimera prabhu; tini chAr3A kona upAsya nei; ataeva, karmavidhAYakarUpe tA~kei grahaNa kara|
Ara tArA (avizvAsIrA) yA vale tAte dhairyadhAraNa karo evaM tAderake sundarabhAve (yathAvihita) varjana kara|
vilAsasAmagrIra adhikArI avizvAsIderake AmAra hAte cher3e dAo evaM tAderake kichuTA avakAza dAo|
(tAdera janya) AmAra kAche Ache zRMkhala, tI\ Aguna,
galAYa ATake-par3A khAdya o yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
(sei keYAmatera dine) yedina bhUmi Ara pAhAr3a ke~pe uThave evaM pAhAr3agulo vAlira vahamAna stupe pariNata have|
Ami tomAdera kAche ekajana rasUla pAThiYechi, ye tomAdera janya sAkSI have; yemana pherAunera kAcheo ekajana rasUla pAThiYechilAma|
kintu pherAuna sei rasUlera kathA amAnya karechila; tAi Ami tAke kaThinabhAve dharechilAma (kaThina zAsti diYechilAma)|
ataeva, tomarA yadi kuphari karo tAhale sei (keYAmatera) dine kIbhAve (zAsti theke) rakSA pAve, yA vAlakaderake vRddha kare deve?
sedina AsamAna phATalayukta have| tA~ra oYAdA vAstavAYita havei|
eTA nizcaYai ekaTA upadeza| ataeva, yAra icchA se yena tAra prabhuke pAoYAra patha dhare|

tomAra prabhu to jAnena ye, tumi (kakhanao) rAtera prAYa tina bhAgera dui bhAga, (kakhanao) ardheka evaM (kakhanao) tina bhAgera eka bhAga jege thAka (jege ivAdata karo); tomAra saGgIdera ekaTi dalao (tAi kare)| AllAhai rAta o dina parimApa karena| tini jAnena, tomarA tAra (pUrNa) hisAva rAkhate pArave nA (sArArAta jAgate pArave nA); tAi tini tomAdera prati sadaYa haYechena| kAjei koraAna yataTuku (pATha karA) sahaja haYa, tomarA tataTuku pATha kara| tini jAnena, tomAdera madhye keu keu asustha thAkave, keu keu AllAhara anugraha (jIvikA) sandhAna karate jamine ghure ver3Ave, keu keu AvAra AllAhara pathe lar3Ai (jehAda) karave; kAjei tA yataTuku (pATha karA) sahaja haYa tataTuku pATha karo; Ara nAmAya kAYema karo, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAhake uttama RNa dAo| tomarA nijedera janya bhAla yA kichu addhvima pAThAve, tA AllAhara kAche emana avasthAYa pAve ye, tA Aro bhAla evaM puraskAra hiseve Aro var3a| Ara AllAhara kAche kSamA cAo| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he vastrAcchAdita (navI)!
oTha evaM (lokaderake) satarka kara|
tomAra prabhura gaurava varNanA kara|
tomAra pozAka pavitra rAkha|
apavitratA (mUrtipUjA) parihAra kara|
adhika pAoYAra uddezye kichu dAna karo nA|
Ara tomAra prabhura janya dhairyadhAraNa kara|
yakhana ziGgAYa phu~ deoYA have,
se dinaTi have ekaTi kaThina dina,
kApheradera janya, sahaja (dina) naYa|
ye vyaktike Ami ekAkI (dhana-sampada o santAna-santativihIna) sRSTi karechi tAke (arthAt sei oYAlIda ivane mugIrAke) AmAra hAte cher3e dAo|
Ami tAke dAna karechi vipula dhana-sampada
o kAche avasthAnakArI putravarga;
Ara tAke veza sacchalatA dAna karechi|
tAraparao se cAYa, tAke Ami Aro vezi dei|
kichutei naYa, se to AmAra nidarzanasamUhera viruddhAcArI|
Ami tAke (jAhAnnAme) ekaTi picchila pAhAr3e ArohaNa karate vAdhya karava (athavA eka kaThina zAstira sammukhIna karava)|
se cintA karala Ara siddhAnta nila|
se dhvaMsa hoka! kemana kare se (amana) siddhAnta nila!
AvAra se dhvaMsa hoka! kemana kare se (amana) siddhAnta nila!
tArapara se tAkAlo,
ataHpara bhrUkuTi karala o vikRta mukhabhaGgi karala|
tArapara piTha phiriYe cale gela o dambha prakAza karala|
tArapara valala, “e to prAcInakAla theke cale AsA eka yAdu chAr3A kichu naYa|”
“e to mAnuSerai kathA|”
Ami tAke jAhAnnAmera Agune nikSepa karava|
tumi ki jAna, jAhAnnAmera Aguna ki (kata bhaYaMkara)?
(tA jAhAnnAmera vAsindAke) rAkhaveo nA, chAr3aveo nA;
mAnuSa dagdhakArI|
era praharAYa raYeche unizajana (pherezatA)|

Ami pherezatAderakei jAhAnnAmera praharI karechi| Ara tAdera ei saMkhyA nirdhAraNa karechi kevala kApheraderake parIkSA karAra janyai; yAte kitAvIdera pratyaYa janme, muminadera ImAna vRddhi pAYa, kitAvI o muminarA sandeha poSaNa nA kare evaM yAdera antare (kapaTatAra) vyAdhi Ache tArA Ara kApherarA vale, “AllAha ei (abhinava) udAharaNa dvArA ki vojhAte ceYechena?” ebhAve AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA satpatha dekhAna| Ara tomAra prabhura vAhinI samparke kevala tinii jAnena| eTA (jAhAnnAmera ei varNanA) vastuta mAnuSera janya eka satarkavANI|
kakhanao naYa; canedrara zapatha!
rAtera zapatha, yakhana tA cale yAYa!
evaM prabhAtera zapatha, yakhana tA udbhAsita haYa!
nizcaYai tA (jAhAnnAma) gurutara viSaYasamUhera ekaTi;
mAnuSera janya eka satarkavANIsvarUpa;
tAra janya, ye tomAdera madhye sAmane yete (satkAja karate) athavA pechane thAkate (pApAcAre lipta thAkate) cAYa|
pratyekei tAra kRtakarmera dAYe Avaddha;
DAnadikera lokerA (satkarmazIla muminarA) vyatIta;
tArA thAkave jAnnAte; (sekhAne tArA) eke aparera kAche jAnate cAive,
aparAdhIdera samparke;
(tArA tAderake jijJAsA karave,) “kon‌ kAja tomAderake jAhAnnAme niYe ela?”
tArA valave, “AmarA nAmAya par3atAma nA,
misakInake khAvAra ditAma nA,
ahetuka samAlocanAkArIdera sAthe (mile) ahetuka samAlocanA karatAma
evaM vicArera dinake mithyA valatAma|
ei avasthAYai AmAdera nizcita pariNati (mRtyu) ese giYechila|”
phale, supArizakArIdera supAriza tAdera kona upakAre Asave nA|
tAdera kI haYeche ye, upadeza (grahaNa) theke mukha phiriYe neYa?
yena tArA bhaYa peYe palAYanakArI gAdhA,
yArA kona siMhera bhaYe pAliYe eseche|
varaM tAdera pratyekei (yena) cAYa ye, tAke unmukta AsamAni kitAva deoYA hoka|
kakhanao naYa; Asale tArA parakAlake bhaYa kare nA|
kakhanao naYa; nizcaYai eTi (ei koraAna) ekaTi upadeza|
ataeva, ye cAYa se yena e theke upadeza grahaNa kare|
tave AllAha cAilei kevala tArA upadeza grahaNa karave| tinii bhaYa karAra hakadAra o kSamAra mAlika|
Ami keYAmatera dinera zapatha karachi,
zapatha karachi tiraskArakArI AtmAra!
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, (tAra marAra para) Ami tAra hAr3agulo ekatrita karava nA?
hyA~, Ami tAra AGgulera DagA paryanta ThikabhAve lAgAte sakSama|
varaM mAnuSa tAra sAmanera (bhaviSyat) jIvaneo pApa karate cAYa|
se prazna kare, “keYAmatera dina kave (Asave)?”
(keYAmatera prAkkAle) yakhana dRSTi dhA~dhiYe yAve,
canedra grahaNa lAgave
evaM sUrya o canadrake ekatrita karA have (athavA ekairakama AlovihIna karA have),
sedina mAnuSa valave, “kothAYa Ache palAYanera jAYagA?”
nA nA, kona AzraYasthala nei|
tomAra prabhura kAchei have sedina vizrAmasthala|
mAnuSake sedina jAniYe deoYA have se yA sAmane pAThiYeche o (yA) pechane rekhe eseche| (arthAt tAra sava kAja tAke avahita karA have|)
varaM mAnuSa nijei tAra savakichu dekhate pAve|
yadio se tAra (khArApa kAja DhAkAra janya) ajuhAta peza karate cAive|
koraAna niYe tAr3Ahur3A karAra janya tumi tAra sAthe sAthe tomAra jihavA ner3o nA| (druta jihavA saJcAlana kare tAr3Ahur3A kare koraAnera AYAta mukhastha karAra janya asthira haYo nA|)
era saMgraha o pAThera vyavasthA karA AmArai dAYitva|
ataeva, Ami yakhana tA (jivarAIlera mAdhyame) pATha kari takhana tumi era pATha anusaraNa karo (jivarAIlera pAThera anusaraNe tA pATha karo)|
erapara tA vujhiYe deoYAra dAYitva AmArai|
nA nA, tomarA varaM (ayathA) pArthiva jIvanaTAkei bhAlavAsa
Ara parakAlake upekSA kara|
sedina kataka cehArA have ujjvala,
tArA tAdera prabhura dike tAkAve|
Ara kataka cehArA have gomar3A (anujjvala),
tArA dhAraNA (AzaMkA) karave ye, tAdera opara eka viparyaYa neme Asave|
kakhanao naYa; yakhana (mumUrSu vyaktira) prANa galAra kAche Asave
evaM valA have, “ke sustha (rakSA) karave?”
Ara se vujhate pArave ye, eTAi vidAYera samaYa;
evaM (eka) pA (Areka) pAYera sAthe jar3iYe yAve,
sedina tomAra prabhura dikei have (savakichura) gatipatha|
se (satyake) vizvAsa kareni, nAmAyao par3eni;
varaM avizvAsa kareche o mukha phiriYe niYeche|
ataHpara dambhabhare tAra parivAra-parijanera kAche cale giYeche|
(he avizvAsI!) tomAra durbhogera para durbhoga hoka!
AvAro tomAra durbhogera para durbhoga hoka!
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, tAke vRthAi cher3e deoYA have?
se ki (mAYera garbhAzaYe) nikSipta ekapho~TA vIrya chila nA?
ataHpara se chila (mAtRgarbhe) ekaTi jhulanta raktapiNDa, tArapara AllAha tAke sRSTi karechena evaM sundara AkAra diYechena|
tArapara tAra theke dui liGga— puruSa o nArI sRSTi karechena|
ei sRSTikartA (AllAha) ki mRtaderake jIvita karate sakSama nana?
mAnuuSera opara ki emana ekaTA samaYa yAYani, yakhana se kona ullekhayogya vastu chila nA?
Ami to mizra vIryera ekaTi pho~TA theke mAnuSa sRSTi karechi, tAke parIkSA karava vale; tAi tAke zravaNazaktisampanna o dRSTizaktisampanna karechi|
Ami tAke patha dekhiYe diYechi; ekhana (tAra icchAYa) haYa se kRtajJa have, nA haYa akRtajJa|
Ami kApheradera janya zikala, ver3i o jvalanta Aguna prastuta rekhechi|
satkarmazIlarA emana eka peYAlA theke pAna karave yAte (yAra zarAve) kAphUrera mizraNa thAkave|
emana ekaTi jharanA yA theke AllAhara vAndArA pAna karave evaM tArAi eke yathAyathabhAve (nijedera suvidhAmata) pravAhita karave|
tArA (tAdera) mAnata pUraNa kare (kartavya pAlana kare) evaM emana ekaTi dinake bhaYa kare yAra aniSTa have vyApaka|
tArA khAdyera prati bhAlavAsA sattveo (athavA AllAhara prati bhAlavAsAra janya) misakIna, iYAtIma o vandIke khAdya dAna kare|
(Ara vale,) “AmarA kevala AllAhara santuSTira janyai tomAderake khAoYAi, (era janya) tomAdera kAcha theke kona pratidAna kiMvA kRtajJatA cAi nA|
AmarA AmAdera prabhura kAcha theke eka kaThora o vipadamaYa dinera bhaYa kari|”
tAi AllAha tAderake sedinera aniSTa theke rakSA karavena evaM tAderake sajIvatA o Ananda dAna karavena|
Ara jAnnAta o rezamI pozAka dvArA tini tAdera dhairyadhAraNera puraskAra devena|
tArA sekhAne gadira opara helAna diYe vasave| sekhAne tArA sUrya (sUryera pracaNDa tApa) kiMvA tI\ ThANDA dekhate pAve nA|
jAnnAtera (gAchera) chAYA tAdera opara nuYe thAkave (chAYA devAra janya gAchagulo tAdera opara nuYe Asave) evaM tAra phalamUla tAdera nAgAlera madhye nice jhuliYe rAkhA have|
tAdera mAjhe parivezana karA have (khAdya o pAnIYa bharA) rupora pAtra o kA~cera pAnapAtra;
rupora tairI kA~cera mata (svaccha)| parivezanakArIrA saThikabhAve segulora parimApa Thika karave|
sekhAne tAderake emana peYAlA pAna karate deoYA have, yAte (yAra pAnIYate) AdAra mizraNa thAkave|
sekhAnakAra (jAnnAtera) ekaTi jharanA, yAra nAma sAlasAvIla|
tAdera mAjhe (esava) parivezana karave cirataruNa vAlakerA| tumi tAderake dekhale char3Ano muktA mane karave|
tumi yakhana sekhAnaTA dekhave takhana (AllAhara) eka neYAmata o virATa eka rAjya dekhate pAve|

tAdera gAYe thAkave savuja pAtalA rezamI vastra o nakazA-karA puru rezamI kApar3a| alaMkAra hiseve tAderake parAno have rupora kaMkana| Ara tAdera prabhu tAderake pAna karAvena pavitra (vizuddha) pAnIYa|
(tAderake valA have:) “eTA tomAdera puraskAra; Ara tomAdera praceSTA gRhIta haYeche|”
Amii tomAra opara paryAYakrame koraAna nAyila karechi|
ataeva, tomAra prabhura nirdezera janya dhairya dhara evaM tAdera kona pApI kiMvA avizvAsIra Anugatya karo nA|
sakAla-sandhyA tomAra prabhura nAma smaraNa kara|
rAtera kichu aMze tA~ra uddezye sejadA karo evaM rAtera dIrgha samaYa dhare tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA varNanA kara|
erA (ei avizvAsIrA) to vartamAna pArthiva jIvanakei bhAlavAse evaM eka kaThina dinake tAdera pechane phele rAkhe (upekSA kare)|
Amii tAderake sRSTi karechi evaM tAdera gaThana majavuta karechi| AvAra Ami yakhana icchA karava takhana tAdera parivarte tAdera matai Arekadalake niYe Asava (sRSTi karava)|
nizcaYai eTA ekaTA upadeza; ataeva, ye cAYa se yena tAra prabhura dikera patha avalamvana kare|
AllAha nA cAile tomarA (kona kichu) cAive nA| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, parama prajJAvAna|
tini yAke icchA svIYa anugrahera antarbhukta karena| Ara jAlemadera janya to prastuta rekhechena yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
zapatha kalyANera janya prerita vAtAsera,
pravala vege vaYe-yAoYA jhar3o hAoYAra,
megha char3iYe-deoYA vAtAsera,
nyAYa-anyAYera pArthakyakArI (koraAnera) AYAtasamUhera,
evaM navI-rasUladera kAche ohI niYe-AsA pherezatAdera—
ajuhAtera suyoga vandha karAra janya athavA satarka karAra janya!
tomAderake ye pratizruti deoYA hacche, avazyai tA vAstavAYita have|
yakhana tArakAderake AlokavihIna karA have,
yakhana AkAza vidIrNa karA have,
yakhana pAhAr3a-parvata vicUrNa karA have
evaM yakhana rasUlagaNake nirdhArita samaYe ekatrita karA have;
kon‌ dinera janya esava viSaYa sthagita rAkhA haYeche?
(nizcaYai) zeSa vicArera dinera janya|
tumi ki jAna, zeSa vicArera dina ki?
sedina avizvAsakArIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
Ami ki pUrvavartIderake dhvaMsa karini?
ataHpara paravartIderake tAdera anugAmI karava (paravartIdera sAtheo ekai AcaraNa karava)|
aparAdhIdera sAthe Ami emanai kare thAki|
sedina (keYAmatera dina) avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
Ami ki tomAderake eka ghRNita pAni (vIrya) theke sRSTi karini?
tArapara tA eka nirApada sthAne (mAtRgarbhe) rekhechi,
eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta,
tArapara Ami parimApa karechi (parimApamata sRSTi karechi)| kata uttama parimApakArI Ami!
sedina avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
Ami ki bhUmike rAkhAra pAtra karini
jIvita o mRtaderake (rAkhAra)?
tAte Ami sudRr3ha u~cu parvatamAlA sthApana karechi evaM tomAderake sumiSTa pAni pAna karate diYechi|
sedina avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
tomarA yA avizvAsa karate tAra dikei (sei jAhAnnAmera dikei) cala|
tina zAkhAviziSTa chAYAra dike (jAhAnnAmera Aguna theke nirgata tina kuNDalIviziSTa dho~YAra dike) cala,
yA zItala naYa evaM agnizikhAra tApa theke rakSA pete kAje Ase nA|
ei jAhAnnAma prAsAdera mata var3a var3a agnisphuliMga nikSepa karave
yena tA haluda uSTrIra pAla|
sedina avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
edina tArA kathA valave nA
evaM tAderake oyara peza karAra anumati deoYA have nA|
sedina avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
edinai zeSa vicArera dina| Ami tomAderake o pUrvavartIderake ekatrita karechi|
yadi tomAdera kona kauzala thAke tAhale AmAra sAthe kauzala kara|
sedina avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
mottAkIrA thAkave chAYA o jharanAra madhye
evaM tAdera AkAMkSita phalamUlera madhye| (tAderake emana jAYagAYa rAkhA have yekhAne gAchera chAYA, jharanA o tAdera pachandera phalamUla thAkave|)
(tAderake valA have:) “nijedera karmera puraskArasvarUpa tomarA tRptira sAthe pAnAhAra kara|”
Ami ebhAvei satkarmazIladerake puraskRta kari|
sedina avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
tomarA alpa kichudina khAo o bhoga kara| nizcaYai tomarA aparAdhI|
sedina avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
yakhana tAderake valA haYa, “ruku karo” takhana tArA ruku kare nA| (arthAt tAderake nAmAya par3ate valA hale tArA tA kare nA|)
sedina avizvAsIdera janya var3a durbhoga raYeche|
tAhale tArA ei koraAnera pare Ara kon‌ kathAYa vizvAsa karave?
tArA kon‌ vyApAre eke aparake jijJAsA karache?
sei virATa saMvAdaTira vyApAre,
yA niYe tAdera madhye matAnaikya raYeche|
nA nA, zigagirai tArA jAnave!
AvAra (vali) nA nA, zigagirai tArA jAnave!
Ami ki jaminake vichAnA vAnAini?
Ara parvatasamUhake pereka?
Ami tomAderake jor3A jor3A sRSTi karechi;
tomAdera ghumake vizrAmera vastu vAniYechi;
rAtake AvaraNa vAniYechi;
dinake jIvikA AharaNera samaYa karechi;
tomAdera (mAthAra) opara sudRr3ha sAta AsamAna nirmANa karechi
evaM (tAte) ekaTi prAjjevala pradIpa (sUrya) diYechi|
Ami vRSTivAhI meghamAlA theke pracura pAni varSaNa karechi,
tAra dvArA utpanna karAra janya zasya, udbhida
o ghana gAchapAlAviziSTa vAgAna|
nizcaYai vicArera dina nirdhArita Ache|
yedina ziGgAYa phu~ deoYA have Ara tomarA dale dale Asave,
AsamAna khule deoYA have Ara tAte aneka darajA have
evaM parvatasamUhake sthAnacyuta karA have Ara tA marIcikAYa pariNata have|
jAhAnnAma to apekSAYa thAkave,
sImAlaMghanakArIdera pratyAvartanasthalarUpe;
sekhAne tArA yuga yuga dhare vAsa karave|
sekhAne tArA kona ThANDA (vastu) kiMvA kona pAnIYa AsvAdana karave nA;
phuTanta pAni o pu~ja vyatIta;
(nijedera karmera) paripUrNa pratiphalasvarUpa|
tArA hisAvera AzA karata nA|
Ara AmAra AYAtasamUha ekevAre avizvAsa karata|
Ami savakichui likhitabhAve saMrakSaNa karechi|
ataeva, tomarA (zAstira) svAda grahaNa karo; Ami kevala tomAdera zAstii vAr3iYe deva|
mottAkIdera janya eka virATa sAphalya (jAnnAta) raYeche|
vAgAna, AGgura,
samavaYaskA unnatavakSA (pUrNayauvanA) taruNI
o (zarAvera) paripUrNa peYAlA|
sekhAne tArA kona nirarthaka o mithyA kathA zonave nA|
tomAra prabhura pakSa theke puuraskAra o hisAvamAphika (yathocita) dAnasvarUpa;
yini AsamAna o jamina evaM tAra madhyavartI savakichura prabhu, parama karuNAmaYa; (keYAmate) tArA tA~ra sAthe (tA~ra anumati chAr3A) kathA valAra adhikArI have nA|
yedina rUha (jivarAIla) o (anya) pherezatArA sArivaddhabhAve dA~r3Ave; daYAmaYa AllAha yAke (kathA valAra) anumati devena se vyatIta anyarA kathA valave nA evaM se satyai valave|
seTA satya dina; ataeva, yAra icchA se tAra prabhura kAche AzraYa nite pAre|
Ami tomAderake eka nikaTavartI zAsti samparke satarka karalAma; yedina mAnuSa tAra kRtakarma dekhate pAve evaM kAphera valave, “hAYa, Ami yadi mATi haYe yetAma!”
zapatha sei pherezatAdera, yArA kaSTa diYe (khArApa lokadera) prANa Tene vera kare (jAnakavaja kare);
sei pherezatAdera, yArA mRdubhAve (bhAla lokadera) prANera vA~dhana khule deYa;
sei pherezatAdera athavA graha-nakSatrera, yArA drutagatite (AkAze) sA~tAra kATe (bhese ver3AYa);
sei pherezatAdera athavA tArakAdera kiMvA ghor3Adera, yArA drutavege egiYe yAYa;
evaM sei pherezatAdera, yArA karmaparikalpanA grahaNa kare (athavA kAja susampanna kare)!
yedina (savakichu) prakampita karave prakampitakArI (prathama ziGgA&ni),
tAra parei Asave paravartITA (dvitIYa ziGgA&ni),
sedina katipaYa (mAnuSera) antara asthira thAkave|
tAdera dRSTi thAkave nicera dike|
tArA vale, “AmAderake satyai ki Agera avasthAYa phiriYe neoYA have?
AmarA yakhana kSaYaprApta hAr3a haYe yAva takhano? (AmAdera hAr3agor3a paryanta pace kSaYa haYe yAoYAra parao?)”
tArA vale, “tAhale to seTA have eka kSatikara pratyAvartana!”
tave ekaTimAtra vikaTa AoYAja have;
Ara takhani tArA (kavara theke) bhUpRSThe uThe Asave|
mUsAra ghaTanA ki tomAra jAnA Ache?
yakhana tAra prabhu tAke pavitra tuoYA upatyakAYa samvodhana kare valechilena,
“pherAunera kAche yAo, se to (aparAdhera) sImA chAr3iYe geche,
giYe vala: tomAra ki bhAla haoYAra icchA Ache?
Ami ki tomAke tomAra prabhura dike patha dekhAva, yAte tumi (tA~ke) bhaYa karo?”
ataHpara se tAke mahAnidarzana (mojeyA) dekhAlo|
kintu se avizvAsa karala o avAdhya hala|
tArapara se apapraYAsa cAlAnora janya prasthAna karala|
tArapara janasamAveza kare ghoSaNA karala:
valala, “Amii tomAdera savaceYe var3a prabhu|”
tAi AllAha tAke AkherAta o duniYAra zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karalena|
ye (AllAhake) bhaYa kare tAra janya nizcaYai ete ekaTi (var3a) zikSA raYeche|
tomAderake sRSTi karA vezi kaThina nA AsamAnake, yA tini nirmANa karechena;
tini era chAda u~cu karechena evaM eke sugaThita karechena;
era rAtake tini andhakArAcchanna karechena evaM era sakAlera Alo udbhAsita karechena|
era pare tini jaminake vichiYe diYechena|
tini tA theke tAra pAni o tRNa vera karechena|
Ara (tAte) dRr3habhAve pAhAr3a-parvata sthApana karechena,
tomAdera o tomAdera pazudera upakArera janya|
kintu yakhana mahAvipada (pratiphala divasa) upasthita have,
sedina mAnuSa tAra praceSTA (kRtakarma) smaraNa karave
evaM jAhAnnAmake prakAzye dekhAno have|
ye sImAlaMghana kareche,
Ara pArthiva jIvanake agrAdhikAra diYeche,
tAra vAsasthAna have jAhAnnAma|
Ara ye tAra prabhura sAmane dA~r3Anoke bhaYa kareche evaM kupravRtti theke nijeke phiriYe rekheche,
tAra vAsasthAna have jAnnAta|
tArA tomAke keYAmata samparke jijJAsA kare ye, tA kakhana saMghaTita have|
era varNanAra sAthe tomAra ki samparka? (arthAt e samparke kichu valAra mata jJAna to tomAra nei|)
era cUr3Anta jJAna raYeche tomAra prabhura kAche|
ei keYAmatake ye bhaYa kare, tomAra kAja kevala tAke satarka karA|
yedina tArA tA dekhate pAve, sedina mane have yena duniYAYa tArA mAtra ekaTi sandhyA kiMvA ekaTi sakAla avasthAna kareche|
se (rasUla) bhrUkuTi karala o mukha phiriYe nila,
tAra kAche andha lokaTi (AvdullAha ivane umme mAkatUma) ese par3AYa|
tumi kemana kare jAnave, se haYato parizuddha hata;
athavA upadeza grahaNa karata evaM ei upadeza tAra upakAre Asata|
ye loka kAro paroYA kare nA
tumi tAra dike manoyoga diccha;
athaca se parizuddha nA hale tomAra kona dAYa nei|
pakSAntare ye tomAra kAche chuTe ela,
Ara tAra madhye (AllAhara) bhaYao Ache,
tAra dike tumi manoyoga diccha nA|

evaM AmAra jAnnAte praveza kara|

Ara tumi ei nagarIte (aparAdha athavA vAdhA theke) mukta,

se ki mane kare ye, tAke keu dekheni?
Ami ki tAke duTi cokha deini?
evaM ekaTi jihavA o duTi Tho~Ta (deini)?

kintu se DhAlu giripathe calate pravRtta haYani (yA tAke sahaje sAphalye pau~che dita)|

ekaTi ghAr3a (ekajana dAsa) mukta kare deoYA;

nikaTa samparkera iYAtImake,
